english: But remember, the winning dart must hit a double! Not "doubling out" results in your score being reset to the previous score, and your turn ending!
zh: 但记住，决胜镖必须命中双倍区！若未命中双倍区，你在本回合的得分无效，还会直接结束这一回合！

english: Remember, at the end you need to check-out on a double or bull to win the game.

english: This game is easy, Niko. Your score starts at 301, first down to 0 wins.
zh: 这游戏很简单，尼克。开局每人301分，分数先到0的人赢。

english: Press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to fire. A rocket will not reach its destination instantly, for moving targets try anticipating where they might move.
zh: 按~INPUT_ATTACK~开火。火箭弹不会立刻击中目标，攻击移动目标时应预判提前量。

english: ~z~Damn, son. I shoulda guessed it. Only paper I got now are the handouts from Playboy. Fucking great. Later.
zh: ~z~靠，小子。我早该想到的。现在我所有的钱都是花花公子施舍的。太他妈棒了。回见。

english: ~z~Hey Dwayne, I've got your money. Come meet me in Middle Park and I'll give it to you.
zh: ~z~嘿德维恩，我拿到你的钱了。来中央公园找我，我会把它给你。

english: ~z~They are, I got rid of Jayvon for you but I let your ex go.
zh: ~z~是的，我替你除掉了杰丰，但我放你的前任走了。

english: ~z~They paid up? I guess my name still means something out there. People are still scared of me.
zh: ~z~他们付清了？看来我的名字在外面还是有点用的。别人还是怕我的。

english: ~z~What? Dwayne must a finished his bid. Shit, he going to be mad angry.
zh: ~z~什么？德维恩一定是刑满释放了。操，他会暴跳如雷的。

english: ~z~Dwayne, I'm sorry. They got away from me. You're still out of pocket.
zh: ~z~德维恩，我很抱歉。他们跑掉了。你还是一贫如洗。

english: ~z~They paid up? I guess my name still means something out there. People still know me.
zh: ~z~他们付清了？看来我的名字在外面还是有点用的。别人还是认我的。

english: ~z~I did what I did to survive. Please. I don't wanna die. Come on!
zh: ~z~我所做的都是为了生存。求求你，我不想死。求你了！

english: ~z~Dwayne, it's Niko. Your ex lost me. She had a motorbike.
zh: ~z~德维恩，我是尼克。你前任跑了。她开摩托跑了。

english: ~z~man, I was pulling moves in the joint so this bitch could pay the rent.
zh: ~z~兄弟，我蹲号子的时候都在运作安排，好给这婊子付房租。

english: ~z~I'm happy she ain't dead, though - she's just an idiot. Peace, man.
zh: ~z~不过她没死我也很高兴，她就是傻了点。再见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Dwayne wouldn't ever hurt no one he loved, even if they screwed him like I did.
zh: ~z~德维恩不会伤害他爱过的人的，就算他被那个人像我这样整了。

english: ~z~Damn, son. I shoulda guessed it. Only paper I got now are the handouts from Playboy. Fucking great. Later.
zh: ~z~靠，小子。我早该想到的。现在我所有的钱都是花花公子施舍的。太他妈棒了。回见。

english: ~z~Shit. Having no paper ain't good but it ain't nothing I ain't seen before. See you round, man.
zh: ~z~操。没钱不自在但什么大风大浪老子没经历过。回头见，老兄。

english: ~z~Hey, are you the two snakes who played Dwayne Forge when he was in the joint?
zh: ~z~喂，你俩就是德维恩･福吉蹲监狱的时候骗了他的混蛋？

english: ~z~She was going to say anything to get out of that. No getting out of it now.
zh: ~z~为了逃避惩罚，她什么话都说得出口。现在逃不掉了。

english: ~z~I thought Playboy was gonna look out for me but he didn't answer my calls. Punk didn't wanna know me.
zh: ~z~本来我以为花花公子会关照一下我，但他都不接我电话。那混蛋不想管我的事。

english: ~z~I didn't mean it. Girl get lonely when her man's inside for a long time.
zh: ~z~我不是故意的。男人在里面待太久的话，他的女人会寂寞的。

english: ~z~Don't kill me. I know I fucked Dwayne over real bad but he wouldn't want me dead.
zh: ~z~别杀我。我知道我把德维恩骗得很惨，但他不会想要我死的。

english: ~z~He too much of a gentleman for that. He ain't like that Playboy X punk, he's only chasing paper.
zh: ~z~他很仁慈，不会下手的。他只想要钱，不像花花公子X那个混蛋。

english: ~z~Dwayne, one of the guys who runs that gentlemen's club got away. I couldn't get control of it for you.
zh: ~z~德维恩， 其中一个绅士俱乐部的经理跑掉了。我没能替你把店夺回来。

english: ~z~Sorry Brucie man, I'm about to go see some naked women but this time it's business not pleasure.
zh: ~z~抱歉，布鲁斯老兄，我是要去看裸女，不过这次是正事，不是娱乐。

english: ~z~He still did business with the gangsters that took over. Screw that.
zh: ~z~他还在跟那些抢我地盘的混账做生意。去他妈的。

english: ~z~I appreciate your help, guys. Remind me to thank Dwayne, okay?
zh: ~z~多谢你们帮忙，二位。记得提醒我谢谢德维恩，好吗？

english: ~z~You guys are here to help. That's cool. Why don't we have some fun?
zh: ~z~你们就是我的帮手吧。很好。一起去找点乐子吧？

english: ~z~I think I'm going to lone wolf it from here on in. I'll write you a postcard or something.
zh: ~z~现在开始我想当匹孤狼。有空我会给你们寄点明信片的。

english: ~z~Hey, for friends of Dwayne's you look alright. Nice to know he's not hanging with crack heads no more.
zh: ~z~嘿，作为德维恩的朋友你们还挺正常的。很高兴知道他周围不是一群瘾君子。

english: ~z~Alright, we had some fun, yeah? Now go get back to your wife and kids.
zh: ~z~好了，我们很爽不是？现在回家陪老婆孩子去吧。

english: ~z~Fucking coward would rather everyone go down than him take a fall alone.
zh: ~z~傻逼儿子，宁可大家一起完蛋，也不肯自己一个人坐牢。

english: ~z~Exactly! And this guy is still threatening to kill me, and my family!
zh: ~z~正是！然后这人，他还是威胁要杀我，杀我全家！

english: ~z~Good, yeah... alive or dead, it's all the same though, isn't it?
zh: ~z~好啊，确实...是死是活，其实都差不多，不是吗？

english: ~z~I need time to prepare for bad news, you bastard. Shite.
zh: ~z~我得先做好听坏消息的心理准备，你这混蛋。操。

english: ~z~I need time to prepare for bad news, you bastard. Shite.
zh: ~z~我得先做好听坏消息的心理准备，你这混蛋。操。

english: ~z~Living, dead, good, bad, right, wrong, chalk, cheese...
zh: ~z~是死，是活，是好，是坏，是对，是错，是是，是非...

english: ~z~Because it feels nice... because it feels better to be high than not...
zh: ~z~因为这样很舒服...因为嗨的时候比不嗨感觉要好...

english: ~z~It's like fucking Cain and Abel the two of us. No wonder I turned into the wreck you see before ya.
zh: ~z~我们俩就像该隐跟亚伯。也难怪我会变成你见过的那副熊样。

english: ~z~He's paying for protection, Niko. Protect him, why don't ya.
zh: ~z~他可是付了保护费的，尼克。你就保护保护他嘛。

english: ~z~Get over it, Derrick. He was a smuggler and the cash was fake. I'll see you around.
zh: ~z~让它过去吧，德里克。他是个走私者，钱也是假钞。我们之后见。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. The Korean and his notes need our help.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克。那个韩国人和他的钞票需要我们救。

english: ~z~Christ, the notes may be fake but these bullets ain't. Get closer to Kim.
zh: ~z~老天，钞票可能是假的，子弹可是真家伙。靠近金一点。

english: ~z~Escorting a Korean contact of mine into the country with a boat load of fake hundred dollar bills.
zh: ~z~护送我的朝鲜联络人入境，他的船上装满了百元假钞。

english: ~z~A rocket launcher. It's in the back. Get rid of the chopper with it. I'll drive the boat.
zh: ~z~火箭发射器，就在后头。拿它把那架直升机打下来，船我替你开。

english: ~z~Needless to say, he'll be inside for a time. Him and Bucky think I talked.
zh: ~z~想都不用想，他肯定得进去一段时间。他和巴基觉得是我告发的。

english: ~z~Maybe Frankie has been tapping Ma's fucking phone and he called this in to mess with me.
zh: ~z~说不定弗兰基这厮一直在偷听妈的电话，这群人就是他派来搞我的。

english: ~z~Shit, Derrick. You sound almost like a human being. I might just see you there.
zh: ~z~妈的，德里克。你这是活过来了啊。我们码头见吧。

english: ~z~I owe ya an apology, Niko. I was dosed when you told me you'd killed Bucky and his boys.
zh: ~z~我欠你一句道歉，尼克。你跟我说你杀了巴基和他的手下的时候我刚好药嗑多了。

english: ~z~Here we are. Got him here in one piece. That was the deal. Thanks, Niko.
zh: ~z~我们到了，把他安全护送到这儿了。就这点事，谢了，尼克。

english: ~z~That's all you can hope for in this God forsaken world. See you round, Niko.
zh: ~z~在这个被神抛弃的世界也没别的指望了。回头见，尼克。

english: ~z~Over there, we used to buy 'em off him off of him then exchange 'em for genuine currency.
zh: ~z~在爱尔兰的时候，我们就问他买假钞，然后再洗成真钱。

english: ~z~Fuck! You'd think the Coastguard had drowning kids to save.
zh: ~z~妈的！搞得好像海岸警卫队有溺水的孩子要救似的。

english: ~z~I didn't think he even knew I was back. Can't the man just let his brother be?
zh: ~z~我都没想到他居然知道我回来了。这家伙就不能放他兄弟一马吗？

english: ~z~Shit, I hope me dealer will front me another dime bag. I'll call ya, Niko.
zh: ~z~操蛋，希望卖我毒品的人肯让我再赊一包。过会儿再联系，尼克。

english: ~z~Only place for it, me boy. Only place for it. See you soon.
zh: ~z~只会花在那儿，小伙子。只会花在那儿的。之后见。

english: ~z~Another immigrant, arriving in this city, trying to make something of himself.
zh: ~z~又一个移民来到了这座城市，想让自己有所成就。

english: ~z~I don't know. I told my dealer I was good for the money I owed him.
zh: ~z~不知道。我跟卖我毒品的人说过我很快就能把欠他的钱还上了。

english: ~z~Doesn't look like the arrival of these notes was such a secret. Can you think of why that is?
zh: ~z~走私钞票的消息好像保密不够到位嘛？你知道咋回事吗？

english: ~z~When you put it like that, he reminds me of a McReary. Good luck to him.
zh: ~z~你这么一说，倒让我想起某个姓麦克雷里的了。祝他好运。

english: ~z~We got to make sure these notes make it, just to piss off Frankie if nothing else.
zh: ~z~我们一定要把这些钞票送到，不为别的，就是要气死弗兰基。

english: ~z~Nice scam if you don't hit the same place too often. His boys are pulling the same gig over here.
zh: ~z~不盯着一个地方洗就不会被发现。他的人要在这里来这套。

english: ~z~Is that because he's coming into the country to rob the good people of America of their hard earned money?
zh: ~z~是不是因为他入境也是来掠夺美国好人的血汗钱的？

english: ~z~Anyway, I figured you'd know a thing or two about smuggling stuff into the country.
zh: ~z~再说，你对怎么把东西偷运入境应该也略知一二。

english: ~z~I haven't felt safe since Aiden O'Malley went inside.
zh: ~z~自从艾登･奥马利进局子以后，我就没觉得安全过。

english: ~z~Shit, there goes pay day. At least he died rich, eh?
zh: ~z~妈的，发薪日泡汤了。好歹他是死在富贵里，对吧？

english: ~z~Sure, I been telling a few people about this, but, hell, I smell a rat.
zh: ~z~的确，我有跟别人说过这事。不过，妈的，肯定是有人泄密。

english: ~z~Yeah, welcome to America. We're meeting your friends in Bohan. I'll text ya the route you got to take.
zh: ~z~对，欢迎来到美国。我们要去波汉和你的朋友碰头。要走的路线我会发给你。

english: ~z~Him and them notes ain't gonna do shit for us no more. Let's go back to land.
zh: ~z~他和那些钞票对咱们已经没用了。咱们回岸上吧。

english: ~z~You're illegal, right? You think us McRearys was legal when we came here?
zh: ~z~你是非法移民，对吧？你以为我们麦克雷里家族刚来这儿的时候就是合法公民吗？

english: ~z~Maybe a few people at the pub I borrowed money from, as well. You'll say anything for a fix.
zh: ~z~也可能是酒馆里借给我钱的人。为了毒品你什么都会说。

english: ~z~It's about bloody time. I been in there doing a stretch I didn't deserve for too long.
zh: ~z~也该到时候了。我在里面蹲了太久本不该蹲的牢。

english: ~z~He's a rat, Derrick McReary. Always has been always will be.
zh: ~z~他才是叛徒，德里克･麦克雷里。过去是，以后也是。

english: ~z~But it ain't like I'm going to put a weapon in his hand just so I can pop him, is it? You do what you got to do.
zh: ~z~可我也不能为了崩了他，先塞把枪到他手上，对吧？该怎么做你就怎么做。

english: ~z~Niko, I hear my brother Derrick is asking you to ice his old drinking buddy, Aiden O'Malley?
zh: ~z~尼克，听说我哥哥德里克让你去做掉他的老酒友艾登･奥马利？

english: ~z~You boys have got to know about giving it back to someone as good as they gave it to you.
zh: ~z~你们哥几个都懂这个理儿：人家怎么对你的，你就怎么还回去。

english: ~z~Thank Christ, the Virgin and every damn saint who ever walked on God's green Earth for you guys.
zh: ~z~为了你们几个，感谢基督、圣母和上帝大地上走过的每个圣人。

english: ~z~Don't think about it, man, he was a rat. I don't believe a word he said about Derrick. He's fish food.
zh: ~z~别想了，老兄，他就是个叛徒。他说德里克的话我一个字都不信。他已经喂鱼了。

english: ~z~She stopped writing and coming on visiting days but I could tell she was still thinking of me. I knew it.
zh: ~z~她确实不给我写信也不来探监了，不过她一定还想着我。我就知道。

english: ~z~I'd been praying to be rescued since the first day they incarcerated me in that God forsaken place.
zh: ~z~从他们把我关进那个被上帝遗弃的鬼地方第一天起，我就在祈祷有人来救我。

english: ~z~Or doing a kind turn for someone who's helped you out in the past. That's what this is about, isn't it?
zh: ~z~又或是帮一个从前帮过你的人一把。这趟就是这个意思，不是吗？

english: ~z~Okay, it looks like we've lost them. Take us over to the cliffs in Leftwood.
zh: ~z~好了，应该甩掉他们了。带我们去左伍德的悬崖。

english: ~z~We better split up so the cops don't make us for what went down in the tunnel.
zh: ~z~咱们最好分头走，免得警察把隧道里的事认到咱们头上。

english: ~z~Christ, someone knows. Someone cares about old Aiden O'Malley. I knew someone had to care.
zh: ~z~老天，有人知道我。还有人关心老艾登･奥马利。我就知道总有人关心。

english: ~z~You've made me a happy man, boys. Now it's time to tell me who asked you to do this.
zh: ~z~你们让我的日子又快活了，孩子们。现在该告诉我是谁让你们这么做了吧。

english: ~z~We need to lose this van, Packie. The cops'll be looking for it.
zh: ~z~我们得把这辆车处理掉，派奇。条子会一直找它的。

english: ~z~Fuck me. Aiden O'Malley sprung from the joint. Wait until this gets around the yard.
zh: ~z~我靠。艾登･奥马利越狱了。等这事在牢里传开再说吧。

english: ~z~So you thought you'd talk about him? He's my brother, and guys like you are killin' him!
zh: ~z~就你还能对他说三道四？他是我哥哥，你这样的人都要害死他了。

english: ~z~Just to be outta these clothes, to be able to get up when I want to get up and walk where I want to walk.
zh: ~z~脱掉这身衣服，想什么时候起就什么时候起，想去哪儿就去哪儿，就值了。

english: ~z~When we have them blocked in, we take down the escort and make off with the prisoner.
zh: ~z~堵住他们以后，我们就干掉护卫，带着囚犯逃跑。

english: ~z~Name Derrick McReary ring any bells? He's my brother.
zh: ~z~德里克･麦克雷里这名儿有印象吗？他是我哥哥。

english: ~z~Is that why you were in the cop shop? Trying to find another way out of the penal system?
zh: ~z~你去警察局是为了这个？想找另一条路钻出监狱系统？

english: ~z~Okay, man. First thing we gotta do is dump this prison van. Cops'll be looking.
zh: ~z~好了，兄弟。我们要做的第一件事就是扔了这辆囚车。条子会来找的。

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. Now that we lost 'em we gotta go out to the cliffs in Leftwood.
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。既然已经甩掉了他们，我们就该去左伍德的悬崖了。

english: ~z~Who knows? Anyway, the convoy with O'Malley in it has to go through the Booth Tunnel.
zh: ~z~谁知道呢？反正押送奥马利的车队必定会经过布斯隧道。

english: ~z~We've got rid of the unwanted attention. Now it's time for business. Get us to the cliffs in Leftwood.
zh: ~z~甩掉这帮多余的人了。现在该做正事了，带我们去左伍德的悬崖。

english: ~z~I don't want to die, I've been rotting in prison for years. I don't want to die.
zh: ~z~我不想死，我都在监狱里烂了这么多年了。我不想死。

english: ~z~I left a truck with a rocket launcher in it for ya in an alley, off of Applewhite in Alderney City.
zh: ~z~我在一条巷子里给你留了辆装有火箭发射器的卡车，~n~在奥尔德尼市的阿普尔怀特街上。

english: ~z~Shake these cops, Niko. We need them to think Aiden is free as a fucking bird.
zh: ~z~甩掉这些条子，尼克。我们要让他们认为艾登现在跟小鸟一样自在。

english: ~z~Please, Niko, boy... just this last one... please?
zh: ~z~拜托了，尼克，孩子...就这最后一次...拜托了？

english: ~z~Problem is, he's the first one they'd talk to if that happened. We got to make this look like a prison break.
zh: ~z~问题在于，真那样的话，警察第一个就会找他问话。我们得把它演成劫囚。

english: ~z~The way I got treated in there by the warden, by the screws, by every fucking inmate in the joint.
zh: ~z~我在里面受的待遇，狱长、狱警，还有牢里每一个该死的犯人那样对我的方式。

english: ~z~The whiskey, the women, every fucking thing a free man takes for granted.
zh: ~z~威士忌、女人，自由人习以为常的每一件该死的事。

english: ~z~O'Malley is in government custody. He's got more police protection than the mayor.
zh: ~z~奥马利现在受政府羁押，保护他的警察比保护市长的还多。

english: ~z~Get rid of this attention, Niko. We don't want anyone after us while we're doing what we gotta do.
zh: ~z~摆脱通缉，尼克。我们可不想在做正事的时候被人追着。

english: ~z~Derrick, Packie is going to help me on this job. He's going to help me get Aiden O'Malley.
zh: ~z~德里克，派奇会帮我干这票。他会帮我抓艾登･奥马利。

english: ~z~The cliffs of Leftwood then. Is there a boat coming or something? Where am I going?
zh: ~z~左伍德的悬崖是吧。那边有船来接吗？我会去哪儿？

english: ~z~So you thought you'd rat him out? This is the last sunset you're ever going to see. Enjoy it...
zh: ~z~所以你就觉得你也能卖了他？这是你能看见的最后一次日落了。好好享受吧...

english: ~z~Great. They're leaving the old cop shop now, should be at the Booth Tunnel soon.
zh: ~z~好了。他们从老警局出发了，很快就会到布斯隧道。

english: ~z~We got to lose this heat before we can send this fucker where he's going.
zh: ~z~我们得先把条子甩了，才能把这逼送到该去的地方。

english: ~z~Disappear, prisoner. Your old life is over. It's time to start a new one.
zh: ~z~消失吧，囚犯。你的旧生活结束了。该开始新的了。

english: ~z~This is a fucking miracle. Shit, I'm free. I've imagined this day for years.
zh: ~z~这真他妈是奇迹。妈的，我自由了。这一天我想了好多年。

english: ~z~Good, good. Make him pay, Niko. Make him pay for the shit he's been talking.
zh: ~z~好，好。让他付出代价，尼克。让他为那些屁话付出代价。

english: ~z~How does a decent criminal stand a chance of losing the cops when they send choppers after him?
zh: ~z~他们连直升机都派出来了，一个守规矩的罪犯哪还有机会甩掉条子？

english: ~z~Thanks. Maybe a clean break is in order. A fresh beginning.
zh: ~z~谢了，也许就此一刀两断比较合适。全新的开始。

english: ~z~Who knows where I'm heading but it ain't Alderney. Maybe I'll go west. Follow the setting sun.
zh: ~z~谁知道我要去哪儿，反正不是奥尔德尼。也许往西走，追着落日走。

english: ~z~I'm gonna come in from the rear and block 'em that way. Pick up the truck and gimme a call.
zh: ~z~我就从后面跟进来，断了他们的后路。拿到卡车后给我打个电话。

english: ~z~That's what I want, sea air. Thank you, boys. Thank you.
zh: ~z~这就是我要的，海风。谢谢你们，小子们。谢谢。

english: ~z~This ain't my idea of fun, boys. Would ya give me a hand?
zh: ~z~这跟我那种乐子不太一样，小子。麻烦您老帮个忙好吗？

english: ~z~The cops is gonna know it wasn't a prison break when they find Aiden. Shit. I'll call Derrick.
zh: ~z~条子找到艾登就会发现这不是一次劫狱了。操。我给德里克打个电话。

english: ~z~I knew that no matter how long I rotted in there, people on the outside world still remember me.
zh: ~z~我就知道不论要在里面烂上多久，外面总有人记着我的。

english: ~z~I tell you, you go into them showers clean and you come out dirty. You catch my drift, son?
zh: ~z~跟你说，进淋浴间时干干净净，出来就脏透了。懂我意思吧，小子？

english: ~z~Shit, I don't even know who sent you guys. Who do I got to thank for springing me from the joint?
zh: ~z~靠，都不知道你们是谁派的。我要感谢哪位大哥出手相助？

english: ~z~A lot of people need a fresh start, I hope you make the most of yours.
zh: ~z~很多人都需要个新起点，希望你能好好把握你的。

english: ~z~Alright, man. We're coming to ya. Take out the escort but keep Derrick's pal alive.
zh: ~z~好的，兄弟。我这边快到了。干掉护卫，但别伤着德里克的旧友。

english: ~z~You've made me a happy man, boys. Now it's time to tell me who asked you to do this.
zh: ~z~你们让我的日子又快活了，孩子们。现在该告诉我是谁让你们这么做了吧。

english: ~z~Thanks. Maybe a clean break is in order. A fresh beginning.
zh: ~z~谢了，也许就此一刀两断比较合适。全新的开始。

english: ~z~Well, Derrick's going to be relieved. Thanks for doing that, Niko.
zh: ~z~德里克总算能松口气了。谢谢你办了这件事，尼克。

english: ~z~For the grace of God, all but for the grace of God I coulda died in there.
zh: ~z~托上帝的福，要不是上帝保佑，我就死在里面了。

english: ~z~You'll find out who it was when we get there. In the mean time, shut the hell up buddy!
zh: ~z~到地方以后你就知道是谁了。至于现在，麻烦您老先闭上嘴！

english: Some bikers are escaping by boat. There are boats moored around the shoreline should you need them.
zh: 有些飞车党正用船逃跑，你应该需要那些停泊在岸边的船。

english: You've found the deal. The ~r~targets~s~ are spread over every floor of this building. Work your way up, clear them out.
zh: 你找到了交易地点，~r~目标~s~分散在大楼的各个楼层。用你的方法干掉他们。

english: You've taken the drugs and eliminated the witnesses. Get to the ~Y~rendezvous point.~S~
zh: 你已经拿到毒品并消灭了目击者，前往~Y~会合地点。~S~

english: ~z~I got this meeting over on Joliet Street. There's a rifle up on the roof of the place next door.
zh: ~z~我把交易安排在了乔利埃特街。那边对面的屋顶上有把狙击枪。

english: ~z~I think it'll be a bit more taxing than hanging with Manny on "the streets".
zh: ~z~我觉得这活比跟曼尼一起在「街道」上转悠更费事。

english: ~z~You don't trust these guys you're doing the deal with, how come you trust me?
zh: ~z~你都不相信那些跟你交易的人，怎么还信得过我？

english: ~z~Mallorie was right about you. You are good. I have some more work for you.
zh: ~z~玛洛丽说的没错，你很棒。我还有更多工作给你。

english: ~z~Putana. How I going to explain this to his hermano? I wish you had learned to shoot.
zh: ~z~妈逼的。我怎么跟他的兄弟解释？真希望你有学过打枪。

english: ~z~I need someone no one knows to oversee a deal I'm not sure about.
zh: ~z~我需要一个没人认识的人，去盯一场我不太放心的交易。

english: ~z~Maybe I was too busy saving your ass to clean up your mess? Sue me.
zh: ~z~可能是我忙着救你的命，没空收拾残局？你打我啊。

english: ~z~So I said if that's the way you want it amigo, then that's what you're gonna get. And that shut him up.
zh: ~z~我就说，你要真想这样，大兄弟，那我就满足你。然后就让他闭了嘴。

english: ~z~Sorry, I just didn't want them trying nothing with your boy. I'll come see you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，我只是想让他们别打你的人的主意。我会来找你的。

english: ~z~What you doing? I get a call from these dealers saying someone shooting at 'em.
zh: ~z~你干了什么？我刚接到了卖家的电话说有人枪击他们。

english: ~z~You want to start rolling with me, drive me back to my crib in Northwood on X.
zh: ~z~你要是想跟我混，就送我回我在北伍德的克塞诺泰姆街的公寓。

english: ~z~Nah? You sound like you coming outta Russia with that accent. That all good, money.
zh: ~z~不是吗？听口音你像是俄罗斯出来的。也没事，老弟。

english: ~z~There ain't a deal in this town I don't know about. I own this city, for real.
zh: ~z~这座城市里就没有我不知道的交易。城市是我的，真的。

english: ~z~You take a bid on a heroin beef you ain't seeing light for a long time.
zh: ~z~一旦被卷入海洛因的交易，你就得过上好久暗无天日的生活了。

english: ~z~For real. My crib's over on Galveston Avenue in North Holland.
zh: ~z~是真的。我的宝贝家在北荷兰的加尔维斯顿大道上。

english: ~z~I don't go near the stuff... professionally... but I found him a buyer.
zh: ~z~我不卖那玩意...说真的...但我帮他找了个买家。

english: ~z~Build me some skyscrapers. See my name in big gold letters.
zh: ~z~给我建一些摩天大楼，看着我的名字金光闪闪的刻在上边。

english: ~z~Elizabeta don't get me to do shit. I just like to keep an eye on things.
zh: ~z~不是伊丽莎贝塔叫我去做事。我只是想盯着情况。

english: ~z~What type of shit you got going on? I'm always looking for work, if it pays that is.
zh: ~z~你还在做什么生意？我一直都在找活，能赚钱就行。

english: ~z~I like to make money, but there should be other considerations when you go into business with a person.
zh: ~z~我喜欢赚钱，但你和别人做生意应该还有其他考量吧。

english: ~z~Yo. They gonna expect us to go out the front with that biker dude.
zh: ~z~哟，他们肯定以为我们会和摩托老哥一起走正门。

english: ~z~My man Dwayne Forge is inside on a crack beef.
zh: ~z~我哥们德维恩･福吉就因为卖霹雳可卡因进去了。

english: ~z~Elizabeta, your friend, the playboy, he's dead. The contact was a cop.
zh: ~z~伊丽莎贝塔，你的朋友，那个花花公子，他死了。联络人是个警察。

english: ~z~I'm buying and selling that shit like any commodity on the trading floor.
zh: ~z~我买卖那玩意儿跟在证券交易所买卖商品是一样的。

english: ~z~Playboy was a fool, but he earned. This ain't good. Come back to see me.
zh: ~z~花花公子是个傻子，但是他能挣钱。这可不好。快回来找我。

english: ~z~That was crazy, money. You a good man to have around when the shit goes down.
zh: ~z~这简直疯了，老弟。遇到这种鸟事时你能够在身边太好了。

english: ~z~Yeah, but Playboy is going legitimate. I wanna be one of them developer cats.
zh: ~z~是的，但是花花公子要洗白自己。我也想做一个房产商。

english: ~z~Street cats like me just get labeled as pimps, and pushers and stickup artists.
zh: ~z~像我这样的街头混混只会被贴上皮条客、毒贩子、抢劫艺术家的标签。

english: ~z~I'm afraid that your friend Playboy, he had an accident, he ain't gonna be around no more.
zh: ~z~恐怕你的朋友花花公子他出事了，他不会再出现在你身边了。

english: ~z~Not big enough for some people. What that other gang called? Death Angels or some shit.
zh: ~z~对某些人还不够大。另一派叫啥来着？死灵天使还是啥的。

english: ~z~Shit man. I'd a fucking died instead of being caught by them feds.
zh: ~z~妈的，老弟。比起被FIB抓住，我宁愿直接去死。

english: ~z~You think I'm short of paper? I just helping out on this deal because Liz is my business partner.
zh: ~z~你觉得我会缺票子？我给这次交易帮忙，只是因为莉兹是我的生意伙伴。

english: ~z~Hell yeah, the amount of rubles being dropped up in Liberty City is a joke.
zh: ~z~太对了，自由城的卢布数量逐渐下降就是个笑话。

english: ~z~But you've got the heroin, correct? You're carrying it, correct? I mean it's a simple question.
zh: ~z~你们手头有海洛因，对吧？你们带过来了，对吧？就这么简单一问题。

english: ~z~You obviously ain't been big time. I started small like you, player.
zh: ~z~你之前肯定还不够格。刚开始我也是小喽啰，玩家。

english: ~z~For sure. Let me hook up with your number. You got a cell, right?
zh: ~z~当然，让我存一下你的手机号。你有手机，对吧？

english: ~z~Them boys, the Lost, they in some heavy type of gang war is what I heard. Crazy whiteboy shit.
zh: ~z~那群家伙，失落帮，好像在进行激烈的帮派战争。一群白皮疯子。

english: ~z~Johnny, your biker friend, got himself killed before the meet. Sorry.
zh: ~z~强尼，你的摩托帮朋友，在见面交易前就死了。抱歉。

english: ~z~Tell me about that biker, the one with the smack, Johnny.
zh: ~z~跟我讲讲那个飞车党吧，有海洛因的那个，强尼。

english: ~z~There be the smack tip, the rap game, X, chronic, meth...
zh: ~z~有海洛因针管，说唱游戏，摇头丸，大麻，冰毒...

english: ~z~She my SoBo connection, hooks me up when I need her to.
zh: ~z~她是我在南波汉的线人，需要的时候她就会联系我。

english: ~z~Sure, let's do this. Nothing like selling some dope to let you know you're alive.
zh: ~z~当然，我们开干吧。只有贩毒才能让你有活着的感觉。

english: ~z~It's like X marks the spot. That's coz I was always on the same corner pushing weight.

zh: ~z~现在一点小事都能让他暴跳如雷。我永远不知道他下一枪打谁，下一刀捅谁。

english: ~z~What the hell did you do that for? How are we supposed to make them pay up now?
zh: ~z~见鬼你干嘛杀了他？我们现在该怎么让他们交钱？

english: ~z~At least he's alive, eh? Mikhail don't always go for the gut shots.
zh: ~z~至少他还活着，嗯？米哈伊尔不是每次都朝肚子打的。

english: ~z~His wife, she is a mess. And he does not let up on me. We need the old Mikhail back.
zh: ~z~他的妻子，是一团糟。他也没有放过我，我们想要从前的米哈伊尔回来。

english: ~z~You can't even hit him in the leg. He has learned at least. Let's go.
zh: ~z~你一点也不能打他的腿，你看他至少知道了轻重，我们走吧

english: ~z~This guy been making porno in his basement and he didn't cut Mikhail in.
zh: ~z~这家伙在他的地下室拍毛片，还不给米哈伊尔分账。

english: ~z~Andrei, who you met in Mikhail's basement. He was always loyal, he was a good worker,
zh: ~z~安德烈，你在米哈伊尔的地下室见着的那个，他一直很忠诚，是个得力干将。

english: ~z~Faustin, things got difficult in the shop. I left Dimitri there to deal with it.
zh: ~z~福斯汀，店里的事情有点棘手。我把迪米特里留那儿应付了。

english: ~z~You need to control yourself, you could become like Mikhail.
zh: ~z~你要控制住自己，不然就会变得跟米哈伊尔一样了。

english: ~z~No, it's Mikhail that has that issue. Can't keep his finger off of the triggers.
zh: ~z~不，有异议的是米哈伊尔。他的手指就是离不开扳机。

english: ~z~You guys are getting protection money off of websites now? What, you stop them from getting viruses?
zh: ~z~你们现在还要收网站的保护费了吗？怎么，交了钱就不会中病毒？

english: ~z~Mikhail seems to go after those close to him, like Ilyena.
zh: ~z~米哈伊尔似乎在追逐那些和他亲近的人，比如伊莲娜。

english: ~z~I'm just in this for the bitches, I don't wanna get hurt! Please. Please. Come on.
zh: ~z~我只是为了那些婊子，我并不想伤到谁！拜托拜托，走啊。

english: ~z~Screw you, we're seeing a friend of mine who's got a good line on weapons.
zh: ~z~去你的吧，我们要去找我朋友，他在军火上很有路子。

english: ~z~Fuck! You're lucky Roman don't try to make you kill someone every two seconds.
zh: ~z~操！罗曼没有隔两秒就让你去杀个人真是你的福气。

english: ~z~Thank you for your help, Niko. Come to see us at the club soon. Mikhail will be cool by then.
zh: ~z~感谢你的帮助，尼克。过后来俱乐部找我们，到时候米哈伊尔应该就消气了。

english: ~z~Yeah, you will. Especially since you got rid of Vlad, our fucking debt collector.
zh: ~z~是的，你会的。更何况你还做掉了弗拉德，我们手下的讨债人。

english: ~z~Guns don't seem that controlled. I seen plenty and I just got here.
zh: ~z~感觉枪也没管那么严啊，我刚到这里就见着一堆了。

english: ~z~Am I helping pick out a porno for you? I think you know best what you like.
zh: ~z~我是要帮你挑片子吗？我觉得你最清楚自己的口味。

english: ~z~You fuckin' Ruskies are milking me dry. I ain't a cow.
zh: ~z~你们这些狗逼俄国佬要把我榨干了，我又不是奶牛。

english: ~z~Remind Faustin of that, maybe then he will not try to kill me.
zh: ~z~提醒福斯汀这一点，也许那样他就不会想杀我了。

english: ~z~I'm special, I'm gonna be a star. Don't hurt me. A big, big star!
zh: ~z~我很特别，我会成为明星的，别伤害我，我是一颗闪亮的明星！

english: ~z~Yes, you're right. It looks like I need to protect myself and my cousin in this place.
zh: ~z~是的，你说的对，我似乎是得在这里保护我和我堂兄。

english: ~z~I got something special in these pants, I need to show it to the world.
zh: ~z~我裤子里有个特别的东西，我还要向全世界展示它呢。

english: ~z~Listen, big guy. You got a great look going on, real strong. We could put you in one of our films.
zh: ~z~听着，大块头，你看起来很棒，力大无比，你可以来参演我们的片子。

english: ~z~You got to remember, you killed Vlad. That angered Mikhail no matter what he said.
zh: ~z~你要记住，你杀了弗拉德，把米哈伊尔惹怒了，之后他说的都不算数。

english: ~z~I told you to shoot him in the leg. It matters little. Let's get out of here.
zh: ~z~我都跟你说了你开枪打他的腿，不过都没关系了，我们赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~Joseph, I thought you were a better businessman than this. We go, Niko.
zh: ~z~约瑟夫，我还以为你是个聪明的生意人，走吧，尼克。

english: ~z~Hey, I heard about these. Big American Supermarket where you can buy any gun you want.
zh: ~z~嘿，这我听说过。美国大商场，想买什么枪就买什么枪。

english: ~z~Or selling hash to tourists in Red Square, or still in the navy? Which is it today?
zh: ~z~还是在红场卖大麻给游客？还是还在海军待着？哪个会是现在的状况？

english: ~z~I guess Roman's real lucky then. I wonder what big favor Faustin's gonna do for him next?
zh: ~z~那我猜罗曼真的很走运了。不过你说福斯汀接下来会对他做什么？

english: ~z~I can't die today. I'm special. I'm really special. I can show you...
zh: ~z~我现在不能死，我很特别、我真的很特别，我可以给你们看看...

english: ~z~Is that a fact? Maybe we can't pop you, Joseph. But we can fuck up one of your boys.
zh: ~z~这是事实吗？也许我们不能立刻崩了你，约瑟夫，但我们可以干死你的一个手下。

english: ~z~I'm into more shit than Mikhail could even imagine. Why would I rat?
zh: ~z~我知道的屁事比米哈伊尔能想到的还多，我为什么要告密？

english: ~z~You and Mikhail will be killed if anything happens to me.
zh: ~z~要是我有什么三长两短，你和米哈伊尔就都死定了。

english: ~z~Think? Look where your thinking has got us.
zh: ~z~想想？也不看看你的想想都让我们落到什么地步了。

english: ~z~You let him go? You disobeyed me? Maybe it is you I should have killed. You and Dimitri.
zh: ~z~你放他走了？你居然违抗我的命令？可能我该杀的是你，你和迪米特里都是。

english: ~z~Dimitri, should I do this? Should I kill this boy for Mr. Faustin?
zh: ~z~迪米特里，我该下手吗？我该替福斯汀先生杀了这小子吗？

english: ~z~No, I never change my mind. I've heard he's at the Guantanamo Avenue station.
zh: ~z~不，我从来不会改变主意。听说他在关塔那摩大道站。

english: ~z~I'm sorry Niko. Thank you. At least you are loyal. We will work together again, come to see me at my house.
zh: ~z~我很抱歉尼克，谢谢你，至少你是忠诚的，我们会再次一起工作，来我家找我。

english: ~z~Dimitri, Dimitri, hey, hey, uh... meet my girl, Natasha.
zh: ~z~迪米特里，迪米特里，嘿，嘿，呃...瞧瞧我的女伴，娜塔莎。

english: ~z~Shut up Dimitri, I don't care who he is. It is too late anyway. Niko has killed him. Stop your whining.
zh: ~z~迪米特里，能消停会吗，我不在乎他是谁，反正已经太晚了，尼克都杀了他了。别抱怨了。

english: ~z~Mikhail Faustin don't like you no more. It's nothing personal.
zh: ~z~米哈伊尔･福斯汀不再中意你了，不是什么私仇。

english: ~z~You were in charge of security. Good job. Well done, Dimitri.
zh: ~z~安全方面是你负责的，干得好，真是好，迪米特里。

english: ~z~Hey, Lenny. Mr. Faustin thinks you're a rat. He ain't taking no risks.
zh: ~z~嘿，莱尼。福斯汀先生认为是你泄的密，他不会接受这个风险。

english: ~z~they've been authorized to tap our phones and they know about the pot we stole.
zh: ~z~他们已经获准窃听我们的电话，还挖到了我们偷大麻的事。

english: ~z~He's my cousin's boyfriend. It's not him. Yes, he's a moron, yes, but he's okay.
zh: ~z~他是我堂妹的男友，不会是他。对，他是个呆子，是的，但他人还行。

english: ~z~You would still be in a fucking Gulag if it wasn't for me. You'd be drilling for oil in the tundra.
zh: ~z~要不是有我，你还会被困在狗屁古拉格，你还会在冻土带钻探石油。

english: ~z~If my daughter goes blind from some S.T.D. then I am holding you accountable, Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~要是我女儿因为什么性病失明，我就拿你是问，尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~Hey, we're gonna beat your ass then I'm gonna go back and fuck that Russian broad and her momma.
zh: ~z~嘿，待会儿先揍死你丫，我再回去操那个俄罗斯贱人和她老妈。

english: ~z~Hey, let's mess this commie asshole up. He fucked with me, he fucked with all the Lost.
zh: ~z~嘿，咱们干烂这个共匪混蛋。他惹我，就是惹了整个失落摩托帮。

english: ~z~This fuckin' douchebag thinks he can tell a member of the Lost who he can and can't fuck. Let's fuck him up.
zh: ~z~这个狗逼混蛋以为他可以对失落摩托帮的人指手画脚，咱们干烂他。

english: ~z~I don't care about her happiness. I care about discipline and loyalty. Thank you, Niko.
zh: ~z~我不在乎她高不高兴，我只关心纪律和忠诚。谢谢你，尼克。

english: ~z~Mikhail, I have bad news. Your daughter... she was hurt.
zh: ~z~米哈伊尔，我有个坏消息，你女儿她...她受伤了

english: ~z~Fuck you, this ain't Russia and we ain't communists.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，这里不是俄国，我们也不是共产主义者。

english: ~z~I've killed the biker. I don't know how happy your daughter will be.
zh: ~z~我做掉了那个飞车党，我不知道你女儿会有多高兴。

english: ~z~My father cannot control who I see. Me and Jason are together no matter what. This is love.
zh: ~z~我父亲不能决定我约谁，我和杰森无论如何都要在一起，这就是爱。

english: ~z~My father is Mikhail Faustin! You can't hurt your boss's daughter.
zh: ~z~我父亲是米哈伊尔･福斯汀！你不能伤害你老板的女儿。

english: ~z~My stupid father thinks he is still in Russia. In America I can see who I like.
zh: ~z~我的白痴父亲当这儿是俄罗斯，但在美国我爱约谁约谁。

english: ~z~Don't you hurt Jason. Don't hurt him. You stupid thug, you stupid gangster.
zh: ~z~你别伤害杰森，不要伤害他。你个蠢蛋流氓，你个白痴黑道。

english: ~z~I knew he was filth from the moment I heard of him. I must tell my wife.
zh: ~z~我刚听说他就知道他是个下流的人，我必须告诉我妻子。

english: ~z~Ha... if you were property then all the brothers would get to share you.
zh: ~z~哈...如果你是帮会财产，那弟兄们都要来共用你了。

english: ~z~Yeah, yeah... she's, uh, very lucky to have such a loving father...
zh: ~z~是，是...她，呃，有这么爱她的父亲是她的福气。

english: ~z~So many years I wondered what it was. Or what was wrong with me,
zh: ~z~这么多年来我一直在想是哪儿不对。也在想我又有哪儿不对，

english: ~z~Mikhail doesn't let me use this anymore, says it makes us look like barbarians.
zh: ~z~米哈伊尔不让我用这个壶，说用它显得我们像野蛮人。

english: ~z~Anyway, I'm sorry but if I get drunk with you and then drive this thing I'll definitely blow myself up.
zh: ~z~总之，我很抱歉，要是跟你去喝个烂醉，开这车的时候肯定会把自己炸没命。

english: ~z~Roman, I'm nervous enough about driving a truck full of explosives around the city for Mikhail Faustin.
zh: ~z~罗曼，光是替米哈伊尔･福斯汀开一辆装满炸药的卡车满城跑就让我有够紧张了。

english: ~z~The fucking truck got trashed before I could get it there. I'm lucky to be alive.
zh: ~z~那辆傻逼卡车在我到那儿之前就废了。幸好我还活着。

english: ~z~When the war came, I did bad things. And after the war, I thought nothing of doing bad things.
zh: ~z~战争期间，我坏事做尽。等到战后，我做坏事都成了家常便饭。

english: ~z~We're already in a lot of trouble. I don't know if I can smooth things over with Petrovic.
zh: ~z~我们的麻烦已经够多了。我都不知道能不能把彼得罗维奇那边摆平。

english: ~z~You and Dimitri, you'd be nothing without me... nothing. This is how you treat me...
zh: ~z~你和迪米特里，没有我你们就会一事无成...一事无成。你们还这样对我...

english: ~z~Dimitri turned on me, not other way around. America made him greedy.
zh: ~z~迪米特里背叛了我，我没有背叛他。美国让他变得贪婪。

english: ~z~Can I call Petrovic and tell him that Mikhail is no longer a problem? Is he dead, Niko?
zh: ~z~我能打给彼得罗维奇并提醒他米哈伊尔不再对我们构成威胁了？ 他是死了吗，尼克？(BETA)

english: ~z~You think Dimitri would have survived prison without me?
zh: ~z~你以为没了我迪米特里还能从监狱里活着出来吗？

english: ~z~A hard thing, but a good thing. Hopefully this will mean peace with Petrovic.
zh: ~z~固然艰难，但的确是好事。这样就很有希望和彼得罗维奇和解了。

english: ~z~I showed mercy to you and your cousin when Dimitri wanted you dead.
zh: ~z~迪米特里想让你死的时候，是我对你和你的堂兄仁慈处理。

english: ~z~It was never going to last, Faustin. You took things too far.
zh: ~z~这样是不可能长久的，福斯汀。你做的事都过头了。

english: ~z~Every second he lives, our lives are in danger. Your cousin's as well, Niko.
zh: ~z~他活着的每一秒，我们都有生命危险，你表哥也一样，尼克

english: ~z~The time for mercy is over. I must rule with a fist of iron.
zh: ~z~仁慈的时代已经过去了，该是我铁腕统治的时代了。

english: ~z~Wherever you go, people will find you, if they want to badly enough.
zh: ~z~只要他们愿意，不管你逃到哪儿，都会被找着的。

english: ~z~kill your best friend, or die... what do you do?
zh: ~z~杀了你最好的朋友，或者自己死...你会怎么做？

english: ~z~I got where I am for a reason. I won't have some Balkan shit take this away from me.
zh: ~z~我能有现在的地位是有原因的，不会让一个巴尔干傻逼夺走的。

english: ~z~We were busted a mile off the coast. I had to swim for my life.
zh: ~z~我们的船在离岸一英里的地方出事了。我只能游出去保命。

english: ~z~An old employer. He lost much money and blamed me for it rather than taking responsibility.
zh: ~z~一个老雇主。他损失了很多钱，全怪到我头上，自己却不负责。

english: ~z~I going speak to Badman, you keep on the low, call Roman and get outta dis place.
zh: ~z~我去和巴德曼谈谈，你保持低调，打给罗曼，然后离开这里。

english: ~z~Yo, what eyes can't see, me heart can't leap at ya know. Me ah come wit you. Where's da place?
zh: ~z~哟，初生牛犊不怕虎是吧。我跟你一起去，地点在哪儿？

english: ~z~It is fucked. Dimitri can do this to me because he has connections here.
zh: ~z~确实操蛋。迪米特里在这儿有人脉就能这么对我。

english: ~z~We find out where Dimitri is and then bam! We take the rest of dem out. Just keep ya head down til then.
zh: ~z~我们找出迪米特里在哪儿然后崩了他！再把剩下的人也干掉。在那之前你先保持低调。

english: ~z~When I next see Dimitri, he is dead man. I will find him.
zh: ~z~下次再让我见到迪米特里，他死定了。我会找到他的。

english: ~z~I only pissed off one, he's dead. I'm going to meet Dimitri to collect on the hit.
zh: ~z~我只惹怒了一个人，他已经死了。现在我要去找迪米特里拿我的报酬。

english: ~z~Yo, mek we go back a the café, seen? But not till we lose Babylon car, sight?
zh: ~z~哟，带我们回咖啡馆，好吧？不过得先把条子给甩了，懂？

english: ~z~Yo Niko, you better watch ya back ya know. Me know ya wicked but dem boy dem are some dog heart ya know.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，你最好是要当心点。我知道你杀人有一手，但他们的人也不是吃素的好吧。

english: ~z~Just chill Niko man, one at a time. Wan wan coco full baskit, seen?
zh: ~z~冷静点，尼克，一次一个。一次一个大丰收，懂？

english: ~z~I didn't know that Mr. Bulgarin was here in Liberty City. If I could have killed them all then and there...
zh: ~z~我不知道布尔加林先生在自由城。要是我当场就杀了他们...

english: ~z~Yo, ya lose Babylon man, forward back ah café now. I need fe black up some more.
zh: ~z~哟，甩掉那些条子了，现在回咖啡馆吧。我得回去抽两口。

english: ~z~Just easy man! The place rammed full man, you'll get us killed my youth.
zh: ~z~别着急，兄弟！这地方全是人，那样会害死我们的，小伙子。

english: ~z~Alright me breda, me hear dem Russian is seriously vexed wit ya.
zh: ~z~我说，好兄弟，听说俄国人现在被你弄得很恼火。

english: ~z~Shit, Dimitri and Bulgarin are leaving. Can you hold these men while I go after?
zh: ~z~我靠，迪米特里和布尔加林要跑了。我去追他们的话你能不能一个人顶住？

english: ~z~Just cool Niko, di boy's a ginnal, yuh nah see? He gonna make his own downfall.
zh: ~z~冷静点，尼克，那小子是个骗子，没看出来吗？他早晚会害死自己的。

english: ~z~Fucking Dimitri, made me kill Faustin then he sell me down the river.
zh: ~z~狗逼迪米特里，利用我杀了福斯汀，然后就把我出卖了。

english: ~z~I don't fucking know and I can't think about it now. I need to shake these fucking pigs.
zh: ~z~我他妈不知道，现在也没法想。我得先甩了这群狗逼条子。

english: ~z~I have it. Meet me at the warehouse on Mohanet in Downtown Broker. Come alone.
zh: ~z~准备好了。来布洛克中心区莫哈内特大道的仓库里找我。自己一个人来。

english: ~z~I have it. Meet me at the warehouse on Mohanet in Downtown Broker. Come alone.
zh: ~z~准备好了。来布洛克中心区莫哈内特大道的仓库里找我。自己一个人来。

english: ~z~But I just wanted to say how grateful me and my bosses are for what you did.
zh: ~z~但我还是想告诉你，我和我的几个老板都对你所做的十分感激。

english: The ~r~biker~s~ is getting away, catch up with him on a ~b~bike~s~ then take him out.
zh: ~r~飞车党~s~正在逃跑，骑~b~摩托车~s~跟着他，然后干掉他。

english: ~s~You can change the aiming sensitivity in the front end menu screen by going to the controls section and selecting Mouse Sensitivity.
zh: ~s~你可以在暂停菜单下的控制设置中调节瞄准时的鼠标灵敏度。

english: ~s~When in cover, press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to blind fire. Blind fire is less accurate than aimed fire.
zh: ~s~在掩体后时，按~INPUT_ATTACK~进行盲射。盲射比瞄准射击精度更低。

english: Sustained firing of your weapon will cause recoil and bullets will spread inaccurately. The aiming reticule will grow larger to indicate this is happening.
zh: 连续射击会产生后坐力，子弹将不精准散布。准星外圈增大说明正受后坐力影响。

english: ~z~Wipe the gunk out of your face and get in your chopper, I need you to get me.
zh: ~z~擦掉脸上的液体，进入直升机吧，我需要你来接。

english: ~z~No skin off my back, NB. That's all cool baby. Another time.
zh: ~z~我无所谓，NB。怎么样都行，宝贝。那就下次吧。

english: ~z~If you don't want to be disturbed, then turn off your phone. I need a lift in your chopper.
zh: ~z~不想有人烦你就直接关机吧。麻烦你开直升机来接我。

english: ~z~Brucie man, those naked chicks are gonna have to wait. Another time.

english: ~z~I ain't shitting you man. I ain't a shitter. I ain't a fucking shitter.
zh: ~z~我没骗你，兄弟。我不是个骗子，我他妈不是骗子。

english: ~z~I don't know what I'm trying to say. Shit. Well, that's all I got to say.
zh: ~z~我不知道我在说什么，妈的。好吧，我就说到这儿吧。

english: ~z~Me heart bleeds as me ego grow large ya know, me breda.
zh: ~z~我的心在你输了之后一直在滴血你知道吗，我的好兄弟。

english: ~z~Whappen rasta, you late ya know. We need fe find a car ya know.
zh: ~z~怎么回事，好兄弟，你迟到了好吧。先找辆车好吧。

english: ~z~One love Niko, thanks for pickin' I an' I up, can ye take I back home?
zh: ~z~你好啊，尼克。多谢你来接我，你能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Niko, I legs ain't workin' good right now. Get I some transport for the rasta now?
zh: ~z~尼克，我的腿已经不听使唤了。能弄给哥们辆车吗？

english: ~z~Okay, rasta, let's see what kind of craziness them have tonight.
zh: ~z~好啦，好兄弟。看看今晚这里会有什么疯狂的节目。

english: ~z~Yo, that was not natural but I dunno, say it taste fine, ya know?
zh: ~z~哟，这玩意是不太健康，但它确实好吃，知道吗？

english: ~z~Yo, Niko, me appreciate that an' ting, give thanks, one love.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，感谢你把我送回来。太感谢你了，再见。

english: ~z~Yo Niko man, I ain't got the strength to be walking right now, man. Can I get some transport?
zh: ~z~哟尼克，好兄弟，我现在这状态不能走路啊，兄弟。能帮我找辆车吗？

english: ~z~it's all dem spliff he been smoking, man. It don't do him head no good.
zh: ~z~都是因为他一直抽的大麻烟，兄弟。对他的脑子不好。

english: ~z~Him speak de truth, man, him know de way, him understand tings properly, you know?
zh: ~z~他述说真理，兄弟，他通晓方向，他对事物理解到位。

english: ~z~I ain't saying nothing to him face. You no call no alligator long mouth til you pass him, bredren.
zh: ~z~我放弃跟他当面沟通了。没见到鳄鱼你都不知道鳄鱼嘴到底多长，兄弟。

english: ~z~Grandad was here back inna the days. Him tell Badman, no badda bawl, don't be feisty.
zh: ~z~爷爷前几天来过这里。他告诉巴德曼，别再吸了，不要再反抗了。

english: ~z~Boy, me vex rasta! Badman outta him mind, man. Him lose it.
zh: ~z~兄弟，我感觉很糟！巴德曼失去理智了，他疯了。

english: ~z~Any money I get I, you know me spend upon sisters or sensemillia. I don't throw my money away, you know.
zh: ~z~反正我赚到的钱不是拿去泡妹就是拿来哈草了，我可不会拿钱打水漂。

english: ~z~Problem be when man no pay another man no respect, you know? Each rasta be vital.
zh: ~z~有人不尊重人就麻烦了懂吧？牙买加人是平等的。

english: ~z~That could be de best ting, you know, Niko. Best ting for all of us, seen?
zh: ~z~这可能是最好的解决方案了，尼克。我们最好的方案，懂？

english: ~z~Being a dread, being a rasta, is all about getting respect and ting, you know?
zh: ~z~就比如我们牙买加人，一切都离不开获得别人的尊重懂吧？

english: ~z~Usual a whole heap of trouble, but, me nah complain, you know. Me learn from me Uncle Bradshaw, you know.
zh: ~z~一如既往的麻烦多多，不过我能接受懂吧。从我布拉德肖叔那里学的。

english: ~z~The hydroponic and artificial and made with chemicals and produced with chemicals. Covered with pesticides... it's wrong.
zh: ~z~水培的，人工的，化工合成的，添加化学成分的。沾满农药的...这样错了。

english: ~z~Niko, Niko, how's me main man Roman? Him still gambling all his money away?
zh: ~z~尼克，尼克，我那哥们罗曼近况如何？还是把所有的钱都拿去赌吗？

english: ~z~Rastas weren't getting no respect, we follow Jah till we get respect, sight?
zh: ~z~牙买加人一天得不到尊重，我们就会跟着主走下去，懂？

english: ~z~This must have happened before, how'd you calm Badman then?
zh: ~z~这种情况以前肯定发生过，你怎么让巴德曼冷静下来的？

english: ~z~Maybe is problem, maybe he just need to get something out of his system.
zh: ~z~或许是个问题，也许他只需要清掉脑子内的一些东西。

english: ~z~Won't leave him place unless him packing more heat dan de sun. Getting all paranoid and shit.
zh: ~z~不武装到和太阳肩并肩就不敢出门。整天疑神疑鬼的。

english: ~z~Sometimes I think he would put her on the table if he had the chance. He doesn't hold onto much for long.
zh: ~z~有时候我觉得如果有机会，他真的会把她押上去。他这人管不住手的。

english: ~z~Only in Liberty City, yo. Man, music from de whole world come a here for massive sound clash, you know.
zh: ~z~只在自由城有，哟。兄弟，世界上所有的音乐都在这里，在Massive B汇集了懂吧。

english: ~z~Sure, man. I don't let nobody talk down to me.
zh: ~z~当然了，兄弟。我不会让任何人不给我好脸色看的。

english: ~z~Babylon downpressors is where we get de problem in society from. Make everyting crash.
zh: ~z~条子的压迫是我们社会问题的根源，祸害了一切。

english: ~z~Raas, him play de best music, man. Him play from de heart, you know.
zh: ~z~我去，他播的歌超赞的，兄弟。他播歌发自真心，懂吧。

english: ~z~Respect due. Bobby Konders is hard man, you know. De sound is raw!
zh: ~z~是啊。Bobby Konders太棒了懂吧。他的选曲超赞。

english: ~z~You think Roman's addicted to gambling, you tink him have a real problem?
zh: ~z~你相信罗曼赌博上瘾了吗？你觉得他的问题很大吗？

english: ~z~I don't blame him, maybe Badman should go to Jamaica too?
zh: ~z~说句实话，或许让巴德曼一起回牙买加比较好吧？

english: ~z~Seen, seen. There's always people around fe lend de money to a man, especially if de man have a habit like Roman.
zh: ~z~懂了懂了。放债的人到处都是，最喜欢找罗曼这种赌鬼下手。

english: ~z~Don't nobody treat you wit de respect you know you deserve, you know, Niko. All of life be about is respect, sight?
zh: ~z~没人能在你有头有脸的时候不尊重你，尼克。生活的本质就是尊重，明白吧？

english: ~z~Jah know him, he can throw his money to dem con men, you know, star. Him a real idiot, you know?
zh: ~z~主知道，他真的会把所有钱都赌掉的。他真的白痴，懂吧？

english: ~z~Make you tink that tings matter, when all that matter is that the sun come up and we have good time and laughter and ting, seen?
zh: ~z~让你觉得某些事很重要，但最重要的是太阳升起时我们还能照常谈笑风生，懂？

english: ~z~You don't got nothing unless you got people paying you no mind, you know?
zh: ~z~如果没人把你当回事，说明你什么都不是，明白吧？

english: ~z~Boy, him back a Jam Dung. Cotching a de sun, man. Couldn't take de city no more.
zh: ~z~兄弟，他回牙买加了。明早之前就到，受不了自由城了。

english: ~z~You uphill you know, Niko? Even for a shotta.
zh: ~z~做人最重要是开心，知道吗？尼克。枪手也不例外。

english: ~z~I am amazed he managed to save enough money to be able to afford the cab depot in the first place.
zh: ~z~他能把钱存够、开起出租车公司就让我够意外了。

english: ~z~Good man, good. I was just enjoying some Massive B dancehall pon de radio.
zh: ~z~还行，还行。我刚刚一边听着Massive B电台一边跳舞呢。

english: ~z~Not all work, work, work, y'know? We got to ease up from time to time, to see how the world turns, you know what I'm saying?
zh: ~z~别只知道干活、干活、干活，好吧？偶尔也要放松放松，看看世界的新变化，懂我意思吗？

english: ~z~Same old, you know, getting by. How's Badman?
zh: ~z~和以前一样，你懂的，凑合着过。巴德曼怎么样了？

english: ~z~Blacking up don't affect I and I de same way, you know. I an' I a chill dread. I don't like that kass kass in the way Badman do.
zh: ~z~哈草对我的作用不一样懂吧。我还很清醒。我不想像巴德曼那样精神失常。

english: ~z~The herb make Badman's head work in all type of ways it shouldn't be working. He think his friends are after him.
zh: ~z~那种草对巴德曼的作用全是预料之外的。他觉得他的朋友都想杀他。

english: ~z~It's his paranoia, man. He's smoking too much of that shit. You got to tell him to calm it down.
zh: ~z~他又犯妄想症了吧。他哈草哈过头了，你得劝他冷静啊。

english: ~z~Mallorie a fine daughta, an him lucky fe have her, you know? Hopefully he won't gamble her away as well.
zh: ~z~玛洛丽是个好姑娘，遇上她是罗曼的福气。希望他不会把她也当成赌注押出去。

english: ~z~He ain't turned on me yet, but one day. You know, one day...
zh: ~z~他还没对我做什么，但迟早啊。真的，迟早啊...

english: ~z~Rum is I-tal. It made from the earth and it put you in tune with it. It's a natural ting.
zh: ~z~朗姆酒就是了。它源于大地，让你回归大地。是自然的东西。

english: ~z~Seen, Niko. you, me, Badman, we all crazy living de life we live.
zh: ~z~你看，尼克。你、我、巴德曼，我们都疯狂地过着疯狂的日子。

english: ~z~This shit is spiritual man. Let me see clearly, hear the I-rations, let I and I enjoy life, and give I and I I-tection.
zh: ~z~这玩意是精神上的，兄弟。让我看清、听清，让我能享受生活，给我乐趣。

english: ~z~We gonna have a whole heap of relaxation. A whole bunch of chilling it out. Of silence, yes? Seen?
zh: ~z~我们要来一大票的娱乐，爽他一大票。享受宁静，对吧？是吧？

english: ~z~I didn't think I deserved any more when they weren't getting any.
zh: ~z~我觉得既然他们的年岁停止了，那我也不配继续下去。

english: ~z~De whole Jam dung getting greedy off a des coke money. It a turn dread against dread.
zh: ~z~整个牙买加都为这可卡因钱贪红了眼。变成了互相内斗。

english: ~z~Him want to be inna de mafia business, big time rude boy, all de time want mash up de place and broke down de place, seen?
zh: ~z~他想掺和黑手党的事，大家伙诶小子，妄图染指的家伙都不会有好下场，懂？

english: ~z~No - cocaine is a bad business, but this whole life is a bad business.
zh: ~z~对，可卡因不是什么好东西，但这种人生也不是好东西。

english: ~z~Shit, I stopped counting birthdays when I saw my friends die back home.
zh: ~z~靠，自从我在老家看着朋友们死去后，我就没记着生日了。

english: ~z~I wish my country had an excuse as good as cocaine for their fighting.
zh: ~z~我倒希望我的祖国是因为可卡因这样的好理由才发动战争。

english: ~z~No one I liked. I might have robbed some sane people, but I did not stick around for conversation.
zh: ~z~我喜欢的里面没有。我可能抢劫过正常人，但我不会留在那儿跟他们聊天。

english: ~z~Cops chasing us, gangsters trying to rip us off, it ain't an easy life, that's for sure.
zh: ~z~条子查我们，黑帮杀我们，生活不容易，这是肯定的。

english: ~z~Man me right hand man, but him big inna de cocaine ting and him want bring it in from jam dung, seen? And it no good.
zh: ~z~我是副手，但他沉迷可卡因，还想从牙买加弄过来，懂？这样不好。

english: ~z~It us a keep de world moving and jamming. Is us, and we make de world I-tal.
zh: ~z~是我们让世界运作、停止。是我们，我们让世界存在。

english: ~z~People say it be the rules, the laws that make the world work, you know? But maybe it ain't dat way.
zh: ~z~人们说是规则、法律让世界运作。不过可能不是那样的。

english: ~z~I mean, I'm trying not to worry too much about the things that are messed up. Relax, you know, have some fun.
zh: ~z~就是不去操心已经搞砸了的事情。要放松，就是找点乐子。

english: ~z~Maybe it's this madness, this crazy shit, that make de world go round.
zh: ~z~也许就是这种疯狂、这种病态狂热，维持了世界的运转。

english: ~z~Seen. Vodka be from de earth too. Inna Jam Dung we have de rum, where you from de rum is de vodka.
zh: ~z~懂了。伏特加也是源于大地。在牙买加我们喝朗姆酒，在你老家你喝伏特加。

english: ~z~All good, Jacob, all good. Or at least, I'm trying not to think too much about things.
zh: ~z~挺好，雅各布，挺好。不过至少，我尽量不在各种事情上想太多。

english: ~z~That's just bucky massa hitting our backs, making de slave ship keep moving.
zh: ~z~都是那些有钱的奴隶主鞭打我们，让贩奴船不断往来的。

english: ~z~Yeah man, I hear That. We gonna have some fun, we gonna sit and enjoy a lickle silence, and enjoy de world as it turns
zh: ~z~是啊，我懂。我们是得找点乐子，应该享受小小的宁静，趁着地球还在转多享受一会儿。

english: ~z~That's just dem downpressors in grey suits, making us waste our life filling out forms and ting.
zh: ~z~就是那些穿灰衣的压迫者，让我们浪费生命去填表啥的的。

english: ~z~Herb be the most spiritual, y'know, messa man. You smoke it, it open your mind to be what's going on in the earth.
zh: ~z~大麻是最精神的，很劲。抽一口，思维就开阔了，与大地融为一体。

english: ~z~You tink things like dat, but, you don't smoke trees. You need a spiritual edge, you know. You take anything?
zh: ~z~你想着这种事，但你不抽大麻。你需要个精神寄托懂吧。有什么爱好吗？

english: ~z~We should be fighting Babylon, but instead we are fight one another.
zh: ~z~我们应该一起跟条子对着干，而不是自己内部掐架。

english: ~z~Thanks Jacob, but I'm alright with the shots of vodka. They fuck me up enough.
zh: ~z~谢了雅各布，但我喝伏特加就够了。这玩意已经够烈了。

english: ~z~Rastas be fighting one another, when they should be cotching and smoking de herb together. Badman included.
zh: ~z~好兄弟们互相干架，本来他们应该在一起哈草的，巴德曼也是。

english: ~z~He ain't the dread he used to be. He used to be righteous man, now him a bad seed. It de coke dat he's doing, you know.
zh: ~z~他已经不是以前的他了。以前他是个正直的人，现在他是个坏胚子。都是被可卡因害的懂吧。

english: ~z~All good, me breda, all good. Me get a whole heap of Kali from Jam dung, from me cousin, him just bring it up.
zh: ~z~都挺好，兄弟，都挺好。我从牙买加弄到了一整车草，亲戚给的，他刚送来。

english: ~z~I look at Badman and tink what could be turning him into the man he's becoming. He's being ruined, you know, Niko?
zh: ~z~我看着巴德曼在想，他为什么会变成现在这样。他已经被毁了懂吧，尼克。

english: ~z~Alright, Rum be a spiritual ting. It wake up your senses and point dem out to de world around you.
zh: ~z~好吧，朗姆酒是精神上的好东西。能唤醒你的感觉，让你感知周围的世界。

english: ~z~Yo, me breda. Long time we had no business, man. Mek we play some pool or someting.
zh: ~z~哟，好兄弟。我们很久没聚了吧，兄弟。一起去打会儿桌球吧。

english: ~z~Me down Firefly Projects star, just link up man, me need a ride man, pronto.
zh: ~z~我现在在萤火虫公屋社区，尽快过来兄弟，我需要你接我，兄弟，快。

english: ~z~Yo, me need some transportation from Rotterdam Hill man, can you pick me up?
zh: ~z~哟，我现在在鹿特丹山，需要有人接送，你能帮我吗？

english: ~z~A long time we're at work me good friend, me could go watch a show or something.
zh: ~z~我们工作了多久了，好朋友，该考虑去看场表演了。

english: ~z~Me down at Firefly Island man, link up man, me need a ride, man.
zh: ~z~我在萤火虫岛，兄弟。快过来，我需要接送，兄弟。

english: ~z~Sorry, I've got some serious shit on just now, Jacob. I can't help just now.
zh: ~z~抱歉，我现在有点麻烦要处理，雅各布。没法帮你了。

english: ~z~Me need some transportation from Rotterdam Hill, can you pick me up?
zh: ~z~我现在在鹿特丹山，需要有人接送，你能帮我吗？

english: ~z~Star, me down at South Slopes man, yo link up star. Me need a ride man, me need a ride.
zh: ~z~哥们，我在南坡，快点来。我需要接送，兄弟，需要接送。

english: ~z~Star, me down Firefly Island man, link up man, me need a ride man, link up star, link up.
zh: ~z~哥们，我在萤火虫岛，快过来，我需要你接我，兄弟，快。

english: ~z~Pool? Yeah, sounds good. And i've got nothing serious going on - I'll head over to your place.
zh: ~z~台球？好啊，这主意不错。刚好我也没什么要紧事，我这就来接你。

english: ~z~Yo, all we do is business, yo? Mek we just go a the strip club or something.
zh: ~z~哟，之前一直忙生计对吧？要不要去脱衣舞俱乐部放松一下？

english: ~z~Yo, star, me down Hove Beach man, me need a ride man, link up star, link up.
zh: ~z~哟，哥们，我在霍夫海滩，需要接送。快过来，兄弟，快。

english: ~z~Jacob, sorry, man, something serious has come up. I can't make it to the hospital.
zh: ~z~雅各布，抱歉，兄弟，突然有点急事。我来不了医院了。

english: ~z~Yo star, me there at Outlook Park man, can you link me up man? Me need a ride.
zh: ~z~哟，哥们，我在奥特卢克公园，你能过来吗？我需要接送。

english: ~z~Yo, Niko, I'm coming out today, man. Can you pick me up at the hospital?
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，今天我出院，兄弟。你能来医院接我吗？

english: ~z~Me down at East Hook, star, me need a ride, man. Can ya link me up?
zh: ~z~我在东胡克，哥们，需要接送，兄弟。你能帮我吗？

english: ~z~Star, yeah, me down Firefly Projects, man, link up star, me need a ride.
zh: ~z~哥们，对，我在萤火虫公屋社区。快过来兄弟，我需要接送。

english: ~z~Yo star, wha'gwan? Yeah, me down South Slopes man, yo, link up star, me need a ride.
zh: ~z~哟，兄弟，你好吗？我在南坡，兄弟，快过来，我要搭车。

english: ~z~Yo, me down at Beechwood, man. Link up, star, me need a ride.
zh: ~z~哟，我在比奇伍德，兄弟。快过来，我需要接送。

english: ~z~Niko, can you pick me up in my yard man? Me need a lift.
zh: ~z~尼克，你能来我家接我吗。兄弟？我需要搭个车。

english: ~z~Sorry man, I can't do a show right now - I've got a problem I've got to deal with.
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟，我现在没空看表演。还有重要的事要忙。

english: ~z~Niko, me breda, me need a lift man, can you pick me up a' me house?
zh: ~z~尼克，兄弟，我需要搭个车，兄弟。你能来我家接我吗？

english: ~z~Yo star, wha'gwan, man? Me there at Outlook Park, man. Me need a ride yo.
zh: ~z~哟，哥们，你还好吗？我在奥特卢克公园，兄弟。我需要搭个车。

english: ~z~Niko, me breda, me need a favor man, can you pick me up a' me house?
zh: ~z~尼克，好兄弟，我需要你帮个忙。你能来我家接我一趟吗？

english: ~z~Star, me down a' Hove Beach man, link up man, me need a ride man, link up.
zh: ~z~哥们，我在霍夫海滩，尽快过来兄弟，我需要你接我，兄弟，快。

english: ~z~You know me man, me hate de car, and de... and de drinking, and de driving ting man.
zh: ~z~知道吗，好兄弟，我讨厌车，也讨厌喝酒，还有开车。

english: ~z~Now, let me sit in peace, Niko. You know me get funny when me drink and you make de world spin funny, man.
zh: ~z~让我好好坐会儿，尼克。你知道我酒品不好，你整的世界天旋地转，兄弟。

english: ~z~Me head spinning, me stomach turning, me all pyoua pyoua, me can't take it easy.
zh: ~z~我头很晕，胃不舒服，人飘啊飘啊的，放松不下来。

english: ~z~Mek we shut up now, Niko, and man, me wonder in peace why you have three heads all of a sudden.

zh: ~z~不了，兄弟。没空整这个，现在还气着好吧，真的。过段时间再找我好吧？先让我歇一歇。

zh: ~z~算了，兄弟。我已经吃得够多了，兄弟，能顶一周吧。下次吧。

zh: ~z~好，兄弟，你到兰开斯特来找我，过来找我好吧。

zh: ~z~哟，我现在没法帮你，兄弟。给我点时间进货，好吧？

zh: ~z~嘿，听着，雅各布，都没事了。我不需要你那些家伙了。

zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟，我需要帮助。给我来点家伙，懂我意思吗？

english: ~z~Yo, sorry rasta, yo. I don't have nuthin for ya right now, man. Try again later.
zh: ~z~哟，抱歉好兄弟，哟。我现在没东西能给你，兄弟。改天吧。

english: ~z~Sorry man - I've got a problem. I need your help. I need a tool if you know what I mean?
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟，我遇上了麻烦，需要你的帮助。我需要工具，你能听懂吗？

english: ~z~I've had naked chicks on me brain since we talked. I'm pumped, Niko.
zh: ~z~聊完电话，我的脑子里就全是裸体少妇了，尼克。

english: ~z~If you spent more time talking to women, and less staring at the internet with your cock in your hand you might get somewhere.

english: ~z~Oh, darts, can't leave the bulleye alone eh? Alright, I'm in.
zh: ~z~噢，飞镖，就是丢不下靶心吗，嗯？好吧，我来。

english: ~z~If you're in a bar full of women and the only person you're interested in is me, you should start asking yourself some important questions.
zh: ~z~如果你在一个满是女人的酒吧里还只对我感兴趣，你就该问你自己一些重要的问题了。

english: ~z~I was getting bored of bowling anyway. I was thinking about shooting the pins down at one point.
zh: ~z~保龄球也打腻了。我在想的是一次打倒所有瓶子。

english: ~z~Here it is Niko. See if we remember we were here tomorrow morning.
zh: ~z~到了，尼克。看看我们明早还记不记得自己来过这里吧。

zh: ~z~没关系，尼克。不过是场游戏而已。你还是更擅长打人，不知道算不算是安慰。

zh: ~z~这算是真实欧洲文化的一个截面吗？下次记得提醒我带你去看爱尔兰吉格舞。

english: ~z~Didn't they teach you to tell the time, you're fucking late. Let's get a car.
zh: ~z~没人教你看时间的吗，你丫迟到了。去弄辆车来。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. We weren't in there long. My priest'll thank you for preventing me from sinning at least.
zh: ~z~我靠，尼克，刚进店没多久吧。至少我的神父会感谢你让我远离罪孽的。

english: ~z~Shit, I'm storing those bitches in the bank for later. If you catch my drift.
zh: ~z~我靠，我要把这些婊子存银行里备用。不知道你听没听懂。

english: ~z~You just go to show that no matter what man achieves, we still behave like fucking apes.
zh: ~z~你就是最好的例子，无论人类进化成什么样，我们还是表现的跟猩猩一样。

english: ~z~Niko, why do you wanna leave so early? You didn't touch one of the girls did ya? I wanna go back there.
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么这么快就走了？你都没摸过姑娘吧？我想再回去玩会儿。

english: ~z~I can give you three reasons, but the fact that you're the ugliest man I've ever seen should be enough of one.
zh: ~z~我可以给你三个理由，但事实上你是我见过的最丑的人，这就够了。

english: ~z~Hey man, this a joke? It ain't a funny one if it is. I'm not going in.
zh: ~z~嘿，兄弟，你开玩笑吗？这可不好笑。我不会进去的。

english: ~z~Alright Niko, you won. If you try to rub me face in it. Things ain't gonna be pretty.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克，你赢了。要是你想骑我头上，就有你好看。

english: ~z~I don't care if she's your girlfriend. That don't stop her being uglier than sin.
zh: ~z~我才不管她是不是你女友。那也改变不了她比罪孽还丑陋的事实。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. This place ain't too shabby. It ain't too shabby at all.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。这地方还不算太烂。真的不能算太烂。

english: ~z~Couldn't hack the pressure, eh Niko? Had to duck out of the game of pool early. That's cool.
zh: ~z~顶不住压力了吧，嗯尼克？只能提前开溜了对吧。没事。

english: ~z~Fuck, I got better things to do than wait for you. Now we got to look for a car as well.
zh: ~z~操，比起等你我本来有更好的事情可做。现在我们还得去找辆车。

english: ~z~Top prize for being an asshole goes to Niko. You made us miss the damn show.
zh: ~z~为人混蛋一等奖颁给尼克。被你搞得错过演出了。

english: ~z~You know I'm gonna destroy you at darts. It's going to happen, Niko.
zh: ~z~要知道，我玩飞镖可是碾压你的。会碾压的，尼克。

english: ~z~Jesus Niko, waiting for your Slavic ass ain't fun at all. Come on.
zh: ~z~天哪，尼克，等你这个斯拉夫混蛋可不好玩。走了。

english: ~z~Fuck you. I'd spill your drinks again if I had the fucking chance.
zh: ~z~操你妈，要是老子有机会，还会把你的酒都倒了。

english: ~z~Your pissing around has made us miss the fucking show. Nice one, Niko.
zh: ~z~你丫到处乱跑搞得我们错过演出了。很好，尼克。

english: ~z~Shit, I love that shit hole. They gotta put something in the drinks there. I'm screwed.
zh: ~z~我操，我喜欢这家店。酒水里肯定下了料。我不行了。

english: ~z~Niko, you beat me at pool. That don't make you a better man.
zh: ~z~尼克，你台球打赢我了。不过这也没法让你变好。

english: ~z~God, I'm gonna have to say a load of Hail Marys after the thoughts I was thinking in there.
zh: ~z~上帝啊，在店里胡思乱想了那么多，我得念上很多遍万福玛利亚了。

english: ~z~This place, eh Niko? If here's you're place then let's do it. It's all the same to me when I'm wasted anyway.
zh: ~z~这家店吗，尼克？确定的话我们就进去吧。反正我都能喝个大醉。

english: ~z~I think that following us out here proves my point. You are fucking stupid.
zh: ~z~我想跟着我们出来就证明了我的观点。你丫就是傻逼。

english: ~z~I don't like losing, Niko. If you weren't such a gracious winner I might have got real angry.
zh: ~z~我不喜欢失败，尼克。要不是因为你是个如此谦和的赢家，我就要生气了。

english: ~z~Alright, man. There are better places to get a drink in this city but a drink's a drink, you know?
zh: ~z~行吧，兄弟。城里还有更好的地方可以喝酒，但总归是有酒喝的，懂吧？

english: ~z~I'm getting bored, man. If we don't get there soon I'm gonna have to start hitting the yayo.
zh: ~z~我开始无聊了，兄弟。再没到地方，我就要开始嗑药了。

english: ~z~Niko, Niko, you come up against the best, you can't expect to win. Bad luck man.
zh: ~z~尼克，尼克，挑战了最强的选手就别想赢了。运气不行啊兄弟。

zh: ~z~老子可是专业的，尼克。你不可能在台球上打败我。

zh: ~z~运气不行啊，尼克。要是给你打到了，真有可能会赢。

zh: ~z~兄弟，一开始喝酒就停不下来了，我他妈能喝一整晚。

zh: ~z~到头来，我他妈根本就硬不起来。这他妈是个死循环。

english: ~z~You're getting to know the McReary family pretty good, Niko boy. What's left of it at least.
zh: ~z~你现在很了解麦克雷里家族了，尼克仔。至少了解剩下的部分。

zh: ~z~可卡因是现实主义者的毒品，对吧？让你活在当下。

english: ~z~Ma had walked out when it started, didn't want to nothing to do with it.
zh: ~z~我妈在这一架开始的时候就出去了，完全不想管。

english: ~z~As the youngest I was always getting me ass kicked. By Derrick, by Gerald...
zh: ~z~作为最小的弟弟，我经常被打。被德里克打，被格里打...

english: ~z~Maybe we're all hypocrites. All imbeciles. Francis - you know about Francis - he wanted to be a priest.
zh: ~z~也许我们都是伪君子。都是蠢蛋。弗朗西斯－你也了解他－他曾想成为神父。

english: ~z~The fighting bit mainly - drunken fights, sober fights, fights on the subway, fights with the family.
zh: ~z~我的话以打斗为主，醉了打斗、醒着打斗、在地铁上打斗、和家人打斗。

english: ~z~They both just stopped when they saw her. Kate stopped being a kid after that. You know what I mean?
zh: ~z~看见她就停下来了。自那以后凯特就不再是一个小孩子了。懂我意思吗？

english: ~z~He got thrown out of the seminary, for cheating. He tried to cheat God.
zh: ~z~他因为作弊被神学院赶出来了。他居然想欺骗上帝。

zh: ~z~格里头一次进少管所的时候，她也在桌上给他留了位置。

english: ~z~There ain't winner in a fight like this. I thought the only thing that was gonna end it was one of them dying.
zh: ~z~这种干架没有赢家。我觉得只有打到一个人半死不活才会结束。

zh: ~z~我也不知道，虽然是我妈，但我一辈子都搞不懂她。

zh: ~z~不一样了。肯定很艰难，意识到你的兄弟都是杀人魔。

english: ~z~If an Irishman ain't beating himself up he's beating up his family.
zh: ~z~要是一个爱尔兰人不打他自己，他就会打自己的家人。

english: ~z~Bury your brother, bury your dad, but at least you can look in the mirror and feel okay?
zh: ~z~埋葬你的兄弟，埋葬你的父亲，但这样你就能安心地看着镜子里的自己？

english: ~z~Well not much, you know... problems, solutions, usual sort of thing.
zh: ~z~没怎么，你也知道...问题、解决，还是老样子。

english: ~z~There was just this feeling in the air. This feeling that told me - this one ain't like all the other fights. They didn't stop.
zh: ~z~空气里就有一种氛围。这个氛围告诉我，这一次不同于往常的打架。

english: ~z~Yeah. Yeah, Kate saw the whole scene, him, insane like he'd ripped a man's throat out,
zh: ~z~是。是，凯特全都看见了，他疯狂到像是刚割了谁的喉一样。

english: ~z~You sounded just like Gerry when you said that, all cagey and thoughtful, like I might be wearing a wire.
zh: ~z~你这么说话就很像格里，深沉晦涩，搞得跟我在窃听一样。

english: ~z~All of us apart from Derrick that is. He left us to visit the Old Country.
zh: ~z~只有德里克是个例外。他之前离开我们回老家了。

english: ~z~Shit, that sounds like a fucking extract from my diary. It would if I kept a diary at least.
zh: ~z~我靠，你他妈从我日记里抄的吧，如果我有写日记的话。

english: ~z~I guess we got Ma to thank for that. Taking us to church and cooking a big lunch for the family on a Sunday.
zh: ~z~这点多亏了妈。礼拜日都会带我们去教堂，还会做丰盛的午餐。

english: ~z~That's what I thought at first, now I just reckon it was denial. She's got this power to switch off.
zh: ~z~一开始我也是这么想的，现在我觉得不是这样。她是有装聋不听的本事的。

english: ~z~The world has a strange way of knocking that out of you pretty quick, hey?
zh: ~z~世界真是奇怪，总能在这种事上给你当头一棒，嘿？

english: ~z~Pain comes easy to the McReary's. Pain and remorse and doing whatever we can to forget about them.
zh: ~z~痛苦很容易找上麦克雷里家。悲痛、自责，然后尽己所能，把这些忘个精光。

english: ~z~He messed the whole fucking family up, I reckon. I used to think I loved him, then I realized I hated him.
zh: ~z~他他妈把整个家都搞烂了。曾经我觉得我爱他，后来发现其实是恨他。

english: ~z~That was until my pa got into a drunken rage one week and threw Gerry's plate against the wall.
zh: ~z~直到有一周我爸发酒疯，抄起格里的盘子就往墙上砸。

english: ~z~A grass, to avoid doing time. That's why Gerry won't bend - he sees it as his penance for the sins of his brother.
zh: ~z~为了不坐牢而告密。所以格里才不会借酒借毒浇愁，他认为这是对哥哥罪孽的弥补。

english: ~z~Keeps your head up your own fucking ass, that's about as grounded as you can get.
zh: ~z~能让你不至于屁股决定脑袋，要多明智有多明智。

english: ~z~No... I'm sorry. Happy thoughts, puppies and little girls smiling and clowns and all that shit.
zh: ~z~没有...不好意思。想点高兴的吧，小狗、小妞的笑脸、小丑啥的。

english: ~z~Yes, but not long enough. I wish he'd been drowned at birth, got rid of the lot of us.
zh: ~z~挺久，但还不够久。我都希望他一出生就被淹死，省得我们痛苦。

english: ~z~I remember one night, years ago, a bit after my dad died, he came home covered in blood.
zh: ~z~我还记得几年前的一个晚上，在我爸死了一段时间后，他浑身是血的回到家。

english: ~z~I'm not sure - but it didn't do him much good, either way. I think it was because of Derrick.
zh: ~z~我不清楚，但实际上也没给他什么好处。我想是因为德里克。

english: ~z~I think that was when she realized just what we were like - she was young then. She was never quite the same after that.
zh: ~z~我想她就是在那时候意识到我们的生活的，当时她还小。在那以后她就性情大变了。

english: ~z~Sure - I reckon it is - maybe that's why the world is divided into the drunk and the miserable?
zh: ~z~当然，我想也是。所以世上才只有喝醉的和痛苦的两种人吧？

english: ~z~Sure... sure. Chaos we all know about. Gerry was the only one who ever tried to live beyond the chaos.
zh: ~z~当然...当然了。我们都知道这种混乱。格里是唯一一个尝试活在混乱之外的。

english: ~z~There is a lot that I am never going to understand, Packie. A whole fucking lot.
zh: ~z~有很多东西是我这辈子都搞不懂的，派奇。太他妈多了。

english: ~z~With what's left of them. I am not so lucky to have my whole family in one city.
zh: ~z~只和还活着的有联络。我可没好运到全家都在同一个城市。

english: ~z~It ended when they was in the kitchen, Gerry was on top just smashing Frankie's head into the floor.
zh: ~z~打到厨房以后才结束的，格里都快要把弗兰基的脑袋往地上敲了。

english: ~z~I don't know. He loved the stories about the Old Country. The poetry, the songs, the books.
zh: ~z~不知道。他就喜欢老家的那些故事。诗歌、歌曲、图书。

english: ~z~Us McRearys never flew far from the nest, we all stuck close to home.
zh: ~z~我们麦克雷里家族从不远离自己的家，都待在离家近的地方。

english: ~z~Ma didn't even flinch. She just sat there. The next week, Gerald's place at the table was empty.
zh: ~z~妈看了动都没动，就坐在那儿。后一周，格里在桌上的位置就没东西了。

english: ~z~Sure - great apart from all the blood and the guilt hey... kind of messed up, this kind of life isn't it?
zh: ~z~当然，抛开那些血迹和罪行的话就挺好...是有点糟吧，这种生活？

english: ~z~There was a look in their eyes. It was fucking animal.
zh: ~z~他们没有收手。眼里都有一种目光，是他妈野兽的目光。

english: ~z~That's probably why he got into smack. Took him to another world.
zh: ~z~可能就是因此他才会沾上海洛因。能带他去另一个世界。

english: ~z~Be a hero with feet of clay or be a drunk and a thug and a killer,
zh: ~z~做一个外强中干的英雄？还是醉醺醺的杀手混混？

english: ~z~Francis tried to get me on his side, team up against the other two he said, but I wasn't having any of it.
zh: ~z~弗朗西斯也拉拢过我，想要抱团对抗他俩。不过我完全没接受。

english: ~z~All of us except for Francis. We stayed together when it was possible.
zh: ~z~除了弗朗西斯。还能在一起的时候我们倒在一起。

english: ~z~I know you talk about this bad shit that happened to you, but I think you can get over it, you know.

english: ~z~Cousin, what is up with this? I feel like we are not cousins we see one another so little.
zh: ~z~堂弟，这是什么情况？最近没怎么来往，我都觉得我们不是兄弟了。

english: ~z~Cousin, how about we play some pool? Remember how we used to hustle those American soldiers back home when the war started?
zh: ~z~堂弟，去打会儿台球吧？还记得战争刚开始时，我们是怎么在老家横扫那些美国大兵的吗？

english: ~z~Cousin, it is the moment for us to spend some quality time together. How about that old American pastime - bowling?
zh: ~z~堂弟，该一起享受美好生活了。要不要来点美式的运动，保龄球？

english: ~z~Alright man? We go see something. I should be with you in no more than one hour.
zh: ~z~好的，老哥。我们去看点东西吧。我应该不用一小时就能到你那里。

english: ~z~Sure, Roman. We eat together. I come get you in next hour.
zh: ~z~当然了，罗曼，一起吃饭吧。我一小时内来接你。

english: ~z~Sure, bowling sounds good. I will come to collect you in next hour.
zh: ~z~好啊，保龄球听起来不错。我一小时内就来接你。

english: ~z~Cousin, we should go out together. Open a bottle of vodka and drink it all like we did in Old Country.
zh: ~z~堂弟，我们该一起出去走走。像在故国时那样开瓶伏特加一饮而尽吧。

english: ~z~Okay man, we go bowling. I come to get you in the next hour.
zh: ~z~好的老哥，去打保龄球吧。我一小时内就来接你。

english: ~z~Okay man, we go drinking together. I pick you up in next hour.
zh: ~z~好的，老哥，一起去喝酒吧。我一小时内来接你。

english: ~z~Cousin, you really want to experience America, you must see a show here. How about it?
zh: ~z~堂弟，想要体验真正的美国，一定要来看场表演。怎么样？

english: ~z~Niko, you want to play some video games? They are much better than ones you are used to back home.
zh: ~z~尼克，想打游戏吗？这些比你在老家玩的那种好多了。

english: ~z~Is about time I show you some fine American silicon filled titties. You want come to strip club with me?
zh: ~z~是时候带你见识下上好的美国硅胶奶子了。想和我一起去脱衣舞俱乐部吗？

english: ~z~That was quick, Niko. You would almost think you didn't want to sit down and converse with your cousin.
zh: ~z~太快了，尼克。感觉都来不及和自己的兄弟坐下来聊上几句。

english: ~z~Niko, when will you learn? Your cousin is better than you at pool. You are no match.
zh: ~z~尼克，你什么时候才能明白？你堂兄比你更擅长台球，你太弱了。

english: ~z~Niko, that was fun. I was at a place belonging to Mikhail Faustin and I was not even shot.
zh: ~z~尼克，玩得很开心。我在米哈伊尔･福斯汀的地盘，还没有挨枪子儿。

english: ~z~Get ready to watch a master at work. I am to darts what Perseus is to clothing.
zh: ~z~等着看大师级技术吧。我就是飞镖界的神之子服饰。

english: ~z~That would have been even more fun if I hadn't been fearing for my life. Your Russian gangster friends are scary.
zh: ~z~要不是担心自己的人身安全，我会更享受一点的。你的俄国黑帮朋友太可怕了。

english: ~z~Niko, this is meant to be a very funny man. Anything you do not understand, you ask me and I will explain.
zh: ~z~尼克，他说的其实都很有趣。哪里没听懂尽管问，我会解释的。

english: ~z~I did not expect an opportunity to kick your ass at darts. How could I refuse?
zh: ~z~没想到还有机会在飞镖上把你干爆。我怎么会拒绝呢？

english: ~z~We are the perfect match, cousin. A tie. That is unheard of, no?
zh: ~z~我们是完美的对手，堂弟。平局了。闻所未闻不是吗？

english: ~z~Niko, how could you want to leave so early. You haven't been hanging out at Hercules Nightclub or something have you?
zh: ~z~尼克，怎么这么快就走了。你该不会是大力神夜店的常客吧？

english: ~z~We have truly made it, Niko. The cousins Bellic eating in the finest dining rooms in Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我们真的成功了，尼克。贝利克兄弟在自由城最好的餐厅吃饭。

english: ~z~American fast-food. Just think we could have the exact same meal in the Old Country.
zh: ~z~美式快餐。要是在故国也能吃到一样的饭菜就好了。

english: ~z~Nothing hits the spot like a Burger Shot, cousin. My fifth chin is all thanks to these guys.
zh: ~z~吃得饱汉堡我喜欢吃，堂弟。我的五层下巴多亏了他们。

english: ~z~Niko, I don't like to stop things half way though. Ask any lady, I always satisfy.
zh: ~z~尼克，我不喜欢半途而废。找个女人问问，我总是能满足她们。

english: ~z~This is real entertainment, cousin. It's hard to find performances of this premium quality, even on Burlesque.
zh: ~z~这是真的好看，堂弟。这种质量的表演就算在滑稽剧场也是只此一家。

english: ~z~Old Vlad's bar. We shall see if he can add our drinks to the rest of my debt.
zh: ~z~老弗拉德开的酒吧。应该问他能不能把喝的酒记在我的账上。

english: ~z~I have been wanting to see this act, cousin. My friend saw this and he pissed in his pants.
zh: ~z~我一直都很想看这场演出，堂弟。我朋友看过，看得他笑尿了。

english: ~z~It was a great restaurant but do not expect me to sleep with you now, cousin. I am not one of your girlfriends.
zh: ~z~餐馆很不错，不过别指望我跟你睡，堂弟。我不是你女朋友。

english: ~z~This is a good idea. It will remind us how lucky we are to have gotten out of the Old Country.
zh: ~z~这是个好主意，好让我们知道能离开故国有多幸运。

english: ~z~I'm sorry for beating you cousin, but I'm the better player. That is it.
zh: ~z~很遗憾，我打赢你了，堂弟，我才是更强的选手。就是这样。

english: ~z~Faustin's Club, eh? So this is where he hangs out when he's not shooting innocent men in their stomachs.
zh: ~z~福斯汀的俱乐部，嗯？这就是他没往无辜平民肚子上开洞时候待的地方吗。

english: ~z~Niko, the phonebook on my cell is filling up so many hot chicks are giving me their numbers.
zh: ~z~尼克，我的通讯录里多得是主动给我电话的辣妹。

english: ~z~You are taking me to Perestroika. I hope that Mr. Faustin gives you an employee discount?
zh: ~z~你带我来Perestroika啊。福斯汀先生会不会给你员工特价？

english: ~z~You see that girl who was eyeing me, I would have sealed that deal if I didn't have to see Mallorie later.
zh: ~z~看见那个偷瞄我的妹子了吗？要不是跟玛洛丽有约会，我就去泡她了。

zh: ~z~可惜你的俄国黑帮朋友福斯汀先生已经死了。这地方也要衰败了。

english: ~z~Niko, you said you'd be here earlier. No matter, you will drive us. If you like you can use a cab.
zh: ~z~尼克，说好了你来这儿等我的。算了，你来开车。需要的话可以开我的车。

english: ~z~Niko, I could suck a Bleeder Burger dry. This is my favorite.
zh: ~z~尼克，我能把一整个吸血鬼堡吸干。这是我的最爱。

english: ~z~Niko, good game. You are good at bowling and I'm good with the ladies. We both have skills.
zh: ~z~尼克，打得不错。你很擅长保龄球，我很擅长对付女人，都有一技之长。

english: ~z~Bowling, Niko. This is a surprise. You know that I like to beat you though. Let's do it.
zh: ~z~保龄球，尼克。这倒是个惊喜，你也知道我喜欢打败你。来吧。

english: ~z~NB, you are making an important business owner wait for you. I am generous though. You can drive me in one of my cabs.
zh: ~z~NB，你居然让大老板等你，不过我原谅你。你可以开我的出租车。

english: ~z~Late NB, not acceptable. Make it up by driving me in one of my cabs.
zh: ~z~迟到了，NB，不能这样。开我的出租车将功补过吧。

english: ~z~Niko, I love that place. Is hard to believe but man cannot live on titties alone.
zh: ~z~尼克，我爱这地方。不过男人居然不能只靠奶子生存。

english: ~z~We must settle this some other way. Maybe we should compete over a woman. Clearly not Mallorie though.
zh: ~z~我们想法子决出胜负吧。比如说比赛泡妞，不过我不会用玛洛丽比的。

english: ~z~Niko. Were you afraid of playing out the game for fear that I would beat you? Do not be scared of defeat, cousin.
zh: ~z~尼克，你是不是怕被我击败才中途退出的？别害怕失败，堂弟。

english: ~z~Niko, you are good with a pool cue. You can teach me about that while I teach you about women.
zh: ~z~尼克，你拿上台球杆还挺行的嘛。我教你泡女人，你教我打台球吧。

english: ~z~Cousin Niko, what's up? We can take one of the cabs. Shotgun not driving.
zh: ~z~尼克堂弟，怎么了？开我的出租也行。我不开车。

english: ~z~Do you see... do you see something in my eye. I am not seeing so good. Must be how you beat me.
zh: ~z~你看见...看见我眼睛里的东西了吗？我看得不太清楚，这才被你捡漏了。

english: ~z~Oh cousin, I salivate at the thought of all the naked flesh in there. Let's go.
zh: ~z~噢，堂弟，光是想到里面赤裸的肉体我就垂涎欲滴了。

english: ~z~You must be in a hurry, Niko. It does not take long to finish a game of darts with your cousin.
zh: ~z~你是有急事吧，尼克。陪堂兄投完一局飞镖又花不了多久。

english: ~z~Hey, NB. We can take one of the cabs if you like. You mind driving?
zh: ~z~嘿，NB。需要的话我可以把出租车借你开。你来开车吧？

english: ~z~Niko, we are evenly matched. There can clearly be no winner when two cousins such as us compete.
zh: ~z~尼克，我们打平了。果然我们兄弟二人是分不出胜负的。

english: ~z~Niko, this is just the place. I hear it is filled with girls with low self esteem.
zh: ~z~尼克，我就想来这里。听说这里有很多不知廉耻的女孩。

english: ~z~Fucking Vlad. I cannot help but think of that scumbag in that place.
zh: ~z~狗逼弗拉德。我在这儿不由自主地就会想到那个小人。

english: ~z~We shall drink and remember the old days. I'll buy the first round. That's if I remembered my wallet.
zh: ~z~我们该喝几杯，回忆下过去。前两杯我请。如果我还找得到钱包的话。

english: ~z~There are better things to do on a pool table than play pool. I could show you the things I'd do to a bored housewife on one.
zh: ~z~台球桌上比起打台球还有更好的事情能做。我可以让你见识下我会对寂寞人妻做的事情。

english: ~z~There is only one thing I'm better at than playing pool, Niko. And, as a man, you won't get to see me in action.
zh: ~z~我只有一件事是比打台球更擅长的，尼克。但是身为男人，你是无福亲眼见到了。

english: ~z~Ahh, Comrades. We shall raise our glasses to the late Vlad while we're here.
zh: ~z~啊，Comrades酒吧。在店里的时候得敬弗拉德一杯。

english: ~z~It is a shame we did not meet Vlad in there. I wanted to tell him what a good loanshark he is.
zh: ~z~没在这儿见到弗拉德真是可惜。我还想告诉他他这个放贷的有多好呢。

english: ~z~Niko, you're pretty good. It's clearly those Bellic genes you've got. If we were a team we'd be unstoppable.
zh: ~z~尼克，你真棒，完全表现了你的贝利克家基因。我们组队就无人能敌了。

english: ~z~What a nice place this is. If I didn't know better I would have thought you were trying to fuck me.
zh: ~z~这家店好啊。要不是我更懂行，我就要以为你是想睡我了。

english: ~z~You see, aren't you pleased you are not in Old Country where that is all that is on.
zh: ~z~你看，只要不是在故国演出，你不就能看得很开心了吗。

english: ~z~Niko, you are really moving up in the world, no? I tell you we are going to the top when you arrive.
zh: ~z~尼克，你这越来越高端了啊。你刚来的时候我就说过我们会走上顶峰。

english: ~z~Oh cousin, I wish I could get angry at you for being late but you're too loveable. Let's go.
zh: ~z~噢，堂弟，你实在是太可爱了，就算迟到我也生不了你的气。我们走吧。

english: ~z~Niko. You had lost before we even got here. Darts is about having the mental edge
zh: ~z~尼克，来美国前你也老输给我。飞镖需要的是心理优势。

english: ~z~Cousin, you are late. For that you are driving. I will let you use a cab if you want to though.
zh: ~z~堂弟，你迟到了，所以你来开车。需要的话我可以把出租车借给你。

english: ~z~Niko, how could you expect to beat someone as supremely skilled as me? It was foolish
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么可能打赢我这样球技精湛的人呢？太蠢了。

english: ~z~I wait and I wait and now you come without even a car. Well, let us find one.
zh: ~z~我等啊等等啊等，结果现在你连辆车都没有就来了。算了，找辆车吧。

english: ~z~What amazing burgers, I feel another chin growing on my face. Do you see it?
zh: ~z~汉堡太棒了，觉得自己又长了一层下巴。你看见了吗？

english: ~z~I like that place, now that Vlad is gone I can really appreciate the atmosphere.
zh: ~z~我喜欢这家酒吧，现在弗拉德不在了，我才能真正享受店里的氛围。

english: ~z~I could have beaten you with my eyes closed, cousin. I'm sorry but I'm that much better.
zh: ~z~我闭着眼睛都能打败你，堂弟。不好意思，我就是比你强。

english: ~z~Niko, why you want to leave, cousin? We could have at least seen the end.
zh: ~z~尼克，你为什么想走了，堂弟？我们至少可以看完的。

english: ~z~Niko, we have left now but those titties will inhabit my dreams for many nights to come.
zh: ~z~尼克，虽然我们出来了，但那些奶子会在我的梦里住很多晚上的。

english: ~z~Niko, you call yourself a criminal but the real crime would be coming home without a lady tonight. Let's go.
zh: ~z~尼克，你自称是罪犯，但今晚不带个女人回家才是罪过。走吧。

english: ~z~I worry for you, cousin. How could any red blooded male want to leave all those lovely titties so soon?
zh: ~z~我很替你担心啊，堂弟。血气方刚的男人怎么会这么快就离开那些可爱的奶子呢？

english: ~z~Ok we can fill up with good American food. I'm in the mood for a hormone and chemical hit
zh: ~z~好了，可以享用美味的美国食物了。我现在就想来一顿激素和添加剂套餐。

english: ~z~Niko, you lazy bastard. All your screwing around has made us miss the show.
zh: ~z~尼克，你个懒鬼。到处乱转转得我们错过演出了。

english: ~z~Niko, why you so impatient? We could have stayed until the end.
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么这么急？我们可以待到表演结束的。

english: ~z~You must have happy memories of your time here with the late Mr. Faustin. Isn't that right, cousin?
zh: ~z~你在这儿肯定有和福斯汀先生一起的美好回忆，对不对，堂弟？

english: ~z~You keep your cousin waiting, is a disgrace NB. Now, we must find a car.
zh: ~z~让你堂兄一直等着，太可耻了，NB。现在先找辆车吧。

english: ~z~Cousin, you will be shooting pool alone today. Do not place bets, okay?
zh: ~z~堂兄，今天你只能自己打台球了。不要赌钱，好吧？

english: ~z~Roman, sorry but I cannot bowl with you anymore. Another time.
zh: ~z~罗曼，很抱歉，但我不能陪你打保龄球了。改天吧。

english: ~z~Niko, get your invalid cousin a car. He cannot walk in this state.
zh: ~z~尼克，给你行动不便的堂兄找辆车。他现在没法走路。

english: ~z~Sorry, Roman. I cannot play pool with you anymore. I have another plan.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼。我没法来跟你打台球了。有别的事要做。

english: ~z~Sorry cousin, but I don't have no cabs right now. You must call again later.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂弟，但我现在也没车可派了。你得待会儿再打过来了。

english: ~z~Niko, as you are my cousin I want you to use family business how you like. Any time you want cab, you call me.
zh: ~z~尼克，既然你是我的堂弟，我想让你随意利用我们的家族产业。什么时候想打车了，给我打个电话。

english: ~z~Niko, I am sorry but nothing is available. You must call back another time.
zh: ~z~尼克，很抱歉，但是现在没车了。你还是过会儿再打过来吧。

english: ~z~Sorry Roman, you may have to drink alone. I can no longer join you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼，你可能要一个人喝酒了。我没法陪你了。

english: ~z~You are a good cousin. Thank you for collecting me. I need to go home now.
zh: ~z~真是个好堂弟，感谢你来接我。我现在要回家了。

english: ~z~Sorry, cousin. I cannot join you at the tittie bar. You can still go by yourself though.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂兄。我没法陪你去奶子吧了。不过你还是能自己去。

english: ~z~Sorry, Roman. I can't do it right now. Can't you get Mallorie to do it?
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼，我现在来不了。你就不能让玛洛丽来接吗？

english: ~z~Don't worry cousin, I have hot bitches that are begging me for my company, see you soon.
zh: ~z~别担心，堂弟，很多性感的贱人求我陪呢，之后见。

english: ~z~Roman. I can't eat with you. This may help you lose some weight.
zh: ~z~罗曼，我没法和你一起吃饭了。说不定还能帮你减减肥。

english: ~z~Hey, Roman. You mind if we catch the show on another night? I have something else to do.
zh: ~z~嘿，罗曼。你介意改天再去看表演吗？我现在有别的事情要做。

english: ~z~I will remember this next time you are in trouble, Niko. I will remember.
zh: ~z~这笔帐我会记着的，下次你有事了当心点，尼克。我都记着呢。

english: ~z~You are my cousin, Niko. How can I refuse? There is a cab on its way.
zh: ~z~你可是我堂弟啊，尼克。我怎么能拒绝呢？已经有辆车在路上了。

english: ~z~Cousin, I hope you are not forgetting your family in this city? We do this on different occasion.
zh: ~z~堂弟，你应该没忘了自由城的家人吧？我们以后再约吧。

english: ~z~Roman, I cannot go look at titties with you. I have to do something else.
zh: ~z~罗曼，我不能陪你去看奶子了。有别的事情要做。

english: ~z~Really, Niko. I told everyone you were coming to get me. I will have to walk now.
zh: ~z~真的，尼克？我告诉了所有人你会来接我。现在只能走回家了。

english: ~z~Sorry, cousin. I cannot see the show with you no more. Hope that's cool.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂兄，我不能和你去看表演了。希望没事。

english: ~z~Cousin, you do not have much family here, you should treat me with more respect. Maybe another time soon. Okay.
zh: ~z~堂弟，你在这里只有我一个家人，对我好一点好吗。那就下次再约吧。

english: ~z~Hey Roman, sorry to fuck you round but I don't need no cab no more.
zh: ~z~嘿，罗曼，很抱歉给你添麻烦了，但我不需要打车了。

english: ~z~Sorry, Roman. Something has come up. I cannot throw darts with you now.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼。突然有点急事，没法跟你去玩飞镖了。

english: ~z~Roman, I'm sorry but something has come up and I can no longer pick you up from the hospital.
zh: ~z~罗曼，很对不起，但我突然有急事，不能来医院接你了。

english: ~z~You are kind for giving me a lift, Niko. Call your sick cousin soon, okay?
zh: ~z~你能来接我真好，尼克。记得给你体弱的堂兄打电话，好吧？

english: ~z~My balls feel fine, but I did notice my man tits getting larger when I was eating at Cluckin' Bell every day.
zh: ~z~我的蛋挺好的，不过之前我每天去铛铛钟吃饭的时候确实会发现自己的胸在变大。

english: ~z~Sure. I miss things about home, but I, I... I think things are ruined now.
zh: ~z~确实，我挺想念老家的人和事的，不过我、我...我想现在那些都被毁了。

english: ~z~In the Old Country, the only thing you could count on was a bomb landing on your bedroom roof in the night.
zh: ~z~在故国，能确定的事只有晚上会有炸弹投到自家屋顶上。

english: ~z~Thanks. Don't you miss home? You've been here a long time. You never get home sick?
zh: ~z~谢了。不过你不想家吗？来这儿那么久，你就没想过一次家吗？

english: ~z~Avoid it as long as you can, cousin. That's my advice to you.
zh: ~z~能避开多久就避开多久，堂弟。这是我给你的建议。

english: ~z~With every day we live we pick up new baggage, baggage that we must carry with us for the rest of our lives.
zh: ~z~每天我们都会背上新的包袱，余生都要背着这些包袱。

english: ~z~No matter where I go, the ladies love me. It's that Bellic blood.
zh: ~z~不管走到哪儿，女士们都爱我。这就是贝利克的血脉。

english: ~z~You dancing? Now that I would like to see. Like the death throes of an elephant.
zh: ~z~你跳舞？这我倒想看看。像大象在垂死挣扎一样。

english: ~z~Niko B in the house... man, sometimes, I cannot believe you are here with me, really I can't.
zh: ~z~家有尼克 B...老弟，有时候我都不能相信你现在和我在一起，真的不能。

english: ~z~And look what freedom was. War, killing, and not even knowing what to hate anymore.
zh: ~z~再瞧瞧自由都是什么。战争、杀戮，甚至都不知道该去恨什么。

english: ~z~I miss the good times we had as children, when our fathers were too drunk to beat us,
zh: ~z~我很怀念美好的童年时光，那个我们的父亲都醉到打不动我们的时候，

english: ~z~To seize them you end up in so much debt that you'll be a slave for the rest of your life.
zh: ~z~要想抓住它，就会背上一屁股债，余生都得做别人的奴隶。

english: ~z~For you too, but in a different way. We grew up wanting to be free.
zh: ~z~对你也是，不过不太一样。我们都期盼长大后能够自由。

english: ~z~My God. For a sociopathic killer, you're also a really miserable bastard.
zh: ~z~我的天哪，虽然是个反社会杀手，但你这混蛋还挺可怜的。

english: ~z~Tell me, Roman, why weren't you such an optimist back home?
zh: ~z~告诉我，罗曼，你在老家的时候怎么没这么乐观？

english: ~z~If women weren't throwing themselves at me, life would be easier.
zh: ~z~要不是女人主动投入我的怀抱，我的生活会更轻松的。

english: ~z~You know, I love your mother - there is just one thing I could never figure out about her.
zh: ~z~你也知道，我爱你的母亲。只是她有一件事让我怎么也想不明白。

english: ~z~My God, you are deranged, cousin. This place has made you sick!
zh: ~z~我的天哪，你疯了吧，堂兄。这地方把给你弄疯了！

english: ~z~You know, I'm worried about her, all alone. Maybe... maybe she should move here, be with us?
zh: ~z~你也知道，我很担心她没人照顾。或许...或许她也该搬到这儿来，和我们住？

english: ~z~Yes, cousin. It is. Sure, this place is crazy, but so was home.
zh: ~z~是的，堂弟，很滋润。这地方确实疯狂，但老家也一样。

english: ~z~It is fun, I think... and if it isn't fun, it's all we can do anyway.
zh: ~z~很有趣，我觉得...就算不好玩，我们能做的也只有这些。

english: ~z~I love Mallorie but come on. A man has his urges.
zh: ~z~我是爱玛洛丽，不过得了吧，男人也是有欲望的。

english: ~z~Yes - maybe she get heavily involved in car jacking and spend some time doing hits for the mob?
zh: ~z~对，或许她也会成为车匪路霸，再去替黑帮杀几个人？
