english: ~z~There's no dropping it and pretending we are fresh and clean just because we get off a boat in a new place.
zh: ~z~不可能就因为我们下船来到了异地，就可以扔下包袱假装无事发生。

english: ~z~Look at how we live here, what we have done. Where exactly would your aunt fit into this lifestyle?
zh: ~z~看看我们现在的生活，看看我们的所作所为。你婶婶怎么可能适应这种日子？

english: ~z~I don't know, Roman. It is the same as any other place only louder.
zh: ~z~我不知道，罗曼。这里和别的地方一样，只是更吵了点。

english: ~z~How she couldn't move back on our farm because of all of the heroin dealers and the coke whores and the arms smugglers?
zh: ~z~有一次就因为那些海洛因贩子、可卡因妓女和持械走私者，她差点连我们的农场都回不来？

english: ~z~They stay on the highway like every other chump. I'm an innovator, Niko.
zh: ~z~那些傻子都待在高速路上。我是个创新者，尼克。

english: ~z~It must be pretty strong because I can't see what you're so happy about.
zh: ~z~药效肯定很猛，因为我都看不出你有什么好高兴的。

english: ~z~Fuck you. I'm an individual, my friend. One of a kind.
zh: ~z~去你妈的。我这人就是有个性，朋友。独一无二。

english: ~z~Oh, stop complaining. You're pathetic. The one thing this country has taught you is how to whine.
zh: ~z~噢，别抱怨了。你真可悲。这个国家教会你的一样本事就是怎么发牢骚。

english: ~z~But you can't, or at least you can't teach everyone. Really, you don't like it?
zh: ~z~但你做不到，至少教不会所有人。你真的不喜欢这儿吗？

english: ~z~Stop being so dramatic, Niko. Time is a healer. We live and we forget the past.
zh: ~z~别演话剧了，尼克。时间会治愈一切。我们活下去，就会忘记过去。

english: ~z~You have to move on from the things that happened to you and think about all the opportunities in this country.
zh: ~z~你要抛下那些陈年往事，多想想这个国家的种种机遇。

english: ~z~I drive off the highway. Off road baby! Every move I make is a gamble.
zh: ~z~我开出了高速公路。不走寻常路，宝贝！我的每一步都是在赌博。

english: ~z~Enjoy this. Us hanging out, living in this lunatic asylum, meeting freaks.
zh: ~z~享受这些。我们一起出门，活在这个疯狂的疯人院里，遇见各种怪咖。

english: ~z~She's the love of my life, the woman of my dreams... she's amazing.
zh: ~z~她是我的一生挚爱，我的梦中情人...她太棒了。

english: ~z~Good. listen, Niko. I received an email from your mother.
zh: ~z~好。听着，尼克。我从你母亲那儿收到了一封邮件。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, but listen, man, you have to lighten up. Enjoy yourself.
zh: ~z~我很抱歉，不过听着，你一定要振作起来。享受自己。

english: ~z~Okay, things aren't easy for us here. But together, we are doing alright.
zh: ~z~好吧，我们在这儿过得都不容易。不过齐心协力，我们就能搞定。

english: ~z~Me? I'm always the same. You know me. I'm an optimist. Life is always great.
zh: ~z~我？一如既往。你也懂我，我是乐观主义者，生活一直都很好。

english: ~z~They must put something into the water, man, because all I'm feeling is pure optimism.
zh: ~z~水里肯定是加了东西，老弟，因为我能感受到的只有纯粹的乐观。

english: ~z~Maybe it'd be easy if I was not an attractive man, but, sadly, I was not blessed with plain features.
zh: ~z~要是我没那么有魅力可能还容易点，不过很遗憾，我没那么平庸。

english: ~z~And here, it is okay to be an eccentric go-getter businessman with a taste for fine women, wine and song.
zh: ~z~在这里，你可以做一个上进的古怪商人，同时对女人、好酒、好歌感兴趣。

english: ~z~Nothing helps a man forget like ripe, round American titties.
zh: ~z~想让一个人忘记，最好的方子就是丰满圆润的美利坚奶子。

english: ~z~The lights, the titties, the food, the opportunities. Come on, Niko. It's kind of incredible.
zh: ~z~灯火、奶子、食物、机遇。得了吧，尼克。这可有点牛逼啊。

english: ~z~But what a yesterday! Man, this has been a crazy time. We've had some insane adventures.
zh: ~z~但那过去真是！老弟，那都太疯狂了。我们都有疯狂的经历。

english: ~z~Yeah, but most people don't know where it is so they stay at the bottom of the food chain.
zh: ~z~是啊，不过大多数人都没找到捷径，所以就只能待在食物链的底端。

english: ~z~I just did. It's good to have you here. Whatever shit we get into, man... it's good.
zh: ~z~真的。有你在这儿真的很好。不管我们会遇到什么麻烦，老弟...都很好。

english: ~z~It's the fast-food, the cheap gas, the fake titties - there's a short cut for everything here.
zh: ~z~就是快餐、廉价汽油、人造奶子，在这儿做什么都有捷径。

english: ~z~Okay. Thank you. I will lighten up, learn how to juggle, maybe get work in a dance troupe?
zh: ~z~好吧，谢谢你。我会振作的，然后学习杂耍，找个歌舞团上班？

english: ~z~until you're sweating out all the chemicals in it and the hormones are making your balls feel funny.
zh: ~z~直到你发汗排出了里面的化学药品，然后你的蛋也被激素弄得不太行了。

english: ~z~I have stumbled from one disaster to another, and now I am here, and it is another disaster.
zh: ~z~我一次次的被各种灾难绊倒，现在才来到这里，然后又是一场灾难。

english: ~z~She did. Many times. But trust me, cousin. She was no good.
zh: ~z~她是喜欢，喜欢得多。不过相信我，堂弟。她不是个好人。

english: ~z~No, I'm going to be on I'm Rich, cousin. If you're lucky,
zh: ~z~不，我会上《我是富豪》的，堂弟。如果你走运的话，

english: ~z~fighting a war that ended, killing, running around like a lunatic, all this craziness.
zh: ~z~为一场已经结束了的战争而战，像个疯子一样杀戮、奔走，各种各样的疯狂。

english: ~z~Ha ha, very funny. I'm serious. I only bet on sure things now.
zh: ~z~哈哈，很有趣。我是认真的。我现在只赌确定的东西。

english: ~z~I was sorry to hear of his death, Roman. We have not spoken about it.
zh: ~z~听闻他的死讯我很遗憾，罗曼。我们还没讲过这件事。

english: ~z~Now they still spit on me, but at least I know I have you here.
zh: ~z~现在他们还是朝我吐口水，不过至少我知道还有你在。

english: ~z~I'll only back a horse if the competition is doped, I'll only bet on a game of football if it's fixed.
zh: ~z~要赌马，我只押用过兴奋剂的。要赌球，也只赌打假球的。

english: ~z~To have a real friend in the world, that was all I think I ever wanted, and in you, I have that person.
zh: ~z~拥有一个真正的朋友，这就是我一直想要的。在你身上，我找到了那个朋友。

english: ~z~The Old Country stopped being home for me when Mama was taken from me in the war.
zh: ~z~当战争从我身边夺走妈妈时，故国就不再是我的家了。

english: ~z~their fathers ran it before them, and their fathers before them.
zh: ~z~之前是他们的父亲执政，再往前是他们父亲的父亲执政。

english: ~z~In poker, I play super tight - Buffet Car Jancowitz style. I only play the top ten hands.
zh: ~z~打牌，我打得也很谨慎，《餐饮列车》的扬科维茨风格。只有十佳手牌才会下注。

english: ~z~You are the man I wanted to be, Roman - happy, kind and a good person.
zh: ~z~你就是我想成为的人，罗曼。开心、善良、正直的人。

english: ~z~I don't buy that bullshit. Grow up, move on, be, be free! At least think about it?
zh: ~z~这种狗屁我可不买账。长大、前进、自由自在！至少考虑一下吧？

english: ~z~Not because of the place. It's interesting, but also strange. Too noisy. I am glad because of you.
zh: ~z~不是说这里有多好。这里很有趣，但也很奇怪，太吵了。是因为有你才高兴。

english: ~z~My mother would be here if she was still alive. She was such a strong woman.
zh: ~z~要是我母亲还活着，她也会来这儿。她是一个很坚强的女性。

english: ~z~That is very kind of you, cousin, but you would be the only one who was sorry that he died.
zh: ~z~你真善良，堂弟，但应该只有你会为他的死感到遗憾了。

english: ~z~I think you must speak for yourself there. Not many would call me emotionally balanced.
zh: ~z~我觉得你说的应该是你自己。很少有人会说我心理健康。

english: ~z~But Mila Tadic prefers Roman... it's a terrible love triangle!
zh: ~z~然而米拉･塔迪奇更喜欢罗曼...是糟糕的三角恋！

english: ~z~The same names are on the new buildings as that are on the old ones.
zh: ~z~新建的大楼上的名字和老的大楼上都是同样的名字。

english: ~z~Don't be stupid, I'm talking about myself. I've come through the tunnel and seen the light.
zh: ~z~别犯傻，我说的是我自己。我已经要走出隧道见着光了。

english: ~z~I can do this. Live this life. I cannot live another. Not now.
zh: ~z~我可以这样，过这种日子。我没法过别的生活，现在不行。

english: ~z~Not too much - I was remembering the Old Country, when we were children.
zh: ~z~也就那样，我只是在回忆故国，回忆我们的童年。

english: ~z~You, you know what? I'm glad you came here. It's good to be living in this madhouse with family.
zh: ~z~你知道吗？我很高兴你能来这儿。能和家人一起住在这个疯人院里很好。

english: ~z~I promised myself I wouldn't go home until I had resolved certain problems.
zh: ~z~我跟自己保证过，直到解决某些问题前，我绝不回家。

english: ~z~I wish I could be with my mother, but there is nothing left for me there other than her.
zh: ~z~我是希望能跟母亲在一起，但是那里给我剩下的只有她。

english: ~z~I don't know. I lost contact. I think he went to Britain. Or to University. I don't know.
zh: ~z~不知道，我联系不上他。我觉得他去英国了，要么上大学去了。我不知道。

english: ~z~Not many know you as well as I do. You're a big softie at heart.
zh: ~z~很少有人像我一样了解你。你心里其实是很善良的。

english: ~z~Listen man. I'm worried about you. You have to sort your life out. Before it ends.
zh: ~z~听着老弟，我很担心你。你必须要整顿一下你的生活，在它结束以前。

english: ~z~To get by, to have a life that isn't totally shit, for things to be a little easier.
zh: ~z~混日子过，过上没那么栏的生活，让生活容易些。

english: ~z~I think someone put something in my drink. Evil people do it to women they wish to take advantage of.
zh: ~z~我觉得有人在我的酒里掺了东西。恶人想占女人便宜的时候就会这么做。

english: ~z~I have a good feeling in my gut. There is money to be won, Niko.
zh: ~z~直觉告诉我现在正是时候，有钱等着我赢，尼克。

english: ~z~About games of chance, about hard work and opportunity, about pleasuring women -
zh: ~z~学习运气游戏，学习努力与机遇，学习取悦女人。

english: ~z~And which nice sailor in there do you think wanted to take advantage of you, pretty lady?
zh: ~z~那你觉得是里面的哪个水手想占你便宜呢，漂亮女士？

english: ~z~You vomit, you cry, you read self help books. You are all man, Roman!
zh: ~z~你呕吐，你大哭，你会读鸡汤书。你完全是个人，罗曼！

english: ~z~The woman of my dreams. My own cousin is thinking about her firm sweet titties.
zh: ~z~我的梦中情人。结果我的堂弟在想她丰满动人的奶子。

english: ~z~Have you been balling Mallorie, cousin? How could you? She's the love of my life.
zh: ~z~你是不是睡过玛洛丽，堂弟？你怎么能这样？她是我的一生挚爱。

english: ~z~Wonderful dollars to collect from stupid chumps who can't pick a winner from loser,
zh: ~z~一大票美刀等着我拿，从那些分不清谁赢谁输的白痴手里，

english: ~z~I am... listen, man... I'm seeing funny. I think I got spiked.
zh: ~z~真的...听着老弟...我看见了幻觉，我觉得我被下药了。

english: ~z~I did - she said you were like a wild animal... like a wild pig.
zh: ~z~我问过。她说你就像是头狂野的禽兽...像一头野猪。

english: ~z~Fuck you. Fuck you, Niko Bellic. He was looking at me like he wanted to fight.
zh: ~z~去你妈的。去你妈的，尼克･贝利克。他看我的时候一副想打架的样子。

english: ~z~As usual, one smell of the alehouse and Roman Bellic is about to vomit!
zh: ~z~一如既往，闻到一点酒馆的气味，罗曼･贝利克就要吐了！

english: ~z~Since you have got to Liberty City I have shared everything with you, everything.
zh: ~z~自从你来到自由城，我什么都跟你分享了，我的一切。

english: ~z~But I won't share that, no I won't share that. I love you, Niko.
zh: ~z~但她我绝对不会分享，不，不分享的。我爱你，尼克。

english: ~z~Tastes like fucking piss. Everyone loves an imported and classy beverage.
zh: ~z~口感跟他妈尿一样。所有人都喜欢进口的上等酒水。

english: ~z~So what if I moved here. Everyone except the Native Americans are immigrants to this country
zh: ~z~我是移民过来的怎么了。除了美洲土著，这个国家的所有人都是移民，

english: ~z~and even they were meant to have walked here from Russia when the sea was frozen over.
zh: ~z~就连土著都得等到海面结冰才能从俄罗斯走过来。

english: ~z~I'm out. This was the last one. I'm taking my money and staying out of this shit.
zh: ~z~我收手了，这是最后一票。拿到分成以后我就远离这行了。

english: ~z~If I was you, I'd go and get the money off them. It has to be on the site.
zh: ~z~要我说，就去把他们的钱抢过来。钱肯定备好了。

english: ~z~Fuck, we gotta get him. I ain't going home empty handed from this. Dimitri would love that.
zh: ~z~操！我们要得到他。我不会空手而归。迪米特里会很喜欢这个。

english: ~z~Shit. We were so close. We did all that shit for nothing. I'll see you around man.
zh: ~z~妈的，就差一点。前面全他妈白干了。我们之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Fuck you - I looked out for you. And I'll pay good. Real good.
zh: ~z~操你妈，我罩过你。我会给个好价钱的，很好的价钱。

english: ~z~There ain't no try, we're getting him. Come on.
zh: ~z~没有什么是不能试试的，我们就要抓住他了，快来。

english: ~z~You think you can get in this work for an easy buck but you end up in deep shit every time.
zh: ~z~你以为能轻轻松松赚大钱，结果每次都是一团糟。

english: ~z~At least you knew what Ray was after from day one, Dimitri can turn on his best friend in a second.
zh: ~z~至少一见到雷就能看穿他的本性，迪米特里随时可以跟他的挚友翻脸。

english: ~z~The punk is getting away with the money. I ain't come this far to let it go. Come on.
zh: ~z~那个混帐想带着钱走人。事到如今他还想跑？快追。

english: ~z~Dimitri would love it if we didn't come back at all.
zh: ~z~如果我们根本就不会来，迪米特里 会喜欢这样的。

english: ~z~How come everything we get into starts off simple and ends up real complicated?
zh: ~z~我们那些开头简单的活好像没一个结尾不难的吧。

english: ~z~Something didn't look right about him. I don't know, there was something in his eyes.
zh: ~z~他这人看上去是不太对。说不清楚，看不透他的想法。

english: ~z~They're gonna be coming after us so we may as well make a play for the money while we still got a jump on 'em.
zh: ~z~他们会追杀我们的，最好还是趁着还能突袭的时候为钱搏一把。

english: ~z~What the fuck are you doing? These boys ain't gonna do business with us now.
zh: ~z~你他妈的在干嘛？这些人现在不会和我们交易了。

english: ~z~Yeah, I met him when Jimmy P set up the deal. There's something about him I don't trust.
zh: ~z~嗯，吉米 P安排这次交易的时候我见过他。我不太信任这个人。

english: ~z~This is just a straightforward money pickup. Dimitri is gonna hand over the H on his end.
zh: ~z~这次就是个简单的收钱工作。迪米特里那边拿白粉交货，

english: ~z~At least we got the cash. That's the one thing we can bring away from this fucked up situation.
zh: ~z~至少我们拿到钱了。这种情况下唯一能得到的收获。

english: ~z~Mr. Pegorino. Phil didn't make it. He's in a better place.
zh: ~z~ 佩戈里诺先生。菲尔挂了。他现在在一个更好的地方。

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. You go that way, I'll go this way. We'll close 'em in.
zh: ~z~好的，尼克。你走那条路，我走这条路。这样我们会接近他们。

english: ~z~No, you listen, you dumb immigrant fuck. I ain't asking you. I'm telling you. Do this!
zh: ~z~不，你听着，白痴移民崽子。我不是在求你，这是命令，你照做！

english: ~z~Dimitri likes to set up executions. He set up his best friend Mikhail Faustin.
zh: ~z~迪米特里最喜欢送人上那儿。他最好的朋友米哈伊尔･福斯汀就被送上去了。

english: ~z~I cannot say I have the same enthusiasm for this partnership. Have you given them the H?
zh: ~z~这次合作我反正是没你这么高兴。白粉你交出去了吗？

english: ~z~I looked out for you, you know. People wanted to whack you, I said no.
zh: ~z~我罩过你，要知道。之前有人想杀你，我不同意。

english: ~z~If they'd gotten tipped off before Dimitri called us, we woulda been fucked.
zh: ~z~要是他们在迪米特里打电话之前就收到了消息，我们早完了。

english: ~z~Look, Phil will look after you. You won't even have to deal with the fucking Russians.
zh: ~z~听着，菲尔会跟你一起去。你都不用跟那些混蛋俄国佬见面。

english: ~z~Listen, Mr. Pegorino. I already told you. I got history...
zh: ~z~听着，佩戈里诺先生。我都说过了，我跟他有...

english: ~z~We'll get a call from him when they have the stuff, then the buyers will hand over the funds.
zh: ~z~货物交付以后他会联系我们，然后买家给我们结帐。

english: ~z~That's true Phil. It's never fucking easy, is it? You can't just walk in somewhere and get free money.
zh: ~z~确实如此，菲尔。从来都不简单，对吗？天上不会掉馅饼。

english: ~z~Especially when you've got a snake like Dimitri Rascalov working with you.
zh: ~z~特别是跟迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫这种小人合作的时候。

english: ~z~No, it's over for me, I'm out. If I was going to kill him I would have done that instead of this deal.
zh: ~z~不，与我无关了，我收手了。要杀他的话我早去了，哪会过来交易。

english: ~z~You know what? I thought, 'Why should we hand over the H for this price?'
zh: ~z~说实话，我觉得吧，「这价钱把粉交出去不是贱卖吗？」

english: ~z~If they going to fuck you over once they'll fuck you again. Wish I realized that before.
zh: ~z~一朝蛇咬你，十年蛇咬你。真希望我能早点明白。

english: ~z~We need to catch this car, Niko. I been fucked around enough and I ain't walking away with nothing.
zh: ~z~我们要追上那辆车，尼克。我已经被操的遍体鳞伤了，我不会空着手离开。

english: ~z~Easier for who? What the fuck are you doing? Me and Phil are in their compound.
zh: ~z~谁简单啊？你他妈在干啥？我和菲尔还在他们的地盘。

english: ~z~I need you to collect that H, I got some Russians who have a buyer.
zh: ~z~需要你拿上那些H，我联络到俄国人了，他们有下家。

english: ~z~I hate to think what's gone down on Dimitri's end. I'm calling Jimmy.
zh: ~z~都不敢想迪米特里那边会怎么样。我给吉米打个电话。

english: ~z~Niko, it's been a long time. I thought your time in America might have calmed you down.
zh: ~z~尼克，好久没见了。我还以为你在美国这么久已经冷静下来了。

english: ~z~I guess you did what you felt you had to do. No deal, no money, no hot tubs and models.
zh: ~z~那你还是跟随了自己内心的指引喽。没有交易，没有钱，没有浴缸，没有辣模。

english: ~z~Look at you, you arrived in this country a spineless rat who would sell out his friends.
zh: ~z~比如你，你来美国时是个没骨气的两面三刀的老鼠。

english: ~z~I killed Dimitri, it's over. He was on the Platypus, the boat I arrived in Liberty City on.
zh: ~z~我杀了迪米特里，都结束了。他就在鸭嘴兽号上，我来自由城时坐的船。

english: ~z~I promised myself I wouldn't kill nobody today. By coming on ship, you have made me break promise!
zh: ~z~本来我发誓今天不杀人的。但你上船了，我就只能破戒了！

english: Change into a suit for the wedding or go to Perseus to buy a smart outfit.
zh: 换一身婚礼用的西装，或者去神之子服饰买点漂亮衣服。

english: ~z~Wait for me, I'm on my way. What is Roman doing there? This is not the place for him.
zh: ~z~等我，我这就来。罗曼过去干啥？那不是他该去的地方。

english: ~z~Jacob, the best way to help me is to keep my cousin alive. I don't want to lose him as well.
zh: ~z~雅各布，保证我哥活着就是对我最大的帮助。我不想再失去他了。

english: ~z~Also, figure out an exit strategy. When this guy is dead, I'm not going to want to hang around long.
zh: ~z~还有，找个撤退方案。等他死了，我可不想在这里久留。

english: ~z~Niko, I and Roman have found one a dat ras clot Pegorino's men, seen?
zh: ~z~尼克，我和罗曼找到了那个混蛋佩戈里诺的手下，懂？

english: ~z~Yeah man, me get de ras clot. See him a crash pon de island?
zh: ~z~耶，兄弟，我找到那个混蛋了。等着他靠岸弃船吧。

english: ~z~Alright, me breda. Dat blood clot be inna de place. I an' I been following him for a time, seen?
zh: ~z~好了，好兄弟。那个狗逼就在这里。我们跟踪他有段时间了，懂？

english: ~z~He backing you up, rasta. I an' I both be, seen? One love.
zh: ~z~他是来支援的，兄弟。我们都是你的后盾，懂吧。再见。

english: ~z~Me tink his next step is wit Pegorino. We follow him there, seen?
zh: ~z~我想他们待会儿会去找佩戈里诺。我们跟着他去，懂？

english: ~z~Thank you, both of you. But I do not think this is the place for you, Roman. This is too dangerous.
zh: ~z~谢谢，谢谢你们。但你不该一起来的，罗曼。太危险了。

english: ~z~You are my cousin Niko, and Kate died at my wedding. I'm helping you.
zh: ~z~你是我的堂弟，尼克。而凯特死在了我的婚礼上。我要帮你。

english: ~z~Ya see, after dat heroin deal, Dimitri's hangin out wit Pegorino now.
zh: ~z~你看，在那次海洛因交易后，迪米特里就和佩戈里诺在一块了。

english: ~z~I know. Jacob was a good friend to both of us. Call me soon, Niko.
zh: ~z~我知道。雅各布是咱俩的好朋友。待会联系，尼克。

english: ~z~I tink dis boy gonna lead me to right where Jimmy and Dimitri are.
zh: ~z~我想这个小子会带我们去吉米和迪米特里在的地方。

english: ~z~Air unit seven-b has been engaged. This is a potential terrorist situation.
zh: ~z~空中单位7-b已经启用了。这是潜在的恐怖主义局势。;//未使用

english: ~z~I wanted out and you killed someone I cared about. It's over for you now, Jimmy.
zh: ~z~我想要退出，但你杀了我在乎的人。现在你死定了，吉米。

english: ~z~Me knew you'd find a way, me bredren. Take control of dis ting. You better at driving than me.
zh: ~z~就知道你能杀出来，好兄弟。飞机你开吧，你技术比我好。

english: ~z~Fuck, we got a tail. Better lose this piece of shit on the way back to the Peg. I don't wanna be late.
zh: ~z~操，有人跟踪。最好在回去找佩戈里诺的路上甩掉他们。我可不想迟到。

english: ~z~Please don't kill us, please don't kill us, please don't kill us.
zh: ~z~求求别杀了我们，求求别杀了我们，求求别杀了我们。

english: ~z~You said you wanted to help, Roman. You said you wanted to give Pegorino payback just as much as I did.
zh: ~z~你说你想帮忙，罗曼。你说你和我一样想让佩戈里诺付出代价。

english: ~z~True dat. When a man lose everything, and him still have him life, him know what it worth ya know.
zh: ~z~确实是这样。当一个人失去了所有，但是他还活着，他知道什么该去做。

english: ~z~Yeah, but this guy better not be fucking with us. He better be bringing us to Pegorino.
zh: ~z~嗯，但这人最好别耍咱们。他最好能带我们找到佩戈里诺。

english: ~z~I do not care if I am killed, if I am hurt, as long as he pays for his attack.
zh: ~z~我不在乎我的死活，我的安危，我只要他杀人偿命。

english: ~z~Word pon de street is dat Peg ain't got much, him held up somewhere a waiting fe get outta town.
zh: ~z~据说佩戈里诺的势力所剩无几，现在正躲在哪里准备跑路。

english: ~z~Easy now Niko. Dat shit work in all dem spy torture type show pon TV, seen?
zh: ~z~冷静尼克。这种拷问只在电视上播的谍战片里有用。

english: ~z~If that shit, Pegorino, understands the worth of his life, it will be all the more satisfying to take it away from him.
zh: ~z~如果佩戈里诺明白他生命的价值，那么从他身上拿走生命就更令人满意了。

english: ~z~At least we're seeing some of Alderney. I don't normally come this side of the West River.
zh: ~z~至少我们见识了下奥尔德尼。平常我不会来西河西边的。

english: ~z~Motherfucker, why don't we just stop his car and start cutting off his fingers until he tells us where the fuck Pegorino is?
zh: ~z~妈个逼的，我们直接把他逼停，断指逼供让他说出佩戈里诺在哪儿不就行了？

english: ~z~I showed a man that you cannot always get what you want at the cost of the lives of others.
zh: ~z~我之前已经让一个人知道，你不能总是以别人的生命为代价去得到你想得到的东西。

english: ~z~Easy me breda. He's taking us to Pegorino. You need fe chill.
zh: ~z~放松，好兄弟。他会带我们找到佩戈里诺的。你要冷静。

english: ~z~But we're done. Now we can start making money... freely.
zh: ~z~至少，事情解决了。我们能开始赚钱了...自由地赚。

english: ~z~We will keep on this guy and hopefully he won't fucking kill us or crash before he leads us to Pegorino.
zh: ~z~继续跟着他，希望他不会杀了我们或者撞死自己，能带我们找到佩戈里诺。

english: ~z~I am not taking you on some tourist sightseeing tour. We're chasing a scumbag back to his boss.
zh: ~z~我不是带你们来旅游的。现在要跟着他找到他的老板。

english: ~z~Alright, we follow him back to Pegorino, then we cut his fucking fingers off.
zh: ~z~好吧，我们跟着他找到佩戈里诺，然后再切了丫的手指。

english: ~z~If I live, I will be able to say that today, I did not hesitate, I did what was right.
zh: ~z~如果我没死，以后我说起今天就是：我没有犹豫，我做了正确的事。

english: ~z~There ain't no getting away from us now that we got this thing. It's a flying tank. He's a dead man.
zh: ~z~他们没有逃走，我们能做到的。那就是个飞着的坦克，他是个死人了。；未使用

english: ~z~We will kill Pegorino, cousin. Whether this constitutes a victory; that is another matter.
zh: ~z~我们会杀了佩戈里诺的，堂兄。不管这是不是一场胜利，那都是另一回事了。

english: ~z~I did not start this, I have no choice after Pegorino killed Kate.
zh: ~z~我也不想的。既然佩戈里诺杀了凯特，我也别无他选。

english: ~z~Shit, cousin, is this a good idea? Taking on all of these hired hoods?
zh: ~z~靠，堂弟，这样真的好吗？真要杀光所有的打手？

english: ~z~Where'd you get this chopper, anyway? This is a serious piece of equipment.
zh: ~z~你在哪整的这架飞机，不管怎么样。这真是个大家伙。

english: ~z~This man will lead us there, we'll get him cousin. I assure you.
zh: ~z~这人会带我们过去的，会找到他的，堂弟。我保证。

english: ~z~Dat no true blood. Ya got I and Roman, seen? Roman just scared and ting. He don't mean what him saying.
zh: ~z~不是的，兄弟。你还有我和罗曼，懂？罗曼只是有点害怕。他真不是那个意思。

english: ~z~They say that the dying animal is the most dangerous in the jungle, cousin.
zh: ~z~他们说濒死的野兽是丛林里最危险的生物，堂弟。

english: ~z~I'm only going to say this is done when Pegorino's heart stops beating. You understand?
zh: ~z~我只想说，佩戈里诺心脏停止跳动的时候，一切都结束了。你明白吗？

english: ~z~I'm being shot at and all I have for company are two gangsters discussing the finer points of torture.
zh: ~z~一边挨着枪子儿，旁边坐着两个黑社会讨论酷刑的细节。

english: ~z~That's not a possibility, cousin. This man has been picking stuff up for Pegorino since we found him.
zh: ~z~不可能的，堂弟。自从我们找到他，他就在替佩戈里诺置办东西。

english: ~z~Me hear from me sources that Pegorino, he might be hiding in the North of Alderney somewhere.
zh: ~z~我的线人告诉我说，佩戈里诺可能躲在奥尔德尼北部的某处。

english: ~z~Are you sure that he's going back to Pegorino? He's not going to go on the lamb?
zh: ~z~你确定他会去找佩戈里诺吗？万一是他自己的藏身处呢？

english: ~z~Then we're going to make that shithead pay for what he did to Kate. Understand?
zh: ~z~然后让那个混蛋为他对凯特做的事付出代价。明白？

english: ~z~Seen, bredren. I and I be after him. Ain't no way de boy gwan live another day upon dis earth. Seen?
zh: ~z~对，兄弟，能找到他的。那小子不可能在这世上多活一天，懂？

english: ~z~Sure, cousin, sure. Eyes to the front. Mind on the job at hand and all that shit.
zh: ~z~当然了，堂弟，当然。向前看，专注手头的任务之类的。

english: ~z~Well, I guess I'll be doing the whole city a favor when I kill Pegorino, then.
zh: ~z~那我杀了佩戈里诺应该是替全城做了件大好事了。

english: ~z~She... was something worth protecting... by helping me today you are doing something good.
zh: ~z~她...是值得保护的...今天你们帮我是在做好事。

english: ~z~You think that it'll just be this guy and Pegorino? We teach them a lesson and we go.
zh: ~z~会不会只有这个人跟佩戈里诺？教训完他们就能走了。

english: ~z~I want to get this guy.I just don't think we want to take any unnecessary risks while we're doing that.
zh: ~z~我也想找到他。只是我不想让我们陷入没必要的危险。

english: ~z~I guess Pegorino is not so weak after all, there were many men with him.
zh: ~z~我猜佩戈里诺毕竟没有那么弱，还有很多人追随他。

english: ~z~From what you tell me about Jimmy P, he's too desperate to do without this shit.
zh: ~z~从你口中吉米 P的为人来看，采购结束前他不敢跑的。

english: ~z~This is something that I have to do. Kate had a messed up family, but she remained good.
zh: ~z~这是我必须要做的事。凯特的家庭环境不好，但是她出淤泥而不染。

english: ~z~This is great, just great. How's married life, Roman? It's really relaxing, thanks for asking.
zh: ~z~可太棒了，太棒了。婚后生活如何，罗曼？相当舒坦啊，感谢提问。

english: ~z~Pegorino ain't as strong as when he used to run the Aldreney family, is he Niko?
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺没之前掌控奥尔德尼家族时那么强大了，对吧，尼克？

english: ~z~He been running round town like a headless chicken,ya know rasta. Picking up shit, him desperate.
zh: ~z~他像无头苍蝇一样在城里乱转，兄弟。到处采购，他怕了。

english: ~z~I did... I do want to but, you know. I don't want to die, I have a wife to think about now.
zh: ~z~是说过...我确实想，但是，说真的，我不想死啊，我还有老婆要照顾。

english: ~z~Ya see, after dat heroin deal, Dimitri's hangin out wit Pegorino now.
zh: ~z~那次海洛因交易后，迪米特里就和佩戈里诺一起行动了。

english: ~z~Niko, mek we get dis ras clot. Get under me chopper and jump on.
zh: ~z~尼克，我们一定得干了丫。开到我直升机的下面跳上来。

english: ~z~If you want to help me, find a way for us to make a swift exit when these men are dead. Goodbye Jacob.
zh: ~z~要是你想帮我，就帮我找个战斗结束后撤退的办法吧。再见了，雅各布。

english: ~z~Alright, me breda. That blood clot is inna the place right now. I been following him for some time.
zh: ~z~好了，好兄弟。现在那个狗逼就在这里。我跟踪他有段时间了。

english: ~z~Niko, I found one of Jimmy Pegorino's boys inna some building in Koresh Square.
zh: ~z~尼克，我在科雷什广场的一栋楼里发现了吉米･佩戈里诺的手下。

english: ~z~I don't care how many of your men I have to kill, I'm finding you, Dimitri.
zh: ~z~我不在乎要杀多少你的人，我来找你了，迪米特里。

english: ~z~I'm gwan find Dimitri and Pegorino. We gwan make 'em pay for Roman.
zh: ~z~我会找到迪米特里和佩戈里诺的。必须让他们为罗曼的死付出代价。

english: ~z~Me think his next stop is with Pegorino and Dimitri. We follow him there, seen?
zh: ~z~我想接下来他就会去找佩戈里诺和迪米特里。我们就跟着他找，懂？

english: ~z~Dimitri, what's the problem? Me and you is partners now. We're back on top.
zh: ~z~迪米特里，怎么回事？你我现在是合伙关系。我们都重返权位了。

english: ~z~Thank you, Jacob. I know you cared for Roman, but he was my family. You do not have to do this.
zh: ~z~谢谢你，雅各布。我知道你很关心罗曼，但他是我的家人。你没必要做这么多的。

english: ~z~I didn't work this hard to share the spoils of a victory. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我付出那么多可不是为了和谁分享胜利果实的。再见。

english: ~z~Rhaatid, there's Pegorino's boy. You have fe stick to him, bredren.
zh: ~z~我去，佩戈里诺的手下来了。一定要跟住他，兄弟。

english: ~z~If Dimitri and Pegorino are so on top, why would they care about me?
zh: ~z~要是迪米特里和佩戈里诺都有这么大权势了，还担心我干嘛？

english: ~z~Ya man ya man. How'de ginnal get away from you anyway, Niko? Me tink ya get dat boy for sure.
zh: ~z~好，兄弟，好，兄弟。那骗子怎么可能躲过你？我觉得你肯定能逮着那崽子。

english: ~z~How you know he's going back to Pegorino and Dimitri? Why would he lead us back to them?
zh: ~z~你怎么知道他会去找佩戈里诺和迪米特里？他真会把我们引过去？

english: ~z~De boy leading us back because him tink him boys going fe tear us to pieces and ting.
zh: ~z~他把我们带过去是因为他觉得他的人足以把我们撕成碎片。

english: ~z~A snake always be a snake, ya know rasta. Dimitri woulda steal from him own mother fe get ahead, ya know.
zh: ~z~叛徒永远都是叛徒懂吧，兄弟。迪米特里为了目标连他母亲都敢偷。

english: ~z~Come on, why does this take so long? Where are these idiots hiding out?
zh: ~z~真是，怎么要花这么久？那些蠢蛋到底躲在哪儿？

english: ~z~We catch him, then we kill him, then we decide what to do with the body. How's that sound, Jacob?
zh: ~z~先逮住他，再杀了他，然后再决定怎么处理尸体。这样如何，雅各布？

english: ~z~Alright, so this guy is taking us to his bosses. We cannot kill him yet then.
zh: ~z~好了，既然这家伙会带我们找到他的老板，暂时就不能杀他。

english: ~z~Dimitri tinks dat you forget about what happen on the docks ya know, in Broker. Him screw ya over after ya kill Faustin for him.
zh: ~z~迪米特里觉得你把布洛克码头的那件事给忘了。你替他杀了福斯汀，他却出卖了你。

english: ~z~Yo Niko, Dimitri and Pegorino gwan have mad firepower pon di ground, ya know. Dis ain't gwan be easy.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，迪米特里和佩戈里诺肯定会在周边布置大量的火力懂吧。不会那么容易的。

english: ~z~No, Dimitri killed Pegorino when I arrived. I don't think he likes to share.
zh: ~z~不，我到的时候迪米特里就杀了佩戈里诺。我想他不喜欢和人分享。

english: ~z~Don't worry, rasta. I gwan shoot him out de blood clot sky. He ain't going to be able to talk his way outta dis.
zh: ~z~别担心，兄弟。我这就让他在天上血妈爆炸。他没法再用花言巧语骗出生路了。

english: ~z~Seen Niko, a whole heap a bodies left inna dat place dere, ya know? Ya a real lion for real, ya know, star?
zh: ~z~懂了，尼克，那里留着一大堆尸体是吧？你真是头雄狮，知道吗，老兄？

english: ~z~Maybe we should go with Dimitri's body. Bury him in his homeland.
zh: ~z~也许我们应该带上迪米特里的尸体过去。把他埋在故乡。

english: ~z~I had the opportunity to settle my score with Dimitri the other day but I chose not to take it.
zh: ~z~之前我就有机会和迪米特里把账算清，但我没有行动。

english: ~z~Dimitri and Pegorino, they be pon top after that deal, ya know. They got de coil and de brown, didn't dey?
zh: ~z~迪米特里和佩戈里诺，他俩在那次交易后就上位了。他们既有钱又有货，不是吗？

english: ~z~Yo Niko, ya need fe lose some of dis anger, ya know, before ya go after dem boy dere.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，在跟着他们找到人之前你还是先消消气比较好。

english: ~z~We haffi get to dem, so we follow dis bumba clot, seen?
zh: ~z~我们必须找到他们，所以才跟着这个小杂种，懂？

english: ~z~I can tell him getting nervous, ya know, Niko. He's driving different. We must be getting close.
zh: ~z~我敢肯定他慌了，尼克。他的开车风格变了。我们肯定很接近了。

english: ~z~No matter what you say about dat murderer, he's consistent. He's consistently fucking anybody him can.
zh: ~z~无论你怎么评价那个杀人犯，他都是一样的。他一直都是能搞谁搞谁。

english: ~z~Yeah, I understand. I get it. I just need those bastards to know and understand what they did to me.
zh: ~z~是，我明白。我懂的。我只是要让那些混蛋明白，知道自己到底对我做了什么。

english: ~z~Anyting could happen if you kill Dimitri pon dat day.
zh: ~z~就算你当时把迪米特里杀了，也不能保证之后会发生什么。

english: ~z~Had I got rid of Dimitri then, the bloodshed would have ended.
zh: ~z~要是我那会儿就杀了迪米特里，这些杀戮就已经结束了。

english: ~z~Also, dey ain't going to know their boy at the wedding didn't do his job properly. They tink ya dead, ya know.
zh: ~z~还有，他们都不知道派去婚礼的杀手没办成事。当你已经死了，懂吗？

english: ~z~Dere ain't no guarantee you gonna make it, bredren. I and I don't know what our actions can do and ting.
zh: ~z~没人能保证你会成功，兄弟。我们也不知道我们的选择会有什么后果。

english: ~z~Sending an assassin after me and killing Roman on his wedding day, this is something I will not ignore.
zh: ~z~派杀手来杀我，还在罗曼的大喜之日杀了他。这，才是我不能坐视不理的。

english: ~z~He stabbed Pegorino in the back, just like he did to everyone he has worked with while I have known him.
zh: ~z~他背叛了佩戈里诺，就像他对他的所有合伙人做的一样，我已经很清楚了。

english: ~z~Dem boy dey no right ya know, Come inna church and come kill a man pon him wedding day. Jah know, it ain't right.
zh: ~z~那几个小子不做好事懂吧。冲进教堂，冲进去把婚礼的新郎给杀了。主知道那是不对的。

english: ~z~He was beaten because of me, he was shot, his business and his home were burnt down.
zh: ~z~他因为我的缘故被打，挨了枪子，他的家和事业都成了焦土。

english: ~z~Who dat inna de helicopter? Did Dimtri and Pegorino both leave when you get inna de ground?
zh: ~z~那架直升机里是谁？你进去的时候迪米特里和佩戈里诺是不是都跑了？

english: ~z~I cannot allow that to happen again, not to me, not to Mallorie and everyone who loved Roman.
zh: ~z~我不能让那种悲剧重演，在我身上，在玛洛丽身上，在任何爱着罗曼的人身上都不能重演。

english: ~z~Roman brought me to this city and I was nothing but a curse to him.
zh: ~z~罗曼让我来到这个城市，而我于他完全就是灾厄。

english: ~z~I have finally learnt this lesson. It has taken the death of my cousin, but it is something I must accept.
zh: ~z~我终于明白了这个道理。以我堂兄的死为代价，但我也必须得接受。

english: ~z~All we can be tinking about is taking dat ras clot down, and stopping him from hurting anyone else. Seen?
zh: ~z~我们现在能考虑的就是干掉那个狗杂种，让他不能再伤害任何人。懂？

english: ~z~We must find Dimitri and Pegorino and end all this.
zh: ~z~我们必须找到迪米特里和佩戈里诺，给一切画上句号。

english: ~z~Easy Niko, just be cool now. Pegorino and Dimitri be splitting up de large amount of money dem get from de business deal.
zh: ~z~放松，尼克，现在先冷静。佩戈里诺和迪米特里正在分配那次交易的巨额钱款。

english: ~z~Me understand ya know, rasta. It's a good ting dat blood clot don't know you as good as I and I know ya, ya know?
zh: ~z~我明白，兄弟。幸好那个狗逼没我那么了解你，懂吗？

english: ~z~He was kidnapped. I should have known that the lives of those close to me would be destroyed.
zh: ~z~被人绑架。我早该知道亲近我的人的生活都会被破坏。

english: ~z~He was a good man. No matter what happened to him, he would never be angry or upset for more than a minute.
zh: ~z~他是个好人。无论遇到什么，他都不会愤怒或者伤心多久。

english: ~z~We can make sure that Roman's life is not the only one that is lost today.
zh: ~z~我们可以做到让罗曼不是唯一一个在今天没命的人。

english: ~z~I came to this city wanting revenge, I let that desire build up inside of me for many years.
zh: ~z~我怀着复仇的心来到这座城市，我已经任由那种欲望在心中生长很多年了。

english: ~z~To get them back for what they have done, I would look for them in every corner of the earth.
zh: ~z~要让他们为自己的行为付出代价，我会寻找到天涯海角。

english: ~z~Seen, we just need fe stay on dis bumba clot and we'll be able to mash dem up real good.
zh: ~z~懂了，我们只要跟住这个杂种，就能把他们彻底粉碎。

english: ~z~If there was any way I could change my actions so that he would not die, I would do it.
zh: ~z~要是有什么办法能改变我的选择，保住他的性命，我一定会去做的。

english: ~z~If you didn't wanna come up here, he was gonna go to Europe and drag you pon a boat.
zh: ~z~就算你不想来这儿，他也会去欧洲拉着你上船过来。

english: ~z~Dat was a long time ago, ya know, king. Dere ain't no promise dat life would be any different from now, ya know.
zh: ~z~那是很久以前了，兄弟。而且也没法保证那样就会和现在有什么区别。

english: ~z~Jah know not many man could a got through dem boys, ya know, star. Ya a real badman for real, real badman!
zh: ~z~主也知道很少有人能杀出这样的血路懂吧，老兄。你真是个大恶人，真真正正的恶人！

english: ~z~Ya man, we getting closer. Me hear from me source dat Pegorino might be inna di north of Alderney.
zh: ~z~喂老兄，我们很近了。我听线人说佩戈里诺可能就在奥尔德尼的北部。

english: ~z~What's done is done, and dere ain't no way to change what happen earlier.
zh: ~z~木已成舟，没有什么办法能够改变已经发生的事。

english: ~z~A man stab you in the back once, him gonna keep stabbing until di job is done, seen?
zh: ~z~背叛过你的人永远都会背叛你，直到双方做个了断，懂？

english: ~z~Roman was a good man, ya know. He had a righteous heart, ya know, star. Jah know him in a better place now.
zh: ~z~罗曼是个好人，懂吧。他的心肠很好，懂吧，老兄。主知道他现在在更好的地方。

english: ~z~Dat be a whole heap of teeth, ya know, Niko. I don't tink we have enough ammo fe shoot him dat many times, ya know.
zh: ~z~那可得打上不少子弹，尼克。我觉得我们的子弹还不够打那么多次。

english: ~z~Are we getting near to them or is this man taking us on a tour around Alderney?
zh: ~z~我们有接近他们吗？还是说这人在带我们参观奥尔德尼？

english: ~z~I guess I'll just have to pass the time by thinking about how much I'm going to punish these scum.
zh: ~z~我大概得靠思考如何惩治这些小人消磨这段时间了。

english: ~z~I do this for my cousin and for his wife. I needed to make Dimitri pay.
zh: ~z~我这么做是为了我的堂兄和他的妻子。我要让迪米特里付出代价。

english: ~z~No matter what he was gonna get close to ya. Because, before you come all him a do is talk about him cousin, Niko.
zh: ~z~不论亲近你会带来什么。因为在你来前，他最常做的事就是谈论他的堂弟尼克。

english: ~z~I an' I gwan find dem, we going to find dem and take dem out, for real, dat's what we doing for Roman.
zh: ~z~一定能找到他们的，找到以后就是斩草除根了，这就是我们要为罗曼做的。

english: ~z~I can't believe I did that deal with Dimitri. How could I trust him? I'm a fool.
zh: ~z~我都不敢相信我居然会帮迪米特里去交易。我怎么会相信他的？我就是个白痴。

english: ~z~Dey say a dying animal is de most dangerous inna de jungle, ya know, cousin. So, ya better be careful.
zh: ~z~他们说濒死的野兽是丛林里最危险的生物懂吧，老弟。所以最好小心点。

english: ~z~Okay, this is good news. I do not know how much of this driving I can continue to do.
zh: ~z~好的，是个好消息。不知道这种追车我还能忍多久。

english: ~z~If we had got him then, Roman would still be alive. Things would be good.
zh: ~z~要是我们在那时就杀了他，罗曼现在就还活着，一切都会很好。

english: ~z~for every agreement he went back on, for every friend he betrayed.
zh: ~z~每与人达成一个协议一枪，每背叛一个伙伴一枪。

english: ~z~Cha! A burial be too good for that bumba clot, ya know. He ain't worth putting inna di ground, ya know, star.
zh: ~z~擦！那狗逼根本不配下葬懂吧。他不值得被葬在地下，懂吧老兄。

english: ~z~He had many men there. Both Russians and Pegorino's men.
zh: ~z~他在那儿安排了不少人。俄国人和佩戈里诺的手下都有。

english: ~z~She told me to leave it. I thought I had. I thought it was over!
zh: ~z~她告诉我要放下过去，我以为我放下了。我以为都已经结束了！

english: ~z~I'm Irish, Niko. We're a people known for strong whiskey, mystics and Catholicism.
zh: ~z~我可是爱尔兰人，尼克。我们民族以够劲的威士忌、秘传仪式和天主教著称。

english: ~z~-Yes, go on man go on. We have to leave man, just leave.~n~-You have to go...
zh: ~z~－对，走吧，老兄，走吧。我们都得离开，老兄，赶紧走人。~n~－你必须得走了...

english: ~z~Tell me, have these good people been hurt by what you've had to do?
zh: ~z~告诉我，这些好人有没有因为你不得不做的事情受到伤害？

english: ~z~Easy, easy, easy... I your brother, man, easy. Calm down, man, calm down.
zh: ~z~放松，放松，放松...你兄弟我在，老兄，放松。冷静，老兄，冷静。

english: ~z~Someone without his good naturedness and optimism would have been broken by what has happened to him.
zh: ~z~换一个没他那么积极乐观的人，早被这些遭遇搞崩溃了。

english: ~z~How do I know that you're right for me? How do I know that I won't get hurt?
zh: ~z~我怎么知道你是不是那个他？我怎么知道自己不会受伤？

english: ~z~Don't worry, man, me find Dimitri me call you. Leave!
zh: ~z~别担心，兄弟，一找到迪米特里我就给你打电话。快走！

english: ~z~You won't regret this, Kate. I'll look after you. I'll protect you.
zh: ~z~你不会后悔的，凯特。我会照顾你的，我会保护好你的。

english: ~z~-Niko, Niko, get up man, get up man, get up.~n~-Ohh... oh, man!
zh: ~z~－尼克，尼克，快起来兄弟，兄弟快起来，起来啊。~n~－哦...哦，老哥！

english: ~z~I am lucky that he is still happy to be part of my family.
zh: ~z~我已经很走运了，他还为自己是我的家人而高兴。

english: ~z~Hey, Kate. I took your advice. I cut my connections with that man.
zh: ~z~喂，凯特。我听取了你的建议。和那个人切断了联系。

english: ~z~Hey!... Yes!.... Yeah!... Congratulations cousin!... Thanks for coming!... Alright, yes, okay!... Yes, we are married!... Niko, mwah, mwah...
zh: ~z~嘿！ 好！ 耶！ 恭喜你，堂兄！ 感谢你的到来！ 好的，好呀，好啊！ 对，我们结婚了！ 尼克，么么...

english: ~z~Oh, I didn't realize it was going to be such a casual service. Shall we go to the church?
zh: ~z~哦，没想到你会穿得这么随意。我们是不是该去教堂了？

english: ~z~It would be easier to be happy if I was with the right person though.
zh: ~z~不过要是跟对的人在一起的话，我应该更容易得到幸福。

english: ~z~Look at you in those fancy clothes, Niko. Trying to upstage the groom on his wedding day? Let's get me married.
zh: ~z~瞧瞧你穿的这套花哨衣服，尼克。你是想在婚礼上抢我这个新郎的风头吗？进去开始婚礼吧。

english: ~z~I have tried to separate myself from it. I am ready to try to be good.
zh: ~z~我已经和过去划清界限了。我准备好做个好人了。

english: ~z~Because I'm going to the wedding of a couple I've never met with a man I barely know.
zh: ~z~我要和一个不太熟悉的男人一起，去参加陌生人的婚礼。

english: ~z~Maybe. The right person can make your life wonderful in the same way that the wrong one can ruin it.
zh: ~z~也许吧，对的那个人能让你的生活有多美好，错的那个人就能让你的生活有多糟糕。

english: ~z~Well maybe they are. I don't want to be involved with the men I have been involved with.
zh: ~z~的确是很久以前吧。我不想再和之前那些人扯上关系。

english: ~z~Yo, yo, yo... Niko, Niko, Niko. Calm down man, calm down man. Easy, easy.
zh: ~z~哟，哟，哟... 尼克，尼克，尼克。冷静兄弟，冷静兄弟。放松，放松。

english: ~z~I now pronounce you husband and wife, you may kiss the bride.
zh: ~z~现在，我正式宣布你们二位结为夫妻，你可以亲吻新娘了。

english: ~z~This is a good idea. I think you'll look so much better in a suit or something. It's Roman's big day.
zh: ~z~这是一个好主意。我觉得你穿正装之类的看起来会帅很多。今天是罗曼大喜的日子。

english: ~z~I'll wait for you here, Niko. I'd like to get to know the groom.
zh: ~z~我就在这儿等你，尼克。我挺想跟新郎认识认识。

english: ~z~You're talking about your criminal exploits as if they are a thing of the past.
zh: ~z~你这话说的跟自己的案底都是很久以前留下的一样。

english: ~z~Thanks for coming to get me. You're looking really nice. Shall we go to the church?
zh: ~z~谢谢你能来接我，你看起来很帅。我们去教堂吧？

english: ~z~Are you prepared to say goodbye to the fast cars, the drugs, the violence, the cheap women?
zh: ~z~那你有准备好向跑车、毒品、暴力和骚货们告别了吗？

english: ~z~He might be your only family, but he's not the only one who cares about you, Niko.
zh: ~z~或许他确实是你唯一的家人，但不是唯一关心你的人，尼克。

english: ~z~I'm really proud of you, Niko. It must have been really hard to turn down the money and stick to your principles.
zh: ~z~我真的很为你骄傲，尼克。拒绝那笔钱的诱惑坚持原则一定很不容易。

english: ~z~Yay!... Yeah!... Congratulations cousin!... Mwah!... Alright!... Yes... Thank you... Thank you all for coming!... Yes!... Okay!
zh: ~z~耶诶！ 耶！ 恭喜你，堂兄！ 么！ 好啦！ 好了 谢谢 感谢各位的到来 好！ 好的！

english: ~z~Niko, what are you doing? I told you to dress up. We will wait. Go and change, quickly.
zh: ~z~尼克，你搞什么啊？跟你说了要穿好点吧。我们等你，赶紧去换套衣服，快点。

english: ~z~Don't be stupid. I'm not coming to this wedding for the free nibbles.
zh: ~z~别傻了，我又不是为了蹭吃蹭喝才来参加婚礼的。

english: ~z~You know, it's not that weird to think that there might be some shooting at this wedding,
zh: ~z~说真的，会认为这场婚礼可能不太平静也很正常。

english: ~z~I was good once, I was a normal kid who got sucked into a war he didn't believe in
zh: ~z~我也曾是个好人，是一个被自己不认同的战争吞噬的普通孩子，

english: Follow the ~r~dealer~s~ to his supplier on foot. Stay behind him and try not to be seen.
zh: 步行跟踪~r~毒贩~s~找到供货商。跟在他后面，别被他发现。

english: ~z~Now obviously I can't go, cause then he gets a picture of me giving him money, and I'm admitting guilt.
zh: ~z~现在我显然不能去，去了就会被他拍下我给他钱的照片，相当于认罪了。

english: ~z~Yeah, and there's a lawyer called Tom Goldberg who's real interested.
zh: ~z~真的，还有一个叫汤姆･戈德堡的律师对此很感兴趣。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天。没错。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天。没错。

english: ~z~Not many people get a second chance like this. It's my redemption.
zh: ~z~很少有人能像这样获得第二次机会。这是我的救赎。

english: ~z~Push me and this shit is all over Weazel News. I got them on speed dial.
zh: ~z~惹毛我的话，就等着这些黑料上Weazel新闻吧，我给他们设了一键呼叫。

english: ~z~Yeah, yeah. We're talking about how you ain't getting no money, but you're still giving up the photos.
zh: ~z~对对，我们来谈谈怎么让你一毛不拿但还是交出照片。

english: ~z~I'm sure he's got your money. Have you got the stuff he wants?
zh: ~z~我向你保证他把钱带来了。他要的东西你带了吗？

english: ~z~Yeah, and there's a lawyer called Tom Goldberg who's real interested.
zh: ~z~真的，而且还有一个叫汤姆･戈德堡的律师对此很感兴趣。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~Push me and this shit is all over Weazel News. I got them on speed dial.
zh: ~z~惹毛我的话这些黑料就等着上Weazel新闻吧，我给他们设了一键呼叫。

english: ~z~What? Did he know I had something to do with it? Shit, I got to call him. Don't fuck up again.
zh: ~z~什么？他知不知道你和我有关系？操，我得给他打个电话，别再搞砸了。

english: ~z~I don't, but no one else does either. They're under the water along with the guy that had them.
zh: ~z~没拿到，不过也没有别人能拿到了。东西已经和带着它的人一起沉到河底了。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~Yeah. I got it. We're gonna make this shit happen. I don't mess around, you know?
zh: ~z~对，在我这儿。这个狗屁交易最好能顺利点。我不是好惹的，懂吗？

english: ~z~That's a weight off my mind. You don't need to be worrying about me knocking on your door in the middle of the night.
zh: ~z~那我就放心了。你也不用担心我半夜三更来敲你门了。

english: ~z~Yeah, he better have my paper. I ain't fucking around.
zh: ~z~是吗，那他最好已经把钱备好了，我他妈不在这附近。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~You know what? Fuck this. I'm getting out of here. The meet's off, buddy.
zh: ~z~说你妈呢，见鬼去吧。我这就走。交易终止，伙计。

english: ~z~Yeah, he better have my paper. I ain't fucking around.
zh: ~z~是吗，那他最好已经把钱备好了，我他妈不在这附近。

english: ~z~You've got to call him and keep a lookout for someone answering a phone. He won't be far.
zh: ~z~你就打给他，留心那些在接电话的人。他就在附近。

english: ~z~The guy's smart. He arranged to do the exchange by the Humboldt River off Silicon Street.
zh: ~z~这人很聪明，他把交易地点定在了硅街的洪堡河边上。

english: ~z~That means he's somewhere close and he's got a phone. I'm gonna text you his number.
zh: ~z~也就是说他在附近，带着手机。待会儿我把他的电话发你。

english: ~z~I know you killed Mikhail Faustin. I know a group of Russians want you dead. I know you ain't no saint, boy.
zh: ~z~我知道你杀了米哈伊尔･福斯汀。我知道一群俄国人想要你的命。我知道你不是什么好人，小子。

english: ~z~Listen... I did what I did... I made a mistake. That don't make me the devil.
zh: ~z~听着...过去我是做了点事...犯了个错。但这并不足以让我成为恶人。

english: ~z~Yeah. I got it. We're gonna make this shit happen. I don't mess around, you know?
zh: ~z~对，在我这儿。这次交易最好能顺利点。我可不好惹，懂吗？

english: ~z~A friend. I'm calling about your exchange with McReary.
zh: ~z~一个朋友。我是打过来问你和麦克雷里的交易的。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~You can be whatever you like. It's the land of opportunity. Any fool can become president.
zh: ~z~你爱做什么做什么。这里是机遇之地，傻逼都能做总统。

english: ~z~Standing up, assertive move, right. I like a man who takes control.
zh: ~z~站起来了，很有自信的举措，对吧。我喜欢控制力强的人。

english: ~z~Hey, I don't give a fuck about the life lessons, friend. What do you want?
zh: ~z~喂，我他妈不是来听取人生经验的，朋友。你想要怎样？

english: ~z~They leave the decay alone and soon it's too late so you have to pull the whole tooth.
zh: ~z~他们不顾腐败，之后为时已晚，就必须将腐败这颗牙连根拔起。

english: ~z~Shit, I might as well lock you up. You'd be more useful to me on the inside.
zh: ~z~靠，我最好把你也关进去。你在里面比外面对我更有用。

english: ~z~Must have got onto me when they saw I was packing heat. Lawyers are smart.
zh: ~z~肯定是看见我带着的家伙就识破我了。律师都很聪明。

english: ~z~Let the security guard, Modupe, play with it for a while. See what happens.
zh: ~z~现在就先让保镖，莫杜佩，把玩会儿这玩意吧。看看会怎么样。

english: ~z~Whoa, hey, hey. What's that, Nikolai? Shit, I've only seen those things on TV.
zh: ~z~喔，嘿，嘿。这啥玩意，尼克？我靠，这玩意我只在电视上见过。

english: ~z~The person on the other end of the line is certainly keen for me to do what I came here to do.
zh: ~z~电话那头的人显然急着让我赶紧办我来这儿要办的事。

english: ~z~Whoa, is that thing real? You know, if that thing goes off we can sue the shit out of whoever sold it to you.
zh: ~z~喔，这玩意是真家伙吗？你也知道，要是它炸了，我们就能把卖你这玩意的人起诉到他亲妈都不认他。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic, welcome. I'll just see if Mr. Goldberg is available.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，欢迎。我要先确认戈德堡先生是否有空。

english: ~z~People don't understand how life is. Life is like a bowl of fruit...
zh: ~z~人们不知道人生是怎样的。人生就像是一碗水果...

english: ~z~Fuck me, this guy's about to bring my whole life tumbling down and you can't even go into an interview room.
zh: ~z~我操，这人都要让我的这辈子完蛋了，你居然还连一间面试室都进不去。

english: ~z~Of course they're smart, that's how they squeeze all your fucking money out of you.
zh: ~z~他们当然聪明，所以才他妈能从你身上把钱都给榨出来。

english: ~z~Man, you bring one of those into court and no one's going to raise any objections to your opening statement.
zh: ~z~老兄，你要是带了这玩意进法庭，你的开庭陈述绝对不会有人敢提出反对。

english: ~z~So, are you going to expand on that or are you just going to hang around like a chump?
zh: ~z~那，你是打算就此详细论述呢，还是在这儿傻坐着？

english: ~z~Don't you want to pick that up? This is only a job interview at one of the most respected law firms in Liberty City.
zh: ~z~你不接吗？这不过是自由城最受敬重的律师行之一的一场求职面试而已。

english: ~z~I'll email you the details. You're a good man, Niko Bellic. A good man.
zh: ~z~具体细节我会发到你邮箱里的。你是一个好人，尼克･贝利克。一个好人。

english: ~z~You silenced Goldberg too, right? I don't need to worry about him?
zh: ~z~你也让戈德堡闭嘴了，对吧？我不用再担心他了吧？

english: ~z~For people, read society, read City Hall. I shake them, and I say "floss!"
zh: ~z~所谓的人，就是社会上的、市政厅里的人。我和他们握手，然后说「牙线！」

english: ~z~I'll talk to him later. I expect that he would prefer me to do what I'm here to do before we speak anyway.
zh: ~z~我晚点再跟他说。反正我想他更希望我先把来这儿要办的事办完，再跟他聊。

english: ~z~Music to my ears, a weight has been lifted. Here's your payment.
zh: ~z~天籁之音啊，解了我的一个心头大患。这是你的报酬。

english: ~z~Get rid of the rotting flesh stuck in your teeth. Prevent decay! Mouthwash, you hear me?
zh: ~z~剔掉你牙缝中的烂肉吧。防止腐败！漱口，听见了吗？

english: ~z~Nikolai, I like your resume. You seem to be the sort of man who would go the extra distance,
zh: ~z~尼克，我喜欢你的简历。你似乎是那种多方面发展的人。

english: ~z~Perfect, the smug bastard ain't gonna know what's coming at him.
zh: ~z~完美，那个自大混蛋不会知道找上他的是什么的。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic, welcome. I'll just see if Mr. Goldberg is available.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，欢迎。我要看一下戈德堡先生是否有空。

english: ~z~Mr. Goldberg is such a saint. He teaches kids to swim, you know?
zh: ~z~戈德堡简直是个圣人，他还教小孩子们游泳，你知道吗？

english: ~z~Some morality cunt who takes photos of guys in the shower at the gym
zh: ~z~这个道德逼，整天在健身房的浴室里拍别人照片，

english: ~z~That your family? I bet they're anxious for this to be a success.
zh: ~z~那是你家人吗？我敢说他们盼着这次面试成功呢。

english: ~z~Here at G, L and S we're pushing things to the limit. We're on the front-line young man.
zh: ~z~在我们GLS律所，要做的是挑战极限。我们冲在前线，年轻人。

english: ~z~And boy, are you in trouble if you get in his way.
zh: ~z~而且，小伙子，要是你跟他对着干，那你就有麻烦了。

english: ~z~You don't need to spark that bad boy up every time you need to get in the zone. No sir!
zh: ~z~没必要每次进入状态都得点着那个坏家伙。没必要的，先生！

english: ~z~He's just so warm and giving. All he cares about is making the world a better place.
zh: ~z~他很热情，具有奉献精神。所关心的只有让世界更美好。

english: ~z~Have you got A.D.D., is that the problem? We can get you a mild amphetamine to level you out, if you need it.
zh: ~z~你是有注意力缺陷症吗？是这毛病吗？如果你有需要，我们可以给你配备低浓度安非他命。

english: ~z~I'm the guy who goes around shaking people. When I say people, I mean society.
zh: ~z~我就是到处奔走和人握手的人。所谓的人，就是社会上的人。

english: ~z~if a guy makes a mistake, should that ruin his life?
zh: ~z~如果一个人犯了一次错误，他就该为此毁了一生吗？

english: ~z~If it helps you concentrate though, hell, keep it going.
zh: ~z~如果它能提升你的专注力的话，靠，就接着来吧。

english: ~z~He's wasting my time. And while you're at it, take a look in the can, will ya? I think I blocked it up pretty good.
zh: ~z~他是在浪费我的时间。还有，你出去的时候顺便看一下厕所行吧？好像被我弄堵塞了。

english: ~z~Strong move though, I gotta say, like that style. I'm all about the Second Amendment.
zh: ~z~但还是很有力的举措，不得不说，我还是喜欢这风格的。我很赞成第二修正案的。

english: ~z~A man I was recently with in this office, in this very room, was murdered.
zh: ~z~最近有个在这个律所、在这个房间和我共事过的人，被谋杀了。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Modupe! Modupe, get in here! Would you remove this gentleman from the building?
zh: ~z~莫杜佩！莫杜佩，进来！你能把这位先生从楼里赶出去吗？

english: ~z~There's this cop. Good cop, but he thinks he's above the law. He's not.
zh: ~z~其中就有这个警官。好警官，不过他觉得自己凌驾于法律之上，但他不能。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~he's got it all wrong... but one stain on my character and I'm finished.
zh: ~z~他完全就搞错了...但只要我身上有一个污点，我就完了。

english: ~z~Whoa, I don't know what the policy is where you're from, Nikolai, but this is a non-smoking office.
zh: ~z~喔，我不知道你老家的政策，尼克，但这个办公室禁烟。

english: ~z~Damn these quotas. You end up with every dumb immigrant in the city coming in for interviews.
zh: ~z~妈的狗屁指标。每个来面试的移民到最后都是哑巴白痴。

english: ~z~Yeah you. Remember, you're doing a real service for the community by getting rid of this scumbag.
zh: ~z~对，你。记住，除掉这个小人就是为社会做巨大贡献。

english: ~z~Clarence told me to dead any fool who don't belong in here.
zh: ~z~克拉伦斯跟我说过，干死任何不是这儿人的傻逼。

english: ~z~No. I don't care about Packie... listen, Ma, I've got to go.
zh: ~z~不行。我才不管派奇会怎样...听着，妈，我得挂了。

english: ~z~Only thing you'll find up there is a bunch a people who wanna kick your ass.
zh: ~z~你在这儿唯一能找到的就是一帮想踹你屁股的人。

english: ~z~Anyway, these projects all got the same layout, a staircase leading up on either side.
zh: ~z~总之，这些公屋的设计都差不多，两边各一个楼梯。

english: ~z~The streets are a little bit cleaner now he's gone. One percent - it's all we can hope for.
zh: ~z~他死了，街道就又干净了一点。百分之一，我们只能奢望这个。

english: ~z~He don't like a younger brother with ambition. Tell you what, I'll reform.
zh: ~z~他不喜欢有野心的小兄弟。这么说吧，我会洗心革面的。

english: ~z~You did a good thing, Niko. That boy was mean. He had a tongue on him too.
zh: ~z~你做了件好事，尼克。那小子很卑鄙，嘴巴也很能说。

english: ~z~The drug dealer is out on the street. Oh no! Lock up the children, Francis.
zh: ~z~现在毒贩子上街了。哦不！快把孩子们锁上，弗朗西斯。

english: ~z~You know there's no good, and no evil... just shades of fucking gray.
zh: ~z~你也知道，根本没有善，也没有恶...只有该死的灰色阴影。

english: ~z~Yeah you. Remember, you're doing a real service for the community by getting rid of this scumbag.
zh: ~z~对，你。记住，除掉这个小人就是为社会做巨大贡献。

english: ~z~Clarence, is that you again? Can't you deal out on another block?
zh: ~z~克拉伦斯，又是你？你就不能去别的街区交易吗？

english: ~z~If you're makin' a mess in the stairwell, I'm sure as hell not cleaning it up.
zh: ~z~你要是在楼道里弄得乱七八糟，我死也不会帮你打扫。

english: ~z~I'll get out the game. Get a GED or some shit. Make something of my life.
zh: ~z~我会退出游戏，去考个GED之类的，让人生有所成就。

english: ~z~Clarence were specific about deading any fools that tried something.
zh: ~z~克拉伦斯有命令，要干掉任何敢轻举妄动的傻逼。

english: ~z~He tried to convince me to let him go. Said he'd get out of town. I finished him anyway.
zh: ~z~他想说服我放了他，说他会离开这里。不过我把他干死了。

english: ~z~Get out of here. I see you again, you'll wish I had killed you now.
zh: ~z~滚得越远越好。再让我碰到你，你会后悔没有现在就死的。

english: ~z~Okay you got a deal. Head on up to Vauxite and call me.
zh: ~z~行吧，就这价吧。你先去沃克斯石，然后打给我。

english: ~z~But it'll take me a year to get the evidence. More maybe.
zh: ~z~但是，光是取证就会花上一年时间，可能还不止。

english: ~z~Good move. You shouldn't trust a word that comes out of that scum's mouth.
zh: ~z~明智的选择。那个小人嘴里的话一个字都不能信。

english: ~z~If someone was to tell me you was some fresh off the boat killer with more balls than brains,
zh: ~z~要是有人跟我说你这个刚下船的杀手胆子比脑子肥，

english: ~z~This scumbag's been pushing drugs, pimping women, you name it, he's done it.
zh: ~z~这个小人贩卖毒品、逼良为娼，你能想到的，他都做过。

english: ~z~Turn off your TVs and come out here to help me deal with this crazy psychopath.
zh: ~z~都把电视关了，出来帮老子解决这个精神病疯子。

english: ~z~Always talking his way out of court, willing to compromise anyone to get out of trouble.
zh: ~z~每次都能舌战群儒离开法庭，为了摆脱麻烦愿意跟任何人妥协。

english: ~z~Anyway, these projects all got the same layout, a staircase leading up on either side.
zh: ~z~总之，这些公屋的设计都差不多，两边各一个楼梯。

english: ~z~No, no, no, no. You sent me to kill one guy. One guy who would put you in prison.
zh: ~z~不不不不，你只让我去杀一个人，那人能把你送进监狱。

english: ~z~I left a rifle for you in the trunk of a car at the corner of Albany and M.
zh: ~z~我在奥尔巴尼大道M路口的一辆车里给你留了把狙击枪。

english: ~z~I paid you to do a man's job, you amateur. You fucking boy.
zh: ~z~我付你钱是让你做男人的活的。你个菜鸡，傻逼小屁孩。

english: ~z~Shit, I don't know. Is there a number on the phone? Can you call it?
zh: ~z~靠，我不知道。电话上有显示号码吗？你能打过去吗？

english: ~z~Alright, I'll tell you what, genius, I'll tell you fucking what.
zh: ~z~行吧，这么跟你说吧，天才，我他妈这么跟你说吧。

english: ~z~Shaniqua, that you? It ain't your style to be doin' this silent shit.
zh: ~z~莎妮夸，是你吗？屁都不放一个可不是你的风格。

english: ~z~No, I can't get a clean shot. He's sitting down or something.
zh: ~z~还没，我这儿打不到他。他好像是坐着还是怎么样的。

english: ~z~There is nothing wrong with admitting that you have done some good. The community thanks you. One percent better.
zh: ~z~认同你做了件好事是没有问题的。社会感谢你。好转百分之一。

english: ~z~Okay, the mope's holed up in his apartment. It's on the fourth floor on the east side of the street.
zh: ~z~好的，这个人渣就躲在他的公寓里。在马路东侧的四楼。

english: ~z~I send you to destroy an organization and you only make the boss disappear.
zh: ~z~我派你去摧毁整个组织，结果你只让他们的老大消失了。

english: ~z~This ain't right. How'd you get these digits? Is this Francis? You killed Clarence, man.
zh: ~z~不太对，你从哪儿弄到这号码的？你是不是弗朗西斯？你把克拉伦斯给杀了，老兄。

english: ~z~Look girl, 5-0 is trying to kill me. And I was real stressed and she was there for me.
zh: ~z~听着，妹子，条子现在还在追杀我。当时我很焦虑，是她帮了我。

english: ~z~Now his chief lieutenant is holed up in an apartment, and he wants to speak to the feds.
zh: ~z~现在他的二把手还躲在公寓里，准备去和FIB交涉。

english: ~z~Tell him I only sent you to kill one guy... so it ain't your fault.
zh: ~z~跟他说我只让你去杀一个人...所以不是你的错。

english: ~z~Listen you chump, one of my CIs just told me our boy is making a run for the border.
zh: ~z~听着白痴，我的一个线人刚联系我说那小子往边境跑了。

english: ~z~Shaniqua, that you? It ain't your style to be doin' this silent shit.
zh: ~z~莎妮夸，是你吗？屁都不放一个可不是你的风格。

english: ~z~I hope that the kids out there get this message and realize that there are better paths to take.
zh: ~z~希望外面的孩子们能知道这事，意识到有更好的路可选。

english: ~z~If there is a God, and he loves us, if there is, he'd want this cunt dead.
zh: ~z~如果上帝存在，并且爱着世人，那样的话，他也会让这逼去死的。

english: ~z~Look around the place, see if there's something you can use to get his lazy ass up.
zh: ~z~仔细看一看，找找有没有能利用的东西，让丫这懒虫起来。

english: ~z~Frankie, what's this about? I've gotta say. I'm nervous about this little meeting.
zh: ~z~弗兰基，这是怎么了？不得不说，这次会面让我很慌。

english: ~z~Frankie arranged to meet me at this park on Bismark, I think he's gonna try to kill me.
zh: ~z~弗兰基约我在俾斯麦大道的公园见面，我觉得他是想杀我。

english: ~z~You don't think I know that. Christ, it happened right in front of me.
zh: ~z~你当我不知道吗。天哪，完全就是在我面前发生的。

english: ~z~Get in position and put Derrick out of his misery. Shit, I better get ready to act surprised.
zh: ~z~就位以后结束德里克的悲剧人生。靠，我最好开始准备故作惊讶了。

english: ~z~Do you know the place? Are you close? Can you get there in time?
zh: ~z~你知道那地方吗？在附近吗？你能不能快点过来？

english: ~z~You know what, Frankie boy - I'm going to use that. I ever feel the heat on me, I'll call you.
zh: ~z~你猜怎么着，弗兰基仔，我会利用这件事。一旦我被警察盯上了，我就打给你。

english: ~z~I'm doing real well for myself, real well. I'm sorry about how life turned out for you.
zh: ~z~我现在过得很好，真的很好。很遗憾你的生活不尽人意。

english: ~z~Don't forget that I still got dirt on you. I know this ain't nice, but neither of us has a choice.
zh: ~z~别忘了我还有你的黑料。我知道这样不太好，不过大家都没得选。

english: ~z~Question is, which one of us is gonna be wandering the earth with a mark on his head
zh: ~z~问题在于，我们中的哪个会带着记号流离漂荡在地上。

english: ~z~It's sounding like I've got no choice. One McReary brother is going to get me to kill another.
zh: ~z~听起来似乎是没得选。麦克雷里兄弟之一让我杀了另一个兄弟。

english: ~z~Jesus. Frankie, I'm sorry. May God forgive us for what we've done.
zh: ~z~老天。弗兰基，对不起。愿上帝宽恕我们的所作所为。

english: ~z~I'm going to meet him in the courtyard park off Bismark in Lancet.
zh: ~z~我会把他约到兰塞特区俾斯麦大道上的庭院公园。

english: ~z~the crooks I can handle, see that I can spin, but not this. Not this.
zh: ~z~光是恶棍我还能解决，大不了编点故事。但这个不行，告密不行。

english: ~z~Okay Niko. Time to get out of here but I ain't leaving my poor dead brother to the mercy of them animals.
zh: ~z~好了尼克。该离开这儿了，但我不会把我死了的可怜哥哥扔在这儿任那些禽兽处置的。

english: ~z~I was thinking you only kept those hitmen away from the church to protect my sister.
zh: ~z~我是在想你干掉教堂前的那群杀手是为了保护我妹妹。

english: ~z~Frankie's plot is in the graveyard on Colony Island, Niko. Can we put him in the ground?
zh: ~z~弗兰基的坟在殖民地岛的墓园，尼克。我们去把他安葬了吧。

english: ~z~This is place of God. Jesus Christ! Can't these people shoot at us on another day?
zh: ~z~这里是上帝的地方。我的天哪！这些人就不能改天再来袭击我们吗？

english: ~z~Anyway, I'm not here for Francis. I am here for you and Packie.
zh: ~z~而且，我不是为了弗朗西斯来的，我是为了你和派奇来的。

english: ~z~He's having a hard death too if this is anything to go by. I never knew it was so difficult to put a body in the ground.
zh: ~z~照这么说死后也没好到哪儿去。我还真不知道把尸体下葬会这么麻烦。

english: ~z~Fuck. Francis was an asshole but he didn't deserve to end up on the road like that.
zh: ~z~操。弗朗西斯确实是混蛋，但也不用让他横尸街头吧。

english: ~z~What in the hell is this, don't these people have any damn respect? It's my own brother's funeral!
zh: ~z~这他妈是什么玩意，这群人都他妈不懂尊重的吗？这是我亲哥哥的葬礼诶！

english: ~z~Anyway, maybe our curse is just us McRearys being screw ups.
zh: ~z~算了，可能我们麦克雷里家族的诅咒就是成为一群废物。

english: ~z~There's a lot to be sorry for on this day, Niko. But you ain't to blame for none of it. I'll speak to ya soon.
zh: ~z~今天需要抱歉的事情多了去了，尼克。但是都不能怪你。我会尽快再和你联系的。

english: ~z~Niko, get behind the wheel of that Romero. You, me, and my brother are getting out of here.
zh: ~z~尼克，你去开那辆钢骨灵车。你，我，我哥要一起离开这里。

english: ~z~There's a whole lot a air where the back doors should be, Niko. Go easy on her or my brother'll fall out.
zh: ~z~后面该有门的地方门没了，尼克。好好开车，别让我哥掉出来。

english: ~z~I did not come for Derrick, I came for you and Packie.
zh: ~z~我不是因为德里克来的，我是因为你和派奇来的。

english: ~z~Alright Niko, it's time to go but we're taking my brother with us. Can you drive the Romero?
zh: ~z~好了尼克，该走了，不过我们得把我哥带上。开车就麻烦你了。

english: ~z~Shit, we lost the back doors. Don't lose my brother too. Go easy there, Niko.
zh: ~z~靠，我们后门没了。别把我哥也弄没了。好好开车，尼克。

english: ~z~Shit, I never thought I'd be on the run from some Albanian gangsters with a cop in the car.
zh: ~z~靠，我从来没想过我会在车里有个条子的时候被一些阿尔巴尼亚黑帮追杀。

english: ~z~If this ain't a fucking beating I don't know what is.
zh: ~z~要是这他妈不是干架的话，我就不知道是什么了。

english: ~z~One brother in jail, another killed and the funeral attacked. You can't tell me this is just bad luck.
zh: ~z~一个哥哥进了监狱，另一个被杀了，他的葬礼还被人袭击。这已经不是能用运气差解释的了。

english: ~z~This has got to be about the deal Gerry fucked up between the Ancelottis and those Albanians.
zh: ~z~这肯定和格里搞乱安切洛蒂家族和阿尔巴尼亚人的事情有关系。

english: ~z~It means a lot - you coming here and helping this messed up family of mine.
zh: ~z~你能来这里，给我一团糟的家族帮忙对我们意义很大。

english: ~z~We all have our ways of coping, Packie. That was Derrick's. He had a hard life.
zh: ~z~我们都有自己的解决方式，派奇。德里克是那么做的。他活着的时候也没好过。

english: ~z~Derrick never had many friends, he sort of lived in his own head.
zh: ~z~德里克的朋友向来不多，他有点活在自己的世界里。

english: ~z~Tell yourself you did it out of the grace of your own heart rather than for another piece of your anatomy.
zh: ~z~告诉自己那么做是出于良知，并不是为了满足那根东西。

english: ~z~Derrick needed good dose of smack to cope with most of the situations that life threw at him. You gotta admit that.
zh: ~z~面对生活甩到他脸上的各种情况，德里克都会需要大剂量的麻药才能解决。这点还是要承认的。

english: ~z~If you're going to fuck up an Albanian gang's arrangement with the Mafia, there might be some backlash.
zh: ~z~你要是想搞烂阿尔巴尼亚帮和黑手党的关系，是会遭到报复的。

english: ~z~and a man of beliefs. God asks us to show faith and that is what he did, in his way.
zh: ~z~也是一个有信仰的人。上帝让我们展现信仰，这就是他的行动，他的做法。

english: ~z~No, you dumb European fuck, I meant my brother, Francis. It was a joke.
zh: ~z~屁，你个欧洲白痴，我说的是我哥，弗朗西斯。就是开个玩笑。

english: ~z~I don't know why your brother got killed but it looks like the funeral was shot up because of the shit Gerry was into.
zh: ~z~我不知道你的哥哥为什么被杀，但看来对葬礼的袭击和格里的所作所为有关。

english: ~z~I'm gonna teach ya for doing this at my brother's funeral.
zh: ~z~你们在我哥哥的葬礼这么搞，老子要教训教训你们。

english: ~z~Now that Francis is on his way to the graveyard, and Gerald is behind bars all I gots left is that smack-head Derrick.
zh: ~z~现在弗朗西斯在下葬路上，格里在牢底坐穿，我这儿剩下的就一个满脑子麻药的德里克。

english: ~z~Are you suggesting that I'm a fucking cop? I thought that you would know better than that.
zh: ~z~你丫这是想说老子是条子吗？我还以为你很清楚我是什么人的。

english: ~z~Alright, man. We're burying Derrick in the graveyard in Steinway. Let's get there.
zh: ~z~好了，老兄。我们要把德里克葬在斯坦威的墓园。去那儿吧。

english: ~z~You know, I'm still not that fond of the guy, even in his death.
zh: ~z~你也知道，我还是不大喜欢那家伙，他死了也一样。

english: ~z~Is not that I don't like cops, you do what you do to get by.
zh: ~z~不是说我不喜欢条子，为了生存该做的事还是得做。

english: ~z~That means the men is in for a bad time but Katie's gonna make it out the other side. She'll stay clean and come out good.
zh: ~z~就是说家族的男人会很糟，但凯特会不一样的。她会洁身自好有好结果的。

english: ~z~Guys like you don't like cops. Being here, helping us out... I appreciate it.
zh: ~z~像你这样的人都不喜欢条子。你能来，还帮了我们...我很感激。

english: ~z~Dammit. We're some back doors light, Niko. The fucking casket better not fall out. Go easy.
zh: ~z~干他，我们现在后门大开，尼克。那口棺材最好别掉出来，好好开车。

english: ~z~More people didn't have to die at a McReary funeral. I'll see you round.
zh: ~z~麦克雷里家的葬礼上不应该死这么多人的。再见了。

english: ~z~You're a sick man, Niko. I'd fucking slap you if I didn't love ya so much.
zh: ~z~真是恶心，尼克。要不是我太爱你，我都要糊你一巴掌了。

english: ~z~Only a McReary family funeral would get shot up like this, Niko.
zh: ~z~只有麦克雷里家族的葬礼会像这样被持枪袭击，尼克。

english: ~z~If Derrick was alive he'd need a shit load of horse to deal with the stress of this situation.
zh: ~z~要是德里克还活着，这么大的压力下他得打上一大堆麻药。

english: ~z~As if my mother hasn't gone through enough without a bunch of goons shooting up her son's funeral.
zh: ~z~就算没那么多混蛋开枪大闹他儿子的葬礼，我母亲也已经受了够多苦了。

english: Call the blackmailer's cell and look to see who answers their phone. Keep him talking until you identify him.
zh: 联系勒索者，注意观察接电话的人。找到他前与他保持通话。

english: Navigate the mobile keypad using ~PAD_DPAD_ALL~. Select your desired input using ~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~. To make a phone call select the phone icon on the top left of the keypad.
zh: 用~PAD_DPAD_ALL~选择键盘上的数字，按~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~输入所选数字。选中键盘左上角的电话图标呼出。

english: ~s~Change into a suit for the funeral or go to Perseus and buy a smart outfit.
zh: ~s~换一套适合参加葬礼的正装，或去神之子服饰买一套讲究的套装。

english: ~z~If I get out of this, punks like Dimitri Rascalov are going to wish they never got off the boat here.
zh: ~z~要是我活下来了，迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫这种混蛋就要后悔自己乘船来这儿了。

english: ~z~When I'm done at the podium, Mayor Ochoa is going to be dedicating half his annual budget to cleaning this problem up.
zh: ~z~演讲结束后，奥乔亚市长肯定会把财年预算的一半拿出来解决这个问题。

english: ~z~Well, we both watch out for one another then. We wouldn't survive in this shitty world if we didn't.
zh: ~z~我们互相照应，才能在这个糟糕的世界生存下去。

english: ~z~The speech is fine, Jon. Before Mayor Ochoa knows it,
zh: ~z~演讲挺不错的，乔恩。但仅限于奥乔亚市长知道之前。

english: ~z~Kid, you are something else. I haven't had someone bust my balls like that in years.
zh: ~z~小子，你跟别人不同。我好多年没被人这么耍了。

english: ~z~I'll explain that important cultural difference to one of these Russian gangsters if our paths cross.
zh: ~z~再遇上的话，我可要好好给某个俄国黑道解释下重要的文化差异。

english: ~z~but don't think about screwing up or screwing with me again, or we'll have a real problem.
zh: ~z~但是别再想着搞破坏或者搞我了，否则就要追悔莫及了。

english: ~z~care that when I shit myself, the pretty nurse has to clean it up...
zh: ~z~在乎我屎拉身上的时候，漂亮护士还得来收拾干净...

english: ~z~American gangsters like Jon Gravelli understand the way life works, they get the limits of their power.
zh: ~z~像乔恩･格拉韦利这样的美国黑道了解人生的规律，他们知道自己的能力是有极限的。

english: ~z~Maybe the guy you love, this Dimitri Rascalov, has an interest in keeping this story out the press.
zh: ~z~或许你最爱的这个迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫就不太想让这件事见诸报端。

english: ~z~How are we supposed to compete with these immigrant criminals when they want it so bad?
zh: ~z~这些移民犯罪者如狼似虎，我们怎么可能打得过？

english: ~z~You're working with me, aren't you Mr. Gravelli? See you later.
zh: ~z~你跟我联手了，不是吗，格拉韦利先生？回头见。

english: ~z~I don't know what I would have done if you hadn't held your head back there. Thank you, son.
zh: ~z~如果没有你在背后支持我，我甚至不知道事情会成什么样。谢谢你，小伙子。

english: ~z~You mean fifty years of you bleeding the city dry might finally come to an end?
zh: ~z~就是说你敲骨吸髓五十年的王朝，现在终于要崩塌了？

english: ~z~This country is falling apart. There's no law anymore. Jesus.
zh: ~z~这个国家正在分崩离析，哪有什么法律可言，天哪。

english: ~z~That's what happens when you try taking control out of the hands of people like Jon Gravelli, I guess.
zh: ~z~当你尝试从乔恩･格拉韦利这样的人手中夺走权力时，就会发生这种情况。

english: ~z~Mr. Gravelli. I took that friend of yours to City Hall. He should be giving his speech any minute.
zh: ~z~格拉韦利先生。你那个朋友已经送到市政厅了。应该就要发表演讲了。

english: ~z~You don't want to go in there. We're not some normal restaurant.
zh: ~z~我建议你最好别进去。我们这可不是一般的餐厅。

english: ~z~Get out of my office before more guys come in here and shoot the place up.
zh: ~z~滚出我的办公室，不然我叫人来把这里打成马蜂窝。

english: ~z~Tell me that Kim Young-Guk isn't devaluing our precious currency anymore?
zh: ~z~那个金永国是不是没法继续让我们宝贵的货币贬值了？

english: ~z~I thought you wanted to help our friend from United Liberty Paper as much as I did?
zh: ~z~我还以为你和我一样想给我们联合自由纸业的旧相识帮忙。

english: ~z~Kim's not here. He left a long time ago. You best go look somewhere else.
zh: ~z~金不在这儿。他老早就走了。你还是去别处找吧。

english: ~z~Shit man, I can't. I'm already on my way to a Korean place.
zh: ~z~操了，兄弟，没空。我已经在去朝鲜饭店的路上了。

english: ~z~Well done, my boy. This is going to be a fruitful partnership for us both.
zh: ~z~干得漂亮，孩子。我们之间的合作可谓收获颇丰。

english: ~z~He's upstairs speaking with the manager. They don't want to see nobody though.
zh: ~z~他在楼上和经理谈话。不过他们不想被别人打扰。

english: ~z~Niko, our friend here is telling me that the Ancelottis are in league with the Russians.
zh: ~z~尼克，我们的朋友说安切洛蒂家族和俄国人结盟了。

english: ~z~I'm afraid some of that chop is going to make it to the noses of yuppies in Middle America, Mr. Gravelli.
zh: ~z~恐怕其中一些白粉要到美国中部的雅痞鼻子下了，格拉韦利先生。

english: ~z~I better not fucking die with him thinking he's got the upper hand. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我可不想死在他认为自己占了上风的时候。再见。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. If that's the way it is, that's the way it is.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。既然情况如此，那我也没什么办法。

english: ~z~My psychiatrist says that I shouldn't be seeing anyone in this emotional state, maybe if you me call back later...
zh: ~z~心理医生说以我现在的情绪状态最好不要见任何人，改天再联系我吧...

english: ~z~Sorry, Alex but I don't memorize your sleeping hours. I'll call you later.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯。我不知道你现在在睡觉，晚点再联系你。

english: ~z~Well there's the mysterious European. I was starting to think you were done with me.
zh: ~z~神秘欧洲人来啦，我差点以为你和我已经分手了。

english: ~z~Niko, I just can't see you right now. I have to put in some serious Daddy time to make sure the card doesn't get cut off.
zh: ~z~尼克，我现在不能陪你。还得好好陪着我亲爹，否则就没人帮我付信用卡账单了。

english: ~z~Alright, well top prize for effort. I'll let you take me out. Come by in the next hour.
zh: ~z~好了，给你的努力颁发一等奖，允许你带我出去。一个小时内来接我吧。

english: ~z~Niko, you picked up. Well it's been a while since I've heard from you.
zh: ~z~尼克，你终于接电话了。好久没接到你的联络了。

english: ~z~What are you doing? Ha fucking ha. I'm asleep. Call me after noon.
zh: ~z~你搞什么啊？呵呵。我正睡觉呢。下午再打给我。

english: ~z~Well, I blew off a lot of people to see you but... sure.
zh: ~z~好吧，为了跟你约会我推了很多人，不过...好吧。

english: ~z~Sorry Alex, it's over between us. I can't say I'm going to miss you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯，咱俩结束了。我也不知道以后会不会想你。

english: ~z~Oh, you picked up. I was starting to think I'd have to get Daddy's private investigator to track you down, Niko.
zh: ~z~噢，可算接电话了。我都在想是不是应该让我爸的私家侦探调查你的行踪了，尼克。

english: ~z~Fuck you. I could have done anything now. You were lucky I agreed to see you.
zh: ~z~操你妈的。本来我有的是选择。选择跟你约会是你的福气。

english: ~z~Are you fucking stupid? I'm sleeping. Call me back after noon. I might be awake then.
zh: ~z~你他妈白痴吧？我正睡觉呢。下午再找我，那会儿我可能醒着。

english: ~z~I can't take you out just now, Alex. I'll call you later.
zh: ~z~我现在不能带你出去，亚历克斯。晚点我再打给你。

english: ~z~Alex Chilton stood up by a European nobody? My friends will not believe it.
zh: ~z~亚历克斯･奇尔顿被一个欧洲小喽啰给鸽了？我那些朋友肯定不信。

english: ~z~Hey Niko, I was just thinking I like guys I date to look good in case the paps snap us together or something.
zh: ~z~喂，尼克，其实我比较希望我的约会对象能好看点，这样被狗仔队拍到也不会太尴尬。

english: ~z~I am a beautiful flower and I need to be treated with care. And if you do that, I might date you again.
zh: ~z~我是一枝美丽的鲜花，需要精心照顾。你能做到的话，也许还有约会的机会。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. But my friends just saw us out again and they might actually think we were serious. Leave it a bit.
zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克。但朋友刚看见我俩一起出去过，她们可能以为我俩真的在交往了。过几天再说吧。

english: ~z~Hey Alex, I want to go buy some clothes. Will you get me a discount?
zh: ~z~喂，亚历克斯，我想去买点衣服。你能给我点优惠吗？

english: ~z~Alex. You probably got more important things to worry about like boots or something, but we're over.
zh: ~z~亚历克斯。你要烦恼的东西可能很多，比如靴子之类的，但我们之间结束了。

english: ~z~Yeah, well actually there's a cute orderly that I'd like to fuck. I'll do that and then get a lift home. Bye.
zh: ~z~好，刚好有个医院勤杂工跟我对上眼了。我会跟他来一炮，乘他的车回去的。再见。

english: ~z~Well this really is a surprise. Guys don't normally wait this long to call me back.
zh: ~z~太令我惊讶了。一般人不会过这么久才打电话找我。

english: ~z~If you think you can just treat me like some slutty European whore then you are sadly mistaken.
zh: ~z~我可不是呼之即来挥之即去的欧洲妓女，别搞错了。

english: ~z~Niko, I cannot get tied down right now. We should leave a bit of a gap between each date.
zh: ~z~尼克，我现在不能被你束缚住。应该在两次约会间多留一些时间。

english: ~z~Niko, they're letting me out of the clinic and Daddy's driver is busy. Would you pick me up?
zh: ~z~尼克，他们放我出院了，但老爸的司机很忙。你能来接我吗？

english: ~z~Sure, Niko. I tell the stores you're a friend of mine and you'll get a price reduction for the rest of the day.
zh: ~z~当然了，尼克。我跟店里的人打声招呼，你今天就能拿到优惠价了。

english: ~z~Niko, I am not someone you want to fuck things up with. You will regret losing me for the rest of your life.
zh: ~z~尼克，我不是可以随便糊弄的人。失去我你会后悔终身的。

english: ~z~I'm scared that if we see each other this much someone's going to get hurt. In a while, maybe.
zh: ~z~我担心咱俩见面这么频繁，会有人受伤的。还是过段时间吧。

english: ~z~Girls like me do not get treated like this by guys like you. Deal with yourself, Niko.
zh: ~z~我这样的女孩不该被你这种人这般对待。你好好考虑下，尼克。

english: ~z~If you ever want a discount from a clothes shop in Liberty City, call me and I'll arrange it.
zh: ~z~如果你想在自由城的服装店拿到内部价，打电话找我我来安排。

english: ~z~Okay. I'll make some calls. I can get you a fifty percent off at the major outlets in Liberty City for the rest of the day.
zh: ~z~好的，我去安排一下。今天一天你都可以在自由城的大商场拿到五折优惠。

english: ~z~Niko. I don't want this to get too serious. Maybe we shouldn't see each other this often. Maybe in a while.
zh: ~z~尼克，我不想让咱俩走得太近。还是不要这么频繁地见面了。改天再说吧。

english: ~z~Sorry, Alex, but I kind of have a lot on my plate. But maybe another time.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯，但我现在有点忙。改天再见吧。

english: ~z~A relationship is not a one way street, Niko. If you don't start going in both directions you might lose me.
zh: ~z~谈恋爱不是走独木桥，尼克。没有你来我往可是会失去我的。

english: ~z~Good news, Alex. You don't have to worry about slumming it no more. We're done.
zh: ~z~好消息，亚历克斯。你不用担心跟着我会受苦了，咱俩到头了。

english: ~z~I can't just go helping anybody out. I'd lose my reputation. Why don't you hang out with me more and then maybe we'll talk?
zh: ~z~我不能随便帮你，面子会挂不住的。你多陪我出去的话说不定还有得聊。

english: ~z~I'll sort it, Niko. There'll be a discount for the rest of the day. Promise to buy nice clothes though.
zh: ~z~包在我身上，尼克。你今天全天都有五折优惠。一定要买件好衣服啊。

english: ~z~Sorry Alex but something's come up. I can't get you from the hospital.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯，但我突然有急事，不能来医院接你了。

english: ~z~I'll give you another chance, Niko. But this better be the best date of my life though. Come collect me in an hour.
zh: ~z~我再给你一次机会，尼克。但这最好是我这辈子最棒的约会。一小时内来接我吧。

english: ~z~Niko, time to earn some brownie points. Would you pick me up from the hospital?
zh: ~z~尼克，是时候挣点印象分了。你愿意来医院接我吗？

english: ~z~A woman has needs, Niko. If you aren't prepared to meet those needs then she might look elsewhere.
zh: ~z~女人也有需求，尼克。如果你满足不了需求，她可能会去找其他人。

english: ~z~Niko, I am an intellectual, beautiful, and interesting woman. I do not need to see a man who treats me like you do.
zh: ~z~尼克，我是一个聪明美丽又有趣的女人。没必要和一个像你这样对我的男人见面。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. No can do now. Maybe if you paid me more attention I'd be able to help you out.
zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克。现在不行。如果你给我更多的关注，我可能会帮你。

english: ~z~The mystery man returns. I did not think I'd be hearing from you again.
zh: ~z~神秘人终于回归了。没想到我还会接到你的电话。

english: ~z~Alex, you're a socialite. Surely you know someone else who'll come pick you up.
zh: ~z~亚历克斯，你可是个社交名媛。总有其他认识的人能来接你吧。

english: ~z~Let's go, Niko. I hope the good mixologist is on tonight.
zh: ~z~走吧，尼克。希望今天是那个技术好的调酒师当班。

english: ~z~This obsession with really shit cars is really taking shabby chic to its limits Niko.
zh: ~z~你对这种破烂车的痴迷程度已经用古董风格都解释不了了

english: ~z~I'm surprised that you think an intellectual such as myself would be interested in playing darts again.
zh: ~z~你居然会觉得我这样的才女会对再玩一次飞镖感兴趣？

english: ~z~Niko, please get a new car. I'm embarrassed to be seen in this thing.
zh: ~z~尼克，拜托你去弄辆新车。我坐这玩意里被别人看见很没面子的。

english: ~z~If I didn't know any better, I'd have thought you were trying to get me drunk.
zh: ~z~要不是因为我很懂，我就会以为你是想灌醉我了。

english: ~z~Okay, let's play pool again. I feel like I've died and woken up in the Midwest.
zh: ~z~好吧，那就再打一次台球吧。我感觉自己像是死了以后又在中西部醒来。

english: ~z~They love me at this place. I swear, you spend enough money and people forget that you threw up on the manager.
zh: ~z~这地方的人很喜欢我。我发誓，只要花的钱够多，别人就会忘记你把店经理给甩了。

english: ~z~God, you know. I'll try anything once. I tried picking up guys on craplist, didn't I?
zh: ~z~天，你也知道，我什么都会试一试。我不就试着在craplist上约了人吗？

english: ~z~Okay, I did not realize you were this... um... earthy. Do they still make clothes like that?
zh: ~z~好吧，没想到你会这么...土。这年头还有人做这种衣服？

english: ~z~Alex Chilton does not take the bus. Please tell me that your car is around the corner.
zh: ~z~亚历克斯･奇尔顿不坐公交，麻烦告诉我你的车就停在附近。

english: ~z~Shit, you're actually who you said you were. I was expecting a two-foot lesbian. I'm Alex.
zh: ~z~我靠，你这人居然描述与实物相符啊。我还以为来的会是一个61厘米高的女同性恋。我是亚历克斯。

english: ~z~Niko, I thought a resourceful guy like you would be able to get hold of a better car than this.
zh: ~z~尼克，你这么有本事，我还以为你开的车能比现在这辆好呢。

english: ~z~We're playing pool, eh? Are you going to make me chug brewskies and chant as well?
zh: ~z~我们是去打台球，对吧？还是说你想顺便带我去喝酒唱歌呢？

english: ~z~This guy is like, seriously urban. I'm told he's like, very now.
zh: ~z~这人就是，很社会。之前刚有人跟我说他的品行。

english: ~z~This is perfect, Niko. I'm an intellectual and I'm cultured so I really enjoy this.
zh: ~z~太完美了，尼克。我既有才华又有教养，真的很能享受这个。

english: ~z~What's this obsession with strip clubs, Niko? Aren't I enough for you?
zh: ~z~你就这么喜欢脱衣舞俱乐部吗，尼克？有我在你还嫌不够吗？

english: ~z~Let's go and hit some balls into holes with long sticks. Oh what fun.
zh: ~z~那我们就去用长长的棒子把球打到洞里吧。哦，真有趣。

english: ~z~You're taking me to play darts twice in a row. You're real imaginative, aren't you Niko?
zh: ~z~你又带我去玩飞镖啊。真是鬼才策划，不是吗尼克？

english: ~z~Well, if that's your only nice outfit you may as well get the most out of it.
zh: ~z~好吧，要是那是你唯一一件的好外套，倒是该物尽其用。

english: ~z~It's a shame you're not wearing that hat any more. I found out how much it cost.
zh: ~z~你没有再戴那顶帽子真可惜。我刚知道它的价格。

english: ~z~I'm a white chick but I'm really into street culture and the urban scene. I think I'll really like this.
zh: ~z~我是一个白人女孩，但我已经融入了街头文化和都市生活。我大概会喜欢这个的。

english: ~z~Can you please explain to me what the appeal of really shit cars is? I don't get it.
zh: ~z~麻烦你告诉我这辆破铜烂铁有什么好的？我是真搞不懂。

english: ~z~Hey, Niko. Is this like an off, off, off, off Burlesque show?
zh: ~z~嘿，尼克。这是不是那种、那种、那种、那种要脱衣服的表演？

english: ~z~Okay, let's eat here. It's not exactly going to be a gastronomic rollercoaster though, is it?
zh: ~z~好吧，在这儿吃吧。这里应该不是那种传送带餐厅吧？

english: ~z~Well Niko, if people are going to see you in the same set of clothes repeatedly, they may as well be fashionable ones.
zh: ~z~好吧尼克，就算每次都穿同一套衣服，也麻烦你穿当季流行款。

english: ~z~You want to play darts... again? Well this is really a hobby of yours, isn't it, Niko?
zh: ~z~你又想玩飞镖...？这个是你的个人爱好是吧，尼克？

english: ~z~I am so pleased you got rid of that hat, please say you burned it.
zh: ~z~很高兴你终于把那帽子扔了，你已经把那玩意烧了吧。

english: ~z~Thank God you've got rid of that thing you were driving before. I mean anything would be better than that.
zh: ~z~谢天谢地你终于不开那辆垃圾了。开啥都比那辆垃圾好。

english: ~z~No, people drive them here as well. Just not people who live in Middle Park East.
zh: ~z~不，这里人也会开这车，只是住在中央公园东的人不开而已。

english: ~z~It's so good that that hat is gone. It made you look like a thug.
zh: ~z~没戴那顶帽子真是太好了，那顶帽子让你像一个小混混。

english: ~z~Okay, those are some pretty bold choices. Are you hoping to come across as an eccentric or something?
zh: ~z~好吧，这套搭配有点大胆。你是想做个怪人之类的吗？

english: ~z~Umm, well you've got to be hungry to eat in a place like this. It hasn't even got a Liberty Tree rosette.
zh: ~z~你一定是饿疯了才会来这里吃饭，这店连Liberty Tree认证都没有。

english: ~z~I didn't think anything could be worse than the car you used to drive, I was wrong.
zh: ~z~我还以为你上次开的车已经够差了，没想到还有更差的。

english: ~z~If I'd known you weren't bringing a car I would have gotten Daddy to lend us a driver.
zh: ~z~早知道你没把车开过来，我就让爹地给我们派个司机了。

english: ~z~Hi, I'm Niko. You must be the Liberated Woman. We met on craplist.
zh: ~z~嗨，我是尼克。你就是自由女性吧，我们在craplist上认识的。

english: ~z~Oh, I guess that you feel comfortable in these clothes. Well, at least they're not disgusting.
zh: ~z~噢，这身衣服你穿着大概还很舒服吧。好吧，至少还不算恶心。

english: ~z~Ooh, it is so nice to be driven around in a car you're used to, don't you think?
zh: ~z~喔，乘着坐习惯了的车四处转悠真好，你不觉得吗？

english: ~z~I'm pleased you've kept this car. Daddy gets rid of nice cars after driving them for a couple of weeks.
zh: ~z~很高兴你的这辆车还在。爹地的话好好的车没开几周就不要了。

english: ~z~It's so nice to be able to properly see your face without those cheap glasses on.
zh: ~z~终于能不被那副廉价眼镜挡着，好好看看你的脸了。

english: ~z~Niko, can't you go for a more preppy look? That hat makes you look like a criminal.
zh: ~z~尼克，你就不能打扮的正经点吗？那顶帽子让你看起来像个罪犯。

english: ~z~What aren't I into? I'm just a Liberty city girl. I like shopping, lunches with the girls, cocktails.
zh: ~z~我能有什么兴趣？我就是个普通的自由城女孩，喜欢购物、和闺蜜一起吃饭还有鸡尾酒。

english: ~z~It's a shame you got rid of those glasses, they made you look sophisticated.
zh: ~z~你不戴那副眼镜真是可惜，那副眼镜能让你看起来老成点。

english: ~z~So, you take the whole "If it ain't broke, don't fix it." attitude to getting dressed then?
zh: ~z~那个，你选衣服是按「缝缝补补又三年」的标准来选的吗？

english: ~z~The good thing about you seeing all these strippers is you'll realize how much better my body is.
zh: ~z~看一些脱衣舞女也有好处，这样你就知道我的身材到底有多好了。

english: ~z~Pool, Niko? Were you in a frat house or something? What next? Keg stands?
zh: ~z~台球吗，尼克？你当这是开大学生联谊会还是什么？接下来是什么？铁桶倒立？

english: ~z~Oh God, I hope none of my friends sees me out with a man dressed like this.
zh: ~z~天哪，希望不会被朋友看见我和穿成这样的男人在一起。

english: ~z~I write a blog. It's Liberated Woman on blogsnobs.org.
zh: ~z~我还开了个博客，就是blogsnobs.org上的自由女性。

english: ~z~I can get down with strippers. I can get into this. Let's go.
zh: ~z~我可以顶住脱衣舞女的，我可以把持住的。走吧。

english: ~z~If you want to take me to a show, Niko. I'd check what time they started.
zh: ~z~要是你想带我去看表演，尼克，我建议你还是先确定下几点开演。

english: ~z~You're dating an intellectual girl, maybe she's into things that are more cerebral than playing pool.
zh: ~z~和你约会的是个才女，她想做的可能是比打台球更需要智力的事情。

english: ~z~Okay, you sell one crap car and you buy another. When did that ever make sense?
zh: ~z~好吧，你这是刚卖了一辆破车就又买了一辆。怎么还有这种操作的？

english: ~z~You look pretty good, Niko. Is that this season's collection?
zh: ~z~你看上去很棒，尼克。这身行头是当季潮流款吗？

english: ~z~I remember going to the opening party of this place, it was wild.
zh: ~z~我还记得来这儿参加开业典礼的情景，当时很放荡。

english: ~z~Niko, you have got to learn you get what you pay for and you didn't pay much for those pants.
zh: ~z~尼克，你一定要明白自己买的是什么东西，这条裤子一看就没花多少钱。

english: ~z~Yeah, I'd be surprised if they let you into any clubs wearing those shoes.
zh: ~z~对，穿着这种鞋还有俱乐部肯放你进去的话，我就要大吃一惊了。

english: ~z~Most guys I know trade up their cars whenever they can. It's good that you're holding on to this one.
zh: ~z~我认识的大多数人都会尽量换上更好的车。你也这么做是件好事。

english: ~z~Look, if you're only going to pick me up in crap cars, I'll get Daddy's chauffeur to drive us.
zh: ~z~听着，要是你只能开这种垃圾车来接我，我就要让爹地的司机开车送我们了。

english: ~z~Well, getting rid of that old car was the first step toward self-improvement. Well done, Niko.
