zh: ~z~很好，换掉那辆旧车是你提升自我的第一步。干得好，尼克。

english: ~z~Yeah, well maybe you should have done more than buy coke off drug dealers since then?
zh: ~z~行吧，估计之后你做的应该不止是问那个毒贩子买可卡因吧？

english: ~z~Uhh, Niko. I was starting to think I'd been stood up. Umm, I'm not walking by the way.
zh: ~z~呃，尼克。我差点就以为自己被鸽了。唔，要我走着去是不可能的。

english: ~z~Niko, are you trying to lubricate me with liquor before making a move?
zh: ~z~尼克，你是想在动作戏前先用酒给我润滑一下吗？

english: ~z~I actually really enjoyed it the last time we came to a strip club. I picked up some moves.
zh: ~z~其实上次去脱衣舞俱乐部的时候我也乐在其中。我还学了几招。

english: ~z~God, are those shoes fashionable back in Europe? You must be so behind the Liberty City trends.
zh: ~z~天哪，这鞋不会还是欧洲流行款吧？你这人完全跟不上自由城的时尚潮流。

english: ~z~Okay, well you've wasted my time by being late. Don't waste my time getting me where we're going.
zh: ~z~好了，迟到已经浪费了我的时间，就不要在路途上多耽搁了。

english: ~z~This is getting boring. I thought we were meant to be on a date? Can you take me home?
zh: ~z~实在太无聊了，我们不是出来约会的吗？能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Ooh, it is so nice to be taken in a car that isn't a death trap. Thanks for trading up, Niko.
zh: ~z~能乘上一辆不是死亡陷阱的车真是好事。感谢你换了辆好车，尼克。

english: ~z~The way I think about it, even if I hate something, I can write a blog about it.
zh: ~z~我的想法就是，即便我讨厌某些东西，我还是能为它写篇博客。

english: ~z~This car is unreal, I thought they only drove cars like this in the third world.
zh: ~z~这车是假的吧，我还以为只有第三世界才会开这种车。

english: ~z~These bikes really take me back. Well let's get going, Niko.
zh: ~z~摩托车能让我想起很多往日时光。好了，我们走吧，尼克。

english: ~z~It was a sad day when the bouncer stopped asking me for ID at this place.
zh: ~z~这里的门卫不再问我要通行证就放我进去的那天是个悲伤的日子。

english: ~z~Wow, back at the strip club, are we? Well you must have really liked the effect it had on me last time.
zh: ~z~哇哦，重返脱衣舞俱乐部，对吧？你肯定是喜欢上次我去了这里后的样子。

english: ~z~Sweetie, I think it's time to get a new car, like, ten years ago.
zh: ~z~宝贝，我想是时候换辆新车了，就像，十年前一样。

english: ~z~I guess you're having your other clothes washed. I mean, there can't be any other reason to be wearing these.
zh: ~z~你的衣服是不是都拿去洗了？除此以外，我也想不到别的穿现在这身的理由了。

english: ~z~Okay, tell me how we're getting where we're going because I don't see a car.
zh: ~z~好吧，快告诉我我们怎么过去，我连你的车都没看见。

english: ~z~Niko, I've been waiting. No fucking wonder when you haven't brought a car.
zh: ~z~尼克，我等很久了。你丫连车都没开来，难怪这么慢。

english: ~z~A motorbike? I haven't been on one of these since I dated a drug dealer in high school.
zh: ~z~摩托车？自从在高中约上了一个毒贩子后我就再也没乘过。

english: ~z~Well if I'd known that you didn't have a car I'd have got the chauffeur.
zh: ~z~要是我早点知道你没有车，我就先把司机叫来了。

english: ~z~Darling, with clothes as with everything else, you buy cheap, you buy twice. I think you'll be trading in your top.
zh: ~z~亲爱的，衣服什么的都一样，一分钱一分货。你该换一件上衣了。

english: ~z~I'm the only person who's allowed to be late, Niko. You're making me sound like my mother. Just drive.
zh: ~z~我是唯一一个可以迟到的人，尼克。你这样搞得我说话都像我母亲了。开车吧。

english: ~z~Okay, well you're moving up the ladder in terms of cars. You're moving slowly but you're moving.
zh: ~z~好吧，你现在在汽车方面步步高升了。虽然升得很慢，但也在上升。

english: ~z~Yeah, don't worry Niko. I mean we all make fashion mistakes.
zh: ~z~没事，别担心，尼克。毕竟大家都会在穿搭上出错。

english: ~z~Niko, I don't care how long you've had this car but I hate it.
zh: ~z~尼克，我才不管你和这车已经在一起几年了，我很讨厌它。

english: ~z~I'm an intellectual, Niko. I like the finer things like culture and cocktails and gourmet food.
zh: ~z~我是个才女，尼克。我喜欢文化、鸡尾酒和美食之类的精致东西。

english: ~z~Oh, Niko. It's sweet that you're attached to this car but it really is disgusting.
zh: ~z~噢，尼克。你这么爱这辆车确实感人，但这样真的很恶心。

english: ~z~Niko, I'm starting to worry about you. Do you only want to look at naked women?
zh: ~z~尼克，我都要替你担心了。你是不是只想看裸体的女人？

english: ~z~Sorry, Mr. European but I want to keep those mysterious bits of you, mysterious.
zh: ~z~抱歉，欧洲先生，但我还是想让你神秘的地方保持神秘。

english: ~z~This hasn't exactly been the date of my dreams, Niko. But what did I expect?
zh: ~z~这跟我想象中的约会不大一样，尼克。不过我还能指望什么呢？

english: ~z~God, the stories I could tell you about this place, let's walk.
zh: ~z~天哪，我有很多关于这里的故事可以讲，边走边聊吧。

english: ~z~Those girls have had some serious work done. I want the name of the honey colored one's doctor.
zh: ~z~那些女人整形整得很厉害。我想知道那个金发女人的整形医生的名字。

english: ~z~Woo hoo, Niko beats Alex at pool - a game she incidentally hates. Stop the press.
zh: ~z~呜呼，尼克在台球上打败了亚历克斯，她最讨厌台球了。别吹了。

english: ~z~Well the crowd in there was a bit B and T, wasn't it? At least I got buzzed enough to cope.
zh: ~z~那里面的人大多是通勤族，不是吗？至少我已经够醉了。

english: ~z~Yeah, let me take your number and we can go on another date sometime.
zh: ~z~确实，给我你的电话吧，我们以后还能再出来约会。

english: ~z~Thank God it's over and we didn't even have to put all the balls in the holes.
zh: ~z~谢天谢地，终于结束了，再也没必要把球都打到洞里了。

english: ~z~Just because I write about sex on my blog, doesn't mean I'm going to put out.
zh: ~z~我在博客上面大谈特谈性的话题，不代表我要进行实践。

english: ~z~I knew you'd find that story interesting. I'm really good at telling what people will like.
zh: ~z~我就知道你会对这个故事感兴趣。我真的很擅长讲述别人喜欢的东西。

english: ~z~This has got to be a new low point, Niko. Being beaten by a girl who hates darts.
zh: ~z~实在是太糟糕了，尼克。你输给了一个讨厌飞镖的女孩。

english: ~z~This date better not be all foreplay and no pay off. Can we get where we're going already?
zh: ~z~这次约会最好别全是前戏没有结局。我们到地方了吗？

english: ~z~I'm always going to love that place, the people are so beautiful. I belong there.
zh: ~z~我向来喜欢那个地方，那里的人都很美。我属于那里。

english: ~z~Niko, I've been diagnosed with ADHD, I don't like having to wait this long to get where we're going.
zh: ~z~尼克，我被诊断有多动症，不喜欢在中途等这么久。

english: ~z~You really like this spot don't you? Did a friend of yours die here?
zh: ~z~你真的很喜欢这里，不是吗？是你的哪个朋友死在这里了吗？

english: ~z~I was finding that really interesting, Niko. Thanks for making me leave.
zh: ~z~我正在兴头上呢，尼克。真是谢谢你带我走人啊。

english: ~z~There are only so many boobs a girl can look at, Niko. I think we should have left earlier.
zh: ~z~那里奶子太多，女孩子受不了的，尼克。我们早就该出来了。

english: ~z~This place carries so many memories for me, Niko. I'm so happy that I can share it with you.
zh: ~z~这个地方承载着我的很多回忆，尼克。很高兴我可以和你共享。

english: ~z~And you've shown me that the criminals are not the only terrible people in Liberty City. Goodye.
zh: ~z~你也让我知道了，罪犯不是自由城里唯一一类糟糕的人。再见。

english: ~z~I hope I wasn't boring you, I mean not that I can bore anyone, but I was talking a lot.
zh: ~z~希望我没有让你无聊，不是说我会让别人无聊，但我一直在说话。

english: ~z~I told you I hate fast-food. I will not let it pass my lips again.
zh: ~z~都说了我讨厌快餐。我不会再让这种东西进我嘴里了。

english: ~z~Here again, okay. There's a lot more to see in Algonquin, Niko.
zh: ~z~又是这儿，行吧。阿尔冈琴能去的地方可多得很啊，尼克。

english: ~z~Don't you feel pathetic? Me beating you at the sport I hate.
zh: ~z~你就不觉得可悲吗？我在我讨厌的项目上打败了你。

english: ~z~That was a frat-tastic experience. It served its purpose though. I'm drunk.
zh: ~z~真是个普通到爆的地方。不过目的至少是达到了，我醉了。

english: ~z~I haven't told that stuff to anyone before. You're a good listener.
zh: ~z~我之前没跟任何人说过那件事。你是一个好听众。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, but I am not putting this chemical and hormone filled stuff into my body again. Will you take me somewhere else?
zh: ~z~很抱歉，但我不会再让这种全是激素添加剂的东西下肚了。能不能换家店？

english: ~z~I'm always happy to come here, Niko. But there are like other places to go walking.
zh: ~z~能来这里我很高兴，尼克。但也有别的地方能去吧。

english: ~z~Umm, are you sure you want to go for a walk right now? Don't people get raped here? You better protect me.
zh: ~z~唔，你确定要现在散步吗？走这里很容易被强奸吧？你最好能保护我。

english: ~z~Niko, this area looks very dangerous. People get killed outside of Algonquin. I trust you though.
zh: ~z~尼克，这地方看起来很危险。阿尔冈琴以外的地方有很多杀人案。不过我相信你。

english: ~z~As I said, that was repulsive. I am never, I mean ne-ver going there again.
zh: ~z~我说了，那地方很恶心。我再也、再也不会去那里了。

english: ~z~Well, let's check out this exciting place one more time. Fingers crossed we won't be killed.
zh: ~z~行吧，那就再去那儿瞧瞧吧。但愿我们不会被杀。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. You're sweet but we can't do that right now.
zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克。你很可爱，但我们现在还不能做那个。

english: ~z~Did we have to go? What? Were you getting jealous of me and the other girls or were you too turned on?
zh: ~z~一定要走吗？咋了？你是嫉妒我和其它女孩一起还是太性奋了？

english: ~z~Shit, to think that I used to love that place. Well, I still get drunk there though.
zh: ~z~我靠，以前我居然还喜欢那地方。好吧，不过我还是在那儿喝醉了。

english: ~z~Do you take all your girls here, Niko? Because I'm getting to know it pretty well.
zh: ~z~你是不是把每个女朋友都往这儿带，尼克？因为我什么都知道。

english: ~z~If you stay that long in a strip club, a girl is going to think that you're more interested in strippers than her.
zh: ~z~要是你在脱衣舞俱乐部待那么久，女孩子就会觉得比起她你更喜欢那些脱衣舞女了。

english: ~z~We've already walked around this place once. I thought we'd seen everything there was to see. I guess not.
zh: ~z~我们来过这儿一次了。我还以为能看的都已经看完了。不过好像还没。

english: ~z~I was just getting into that. Me and that stripper had a connection. She understood me.
zh: ~z~我快习惯这里了。我和那个脱衣舞女有了默契。她能懂我。

english: ~z~It's a good thing you don't want to go out and kill people all the time. There might be some serious consequences to that.
zh: ~z~幸好你没有想着出门杀人，不然后果就很严重了。

english: ~z~But this other guy I was dating told me he'd invest and that I should and that I had a lot of talent and I think he's right.
zh: ~z~只是一个和我约过的人说会给我投资，那我就拍吧，反正我很有才华，他说的没错。

english: ~z~the situation is weird. This is the twenty-first century. It's so now what we're doing.
zh: ~z~但就是感觉很奇怪。这就是21世纪，这就是我们的现状。

english: ~z~I know. But it was also true and that's what this guy told me that I was dating last night.
zh: ~z~我知道，这话没错，昨晚跟我约会的那个男人也是这么说的。

english: ~z~It fell through - but, to be honest, cinema is dead. I mean, it's so old fashioned.
zh: ~z~吹了。不过说实话，电影已死。这种载体过时了。

english: ~z~I think bits of it, they are so beautiful and sad and... they make me cry.
zh: ~z~我略微想了想，它们太美好、太悲惨了...都让我哭出来了。

english: ~z~I really understand people so, they're drawn to me. I mean, that's what people who talk to me and read my blog feel.
zh: ~z~我真的很懂别人，所以他们都被我吸引了。这就是跟我聊天、读我博客的人的感受。

english: ~z~Yeah... okay but I'd say that I'm a feminist. I think that every woman in this day and age should be.
zh: ~z~行，好吧...但我会说自己是女权主义者。现代女性都该支持女权。

english: ~z~These days with all of the internet and videos and stuff and my blog and sites like electrictit.com and stuff -
zh: ~z~现在网上有那么多视频和资源，还有我的博客和电子咪咪这样的网站，

english: ~z~I've never thought that writing my blog was "doing" something. It's just an extension of my personality. I'm creative.
zh: ~z~我从来没把写博客当成什么事。这只是我个性的延伸而已，我很有创造力的。

english: ~z~I like variety. Anyway, did I tell you? I'm making a movie.
zh: ~z~各种口味我都会试试。对了，有跟你说过吗？我正在拍电影。

english: ~z~I know. You're power. You're masculinity. You're freedom. In some ways, you're my muse.
zh: ~z~我知道。你就是力量，就是阳刚，就是自由。某种意义上，也是我的创作源泉。

english: ~z~People really relate to me. They can take a bit of my life and see it as their own.
zh: ~z~人们真的很亲近我。他们可以品味我的人生，当成自己的一部分。

english: ~z~I mean we don't need a man to help us get by in life. I do what I want, when I want and that's that.
zh: ~z~不需要男人帮我们维持温饱。我可以为所欲为，想做什么就做什么。

english: ~z~They get this connection. It's like they feel this glow off me and my life and they want to be near me. I mean, do you feel that?
zh: ~z~他们受我吸引。就好像能感受到我和我生活中的光芒，想要接近我。你感受到了吗？

english: ~z~Not like one of those idiot girls - I mean I know them they are all jealous of me because I'm an individual.
zh: ~z~我和那些白痴女不一样，我也知道她们都嫉妒我的特立独行。

english: ~z~Or a mouth, telling everyone who cares to listen about your life.
zh: ~z~或者说是嘴，可以向所有愿意倾听你的生活的人讲述。

english: ~z~It's going to be amazing. It's going to be the great American novel, only a movie.
zh: ~z~拍出来一定很棒。这将是一部伟大的美国小说，只是以电影呈现。

english: ~z~It's good that you're happy in your home. My home was not so comfortable.
zh: ~z~能在老家幸福生活是件好事。我的老家就没那么舒服了。

english: ~z~I've always kept diaries and, you know, thought really deep thoughts. I don't go in for all the bullshit... the trivial stuff.
zh: ~z~我一直在记日记，你也知道，还思考地很深入。我不会去管那些什么狗屁...没用的琐事。

english: ~z~Nor did I... that was a joke. I wasn't planning to.
zh: ~z~我也没有...刚才是开玩笑的。我就没打算写书。

english: ~z~That is so right. People need to hear about me. I really touch people.
zh: ~z~太对了，人们是得了解了解我。我真的很能打动别人。

english: ~z~I don't believe in classifying people. I think it's what we do that makes us who we are, moment to moment.
zh: ~z~我不相信什么给人归类。个人的行为决定了我们的身份，向来如此。

english: ~z~I don't know, because I can't get my shit together. Oh fuck it, it is together. I'm uh, it is together, sorry...
zh: ~z~不知道，因为我他妈不大清醒。哦操，清醒了。我，呃，现在清醒了，抱歉。

english: ~z~But I'm not an airhead. I mean I could be - I'm fun enough - but I'm also really intelligent.
zh: ~z~但我不是傻瓜。我确实能是，因为我够有趣，但我其实很聪明。

english: ~z~You cannot leave your apartment in this city without spending money so I guess you need to work.
zh: ~z~在这里出了家门就不可能不花钱，我想因此才需要工作。

english: ~z~Everything... No, nothing. That's what dating is isn't it? Giving bits of information. Teasing people.
zh: ~z~我的一切...不，不告诉你。这就是约会，不是吗？ 只给很少的信息，挑逗对方。

english: ~z~Listen, my life is not empty, jackass. It's amazing. I have crazy adventures.
zh: ~z~听着，我的生活并不空虚，蠢驴，它棒得很。我能经历疯狂的冒险。

english: ~z~I was going through the stuff on www.blogsnobs.org and I realized that I had to get Alex Chilton out there.
zh: ~z~我看了www.blogsnobs.org上的各种内容，然后意识到得让我亚历克斯･奇尔顿为世人所知。

english: ~z~It's about me. It started out as a blog, but it's evolved... into so much more than that. I mean sometimes,
zh: ~z~是关于我的。本来想写成博客，但它变了...达到了远超博客的水平。有时候，

english: ~z~I mean, you're living it, Niko - you're an experience. you're not an intellectual. You don't care.
zh: ~z~你现在就在生活，尼克，活生生的例子。你没有什么才华，你不在乎。

english: ~z~No. I'm liberated. I'm free. You can't control me, typical misogynist. Women can be artists too.
zh: ~z~不。我已经被解放了，我是自由的。你控制不了我，典型的仇女癌。女人也可以做艺术家。

english: ~z~I had to expose my deepest thoughts to the public and that's when I created the Liberated Woman blog.
zh: ~z~我必须向大众展现最深刻的思考，于是就建立了「自由女性」这个博客。

english: ~z~Oh, that's actually a quote that I've already used on my blog. What piece of my life do I want to show you first?
zh: ~z~噢，那句话我在博客里用过了。先向你展示我生活的哪方面好呢？

english: ~z~I know what they want and what they're feeling. How is some professor going to be able to give me a grade on what I already know?
zh: ~z~我知道他们的想法和感受。哪个教授能在我熟知的领域授予我学位呢？

english: ~z~It's not like I haven't been on a date like this before. I mean I've picked up guys on craplist and on dating sites but
zh: ~z~我也不是第一次这样约人了。我在craplist和各种交友网站上约过很多人，

english: ~z~It must be so hard for you finding work and stuff in Liberty. I am told immigrants have a really hard time here.
zh: ~z~你在自由城找工作的时候一定很难吧。听说移民在这儿的日子不好过。

english: ~z~Yes - I always knew I'd be a film maker. I have a very strong visual sense.
zh: ~z~确实，我一向认为自己会成为电影人。我的视觉设计能力很强。

english: ~z~Oh he doesn't count. He's not a man. He's Daddy. I'll have any man I want to. Young, old, American, European. Like you,
zh: ~z~哦，他不算。他不算是男人，他是爹地。我想找什么男人就找什么男人。小年轻、老头子、美国人、欧洲人。比如你。

english: ~z~I mean, I'll do that myself and I won't rely on men to get me what I need.
zh: ~z~就是说，我自己就会这么做，不会等着男人送上来。

english: ~z~The other day, I met this guy and I slept with him, and I wrote about it on my blog.
zh: ~z~有一天，我遇到了这个男人，和他睡了一觉，然后写到了博客里。

english: ~z~I mean, I pick you up and I don't give a shit what my Mother will say, or what friends think.
zh: ~z~就是说，我约了你，就不会管我母亲逼逼些什么，也不管我的朋友怎么想。

english: ~z~So, Niko. Do you want to tell me about yourself? I cannot believe we're going on a date and we don't even know each other.
zh: ~z~那，尼克。你能介绍下自己吗？在互不了解的情况下约会不太现实。

english: ~z~I was trying to figure out why it was that I related to you so easily. That must be it.
zh: ~z~我有想过为什么会这么轻易地就接近你。肯定就是这样。

english: ~z~Well, that's not the point. I mean, yep, narrative is dead. It's done. It's all about living.
zh: ~z~那不重要。我是说，对，叙事已死，死透了。重要的是生活。

english: ~z~Next thing I know I've seen three pairs of shoes that I have to have and it's time to call Daddy and get the limit on my credit card extended.
zh: ~z~一出去就看上了三双鞋，反手就打给爹地让他提升我的信用卡额度了。

english: ~z~But, mostly I'm my own muse. I mean, I'm going to be an important person. I think I'll change the world.
zh: ~z~一般我自己才是我的创作源泉。我会成为一个大人物，我以后会改变世界。

english: ~z~Yes, he's amazing. But don't worry. Not all of the guys I date have to be intellectuals.
zh: ~z~对，他很棒。不过别担心，跟我约会的人也可以不是才子。

english: ~z~richer and deeper than everyone else's. I mean, they relate to me because I'm better than them.
zh: ~z~都要丰富、深刻。我比他们强，他们才会亲近我。

english: ~z~Not really what I meant. So, you got a fancy college degree that gets you noticed?
zh: ~z~跟我说的不太一样。对了，你是不是有个引人瞩目的大学学位？

english: ~z~Anyway, the more stuff I do the more I have to write about in my blog... and I'll put it in my novel too.
zh: ~z~总之，我做的越多，在博客里写的就越多...放到我小说里的也越多。

english: ~z~The thing about me is, I'm interesting. People feel like they can talk to me and open up.
zh: ~z~我这人吧，还挺有趣的。跟我聊天的人都会自然地敞开心扉。

english: ~z~So, this blog you write. Is that all you want to do?
zh: ~z~那，你在写的这个博客，就是你想做的一切了吗？

english: ~z~Everyone tells me how creative I am. Especially men. Women are often jealous. You know how girls can be?
zh: ~z~大家都说我很有想法，尤其是男人。女人就以嫉妒为主了。你知道女人能多嫉妒吗？

english: ~z~I don't know. I'm not from here. I'm trying to get through life in a strange country but it isn't easy.
zh: ~z~不好说。我不是本地人，还在尝试融入异国生活，但是有点困难。

english: ~z~Thanks... yep - I'm an intellectual. I mean, I haven't gotten going yet, but I am.
zh: ~z~谢了...对，我是个才女。虽然还不完全是，但也确实是。

english: ~z~Oh, I write a thread called Liberated Woman on blogsnobs.org.
zh: ~z~噢，我在blogsnobs.org上开了一个叫「自由女性」的博客。

english: ~z~Some people make it difficult, yes? What do you want me to know about you?
zh: ~z~总有人来找你麻烦，对吧？你想让我了解你的哪些方面？

english: ~z~I haven't had any trouble. It's not just because I've never had a paying job, because I'm an intellectual.
zh: ~z~我倒没遇上。不只是因为我从未上过班，也是因为我的才华。

english: ~z~He told me what was so amazing about my writing was that it was funny and tender and heartbreakingly original,
zh: ~z~他告诉我我的文章妙就妙在趣味、柔情与令人心碎的真实经历，

english: ~z~I went to college, I was going to be a psych. major but I found it too easy.
zh: ~z~我是上过大学，本来主修心理学的，不过我觉得这个太简单了。

english: ~z~Well, I've been blogging, and I've been doing a lot of web 2.0 shit. And I've... I've... well all kinds of crazy things.
zh: ~z~我在写博客，也整了一堆Web 2.0的玩意。而且还...还...总之啥都做了。

english: ~z~I'm a one man crime wave who has killed indiscriminately since I turned up here, but inside I just want to be loved.
zh: ~z~来这儿以后，我是个犯下无数罪行的无差别杀人犯，但我的内心只是渴望被爱。

english: ~z~Exactly. God I feel like sometimes you're the only one who really listens.
zh: ~z~就是这样。天哪，感觉你是唯一一个真正听我说话的人。

english: ~z~And the only reason girls become anorexic and start popping pills is to get with older guys. It's a match made in Heaven.
zh: ~z~而女孩会得上厌食症成为药罐子，也是为了接近老男人。这是天造之合。

english: ~z~This story is marketable. It could be the arc my novel needs. It might give everything structure. Do you want to get married?
zh: ~z~这个故事肯定很叫座，可以作为我小说的主线，说不定能撑起故事的架构。你想结婚吗？

english: ~z~He's in love with me, you know. I've been seeing him forever.
zh: ~z~跟我陷入爱河了，懂吧。我这辈子都得找他看病。

english: ~z~My life ended many years ago when I saw my childhood friends butchered on a hillside.
zh: ~z~我的人生早就结束了，看见童年玩伴在山坡上被屠杀的时候就结束了。

english: ~z~Okay, maybe this date is not such a good idea. If you are in this type of mood...
zh: ~z~好吧，现在约会似乎不是个好主意。既然你心情不好...

english: ~z~"Alex, did you really sleep with the gardener at our place upstate?".
zh: ~z~「亚历克斯，你该不会真和乡下家里的园丁睡了吧？」

english: ~z~I act all tough, but inside I'm just a little girl. I used to be anorexic.
zh: ~z~我假装坚强，但内心还是一个小女孩。我得过厌食症。

english: ~z~I mean... ok they've like, taken the cab to where I told them to take it, or they've got me the right size of shoe...
zh: ~z~就是说...有了，比如说按照我的指示开车，或者是拿给我合适的鞋子...

english: ~z~Yep. I guess... I guess... I guess it just hurts knowing as much as I do.
zh: ~z~是吗？大概吧...大概吧...大概懂的像我一样多也很痛苦。

english: ~z~Too many things to mention. It's been crazy. Wild and liberated, the whole nine. What about you?
zh: ~z~能说的太多了，疯狂得不行。彻头彻尾的狂野又自由。你呢？

english: ~z~Dish washers, gardeners and valets would put posters of you on their walls.
zh: ~z~洗碗的、搞园艺的、当仆人的都会把你的海报贴在墙上。

english: ~z~No you don't. Not in the way I mean. You couldn't possibly know how much I suffer.
zh: ~z~不，你不理解。你跟我的感受不一样。你不可能知道我经历了多少痛苦。

english: ~z~It's fucking Mother. It's all - "Alex do this?", "Alex, when are you going to meet a nice man?
zh: ~z~是我老母的关系。整天「亚历克斯拜托了」「亚历克斯，你几时才能找到个好男人啊？」

english: ~z~I'm sorry, it's just my doctor put me on some new meds and I haven't quite leveled out yet.
zh: ~z~对不起，只是医生给我开了些新药，我还不太适应。

english: ~z~I still hate life. I'm a failure. I should have done more.
zh: ~z~我还是厌恶生活，我就是个失败者。我应该做更多事情的。

english: ~z~I knew it. You are so lucky to have me. I imagine I bring adventure to your life.
zh: ~z~我就知道。遇到我是你的福气，我给你的生活带来了奇遇。

english: ~z~"Alex, why are all my friends reading about your sex life on the internet?",
zh: ~z~「亚历克斯，怎么我的朋友都在网上读你的性生活？」

english: ~z~The fucking driver was there, why did I have to be there too? No I think it's the pills.
zh: ~z~有那个狗逼司机在，还要我去干嘛？不，果然还是药的关系。

english: ~z~Yeah you. I don't know much about you, you're a man of mystery. Where you from? Spain isn't? Oh! Was that the other guy?
zh: ~z~就你。我对你了解不多，你太神秘了。是哪里人来着？西班牙对吧？噢！那个不是你吧？

english: ~z~I've had the worst day. It's like everyone has been talking at me and no one has been listening to what I have to say.
zh: ~z~今天真是糟透了。感觉所有人都在对我说三道四，没人听我在说什么。

english: ~z~I think you're okay. I think you are just being a human being. That's what my cousin told me, when I was like you.
zh: ~z~我觉得你挺好的，这些都是正常人的反应。我堂兄就是这么说的，当时我也是这么痛苦。

english: ~z~The only reason guys become psychiatrists is to get with young, anorexic pill poppers.
zh: ~z~男人会当心理医生的唯一原因，就是为了接近那些年轻、厌食的药罐子。

english: ~z~Nothing. I mean ha fucking ha, little rich girl, all depressed, can't write a book.
zh: ~z~没什么。就是，呵呵，小富婆很抑郁，写不出书。

english: ~z~I bet you do. Every guy from your background must dream about marrying into money. Think about it -
zh: ~z~一定想过吧。你这种家境的人做梦都想娶富婆回家。想想吧，

zh: ~z~是啊，我也玩得很开心。给我你的电话吧，以后我可能会打过来找你。

english: ~z~I don't normally say no, Niko. But for you, I'll make an exception. No.
zh: ~z~我通常不会说「不」，尼克。但对你是个例外。不。

english: ~z~If you got me a place you'd have me all to yourself. We could have a whole lotta fun.
zh: ~z~要是你能帮我安家，我就完全是你的人了。我们可以过得很开心。

english: ~z~Fake is the best kind. They firm, they round, they beautiful, don't you think?
zh: ~z~假胸是最好的胸。坚挺、丰满、美丽，你不觉得吗？

english: ~z~It's true, men love me. I see the way you looking at me.
zh: ~z~真的，男人都爱我。从你看我时候的样子里就能看出来。

english: ~z~They got a reality TV show for everything now - rich people, cars, hookers.
zh: ~z~现在什么题材的真人秀都有：富人、汽车、妓女。

english: ~z~How could I leave Liberty City? There's nowhere else to go? Except maybe Los Santos.
zh: ~z~我怎么会离开自由城？还有别的地方能去吗？洛圣都倒可以考虑一下。

english: ~z~Prices are crazy in Algonquin but who cares, the other boroughs are more interesting.
zh: ~z~阿尔冈琴的物价确实高得离谱，不过管他呢，别的地方更加有趣。

english: ~z~I ain't talking about being paid. I ain't no hooker. I'm talking about gifts, Niko. Shit.
zh: ~z~我说的不是钱的事，我又不是鸡。我说的是礼物，尼克。靠。

english: ~z~Bohan's just interesting if you don't got any aspirations. I want to live in the real Liberty City -
zh: ~z~要是你无欲无求的话，波汉确实够有趣了。我想活在真正的自由城，

english: ~z~You could be exclusive with a guy because you like him, not just because he was paying you to be.
zh: ~z~你可以因为喜欢一个人而成为他的独享，而不是因为他肯为你花钱。

english: ~z~I get blood and sick all over me all day. You know what it's like to get blood on you?
zh: ~z~血啊、呕吐物啊整天沾我身上。你知道身上沾血的感觉吗？

english: ~z~Carmen, I have enough problems looking after myself. I can't afford to support you as well.
zh: ~z~卡门，我光是要照顾好自己就够麻烦了。没法子同时养你。

english: ~z~I'm a free spirit, you hear? A modern woman. I don't wanna be chained to no cooker like me mami was.
zh: ~z~我是独立的人，听见了吗？现代女性。我可不想被迫成为妈咪那样的煮饭婆。

english: ~z~I'm not asking for a commitment, Carmen. I'm happy with the way things are. It's cool.
zh: ~z~我不是想向你求婚，卡门。现在这样我就很满足了。没关系的。

english: ~z~I don't see no reason to only give what I give to a man if he ain't going to pay for it.
zh: ~z~要是一个男人连这点钱都不肯出，我觉得也没有理由必要要成为他的独享。

english: ~z~It ain't pretty, is it? I'm wearing some shitty uniform, I got crap on me.
zh: ~z~感觉很不好，对吧？我穿着一身垃圾制服，还沾上了各种污渍。

english: ~z~You know, plenty of my girl friends get apartments rented for them, they get allowances from their men.
zh: ~z~你也知道，我的很多闺蜜都有人帮她们租房，她们的男人会给钱。

english: ~z~They so expensive though. I can't afford that shit on my nurse's salary.
zh: ~z~就是那里房价太贵，靠我做护士的那点工资买不起。

english: ~z~See these clothes? They all designer, baby. Don't nothing without a label touch this skin.
zh: ~z~看见这身衣服了吗？全都是私人定制的。杂牌的东西就别想在我身上出现。

english: ~z~Hey honey, you like the way Carmen looks after herself? You a lucky man, no?
zh: ~z~嘿，甜心，你喜欢卡门打扮自己的方式吗？你这人真走运啊。

english: ~z~No story. You know. I came to your country and I'm trying to make a go of it.
zh: ~z~没什么故事，真的。我来到你的国家，想开创一番事业。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko, I really need to get out of here. I need to move.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克，我真的得离开这儿了。我需要搬家。

english: ~z~You got to help yourself first, honey. That's the truth. I'm looking out for Carmen.
zh: ~z~人就是要先帮助自己的，甜心。那是事实。我要先照顾好卡门。

english: ~z~Are you rich? I like rich. If there's one thing working in a hospital teaches you, it's that money matters.
zh: ~z~你有钱吗？我喜欢有钱人。要说从医院的工作中能学到什么，就是有钱可以为所欲为。

english: ~z~It'd tell everyone out there what it's like for a girl coming out of South Bohan trying to make something of herself.
zh: ~z~我的节目会告诉所有人，一个出身南波汉的女孩怎样让自己有所成就。

english: ~z~No, you're sweet. You know we ain't exclusive right? You know I'm seeing other guys.
zh: ~z~不，你就是好。你也知道我们都不是某人独享的吧？也知道我在跟别的男人见面。

english: ~z~I don't want no baby pulling on my puppies. I just want them looking perfect.
zh: ~z~我可不想让什么婴儿吸扯我的乳房。我只想让胸部有完美的外观。

english: ~z~I want to live in Algonquin. You couldn't rent me a place there, could you?
zh: ~z~我想活在阿尔冈琴。你没法帮我在那儿安家，对吧？

english: ~z~I got to look good when I'm out of that place. It's the only thing that's important.
zh: ~z~那我下班以后肯定得好好打扮。这才是头等重要的事。

english: ~z~Man, you're tough. But you seem fun. Are you fun?
zh: ~z~天，你真烦人。不过你好像挺有趣的。你这人有趣吗？

english: ~z~I don't know, honey. I like boys. I like looking good. I like watching TV.
zh: ~z~不知道，甜心。我喜欢男人，喜欢自己好看，还喜欢看电视。

english: ~z~If that's how you roll, Carmen, that's how you roll. You never made any promises to me. You can do what you like.
zh: ~z~你爱这样的话，卡门，那就这样吧。你也从没跟我约定过。你爱怎么来怎么来。

english: ~z~It don't matter because Carmen ain't leaving Liberty City. She just need to get her a place in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~无所谓，反正卡门没打算离开自由城，她只是想在阿尔冈琴安个家。

english: ~z~I want to do something important, really make a difference, you know?
zh: ~z~我想做有价值的事，能够做出影响的事，知道吗？

english: ~z~I like fun. I'm a nurse. We have so much fun at the hospital. That shit is crazy.
zh: ~z~就喜欢有趣的。我是护士，医院里就有很多乐子。那里太疯狂了。

english: ~z~Oh, you know - I'm pretty incredible. Carmen is one of a kind I mean, you know.
zh: ~z~噢，你也知道，我这人很特别。卡门是独一无二的，懂吧。

english: ~z~My tits, honey. I didn't pay this much for them if I didn't want men to look. You like what you see?
zh: ~z~我的奶子啊，甜心。在这上面花大价钱就是为了让男人看的。你看着喜欢吗？

english: ~z~They should make a show about me. I look better than most of them bitches on there anyways.
zh: ~z~就应该给我拍一个节目。我比电视上的大部分贱人好看。

english: ~z~If your picture of the world comes from the TV you watch in this country,
zh: ~z~要是你对世界的了解都来自这个国家的电视节目，

english: ~z~Screw that, honey. I want people to notice me. I want to be a television personality.
zh: ~z~得了吧，甜心。我想被别人注意，我想做电视名人。

english: ~z~You like being with me, don't you Niko? All men do.
zh: ~z~你喜欢和我在一起，不是吗，尼克？男人都喜欢。

english: ~z~Carmen looking better than good. She's got her hair done, she's been for a manicure.
zh: ~z~卡门看起来可不只是美。她做了头发，还做了指甲。

english: ~z~A lot of people think that, Carmen. I'm not sure how true it is though
zh: ~z~很多人都这么想，卡门。不过这话有几分真假我就不知道了。

english: ~z~I'm a nurse, honey. I got to clean people's asses nine to five.
zh: ~z~我是个护士，甜心。一天到晚都在收拾病人的烂摊子。

english: ~z~For sure, if you watch those big Vinewood movies and sitcoms and stuff.
zh: ~z~当然不会，除非你只看好麦坞大片和单口喜剧之类的东西。

english: ~z~Ain't you got no friends? We never go anywhere, we never meet important people.
zh: ~z~你没有朋友吗？我们从未去过什么地方，从未见过重要的人。

english: ~z~That don't matter. A pretty girl like me should be famous. And rich. Like in the magazines.
zh: ~z~那都不重要。我这样的漂亮女孩就该出名，就该富贵。像杂志里写的那样。

english: ~z~you ain't the boss of me and he says if he was he'd sack me and then I start crying.
zh: ~z~你又不是我老板。他说要是他是我老板，就炒了我，然后我就哭了。

english: ~z~Wow! Is Tony McTony a goth? I didn't know.
zh: ~z~哇哦！那托尼･麦克托尼他内心阴暗喽？这我倒不知道。

english: ~z~Yes. He says you only want one thing and I say I don't care, I like having fun,
zh: ~z~真的。他说你想要的东西只有一个，然后我就说我不在乎，我喜欢享受乐趣。

english: ~z~All we ever do is hang out and talk and get in trouble and be you and me.
zh: ~z~我们一直做的事都是出来转悠、聊天、惹上麻烦，然后各回各家。

english: ~z~Thanks, baby. You're special. Not as special as Carmen, but still special.
zh: ~z~谢了，宝贝。你真特别。虽然没卡门这么特别，但也很特别了。

english: ~z~I was partying the other night in Bungalow 9 and I had my nails done, and I went shopping with the girls.
zh: ~z~我在9号平房的派对玩了一夜，然后去做了指甲，还和闺蜜一起去逛了街。

english: ~z~Yes. Jill van Crastenburg was just in before me. Oh, and Tony McTony.
zh: ~z~没错，吉尔･万･克拉斯顿堡当时就在我面前。哦，还有托尼･麦克托尼。

english: ~z~I had them done. By my girl, Lucille, she does lots of celebrities, you know?
zh: ~z~我专门去做的。找我女友露西尔做的，她给很多名人做过指甲，你知道吗？

english: ~z~About my life - about the way I'm carrying on, about hanging out with guys like you.
zh: ~z~我的生活，现在的状态，还有和你这样的人出来约会。

english: ~z~I know. I hate them. Listen do you think my teeth need straightening? Or whitening?
zh: ~z~我懂。我讨厌他们。听着，你说我要去做牙齿矫正吗？或者做个牙齿美白？

english: ~z~I've been pretty quiet, Carmen. Nothing that exciting. What about you?
zh: ~z~我最近安宁得很，卡门。没什么刺激的事情。你呢？

english: ~z~and he says you a slut and I say women have changed, it's call being a woman,
zh: ~z~然后他说我是个荡妇，我就说女性已经变了，这才叫女人。

english: ~z~I don't know yet. I only just began plotting. Maybe modeling or some shit.
zh: ~z~还没想好，才刚开始谋划而已。可能靠当模特之类的吧。

english: ~z~I like hanging out with you, Niko, but I got one problem. I mean with taking this further.
zh: ~z~我喜欢和你出来逛，尼克，但我有个问题。是个更加深入的话题。

english: ~z~Not like all the other men I date, just want to talk about themselves and how successful they are.
zh: ~z~和我约过的其他男人不同，他们只会吹嘘自己有多成功。

english: ~z~Not bored. Just unfulfilled. I mean, it's great helping people, but you don't get thanked.
zh: ~z~不是腻了，只是没什么成就感。我是说，帮助别人是好，但你得不到感谢。

english: ~z~You only buy her the happy hour drinks not them high price ones.
zh: ~z~你给她买的酒都是便宜的促销酒，不买贵的那些。

english: ~z~You lucky Carmen's hanging out with you, baby. She's so out your league.
zh: ~z~卡门肯跟你出来是你的福气，宝贝。她的阶层比你高了不少。

english: ~z~She should be going out with rap stars and football players, not hoods like you.
zh: ~z~她应该和嘻哈明星、橄榄球运动员出门，而不是你这样的小混混。

english: ~z~No problem? I gotta be at work soon. I gotta save lives, man.
zh: ~z~没关系？我待会儿要上班的，还要去救人性命的，老兄。

english: ~z~I'll give you fucking issues, I'll put you in the fucking hospital myself.
zh: ~z~我会让你丫有问题的，我会亲自把你丫送进那个破医院的。

english: ~z~You a cheapskate or something, Niko? You don't want to spend no money on Carmen?
zh: ~z~你是铁公鸡还是什么，尼克？你不想在卡门身上花钱吗？

english: ~z~Fuck you, Niko. You think you better than Carmen? You ain't. You ain't fucking shit.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，尼克。你以为你比卡门强吗？才怪呢，你丫屁都不是。

english: ~z~she was saying something with her eyes and with her hips and with her whole body language.
zh: ~z~她用眼睛、屁股和全身上下的肢体语言跟你说了。

english: ~z~Kate - I'm sorry, something's come up... I can't make it to the hospital.
zh: ~z~凯特，我很抱歉，我有点急事...来不了医院了。

english: ~z~You've reached Kate McReary. I'm sorry, I can't take your call just now. Please try back another time.
zh: ~z~你呼叫的是凯特･麦克雷里。很抱歉，现在我没法接听你的电话。请过会儿再试。

english: ~z~I'd really love to Kate - but I'm in the middle of something crazy.
zh: ~z~我很想来，凯特。但是我现在忙着做一些疯狂的事。

english: ~z~Okay... you're a dick, but I forgive you. Let's try again, shall we? Pick me up in an hour or so.
zh: ~z~好吧... 你这个混蛋，但我原谅你。我们再试一次，好吗？一小时内来接我。

english: ~z~God, I must be really boring... even you don't want to know me.
zh: ~z~天哪，我这人一定很无聊...连你都不想了解我。

english: ~z~Okay. Maybe we'll hang out another time, when you're less busy - maybe not.
zh: ~z~好的。或许我们可以改天再出去，等你没那么忙的时候。或许不出去了。

english: ~z~I'm happy to give our friendship another go, because I like you, even though you are a dick. Pick me up in an hour.
zh: ~z~我很乐意再给我们的友谊一次机会，因为我喜欢你，尽管你是个混蛋。一小时内来接我。

english: ~z~You're a fine one to call me after the way you've been treating me... I know - piss off. Call back when you're less annoying.
zh: ~z~你倒好，那样对我后还给我打电话...我知道。滚蛋。等你没那么令人恼火了再打回来。

english: ~z~I'm too pissed off to speak to you right now, amigo. Call back when I don't think you're a dick...
zh: ~z~我现在很生气，不想和你说话，老兄。等我不再认为你是个混蛋后再打回来...

english: ~z~That's weird, because when I woke up, I said to myself, Kate - hopefully you can be stood up by a prick today.
zh: ~z~很奇怪，因为今天醒来的时候我告诉过自己，凯特，今天你有希望被某个混蛋放鸽子。

english: ~z~Are you still alive? I haven't heard from you for a very long time. Did you lose my number?
zh: ~z~你还活着吗？我很久没接到你的电话了。你是弄丢了我的号码吗？

english: ~z~I'm not going to ask what you were doing... I don't want to know, let's go.
zh: ~z~我不会问你你刚才在干嘛...我不想知道，走吧。

english: ~z~I'm not superficial, but please change your clothes ONE time you take me out?
zh: ~z~也不是我外貌协会，但你跟我约会就不能换套别的衣服吗？

english: ~z~We can have fun in here, if they let a pair of scumbags like us in!
zh: ~z~我们是能在这儿玩得很高兴，只要他们肯让一对我们这样的草包进去！

english: ~z~Have I died and gone to hat hell with you Niko?
zh: ~z~我是不是已经死了，和你一起下了帽子地狱，尼克？

english: ~z~You know, all this bowling might ruin your tough guy image.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，再打保龄球，你的硬汉形象就要毁了。

english: ~z~Back at the bowling alley with the sociopath. Who'd have thought it?
zh: ~z~又和反社会者回到保龄球球道上了。谁能想到呢？

english: ~z~I come from a distinguished family of alcoholics - as you know - let's go.
zh: ~z~我就是从喝酒见长的家族出来的，你也知道。来吧。

english: ~z~I've had more fun at funerals, Niko - can you take me home?
zh: ~z~参加葬礼都比这个有趣，尼克。你能带我回家了吗？

english: ~z~I don't know what Packie will say when I tell him you weren't enough of a gentleman to let me win at bowling.
zh: ~z~要是我告诉派奇你不够绅士，打保龄球的时候没让我赢，我不知道他会说什么。

english: ~z~You're a great guy, for a maniac - but I'm going to bed. Goodnight.
zh: ~z~作为一个疯子，你很不错。不过我要上床睡觉了。晚安。

english: ~z~Now, Niko. I beat you at bowling. Please don't get into a rage and go killing people.
zh: ~z~现在，尼克，我保龄球打赢你了。拜托你不要突然暴怒，开始杀人。

english: ~z~That was so so, don't you think... anyway, it's getting late.
zh: ~z~刚才那个也就一般吧，你不觉得吗...总之，现在也有点晚了。

english: ~z~I had a great time - reminds me of my family, only no one died.
zh: ~z~我玩得很高兴，让我想起了我的家人，只是没有人死。

english: ~z~I too have things I wish to forget. The things that happened to me back home, the war...
zh: ~z~我也有想要忘却的事情。那些在我故乡发生的事情，战争...

english: ~z~My dad was a drinker and he sure had a temper, but I believe in my heart of hearts that he was a good man.
zh: ~z~我父亲是个酒鬼，脾气也不好，但我发自真心地相信他是个好人。

english: ~z~I don't know... getting out, doing stuff, not working or fighting with my family. Getting to know you.
zh: ~z~不知道...出门玩，做各种事，不为我的家人工作或者干架。逐渐了解你。

english: ~z~You have had opportunities that most of the world could not imagine.
zh: ~z~你已经拥有世界上很多地方连想都不敢想的机会了。

english: ~z~Well, for a murdering, thieving idiot who can't talk about things, you're kind of nice.
zh: ~z~算了，比起那种偷窃杀人还不会讲话的白痴，你已经算是好的了。

english: ~z~I just hope that the way you choose to deal with yours is productive, not destructive.
zh: ~z~我只是希望你的处理方式是建设性的，而不是毁灭性的。

english: ~z~I do, but I don't think that any life is not mad. You were here in America.
zh: ~z~是知道，不过我觉得所有人的生活都很疯狂。你可是在美国。

english: ~z~I was mostly raised by Roman's mother. She was great. An amazing person.
zh: ~z~我基本上是罗曼的母亲养大的。她很伟大。是个令人惊奇的人。

english: ~z~An Irish family manages to make it the eighteenth century when or wherever they are.
zh: ~z~我有一个随时随地都想重现18世纪辉煌的爱尔兰家族。

english: ~z~Dad drove my brothers mad. I sometimes think that the reason they act the way they do is rebelling against him.
zh: ~z~我爸让哥哥们很不爽。有时候我都觉得他们的现状是对爸爸的叛逆。

english: ~z~Fair enough. A life time of trying to sort my brothers out has left me a little sanctimonious.
zh: ~z~有道理。一直规劝我那些哥哥都弄得我有点道貌岸然了。

english: ~z~The men in my family are just highwaymen and moralists, usually both in equal measure.
zh: ~z~家里男人不是拦路强盗就是道德卫士，通常还是一半一半。

english: ~z~Date? This isn't a date, Niko. We're just getting to know each other. We might be friends and that's all.
zh: ~z~约会？才不是约会，尼克。我们只是在互相了解对方。我们可能会做朋友，就是这样了。

english: ~z~What have you been up to? Actually, I don't think I want to know. I'm sure it made you feel big and strong.
zh: ~z~你最近在干嘛？不过我也不太想知道。肯定是能让你觉得自己高大威猛的事情。

english: ~z~I don't know if I'd agree that Packie was a moralist. He seems like a highwayman through and through.
zh: ~z~要是派奇也算道德卫士的话我就不敢苟同了。他似乎是个彻头彻尾的拦路强盗。

english: ~z~We grew up the next house to each other. So physically yes. And temperamentally, yes.
zh: ~z~小时候我们两家只有一墙之隔。所以距离上是近的。两个人性格也很接近。

english: ~z~I don't know. I have lived a complicated life. I was in a war.
zh: ~z~我不知道，我的人生经历有点复杂。我参加过战争。

english: ~z~The war taught me a lot of bad things, but it also taught me to enjoy life.
zh: ~z~战争教了我很多坏东西，但也教会了我要享受生活。

english: ~z~I was his princess, I was the little girl. And I didn't give him a reason to discipline me.
zh: ~z~我是他的掌上明珠，我是最小的女儿。而且我也没给他理由体罚我。

english: ~z~They were identical. But did they get along? No. they hated each other. They were both assholes, you see.
zh: ~z~他俩一模一样。至于他们处得好吗？不好，他们互相看不顺眼。他俩都是混蛋，就这样。

english: ~z~You should see him around me, if a man even looks in my direction, he threatens to rip his heart out.
zh: ~z~那你应该看看他在我身边的表现。要是有男人往我的方向看，他就会上去威胁要掏了那个男人的心脏。

english: ~z~I guess I played up to it even more because my relationship with him was something I had that the boys didn't.
zh: ~z~我想我这么做更多是为了迎合他，因为我和他的关系是哥哥们没有的。

english: ~z~Forgive me... I'm sorry if this is a weird question - what was the war like?
zh: ~z~请见谅...如果这个问题太怪的话我就先道歉了。战争是怎么样的？

english: ~z~It's nice to have a friend, Niko. I feel like you are someone I can speak to.
zh: ~z~有个朋友真好，尼克。感觉我可以跟你聊很多东西。

english: ~z~With a family like yours, I would have thought you would have learnt to cope by now.
zh: ~z~你有这样一个家族在，我还以为你早就学会应付它了。

english: ~z~Well, is a good thing that we are just friends. If this was a date, I'd be scared.
zh: ~z~幸好我俩只是普通朋友。如果这是在约会，我就要害怕了。

english: ~z~I hope so, I don't want to believe that every man in my family was as bad as my brothers.
zh: ~z~但愿吧，我不想相信我家里的所有男人都和我的哥哥们一样坏。

english: ~z~You know, just waiting around and wasting time until she can join my father in the eternal splendor of Heaven.
zh: ~z~你也知道，只是在等待大限、浪费时间，等着到天堂的永恒光辉中去找我父亲。

english: ~z~Some downtime. A moment away from the craziness of it all - my family, life in general.
zh: ~z~放松的时间。能够远离我疯狂的家庭、普通地生活的时光。

english: ~z~Rather than me keeping secrets about my family from you, you're probably keeping secrets about my family from me?
zh: ~z~这次倒未必是我对我家的事保密了，我看是你在对我保密我家的事吧？

english: ~z~I found her. Roman does not know - he thought she died in a house fire.
zh: ~z~我找到了她。罗曼还不知道，他以为她是因为家中失火丧命的。

english: ~z~It was great - you got to see people turn into animals and your close friends die.
zh: ~z~战争很棒。你可以看见人类变成禽兽，看见你的挚友死亡。

english: ~z~I couldn't date you... someone like my brothers. I couldn't do that to myself.
zh: ~z~我不可能跟你约会的...约你这种和我哥哥们一样的人。我不会对自己做那种事的。

english: ~z~She wanted to send me too, but I wanted to fight. I was stupid.
zh: ~z~本来她想把我也送来，不过当时我想参战。我真是太蠢了。

english: ~z~Maybe it's a break from it all... a new beginning.
zh: ~z~比如说远离种种琐事的休息...一个全新的开始。

english: ~z~None of the boys liked my dad, and he didn't appear to like them much either. He believed in discipline, you know?
zh: ~z~他们没一个喜欢我爸的，而我爸似乎也不太喜欢他们。他相信体罚，你知道吗？

english: ~z~Alright then, this isn't a date. We're just two people, hanging out.
zh: ~z~那好吧，这不是在约会。我们就是两个人出来玩。

english: ~z~When the war came, she saved up all her money and sent Roman here.
zh: ~z~战争来临的时候，她把她的钱都省了下来，把罗曼送到了这儿。

english: ~z~It taught me how to get by, how to detach myself from people who upset me. Therapy works... it sort of works.
zh: ~z~它教会了我怎么挺下去，怎么让自己摆脱那些令我伤心的人。~n~治疗还算有效...至少能算有效吧。

english: ~z~To live a normal life, I mean - get married, have kids, not steal, rob, kill.
zh: ~z~我是说过正常的生活。结婚生子，不是偷盗、抢劫、杀人。

english: ~z~No. It was seeing your home destroyed, seeing members of your family die.
zh: ~z~不，那种经历是看着自己的家被毁，看着你的家人死亡。

english: ~z~Sorry. I knew it was a dumb question. It's just, I hoped it wasn't so awful for you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，我不该问这么蠢的问题。我只是希望那次战争对你不算太糟。

english: ~z~but it's those moments when you can just forget that I value most.
zh: ~z~但我最珍视的还是可以直接忘却这种家庭的时光。

english: ~z~They hated him, they'd fight with him and scream at him and run away for days at a time before he'd drag them home.
zh: ~z~他们都恨他，他们会和他打架，对他大喊大叫，离家出走几天直到被他拖回来。

english: ~z~Another one like my brothers. A tough guy with a death wish. A man eager to get into Hell as soon as possible.
zh: ~z~和我哥哥一样的那种。怀着死亡觉悟的硬汉。时刻准备下地狱的人。

english: ~z~But you're not ready either. You're a lunatic. I don't know if you can change...
zh: ~z~可是你也没准备好。你是个疯子，我不知道你能不能改变...

english: ~z~I don't want to get into that. But you know what I mean. What is the purpose of existence?
zh: ~z~我不想讲那个，但你知道我的意思。存在的目的是什么？

english: ~z~We have scars that come from these horrible situations and we can live to tell the tale.
zh: ~z~我们都有在极恶环境下留下的创伤，而且都能活着讲述那些故事。

english: ~z~You're like me - a whack job who should have been locked up years ago. You're a deranged psycho.
zh: ~z~你很像我，一个几年前就该被关起来的疯子。你就是个精神错乱的疯子。

english: ~z~Give it up. Move away. Grow up. Get out... you could be happy.
zh: ~z~放弃现状，搬走，成长，离开...你可以幸福的。

english: ~z~I really like you. I mean, not like that. I'm not into that. Not with you.
zh: ~z~我真的喜欢你。我是说，也不是那个。我没那个意思。不会跟你那个。

english: ~z~Our mutual interest in wine, conversation, art house movies and long walks on the beach...
zh: ~z~我们兴趣相似，无论是在酒上、话题上、小众电影上，还是在沙滩上漫步...

english: ~z~Good. Because I don't want to think about it. I hang out with you to forget about that life.
zh: ~z~好。因为我也不想想这个。我和你出来就是为了忘记那种生活的。

english: ~z~It's the period between trips to the laundromat or calls from my mother or dates with you.
zh: ~z~就是去洗衣店的途中，或者我妈打来的电话，或者和你约会。

english: ~z~I should be forcibly sterilized... imagine a little baby Packie...
zh: ~z~我就应该被强制绝育的...想象一下一个小派奇...

english: ~z~Maybe that is why we get on. We're friends. I like you Kate. I really do.
zh: ~z~可能正是如此我们才处得来。我们是朋友。我喜欢你，凯特，真的喜欢你。

english: ~z~You're scarcely a good judge. No, I'm not ready for a relationship... but...
zh: ~z~你这人当不了好法官。不，我还没准备好开始一段关系...但是...

english: ~z~Now, after everything I have been through, I am not sure that life is so simple.
zh: ~z~现在，经历了那么多后，我就不太确定人生有那么简单了。

english: ~z~It's over. This life of yours. You can change. At least think about it.
zh: ~z~就这样了，你的这种生活。你可以改变的，至少考虑一下吧。

english: ~z~This one thing, it drove me, it gave me motivation in everything I did.
zh: ~z~这一件事，给了我动力，我做任何事都是由它驱使的。

english: ~z~Because I want to be happy - because I want to move away, have a family myself,
zh: ~z~因为我想开心点，因为我想搬出去，自己组建一个家庭，

english: ~z~He's a psychotic cocaine addict, sure, but he's actually quite sentimental and longs for normality.
zh: ~z~他的确是个精神病瘾君子，但他也多愁善感，渴望变得正常。

english: ~z~I can tell you stupid things, because I know you're as mad as me. I like being your friend.
zh: ~z~可以跟你讲各种蠢事，因为我知道你和我一样疯。我喜欢做你的朋友。

english: ~z~I want to be able to make the right decision and it be my own decision to make.
zh: ~z~我想成为能够做出正确决定、为自己做决定的人。

english: ~z~If you liked me, you'd give this up. Give up this life, for me, I mean.
zh: ~z~要是你喜欢我，你就该放弃现状了，放弃这种生活，为了我放弃。

english: ~z~I don't know. I think life can be simple if you let it be. I think that life can have meaning.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我觉得只要你想，生活就可以很简单。我觉得生活可以有意义。

english: ~z~Sometimes I do not call my life survival, it is somewhere below that, but yeah. I take your point.
zh: ~z~有时候我不管我的生活叫生存，应该连生存都谈不上。~n~不过确实，我同意你的观点。

english: ~z~I want to be productive, I want to help people, I think that if I went back to school and became a teacher...
zh: ~z~我想做个有益的人，我想帮助别人，我在想要是我回到学校成了老师...

english: ~z~It isn't a difficult question if you don't care about the answer. What kind of a man do I want to be?
zh: ~z~如果你不在乎答案的话是不难。我想做怎样的人？

english: ~z~I don't know about you, but I have my fair share of physical scars.
zh: ~z~我不清楚你的情况，但我的身体创伤已经够多了。

english: ~z~My pleasure. You know what, Niko, I really... I really...
zh: ~z~没关系。你猜怎么着，尼克，我真的...我真的...

english: ~z~No you don't. You don't like anything. You tolerate me, like you tolerate life.
zh: ~z~不，你不喜欢。你什么都不喜欢。你在忍受我，就像忍受你的生活一样。

english: ~z~This is a good thing to do, you will help people. You should go back to school and become a teacher.
zh: ~z~这是好事，你会帮到别人的。你是该回到学校当老师。

english: ~z~No. Not really. I was trying to be more optimistic. My shrink tells me I need to be more optimistic
zh: ~z~不，不算太好。只是想更乐观点，医生让我想得开一点，

english: ~z~He just thinks that he'll find it by doing 5 hits of X a day, and smoking crack at weekends after a spot of bank robbing.
zh: ~z~只是他觉得一天嗑五次摇头丸、周末抢完银行吸可卡因就能变得正常。

english: ~z~I'm not ready - I'm scared of all of that - you care about people, they die. I'm pretty messed up.
zh: ~z~我还没准备好。我很害怕那个，你关心谁，谁就死了。我真的是一团乱麻。

english: ~z~Whether this will satisfy you though... that is another matter.
zh: ~z~至于这么做能不能满足你...那就是另一回事了。

english: ~z~The point of life. I just get the feeling sometimes that life is waiting between points.
zh: ~z~生活的目的。我有一种感觉，有时候生活处在两个目的地之间。

english: ~z~Oh, shut up, I don't mean that. I like you. I really like you. You know I do.
zh: ~z~噢，闭嘴，我不是那个意思。我喜欢你，真的很喜欢你。你知道我喜欢的。

english: ~z~We want things because we think they will make us whole.
zh: ~z~我们想要某些东西，是因为我们觉得它能满足我们。

english: ~z~Genuinely awful, but at least you're not a fucking hypocrite. That can't be said of many people.
zh: ~z~真诚得不行，但你至少不是个狗屁伪君子。能被这样评价的人也不多。

english: ~z~Okay, we're both survivors then. Maybe that's why we like each other.
zh: ~z~好吧，那我们就都是幸存者了。也许就是因此才会喜欢对方。

english: ~z~So you could do this until you've killed everyone? Or until you die? Your life must be hell.
zh: ~z~所以你要等到杀光所有人才肯收手是吧？还是要等到你死了？你的生活肯定是地狱。

english: ~z~Bad stuff has happened to people around us, to people we care about, to us even, but we have pulled through.
zh: ~z~坏事都在我们身边的人身上发生过，在我们关心的人身上，甚至在我们自己身上，但我们都挺过来了。

english: ~z~I don't know, maybe the fact that we both understand that the world is a fucked up place.
zh: ~z~我不知道，也许是因为我们都明白这个世界是个狗屁地方。

english: ~z~I care about the lives of people I care about... my family, my friends... yes!
zh: ~z~我关心我关心的人的生活...我的家人，我的朋友...对！

english: ~z~I don't know - because my whole family does, and they're such a bunch of winners!
zh: ~z~我不知道。因为我全家都喝，他们还都是一群人生赢家！

english: ~z~They haven't invented a tranquilizer strong enough, but if she combines them with whiskey, she can get to sleep.
zh: ~z~现在的镇静剂药效都不够强，但只要混上一点威士忌，她就能睡着了。

english: ~z~My dad - he did awful things to my brothers, I loved him, but I knew.
zh: ~z~我爸，他对我的哥哥做了很多糟糕的事情。我爱他，但我知道。

english: ~z~Yes, fuck you, you creep. You fucking lunatic creep. Fuck you.
zh: ~z~对，操你妈，你这变态。你这狗屁疯子死变态。操你妈。

english: ~z~You're a loser. You're a fucking loser. Fuck you. What is wrong with you, you cold hearted creep?
zh: ~z~你就是个失败者。你丫就是个失败者。操你妈。你什么毛病，你这冷血变态？

english: ~z~Do us a favor? Try not to freak out like you seem to when you get drunk.
zh: ~z~替我考虑下吧？喝醉以后能不能别和之前一样发酒疯了。

english: ~z~You already knew that, maybe... I hate myself and I want to die!
zh: ~z~你已经知道了，大概...我讨厌我自己，我想死！

english: ~z~Why would I worry? What in God's name have I got to worry about?
zh: ~z~我为什么要担心？看在上帝份上我有什么要担心的？

english: ~z~You poor baby, let me give the judge a call and see if we can sort this out. See you soon.
zh: ~z~真可怜啊，我给法官打个电话，看看他能不能帮个忙。再见。

english: ~z~Fine Niko. Just wanted to let you know, I cancelled other plans for you. Just wanted you to know.
zh: ~z~好吧尼克。我就跟你说一声，我为你推掉了其他事。就这么说一声。

english: ~z~You're seeing things, Kiki. Take some pills, have a hot bath and chill out...
zh: ~z~你想多了吧，琪琪。吃点药，再洗个热水澡冷静一下...

english: ~z~Sorry, I'm heading into Alderney to see my parents. Speak soon?
zh: ~z~不好意思，我要去奥尔德尼看我父母了。以后再聊吧？

english: ~z~I guess you had time to stop fucking your other girls and pick up the phone huh, Niko? God I've got low self esteem.
zh: ~z~你终于能从别的女人身上下来接我电话了，尼克？老天，我真不要脸。

english: ~z~Niko, I can't see you again right away. If we're going to turn this into something serious we have to behave ourselves.
zh: ~z~尼克，我们才刚约过会。真正的感情还是要细水长流。

english: ~z~What we have is sacred, Niko. Do you know what happens to those who piss on something sacred?
zh: ~z~我们的爱情是神圣的，尼克。你知道亵渎神圣之物的人有什么下场吗？

english: ~z~Just when I'm starting to get over you, you call again. This hurts me so much. But...
zh: ~z~每当我快要忘掉你时，你又打来电话。这真的很伤我，但...

english: ~z~Niko, I know you like me but we have to take this slow. We should wait a bit before we go on another date.
zh: ~z~尼克，我知道你喜欢我，但也别操之过急。给彼此多留一点时间吧。

english: ~z~Hey baby, there are some cops after me. I think they're just looking for another immigrant to pick on.
zh: ~z~嘿，宝贝，有几个条子在追我。我想他们只是又想找移民的麻烦。

english: ~z~Oh, you're back in my life. Picking me up and dropping me like a cheap toy. I guess I don't have much of a choice do I?
zh: ~z~噢，你终于想起我了。我就像个廉价玩具，你想玩就玩，想丢就丢。不过我也没什么办法，不是吗？

english: ~z~Kiki, it's crazy but these cops just started to harass me. Can you see what you can do?
zh: ~z~琪琪，真是疯了，这些条子开始骚扰我了。你能帮帮我吗？

english: ~z~I knew you were serious about me, Niko. This is going to be amazing. Pick me up in the next hour.
zh: ~z~我就知道你对我是认真的，尼克。这真是太让我开心了。一个小时内来接我吧。

english: ~z~Niko, if I didn't know better I'd think you were falling for me. We shouldn't see one another again so soon.
zh: ~z~尼克，我不会单纯到认为你已经倾心于我了。我们不应该约得这么频繁的。

english: ~z~I was starting to think you were done with me. I couldn't bear it if you were.
zh: ~z~我差点以为我们已经结束了。真那样我可受不了。

english: ~z~You're clearly not as serious about this as I am, Niko. I wouldn't have abandoned you in this situation.
zh: ~z~你对这段感情明显没我认真，尼克。换我就不会在这种时候抛弃你。

english: ~z~So you expect me to help you when you're out with your cheap whores instead of me? Sorry, Niko. Maybe prison will help you be faithful.
zh: ~z~怀里抱着个臭贱人还想着让我帮忙？抱歉，尼克。你还是去监狱改过自新吧。

english: ~z~I've been thinking about you all day, Niko. Pick me up in the next hour.
zh: ~z~我一整天都在想你，尼克。一个小时内来接我吧。

english: ~z~Niko, they're really out to get you. I'm sure they're persecuting you, but I can't do anything. Stay safe.
zh: ~z~尼克，他们这次是认真的。我知道他们想迫害你，但我无能为力。祝你平安。

english: ~z~I thought I meant something to you, Niko. I thought we had something special.
zh: ~z~我还以为我对你很重要，尼克。我还以为我们之间有感情。

english: ~z~I just wanted to hear your voice. That was all. Call me soon, Niko.
zh: ~z~我只是想听听你的声音，就是这样。有空记得找我，尼克。

english: ~z~I'm being let out of the hospital, Niko. It'd be really sweet if you picked me up.
zh: ~z~我现在可以出院了，尼克，如果你能来接我就再好不过了。

english: ~z~You really want to make this work, do you? Okay then. Pick me up in the next hour.
zh: ~z~你是真的想再续前缘吧？那好吧，一小时内来接我。

english: ~z~I'd like to take you out, Kiki. I'll stop by your place in the next hour.
zh: ~z~我很乐意带你出来玩，琪琪。我一个小时内到你那儿去。

english: ~z~Don't leave me. Don't you ever leave me. Never, never, never.
zh: ~z~不要离开我。永远不要离开我。永远，永远，永远。

english: ~z~This is disgraceful Niko. I'm going to call the D.A. right away.
zh: ~z~真是太无耻了，尼克，我这就给地方检察官打电话。

english: ~z~From what I've heard those cops really mean business, Niko. I can't do anything. Good luck. Call me later, yeah?
zh: ~z~听说那些条子来真的了，尼克。我无能为力，祝你好运。记得打给我，好吗？

english: ~z~Kiki, sorry about this but I can't see you anymore. To be honest, you kind of freak me out.
zh: ~z~琪琪，我很抱歉，但我不能再见你了。说实话，你有点吓到我了。

english: ~z~Dammit, Niko. You don't have to rub my face in it. I hate you for how you make me feel.
zh: ~z~靠，尼克。你不用来恶心我。我讨厌被你践踏自尊。

english: ~z~Sorry, Kiki. I didn't see the time. I'll speak to you later.
zh: ~z~对不起，琪琪，我没看到时间，待会儿再和你说。

english: ~z~Dammit, Niko. You don't have to rub my face in it. I hate you for how you make me feel.
zh: ~z~靠，尼克。你不用来恶心我。我讨厌被你践踏自尊。

english: ~z~You're testing me. This is a test to see if I'll come back to you, isn't it? I'm not going anywhere, Niko.
zh: ~z~你在考验我，你在考验我会不会回到你身边，是吧？我哪儿都不去，尼克。

english: ~z~So, I didn't realize you liked sluts. That's what she is, a slut, right? Do you want me to turn into a slutty whore for you?

zh: ~z~好吧，琪琪。这对我来说真的很难，但是我想说我们的关系结束了，保重。

zh: ~z~别担心，尼克。我会赶走他们的，甚至还能拿掉他们的警徽。有空约我，好吗？

zh: ~z~我被恶心到了，尼克。既然你宁愿去上哪个贱女人也不来接我，那好。

english: ~z~Kiki, I don't like to do this but something's come up. I can't go on a date with you.
zh: ~z~琪琪，我也不想这样，但我突然有点急事，不能约你出来了。

zh: ~z~嘿，尼克。我知道你日子不好过，还会被当局骚扰。

zh: ~z~尼克，你在搞什么？之前不给我打电话让我崩溃，现在又想起我了？

zh: ~z~你要是觉得有警察无缘无故就盯上你了，给我打个电话。

zh: ~z~那些条子不配佩戴警徽。我去跟地方检察官聊聊。爱你，尼克。

zh: ~z~如果我只需要考虑你该有多好，但我必须让委托人远离牢狱之灾。再说吧？

zh: ~z~我在地检那边还是有点影响的，我会尽量让他们规矩点的。

english: ~z~I don't know if I believe you, call me later if you're serious about this.
zh: ~z~我现在很难相信你，晚点再打过来，向我证明你是认真的。

zh: ~z~多谢，琪琪。总有条子无缘无故刁难我。有空再聊啊。

english: ~z~So you call me only when you need something? I'm not going to help you, Niko. I hope this makes you learn to treat me right.
zh: ~z~你把我当工具人是吧？我不会帮你的，尼克。希望能让你学会该如何对我。

english: ~z~Ahh, Niko. Have you been playing hard to get? I haven't got time for bullshit, if that's your game.
zh: ~z~啊...尼克。你一直都是欲擒故纵吗？本小姐没那闲工夫陪你。

english: ~z~Do you know how cheap your calling me like this makes me feel? And I can't resist you.
zh: ~z~你知道这样对我会有多伤自尊吗？但我无法拒绝你。

english: ~z~If you want new shoes, Niko. I can buy them. Don't spend your own money.
zh: ~z~如果你想换新鞋，尼克，我帮你买，别花你自己的钱。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. I didn't realize it was going to take this long. I don't think I've got time for this. Can you take me home?
zh: ~z~对不起，尼克，没想到这次约会会这么久，我想我不能多陪了。你能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Niko. My schedule is pretty tight at the moment. I can't really wait around for you. Let's go.
zh: ~z~尼克，我的安排真的很紧，真的等不了太久的，赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~You don't need to take me to a place like this, Niko. Your company is more precious to me than an expensive meal.
zh: ~z~没必要带我来这种地方的，尼克。你的陪伴比山珍海味更加珍贵。

english: ~z~Do you come to this club to pick up your cheap whores? Fine then, pretend I'm a whore.
zh: ~z~你来这儿找你的贱人婊子了？那好吧，你当我就是吧。

english: ~z~Okay, if you're going to be like this, Niko. I'll make my own way home. Call me.
zh: ~z~好吧，你一定要坚持的话，尼克，我就自己回去了。有空找我。

english: ~z~Hey, are you LawChick? We met online, I'm Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~嘿，你是律师小妹吗？我们网上认识的，我是尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~The ball's in your court, Niko. I'm happy to do whatever you enjoy. It's such a treat for me to be out and about.
zh: ~z~决定权在你，尼克。只要你喜欢我就高兴了。对我来说，出去走走就很快乐。

english: ~z~What's different about you? Oh... yeah, you're not wearing the glasses. Pity.
zh: ~z~你人好像不太一样？哦...对，你没戴着那副眼镜，真可惜。

english: ~z~Please tell me you didn't waste your hard earned money on a new top on my account.
zh: ~z~希望你不是为了我才会花血汗钱买这件新上衣的。

english: ~z~Okay, why don't we play pool? My ex, Tyrone was falsely accused of beating this guy to death with a pool cue.
zh: ~z~好吧，为什么不打台球呢？我前任，泰隆曾经被诬告用台球杆打死了人。

english: ~z~Oh God, I can't think. I'm just happy to be out of the office. It's such hard work at City Hall.
zh: ~z~天哪，我想不出。能出办公室我就很开心了，在市政厅工作真是太辛苦了。

english: ~z~I liked the old hat, Niko. It reminded me of the good times we've had together.
zh: ~z~我挺喜欢老的那顶帽子的，尼克。能让我想起我们共度的欢乐时光。

english: ~z~I'm not sure really. I don't get that much time off work so I'm just happy to be out.
zh: ~z~我不太确定。我没有那么多的休息时间，只要能出来转转我就很开心了。

english: ~z~All sorts of stuff, Niko. Whatever you want to do. I'm sure I'll enjoy it.
zh: ~z~什么都喜欢，尼克。只要是你喜欢的，我就可以喜欢。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. I really do need to get back home. Give me a call, okay?
zh: ~z~对不起，尼克，我真的要回家了。有时间再找我吧，好吗？

english: ~z~I can't just play darts with you the whole time. Are you ashamed to take me anywhere else?
zh: ~z~我也不能老是和你玩飞镖吧，带我去其他地方不行吗？

english: ~z~Oh, bowling is it? This is becoming our regular thing. We could have our wedding at a bowling alley.
zh: ~z~哦，又是保龄球？这都快成我们的标配了。干脆直接在保龄球馆办婚礼算了。

english: ~z~The glasses make you look shifty, Niko. You aren't hiding anything from me, are you?
zh: ~z~这副眼镜显得你靠不住，尼克。你没瞒我什么吧？

english: ~z~I like the fact that you don't need to wear expensive clothes to be cool, Niko.
zh: ~z~你不穿昂贵的衣服也可以很帅，我喜欢这一点，尼克。

english: ~z~Tremaine used to take me to places like this, they're so quick and easy.
zh: ~z~特雷梅因以前常带我来这样的地方，又快又方便。

english: ~z~Isn't it cool that we're comfortable enough with one another to not have to dress up?
zh: ~z~我们不用刻意去打扮也可以相处得很舒服，真是太好啦。

english: ~z~It's hard for me to concentrate on eating when I'm with you, Niko.
zh: ~z~和你在一起的时候，我的注意力都不在吃的上面，尼克。

english: ~z~Umm, Niko. Why're you late? You haven't been seeing anyone else have you? Let's go.
zh: ~z~嗯，尼克，你怎么迟到了？你该不会还有别的女人吧？走吧。

english: ~z~This car just oozes sex, Niko. Maybe that's because you own it.
zh: ~z~这车散发着性感的气息，尼克。也许是因为这是你的车。

english: ~z~I hope you're not trying to impress one of your other whores with this new car. It doesn't impress me.
zh: ~z~希望你的新车不是为了你的哪个婊子买的。反正我不喜欢。

english: ~z~Hey. I don't want to sound like a whining girlfriend or anything but please don't make me wait for you. Let's go on our date.
zh: ~z~嘿。我不想像老妈子一样啰嗦，但是求你下次别迟到了。赶快出发吧。

english: ~z~I'd really like to experience your culture with you, Niko. Let's go.
zh: ~z~我很乐意体验你们那边的文化，尼克，我们走吧。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. I'm really into bowling. That's only if you are though...
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。我很乐意打保龄球，只要你高兴的话...

english: ~z~Oh, darts again. Not what I'd normally do but if you're into it...
zh: ~z~噢，又是飞镖。我其实不怎么喜欢，不过既然你喜欢...

english: ~z~Ok, Niko, I'm a busy woman, I haven't got time to be screwing around like this. Can you take me home?
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克，我是个很忙的女人，没时间陪你乱转。送我回家好吗？

english: ~z~What a good idea, Niko. I sometimes get emotional when I drink so stop me from having too much.
zh: ~z~真是个好地方，尼克。喝多了的话我可能会有些情绪化，所以别让我喝太多。

english: ~z~Katt Williams really tells it like it is. I'm so pleased you brought me here, Niko.
zh: ~z~Katt Williams说得挺好的。很高兴你能带我来这儿，尼克。

english: ~z~Thanks for getting rid of that hat, Niko. You really do care about what I think.
zh: ~z~谢谢你为了我放弃那顶帽子，尼克，你真的在乎我的感受。

english: ~z~Sorry Niko, but I don't like your car. Does that make me a bad person?
zh: ~z~对不起，尼克，但是我真的不喜欢你的车。说这话会让我像个坏人吗？

english: ~z~It's so sweet of you to get rid of that hat. You knew I didn't like it.
zh: ~z~你能拿掉那顶帽子我真的高兴，你知道我不喜欢它。

english: ~z~Your language is so beautiful, Niko. It's such a shame you've got to speak English the whole time.
zh: ~z~你的语言真美，尼克。可惜在这儿你只能说英语。

english: ~z~I hear they've got bowling alleys at American Air Force bases overseas. Is that where you learnt how to do it?
zh: ~z~听说美国空军的海外基地里有保龄球馆。你是在那学的吗？

english: ~z~Do you ever get so happy that you feel like crying, Niko? That what I'm feeling right now.
zh: ~z~你有没有喜极而泣的经历，尼克？这就是我现在的感觉。

english: ~z~Shit, add insult to fucking injury, Niko. Sorry, I'm not one of your cheap whores, okay?
zh: ~z~靠，真他妈是伤口上撒盐，尼克。对不起啊，我不是你的那些贱婊子，懂？

english: ~z~I really didn't think there was any way I wouldn't enjoy being taken out. But this wasn't fun. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我一直觉得出去玩肯定很有意思，但这次真的好无聊。再见。

english: ~z~Were you ashamed to be bowling with me, Niko? That's why you stopped, wasn't it?
zh: ~z~和我打保龄球让你感到羞耻吗，尼克？这就是你不打的理由，是吗？

english: ~z~Niko, are you trying to fatten me up? I like this place but I can't eat here again.
zh: ~z~尼克，你是想把我喂肥吗？我喜欢这家店，但也不能回回来这儿啊。

english: ~z~Niko, I wish this date could go on forever, but it's got to end, doesn't it?
zh: ~z~尼克，我也想这场约会能一直持续下去，但天下没有不散的筵席。

english: ~z~Can't you even finish bowling with me? Are you that keen to get off with some other whore?
zh: ~z~你连陪我打完一场都不肯？这么着急去和你的哪个婊子上床啊？

english: ~z~You really didn't have to spend that money, Niko. I'm not impressed by conspicuous consumption.
zh: ~z~你真的不用花那钱，尼克。我不喜欢花钱买虚荣。

english: ~z~Niko, if you've got a problem with a dominant female who can beat you at pool, then maybe you're dating the wrong girl.
zh: ~z~尼克，如果你不喜欢能在台球上赢过你的女强人，那你可能约错妹子了。

zh: ~z~对，把你从那些婊子身上得到的性病都传染给我。真可耻啊，尼克。

english: ~z~That was really nice, Niko. I feel like I'm really getting to know you.
zh: ~z~你人还挺不错的，尼克。我觉得我有点了解你了。

english: ~z~Niko, I can't eat here now. There are too many painful memories of Tremaine.
zh: ~z~尼克，在这我吃不下饭。在这我就想起了特雷梅因，痛苦的回忆。

english: ~z~I really felt like we got close on this date. It can't go on forever though.
zh: ~z~感觉我们这次真的亲近了不少，但约会总是要结束的。

english: ~z~That was so nice, Niko. I don't care what they say about health risks, that stuff tastes good.
zh: ~z~真的很不错，尼克。不管他们说这东西对健康多有害，我就是觉得真香。

english: ~z~I feel like you're stalling, Niko. Why is taking so long to get there?
zh: ~z~我感觉你磨磨蹭蹭的，尼克。为什么这么久才到？

english: ~z~What's the chances of finishing on a tie? I guess we're perfectly matched, aren't we?
zh: ~z~平局结束的概率真的好小，我们大概是命中注定的一对吧，不是吗？

english: ~z~There's nothing I want more than to be both physically and emotionally close to you. Not tonight though.
zh: ~z~我也想在精神和肉体两方面跟你亲近，但不是今晚。

english: ~z~I need it to really mean something when we're together physically. Not tonight, Niko.
zh: ~z~我们在一起的那一晚应该要更有意义。今晚不行，尼克。

english: ~z~This date has been amazing. We're really breaking down barriers. Maybe we should call it a day though.
zh: ~z~这次约会真的太棒了，我们之间的隔阂一定变少了。不过今天就到这吧。

english: ~z~Did you take me out just to humiliate me, Niko? Show me some respect.
zh: ~z~你带我出来就是为了羞辱我吗，尼克？给我点尊重好不好。

zh: ~z~与男人竞争也是我工作的一部分，赢了你不奇怪。

english: ~z~That really taught me a lot about your culture, Niko. Thank you for sharing it with me.
zh: ~z~这场演出让我更好地了解了你的文化，尼克。谢谢你带我来这儿。

english: ~z~Come on, Niko. It can't be that hard to get me home. Why is it taking so long?
zh: ~z~搞错没有，尼克，送我回家很难吗？为什么要这么久？

english: ~z~Well you're being sensible for both of us. Thank you. I'll call you, Kiki.
zh: ~z~你这样对大家都好。谢谢。我会给你打电话的，琪琪。

english: ~z~There's nothing like sharing a moment like this with someone you care about, is there?
zh: ~z~没有什么比和你在乎的人共享这样的时刻更好的了，不是吗？

english: ~z~Can't stand sitting next to me, is that it? I can't believe you couldn't even wait until the end of the show.
zh: ~z~受不了坐我旁边了是吧？没想到你都不能等到演完再走。

english: ~z~This date could keep going inside your place if you invite me in. How about it?
zh: ~z~如果你让我进去，我们还能接着约会。你觉得呢？

english: ~z~That place is full of bankers and lawyers. I'm not interested in guys like that. Don't turn into one of them.
zh: ~z~那家店尽是银行家和律师，我对那种家伙不感兴趣。别变成种人。

english: ~z~So you think I'm cheap like your other whores! Thanks a lot, Niko.
zh: ~z~所以你觉得我和你的其他婊子一样贱！谢谢你啊，尼克。

english: ~z~I had a really good time, Niko. I can't tell you how nice it is to be taken out on a date.
zh: ~z~我玩得很开心，尼克。和你出去约会真是无法形容的好。

english: ~z~My time is really valuable, Niko. Can we do something soon?
zh: ~z~我的时间非常宝贵，尼克。我们能快点做些什么吗？

english: ~z~Well, maybe I'll take you out again, give me your number. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~也许我会再邀你出来，给我你的号码吧。那再见啦。

english: ~z~You really know how to handle those darts, Niko. I wonder what else you're good at?
zh: ~z~你真的好会玩飞镖，尼克。我在想你还擅长些什么呢？

english: ~z~It's been so hard resisting you. I'm so pleased that it's time.
zh: ~z~拒绝你真的很难。我不用再拒绝你真是太开心了。

english: ~z~Do you not think that it is vain to think you can make a difference? To think it is your concern?
zh: ~z~难道你不觉得，认为自己可以发挥作用，认为这是你的责任，是没有意义的吗？

english: ~z~I thought it would be like I imagined. But I'm really lonely. I mean, it's nice to be out with you.
zh: ~z~我以为能过上想象中的生活，但实际上我很孤独。我是说，很高兴能和你出来玩。

english: ~z~The world has rights, just like criminals and murderers and immigrants and all the other disadvantageous do, too.
zh: ~z~地球也有权利，就像罪犯、杀人犯、移民和各种弱势群体一样。

english: ~z~I mean, it's just the arresting officer's word against the perps. "We found this gun on him."
zh: ~z~我是说，光靠办案刑警的证词就定罪了。「嫌犯身上有枪。」

english: ~z~I'm a girl who wants to make it in the big city. You know, I grew up in the suburbs, bored out of my mind...
zh: ~z~我是个想在大城市有所成就的女孩。你看，我在郊区长大，从小就很无聊...

english: ~z~"His clothes were covered in the victim's blood." An innocent man with a felony prior doesn't stand a chance.
zh: ~z~「他的衣服沾满了受害者的血。」曾犯重罪的良民是没有机会的。

english: ~z~The only guys I meet are the other lawyers - complete creeps - and my defendants.
zh: ~z~能见到的只有我讨厌的其他律师，和我的委托人。

english: ~z~There will always be people who suffer, Kiki. That is the way of the world.
zh: ~z~总会有人遭遇不幸的，琪琪。这个世界就是如此。

english: ~z~this is so unlike me, but I'm giving it a go and it seems to be working out.
zh: ~z~这太不像我会做的事了，但我试了一试，似乎也还不错。

english: ~z~Sometimes, when I'm having a fun time - even a fun time with a crazy man like you, I feel so guilty.
zh: ~z~有时候，即便我很开心，我还是会感到内疚，哪怕是跟你这样的好人在一起的时候。

english: ~z~You can try. Most of the people from my law class just went to big firms on the Exchange to make their millions.
zh: ~z~不试试怎么知道。跟我同专业的同学大多去了证券交易所的大公司，年入百万。

english: ~z~Relationships can't rarely last when they get sent out of state to a Federal Penitentiary though.
zh: ~z~不过等他们被送进联邦监狱以后，这段感情就难以维系了。

english: ~z~It's nearly impossible for a man born into poverty in this country to make it without breaking the law.
zh: ~z~在这个国家，穷人家的孩子不犯法是很难成功的。

english: ~z~I wanted to help people. That's why I do pro bono work at City Hall.
zh: ~z~我想帮助别人，所以才会去市政厅做无偿法律援助。

english: ~z~He's got such soul. Being unfairly incarcerated would break most men.
zh: ~z~他有高洁的灵魂。大多数人含冤入狱后都会崩溃，

english: ~z~He's serving life upstate. Can you believe that they revoked his conjugal visit privileges? It's inhuman.
zh: ~z~在北方终身监禁。他的配偶探望权居然还被剥夺了。太没人性了。

english: ~z~Just sometimes I feel like I can't do enough though. I feel like I can't help people as much as I want to be able to.
zh: ~z~不过有时我会觉得自己做得还不够，帮助他人时时常感觉心有余而力不足。

english: ~z~I'm a criminal, and a murderer. I arrived in your country and fell in with a bad crowd. What rights do I have?
zh: ~z~我是一个罪犯，还是杀人犯。我来到你们国家，和不法分子厮混。我能有什么权利？

english: ~z~I don't pretend that I wouldn't be selling my ass for crack if I was born in project housing though.
zh: ~z~要是我出生在公屋社区，多半也会为了毒品出卖肉体。

english: ~z~It was a conspiracy. The government doesn't like free thinkers and autodidacts.
zh: ~z~这是个阴谋。政府不喜欢思想自由的人和无师自通的人。

english: ~z~As I see it, I have chosen to live life outside the law. Rights mean nothing to me now.
zh: ~z~在我看来，既然选择了当法外之徒，权利就对我毫无意义了。

english: ~z~Yeah, I guess I do make a difference. I feel like all my life I've been given things by my parents.
zh: ~z~是啊，我大概确实有所改变。感觉我这辈子一直在接受父母的给予。

english: ~z~Oh... ummm... nothing. Have you got any ex-boyfriends I should worry about?
zh: ~z~噢...呃...没什么。我需要担心你的哪个前男友吗？

english: ~z~Mom and Dad made me promise not to date any more of them so here I am, dating on the internet.
zh: ~z~爸妈让我保证不再跟这些人约会，所以我现在搞网恋。

english: ~z~I'm so sorry! Our society let you down! My country failed you!
zh: ~z~真对不起！我们的社会让你失望了！我的国家辜负了你！

english: ~z~But, well... it was nice. It's strange. You always want something to be like it is in the movies, don't you?
zh: ~z~但是，嗯...普通就好。很奇怪，你会不会期待生活偶尔像电影情节一样发展？

english: ~z~So, Niko, are there any skeletons in your closet? Is anyone haunting you?
zh: ~z~那，尼克，你有什么不可告人的秘密吗？有人缠着你吗？

english: ~z~But it was obviously self defense. A mother clearly attacked him, and he shot her, and her kids.
zh: ~z~但明明是正当防卫。那个母亲攻击了他，他掏枪反击，还打中了两个孩子。

english: ~z~It's not bad luck Niko. It's the system. It's totally fucked. Totally.
zh: ~z~这不是倒霉，尼克，是体制问题。体制烂了，完全烂了。

english: ~z~And now I'm here, trying to make a difference. I'm not naïve... but...
zh: ~z~现在我进城了，想要有所改变。不是我太幼稚...但...

english: ~z~Cars, clothes, my apartment, my education. I help the people who haven't been given anything.
zh: ~z~车子，衣服，我的公寓，我的教育。现在我帮助那些无法得到给予的人。

english: ~z~I mean, are there any ex-girlfriends who are still hung up on you? What did you think I meant?
zh: ~z~我是说，有没有哪个前女友现在还对你死缠烂打？你以为我是什么意思？

english: ~z~It might be because I feel guilty but is that a bad thing? Am I doing it for the wrong reasons?
zh: ~z~可能是出于内疚，但这有关系吗？难道我的动机就错了吗？

english: ~z~I could just tell... I mean, not that I read too much into it. This is just a casual date, you know. Casual.
zh: ~z~就是能看出来嘛...也不是说我过度解读了。反正这次就是个普通约会而已。普通约会。

english: ~z~Client / ex, ex / client, lover, friend, spiritual guru.
zh: ~z~委托人兼前任，前任兼委托人，爱人，朋友，精神导师。

english: ~z~Yeah, only Tremaine was completely innocent. There's no way he killed those guys.
zh: ~z~是啊，但特雷梅因是完全无辜的。他不可能杀那些人。

english: ~z~It's just that I'm working these cases the whole time and I can't get out to meet new people.
zh: ~z~只是因为我每天忙着打官司，没空出去交新朋友。

english: ~z~You two have so much in common, I mean more than just me. You're both such peace loving men.
zh: ~z~你们两个有很多共同点，不只是都和我处得好。你们都是爱好和平的人。

english: ~z~But the police will arrest any man in the vicinity of a crime in order to clear a file from their desks.
zh: ~z~但那些警察为了尽快结案，只会在案发现场附近随便抓一个人。

english: ~z~It was stupid. It just goes to show how the system is primed to punish people who already disadvantaged.
zh: ~z~说来可笑，他的经历只会证明，现有体制旨在惩罚弱势群体。

english: ~z~When you have seen what I have seen, you realize that most leaders are after the same thing.
zh: ~z~如果你经历过我的遭遇，你就会发现大多数领导者都只有一个动机。

english: ~z~Not really. In my line of work, honesty is not always the best quality.
zh: ~z~不太诚实。干我这行，诚实不算是最重要的品质。

english: ~z~They're out for themselves, no matter what party they are a member of or what they claim to believe in.
zh: ~z~全都是为了自己。无论他们属于哪个党派，无论他们信仰什么。

english: ~z~You know, the French have it right. Crimes of passions are not real crimes.
zh: ~z~知道吗，法国人说得对，激情犯罪不是真正的犯罪。

english: ~z~Sometimes, late at night, I imagine us as two souls meeting on a beach...
zh: ~z~有时，深夜时分，我会把我们想象成两个在沙滩相遇的灵魂...

english: ~z~They are an essential part of the human psyche. And I say that as a committed liberal.
zh: ~z~它是人类心理的重要组成部分，这句话是我作为一个坚定的自由主义者说的。

english: ~z~We have a special understanding, haven't we? This is so real.
zh: ~z~我们之间有特别的理解，不是吗？这感觉很真实。

english: ~z~Are you the casual encounter kind of guy, is that it? The use them and lose them guy? Fuck 'em and sling them?
zh: ~z~你只是想搞一夜情，对不对？对女人用完就扔？提上裤子不认人？

english: ~z~By not making a proper commitment to me, by not telling me you love me. By not being there for me.
zh: ~z~因为你没有向我好好承诺，没有告诉我你爱我，没有在我身边陪伴我。

english: ~z~I mean, I'm not looking for a commitment. But where is it going?
zh: ~z~那个，我也不是想直接订婚，但这段感情到底怎么办？

english: ~z~I like saying your name, Niko. You're amazing. This is just so so nice, isn't it?
zh: ~z~我喜欢念你的名字，尼克。你很出众。这样实在是太棒了，不是吗？

english: ~z~I don't need a commitment right now, I just need to know it's not impossible. Is it impossible?
zh: ~z~我没让你现在就跟我订婚，我只是不想听到你否定这种可能。有这种可能吗？

english: ~z~This nation was built upon a belief in the family unit and the strength of the nuclear family.
zh: ~z~这个国家的基石是对家庭成员的信任和原生家庭的力量。

english: ~z~Well, you better not cheat, because if a man cheats on a woman, he is cheating on life.
zh: ~z~好吧，你最好不要骗人，因为欺骗女人感情的男人，平时一定在自欺欺人。

english: ~z~I don't know. We have a nice time, usually. When you're not feeling too guilty.
zh: ~z~我不知道。只要你没感到内疚，一般大家都能高兴。

english: ~z~Yeah, but if you had to choose - liberal or conservative?
zh: ~z~确实，硬要选的话，你会选自由主义还是保守主义？

english: ~z~Don't you find that when you're getting close to someone you just want to be with them the whole time?
zh: ~z~你不觉得当你和某人关系越来越好时，就会想一直和他在一起吗？

english: ~z~There's something special going on here. Can't you feel it? When you're inside me, Niko.
zh: ~z~我的身上有种奇妙的变化，你没感觉到吗？你我结合的时候，尼克，

english: ~z~No, this was my professor at law school. He had the gall to accuse me of stalking him.
zh: ~z~不，这个是我法学院的教授。他竟厚颜无耻地指控我跟踪他。

english: ~z~I guess I'm a liberal. I mean I believe in the welfare state and the green energy movement.
zh: ~z~我想我是个自由主义者。因为我相信福利国家和绿色能源行动。

english: ~z~I don't know. These days, I think I'm just a whore, running around working for the highest bidder.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我觉得自己最近像个妓女，四处奔波，价高者得。

english: ~z~But it's not perfect, you know. I'm conservative when it comes to family.
zh: ~z~但自由主义也不完美，懂吧。我在家庭观念上比较保守。

english: ~z~Nice? I'm talking about love, about passion, about the important stuff, not nice!
zh: ~z~享受？我在说的是爱情，是激情，是人生大事，严肃点！

english: ~z~No, you didn't. Sorry if I don't want to kick back a bit when I'm not at work.
zh: ~z~对，你没有。恕我在工作时间之外也不想太放松。

english: ~z~What are you talking about Kiki? I wasn't the one who suggested those tequila slammers.
zh: ~z~你在说什么啊，琪琪？又不是我提议喝龙舌兰酒的。

english: ~z~You don't need a real woman. You can't handle a real woman. You hate me.
zh: ~z~你不需要真正的女人。你应付不了真正的女人。你讨厌我。

english: ~z~What are their names? What are their fucking names, Niko? I'll find those bitches.
zh: ~z~她们叫什么？她们他妈叫什么，尼克？我会查到那些婊子的。

english: ~z~Oh, oh, are you going to run off to your other whore because I've gone a bit weird?
zh: ~z~哦，哦，就因为我有点神经质，你就要去找你的哪个妓女吗？

english: ~z~I'll find them. I'll find those filthy whores. You're mine. You're all mine.
zh: ~z~我会找到她们的。我会找到那些肮脏的妓女。你是我的，你的一切都属于我。

english: ~z~That would be the shot you just downed. Let me know if you're going to throw up.
zh: ~z~肯定是最后一杯酒的效果。你想吐了就知会我一声。

english: ~z~You'd just love to leave me spewing on the side of the road so you could go back to one of your other whores.
zh: ~z~你就是想把我扔在路边呕吐，这样你就可以去找你的其他妓女了。

english: ~z~So, you don't deny it? You have other whores out there. I feel so dirty. I feel used.
zh: ~z~好，你不否认是吧？你确实有别的妓女。我被玷污了，我被耍了。

english: ~z~Fuck you. Fuck you asshole. Run off to your whores, run off to your sluts.
zh: ~z~操你妈，操你妈，傻逼。去找你的妓女，去找你的荡妇。

english: ~z~You take your other whores there do you? The place you get them drunk before you have your way with them?
zh: ~z~你经常带那些贱人来这儿吧？先把她们灌醉，然后为所欲为？

english: ~z~I don't think so Niko. I'm still really mad at you because of what you did... another time, maybe.
zh: ~z~算了吧，尼克。你之前的作为还是很让我生气...还是改天再说吧。

english: ~z~Oh? Really? I wanted to see you. Well, maybe some other time, then. Bye.
zh: ~z~哦？是吗？我还想见你呢。好吧，那就改天吧。再见。

english: ~z~Great! I love rejection - I really love it. You know you might just lose me, Niko.
zh: ~z~太棒了！我喜欢被拒绝，真的喜欢。你有可能会失去我的，尼克。

english: ~z~I think you're a great guy, but I don't want to hang out again so soon. Another time.
zh: ~z~你的品性很好，但我不想这么快又出去。下次吧。

english: ~z~You never want to hang out. Do you think I've got herpes or something?
zh: ~z~你一直不找我出去。你是觉得我有疱疹还是什么？

english: ~z~Niko it's me, Michelle - can you pick me up from the hospital, please? They're letting me go.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，米歇尔。你能来医院接我吗？我出院了。

english: ~z~After what you did? No way. I'm still mad at you, call back another time. Maybe I'll have calmed down.
zh: ~z~就你上次的表现？没门。我还在生你的气，下次再打过来吧。也许我就消气了。

english: ~z~Oh, it's you? Well, I'm going to give you another chance, since you called back... pick me up in an hour.
zh: ~z~噢，是你啊？既然你打回来了，我再给你一次机会...一小时内来接我。

english: ~z~No - we hung out only recently - I'm not that easy, Niko. Maybe later.
zh: ~z~不了，我们最近才出去过。我没那么轻浮，尼克。过几天吧。

english: ~z~Okay then - I'm willing to give you another chance - since you called back - pick me up in an hour.
zh: ~z~好吧，既然你打回来了，我再给你一次机会，一小时内来接我。

english: ~z~Niko - it's me, Michelle - why haven't you called me? Don't be cold and weird with me. Come on.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，米歇尔。你为什么不给我打电话？别对我冷若冰霜，拜托了。

english: ~z~Yes. I'm not up to much, I'd like to see you. I'll be over in an hour.
zh: ~z~是的。我不太忙，很乐意来见你。我一小时内能到。

english: ~z~Oh you still have my number. I haven't heard from you in the longest time.
zh: ~z~噢，你还有我的号码。我很长时间没接到你的电话了。

english: ~z~Michelle, listen, you're going to have to forgive me. Something has come up. I'm going to have to check the rain as they say.
zh: ~z~米歇尔，听着，请你原谅我。突然有急事，我们的约会只能延期了。

english: ~z~Hey, Michelle, it's Niko. Niko Bellic - listen, it's annoying, but I'm going to have to cancel our date.
zh: ~z~嘿，米歇尔，我是尼克，尼克･贝利克。听着，不好意思，我们的约会不得不取消了。

english: ~z~Well, thanks for nothing - you know what? You might just lose me as a friend, Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~好吧，谢谢您哪。你知道吗？你可能会失去我这个朋友，尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~I'd love to help, but I'm in the middle of something - make your own way home.
zh: ~z~我很想帮忙，但我现在正忙着呢。你自己回家吧。

english: ~z~Niko - it's me - Michelle - you remember me? The idiot you haven't called for ages? Anyway, I miss you.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，米歇尔。你还记得我吗？你多年没联系的那个白痴。总之，我好想你。

english: ~z~Hi. You've reached Michelle's phone. Unfortunately, I can't get to the phone just now, but please call back later.
zh: ~z~嗨，这里是米歇尔。很抱歉，我现在不能接电话，请稍后再打来。

english: ~z~Why are you late? Don't tell me... something came up. Let's go.
zh: ~z~为什么你迟到了？别告诉我是出了什么事...出发吧。

english: ~z~Do you know that some criminals meet at bowling alleys because the ambient sound drowns out bugs?
zh: ~z~你知道吗？有些罪犯会在保龄球馆碰头，因为周围的声音能盖过窃听器。

english: ~z~Niko, no offense, but this is really boring - can you take me home?
zh: ~z~尼克，无意冒犯，但这太无聊了，你能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~They have watches in your country? I'm sorry. I'm just crabby. Let's go.
zh: ~z~你们国家有手表吗？很抱歉。我只是有点生气。走吧。

english: ~z~Okay, next time you buy glasses, you should take a girl with you to check they look okay.
zh: ~z~好吧，下次买眼镜的时候，记得带个女孩给你参考意见。

english: ~z~I think you look good in that outfit - I liked it last time.
zh: ~z~我觉得你穿这套衣服很好看，上次我就这么想了。

english: ~z~What's this? This isn't what we said. I don't want to do this just now.
zh: ~z~这是什么？我们说好的不是这样。我现在不想来这里。

english: ~z~Cabaret - I wonder what's on? The crowd always scares me at this place.
zh: ~z~卡巴莱，不知道里面演的什么。这里的顾客让我有点害怕。

english: ~z~Niko are you aware of the consequences of that kind of thing? People get hurt, end up in court, you know.
zh: ~z~尼克，你知道这种事的后果吗？会有人受伤，最后会上法庭的。

english: ~z~Sure, I like you, but let's be careful. Make sure no one gets burnt.
zh: ~z~当然，我喜欢你。但我们要小心，确保没有人受伤。

english: ~z~You think I'm a whore, is that it? I bet this'll end up on the internet. Fuck you.
zh: ~z~你把我当成妓女，是这样吗？我会把这事发到网上的。操你妈。

english: ~z~Oh, Niko, this is our special place, let's go for a walk...
zh: ~z~噢，尼克，这是我们的二人世界，我们去散步吧...

english: ~z~After today, sure, but if this ends up on the internet, I'll kill you.
zh: ~z~既然约过会了，可以。要是被人传到网上，我杀了你。

english: ~z~Hey, Niko, let's find something else to do, we can't go back yet!
zh: ~z~嘿，尼克，我们再找点事做吧，现在回去太早了！

english: ~z~I think we should stay out and have some more fun - you got any ideas?
zh: ~z~我觉得我们应该多在外面玩一会儿，你有想法吗？

english: ~z~Why do we go to Comrades so often - seems full of criminals to me?
zh: ~z~为什么你总来Comrades？这里似乎到处都是罪犯。

english: ~z~We left too early - I was sort of enjoying that in a weird way.
zh: ~z~我们走得太早了，我在一定程度上看得还挺高兴。

english: ~z~Most American guys race a girl back to her place at the end of a date - what gives, Niko?
zh: ~z~大多数美国男人约完会都会送女孩回家，这是为什么，尼克？

english: ~z~Hey, you beat me. Now you've got to tell me a secret about yourself.
zh: ~z~嘿，你打败我了。现在你得告诉我一个关于你自己的小秘密。

english: ~z~This is a great idea, Niko, I love seeing a bit of the city, we should go for a walk...
zh: ~z~这真是个好主意，尼克。我很乐意看看这个城市，我们应该去散散步...

english: ~z~This really is a beautiful city, isn't it? Sometimes you can just forget about all the crime and stuff here, can't you?
zh: ~z~这座城市真美啊，不是吗？在这里时甚至可以把一切罪过都忘掉，不是吗？

english: ~z~Hey, I won. As a reward can you tell me some stuff about what you did before you got here?
zh: ~z~嘿，我赢了。作为奖励，你能告诉我你来自由城之前的事吗？

english: ~z~Okay, you beat me at bowling. Now the least you can do is open up to me a little.
zh: ~z~好吧，你打保龄球赢了我。那现在你至少对我敞开一点心扉吧。

english: ~z~It's amazing that this city can be so pretty but so dangerous too, don't you think?
zh: ~z~这个城市如此美丽，但也如此危险，不是很奇妙吗？

english: ~z~Liberty City is an amazing place, isn't it? That's probably why it attracts so many crooks, don't you think, Niko?
zh: ~z~自由城是个神奇的地方，不是吗？可能因此才会引来这么多罪犯吧，你不这么想吗，尼克？

english: ~z~Why'd you quit bowling, Niko? It's almost like you don't want me to find out about your life.
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么不打了？好像你不想让我了解你的生活一样。

english: ~z~This is a great spot, Niko, I can't remember when I last came here. Why don't we have a look around?
zh: ~z~这真是个好地方，尼克。我都不记得上次来是什么时候了。要么我们四处转转吧？

english: ~z~Most of the time, I'm kind of depressed, but there are moments when I'm happy to be in Liberty City.
zh: ~z~大多数时候我都有点沮丧，但也有一些时候，我很高兴能来自由城。

english: ~z~Well, now that you've lost to me at bowling you've got nothing to hide from me.
zh: ~z~嗯，既然你在保龄球比赛中输给了我，你就不能对我隐瞒了。

english: ~z~Hey, we tied. I like you, Niko. I'd like you even more if you were more honest about what you do for a living.
zh: ~z~嘿，我们平了。我喜欢你，尼克。如果你能告诉我更多关于你工作的事，我会更喜欢你。

english: ~z~I'd invite you in for some coffee, but it'd cost at least, say... $20m
zh: ~z~我很乐意请你喝杯咖啡，但怎么说也要...两千万美元吧。

english: ~z~Interesting place - seems like the kind of place Irish mobsters would like to hang out, don't you think?
zh: ~z~有趣的地方。似乎是爱尔兰黑帮喜欢去的地方，你不觉得吗？

english: ~z~Do you think he's in the Russian Mafia? He sounded like a crook.

zh: ~z~很难解释清楚，而且也没什么关系。我累了而已。

zh: ~z~我从来没跟外国人约过会。外星人约过不少，但就是没有外国的。

english: ~z~That ain't gonna cut it, Niko. The rest of the Ancelottis won't get properly pissed unless everyone goes.

zh: ~z~谢了，拜托你了。要是我进去了，帮我照顾好我的家人。

zh: ~z~我总感觉条子随时都会冲进我妈家的大门，把我抓进去。

zh: ~z~我还以为你肯定能干掉他。算了，再来我妈家找我吧。

zh: ~z~等我爸爸处理完你，你会后悔没有被抓进监狱的。

zh: ~z~既然你还待在这儿，我觉得还是由你来看守格雷西比较好。

zh: ~z~这么严重的话，你就该去医院看看了。我们之后再说。

zh: ~z~我们需要一张格雷丝的照片，她爸还以为她在和哪个男人鬼混呢。他不相信她在我们手里。

zh: ~z~干得好，尼克。安切洛蒂头子不会认为女儿在和男人鬼混了。

zh: ~z~他来了！斯蒂维，把车扔了。这个贱人就交给我吧。

zh: ~z~派奇，安切洛蒂的人追杀我，把车也撞烂了。我想格雷西死了。
