zh: ~z~要不是我哥哥格里在蹲号子，你丫早就完了，尼克。自己当心点。

english: ~z~Motherfuckers! When my daddy finds you, he's gonna kill you! He's gonna kill everybody you've ever met!
zh: ~z~狗逼玩意！等我爹地找到你们，他会把你们都杀了！还会把你们认识的人都杀了！

english: ~z~You motherfuckers, I'll rip your cocks off! Help! Help! Please let me outta here!
zh: ~z~你们这群狗逼，我要剁了你们的屌！救命！救命！求你放我出来！

english: ~z~Shit, the old bastard killed his own daughter. I gotta tell Gerry, I'll see you later.
zh: ~z~妈的，那老混蛋杀了自己女儿。我得告诉杰里，回头见。

english: ~z~Niko, my man. Katie's taken over on Ma duty so I'll be watching this guido bitch for you.
zh: ~z~尼克，好兄弟。现在是凯特在照顾妈，所以我就来替你看着这个意呆利贱人了。

english: ~z~I think you and her... should go out on a glamorous date in Algonquin,
zh: ~z~我觉得你和她...应该去阿尔冈琴来一次独特的约会，

english: ~z~I'm screwed either way. If I don't give you the diamonds, you kill me here and you take 'em.
zh: ~z~反正我怎么着都是死。要是不给你们钻石，你们在这儿就会杀了我拿走它。

english: ~z~I don't care what you did to that man, but we ain't leaving here without them diamonds.
zh: ~z~你跟他的纠纷我不感兴趣，但是没拿到钻石我们就不走了。

english: ~z~You might be right, Niko. Whose fucking diamonds were they anyway?
zh: ~z~说不定是这样，尼克。说起来这傻逼钻石到底是谁的？

english: ~z~Packie, this is great. You've finally found a woman who will sit down and listen to your shit.
zh: ~z~派奇，这下可好。你终于找到了一个会坐下来听你逼逼的女人了。

english: ~z~Yeah, but there is no guarantee we woulda made any money out of those diamonds anyway.
zh: ~z~对，但是也没人保证我们拿到钻石就一定能换到钱。

english: ~z~That's a fucking tragedy. We should throw her a goodbye party.
zh: ~z~那还真他妈可惜。我们应该替她开一个送别派对。

english: ~z~Bulgarin lost a lot of money that night and he needed someone to blame.
zh: ~z~那天晚上布尔加林损失了一大笔钱，他需要找一个人背锅。

english: ~z~Me and some biker had to try to sell them to a diamond dealer and it turns into a blood bath.
zh: ~z~我和一个飞车党想把它卖给一个钻石商，结果又成了一场血战。

english: ~z~and his Dominican bitch, they stole my diamonds.
zh: ~z~还有他的多米尼加婊子，就是他们偷了我的钻石。

english: ~z~I've got a suspicion those were the ones Ray Boccino got me to handle a while back.
zh: ~z~我怀疑那包钻石就是之前雷･博奇诺让我去搞的那些。

english: ~z~A guy like Gerry can still do stuff in the joint. He organized this kidnapping shit, didn't he?
zh: ~z~格里这样的人就算在牢里也能做事，这次的绑架不就是他策划的吗？

english: ~z~Niko, me and Gracie is waiting for you just off a Frankfort Avenue in Northwood.
zh: ~z~尼克，我和格雷西在北伍德的法兰克福大道等你。

english: ~z~That's a real shame, I can see you fitting right in down in Hove Beach, Niko.
zh: ~z~那还真可惜，依我看你能在霍夫海滩过得很好的，尼克。

english: ~z~A ship sunk, the cargo sunk to the bottom of the sea, I had to swim for my life.
zh: ~z~有条船沉了，货都沉到了海底，我只能游泳逃生。

english: ~z~And now he shows up claiming the ice belongs to him? What are the chances?
zh: ~z~然后现在他就跳出来说钻石是他的了？有什么关联吗？

english: ~z~I do give you the diamonds, Mr. Bulgarin kills me later.
zh: ~z~要是把钻石给你们，布尔加林先生之后会杀了我。

english: ~z~That's the plan. Hopefully someone might bring a big present for us to this shindig as well.
zh: ~z~计划就是这样。很可能还会有人在这场饯行会上送我们一份大礼。

english: ~z~Kidnapping the bitch, holding onto her, fighting through them damn Russians... all of that for jack shit.
zh: ~z~绑架那个贱人，牢牢看住她，和这群狗日的俄国佬干架...全他妈成了狗屁。

english: ~z~Hopefully one day I will be able to teach him his lesson by putting a bullet through the back of his head.
zh: ~z~希望有一天我能用一发穿透他脑壳的子弹教训教训他。

english: ~z~I hate that I'm the one that has to tell Gerald about this. Later on, man.
zh: ~z~为什么这种事一定要由我去告诉格里。回见，兄弟。

english: ~z~You're not meant to say what you wish for out loud. It won't come true if you do.
zh: ~z~你不应该把愿望说出来的，说出来就不会实现了。

english: ~z~Bulgarin, he the motherfucker who busted up our peaceful hostage exchange?
zh: ~z~布尔加林，就那个破坏了我们和平人质交易的狗逼玩意儿？

english: ~z~Screw that. I got close to knocking her teeth out. That was about it. We ain't got shit now.
zh: ~z~放屁，我差点没把她的牙给打下来。就是这样，我们现在屁都没了。

english: ~z~I worked for him on the Adriatic, he thought I stole from him and he came after me.
zh: ~z~还在亚得里亚海的时候我就替他卖命，他觉得我偷了他东西就来追杀我。

english: ~z~Well, Niko. That was a whole lot of effort for no fucking reward.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。又是屁回报都没有，工夫倒是费了不少。

english: ~z~Maybe a big bag of diamonds will help us get over the pain of losing her.
zh: ~z~可能是能帮我们摆脱失去她的痛苦的一大包钻石。

english: ~z~Maybe we was going to have to give up them diamonds to fucking Ray Boccino but we woulda got a payday.
zh: ~z~可能我们是该把钻石都上交给雷･博奇诺那个狗逼，那样我们至少还能拿到点钱。

english: ~z~I know I'm too good for him, but sometimes a guy has got to hang out with lowlifes like Niko here.
zh: ~z~我知道我比尼克强太多了，不过有时候就是得跟他这样的底层人一起出去。

english: ~z~Shit, I don't wanna spend another minute in this crap-hole, let's get outta here.
zh: ~z~操，我不想在这个粪坑里多待一秒了，我们赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~It's gonna be a nice thing to mull over. You know, while he's staring at them metal bars for the next decade or so.
zh: ~z~反倒是很适合拿去苦思冥想。你也知道，在他盯铁窗盯个十年之类的时候。

english: ~z~Niko Bellic, how is it that whenever something is stolen from me you are not far away?
zh: ~z~尼克･贝利克，怎么每次我东西被偷都能在附近找到你？

english: ~z~He coulda walked away from there. Instead, he's fucked and the diamonds are who knows where.
zh: ~z~大可放他走人。结果呢，他被搞了，也没人能知道钻石的下落。

english: ~z~There ain't much that could cheer him up now that he thinks he's doing serious time,
zh: ~z~现在他日子不好过，本来就没多少能激励他的东西，

english: ~z~Is it finally beginning to sink in that my sister's chastity belt don't come off?
zh: ~z~你终于明白了吗，我妹妹的贞操带是拿不下来的？

english: ~z~Okay, so we exchanged Gracie for some diamonds that Ray used to have.
zh: ~z~好了，就是我们用格雷西换来了以前属于雷的钻石。

english: ~z~I'm screwed either way. If I don't give you the diamonds, you kill me here and you take 'em.
zh: ~z~反正我怎么着都是死。不给你们钻石，你们就会当场杀了我拿走它。

english: ~z~We was outnumbered, Niko. I can see how he thought it was covered.
zh: ~z~我们被人数压制了，尼克。我能想到他觉得自己优势很大。

english: ~z~That might be okay where you're from, Niko. But this is an enlightened society we live in.
zh: ~z~在你老家可能可以，尼克。但我们这儿可是开明社会。

english: ~z~I do give you the diamonds, Mr. Bulgarin kills me later.
zh: ~z~要是我把钻石给你们，布尔加林先生之后会杀了我。

english: ~z~This is not the first time he has assumed that I will be killed by some of his employees.
zh: ~z~这已经不是他第一次以为我能被他的几个手下解决了。

english: ~z~Some time ago, I worked for Mr. Bulgarin in Europe, smuggling people across the Adriatic.
zh: ~z~之前有段时间，我替布尔加林先生在欧洲干活，通过亚得里亚海贩卖人口。

english: ~z~Maybe they belong to this homosexual man, Gracie's friend. I don't know. Maybe to Bulgarin.
zh: ~z~可能属于这个男同性恋，格雷西的朋友。我不清楚。也可能是布尔加林。

english: ~z~Jesus Christ, why did that moron have to throw the ice away? It was just plain selfish.
zh: ~z~我的天哪，为什么那个蠢货要扔掉钻石？完全就是自私嘛。

english: ~z~Gracie, watch your mouth. Niko is good friend of mine. Don't say that about him.
zh: ~z~格雷西，嘴巴干净点。尼克是我的好朋友。别那么说他。

english: ~z~Real enlightened, real civilized. That's the impression I've got so far.
zh: ~z~真是开明，真是文明。和我至今的印象完全一致。

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. The exchange is over on Charge Island at the water treatment plant.
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。人质交易将在查奇岛的污水处理厂进行。

english: ~z~Probably a good thing you got out though. Wouldn't a met me if you'd stayed, would ya?
zh: ~z~不过你出来了也算是件好事。你呆在那儿就遇不到我了，不是吗？

english: ~z~Shit, these diamonds have been trouble since Ray first made me take them out of a trash can for him.
zh: ~z~操，从雷让我把钻石从垃圾堆捞出来的时候开始，它就带来了麻烦。

english: ~z~Then some Russian turns up saying they're his. Then everything goes to shit. That's about right, isn't it?
zh: ~z~然后就有个俄国佬跳出来说钻石是他的。之后情况就完全不对了。是这样子没错吧？

english: ~z~Here we are, the party is happening in the back. Gracie's friends should be waiting.
zh: ~z~到了，派对在后头。格雷西的朋友们应该等着呢。

english: ~z~Well, Niko. That was a whole lot of effort for no fucking reward.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。又是屁回报都没有，工夫倒是费了不少。

english: ~z~See, she was just telling me how much she loved me. What do ya think of Niko, Gracie?
zh: ~z~你看看，她又在跟我说她爱我有多深了。你觉得尼克怎么样，格雷西？

english: ~z~There's nothing right about this situation, but that would be an accurate description of what went down.
zh: ~z~对情况的描述没有一个对的，但是对于发生了什么描述的还是很到位。

english: ~z~My cousin and I moved up to Bohan to get away from him and another man called Dimitri Rascalov.
zh: ~z~我的堂兄和我搬到了波汉，好避开他和另一个叫迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫的人。

english: ~z~Fuck, he weren't too chipper the last time I spoke to him and he's gonna be a long way from chipper when I tell him what went down.
zh: ~z~操，上次我跟他交谈的时候他就没什么生气，这次的事讲完他还不得直接断气。

english: ~z~It was recently targeted by terrorists in Weazel's 72.
zh: ~z~最近在Weazel电视台的《72小时》中成为了恐怖分子的目标。

english: ~z~First up, the Daily Globe Building, home to all the LC news,
zh: ~z~首先是环球日报大厦，自由城一切新闻的大本营。

english: ~z~Every day, Algonquin residents are grateful that this is here to keep us separate from Alderney.
zh: ~z~每天，阿尔冈琴的居民都很感激这条河让我们与奥尔德尼划清界限。

english: ~z~this won't be in guide books, you'd have to be one extreme tourist. Gnarly.
zh: ~z~旅游指南都忽略这里，只有硬核旅行者会来。很好。

english: ~z~I'm Jase, you're in safe hands, I could fly this baby with my eyes shut.
zh: ~z~我是杰斯，值得你们信赖，这飞机闭着眼睛我都会开。

english: ~z~Hi, welcome to Higgins Tour, I'm Vicki, I'm your pilot.
zh: ~z~嗨，欢迎参加希金斯观光，我叫维琪，是你的飞行员。

english: ~z~bodies, torn up as if by artillery. That, or giant teeth.
zh: ~z~尸体，如果不是被大炮轰过，就是被尖牙撕裂的。

english: ~z~I've never been in there, but it sure is popular with you visitors. Full of old stuff, crammed with it.
zh: ~z~我是没进去过，不过你们游客肯定很喜欢。全是古董啥的，都塞满了。

english: ~z~where Yusuf Amir is building more apartments for his foreign buddies to live in tax-free.
zh: ~z~建成后尤瑟夫･阿米尔就能为他的外国哥们提供免税住所了。

english: ~z~Well, that's us; I hope you've enjoyed LC from the skies!
zh: ~z~好了，就到这里。希望你喜欢自由城天际的风光！

english: ~z~Higgins Helitours. We're here to show you Liberty City from the sky.
zh: ~z~希金斯直升机观光，让您从空中一览自由城风光。

english: ~z~It sure is great to be driving a chopper for fun rather than to mow down a village full of hostiles.
zh: ~z~兴趣使然开直升机可比被迫扫射敌方村庄要好多了。

english: ~z~but a third of the park's budget goes toward cleaning this fountain of pigeon shit.
zh: ~z~公园管理费有三分之一是用来清理水里的鸽子屎的。

english: ~z~First, the famous Broker Bridge, used in many movies and TV shows.
zh: ~z~首先，是著名的布洛克大桥，许多影视作品的取景地。

english: ~z~all manner of ways for chubby, spoiled brats, to get whipped into a sugar frenzy.
zh: ~z~这里无所不用其极，诱使被宠坏的小胖子们陷入糖分狂热。

english: ~z~you can spot the library, where they get their long hair stuck in their fancy books.
zh: ~z~你可以看见图书馆，学生把自己的长发夹在书里当书签。

english: ~z~Over Westminster now, some of you out-of-towners may never have seen a gay before,
zh: ~z~现在在威斯敏斯特，你们这些外地人可能从来没有见过同性恋。

english: ~z~Come back for food poisoning or a massage with the happiest ending in the City.
zh: ~z~这里不仅有食物中毒，还有全城最令人愉悦的按摩。

english: ~z~From us at Higgins, have a nice day and remember that tips are appreciated.
zh: ~z~我谨代表敝公司，祝您生活愉快。别忘记给小费哦。

english: ~z~I will be your guide for today. Buckle up, and no questions about my name.
zh: ~z~是你今天的导游。系好安全带，别在意我的名字。

english: ~z~I always think of this place as like, Algonquin's appendix; it's there, but nobody knows why.
zh: ~z~我一直把这里视作，阿尔冈琴的鸡肋：食之无味，弃之可惜。

english: ~z~Heard the name Kenny Petrovic folks? He's a Hove Beach landmark too,
zh: ~z~听说过肯尼･彼得罗维奇吗？他也是霍夫海滩的一大标志，

english: ~z~a den of vice and corruption the likes of which most of you folks will never see again.
zh: ~z~罪恶与腐败的老巢，不过你们很难有机会再次来到这里。

english: ~z~This is the Exchange. High flying workers here are calling in debt
zh: ~z~这里是证券交易所，壮志凌云的职员们在这里催债，

english: ~z~these youngsters taunt death because they've never seen war. Bring back the draft.
zh: ~z~这些年轻人嘲笑死亡，因为他们从未见过战争。就该恢复兵役。

english: ~z~Yep, when the hippies were distracted with weed and shit, those money guys never missed a beat.
zh: ~z~是的，虽然嬉皮士们正沉迷大麻之流，但有钱人的脚步从未停下。

english: ~z~Well, that's it folks, you've seen the decline of the Roman Empire from the skies, choose Higgins again!
zh: ~z~好了，观光结束了，你已经鸟瞰了罗马帝国的衰败。欢迎下次光临。

english: ~z~It was here that Ochoa eased safety restrictions on Helicopters and their pilots.
zh: ~z~奥乔亚就是在这里放宽了对直升机及其飞行员的安全限制。

english: ~z~The tall, clean buildings smooth enough to do lines of cocaine off of,
zh: ~z~耸立洁净的大楼，外墙平滑到可以在上面吸可卡因，

english: ~z~There's a guy lives in a bush, can get you anything that smokes. Anything.
zh: ~z~这里有个住草丛里的人，要什么都能给你弄来。什么都能。

english: ~z~disappointing arty liberal kids with their ideas about how there's no God.
zh: ~z~其无神论的观念让附庸风雅的自由主义青少年失落沮丧。

english: ~z~Of course, once you've seen war, God is a joke, but would you look at that architecture?
zh: ~z~当然，见过战争以后，上帝就是个笑话了，不过建筑还是值得欣赏的。

english: ~z~Now Firefly Island, where some remnants of the glory days can still be seen.
zh: ~z~这里是萤火虫乐园，在这儿还能找到往昔岁月的痕迹。

english: ~z~Well, here we are, I hope you've seen another side to Liberty City.
zh: ~z~好了，我们到了，希望你已经看到了自由城的另一面。

english: ~z~where Mayor Ochoa makes all his important decisions to keep LC running smooth.
zh: ~z~奥乔亚市长于此作出各项重大决策，让自由城平稳运转。

english: ~s~If you are in a vehicle and have an appropriate weapon you can fire it.
zh: ~s~在载具中时，若你拥有合适的武器，即可用其进行攻击。

english: ~z~Sometimes literally. We're gonna need your skills again soon. Arrivederci.
zh: ~z~有时是字面上的没头脑。马上就会再次需要你的。再会。

english: ~z~You did good, kid. Kept your head when everyone else was losing theirs.
zh: ~z~干得不错，小子。别人都没头脑的时候你还能保持清醒。

english: ~z~You fired first. Lucky for you, they was out to whack me anyway.
zh: ~z~你为什么要先开火？不过无所谓了，他们本来就想把我干掉。

english: ~z~You gotta go, Niko. I can't move with this bullet in my gut.
zh: ~z~你自己去吧，尼克。我肚子上中了一枪，现在动弹不得。

english: ~z~It's too bad that gift got destroyed, Mr. Pegorino. I'm sure it was real nice.
zh: ~z~很抱歉，礼物被毁了，佩戈里诺先生。那个礼物确实很好。

english: ~z~The fucking Pavanos. If the rest of the Commission knew they did this...
zh: ~z~该死的帕瓦诺家族！如果委员会的其他人知道他们敢这么做...

english: ~z~They gonna take that stuff back to Algonquin and laugh at our Alderney, gumba, guido asses.
zh: ~z~他们会把战利品带回阿尔冈琴，一边还嘲笑我们这些奥尔德尼的所谓意大利黑道的。

english: ~z~The dumb fucks have crashed. Go get my gift and make the fuckers pay.
zh: ~z~这群傻逼自己撞上了。去把我的礼物拿回来，让他们付出代价！

english: ~z~You think we're midgets? Get a car that'll fit us all.
zh: ~z~我操，你以为我们是侏儒吗？求求你找一辆能装下我们所有人的车好吗。

english: ~z~Don't worry about that cousin of yours, he won't be in no danger sleeping in your Algonquin pad by his self.
zh: ~z~别担心你那堂兄了，他晚上一个人睡阿尔冈琴的公寓不会出事的。

english: ~z~Maybe you can pick up another one on craplist.net. Don't worry about it.
zh: ~z~或许你可以在craplist上再找一个。不要担心了。

english: ~z~I don't know what you're busy with up there, but I need your immigrant ass down here now!
zh: ~z~我不知道你他妈在上面瞅什么，你这移民弱智赶紧给老子下来帮忙！

english: ~z~Don't start shooting unless they attack us. I don't want this thing screwing up for no good reason.
zh: ~z~他们不动手，你就别开枪。我可不想平白无故搞砸这笔交易。

english: ~z~I don't know what you're busy with up there, but I need your immigrant ass down here now!
zh: ~z~我不知道你他妈在上面瞅什么，你这移民弱智赶紧给老子下来帮忙！

english: ~z~Niko, go up into that building. There should be a spot where you can see over the meet.
zh: ~z~尼克，去那栋楼里面。那里应该有个能监视交易的绝佳位置。

english: ~z~So you here to work for him, shoot him, or arrest him? Or maybe all three?
zh: ~z~所以，你是来给他干活的，来把他做掉的，还是来逮捕他的？或者三种都是？

english: ~z~You're insurance. I'm the captain of this ship because I look at every possibility.
zh: ~z~保险措施而已。我是这艘船的船长，需要考虑所有情况。

english: ~z~Ask me why it matters. Women just don't understand this life of ours.
zh: ~z~一直说有必要吗。女人是真不明白我们这种生活。

english: ~z~It means something in Alderney even if it don't in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~就算在阿尔冈琴不太管用，但在奥尔德尼总有份量。

english: ~z~or you're not going to deal with it, and you're going to be a problem that somebody else has to deal with.
zh: ~z~要是你办不成，你就会成为需要别人解决的麻烦。

english: ~z~We gonna get that gift back and make this crew pay for their disrespect. Come on.
zh: ~z~赶紧夺回礼物，让他们为不尊重我付出代价。干他。

english: ~z~Yeah, I'm in a life threatening situation and I'm having a conversation here.
zh: ~z~是啊，我现在性命受到威胁，还在这里跟人聊天。

english: ~z~Shit, sometimes I wish she'd just run off with some other guy. Leave me in peace.
zh: ~z~操，有时候我都希望回到家发现她跟别的男人跑了。让我得以安宁。

english: ~z~My old man, God rest his soul, didn't have the balls to bring the family to the level I got it to.
zh: ~z~我老爹，愿他安息，胆子没我大，没能让家族达到现在的实力水平。

english: ~z~Marco and Pete? Oh yeah, those guys didn't make it, did they? Well, too fucking bad.
zh: ~z~马可和皮特？哦对，他俩没活下来是吧？确实太可怜了。

english: ~z~Gets us into debt and in some heavy shit with people, but... he's family.
zh: ~z~让我们负债累累，惹上一堆硬骨头，但...他是我的家人。

english: ~z~Don't tell me what's due to me. I been waiting for this and working hard for this for years.
zh: ~z~不用你告诉我该干什么。为此我辛苦努力了好多年。

english: ~z~When I say I wish she'd run off with another guy it's a figure of speech.
zh: ~z~我刚刚说的希望她跟别的男人跑路是夸张的说辞。

english: ~z~It ain't like she's my only woman. I got a nice little goomah set up in an apartment in Acter.
zh: ~z~她又不是我唯一的女人。我在阿克特的公寓那边还有个娘们。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna do shit for him no more. I don't like the way he does business.
zh: ~z~我再也不会替他办事了。我不喜欢他的办事风格。

english: ~z~They knew what they was signed on for. Weren't complaining on the way out, were they?
zh: ~z~他们知道当我手下的下场如何。在路上也没有怨言，对吧？

english: ~z~You guys all friends now? Nice. You best hope you made a good first impression on Niko, boys.
zh: ~z~你们现在都是朋友了吧？好。最好给尼克留下个好点的印象，小的们。

english: ~z~If the Pavanos is a Liberty City family, what are they doing coming out to Alderney for this meet?
zh: ~z~如果帕瓦诺家族是自由城的家族，他们为什么要来奥尔德尼跟你见面呢？

english: ~z~No wonder I ain't on the Commission when my muscle is this stupid!
zh: ~z~怪不得委员会不给我席位，谁让我的手下都这么弱智！

english: ~z~Yeah, uh boss, I got you this, because I care.
zh: ~z~好，呃，老大，我给您带来了这个，因为我在乎您。

english: ~z~Ray was nothing to me until he started earning big and sticking his nose in places it didn't belong.
zh: ~z~在雷赚到大钱，把触角伸到不属于我们的地盘之前，他对我什么都不是。

english: ~z~That's just if the shit goes down, right boss? The Pavanos wouldn't fuck with you.
zh: ~z~只是防一手意外情况，对吧老大？帕瓦诺家族不会暗算你的。

english: ~z~Yeah, well best ain't good enough. I did my best. Made a name for the Pegorinos.
zh: ~z~是啊，但光尽力还是不够。我已经为家族呕心沥血了，替佩戈里诺家族打出了名声。

english: ~z~Exactly... I mean, we can pretty much guarantee you were followed.
zh: ~z~没错...我是说，我可以确认你百分百被跟踪了。

english: ~z~This is a declaration of war. The Pegorinos and the Pavanos are hitting the mattresses.
zh: ~z~这就是开战宣言！佩戈里诺家族和帕瓦诺家族现在正式开战了！

english: ~z~I guess not. Lucky I have people like you to teach me when I'm wrong.
zh: ~z~我觉得不会。幸好有你这样的人能在我犯错的时候提醒我。

english: ~z~My wife, Angie's, gonna love this. She keeps busting my balls about trying to get on the Commission.
zh: ~z~我夫人安吉肯定很高兴。她一直对我加入委员会的想法冷嘲热讽。

english: ~z~Well, he's being paid to look out for me so saving you guys' asses would be overtime.
zh: ~z~其实，给他的钱只是负责我安全用的，保护你们的话算是加班。

english: ~z~It don't do too well for the reputation of us Pegorinos having St Patrick that high up in our organization.
zh: ~z~组织高位有个绿帽子小精灵对我们佩戈里诺家族的声誉可不太好。

english: ~z~Yeah, even if you can't speak right, at least you can shoot straight.
zh: ~z~是啊，就算你这人不会说话，枪法也还是可以的。

english: ~z~Guy who owned the diamonds, Gay Tony, is in with the Ancelottis.
zh: ~z~钻石的主人，基佬托尼，他站在安切洛蒂家族那边。

english: ~z~Ah these kids come and go. It ain't worth paying attention to them until they prove they can survive.
zh: ~z~啊，这些小伙子来来走走的。如果他们不能证明自己的生存能力，就不值得我去关注。

english: ~z~We just hoping they got the manners to smile to our faces before they do it.
zh: ~z~我们指望他们能在下手前对我们先笑一阵子就行。

english: ~z~Shit, but times is changed. Since RICO, the Commission ain't the same.
zh: ~z~操，但时代变了。自从RICO颁布，委员会就变了。

english: ~z~Has to be. I only start paying attention to my crew when they start putting me in an awkward position.
zh: ~z~必须这样。只有哪个手下让我处境尴尬了，我才会关注他。

english: ~z~What I'm worried about is our involvement with getting back to Gay Tony and his connections...
zh: ~z~我只担心我们做的事被基佬托尼和他的盟友知道...

english: ~z~Or because they got too much power and they're too smart to get themselves clipped.
zh: ~z~要么因为他大权在握，头脑聪明到没那么容易被杀。

english: ~z~Hopefully they gonna respect that when it comes time to ask them for a favor.
zh: ~z~希望能让他们多尊重我些，要他们帮忙的时候能给点面子。

english: ~z~You see the respect we're getting out on the street. Jesus.
zh: ~z~你也看见外面的人对我们有多「尊重」了。老天。

english: ~z~I didn't get where I am by believing what every schmuck told me.
zh: ~z~要是什么人说的话我都信，我就不会有今天的地位。

english: ~z~I got a nice little offering to the Pavanos that's gonna persuade 'em to argue my case.
zh: ~z~我为帕瓦诺家族准备了一份小礼物，应该能说服他们帮我。

english: ~z~Me and two of my guys gonna meet with a couple of boys from the Pavano family.
zh: ~z~我和两个手下，待会儿要去见帕瓦诺家族的几个小伙子。

english: ~z~With guys like you, no wonder this 'organization' is doing so wonderfully.
zh: ~z~有你这样的「得力干将」，难怪这个「组织」运作得这么好。

english: ~z~Alright, let's get these slimeball bastards. People like that give Italians a bad name.
zh: ~z~好了，让我们追上这群混蛋。就是这种人毁了意大利人的名声。

english: ~z~I don't mind 'em taking a bite, I don't even make 'em give me a taste.
zh: ~z~我不介意他们来插一脚，我都没让他们给我分成。

english: ~z~Niko, this is Pete and Marco. Guys, Niko.
zh: ~z~尼克，这两位是皮特和马可。伙计们，这是尼克。

english: ~z~Anyways, that's why Ray ain't ever gonna make it to the level he wants to reach.
zh: ~z~总之，这就是雷永远都得不到他想要的地位的原因。

english: ~z~You giving them a nice little offering though, skip.
zh: ~z~你不是给他们准备了一份挺好的小礼物吗，老大。

english: ~z~Yeah, but a wife is a wife. I guess it's like with my cousin. He puts me in so much shit.
zh: ~z~确实，但你老婆就是你老婆。我觉得就像我堂兄一样，他给我带来太多麻烦了。

english: ~z~I'm surprised you can even speak when your lips are always puckered up, kissing my ass.
zh: ~z~都舔到我屁股上了，你还能说出话来倒让我很惊讶。

english: ~z~Only way you know is by finding their shit all over the place in the morning.
zh: ~z~只有起床后看见满地老鼠屎，才会知道有老鼠在。

english: ~z~I can't believe them Pavanos would treat me like this. The Pegorino name should mean something to them.
zh: ~z~帕瓦诺家族的孙子居然敢这样对我！佩戈里诺这个名字对他们应该是有份量的！

english: ~z~Can you do me a favor? Can you just shoot yourself to save me the trouble of doing it?
zh: ~z~你能帮我个忙吗？你他妈给自己来一枪省得我动手好吗？

english: ~z~I think about what's gonna happen if this guy screws me, if this one turns state's, and so on.
zh: ~z~我也考虑过有人反咬我一口，或者突然背叛。都考虑过。

english: ~z~Hand something up the ladder. That's how us Italians been doin' things for centuries.
zh: ~z~给自己的上级纳贡。我们意大利人几百年的规矩了。

english: ~z~Listen, some of their boys are in town today, gonna collect their piece of an Alderney bookie ring.
zh: ~z~听好了，他们家族的人今天在城里，准备去收奥尔德尼一家赌庄的分成。

english: ~z~Tell me this job ain't as crazy as when you and me hit that bank together.
zh: ~z~告诉我，这活不会跟之前我们抢银行那件那么疯狂。

english: ~z~You'll lose your balls if you make a habit of fucking up like this. Come see me soon.
zh: ~z~你丫在像这次一样搞砸，你的蛋就别想要了。过会儿来找我。

english: ~z~You mean when Michael died? I couldn't possibly be having that much fun.
zh: ~z~你说迈克尔死的时候？我当时可没有那么「开心」。

english: ~z~Hey, I'm offended. You're havin' fun without me.
zh: ~z~嘿，我感觉自己被冒犯了。你享乐为什么不带上我。

english: ~z~You disrupt it, and I'll let you keep the money, but make sure you hit the Pavanos real hard! Capiche?
zh: ~z~你去干烂他们，钱你可以留着。但得给我重创帕瓦诺家族！懂？

english: ~z~Word is they're at the Diner in Acter. Find 'em, and follow them to the meet.
zh: ~z~他们现在在阿克特的餐厅里。找到他们，尾随他们到碰头地点。

english: ~z~Niko, I know you're probably occupied and don't wanna hang out but I thought I'd try. I'm bored.
zh: ~z~尼克我知道你现在很忙而且不愿意和我出去玩，但我现在真的太他妈无聊了。

english: ~z~Well done, my boy. I hope you made 'em suffer. Teach 'em that Alderney is Pegorino turf.
zh: ~z~干得不错，孩子。希望你让他们吃了苦头。让他们知道奥尔德尼是我佩戈里诺的地盘！

english: ~z~Shit, Packie. I'm kind of busy chasing down some wiseguys for those guido buddies of yours.
zh: ~z~操，派奇。我现在很忙。我在为你老大开车追一些黑手党成员。

english: ~z~The way they look at us, we're bottom feeders! Always have been.
zh: ~z~他们纯粹当我们家族是臭要饭的！一直都是这样。

english: ~z~We ain't a real family to them - just a bunch of Guernsey goombas.
zh: ~z~他们就没把我们当真正的家族，只把我们看作根西的小老弟。

english: ~z~Anthony - will you shut up? In fact, will you fuck off?
zh: ~z~安东尼！你他妈能闭嘴吗？直白点，你能滚了吗？

english: ~z~You have fun. Pick a swell guy to kill - hopefully someone with a young family who'll really miss him...
zh: ~z~你高兴就好。看上哪个上流人士就杀了吧，他死了家里人多半会很想他的...

english: ~z~Hey, I saw you a second ago. If you're a doctor I'm the Pope.
zh: ~z~喂，之前我刚见过你。你要是是医生，那老子就是天皇。

english: ~z~Oh, it looks like I messed something up. Sorry about that, Anthony.
zh: ~z~哦，我好像动了什么不该动的东西。不好意思了，安东尼。

english: ~z~Speak, you Balkan piece of shit - I'm done with you, done with everyone.
zh: ~z~说话啊，你这巴尔干烂人，我跟你结束了，我跟所有人都结束了！

english: ~z~Mr. Pegorino, I don't know what you're talking about. I came as quickly as I could.
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺先生，我不知道你在说什么，我已经尽可能快地赶过来了。

english: ~z~Do I know you? I've seen so many green doctors, patients and cadavers, I don't recognize anyone anymore.
zh: ~z~我认识你吗？我见过了太多一身绿的医生、病人和尸体，现在认不出人了。

english: ~z~He freaks out on the phone, and I put the fear of God in him.
zh: ~z~他在电话那头吓得要死，我就在这头一直威胁他。

english: ~z~But the asshole lived and now he's in the Leftwood hospital under heavy guard.
zh: ~z~结果这混蛋没死，现在在左伍德的医院里被人严密保护。

english: ~z~Oh shit, I didn't have a choice. They was gonna put me away for some hard time.
zh: ~z~哦天哪，我真的没得选。不然我就要被关进去了。

english: ~z~Fucking feds. Turning everybody into rats. See ya round, Niko.
zh: ~z~该死的FIB。把所有人都变成了叛徒。一会儿见尼克。

english: ~z~Hey, watch out for those cops. They're down the hall acting like they own the place.
zh: ~z~嘿，小心点那些条子。他们把走廊那头当自己的地盘。

english: ~z~I better not be seeing you up there neither. Or anybody else I know for that matter.
zh: ~z~也别让我在那儿看见你，或者哪个我认识的熟人。

english: ~z~Cops act all nice when they get shot but it's Mr. Toughguy now that they're down the hall with a witness.
zh: ~z~挨了枪子儿的条子那叫一个温顺，这会儿跟证人在一起，就成硬汉先生了。

english: ~z~Niko, I've been thinking about it and I want you to pay our friend Ray a visit. Give him a message from me.
zh: ~z~尼克，我考虑良久，决定让你去找我们的雷一趟。向他传达我的态度。

english: ~z~Well, I've given you my advice, Peg, you do what you think is best.
zh: ~z~该说的我都说了，佩戈里诺，余下就是你的考量了。

english: ~z~We got a couple of boys in jail... I think they might squeal!
zh: ~z~我有很多手下被抓进去了...我觉得他们会告密！

english: ~z~He should be heading over to a chop shop in BOABO. Don't get too comfortable with him, Niko.
zh: ~z~他应该是要去博阿博的改车店。不要掉以轻心，尼克。

english: ~z~Like every rat, he's a survivor, he's got good instincts. He has a bad feeling about you in particular.
zh: ~z~他有叛徒的共性，擅长死里求生，直觉也很好。他对你也有不好的感觉。

english: ~z~I'll give you a call... whoever I say to go see, go see 'em. And shut 'em up!
zh: ~z~待会儿我给你打电话...我说去找谁就找谁，让他永远闭嘴！

english: ~z~Look either we make the right call or we all end up in prison anyway,
zh: ~z~要么做出正确的决定，要么大家一起死在监狱里。

english: ~z~Sorry, Mr. Pegorino. He's a cockroach, Ray would survive anything. Even a nuclear holocaust.
zh: ~z~不好意思佩戈里诺先生。雷就是个打不死的小强。估计就算核弹爆炸他也能活下来。

english: ~z~He bought some protection and he ain't gonna hang around and wait for "you know what" to happen.
zh: ~z~他雇了几个保镖，不会招摇过市等着「你懂的」发生。

english: ~z~I don't know... I gotta shut someone up, and show people I mean business.
zh: ~z~不知道...我要杀鸡儆猴，告诉他们我要动真格了！

english: ~z~I pay you to be a nuclear holocaust, Bellic. Sort your shit out. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~花钱就是让你去核爆他的，贝利克。自己看着办吧。之后再联系你。

english: ~z~Cleaning house is a tough job, Bellic. I don't got much left in mine, it's so clean.
zh: ~z~打扫屋子可不容易啊，贝利克。我家快打扫完了，很干净。

english: ~z~Fuck, do I gotta do everything myself? He's gonna be onto us now. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~操，一定要我事必躬亲吗？他马上就要反水了。之后再联系。

english: ~z~Ray got wise to me, Mr. Pegorino. I think I spooked him.
zh: ~z~雷把我甩掉了，佩戈里诺先生。我想我把他吓到了。

english: ~z~Shit, I told you he had his eyes open. He'll be on the lamb now. Dammit.
zh: ~z~该死，我告诉过你他一直保持警惕着，他马上就要告发我了，操。
