zh: ~z~是为了爱，伙计。人认识我是因为我帮了他们，伙计。我对街道心怀大爱。

english: ~z~Yeah here, right here, right here, turn around, man, right here.
zh: ~z~对，这边，就这边，就这边，转过来，伙计，就这边。

english: ~z~This film is my gospel, man. The gospel of the streets.
zh: ~z~这部影片就是我的福音书，伙计。街道的福音书。

english: ~z~The kids have to look up to me, man. To know that the clean path is the good path. You hear me?
zh: ~z~孩子们以我为榜样，伙计。能学到干净的路才是正道。听见了吗？

english: ~z~Ok, yeah, great, so, eh, so you know streets take no prisoners, right?
zh: ~z~好，对，很好。那个，你知道街道对敌人绝不手软，对吧？

english: ~z~This is the one, man - we're gonna get a really nice shot of them, it's going to be beautiful.
zh: ~z~就是这样，伙计。要把他们一起拍进去，效果会很棒的。

english: ~z~"Help" has only one name on the streets of South Bohan - Manny Escuela.
zh: ~z~南波汉的「救星」只有他一个－曼尼･埃斯库埃拉。

english: ~z~The dealer and his drug wagon are up there. Pull up behind and we wait.
zh: ~z~毒贩子和他装毒品的车都在那儿。停到他后面，见机行事。

english: ~z~-Hey, hey! Please, please, what are you doing? Hey! My...~n~-Hey, hold on a second, man! Wha...
zh: ~z~－喂，喂！拜托，拜托，你要干啥啊？喂！我的...~n~－喂，停一下，伙计！哇...

english: ~z~If you can't clean up the streets, man, then you can walk on them, man. Get out.
zh: ~z~要是你不能收拾干净街道，就去街上走走吧，伙计。滚吧。

english: ~z~Shit, he'd pulled up. It's almost like you don't care about the kids, man.
zh: ~z~我靠，他停车了。你这人真就不在乎孩子们死活吗，伙计。

english: ~z~You taking my money, aren't you? Be my voice. I'm gonna go back and get Jay.
zh: ~z~我付你钱了，不是么？替我把话带到。我要回去找杰了。

english: ~z~You think these streets is safe enough? See for yourself - get out.
zh: ~z~你觉得街道现在够安全吗？自己去看看吧，慢走。

english: ~z~I'm disappointed in you man. I thought we was on the same page. I thought you cared. Get out.
zh: ~z~我对你很失望，伙计。我以为我们是一路人。还以为你也在乎。滚吧。

english: ~z~For a guy who just lost his home and his business and who now has a price on his head?
zh: ~z~考虑到他刚没了自己的家和事业，还被人重金悬赏，

english: ~z~ I love that girl, man, I love her, man. Your cousin better not be messing with her head.
zh: ~z~我爱那女孩，伙计，我爱她，伙计。你堂兄最好别搅得她心烦意乱。

english: ~z~Just wait 'til you see your face on the screen, man. Maybe you change your mind then!
zh: ~z~你就等着瞧自己在电视上露脸吧，伙计。说不定到时候你就改主意了！

english: ~z~Shit, man. I thought you were the streets man. We need to tail him.
zh: ~z~干，伙计。我还以为你是街道同僚。我们得跟着他。

english: ~z~Everytime the streets is hurt, I hurt inside, man. You cut me deep, man. Get out of here.
zh: ~z~每次街道受伤，我的心就会更痛，伙计。你深深伤害了我。你走吧。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, you know, sometimes you gotta break some omelets to make some eggs, you know what I'm saying?
zh: ~z~行，没事，要知道，不经历彩虹怎能见风雨，懂我什么意思吗？

english: ~z~We're gonna get all these dealers off the streets and we're gonna kick their ass and they're gonna know it was me...
zh: ~z~赶跑街上的所有毒贩，把他们揍出屎来，人们就知道我的功劳了...

english: ~z~You cut them and they bleed. Man, that was good. I should write that down. You got a pen?
zh: ~z~划上一刀，它也会流血。伙计，这话漂亮，我得先记下来。你有带笔吗？

english: ~z~Only someone who has been to prison gets that close to a man. Hold off, man!
zh: ~z~只有坐过牢的人才会离男人那么近。拉开点，伙计！

english: ~z~Shit, we meant to be keeping this shit on the down low. What you doing getting five-oh on our ass?
zh: ~z~我靠，我说了要低调做事。你把条子惹上是几个意思？

english: ~z~Philanthropicalism, man, like one of them rich guys who makes computers and cures AIDS and shit.
zh: ~z~心怀大善，伙计。就像那些造电脑啊、治艾滋啊的有钱人。

english: ~z~You know, when I was stalking this girl in Europe, I found that two car lengths was the best distance.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，我在欧洲跟踪姑娘的时候，发现两个车距是最好的距离。

english: ~z~Shit, man. Manny's close to everyone who grew up on the streets of South Bohan, man.
zh: ~z~我靠，伙计，曼尼跟所有在南波汉的街道长大的人关系都很好，伙计。

english: ~z~Hey, the message is what's important, man. It don't matter who gives it.
zh: ~z~嘿，重要的是意思能传达到，伙计。是谁动的手不重要。

english: ~z~How we going to clean up these streets if there's cops on us, man? Lose the heat.
zh: ~z~身后有条子跟着我们还怎么整治街道啊，伙计？摆脱通缉。

english: ~z~Best of both worlds, man. I see myself that way, man.
zh: ~z~两个领域都是最好的，伙计。我觉得我就是这种人，伙计。

english: ~z~Hey did it look good? Huh? Was it a good mixture of that sadness and resolve?
zh: ~z~嘿，效果还好吗？哈？是不是融悲伤与决心为一体？

english: ~z~I like your vibe, man. I like it. You're out to make money but you want to make a difference too, man.
zh: ~z~我喜欢你的风格，伙计。我喜欢。赚钱谋生的同时，也想要有所作为，伙计。

english: ~z~See, it's the streets man, but people gotta understand the struggles...
zh: ~z~看，街道大家庭。伙计，但各位一定要明白背后的付出...

english: ~z~This dealer's going to see us if we rolling with all this heat, man! You gotta shake the cops, man.
zh: ~z~这么招摇的话会被毒贩发现的，伙计！你得甩掉警察，伙计。

english: ~z~He going to propose, right? He's going to make an honest woman of her, right?
zh: ~z~他要求婚，对吧？他会对玛洛丽负起责任的，对吧？

english: ~z~Yeah, I'm an entrepreneur, man. You got to have some money if people is gonna respect you out there, man.
zh: ~z~对，我是个企业家，伙计。有钱才能让别人尊重你，伙计。

english: ~z~Yo, chill on the shooting, man. We trying to keep this shit on the down low.
zh: ~z~嘿，先别想着开枪，伙计。现在我们得低调一点。

english: ~z~People say to me, "Manny why you do this? Why you want to clean up the streets so bad? What's your passion?"
zh: ~z~人们对我说，「曼尼，为什么这样做？你怎么这么想整治街区？你的动力是什么？」

english: ~z~It's two car lengths, right? That's how far you stay behind a woman when you're harassing her?
zh: ~z~两辆车的距离，对吧？骚扰女人的时候也是这个距离吧？

english: ~z~Shit, man. You don't need to fire that thing until we find the rest of those suckers, man.
zh: ~z~我靠伙计。我们找到其他毒贩之前你没必要开枪。

english: ~z~I thought you was going to clean shit up. For me and these streets. For these people man, my people.
zh: ~z~我以为你会把街道清理干净。为了我和街道，为了这里的人们，伙计，为了我的子民。

english: ~z~You lost him, man. He probably selling drugs to kids right now.
zh: ~z~你跟丢他了，伙计。他现在可能在向孩子们卖毒品了。

english: ~z~Man, you hit him. No way we can get the rest of them leeches now!
zh: ~z~伙计，你撞上他了。现在我们不可能找到其他寄生虫了！

english: ~z~I don't know if he's grown up enough to make a good husband. What's it to you anyway?
zh: ~z~我不知道现在他能否当一个好丈夫。不过跟你有什么关系？

english: ~z~Niko, you made a promise to me, man. Your bond is your word, man.
zh: ~z~尼克，你跟我可说好了，伙计。说话要算数，伙计。

english: ~z~Step on it, man. I need you close to this guy, but not too close. You hear me?
zh: ~z~快点，伙计。我需要你跟紧他，但也别跟太紧。懂了吗？

english: ~z~Shit, man. He seen us. He ain't never gonna go to his boys now.
zh: ~z~该死，伙计，他看见我们了。他不可能去找他的同伙了。

english: ~z~I ain't touched that shit in years. Who you been talking to, man?
zh: ~z~我好多年没碰那玩意了。你把我当什么人啊，伙计？

english: ~z~You know, these streets is mine, man! I can feel them flowing through my veins.
zh: ~z~知道吗，这片街区是我的，伙计！我能感觉到它在我的血管中流动。

english: ~z~-The fearsome street warrior stands outside the site of another gangland massacre. Oh...~n~-Yeah... 'sright...
zh: ~z~－罪犯畏惧的街道战士正站在另一起黑社会大屠杀的现场外。哦...卡。~n~－对...是这样...

english: ~z~Could you walk out of there just one more time? We need to get the shot just right.
zh: ~z~你能不能再从里面出来一次？我们拍到这个镜头的时机得合适。

english: ~z~That guy gets away there'll be more drugs on the street, killing our kids.
zh: ~z~给那家伙跑了的话街上会有更多毒品的，会害死孩子的。

english: ~z~Shit, how about that for a title? 'Manny's Street Gospel' man.
zh: ~z~我靠，要么就叫这名字吧？《曼尼的街道福音》，伙计。

english: ~z~Shit man, I'm the voice of the streets, man. Yo, if I'm gonna make some money, that's the way shit's gonna be.
zh: ~z~我靠，伙计，我是街道的喉舌。哟，我要是想赚钱，那就他妈那样干得了。

english: ~z~Yo, that's what I'm saying man. The streets, we got codes man you know what I'm saying.
zh: ~z~哟，就是这么回事。在街道，我们自有规矩，你们也懂我意思。

english: ~z~A little closer. Thank you so much. Wonderful, wonderful. Beautiful. Now we are gonna be da da da da.
zh: ~z~再近点。非常感谢。很棒，很棒。漂亮。现在就要开始拍摄了。

english: ~z~Yo, listen, homeboy, I need you to do me a favor man. Listen man, I need you to help me out man.
zh: ~z~哟，听着，老兄，我需要你帮我个忙。听着伙计，你一定要帮我。

english: ~z~Yeah, you know, it was a real big thing for me, you know what I'm sayin', a real street cat,
zh: ~z~是的，要知道，这对我真的是意义重大，懂我意思吗。真正的街道卫士，

english: ~z~Tighten up Manny. I need you guys tight. This is gonna be great. Okay good. Thank you. A little closer.
zh: ~z~站近点，曼尼。你俩站近点。效果会很好的。好，好。谢谢。再近点。

english: ~z~Yo man, I was getting my flow on, man, I ain't rapped for years.
zh: ~z~哟，伙计，我刚才在找感觉，伙计，好多年没唱Rap了。

english: ~z~Cause yo, I promised Mr. McReary I was gonna get this place cleaned up and I will.
zh: ~z~因为我答应了麦克雷里先生会把这里收拾干净，说到做到。

english: ~z~I mean, where I'm from, out here, man, police is a dirty word man.
zh: ~z~我是说，在我老家，外面的街区，伙计，「警察」是句骂人话，伙计。

english: ~z~It's all business with you kid, but that's okay. Money's what makes these streets sing, man.
zh: ~z~对你来说都是生意，小子，不过也行。有钱才能让街道高歌嘛，伙计。

english: ~z~Hey, man, you know, for a cop, you ain't so bad man, you know. Give it up, the streets, man. Word, give it up.
zh: ~z~嘿，伙计，其实吧，作为警察，你还蛮不错的，伙计。加油吧，为了街道，伙计。说话算话，加油吧。

english: ~z~I need you to get some bitches taken out, moved on, whatever.
zh: ~z~帮我解决一些贱人，干掉也行，赶走也行，怎样都行。

english: ~z~Niko, you cold, man. You cold and you ain't doing shit right. Come see me.
zh: ~z~尼克，没良心的，伙计。没良心还办不成事。过来找我。

english: ~z~Hey, Officer McReary, this is Niko right here. This is my man Niko.
zh: ~z~嘿，麦克雷里警官，这边这位就是尼克。我的伙计尼克。

english: ~z~Man, they disrespected the codes of the streets, man. The streets man. They owe you man. They owe you big time.
zh: ~z~伙计，他们不尊重街道的规矩，伙计。为了街道，伙计。街道欠你的，伙计。街道欠你个大人情。

english: ~z~All I can say is I hope you'll continue to make the community a better place.
zh: ~z~我能说的就是，衷心希望你能让这个社区不断变好。

english: ~z~A bunch man, a bunch. They're hanging out and making bad shit happen all over South Bohan man.
zh: ~z~一大群，伙计，一大群。他们四处游荡，弄得南波汉不得安宁，伙计。

english: ~z~Manny, I got rid of your street problem, now help me out with my financial one.
zh: ~z~曼尼，我帮你解决了街道问题，现在轮到你帮我解决经济问题了。

english: ~z~Okay guys, I just want to get one more shot please. This is gonna look great.
zh: ~z~好了各位，再拍一个镜头就可以了。效果会很好的。

english: ~z~Oh, good to meet you, I hear you're helping this guy with his vital work for our city.
zh: ~z~哦，很高兴见到你，听说在他为我市所做的重大贡献中，你帮了不少忙。

english: ~z~I'm gonna thank you in all my acceptance speeches, man, for real.
zh: ~z~以后我致辞的时候一定会记得感谢你的，伙计，真的。

english: ~z~-Man, who the hell ever heard of a metrosexual ex-gangster, man?~n~-Hey!
zh: ~z~－伙计，谁他妈见过混过黑道的都市美男啊，伙计？~n~－喂！

english: ~z~When we going get us a Patriot or something? Ride in style.
zh: ~z~什么时候才能整辆爱国者之类的给我们乘？有范的座驾。

english: ~z~-Yo man! You made me look gay, man. I warned you, bro.~n~-in the art of competitive street dancing.
zh: ~z~－哟，伙计！你拍得我像个基佬，伙计。我早说了，老兄。~n~－竞技街舞的技巧。

english: ~z~Yo I tried, man, I tried to be a good guy. I said, I'm reformed, man.
zh: ~z~哟，我尽力了，伙计，我尽量在做好人。我说了，我已经洗心革面了，伙计。

english: ~z~You see that, man? You see that, man? Yo, that is streets right there, man.
zh: ~z~见着了吧，伙计？见着了吧，伙计？哟，那才是街道，伙计。

english: ~z~They got away? That just ain't good enough, man. This is my rep that's in danger. Shit.
zh: ~z~他们跑了？那可不太妙，伙计。我的名声有危险了。操。

english: ~z~I thought you was the streets, man? You ain't shit, man.
zh: ~z~亏我当你是街道的一份子，伙计。你屁都不是，伙计。

english: ~z~A'ight, man. Yo listen, can you shut these punks up for me please?
zh: ~z~好了，伙计。哟，听着，能不能拜托你替我堵上那些蠢货的嘴？

english: ~z~I'm a lord, man, not a lady. This show was gonna make me famous!
zh: ~z~我是领主，伙计，不是贵妇。拍这片子是为了让我出名的。

english: ~z~You know what happened last time some puto thought he'd stare me down.
zh: ~z~你也知道上次那个觉得自己能瞪过我的波多黎各人下场如何。

english: ~z~What? No? You don't look gay. You look a little metrosexual or something.
zh: ~z~啥？没吧？一点都不基。看起来有点像都市美男。

english: Escort Petrovic's ~b~daughter ~s~and her ~b~friends ~s~to where they want to go.
zh: 把彼得罗维奇的~b~女儿~s~和她的~b~朋友们~s~送到她们要去的地方

english: Press ~PAD_DPAD_RIGHT~ for projectiles, press ~PAD_DPAD_DOWN~ for shotguns, press ~PAD_DPAD_LEFT~ for pistols, and press ~PAD_DPAD_UP~ to switch between assault rifle and submachine gun.
zh: 按~PAD_DPAD_RIGHT~选择投掷物，按~PAD_DPAD_DOWN~选择霰弹枪，按~PAD_DPAD_LEFT~选择手枪，按下~PAD_DPAD_UP~可以在突击步枪与冲锋枪间切换。

english: ~s~The target is on that train. Follow the ~r~train~s~ and take him out when he gets off.
zh: ~s~目标在那辆列车上。跟着~r~列车，~s~在他下车后干掉他。

english: The chase camera will focus on the target you are pursuing allowing you track their movements.
zh: 追逐视角会将镜头对准目标，便于观察其行进方向。

english: N.O.O.S.E. are raiding the hospital; get out of there, and lose your wanted level.~s~
zh: N.O.O.S.E。正在突袭医院。离开医院，摆脱通缉。~s~

english: ~z~I don't know, I'm just surprised you have not found more success with your... talents.
zh: ~z~我不知道，我只是奇怪，凭你的...天赋，怎么没混得更成功。

english: ~z~I cannot believe that you would steal from my friend Ray Bulgarin twice.
zh: ~z~我真是不能相信，你居然偷了我朋友雷･布尔加林的东西两次。

english: ~z~We need to talk in person. I'll be on the Firefly Island boardwalk from 5pm to 3am.
zh: ~z~我们得当面谈。下午 5 点到凌晨 3 点我在萤火虫岛海滨步道。

english: ~z~Now that I hear you are friends with Bryce Dawkins and Bernie Crane, I know what it is.
zh: ~z~现在我听说你跟布莱斯･道金斯和伯尼･克兰是朋友，就知道哪儿不对了。

english: ~z~They might want to make different decisions. Enjoy your life, I don't want nothing more to do with you.
zh: ~z~他们也许想做不同的决定。过好你自己的日子，我再也不想跟你有任何瓜葛。

english: ~z~You're right. You are lucky now though. This is a good partnership.
zh: ~z~你说得对。不过你现在运气不错。这是桩好买卖。

english: ~z~I nearly ran into your cousin the other day. My friends were hanging out with him.
zh: ~z~前两天我差点就碰到你堂兄了。当时我的朋友和他在一起。

english: ~z~So, this is what the dream feels like, this is the victory we longed for.
zh: ~z~原来，这就是梦想成真的感觉，这就是我们渴求已久的胜利。

english: ~z~Niko Bellic, we did not find your body with the others in the warehouse.
zh: ~z~尼克･贝利克，我们没在仓库的那些尸体里面找到你。

english: ~z~I'll be on the Firefly Island boardwalk all evening. I hope to see you there.
zh: ~z~我一整晚都在萤火虫岛海滨步道。希望在那儿见到你。

english: ~z~Mr. Faustin does not care about how hard you are trying, he cares about this getting done.
zh: ~z~福斯汀先生不在乎你有多努力，他只在乎事情办没办成。

english: ~z~You have a sharp tongue, Niko. It is only a matter of time before it is cut out of your mouth.
zh: ~z~你的嘴可真毒啊，尼克。你迟早会死在自己这张嘴上。

english: ~z~Niko, you are doing very well for us. You are good, almost too good.
zh: ~z~尼克，你替我们干得很好。你很有本事，好得有点过头。

english: ~z~We need to talk in person. I'll be on the Firefly Island boardwalk from 5pm to 3am.
zh: ~z~我们得当面谈。下午 5 点到凌晨 3 点我在萤火虫岛海滨步道。

english: ~z~You, if you drink and drive, Niko, you're a bloody idiot.
zh: ~z~你，要是你酒后驾驶，尼克，那你丫真的是傻逼了。

english: ~z~You robbed Bulgarin, you killed Mikhail. You know no more of loyalty than I do.
zh: ~z~你抢了布尔加林，你杀了米哈伊尔。你的忠诚一点都不比我多。

english: ~z~You might want to check in jail or hospital. This city is full of crazy people.
zh: ~z~你可以去监狱或者医院看看。这座城里满是疯狂的人。

english: ~z~Stop blackmailing my friends, Dimitri. You do not want to anger me more.
zh: ~z~别再勒索我的朋友了，迪米特里。你不会想再惹毛我一次的。

english: ~z~I was loyal to you, Dimitri. Why did you turn on me?
zh: ~z~我对你那么忠诚，迪米特里，为什么你要背叛我？

english: ~z~I will smoke you out of any other hiding place you have in this city. See you soon, Niko.

zh: ~z~尼克老兄，最近怎么样？给那帮意裔混混干活感觉如何？

english: ~z~Well, if I'd a known it was such a big deal to you, I woulda asked you to let them kill me.
zh: ~z~早知道对你意义这么重大，我就该求你让他们杀了我的。

english: ~z~That said, the only celebrating Gerry's gonna be able to do will be in prison. He got hauled in last night.
zh: ~z~不过，格里就算想庆祝也只能在监狱庆祝了。昨晚他被抓进去了。

english: ~z~Remember to wear a suit, Niko. We can't have you dressed like a bum in the church.
zh: ~z~记得穿正装，尼克。我们可不能让你穿得像乞丐一样进教堂。

english: ~z~Gerry said you did good by him - he's grateful. Says you're the first decent person I ever introduced him to.
zh: ~z~杰里说你帮了他大忙，他很感激。说我介绍给他的人里，你是头一个正经人。

english: ~z~If you have a complaint about a high ranking official, please leave your details after the tone.
zh: ~z~如果你对高级官员有抱怨，请在哔声后留下具体信息。

english: ~z~She didn't do nothing to nobody. It was us McReary men who were the sinners.
zh: ~z~她没有伤害过任何人。明明我们麦克雷里家的男人才是罪人。

english: ~z~Don't worry, he's always being hauled in but the charges don't stick.
zh: ~z~别担心，他经常进去，不过罪名不会太重就是了。

english: ~z~I don't think I like it any better than you and your brother do. We gotta make a living though, don't we?
zh: ~z~我和你跟你兄弟一样不喜欢这行。可日子总得过，不是吗？

english: ~z~Yes - you better stop embarrassing me - if I lose my reputation as the family fuck up, I'll never forgive you.
zh: ~z~是啊，你最好别再让我丢脸。要是我「家里废物」的名声没了，我绝不原谅你。

english: ~z~Half my mates is dead and the other half is in AA so I'm kinda bored.
zh: ~z~我兄弟一半死了，另一半在戒酒会，所以有点无聊。

english: ~z~Anyway, listen you want to hang out some time, go for some drinks, give us a call.
zh: ~z~总之，想什么时候出来聚聚、喝两杯，就打给我们。

english: ~z~Niko, it's Patrick McReary. You and me did some work for Elizabeta Torres together.
zh: ~z~尼克，我是帕特里克･麦克雷里。我们一起替伊丽莎贝塔･托雷斯干过活的。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, Packie. I was there, I tried to stop it...
zh: ~z~我很抱歉，派奇。我当时在场，我没能阻止他...

english: ~z~Roman's going to miss me, but it'll be useful. Thanks, Packie, later on.
zh: ~z~罗曼会想我的，不过这房子会派上用场。谢了，派奇，回头见。

english: ~z~I just hope he was smacked out of his brain when it happened because it wouldn't have suited him to be jonesing when he died.
zh: ~z~我只希望他的致命伤在脑子上，至少这样他死的时候不会犯毒瘾。

english: ~z~He's in a bad way. Last I heard he was spending his hours in some park in Acter.
zh: ~z~最近他情况不太好。我最后听说到的是他在阿克特的一个公园里消磨时光。

english: ~z~Anyways, I weren't talking about me. When are you making an honest woman of my sister?
zh: ~z~再说了，我问的是你。你什么时候跟我妹妹结婚？

english: ~z~Charges ain't gonna stick, don't worry. Anyway, it'd mean a lot to the family if you'd come to Francis's funeral.
zh: ~z~指控不会太重的，别担心。总之，你要是能来参加弗朗西斯的葬礼的话，对家族的意义还是很大的。

english: ~z~Remember to wear a suit, Niko. We can't have you dressed like a bum in the church.
zh: ~z~记得穿正装，尼克。我们可不能让你穿得像乞丐一样进教堂。

english: ~z~I'll give her a call man, but I don't think she'll wanna see me.
zh: ~z~我会打给她的，老兄，不过我不觉得她会想见我。

english: ~z~I gotta be with me Ma, Niko. She don't got much left other than me. And that ain't much... see you, man.
zh: ~z~我得去陪妈了，尼克。她剩下的就只有我了。所剩无几了...再见了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Come to Derrick's funeral. It'd mean a lot to the family. It's today at the Church in Suffolk.
zh: ~z~来参加德里克的葬礼吧，对家族的意义还是很大的。就是今天，在萨福克的教堂举办。

english: ~z~I don't think I like it any better than you and your brother do. We gotta make a living though, don't we?
zh: ~z~我和你跟你兄弟一样不喜欢这行。可日子总得过，不是吗？

english: ~z~She likes you, just as friends, I'm gonna send you her number.
zh: ~z~她喜欢你，作为普通朋友的喜欢，等下我把她的号码发你。

english: ~z~Niko, my man, how's it going? How you like working for those guidos?
zh: ~z~尼克老兄，最近怎么样？给那帮意裔混混干活感觉如何？

english: ~z~Niko, I don't know if you've heard it but my brother, Derrick's dead.
zh: ~z~尼克，不知道你有没有听说，但是我哥哥德里克他死了。

english: ~z~Go down and check on him? Me and Gerald will cover any expenses incurred.
zh: ~z~你能不能去看看他？产生的开销我和格里会给你报销的。

english: ~z~Go down and check on him? Me and Gerald will cover any expenses incurred.
zh: ~z~你能不能去看看他？产生的开销我和格里会给你报销的。

english: ~z~You remember my brother Derrick, came along on the bank job?
zh: ~z~你还记得我哥哥德里克吗，银行那票的时候一起的？

english: ~z~I guess not, Gerald got arrested too. They got him in the Alderney State Correctional Facility.
zh: ~z~大概没有。格里也被捕了。他被关进了奥尔德尼州立监狱。

english: ~z~I mean that my cop brother Francis McReary is no longer with us.
zh: ~z~我是说我的条子哥哥弗朗西斯･麦克雷里与世长辞了。

english: ~z~He's in a bad way. Last I heard he was spending his hours in some park in Acter.
zh: ~z~最近他情况不太好。我最后听说到的是他在阿克特的一个公园里消磨时光。

english: ~z~I think he is worried I'm too much of a skeleton in his closet if he chooses to run for mayor.
zh: ~z~咱觉得他是怕咱的存在对他竞选市长会有很大影响。

english: ~z~Have fun on the outside, Niko! Look after your cousin and Mallorie.
zh: ~z~享受外面的生活吧，尼克！照顾好你的堂兄和玛洛丽。

english: ~z~Sometimes I think my past is all I got. So long. You look after yourself.
zh: ~z~有时候我觉得过去就是我拥有的一切。再见，你多保重。

english: ~z~The guilt has destroyed him. I don't know. Somehow it was better to walk away.
zh: ~z~他的罪行已经毁了他。我也不知道。可能还是直接走开比较好。

english: ~z~She's in on a trafficking beef. We'll keep each other company for the next five years.
zh: ~z~她也是贩毒被抓进来的。接下来的五年我们会住在一起。

english: ~z~This is a voice from your past Niko. Can you guess who it is?
zh: ~z~这是一个来自你过去的声音，尼克。猜猜咱是谁？

english: ~z~Well he doesn't know I'm giving you this but he gave it to me so it's technically from him.
zh: ~z~好吧，他不知道咱要送你这个，不过这个就是他送咱的，所以严格来说算是他送的。

english: ~z~I only power walk or take cabs so I figured I should pass this on to my savior.
zh: ~z~咱只会走路或者打的，所以咱觉得还是送给救命恩人比较好。

english: ~z~Shut the fuck up, Jacob. Niko, I hear you can understand this rasta shit.
zh: ~z~你他妈闭嘴，雅各布。尼克，听说你听得懂这个牙买加白痴说话。

english: ~z~Florian, I thought you should know, Darko is dead. He's finally paid for his crimes.
zh: ~z~弗洛里安，我想有必要告诉你，达尔科死了。他终于为他的罪行付出了代价。

english: ~z~You'll be okay. Go get a face pack, and stay in touch. I've got to go, see you later.
zh: ~z~很快就会过去的。你去敷个面膜吧，有空再聊。我现在得挂了，回头见。

english: ~z~Thank you, Bryce Dawkins. I hope the cash for this didn't come out of city funds.
zh: ~z~谢谢你，布莱斯･道金斯。希望买车的钱不是从政府资金里榨出来的。

english: ~z~This is Ilyena Faustin. If you are looking for Mikhail, or wanting to collect on a debt, then please look elsewhere.
zh: ~z~我是伊莲娜 福斯汀。如果你在找米哈伊尔，或者想要讨债，还是另请高明吧。

english: ~z~I don't know if you'd heard Niko, but Kim, the Korean kid we brought into the country, got taken down.
zh: ~z~不知道你有没有听说，尼克。但是我们护送入境的朝鲜人，金，被杀了。

english: ~z~Florian, I thought I should let you know, I found Darko.
zh: ~z~弗洛里安，我想有必要告诉你，我找到达尔科了。

english: ~z~Shut the fuck up, Jacob. Niko, I hear you can understand this rasta shit.
zh: ~z~你他妈闭嘴，雅各布。尼克，听说你听得懂这个牙买加白痴说话。

english: ~z~See you around. You're a great guy. I hope you find what you're looking for.
zh: ~z~有缘再见了。你是个好人。祝你早日找到那家伙。

english: ~z~Thanks for coming to the funeral, Niko. And for looking after me family. I was in no state to do nothing.
zh: ~z~多谢你能来参加葬礼，尼克。你还保护的我的家人。当时我没心情做任何事。

english: ~z~I don't think I've ever played peacemaker, but I'll be there in a bit.
zh: ~z~我好像从来没当过和事佬，不过我会马上过来的。

english: ~z~We are friends from the Old Country, nothing more. ~c~Can't he understand that?
zh: ~z~我们只是在故国时就认识的朋友，仅此而已。~c~他就不明白吗？

english: ~z~Niko, Niko. You there? You there? Bet there are about a hundred cops listening to this shit and you can't even hear me.
zh: ~z~尼克，尼克，是你吗？是你吗？估计有一百个警察在听这通电话，你都听不见我说话了。

english: ~z~It was all a lie! I see that now. I've been an idiot all along.
zh: ~z~结果都是假的！现在咱明白了。咱一直都是个傻子。

english: ~z~My husband is dead. Show Anna and I respect by leaving us be.
zh: ~z~我的丈夫已经死了。对安娜和我尊重一点，别管我们了。

english: ~z~This is Elizabeta. Sorry, I'm away from the phone at the moment. Try me again in twenty five years or so.
zh: ~z~我是伊丽莎贝塔。抱歉，现在我暂时无法接听。大概二十五年后再来找我吧。

english: ~z~You? Those bastards were after me long before you showed up. Too many parties, too much coke,
zh: ~z~你？见着你之前这帮混蛋就盯上我了。天天开派对，大量可卡因，

english: ~z~I'm a walking cliché, Niko. An embarrassment, to him and to everyone.
zh: ~z~咱就是个傻子，尼克。无论对他还是对谁都是累赘。

english: ~z~I don't think I've ever played peacemaker, but I'll be there in a bit.
zh: ~z~我好像从来没当过和事佬，不过我会马上过来的。

english: ~z~Well he doesn't know I'm giving you this but he gave it to me so it's technically from him.
zh: ~z~好吧，他不知道咱要送你这个，不过这个就是他送咱的，所以严格来说算是他送的。

english: ~z~I pinned my hopes on this guy, and he left me. Said I was an embarrassment.
zh: ~z~咱把希望寄托在他身上，而他抛弃了咱。他说咱是个累赘。

english: ~z~Niko, my boy, I left you something at your house. A token of me gratitude, should come in handy with your line of work.
zh: ~z~尼克，好孩子，我在你家留了样东西，一点小小的心意，对你的工作应该会有用。

english: ~z~I'm here, Elizabeta. I was sorry to hear you got in trouble. I hope I wasn't something to do with it?
zh: ~z~是我，伊丽莎贝塔。很遗憾你进监狱了。应该跟我没什么关系吧？

english: ~z~Yeah, I guess every immigrant's story, ain't the fairytale yours is.
zh: ~z~是啊，我想也不是所有移民的故事都是你这样的童话。

english: ~z~If this is a business call then use the right fucking number. Adios.
zh: ~z~如果你是来谈生意的，那他妈就换个号打。再见。

english: ~z~I have to make things work with him. He's my life.
zh: ~z~咱必须维护好咱和他之间的关系。他是咱的全部。

english: ~z~Yeah, mine's a real fairytale, Derrick. I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy. Later on, man.
zh: ~z~嗯，我的生活是个童话，德里克。这个童话还是谁都别去读比较好。回见，老兄。

english: ~z~Nothing's gonna get rid of the truth, I may as well be wandering with a mark on me head. Later on, Niko.
zh: ~z~但事实就是事实，也许我也要带着记号流离漂荡了。回见，尼克。

english: ~z~Gravelli is the only man who can get what you need done. He's in Schottler Medical center.
zh: ~z~格拉韦利是唯一一个可以满足你需求的人。他在舒特勒的医疗中心。

english: ~z~I'm pregnant, we were going to say something at the reception.
zh: ~z~我怀孕了，本来我们要在喝喜酒的时候说点事情的。

english: ~z~Hey, you've reached the phone of the future Mrs. Bellic. Leave me or Roman a message and we'll get back to you.
zh: ~z~嘿，你呼叫的是未来的贝利克太太。给我或罗曼留个消息，我们会回复你的。

english: ~z~I don't know what she is, but she was lying to us all along and now I'm paying for it.
zh: ~z~我不知道她是什么，但她一直以来都在骗我们，现在我为此付出代价了。

english: ~z~He don't act like it. Piece of shit, when I get my hands on him I'm going to...
zh: ~z~他不能那么做。操他妈的，等我再见到他，我就要...

english: ~z~I'm already working for a Mafia family. They are scum.
zh: ~z~我已经在替一个黑手党家族做事了。他们是人渣。

english: ~z~Bellic, I have your man. He's been flown in. We're going to drop him in the airport cargo area for you.
zh: ~z~贝利克，你要的人在了，马上就送过来。我们会在机场货运区把他交给你。

english: ~z~Give him some of his own medicine - find out if he was serious about me.
zh: ~z~想让他尝尝我对他乱搞的感受，试试他对我到底是不是认真的。

english: ~z~Niko, tell me straight. Was Roman with another woman last night? I swear I'm going to cut his balls off.
zh: ~z~尼克，跟我说实话。罗曼昨晚是不是又在找别的女人？我发誓我要把他给阉了。

english: ~z~So, I hear you've found the big bad monster you were after? Bernie Crane, the muscle Mary. Come on.
zh: ~z~听说你找到你在找的那条大恶龙了？伯尼･克兰，就那肌肉玫瑰？得了吧。

english: ~z~Good thing you haven't been hanging around with them too much. That shit is fucked up. I'm sorry for getting you involved.
zh: ~z~幸好你没跟他们混太久。那边全他妈完了。很抱歉把你牵扯进去了。

english: ~z~Hello, you have reached United Liberty Paper Merchants. None of our operatives can come to the phone.
zh: ~z~您好，您呼叫的是联合自由纸业。我们的员工暂时无暇接听。

english: ~z~Thank you, Niko. I know you're trying, but a child without a father has a lot to worry about. Trust me on that one.
zh: ~z~谢谢你，尼克。我知道你尽力了，但是一个没有父亲的孩子会有很多需要担心的。这点你要相信我。

english: ~z~You're out. You've done good things for us and we are grateful. That said, I've given you a lot of protection.
zh: ~z~你自由了。你替我们做了很多，十分感谢。再说，我们给你的保护已经够多了。

english: ~z~I'm helping you find the man you're after, I'm not some reunite old boyfriends service. Look, I was in the army.
zh: ~z~我正在帮你找你要找的人，我可不是什么老男友重聚服务。听着，我也当过兵。

english: ~z~Niko. The shit went down with those guys in Bohan. Elizabeta's doing a bid. I think she might have killed Manny.
zh: ~z~尼克，波汉那些人出事了。伊丽莎贝塔坐牢去了，我想她可能还杀了曼尼。

english: ~z~Elizabeta Torres, she's got an apartment on San Quentin in Fortside. Meet me there.
zh: ~z~伊丽莎贝塔･托雷斯，她在福特赛德的圣昆汀大道有间公寓。到那儿找我。

english: ~z~Hey, Niko. It's Mallorie. I've got a personal question for you.
zh: ~z~喂，尼克，我是玛洛丽。我有一个私人问题要问你。

english: ~z~Putanesca. There was always something funky about her. I'm real sorry.
zh: ~z~贱人。确实一直有关于她的流言。我真的很抱歉。

english: ~z~Maybe you have learned something, Bellic. Goodbye and good luck. Try to live a good life.
zh: ~z~看来你有长进了，贝利克。再见，祝你好运。以后过正经日子吧。

english: ~z~For him, death would have been a release. For me, another stain I do not need.
zh: ~z~于他，死亡是一种解脱。于我，杀了他也无济于事。

english: ~z~So, you got your revenge. I hope it gave you the satisfaction you were looking for.
zh: ~z~那，你完成复仇了。希望你已经得到了你在追寻的满足感。

english: ~z~I must be getting paranoid. Of course Roman wouldn't. Thanks Niko.
zh: ~z~一定是我想太多了，罗曼当然不会这样。谢了，尼克。

english: ~z~That's exactly right, he's an old school romantic. See you soon, Mal.
zh: ~z~完全就是这样，他是那种老派浪漫的人。之后见，马尔。

english: ~z~Come on, Mallorie. Roman wouldn't do something like that to the love of his life.
zh: ~z~放松，玛洛丽。罗曼不会对她的一生挚爱这么做的。

english: ~z~I know it gets lonely. I know what it feels like to get close to a man.
zh: ~z~我知道会很孤单，我也知道接近一个人是什么感觉。

english: ~z~Roman hasn't spoken to you about anything, has he? Nothing about maybe asking me to marry him?
zh: ~z~罗曼最近没跟你说什么吧？有没有说过要向我求婚？

english: ~z~I been taking a lot of heat for you, Niko. Start doing me some favors.
zh: ~z~我已经为你顶了不少压力了，尼克。总该帮我点忙了吧。

english: ~z~You know Roman, he has these other women but you're the only one he loves.
zh: ~z~你知道罗曼，他外面是有些别的女人，但你才是他唯一爱的人。

english: ~z~I've already helped you but I'll help you again. Wait for me to be in touch.
zh: ~z~我已经帮过你一次了，不过会再帮一次。等我的联络吧。

english: ~z~Don't worry about it. You've got enough on your plate looking after Roman. See you soon.
zh: ~z~别担心。你光是照顾罗曼就已经够忙了。之后见。

english: ~z~Thanks and hey, Roman and I decided to be honest with each other last night. He told me about Vlad.
zh: ~z~谢了。噢对，罗曼和我昨晚决定对彼此坦诚了。弗拉德的事他跟我说了。

english: ~z~Is your johnson so big you can't keep it in your pants, Bellic? I told you to be calm.
zh: ~z~你的老二已经大到裤子里装不下了吗，贝利克？我告诉过你要冷静了。

english: ~z~Elizabeta Torres, she's got an apartment on San Quentin in Fortside. Meet me there.
zh: ~z~伊丽莎贝塔･托雷斯，她在福特赛德的圣昆汀大道有间公寓。到那儿找我。

english: ~z~Yeah, thanks for helping him get rid of the body. He has such fire in his heart.
zh: ~z~对，谢谢你帮他处理尸体。他心里居然还有这种怒火。

english: ~z~Niko, I heard that Michelle was a cop or a fed or something, is it true?
zh: ~z~尼克，听说米歇尔好像是个条子还是FIB之类的，是真的吗？

english: ~z~Roman and I are getting on well now, and I don't want this shit to jeopardize anything. Thanks Niko.
zh: ~z~罗曼和我现在处得很好，我不想因为他让生活被破坏。谢了，尼克。

english: ~z~I haven't heard anything, but I'm sure it would be a really good thing for both of you.
zh: ~z~他没跟我说过。不过我敢肯定，这对你们两个都是好事。

english: ~z~I don't know what she is, but she was lying to us all along and now I'm paying for it.
zh: ~z~我不知道她是什么，但她一直以来都在骗我们，现在我为此付出代价了。

english: ~z~Putanesca. There was always something funky about her. I'm real sorry.
zh: ~z~贱人。确实一直有关于她的流言。我真的很抱歉。

english: ~z~His love for me took over and he just had to kill him.
zh: ~z~他被对我的爱冲昏了头脑，就只能杀了弗拉德了。

english: ~z~Bellic, I want to introduce you to John Gravelli, head of the Gambetti family. He needs help.

zh: ~z~我只希望他的力量足够帮我找到达尔科･布雷维奇。

english: ~z~Don't get ahead of yourself, Niko. Be careful around these men. Talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~别做力不能及的事情，尼克。和这些人一起的时候当心点。以后再聊。

english: ~z~There are all types of people here. Most of them ignore you, some of them want to employ you, some of them want to kill you,
zh: ~z~这里有形形色色的人。大多数会忽略你，部分人想雇佣你，有的人想杀了你，

zh: ~z~罗曼，我再次为没来找你道歉。到美国后你已经帮了我很多了。

english: ~z~Niko, where are you? I'm at the church now! I'm getting married.
zh: ~z~尼克，你在哪儿？我现在在教堂了！我要结婚了。

english: ~z~Roman, you'd never believe it but I met this girl on Craplist.
zh: ~z~罗曼，你肯定不敢相信，但我在Craplist约到妹子了。

english: ~z~Wants to be. Keeps talking about being powerful, about getting on the Commission with the five big families.
zh: ~z~他也想啊。一直在说要做大做强，说要加入五大家族所在的委员会。

english: ~z~He just got out of prison and he hasn't got much but... I made the right decision.
zh: ~z~他才刚出狱，身上也没几个子，不过...我做了正确的选择。

english: ~z~Good, I feel like I am getting close. I have been working for Jon Gravelli.
zh: ~z~挺好的，感觉我已经很接近了。我最近在替乔恩･格拉韦利干活。

english: ~z~I'm working for this guy, Phil Bell, at the moment. He's better than Ray Boccino.
zh: ~z~我现在在和这个人做事，菲尔･贝尔。他这人比雷･博奇诺要好。

english: ~z~Not when it means me getting beat up and sent to hospital. Come and pick me up, cousin.
zh: ~z~那会儿我也没被人暴揍一顿送进医院啊。过来接我，堂弟。

english: ~z~It's all sport, NB. Have some fun with her. Later on, cousin. I'm proud of you.
zh: ~z~就当是玩玩吧，NB。祝你玩得愉快。回见，堂弟。我为你骄傲。

zh: ~z~一条没那么暴力的路。我会再和你联系的，好吧？

zh: ~z~你最好比很好还要好，堂弟。早上十点到教堂来，衣服记得穿好点。

zh: ~z~你不会想招上这种事的。拿到你那份钻石的分成就脱身吧。

english: ~z~Yeah, the head of the family. Is he a big time gangster like in the movies then?
zh: ~z~嗯，家族老大。那他是不是像电影里演的那种黑帮大佬一样？

english: ~z~And at least tell me that you got her titties out? Maybe then your betrayal would be worthwhile.
zh: ~z~有没有摸到她的奶子？摸到的话你的背叛倒还算值得。

zh: ~z~真是可耻，尼克･贝利克。你自己也知道的。她是谁？谁让你绑架她的？

zh: ~z~一个叫亚历克斯的啃老族。我不太喜欢她，不过也是一种消遣，对吧？

english: ~z~Great, Niko. I've got my hands full at the moment with these charming money lenders I know.
zh: ~z~真好，尼克。现在我正忙着对付那些友善的债主呢。

zh: ~z~我最近在替吉米･佩戈里诺做事，他是奥尔德尼的那个意大利家族的老大。

zh: ~z~罗曼，关于自由城你说的没错。这是个疯狂的地方。

zh: ~z~你是说一晚上睡了两个女人，结果她们是母女的那种吗？

zh: ~z~他是个蟑螂，是害虫。但我不知道这种杀人买卖我还能做多久。

zh: ~z~他们说的我都照做，除了出卖你，堂弟。我都快吓死了。

zh: ~z~再说了，刚才我去找米歇尔了。之前不是你想让我去约她吗？

zh: ~z~我在给那个爱尔兰家族做事。她是黑帮老大的女儿，格雷西･安切洛蒂。

zh: ~z~尼克，我靠。你丫惹上大家伙了。安切洛蒂家族是五大家族之一。

zh: ~z~感谢你这个大忙人能抽出时间，从那些你招惹的高利贷疯子手里保护我，尼克。

english: ~z~Paranoid about wire taps and helicopters but he seems legitimate.
zh: ~z~虽然整天担心窃听和直升机监视，但他正经多了。

english: ~z~That's what I thought. I've had to kidnap this girl and she's a fucking nightmare.
zh: ~z~和我想的一样。我被迫绑架这个女孩，而她他妈是个噩梦。

english: ~z~Look you'll have to have some fun with the nurses because I can't pick you up. See you soon.
zh: ~z~我没法来接你，看来你得和护士们找会儿乐子了。回头见。

english: ~z~You're shitting me, NB. No fucking way! Who'd you do it with?
zh: ~z~你不要骗我，NB。这他妈不可能！你跟谁一起干的？

english: ~z~Have you seen this bank heist on the news, NB? That's some crazy shit. I bet you wish you'd pulled off a job like that...
zh: ~z~你看过这个银行劫案的新闻了吗，NB？实在是太疯狂了。我看你肯定也想干这么一票...

english: ~z~Make sure you get lots of beauty sleep. You need to be at the church at 10am though.
zh: ~z~晚上务必要睡得好点。明早十点你就要到教堂了。

english: ~z~I don't know nothing about this. Give her back as soon as you can. I've got to go, Niko.
zh: ~z~具体我也不太清楚。尽快把她放了吧。先挂了，尼克。

english: ~z~I mean like this Dominican looking guy shot up a deal I was trying to make.
zh: ~z~我是说这个多米尼加人先开枪搅乱了我的钻石交易。

english: ~z~Remember to make it clear that you are a red blooded animal though and you won't be tied down
zh: ~z~不过记得先跟她说好，你是一个血气方刚的猛兽，这样就不会被

english: ~z~I need to work with these guys. Hopefully they'll be able to find Darko Brevic for me.
zh: ~z~我需要帮他们做事。他们有希望帮我找到达尔科･布雷维奇。

english: ~z~and the other is a heroin addict ex-freedom fighter. Then there's a sister...
zh: ~z~还有一个是海洛因成瘾的前自由斗士。然后就是妹妹...

english: ~z~If she was not a friend of Mallorie's it would be me with the smell of tittie on my breath and you who ended up in hospital.
zh: ~z~要不是因为她是玛洛丽的朋友，呼吸里透着她的奶子味的人就会是我，该进医院的就是你了。

english: ~z~There is the man who chose cooch before his cousin. I hope she was worth it.
zh: ~z~有个人在他堂兄前选了马子，希望那女人是值得的。

english: ~z~Stay disorganized would be my advice, Niko. Don't let them get you for racketeering.
zh: ~z~建议你保持无组织，尼克。别让他们以涉黑罪逮捕你。

english: ~z~You're an animal, Roman. Nothing can stop you being horny. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~你这个禽兽，罗曼，什么时候都能发情。我马上来接你。

english: ~z~He tried to get me to get rid of a friend of his for him but, uh, I liked the friend better.
zh: ~z~他让我帮忙除掉他的一个朋友，不过...我更喜欢他的朋友。

english: ~z~That is a useful profession considering your job, NB. Good work.
zh: ~z~=对你这个杀手来说还挺有用的嘛，NB。干得好。

english: ~z~So, he steals the diamonds at the deal and then has to give them back for the girl. What's the big deal?
zh: ~z~所以就是，他在交易的时候偷走了钻石，然后又为了这女孩把钻石交了回来。那有什么？

english: ~z~That won't be a problem, Roman. We're not serious. I'll talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~不会有问题的，罗曼。我们也就玩玩。我会再跟你聊的。

english: ~z~some of them want to fuck you. It's mad cousin. Enjoy the ride.
zh: ~z~甚至有人想上你。是很疯狂，堂弟。享受生活吧。

english: ~z~Not much, cousin. I've gone on a date with this girl I met on Lovemeet.
zh: ~z~没什么，堂兄。我跟一个在觅爱网找到的女孩约会了。

english: ~z~Hey Roman. You ever wonder if things are just coincidence or if everything is all planned?
zh: ~z~喂，罗曼。你有没有想过有些事是巧合，还是说都是被计划好的？

english: ~z~I can tell from your voice that you like her, Cousin. Are you two doing it?
zh: ~z~听你的声音我就知道你喜欢她，堂弟。你俩好上了吗？

english: ~z~I hope you will be able to relax when you do finally find him, Niko. Speak soon.
zh: ~z~希望你在找到他之后能够放松下来，尼克。以后聊。

english: ~z~How was she cousin? Tell me how she was. I wondered about Michelle when I first met her.
zh: ~z~她怎么样，堂弟？告诉我她怎么样。我第一次见到米歇尔就对她好奇了。

english: ~z~Then, I've kidnapped this girl and we're handing her over for these same diamonds
zh: ~z~然后我绑架了这个女孩，用她换回了同一袋钻石作为赎金，

english: ~z~There ain't no bringing back those you love, that the truth, money. No matter how powerful you are.
zh: ~z~逝去的爱人是唤不回来的，这才是真相，老铁。不管你有多大权势。

english: ~z~he holding up there and needs help with some shit. You assist his broke ass, I'll send some paper your way.
zh: ~z~现在他住在那里，还缺个人给他帮忙。你去帮帮他那把老烂骨头，我会给你钱的。

english: ~z~I can't tell you what happens when it ends, friend. I can tell you that we'll all find out at some point though.
zh: ~z~朋友，我没法告诉你一切结束时会怎样。但我可以告诉你，我们总有一天都会知道的。

english: ~z~Yo money, I appreciate what you doing for me. There be so many fake cats out there.
zh: ~z~哟，老弟，我很欣赏你的能力。外面的假黑道确实很多。

english: ~z~You popped him, man. He raised me, showed me everything a G need to see. Just tell me it didn't hurt him none.
zh: ~z~是你干掉了他，老兄。他养大我，教我一切 G 该懂的事。告诉我，他没受苦。

english: ~z~Hey, it ain't our problem, Playboy - it's yours. That said, I know what I'm going to do.
zh: ~z~嘿，那可不是我们的问题，花花公子，是你的问题。这么说吧，我知道我要做什么。

english: ~z~Playboy? I thought you didn't want to talk to me no more. Too cold hearted?
zh: ~z~花花公子？我还以为你不理我了呢。嫌我心太狠？

english: ~z~You should have known that when you asked me to kill him. I'm hanging up now, Playboy. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~你让我杀他的时候就该明白。我挂了，花花公子。再见。

english: ~z~Sure, just got out of the pen, old friends aren't paying him no mind.
zh: ~z~当然，刚放出来的那个嘛，老朋友们不会不报答他的。

english: ~z~Niko, shit is getting fucked up. I need to see you at my crib.
zh: ~z~尼克，狗屎玩意出大乱子了，我需要你来我家见我。

english: ~z~Yeah, that's what he think. He got friends all over the shop but he living in the past.
zh: ~z~对，他就这么想的。他的朋友到处都有，不过他还活在过去。

english: ~z~Don't help him out when it fucks up my business interests. Damn, son. That ain't cool.
zh: ~z~他动到我的生意利益的时候就他妈别帮他。干，小子。那可不好。

english: ~z~Yo, if you trying to find Playboy you should ask your bitch - ha ha! She probably know where I'm at. Leave a message.
zh: ~z~哟，想找花花公子的话就问你家婊子吧。哈哈！她可能知道我在哪儿。留言吧。

english: ~z~I own this city, player. I can look at anyone in this town and they gonna kill for me.
zh: ~z~这座城是我的，大佬。我看上谁，谁就会为我杀人。

english: ~z~I need you to go over to the Governor Greg Johnson projects over in Northwood,
zh: ~z~我需要你去北伍德区的格雷格･约翰逊州长公屋，

english: ~z~Yo, this is streets. Streets need to sleep, streets need to eat so they don't answer the phone the whole time.
zh: ~z~哟，我是街道。街道需要睡觉，街道需要吃饭，所以不可能全天接电话。

english: ~z~he holding up there and needs help with some shit. You assist his broke ass, I'll send some paper your way.
zh: ~z~现在他住在那里，还缺个人给他帮忙。你去帮帮他那把老烂骨头，我会给你钱的。

english: ~z~I owe that fool - ain't payback a bitch? Peace out, money.
zh: ~z~我欠那个傻逼的——不是要报答那贱人吗？再见，老弟。

english: ~z~Niko, tell me it weren't you that shot up the strip club in Bohan.
zh: ~z~尼克，告诉我在波汉大闹脱衣舞俱乐部的人不是你。

english: ~z~I owe that fool - ain't payback a bitch? Peace out, money.
zh: ~z~我欠那个傻逼的——不是要报答那贱人吗？再见，老弟。

english: ~z~This is the X, giving everyone out there some advice. You don't know what you got 'til it's gone. Leave a message.
zh: ~z~我是X，正在给别人讲人生经验呢。失去之前你也不知道拥有什么。留言吧。

english: ~z~I'll show you what you can make of yourself when you start hustling.
zh: ~z~我会让你看看，一旦开始打拼，你能混成什么样。

english: ~z~Yo money, I appreciate what you doing for me. There be so many fake cats out there.
zh: ~z~哟，老弟，我很欣赏你的能力。外面的假黑道确实很多。你还记得我哥们，德维恩吗？

english: ~z~Now you talking. I got something for you, player. Come to my crib, you been there before.
zh: ~z~这话听着顺耳。我这儿有活儿给你，老兄。来我那儿，你来过的。

english: ~z~Sure, just got out of the pen, old friends aren't paying him no mind.
zh: ~z~当然，刚放出来的那个嘛，老朋友们不会不报答他的。

english: ~z~Man, fuck Yusuf Amir. I got bigger problems. Come see me now.
zh: ~z~操他妈的尤瑟夫･阿米尔。不过还有更大的问题。现在就来找我。

english: ~z~Hey, it ain't our problem, Playboy - it's yours. That said, I know what I'm going to do.
zh: ~z~嘿，那可不是我们的问题，花花公子，是你的问题。这么说吧，我知道我要做什么。

english: ~z~I met you with Liz in SoBo. We had some troubles with a UC called Charlie.
zh: ~z~我和莉兹在南博汉见过你。我们跟一个叫查理的便衣有过节。

english: ~z~Yeah, that's what he think. He got friends all over the shop but he living in the past.
zh: ~z~对，他就这么想的。他到处都有朋友，不过他还活在过去。

english: ~z~I need you to go over to the Governor Greg Johnson projects over in Northwood,
zh: ~z~我需要你去北伍德区的格雷格･约翰逊州长公屋，

english: ~z~Dammit, Nicky. Cut the bullshit. You got 'em? Where are they?
zh: ~z~干他妈的，尼克。别说那个了，到手了吗？在哪儿呢？

english: ~z~I mean, you got a whole city full a potential lays and he's chasing the skipper's cooze.
zh: ~z~我是说，满城都是随时能上手的姑娘，他偏偏去追头儿的妞。

english: ~z~Dwayne, man. I bumped into your ex. The one that messed you around while you were in the joint.
zh: ~z~德维恩，兄弟。我碰见你前女友了，就是趁你蹲号子的时候背弃你的那个。

english: ~z~Yo, this is Dwayne. I'm out and I ain't letting shit get me down.
zh: ~z~哟，我是德维恩。我现在在外面，不会让别的事妨碍的。

english: ~z~Nicky, this is Ray Boccino. The man keeping your Irish friends in liquor.
zh: ~z~尼克，我是雷･博奇诺。就那个让你的爱尔兰朋友有酒喝的人。

english: ~z~This is Dwayne, guess not many people got this number cause nobody's calling.
zh: ~z~我是德维恩，我想知道这个号码的人不多，因为没什么人打。

english: ~z~This Dwayne. Don't know why I'm doing this. Nobody leaving me messages. You all fake.
zh: ~z~我是德维恩。不知道为什么要这么做。反正没人给我留言。你们这些虚伪的人。

english: ~z~I got the money robbed off of me by a biker, remember? The diamonds were sold.
zh: ~z~我的钱被一个飞车党抢走了，记得吗？钻石被卖掉了。

english: ~z~I don't wanna see you get caught up in it, that's all. Just looking out for ya, pal.
zh: ~z~我只是不想看你卷进去，就这样。照顾你才提醒你，伙计。

english: ~z~Dwayne, it was her. She screwed you over while you were inside. She's dead now.
zh: ~z~德维恩，就是她。你在里面的时候她把你给骗了。她已经死了。

zh: ~z~出钱的是她朋友，基佬托尼，用老子的钻石顶账。

zh: ~z~之前你说在机厅外面把她和杰丰一起杀了。你确定杀的是她吗？

english: ~z~You a good friend, Niko. She ask about me? You think she been thinking about this fool?
zh: ~z~够朋友，尼克。她有问到过我吗？你觉得她还在不在乎我这个傻子？

english: ~z~Well, we took it off Tony in the first place, but it shoulda ended there.
zh: ~z~虽然一开始就是从托尼那里偷的，但不该有这么多事的。

english: ~z~I was in the shower and I heard the phone ringing so I thought you mighta called or something. My bad. Later.
zh: ~z~刚才我洗澡的时候听见手机响了，我就在想可能是你打过来的。我的错。回见。

english: ~z~Dwayne, she's no good for you. Forget about her. We'll hang out soon. Later on.
zh: ~z~德维恩，她不适合你。忘了她吧。有空一起出去玩。回见。

english: ~z~Because of that I got Phil telling me that the Peg - Jimmy Pegorino - is pissed.
zh: ~z~后果很严重，菲尔告诉我佩戈里诺－吉米･佩戈里诺－很生气。

english: ~z~Nicky, I got a piece of advice for ya - stay away from Phil. He's causing himself some problems.
zh: ~z~尼基，给你个忠告——离菲尔远点。他在给自己惹麻烦。

english: ~z~Hey, Ray. I got some bad news for you. You weren't the only one who thought they owned those diamonds.
zh: ~z~喂，雷。我有一些坏消息要说。你不是唯一一个觉得钻石是自己的的人。

english: ~z~Niko, man. I was out today and I saw this bitch coming out a nail place. She looked just like my old girl, Cherise.
zh: ~z~尼克，兄弟。今天我出去的时候看见一个从美甲店出来的婊子，长得很像我的老情人谢丽丝。

english: ~z~Nicky, I hear you and the Irish have got your hands on Ancelotti's daughter.
zh: ~z~尼克，我听说你和那个爱尔兰人对安切洛蒂的女儿出手了。

english: ~z~Nah, man. Don't worry about that. She's not my type. We'll hang out soon.
zh: ~z~没有，兄弟。你放一万个心，她不是我的菜。有空我找你出去玩。

english: ~z~I told you to take our half of the money, and I said let Johnny take the half and you hold onto the other half.
zh: ~z~我让你拿走我们的那一份钱，还说过强尼拿一半你拿另一半。

english: ~z~Liberty City Dump... I don't know. They got thrown into traffic.
zh: ~z~自由城垃圾场...我不知道。钻石被扔到垃圾车里了。

english: ~z~Yeah? Well, remember who made the introduction. Remember who brought you in, don't you forget about me.
zh: ~z~是吗？记住是谁替你做的介绍。记住是谁引荐的你，你可别忘了我。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. She's gone. Maybe things coulda been different in another life.
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟。她已经走了。可能下辈子会不一样吧。

english: ~z~If you wanted to pass something up to me... pay me some tribute.
zh: ~z~如果你想孝敬点什么给我...给我上点贡金就行。

english: ~z~Because of that I got Phil telling me that the Peg - Jimmy Pegorino - is pissed.
zh: ~z~后果很严重，菲尔告诉我佩戈里诺－吉米･佩戈里诺－很生气。

english: ~z~Yo, I hear you been rolling with Cherise, Niko. You two tight now?
zh: ~z~哟，听说你跟谢丽丝在一起，尼克。你俩好上了？

english: ~z~Sorry, Ray. I'm freelance. I don't buy into that tribute stuff.
zh: ~z~抱歉，雷。我是自由职业者。贡金之类的我不买账。

english: ~z~Turns out a serious Russian called Bulgarin claims ownership as well.
zh: ~z~有一个叫布尔加林的麻烦的俄国人也宣称了对它的所有权。

english: ~z~I told you to take our half of the money, and I said let Johnny take the half and you hold onto the other half.
zh: ~z~我让你拿走我们的那一份钱，还说过强尼拿一半你拿另一半。

english: ~z~This work has many disadvantages, but, hey, at least it is tax free.
zh: ~z~这个工作是有很多缺点，不过，嘿，至少它不用交税。

english: ~z~Sorry, you've gone past my jurisdiction. Don't mention my name if you get caught.
zh: ~z~抱歉，你的事已经不是我能摆平的了。就算被捕也别提我的名字。

english: ~z~Hey, I don't like the sound of sirens. Tell your cop friends to stay away from me.
zh: ~z~嘿，我不喜欢警笛的声音。告诉你的条子朋友别来烦我。

english: ~z~Yo, Frankie. The smell of bacon is starting to get on my nerves. Get these cops off my back.
zh: ~z~哟，弗兰基。条子的味道搞得我很不爽。让他们别来追我。

english: ~z~I want you to look after 'em is all. Keep an eye on 'em. Make sure no harm comes to them. It's a fucked up world out there.
zh: ~z~我只是想让你照应他们。盯紧点。别让他们出事。外面这世界烂透了。

english: ~z~If that asshole ever comes back from Ireland, I can't be held responsible for what I'd do.
zh: ~z~要是那个混蛋从爱尔兰回来了，我可不能对我会做出的事负责。

english: ~z~Niko, Gerald McReary here. Calling from the Alderney State Correctional Facility.
zh: ~z~尼克，我是格里･麦克雷里。从奥尔德尼州立监狱打过来的。

english: ~z~Great. Look, Niko. I've always been responsible for my family. Now, one of my brothers is dead and I'm on the inside.
zh: ~z~好极了。听着，尼克。我一直撑着这个家。现在一个兄弟死了，我自己还在坐牢。

english: ~z~We gotta discuss something. I've put you on the visitors list here. Come down...
zh: ~z~我们得商讨些事情。我把你写到探监名单上了。来一趟...

english: ~z~He's got work and he's a good guy. You're not planning on taking him down, are you? Lay off him for me.
zh: ~z~他那儿有活干，他也是个好人，你该不会是想把他给干掉吧？你就别管他了。

english: ~z~Hey, I'm playing this game of cops and robbers and it's getting boring. End it.
zh: ~z~嘿，我已经玩腻了警察抓小偷的游戏了。结束它吧。

english: ~z~This is Gerald. Don't leave me a message 'cause I ain't gonna listen to it and I sure as shit ain't gonna return your call. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~我是格里。别给我留言，我听不了，而且也回复不了。滚蛋。

english: ~z~Packie McReary, Francis McReary. It's all starting to make sense.
zh: ~z~派奇･麦克雷里，弗朗西斯･麦克雷里。这就说得通了。

english: ~z~I just heard that Clarence Jones - that no good, kid killing, drug dealer I paid you to whack - is still alive.
zh: ~z~我刚听说克拉伦斯･琼斯——那个我出钱让你做掉的、杀孩子的烂人毒贩——还活着。

english: ~z~Shit, something came up. I didn't make it. Maybe they'll schedule another one.
zh: ~z~操，突然有点事。我没去成。他们可能会另外安排一次。

english: ~z~I knew Irish families were big but I didn't expect to run into brothers in a place the size of Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我知道爱尔兰家族很大，不过我倒没想到会在自由城这么大的地方遇见一对兄弟。

english: ~z~Actually, I ain't heard nothing. I've seen him walking down Vauxite Street in the middle of the day.
zh: ~z~其实我什么都没听说。我光天化日亲眼看见他走在 Vauxite 街上。

english: ~z~Niko, my boy, this is Packie's brother Gerald McReary.
zh: ~z~尼克，小伙子，我是派奇的哥哥格里･麦克雷里。

english: ~z~They're gonna need some looking after. Especially young Patrick and Katie, my sis.
zh: ~z~他们需要有人照应。尤其是小帕特里克和我妹妹凯特。

english: ~z~Maybe at the next McReary family function. Whatever that might be.
zh: ~z~也许下次麦克雷里家的聚会上吧。管它是什么聚会。

english: ~z~And the problem with having a dirty cop for a kid is that he'll kill his own brother if he gets in his way.
zh: ~z~养个黑警儿子的问题就在于，谁挡他的道，他连亲兄弟都杀。

english: ~z~Easy there, Niko. You think this has been easy for me? I ain't sleeping nights. I'm a wreck.
zh: ~z~别激动，尼克。你以为我轻松吗？我夜夜睡不着。整个人都垮了。

english: ~z~Niko, what's this I hear about you running with Patrick McReary now these days?
zh: ~z~尼克，最近我怎么听说你和帕特里克･麦克雷里跑一块儿去了？

english: ~z~Maybe if doing what you do is good, then I wanna be no good instead.
zh: ~z~要是你做的事情是好事，那我还是别做好事了吧。

english: ~z~Packie's just a hood but Gerald is into some serious shit. And Derrick. He's the worst.
zh: ~z~派奇只是个小苍蝇，不过格里就涉及到大案子了。至于德里克，他是最坏的。

english: ~z~He said he'd get outta town. I thought that'd be enough for you.
zh: ~z~他说过要离开本城的。我以为那对你就算交代了。

english: ~z~My brothers ain't no good, Niko. Trust me on that.
zh: ~z~我的兄弟都不是什么好人，尼克。这你要相信我。

english: ~z~You're a fucking Weazel, Niko. I trusted your word and you screwed me. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~你他妈就是个卑鄙小人，尼克。我信了你的话，你却坑了我。再见。

english: ~z~What, are you mental? You shouldn't even be calling me when you're this hot. I don't know you.
zh: ~z~什么，你疯了吗？这么严重了还给我打电话？我不认识你。

english: ~z~Just thank the Lord you ran into Packie and not my other brothers.
zh: ~z~感谢上帝你遇到的是派奇，而不是我的其它兄弟。

english: ~z~If you don't want to make things real difficult for him you're going to come to Comrades Bar on Mohawk. I have a work for you.
zh: ~z~你要是不想让他难做，就到莫霍克的Comrades酒吧来。我有活给你。

english: ~z~Who'd a thought an immigrant from the wrong side of the Adriatic would be the most reliable soldier we got?
zh: ~z~谁能想到，一个从亚得里亚海穷那边来的移民，竟是我们最靠得住的兵？

english: ~z~Niko, what's up, listen. This family's falling a-fucking part.
zh: ~z~尼克，怎么样，听着。这个家正在他妈的四分五裂。

english: ~z~Hey, yokel. What the fuck? That car you got to me, it looked like shit. I got a hot date tonight.
zh: ~z~喂，乡巴佬。你搞毛？你给我弄来的车，烂得跟坨屎一样。今晚我还有个火热的约会呢。

english: ~z~What'd'ya mean, Niko? We're family. We've welcomed you into the fold.
zh: ~z~你什么意思，尼克？我们是一家人。我们已经把你当自家人了。

english: ~z~Don't worry about that cousin of yours, he won't be in no danger sleeping in your Algonquin pad by his self.
zh: ~z~别担心你那个表哥，他一个人睡你在阿尔冈昆的公寓不会有什么危险。

english: ~z~Too bad, man. It was clean, wasn't it? Well, maybe you should stay home. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~太糟了，老弟。车本来是干净的吧？大概你还是该待在家里。再见。

english: ~z~Hey baby, how about I take your beautiful ass out tonight? Maybe we can take one of your fat boyfriend's cabs...
zh: ~z~嘿宝贝，今晚我带你这美人儿出去玩怎么样？也许咱们能开你那胖男友的出租车...

english: ~z~I'm not in the family, I'm your employee, Mr. Pegorino. You seem to get this stuff confused.
zh: ~z~我不是家里人，我是你的雇员，佩戈里诺先生。你好像老把这搞混。

english: ~z~We're back on top, Niko. The Pegorinos is still somebody.
zh: ~z~我们重振雄风了，尼克。佩戈里诺家族还是有地位的。

english: ~z~She won't be impressed with the way you look, so clean car is good thing. Later on.
zh: ~z~她不会对你的长相留下好印象的，所以一辆干净的车也还不错。回见。

english: ~z~Don't get cute, kid. It don't suit you. You're staying in Alderney now, just like me and Phil.
zh: ~z~别耍小聪明，小子。不适合你。你现在就待在奥尔德尼，跟我和菲尔一样。

english: ~z~A nice apartment in Alderney City, on Mahesh Avenue. Real classy.
zh: ~z~奥尔德尼市马赫什大道上的一套好公寓。相当气派。

english: ~z~I bought some of his debt for him. Now he don't have to worry about no loansharks coming after him, just me.
zh: ~z~我替他买下了一些债。现在他不用担心放高利贷的追他，只要担心我就行。

english: ~z~Money's not what motivates everyone, Mr. Pegorino. I had more important things to think about.
zh: ~z~钱不是驱动每个人的东西，佩戈里诺先生。我有更重要的事要想。

english: ~z~And that means we're looking after your cousin too. That guy likes to gamble, don't he?
zh: ~z~那就意味着我们也照应着你表哥。那家伙好赌，不是吗？

english: ~z~Forget about it. I'm gonna hold onto it for a while. Least I could do. Ciao.
zh: ~z~别提了。这钱我先留一阵。算我一点心意。再见。

english: ~z~You don't need to do that for my cousin, Mr. Pegorino. I can handle all his debt. I'll cover it.
zh: ~z~不用为我表哥这么做，佩戈里诺先生。他的债我来担。我全包了。

english: ~z~Now, I'm out. I don't want to get involved in this shit no more. Good luck to you.
zh: ~z~现在，我退出。我不想再掺和这摊子烂事了。祝你好运。

english: ~z~Hello, this is Vladimir's answer phone message. Be leaving a recording for me after the buzz has been playing.
zh: ~z~你好，这里是弗拉基米尔的留言信箱。请在蜂鸣声后向我留言。

english: ~z~Dimitri and I had unfinished business so I went ahead and finished it.
zh: ~z~迪米特里和我有笔没完的账，所以我去把它了结了。

english: ~z~Niko, It's Jimmy. You're doing real well, kid. You're becoming part of the family.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，吉米。你干得很出色，小子。你正在成为家里的一分子。

english: ~z~You better start remembering important people you dumb peasant. Your cousin owes me a lot of money.
zh: ~z~你最好记住那些大人物，蠢蛋土包子。你堂兄可欠了我一大笔钱。

english: ~z~Niko, the shit has gone down. I need to see you. Come to the club in Tudor.
zh: ~z~尼克，情况不太妙，我需要见你。到都铎的俱乐部来。

english: ~z~For a peasant you did okay. Car looks good. Girl I'm taking out tonight is going to be impressed.
zh: ~z~作为一个乡巴佬你的表现还不错。车子看上去很好。今晚我带出去的姑娘会有个好印象的。

english: ~z~How hard would it have been to suck up your pride to do one deal? Now, I got nothing left to lose.
zh: ~z~放下身段做一票生意能有多难？现在，我什么都不剩，也没什么可输的了。

english: ~z~I had that deal set up. I needed this, it was my only way back in and you fucked me.
zh: ~z~那笔交易是我安排好的。我需要这个，那是我翻身的唯一机会，你却坑了我。

english: ~z~Phil's bringing me my taste of the cash and Dimitri's still got hold of the horse. This is perfect.
zh: ~z~菲尔会把分成给我，迪米特里手上的海马也还在。太完美了。

english: ~z~You smug fucking bastard, after all I done for you, you play me like this.
zh: ~z~你个自鸣得意的混蛋，我为你做了那么多，你却这样耍我。

english: ~z~Ahh, the dumb yokel, I meant to call this girl I'm seeing.
zh: ~z~啊，土包子，我本来是想打给我正交往的那个姑娘的。

english: ~z~I'm sorry about the car, Michelle. I can get you a new one.
zh: ~z~车子的事我很抱歉，米歇尔。我会赔你辆新车的。

english: ~z~I feel like I should have been more organized. Had a better plan for our date.
zh: ~z~我还是觉得该好好策划一下。给约会弄个更好的计划。

english: ~z~Roman? He's made some mistakes, got involved with people he shouldn't have but
zh: ~z~罗曼？他确实犯了些错误，认识了一些不该认识的人，但

english: ~z~You're good, Niko. That was fun. Will you take me back home now?
zh: ~z~打得真好，尼克。我玩得很开心。你能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Really? Does Roman get himself into a lot of trouble? Is he involved in criminal stuff?
zh: ~z~真的？罗曼是不是经常惹上一堆麻烦？他有没有和什么犯罪勾当扯上关系？

english: ~z~You know, the carnival isn't open this time of year. I don't know if it would pass safety regulations anyway.
zh: ~z~嘉年华每年这会儿都不开门。不知道能不能通过安全审查。

english: ~z~You already know Roman. I don't hang out with anybody else really.
zh: ~z~罗曼你已经认识了。剩下就没别的人和我一起出去过了。

english: ~z~Oh, the Midwest. You probably know more people here than me.
zh: ~z~呃，中西部来的。说不定在这你比我认识的人还多。

english: ~z~I was really looking forward to that, Niko. I'm sorry if it wasn't your thing. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我本来还很期待的，尼克。如果不是你的事，我很抱歉。再见。

english: ~z~There's a bowling alley over on the boardwalk. Why don't we play a few frames?
zh: ~z~那边的木板道上有家保龄球馆。要不我们去打几球？

english: ~z~I think you do. There must be something that made you leave your home and come here.
zh: ~z~你应该知道吧。总不会无缘无故就离开老家来这里吧。

english: ~z~Niko, the carnival isn't open. I think they're going to turn it into a big Las Venturas style theme park.
zh: ~z~尼克，嘉年华没有开门。我觉得这里会被改造成拉斯文加斯风格的主题公园。

english: ~z~So, you don't know many people here in Liberty City. No boyfriends or husbands or anything?
zh: ~z~那，你在自由城认识的人不多喽？没有男友老公啥的？

english: ~z~I thought you'd be better at that, Niko. We had fun, didn't we? Will you take me back home now?
zh: ~z~我还以为你不止那么点水平呢，尼克。玩得挺开心不是吗？你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~The carnival's closed, Niko. I think some big developers have bought it or something.
zh: ~z~嘉年华关门了，尼克。我觉得应该是被大开发商买走了。

english: ~z~I'm working the whole time. Sometimes I think all I am is my job.
zh: ~z~我一直在工作。有时候我都觉得没了工作我就什么都不是了。

english: ~z~Shame we couldn't finish that game, Niko. It was fun playing though. Can you take me back now?
zh: ~z~没能打完真是遗憾，尼克。不过我还是玩得挺高兴的。你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~I didn't realize you were so violent, Niko. Have you got caught up with the Hove Beach criminals?
zh: ~z~真没想到你是个这么暴力的人，尼克。你是不是和霍夫海滩的犯罪团伙有关系？

english: ~z~Is that a fact? You haven't gotten involved in anything dubious here in Liberty City, have you? You'd tell me if you had, wouldn't you?
zh: ~z~是这样吗？你该不会是跟一些可疑的事情扯上关系了吧？就算扯上了，你也会告诉我吧？

english: ~z~I can look after myself Michelle, don't worry about me. Sorry again.
zh: ~z~我可以照顾好自己米歇尔，不用这么操心我。很对不起。

english: ~z~Roman's bullshit stories maybe. I just felt like I needed a new start.
zh: ~z~那大概就是罗曼的狗屁故事了。我只是觉得自己需要一个新起点。

english: ~z~Good game, Niko. We had fun. Will you take me home now?
zh: ~z~打得不错，尼克。挺开心的。你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~I thought you were doing me a favor by going out with me. You're the local.
zh: ~z~我还以为你陪我出来是在迁就我，毕竟你是本地人。

english: ~z~I just want to get to know you, Niko. See the places you hang out. The people you associate with.
zh: ~z~我只想好好了解下你，尼克。看看你常去的地方，见见你的熟人。

english: ~z~Do you mean you'd steal one? Have you got caught up with the Hove Beach criminals, Niko?
zh: ~z~你是不是要去偷车？你是不是和霍夫海滩的犯罪团伙有关系，尼克？

english: ~z~Sorry I had to run out on our date, Michelle. Something important came up.
zh: ~z~约会中途就走我很抱歉，米歇尔。突然有点急事。

english: ~z~Thanks for taking me out. I haven't been on a date for a while. I'm kind of lonely here.
zh: ~z~谢谢你带我出来玩。我已经很久没有约会了。我在这儿还有点寂寞。

english: Many of your friends have special abilities that they'll use to help you, should they like you enough.
zh: 你的许多朋友都有特殊的能力，如果他们够喜欢你，就会用能力帮你。

english: These range from delivering guns to providing bombs to help you get those hard-to-reach targets.
zh: 从提供枪支到提供炸弹，帮你解决那些难以接近的目标。

english: Each friend and girlfriend you have will have their favorite and least favorite activities.
zh: 你的每个朋友和女友都会有他们最喜欢和最讨厌的活动。

english: Many of your friends have special abilities that they'll use to help you, should they like you enough.
zh: 你的许多朋友都有特殊的能力，如果他们够喜欢你，就会用能力帮你。

english: Each friend and girlfriend you have will have their favorite and least favorite activities.
zh: 你的每个朋友和女朋友都会有他们最喜欢和最不喜欢的活动。

english: You will make friends and meet girlfriends as you spend time in Liberty City. You will be able to partake in a variety of activities with them, like eating...
zh: 你会在自由城结识朋友，交到女友。你们可以一起进行各种活动，比如下馆子...

english: You will make friends and meet girlfriends as you spend time in Liberty City. You will be able to partake in a variety of activities with them.
zh: 你会在自由城结识朋友，交到女友。你们可以一起进行各种活动。

english: There are many different types of restaurant around the city where you can take them for food.
zh: 城里有许多不同类型的餐馆，你可以带他们去搓一顿。

english: ~z~I have been told that they are soon to make a delivery in the Acter Industrial Park.
zh: ~z~我得到消息，他们很快会在阿克特工业园交一批货。

english: ~z~First, you need to collect some explosives. No expense can be spared for their bon voyage.
zh: ~z~首先，你得弄些炸药。给他们的"送行礼"可不能省钱。

english: ~z~The head of this organization has a ~r~bike ~s~he calls Sexy Charlie.
zh: ~z~这个组织的头目有辆~r~摩托~s~，他管它叫"性感查理"。

english: ~z~Put a saddle on one of these fucking cops, I will ride him to safety.
zh: ~z~给这些该死的条子随便套个鞍，我都能骑着逃出去。

english: ~z~I need them transported but do not trust the Liberty City roads. Take them in a ~b~helicopter.
zh: ~z~我得运走他们，但不信任自由城的马路。用~b~直升机~运。

english: ~z~This will show every arrogant shit in the city that we are to be respected.

zh: ~z~我开的绅士俱乐部里几个~b~姑娘~s~去单身派对出台，结果~r~那帮男人~s~拒绝付钱还动粗。

english: ~z~I slept with ~r~greedy woman ~s~last night. My sex and a ten dollar tip is not enough for her.
zh: ~z~我昨晚跟一个~r~贪心的女人~s~睡了。我的活儿加十美元小费还满足不了她。

english: ~z~Snobbish wasps have turned down my wife's application to fancy club.
zh: ~z~那些势利的白人老爷们拒绝了我妻子加入高级俱乐部的申请。

english: ~z~Fucking Bryce Dawkins, the deputy mayor, is getting on my nerves.
zh: ~z~那个该死的副市长布莱斯･道金斯在挑战我的耐心。

english: ~z~Police do not know so should be safe for him to go to hospital. Take ~b~him ~s~there.
zh: ~z~警察不知道，所以他去医院应该安全。送~b~他~s~过去。

english: ~z~~r~She ~s~wants more money or she will go to my wife. Stop this from happening.
zh: ~z~~r~她~s~想要更多钱，不然就去找我老婆。别让这事发生。

english: ~z~Thieving punks have no respect for nothing. They steal my ~b~Cognoscenti ~s~last night.
zh: ~z~小偷小混混什么都不放在眼里。他们昨晚偷了我的~b~至尊慧眼~s~。

english: ~z~I had to whack Ivo last night. It wasn't pretty, but these things happen, yes.
zh: ~z~我昨晚不得不做了伊沃。场面不好看，但这种事总会发生，是的。

english: ~z~Come steal ~b~it ~s~so they'll never know it was super charged.
zh: ~z~来把~b~它~s~偷走，他们就永远不会知道那车被改装过。

english: ~z~Take out the ~r~collectors ~s~working now so we're the only option for the job.
zh: ~z~干掉现在干活的~r~收账人~s~，这活儿就只能找我们了。

english: ~z~I am investing in a classic car, only these American geeks look after theirs too well.
zh: ~z~我在投资一辆老爷车，可惜这些美国宅男把自己的车保养得太好。

english: ~z~but they don't speak English or Russian. We will screw them like they screw me.
zh: ~z~可他们既不说英语也不说俄语。他们怎么坑我，我们就怎么坑他们。

english: ~z~I am having to have some meetings. One of you must show my ~b~wife ~s~the good times while I am away.
zh: ~z~我得去开几个会。我不在的时候，你们谁得带我的~b~妻子~s~好好快活快活。

english: ~z~The people at the Panoramic TV company send my call to centre in who knows where,
zh: ~z~全景电视公司的人把我的来电转到不知道哪里的客服中心，

english: ~z~Someone pick ~b~me ~s~up and take me to these hot little bitches I know. That should cool me down.
zh: ~z~谁来接~b~我~s~，送我去我认识的那几个火辣小妞那儿。这样我就能消消火。

english: ~z~I met a steroid pumped gear head called Brucie, we are the best of friends.
zh: ~z~我认识了一个打类固醇的车痴，叫布鲁斯，我们现在是铁哥们。

english: ~z~~b~Vanya ~s~is drunk out his brain on Cherchenkov. He can't kill nobody when he's that drunk.
zh: ~z~~b~瓦尼亚~s~喝 Cherchenkov 喝到断片了。醉成这样他谁都杀不了。

english: ~z~I give you one piece of advice, do not have a daughter. They suck the life out of you.
zh: ~z~我给你一条建议：别生女儿。她们会榨干你的命。

english: ~z~A ~r~gang ~s~will soon make a play for our operations. Crush them with a pre-emptive strike.
zh: ~z~一个~r~帮派~s~很快会打我们生意的主意。先发制人，碾碎他们。

english: ~z~The ~r~Angels of Death ~s~think they are so clever. So what if they blew up our meth lab?
zh: ~z~~r~死亡天使~s~自以为聪明。炸了我们的冰毒作坊又怎样？

english: ~z~My dumb nephew won a big motorcycle race. The organizers want to see his ~b~bike ~s~to make sure he didn't cheat.
zh: ~z~我那个蠢侄子赢了一场大型摩托赛。主办方要看他的~b~摩托~s~，确认他没作弊。

english: ~z~I tell him I will give him sexy ~b~truck ~s~to cruise in. Steal one for me.
zh: ~z~我跟他说过会给他一辆拉风的~b~卡车~s~兜风。给我偷一辆来。

english: ~z~I just bought a new car, but I feel common. Everybody is driving these ~r~Sultans.
zh: ~z~我刚买了辆新车，却觉得很没面子。人人都开这种~r~王者。

english: ~z~Problem is they spend time in music school, not the ghetto. You show ~b~them ~s~gangster life, okay?
zh: ~z~问题是他们混的是音乐学校，不是贫民窟。你带~b~他们~s~见识下黑帮生活，好吗？

english: ~z~I would tell him to screw himself but he did me a favour. Take ~b~him ~s~out, yes?
zh: ~z~我真想叫他滚蛋，但他帮过我。带~b~他~s~出去，好吗？

english: ~z~Mine suddenly wants a pink ~b~Feltzer. ~s~Get it for her so she can think about what she needs next.
zh: ~z~我家那位突然想要一辆粉色~b~飞特者。~s~给她弄来，好让她琢磨下一样想要的东西。

english: ~z~Anyway, this man is trying to smuggle heroin through our turf in a beaten up ~b~sedan. ~s~Take it for me.
zh: ~z~总之，这人想开一辆破旧~b~轿车~s~从我们地盘上海洛因过境。替我把车弄来。

english: ~z~Someone has filled a ~b~moped ~s~tank full with cocaine. Was planning on taking it to that club, Hercules.
zh: ~z~有人把一辆~b~小摩托~s~的油箱塞满了可卡因，本想开到 Hercules 俱乐部。

english: ~z~We are working with a Jamaican, calls himself ~b~Small Jacob. ~s~He has a deal to make. Ferry him there.
zh: ~z~我们和一个牙买加人合作，他自称~b~小雅各布。~s~他有笔交易要谈。送他过去。

english: ~z~A ~r~Triad hit squad ~s~killed Georgi. They shall pay for this. Kill them all.
zh: ~z~一个~r~三合会杀手小队~s~杀了格奥尔基。他们得血债血偿。全杀了。

english: ~z~Is worse than back home. I need to get this done though, go and pick up my ~b~wasted crew.
zh: ~z~比老家还糟糕。不过这活儿我得干完，去把我那帮~b~烂醉的手下~接来。

english: ~z~I have a shipment of ~b~rocket launchers. ~s~I need someone to try them out before they sent off to a warzone.
zh: ~z~我有一批~b~火箭筒。~s~在运往战区之前，得有人先试试货。

english: ~z~I'm getting bored of this ~b~car. ~s~Come and steal it from me so I can claim the insurance, okay.
zh: ~z~这辆~b~车~s~我开腻了。来把它从我这儿偷走，好让我骗保，行吧。

english: ~z~These ~b~grenades ~s~are too noisy for my liking. You can use them though. Please, they are here.
zh: ~z~这些~b~手榴弹~s~对我口味来说太吵了。不过你可以用。请便，就在这儿。

english: ~z~These dumb Irish ~r~hoods, ~s~they want to take our territory. Kill them all.
zh: ~z~这些蠢货爱尔兰~r~混混，~s~想抢我们的地盘。全杀了。

english: ~z~I like my girlfriend's face. Will you take ~b~her ~s~out of the area so my wife can't do this?
zh: ~z~我喜欢我女朋友这张脸。你能把~b~她~s~带离这片吗？免得我老婆对她下手。

english: ~z~My cousin, Igor, he wants to go bowling. He is, you know, simple.
zh: ~z~我表弟伊戈尔想去打保龄球。他嘛，你懂的，脑子简单。

english: ~z~Poor Anton was killed by some monsters. They tell me that all is left is his ~b~head.
zh: ~z~可怜的安东被几个畜生害死了。他们告诉我，只剩下他的~b~脑袋。

english: ~z~She will not shut up about it. Get rid of the ~r~committee ~s~so her appeal stands better chance.
zh: ~z~她为这事没完没了。除掉~r~委员会~s~，她的申诉就多几分胜算。

english: ~s~Weapons are placed around the area - their locations are represented on your radar by icons.
zh: ~s~武器散布在区域各处——它们的位置会在小地图上以图标显示。

english: ~s~You can set up the appearance of your multiplayer character on the Player Model screen.
zh: ~s~你可以在「玩家模型」界面设置多人游戏角色的外观。

english: ~s~In a free-for-all deathmatch game your objective is to kill all other players while surviving for as long as possible.
zh: ~s~在混战死斗模式中，你的目标是杀光其他玩家，同时尽可能活得久。

english: ~s~If you are the host you will be able to change a variety of options such as weapon types, game duration, and auto-aim.
zh: ~s~如果你是房主，可以修改武器类型、游戏时长、自动瞄准等多项选项。

english: ~s~While riding as a passenger you can perform drivebys. Use ~INPUT_AIM~ and ~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~ to aim. Press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to fire.
zh: ~s~作为乘客时你可以进行车载射击。用~INPUT_AIM~和~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~瞄准，按~INPUT_ATTACK~开火。

english: ~s~While riding as a passenger you can also drop grenades from your window. Hold ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to pull the pin, and release to drop the grenade.
zh: ~s~作为乘客时，你还可以从车窗投出手雷。按住~INPUT_ATTACK~拔掉保险销，松开即投出。

english: ~s~If the auto-aim option is set to disallow, you cannot use the targeting system to lock onto opponents.
zh: ~s~如果「自动瞄准」选项设为禁止，你就无法用锁定系统锁住对手。

english: ~s~The player with the highest score when the game ends is the winner. In a timed game, the remaining time will be displayed in the top right of the screen.
zh: ~s~游戏结束时得分最高的玩家获胜。限时游戏中，剩余时间会显示在屏幕右上角。

english: ~s~Your opponents are also represented on the radar by icons. Each has a unique color.
zh: ~s~对手也会在小地图上以图标显示，每人有各自不同的颜色。

english: ~s~The dollar amount in the bottom left of the screen represents the total cash you have earned in ranked games.
zh: ~s~屏幕左下角的金额是你在排位游戏中累计赚到的现金。

english: ~s~Using the environment and powerful weapons, in the way this player is, will give you the advantage in combat.
zh: ~s~像这名玩家那样善用地形和强力武器，就能在战斗中获得优势。

english: ~s~The lobby screen displays both the game mode and its rules, and also has options that you can alter.
zh: ~s~大厅界面会显示游戏模式及其规则，也有可以修改的选项。

english: ~s~At the end of the game the score screen will appear. This represents your deaths, your kills and how much cash you have earned.
zh: ~s~游戏结束时会出现计分界面，显示你的死亡数、击杀数和赚到的现金。

english: ~s~You can drive, or ride as a passenger, in a vehicle with your teammates.
zh: ~s~你可以和队友同乘一辆载具，由你驾驶或当乘客。

english: ~s~You can identify opponents by the name displayed above their head. The dot next to the name will flash when they are taking damage.
zh: ~s~你可以靠头顶显示的名字辨认对手。对方受伤时，名字旁的小点会闪烁。

english: ~s~In other team games, the cash acquired by each team may be divided equally between its members.
zh: ~s~在其他团队模式中，各队获得的现金可能会在队员之间平均分配。

english: ~s~In a team game you must work together in order to win. Do not shoot your teammates and do your best to help them out.
zh: ~s~团队模式中必须协作才能获胜。不要向队友开枪，尽力帮助他们。

english: ~s~The ticker in the top left of the screen keeps you updated about what is going on in the game.
zh: ~s~屏幕左上角的滚动条会持续提示游戏里发生的情况。

english: ~s~In a Deathmatch game, you will gain cash for killing other players. The scoring rules for each game type will be displayed on its lobby screen.
zh: ~s~死斗模式中，击杀其他玩家可获得现金。各模式的计分规则会在其大厅界面显示。

english: ~s~In multiplayer modes, police will not attempt to bust you, they will only attack you.
zh: ~s~多人模式中，警察不会试图逮捕你，只会直接攻击。

english: ~s~The crown icon identifies the host. The host is the player who controls the game settings/options and starts the game.
zh: ~s~皇冠图标代表房主。房主是控制系统设置与选项并开始游戏的人。

english: ~s~The dollar amount in the bottom left of the screen represents the total cash you have earned in multiplayer games.
zh: ~s~屏幕左下角的金额是你在多人游戏中累计赚到的现金。

english: ~s~Your rank will increase as you acquire cash in multiplayer games. This unlocks new multiplayer models.
zh: ~s~在多人游戏中赚取现金会提升等级，从而解锁新的多人角色模型。

english: ~s~The star icon indicates the player's rank as a number between 0 and 10.
zh: ~s~星形图标显示玩家的等级，数值在 0 到 10 之间。

english: ~s~Weapons, health and armor will always reappear in the same place. Learning where they are located is vital for survival.
zh: ~s~武器、生命值和护甲总会在同一位置重新出现。记住它们的位置对生存至关重要。

english: ~s~When locking onto a target for the first time, if you lightly press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ the reticule will reduce in size. This means your first shot will be very accurate.
zh: ~s~首次锁定目标时，轻按~INPUT_ATTACK~会让准星收缩，这样第一枪会非常准。

english: ~s~Your rank will increase as you acquire cash in ranked multiplayer games. This unlocks new multiplayer models.
zh: ~s~在排位多人游戏中赚取现金会提升等级，从而解锁新的多人角色模型。

english: ~s~Check the current cash scores at any time by pressing ~PAD_DPAD_DOWN~. This also zooms out the radar.
zh: ~s~随时按~PAD_DPAD_DOWN~查看当前现金得分，这也会把地图视野拉远。

english: ~s~When all players are ready, the game will launch. The game will also start after a short interval if the host and the majority of players are ready.
zh: ~s~所有玩家就绪后游戏就会开始。如果房主和多数玩家已就绪，一小段时间后也会自动开始。

english: ~s~In some team games, your appearance will be picked for you. All members of a team will have the same appearance.
zh: ~s~部分团队模式会为你指定外观，全队成员外观相同。

english: ~s~While riding as a passenger you can perform drivebys. Hold ~INPUT_AIM~ and use ~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~ to aim. Press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to fire.
zh: ~s~作为乘客时你可以进行车载射击。按住~INPUT_AIM~并用~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~瞄准，按~INPUT_ATTACK~开火。

english: ~s~You can select the area of the city that the game will be played in with the Location option.
zh: ~s~你可以用「地点」选项选择在市区的哪个区域进行游戏。

english: ~s~Sustained firing of your weapon will cause recoil and bullets will spread inaccurately. The aiming reticule will grow larger to indicate when this is happening.
zh: ~s~持续开火会产生后坐力，子弹会散布得不准。此时准星会变大，提示这一点。

english: ~s~Your name will be listed as part of your team in the lobby. You can also check the teams by accessing the scoreboard.
zh: ~s~你的名字会作为队员列在大厅里。你也可以打开计分板查看各队情况。

english: ~B~Petrovic~S~ is making a break for the transport. Once he's in, get outta there.
zh: ~B~彼得罗维奇~S~正在为运输做准备。他一进去，就离开那儿。

english: One of your crew has got some transport and it's on its way. Keep ~b~Petrovic~s~ alive until it gets here.
zh: 你的一名成员已经有了一些运输工具，但还在路上。在它们到货之前留着~b~彼得罗维奇的小命~s~。

english: The transport is full. Petrovic won't leave the jet unless there is a free seat.
zh: 运输工具已经满员了。除非有空位，否则彼得罗维奇不会离开飞机。

english: You must find another vehicle to get Petrovic to the ~Y~safe zone.~S~
zh: 你必须另找一辆载具把彼得罗维奇送到~Y~安全地带。~S~

english: Clear the area. Petrovic won't come out until its safe.
zh: 消灭这个地区的敌人。彼得罗维奇在这儿安全之前不会出来。

english: ~B~Petrovic~S~ is vulnerable. Get some transport to the extraction point.
zh: ~B~彼得罗维奇~S~是脆弱的。找些运输工具送到提取点。

english: ~S~One of your crew has collected Petrovic. Make your way to the ~Y~safe zone.~S~
zh: ~S~你的一名成员已经找到了彼得罗维奇。到~Y~安全区~S~去。

english: You must secure the area. Petrovic won't leave the jet while there are cops nearby.
zh: 你必须保护好这个地区。只要附近有警察，彼得罗维奇 就不会离开飞机。

english: Petrovic is vulnerable. Get some transport to the ~Y~extraction point.~S~
zh: 彼得罗维奇是脆弱的。找些运输工具送到 ~Y~提取点~S~。

english: ~s~You left ~b~Packie,~s~ ~b~Derrick~s~ and ~b~Michael~s~ behind, go back and get them.
zh: ~s~你把~b~派奇~s~、~b~德里克~s~和~b~迈克尔~s~落下了，回去找他们。

english: Clear away any vehicles parked behind the Ancelottis' car before planting the bomb.
zh: 放置炸弹前，清除停在安切洛蒂家族的车后面的所有汽车。

english: You already have a bomb, get to the Ancelottis' ~b~car~s~ and rig it with the bomb.
zh: 你手头有一个炸弹，去给~b~安切洛蒂家族的车~s~装上炸弹。

english: Don't get too close or the Ancelottis will spot you.
zh: 不要跟得太紧，否则安切洛蒂家族的人会发现你。

english: Follow the ~r~Ancelottis~s~. Don't let them know you're following them.
zh: 尾随~r~安切洛蒂家族的人。~s~别让他们发现你在跟踪他们。

english: ~z~I asked my sponsor to come along but he says this is something I got to do without him.
zh: ~z~我有请我的赞助人一起来过，不过他说这事我该自己去做。

english: ~z~Yeah, but this ain't no rock - it's a fucking boulder. This shit's gonna blast me to the moon.
zh: ~z~拿到了，不过不是普通石头。是块巨石！这玩意能把我炸上月球。

english: ~z~This is step number nine in the program. I'm making amends to all those I harmed. Expensive process.
zh: ~z~这是戒毒计划的第九步，我要补偿伤害过的所有人。真是代价高昂。

english: ~z~I mean, I was a dick. But I'm making up for it.
zh: ~z~我是说，以前我是个屌人。不过我现在已经在弥补了。

english: ~z~What's that film where that guy is on a mountain and he gets chased by that huge boulder?
zh: ~z~主角在山上被大号巨石追的那个片子叫啥名儿来着？

english: ~z~I mean I'm clean, but I'm still an addict and I can never let my guard down.
zh: ~z~我是说我干净了，但我还是个瘾君子，不能放松警惕。

english: ~z~It's amazing how low you can get without realizing that you actually have a problem.
zh: ~z~没意识到自己有问题的时候，一个人能达到的下限之低实在是太神奇了。

english: ~z~You pretty dumb for a banker. You forgot about interest, bitch.
zh: ~z~作为一个银行家你实在是有点蠢，连利息都忘了，贱人。

english: ~z~Anyway, that's how I gonna feel when this shit's chasing me round my head.
zh: ~z~算了，反正这玩意绕着我的脑袋追的时候我就这感觉。

english: ~z~These injuries are only physical, at least I didn't feel the hunger again.
zh: ~z~这些伤只是物理上的，至少我没有再感到那种饥渴。

english: ~z~That said, it's a lot harder to ask people to write off the emotional debts than the financial ones...
zh: ~z~据说，想把人情债一笔勾销可比钱的债难多了...

english: ~z~Would you come with me? I hate to ask, but I'm afraid the temptation might get to me.
zh: ~z~你能一起来吗？我讨厌求人，不过又害怕自己经不住诱惑。

english: ~z~when you're giving blowjobs at ten bucks a pop, so you can score your next rock.
zh: ~z~想想你十块钱就给人口一次，然后才能买下一块石头的时候。

english: ~z~Listen... I gotta go pay off one of my dealers. Make things right.
zh: ~z~听着...我要去跟我的一个卖家结账。让事情走上正轨。

english: ~z~I like your style, dude. I like your fucking style.
zh: ~z~我喜欢你的风格，哥们。我太他妈喜欢你的风格了。

english: ~z~Hey, I remember you. You're the comrade guy. The guy with all the jokes?
zh: ~z~嘿，我认识你。你就是那个同志男，讲了一堆笑话的那个？

english: ~z~Good! Yes comrade, I am doing good. There is no "I", there is only "we" - it is a glorious system, comrade.
zh: ~z~很好！对了同志，我最近很好。没有小「我」，只有大「我」。是个光荣的体系，同志。

english: ~z~You're excused, comrade. You're excused, now go and mine salt for fifty years...
zh: ~z~没事了，同志。你可以走了，去挖五十年盐矿吧...

zh: ~z~第九步很难完成，不是所有人都想你变好的。我会去组里面讨论的。

zh: ~z~就那种远离帮派份子和毒贩子的。翻开新的一页懂吧。

zh: ~z~那个，在那...在那次事件以后，我就想改一改我的生活，换种生活方式。

zh: ~z~不是...这个问题是很蠢，我知道...是很蠢。只是我刚好想到。

zh: ~z~有让别人控制过你吗？这会是次很狂野的经历的！

zh: ~z~不过你猜怎么着，帅哥，今晚我很饥渴，无法被满足。过来吧！

zh: ~z~别，等下。等一下，先生！我很抱歉，我是很怪，我是个奇怪的人...我也知道。

zh: ~z~那你喜欢什么，老哥？埃迪什么都懂。你会让埃迪把你绑起来吗？

zh: ~z~至于你的女儿，你的漂亮小女儿，亚伯拉罕斯太太...

zh: ~z~很抱歉，老哥。我当然是在开玩笑。你是不是觉得我很奇怪？

zh: ~z~不，净是些蠢话。我又犯蠢了。傻比小比利。说的就是我！

zh: ~z~好吧，史密斯太太，埃迪已经绑架了你的宝贝儿子，你的宝贝小四分卫－

english: ~z~It's hard to say goodbye to people sometimes, isn't it? You don't know when to let them go.
zh: ~z~有时候就是很难跟别人告别，对吧？不知道该在什么时候放手。

english: ~z~You're making me a little uncomfortable, Eddie. I hope you're joking.
zh: ~z~你弄得我有点不舒服了，埃迪。希望你只是在开玩笑。

zh: ~z~你这人是有点奇怪，埃迪。有考虑过去看心理医生吗？

zh: ~z~不是，我不是想惹怒你，尼克。我也不想吓人的，我这人就这样。

zh: ~z~你真有趣...你是个真正的小丑。我就认识一个小丑，可爱的家伙...

zh: ~z~要是知道不烧橡胶烧什么，他们就不会介意烧橡胶的气味了。

english: ~z~We're all the same under those layers of hair and skin and fat.
zh: ~z~在那层头发、皮肤和脂肪下面，我们都是一样的。

zh: ~z~因为他们开始发臭了。那时候埃迪就又要去院子里烧轮胎了。

english: ~z~I thought you didn't let people get close to you? You have to let down your barriers.
zh: ~z~我以为你不会让别人亲近你？你还是得放下内心的屏障。

zh: ~z~不是什么...只是想搭讪一下...只是想让寂寞离我远一点...懂了吗？

zh: ~z~就是那个狗逼绑架了我！安东尼，萨尔，托尼，马克，本尼！来帮我！

zh: ~z~我就是个狗逼混蛋，至少我的前女友们都这么说。

zh: ~z~确实，不过考虑到在这里能享受到的乐子...那还是值得的。

zh: ~z~老兄，在船上过了三个月以后...我只能说我不是块做水手的料。

zh: ~z~我们没签证就是日子不好过啊。别人都不想好好对我们。

zh: ~z~这是什么意思？我靠，这里可是世界上最好的城市。

zh: ~z~是吗？我靠，尼克，你当然是人。你在我遇上麻烦的时候帮了我。

zh: ~z~确实，至少你还喜欢你的工作。我做的有些事就拿不到工资。

zh: ~z~我实在是很讨厌这些仗着祖上来这儿早就压榨勤劳工人的人。

zh: ~z~而我女儿的成长中就没有父亲了。这样苦涩的一课她接触的太早了。

zh: ~z~好了，好了...你说服我了。我不会再去找那个贱人了。

zh: ~z~伊莲娜 福斯汀。我还以为你会不一样，尼克。我说了不要杀人，你们这些人都一样。

zh: ~z~我看得出他是个混球。我觉得他想骗我女儿去脱衣舞俱乐部，甚至更糟。

zh: ~z~是吗？只是我下半辈子想要每天早上有人吹箫，不过没法同时满足我们两个。

zh: ~z~那个，我真的是很对不起，不过我好像撞倒了一个可怜的家伙。他大概是死了。

zh: ~z~是。好的谢了。噢，杰夫这次真的搞砸了不是吗？噢。

zh: ~z~嘿，你还记得我吗？还记得吧，哈？我老婆的那些照片就是你拍的。

zh: ~z~失手了？是不是你也在跟她偷情？干我的老婆而不帮我。

zh: ~z~溜了？是不是你也在跟她偷情？干我的老婆而不帮我。

zh: ~z~对，杰夫这次真下手了。杰夫做过头了。杰夫是个坏孩子，真真正正的坏孩子。

zh: ~z~他还想在我的脊椎下面装定位器。说我要是没做亏心事就别怕鬼敲门。

zh: ~z~表面上是个笑眯眯有黑卡的人，完全想不到他背地里会变成这样的禽兽。

english: ~z~Come on, Jeff, be calm. Jeff, be cool. Come on, champ. You can do this. Be a winner.
zh: ~z~好了，杰夫，要冷静。杰夫，冷静点。加油，老哥。你能行的。做个赢家。

zh: ~z~我是说，不是我想瞒他。我只是不想被搞成半身截瘫。

zh: ~z~嘿，我是杰夫。对了，你还记得吗，就那个逍遥自在的人？

zh: ~z~问题就是他很生气，很吃醋。我不知道该怎么办。

zh: ~z~这他妈不就成罗密欧与朱丽叶了吗。我现在一无所有了。

zh: ~z~你告诉他他老婆是个背地乱搞的淫娃荡妇的那个。

zh: ~z~我的手机里被装了窃听器。回到家我的内裤抽屉空了。

zh: ~z~杰夫。我看不惯跟你老婆在一起的那人就把他杀了。不用谢。

zh: ~z~你他妈杀了他？天哪！他可能只是个普通朋友或者健身教练之类的。

zh: ~z~听从自己的建议吧，杰夫。要冷静。是你主动想知道的。

zh: ~z~还记得我老婆雪莉吗？她出了点事故...在厨房里。

zh: ~z~我们下车的时候就有人来搭讪。搭讪女孩和男孩。

english: ~z~Maybe I can last a bit longer this time around. I need to get clean first though.
zh: ~z~这次说不定能坚持更久一点。不过我还是得先把毒戒掉。

english: ~z~Well, some producer discovered me but I didn't exactly end up in a Vinewood movie.
zh: ~z~是有个制作人发掘过我，不过最后拍的不是好麦坞大片。

english: ~z~I'll try Niko. Thanks. I was right - you are sweet.
zh: ~z~我会的，尼克。谢了。我果然没看错，你很善良。

english: ~z~The sweats and the shakes is gonna be real fun. Need to get off this shit. Need to be strong.
zh: ~z~出汗和发抖太痛苦了。是得戒掉毒品了，得强大一些了。

english: ~z~Ever since I got to this city. On my way here I actually thought it was gonna be different.
