zh: ~z~生活中偶尔有点胆小。现在总他妈能滚蛋了吧，等老子把瓶子砸过来就晚了。

english: ~z~That's a lesson I've learnt. Fucking Boccino said it'd be easy.
zh: ~z~这次我可长记性了。狗逼博奇诺说这活儿很轻松。

english: ~z~Don't you got other guys to help you out? You're from here, you should know everyone.
zh: ~z~难不成就没别的人能帮上你了？你是本地人，人脉应该挺广的啊。

english: ~z~This is Niko, some drug dealing de-fucking-generate from some armpit in Eastern Europe.
zh: ~z~这位是尼克，不知道从哪个东欧粪坑里出来的贩毒蛆虫。

english: ~z~Who are we welcoming and what have they got that makes this drive worth the effort?
zh: ~z~我们要欢迎哪位？他们拉的货配得上我们这趟出的力吗？

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. You drive. I'll take out anyone who tries to follow us.
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。你开车，我来解决那些想尾随我们的人。

english: ~z~-I'm thinking maybe you can catch VD for both of us, Patrick.~n~-Fuck you, Katie.
zh: ~z~－那就拜托你把我那份的性病也给得了吧，帕特里克。~n~－去你妈的，凯特。

english: ~z~get into fights on a nightly basis and die young leaving a scarred, bloated corpse.
zh: ~z~每晚跟人打架，英年早逝，留下一具满是伤痕的浮肿尸体。

english: ~z~Usual for you and me maybe. The general population, I am not so sure.
zh: ~z~对你我可能是家常便饭。普罗大众的话，我就不太确定了。

english: ~z~We're going to Ray's lockup in Westminster off of Union Drive West.
zh: ~z~我们要去雷的车库，在联合车道西旁边的威斯敏斯特。

english: ~z~Anyways, I was in Algonquin last night, partying with some sweet college chicks.
zh: ~z~不说了，昨晚我在阿尔冈琴和几个性感学生妹开派对。

english: ~z~We're welcoming some of our cousins from the East, but we don't know what it is that they're bringing in exactly.
zh: ~z~欢迎的是几个来自东方的远房亲戚。不过说实话，我们也不知道拉的是什么货。

english: ~z~These better be some good fucking pills. The housewives better be grateful.
zh: ~z~车里的药效果最好他妈好点。太太们也最好会感恩戴德。

english: ~z~There should be a good view of the dock so we can scope that shit out.
zh: ~z~那里应该能把码头看得一清二楚，可以好好侦查一下。

english: ~z~My brother Gerry's had word from Ray Boccino, his Italian contact,
zh: ~z~我哥格里从雷･博奇诺那里收到的风，那是他的意大利线人，

english: ~z~Who's going to judge Kate? What would she win if they did? Virgin of the year?
zh: ~z~谁会评判凯特？要是他们评了，凯特会得个什么奖？年度处女？

english: ~z~A lotta wives and mistresses are gonna be happy when their men get a hold of those, huh?
zh: ~z~家里的男人吃了这个，那些太太和情妇都会很开心的吧，哈？

english: ~z~You can't trust people. I only trust me family, some of them at least, and people I don't know.
zh: ~z~外人不能信的。我只信任我的家人，至少信一部分，还有就是不认识的人了。

english: ~z~Not in this country. In Europe. They do things different there.
zh: ~z~不是在这儿，那会儿还在欧洲。他们那边不太一样。

english: ~z~My brother Gerald had word about it through this Italian, Ray Boccino.
zh: ~z~我哥哥格里从雷･博奇诺这个意大利人那里收到的风。

english: ~z~Yeah, he'll probably try to give us a fraction of whatever this stuff's worth but it'll be a fun night.
zh: ~z~对，甭管这批货值多少钱，估计他都只会给我们一点零头，不过今晚会很有乐子的。

english: ~z~Don't worry about Gordo and Mikey, they ain't gonna have no troubles. You'll get your share.
zh: ~z~用不着担心戈多和迈基，他们不会有事的。分成会给你的。

english: ~z~It's called that because people found the McRearys' stories so fuckin' boring.
zh: ~z~是因为人们发现麦克雷里家族的故事太他妈无聊了才叫这名的。

english: ~z~It's an Ancelotti operation. Ray tipped us off about a big payoff they just got.
zh: ~z~是安切洛蒂家族开的。雷放风给我们说他们刚进了一票大的。

english: ~z~A guy who bats one-fifty hits a three run homer. Bullshit!
zh: ~z~一个打击率只有十五分之一的选手打了个三分本垒打出来。扯淡吧！

english: ~z~That don't mean I can drive one. Fuck it though, I'll give it a try.
zh: ~z~乘船来又不等于开船来。不过管它呢，我先试试吧。

english: ~z~I've got it boys. Prettiest thing I seen in all me days. I'll tell you that.
zh: ~z~我拿到了，小子们。要我说这是我这辈子见过的最漂亮的东西。

english: ~z~There's got to be a pizza parlor on this island coz I ain't never seen so many Italians.
zh: ~z~从来没见过这么多意大利人，这座岛上肯定是有家披萨店。

english: ~z~Try to keep the money dry, won't ya? I don't know how my bookie's gonna be about wet notes..
zh: ~z~尽量别把钱弄湿好吧？我可不知道我的赌场代理收不收湿钞票。

english: ~z~What you got to worry about? There's only every virus known to man floating about in this river. Come on.
zh: ~z~你有什么好怕的？这条河不过是集齐了人类已知的所有病毒而已。来吧。

english: ~z~Alright boys, if Ray is correct then the money's going to be kept in the office in the main building.
zh: ~z~好了小子们，如果雷说的没错，那笔钱就在主楼的办公室里。

english: ~z~If the Ancelottis hear we've been spending it up they might finger us for this job.
zh: ~z~要是让安切洛蒂家族听说我们花钱太厉害，还不得把我们在做的活计给暴露了。

english: ~z~That's Francis down to a fucking T. I don't even know if he realizes what a crook he is.
zh: ~z~弗朗西斯骨子里就是这样的人。我都怀疑他知不知道自己到底有多坏。

english: ~z~You guys take the money and meet me back at Ma's. Me and Niko are taking a swim.
zh: ~z~你们俩带着钱走，到我妈地方会合。我跟尼克用游的。

english: ~z~Michael, Gordo watch our backs. Make sure none of these wops tries to come up behind us.
zh: ~z~迈克尔，戈多，替我们断后。确保没人能来追击我们。

english: ~z~If ya want a pair of armbands you ain't gonna find them there. Get in.
zh: ~z~你要是想要游泳臂圈的话，这里可没有。下来吧。

english: ~z~Shit, you've sunk it. Looks like we're swimming to Dukes.
zh: ~z~操，你丫沉船了。看来我们得游回公爵区了。(BETA)

english: ~z~Can you drive a boat? You got to this fine country in a boat didn't ya, Niko?
zh: ~z~你会开船吗？你是不是就是乘船来这个好国家的，尼克？

english: ~z~Us McRearys are under the fucking radar nowadays. It ain't a problem.
zh: ~z~我们麦克雷里家族现在转战地下了，不会有问题的。

english: ~z~Mikey, maybe you and me should take this cash down to Vice City. Have some fun.
zh: ~z~迈基，我们俩还是带着钱去罪恶都市吧。去那儿玩玩。

english: ~z~Then I am quite sure you and mister Niko here will have fun on your 'play date'.
zh: ~z~那你和尼克先生这次的「娱乐邀约」肯定会很愉悦喽。

english: ~z~Ancelottis, eh? I can't tell none of those wop families apart.
zh: ~z~安切洛蒂家族，啊？我可分不清这些南蛮子的家族。

english: ~z~What's that say about you then, Gordo? If you're taking orders from Packie.
zh: ~z~你说这话是几个意思，戈多？还想不想跟派奇混了。

english: ~z~If you think I'm letting one of these reprobates sit on my knee, you're crazy.
zh: ~z~要是你觉得我会让俩人渣坐在我腿上，你就是疯了。

english: ~z~Michael, Gordon tries anything you fucking shoot him. Understand?
zh: ~z~迈克尔，戈登有什么用什么干他们就对了。懂了没？

english: ~z~I don't give a shit what you're doing with your cut. All I care about is you holding up your end on the job.
zh: ~z~我他妈才不管你那份钱要拿去干啥。只要你丫不掉链子就成。

english: ~z~Both of me boys is gone. I got to re-evaluate this shit.
zh: ~z~我的两个手下都死了。我得重新算下这票值不值了。

english: ~z~I like your attitude, Niko. I think we're gonna keep getting on real well.
zh: ~z~我喜欢你的态度，尼克。我觉得我们关系会很好的。

english: ~z~He only put on that cassock so he could pocket the change in the collection plate. Fact.
zh: ~z~他只是想穿上长袍，然后就能把募款盘里的零钱藏自己袋子里了。真的。

english: ~z~Them guidos use you for what they like, if the Peg asked Gerald to wipe his ass he probably would.
zh: ~z~这些意呆佬爱怎么使唤就怎么使唤你，就算佩戈里诺叫格里帮他擦屁股，他估计都肯擦的。

english: ~z~That's got to be the office up there. I can smell the fucking money.
zh: ~z~应该就在上面那个办公室里了。我他妈都能闻到钱味儿了。

english: ~z~We did it. Top of the fucking world. Here's your share. Don't go spending it in any Italian restaurants.
zh: ~z~我们做到了，这他妈就是世界第一。这份是你的，不过别拿到意大利餐馆去花。

english: ~z~Can you get us a car, man? I'm afraid these two idiots can't drive for shit.
zh: ~z~你能给我们弄辆车吗，兄弟？我看这俩傻屌多半不会开车。

english: ~z~I'd like to see him try it. Not gonna happen with the things Gerry knows.
zh: ~z~我是无所谓。只要格里知道的那些黑料还在，这就不可能。

english: ~z~How were we supposed to get that money outta there if our getaway boat gets trashed before we're even on board?
zh: ~z~我们还没上船船就没了，这他妈还怎么把钱带出去？

english: ~z~Our family used to be bigger than all them Mafia families put together. Back in the day, that is.
zh: ~z~我们家族比这些黑手党家族加起来还大。不过那是以前了。

english: ~z~He swears to this day that he wanted to serve the Lord. Gerry knows the truth though.
zh: ~z~直到现在他还整天发誓他想侍奉主。不过格里知道实情。

english: ~z~Fuck you, Gordon. I'll fucking come back there and kick your fucking ass in a minute.
zh: ~z~去你妈的，戈登。老子这就到后排来收拾你丫的。

english: ~z~Michael's out. Does anyone know where he keeps his cash? Fuck it, I'm gone.
zh: ~z~迈克尔挂了。有哪位知道他钱都存哪儿了吗？操蛋，我走了。

english: ~z~You shouldn't save too much, Michael. You never know, you might get hit by a bus tomorrow.
zh: ~z~你不该太节俭的，迈克尔。指不定明天你就被车撞死了呢。

english: ~z~That sounds like the Francis McReary I met.
zh: ~z~听起来还是挺像我遇到的那个弗朗西斯･麦克雷里的。

english: ~z~Don't fucking worry about it. They'll just figure it was another one of the five families.
zh: ~z~用不着担心这个。他们会当这是五大家族的另一批人干的。

english: ~z~Okay kids, I got the cash. Shit! Looks like we're not the only ones after it.
zh: ~z~好了，小子们，钱我拿到了。操！看来想要这笔钱的不止我们一个。

english: ~z~Not gonna throw it at the bookies like Gordon over here. I'm saving it up so...
zh: ~z~一分钱都不会扔到赌场里去的，不像戈登那样。我把钱存着，以后就...

english: ~z~The only thing they're doing for Gordon is keeping the bookies off his back for another week.
zh: ~z~再多的钱也只能让戈登从赌场主手里多活一个礼拜。

english: ~z~These places are messed up. I think this Ray guy is fucking with you.
zh: ~z~净是些乱七八糟的地方。我看那个叫雷的是存心搞你。

english: ~z~...so the plan was they were gonna hide the diamonds in the Queen's ass!
zh: ~z~...结果他们的计划是把钻石藏在女王的屁眼里！

english: ~z~You think even these Alderney guidos would have the balls to do that?
zh: ~z~你以为连这些奥尔德尼的意呆佬都有胆子笑我们？

english: ~z~We're talking, not having casual sex, Patrick...
zh: ~z~我们不过是聊两句，又没有乱搞性关系，帕特里克...

english: ~z~Not this shit again. I heard this speech a million times. The McRearys ran the city.
zh: ~z~别说这些狗屁了。这套话我都听了几百万回了。麦克雷里家族在城里呼风唤雨。

english: ~z~It's the fucking Pegorinos, man. We're workin for them.
zh: ~z~那他妈叫佩戈里诺家族，兄弟。我们就在替他们干活。

english: ~z~you're only getting your hands on one of those things, you maniac, and it ain't going to be my Katie.
zh: ~z~二者只能得其一，你这疯子。不过我妹你就别想了。

english: ~z~I am not so familiar with these English phrases, but isn't that meant to mean something was easy?
zh: ~z~我不是很懂这些英语俗语，不过这句不是用来说这事很简单的吗？

english: ~z~Alright, we're heading over to the docks in Dukes. Make it happen.
zh: ~z~好了，我们要向公爵区的码头进发。好好开吧。(BETA)

english: ~z~Shut it, Gordo. Ray's given us a tip off about a big payment the Ancelottis just got.
zh: ~z~闭嘴，戈多。雷给我们放了风，是关于安切洛蒂家族刚到手的一笔大钱的。

english: ~z~You think they're having a laugh with Gerald, Gordo?
zh: ~z~要么你看看他们在格里面前还笑不笑得出来，戈多？

english: ~z~He may have a badge, but I tell you for a fact he's as crooked as the rest of us McRearys.
zh: ~z~他的确是个警察，不过我跟你讲，实际上他跟我们麦克雷里家族的其他人一样坏。

english: ~z~People was scared to say their name let alone come near their place in Purgatory.
zh: ~z~人们连他们的名字都不敢提，更别说靠近他们在炼狱的地盘了。

english: ~z~you're only getting your hands on one of those things, you maniac, and it ain't going to be my Katie.
zh: ~z~二者你只能得其一，你这危险分子，不过不准你拿我的凯特。

english: ~z~Shut up and think about the money. If that don't work, think about my sister. I tell you though,
zh: ~z~闭上嘴想想这笔钱吧。要是这还不行，就想想我妹妹。不过话我先撂这儿，

english: ~z~Fucking with us or not, these jobs pay the bills, don't they?
zh: ~z~不管是不是搞我们，反正这些差事会给钱就对了。

english: ~z~We made it, Niko. Who'd a thought we'd fucking survive that?
zh: ~z~我们做到了，尼克。谁他妈能想到我们能活着出来？

english: ~z~It's fucking true. I'd like to hear you tell Gerald that it's a boring story.
zh: ~z~这他妈是事实。我看你敢不敢跟格里说这是个无聊的故事。

english: ~z~Shut up, Gordon. So, Niko, when Francis and Gerald was growing up, Frankie becomes an altar boy.
zh: ~z~闭嘴，戈登。听好，尼克，~n~弗朗西斯和格里还小的时候，弗兰基就成了辅祭男童。

english: ~z~Gordon, Michael. You hold these boys back while me and Niko make a swim for it with the money.
zh: ~z~戈登，迈克尔，你俩拖住他们，我和尼克先带着钱游过去。

english: ~z~Whatever, at least I'm honest about my habits, Derrick.
zh: ~z~随便啦，至少我吸大麻烟的方法是真的，德里克。

english: ~z~Niko, these are my two brothers, well two of my brothers, the two that count.
zh: ~z~尼克，他们是我的两个哥哥，其中两个哥哥，说得上话的两个。

english: ~z~Patrick, you was such a sweet little boy when I left this city.
zh: ~z~帕特里克，我刚离开这儿的时候你还是个好孩子。

english: ~z~nothing personal, but don't fuck with my family, or I will fuck with yours.
zh: ~z~我不是针对你，但你别给我的家族添乱，否则我要你家好看。

english: ~z~I'm not taking that fucking blood money. Them people didn't need to die.
zh: ~z~这票沾满人血的钱老子不要了。他们没必要死的。

english: ~z~That's a bad omen if ever I saw one. We didn't even get to the damn bank. I'll speak to you soon, Niko.
zh: ~z~这要还不算凶兆，我就没见过凶兆。咱们连银行都没进去。回头再聊，尼克。

english: ~z~Don't none of you worry about nothing. We're here for the bank's money, it's going to a greater cause.
zh: ~z~你们不用害怕，我们只要银行的钱，都是为你们好。

english: ~z~Niko, there ain't no way we're leading all these cops back to the house. Lose 'em.
zh: ~z~尼克，绝不能把这些条子引到家里去。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~I scored a touchdown and won the game. The world is built out of bad ideas, my friend.
zh: ~z~我触地得分赢得了比赛。世界终究是由各种坏主意构成的，我的朋友。

english: ~z~We ain't going back to me ma's house with all this heat, man. Shake the cops.
zh: ~z~风头这么紧，我们可不能就这么回我妈家，老兄。把条子甩掉。

english: ~z~Me and me brother will hold the pigs back. Get us a car, Niko.
zh: ~z~我和我兄弟来挡住那群猪。给我们弄辆车，尼克。

english: ~z~Yeah? They said catching that pass at my high school championship football game was a "bad idea"
zh: ~z~是吗？我在高校橄榄球决赛的那次接球也被说是「坏主意」，

english: ~z~Niko is a trip, man, I met him through that Puerto Rican coke dealer...
zh: ~z~尼克是个猛男，老兄。我在波多黎各可卡因贩子那里认识他的...

english: ~z~Never does, Patrick. The best laid plans of mice and men often go awry.
zh: ~z~从来都不一样，帕特里克。计划永远赶不上变化。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. You want to leave one of us behind? Get something we're all gonna fit in.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。你是想扔下我们之一吗？找辆我们乘得下的东西。

english: ~z~Why're you tellin' them we're brothers, you idiot? That's going to make it hard for them to find us, isn't it?
zh: ~z~你丫说我们是兄弟干嘛，傻逼吗？这不是更容易让我们被抓？

english: ~z~I coulda been nice to him for once in my fucking life. Kid only wanted to help.
zh: ~z~我他妈之前该对他好一点的，这小子只是想帮点忙而已。

english: ~z~They don't make things easy for us, do they? Damn bridge is blocked.
zh: ~z~他们就是不让我们省心，是吧？该死的桥被封了。

english: ~z~when you stop shoving half of Bolivia up your nose every Saturday night!
zh: ~z~只要你别每周六晚上都把半个玻利维亚的毒品吸到肚！

english: ~z~Now listen people, we're your friends. Me and me brother here, we...
zh: ~z~你们都听好了，我们是你们的朋友。我和我弟弟会...

english: ~z~He loved you, Packie. He was happy you spoke to him. Didn't matter what you was saying.
zh: ~z~他爱你，派奇。你跟他说话他就很高兴了，你说什么都行。

english: ~z~Alright, alright. Do we all know what we're doing? Once the vault door blows,
zh: ~z~行了行了。各位都搞清楚分工了吗？金库门一炸开，

english: ~z~Walk in with guns and bombs, walk out with the cash. Simple as that.
zh: ~z~带着枪和炸弹进去，揣着现金出来。就这么简单。

english: ~z~I'm trying to be honest with these people. We've put them through a lot today.
zh: ~z~我只是想对他们诚实点。今天给他们添了够多麻烦了。

english: ~z~You think me, me brother and the money are gonna fit in that thing? Get something bigger.
zh: ~z~你觉得这玩意够装我、我弟弟和钱吗？找辆大点的来。

english: ~z~Fuck you, take the needle out your arm then tell me what to do.
zh: ~z~操你妈！先把你膀子上的针头拔下来，再对我发号施令。

english: ~z~It was meant to be easy, Niko. It was meant to be fun. Shit. See you round.
zh: ~z~明明应该很容易的，尼克。明明应该很快乐的。靠。回头见。

english: ~z~Now you've said bloody Ireland, that's gonna narrow the search ain't it?
zh: ~z~你他妈说了爱尔兰是吧，这不是又把范围缩小了？

english: ~z~Sure. So, Derrick, you got the charge rigged up to your phone?
zh: ~z~当然。那德里克，破门的时候是用你的手机引爆吗？

english: ~z~Safe to say, what we're using is controllable enough to go through any vault door without incinerating whatever's inside.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，这种炸药可控性强，~n~能够炸穿任何金库大门，还不会损伤里面的东西。

english: ~z~I wasn't just driving you two, the money was in the car as well. Remember that.
zh: ~z~我不只是替你俩开车，车里面可还有钱呢。记着点。

english: ~z~All makes sense to me. If you guys can stop arguing for a few minutes then I think we might be okay.
zh: ~z~我是明白了。只要你们少吵一会儿架，我们基本就稳了。

english: ~z~We won't forget it, Niko. Here's your cut. I'll tell Gerry you did good. He might give you a call or something.
zh: ~z~我们不会忘的，尼克。这是你的那份。~n~我会告诉格里你干得很好的。改天他可能会打电话找你。

english: ~z~Niko, that thing can't take all of us and this cash. Use your head, man.
zh: ~z~尼克，那破车坐不下我们几个加这一堆钱。用用脑子吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~Alright, boys. The only way we got to go is along the tracks. Come on.
zh: ~z~好了小子们。我们唯一的去路就是顺着轨道走了。来吧。

english: ~z~Sure you do, you believe in the needle and its power to make the rest of the world disappear, while you dream of nonsense.
zh: ~z~是啊你当然有信仰——你信针头，信它能让你把全世界都忘掉，整天做着白日梦。

english: ~z~How is you, me and Derrick gonna fit in there with the money?
zh: ~z~就你我还有德里克，加这一堆钱，那车怎么坐得下？

english: ~z~This ain't the type of thing I agree with. I ain't in it for the money. I believe in something, you know?
zh: ~z~这种事我可不认同。我不是为了钱入的伙。我是有信仰的人，懂吗？

english: ~z~I got told this was going to be a smooth job. Real easy, they told me. No casualties.
zh: ~z~他们跟我说这票很顺。说容易得很。不会出人命。

english: ~z~I saw your eyes light up when you thought about all the drugs you could buy with this haul.
zh: ~z~你盘算这批钱能买多少毒品的时候，我看得见你眼睛都亮了。

english: ~z~This is typical. A typical fucking McReary family screw up. Can't we do nothing right.
zh: ~z~真是一如既往。麦克雷里家祖传的搞砸。我们就没有做对的事吗。

english: ~z~Jesus, Packie. Show some fucking consideration. Sorry if I'm a man of principle unlike you and Gerald.
zh: ~z~我的天，派奇。多少替人考虑考虑，行吗。对不起了，不像你和格里，我可是有原则的人。

english: ~z~Get in cover, Packie. Ma'd be real upset if you got hit.
zh: ~z~找掩护，派奇。妈要是知道你挨了枪非得伤心死。

english: ~z~He's going to love the fact that us boys pulled off the biggest bank heist in this city's history.
zh: ~z~我们哥几个干成了本市史上最大银行劫案，他肯定乐坏了。

english: ~z~I never shoulda come back to Liberty City. I knew Gerald would get me back into this shit.
zh: ~z~我就不该回自由城。我早知道格里会把我重新拖进这堆烂事里。

english: ~z~Shit, they sent a chopper after us. There ain't no getting away. We're done.
zh: ~z~操，他们派出直升机了。这下逃不掉了，我们完了。

english: ~z~I'm gonna knock myself out for the fucking count. Try to forget about all this shit.
zh: ~z~非得把自己折腾到不省人事，好把这些破事统统忘掉。

english: ~z~I can taste the fresh air, boys. Can't have long to go.
zh: ~z~小子们，我都尝到新鲜空气的味儿了。快到头了。

english: ~z~They ain't gonna get us from behind, boys. I got it covered.
zh: ~z~他们休想从背后偷袭我们，小子们。后面有我盯着。

english: ~z~I ain't been here since Frankie threw me a farewell dinner when I was going to Ireland. That was a lifetime ago.
zh: ~z~上次来这儿还是去爱尔兰之前，弗兰基为我饯行的时候。已经是很久以前了。

english: ~z~Niko you're the getaway driver. Will ya get us back to my ma's?
zh: ~z~尼克，你是接应司机。把我们送回我妈家，行吗？

english: ~z~We'll be laughing about this shit tomorrow, boys, I promise ya that.
zh: ~z~明天咱们就能拿今天这些破事开涮了，小子们，我保证。

english: ~z~This ain't my idea of fun, boys. Would ya give me a hand?
zh: ~z~要我说这可算不上寻开心，小子们。谁来搭把手？

english: ~z~Shit, they've followed us down here. They're in the subway too.
zh: ~z~操，他们跟到这儿来了，地铁站里也是他们的人。

english: ~z~Make sure these pricks don't shoot the bags. Notes with bullet holes in 'em are gonna be mighty hard to get rid of.
zh: ~z~别让这些屌人打到包上面。有弹孔的钱可花不出去。

english: ~z~You knew what this job was when you signed up. Don't pretend that you're all holier than thou.
zh: ~z~入伙的时候你就知道干的是这买卖。少装得道貌岸然。

english: ~z~The can't be another truck full of them. Jesus. They're blocking the roads.
zh: ~z~不会又是一整车他们的人吧。我的天。他们把路都封了。

english: ~z~Can't you remember coming over to my place and throwing the TV out the window?
zh: ~z~你是不是忘了你之前来我家把我电视砸窗户外边的事情了？

english: ~z~Pissing all over my couch? Slumlord kicked me out on the street.
zh: ~z~把我的沙发尿得一团糟？搞得房东把我赶到大街上。

english: ~z~How am I gonna cope out here? Who knows what I did when I was on the sauce?
zh: ~z~这我还怎么在这儿混啊？谁知道我喝醉的时候都干了什么？

english: ~z~Yeah... yes, siree. I'm a new man. Not dependent on anything.
zh: ~z~对...完全就是。我重新做人，不会依赖任何东西了。

english: ~z~Thanks, man. Can you take me back to where we were before?
zh: ~z~谢了，老兄。你能送我回来这儿前的那个地方吗？

english: ~z~ I'm sure you was one of those commie bastards used to come in there. I remember you.
zh: ~z~你肯定是那群整天来的共产混蛋中的一个。我记得你。

english: City officials gave no word as to when this siege on common sense will continue, but residents are urged to support liberal candidates in the next election so we can have our freedoms back, like the important freedom to ban smoking, profanity or anything that might upset people who recycle.
zh: 市政府官员没有透露这场对常识的围攻会持续多久，但是居民被怂恿在下一次选举中支持自由派候选人，这样我们就可以重获自由，比如禁止吸烟和脏话的重要自由，出台令垃圾分类践行者落泪的政策的重要自由。

english: The so called "War on Terror" is now a war on commuters and the poor, who don't have helicopters but instead are forced to use trains, bridges and tunnels, many of which are closed after an unsubstantiated Internet threat. Rather than broker peace talks and work to end global warming, Liberty City politicians and federal agents are flush with anti-terror cash which they stuff down the panties of defense contractors to turn this city into a war zone.
zh: 所谓的「反恐战争」却成为了一场针对通勤者和穷人的战争。他们没有直升机，只能选择城铁、桥梁和隧道，而未经证实的网络恐怖威胁封堵了他们仅剩的选择。自由城的政客和联邦探员并没有选择和平谈判，也没有尝试解决气候变暖，反倒将反恐资金塞进国防承包商的口袋，把本市变成了战区。

english: The Panoramic e-fridge 5000 detects the user of your fridge and monitors nutritional habits. A midnight snack of frozen French fries, pizzas with mustard and fishstick bacon omelets will trigger the intelligent engine and send an email to mom and dad that their child is most likely high as shit. If the e-fridge 5000 detects that it hasn't been accessed by your daughter in a few days, an eating disorder alert will be sent. The price is planned at $6,000.
zh: 全景牌5000型智能冰箱会检测冰箱使用者的身份，并监测其营养习惯。一份速冻薯条、芥末披萨和炸鱼条培根蛋卷组成的夜宵将触发智能引擎，向父母发送一封电子邮件，告诉他们的孩子很可能在家嗨到不行了。如果5000型智能冰箱检测到你的女儿数日没有使用记录，就会发送饮食失调警告。目前产品的计划售价为$6000。

english: While most liberal-minded voters are opposed to the constant electronic monitoring of American citizens, as parents, we owe it to our children to track their every move. Whether it's the Trackify device or hiring a private investigator, it's your responsibility to make your kids safe. But it's very difficult to know if your child is using drugs. We've all dabbled in a little reefer and the occasional rail but, once you become a parent, it's time to change your tune and pretend your child won't go through the same adolescent trials and tribulations you did and get sanctimonious on them.
zh: 虽然大多数持有自由主义观念的选民反对对美国公民进行长期电子监控，但作为父母，我们有责任监视孩子的一举一动。无论是使用追踪设备还是雇佣私家侦探，保证孩子的安全都是你的责任。但想知道你的孩子是否在吸毒很难。我们都碰过大麻，偶尔还吸吸白粉，不过一旦为人父母，你就该改变你的态度，假装你的孩子不会经历你曾经历过的青春期的考验和磨难，在他们面前装作自己没有吸毒之类的陋习。

english: So conservatives and police have been banging on about the link between drugs and terrorism - as if it is a surprise - but their equation does not quite add up. They left out one important variable: big business and, in particular, big oil. Drug money is laundered through the same patriarchal banking system as oil profits and big business. Drugs are BIG BUSINESS - supported by the same corrupt puppet governments that support both terror and the oil industry. The facts are clear - stop local communities from growing marijuana and they will gateway to opium and then very quickly to fundamentalism.
zh: 保守派和警方一直在猛烈抨击毒品和恐怖主义之间的联系，搞得跟真有这回事一样，但他们的等式并不完全成立。他们漏掉了一个重要的变量：政商勾结，尤其是石油巨头。与石油利润和政商勾结一样，毒品资金也是通过家长制的银行体系洗钱的。毒品也是政商勾结的一环——由同样支持恐怖主义和石油工业的腐败傀儡政府支持。事实很清晰——阻止当地民众种植大麻，他们就会走向鸦片，然后很快就会走向原教旨主义。

english: But no, the prohibitionists believe they can control everything and everyone, legislate morality and profit from all our misery, by fabricating a link between drug dealing in Colombia and terrorism in America. There is no link. Terrorism is a direct result of our foreign policy - a policy that is so inherently ludicrous it is beyond any parody I can imagine.
zh: 但是，禁毒派认为他们可以控制任何东西和所有人，他们借口哥伦比亚的毒品交易和美国的恐怖主义之间存在联系，据此用法律规定道德，并从我们所有的苦难中获利。实际上并没有任何联系。恐怖主义是我们外交政策的直接结果——这一政策比任何讽刺作品都要荒唐。

english: What does the news that the BAWSAQ 100 closed up 12 points mean to a man who can't buy a sandwich and has to degrade himself in public for money to buy cheap liquor? The stock market is nothing more than a big fat casino for rich people. Unfortunately, when they bust, we're all screwed. Conservatives think the future would be brighter if we invested all of our retirement money into oil and armaments. You should invest in sustainable crops, like marijuana. And recycle and wear hemp underwear. Please, if we don't, we'll totally die and I won't get to go to the smoldering dude festival in the desert and get cranked to the ether on peyote.
zh: 对于一个连三明治都买不起、为了买便宜酒而不得不在公共场合贬低自己的人来说，BAWSAQ 100指数收盘上涨12点的新闻意味着什么？对富人来说，股市不过是一个大赌场。不幸的是，他们一破产，我们就完了。保守派认为，如果我们把所有的退休金都投入石油和军备，前景会更光明。你应该投资可持续的农作物，比如大麻。然后回收之、制成能穿的麻内衣。拜托，如果我们不这样做，我们会死的，我可不想参加沙漠里又闷又热的爷们儿派对，也不想吸佩奥特碱吸到神志不清。

english: It's tough being a godless liberal in a theocracy, but it's about to get even worse if Congress has its way. "Everyone should be able to get married," says Phil Kensington of the American Society of Same Sex, "I want to marry my life partner, who is a 79 year old man, but very wealthy, and I am 26 and love to club and we have a great time. If we don't marry, how can I ride this old git for a couple of years, cringing every time he slobbers on me and calls it a kiss, just so I can take his millions?"
zh: 在一个神权政体中，成为一个无神论的自由主义者很难，但如果国会执意这样行事，情况将变得更糟。「每个人都应该能够结婚，」 美国同性恋协会的菲尔･肯辛顿说「我想和我的终身伴侣结婚，他79岁了，但是很富有。而我26岁，喜欢去夜店，我们在一起很开心。要是我们不结婚，我怎么会骑这老家伙好几年、每次他管对我流口水的行为叫亲吻就巴结他，然后拿走他的百万家产呢？」

english: Critics are divided and have promised a symposium on the subject. One anthropologist noted, "Web 2.0 is a revelation - there's no doubt about it - or the fact is my career has gone nowhere as a serious academic so I'm now doing a paper on the internet in a bid to get some TV appearances and tenure that way. My next book will have a controversial title, and probably feature tits." The debate continues, until someone stops the funding.
zh: 批判人士意见不一，并承诺将就此问题召开研讨会。一位人类学家指出，「毋庸置疑，Web 2.0是一个启示。说实话，作为一名正经学者，我的事业已经无路可走，所以我正在写一篇关于互联网的论文，希望能借此获得上电视的机会和终身职称。我的下一本书的标题或将引起争议，不过很可能会以奶子为特色。」争论还将继续，直到有人停止资助。

english: Sociologists and other irrelevant academics have begun to furiously debate the question on everyone's lips - web 2.0: is it interesting, or not? It seems no one can decide. Certainly people turning their lives into content for everyone else to watch online and then turn into their own content for others to listen to and blog about has taken art and broadcasting from the elite to the masses. Is it in fact one of the most boring things we've ever witnessed?
zh: 社会学家和其他不相干的学者已经开始激烈地讨论备受关注的问题：Web 2.0能否带来新意？似乎没人能够给出定论。人们把自己的生活变成任何人都能在线观看的内容，然后再变成自己的谈资，用于撰写博客，这确实让艺术和传媒从精英阶层走向了大众。这真的是我们所见过的最无趣的事情吗？

english: Officials also said they are paying special attention to eastern Europeans. Great, more racial profiling.
zh: 政府还说他们会加倍留意东欧人。好，又是种族歧视。

english: Well, it's finally over. The King has won and Rome is burning. The conservatives have had their way and the constitution is in shambles. With the renewal of the Jingoism Act, EVERY SINGLE THING YOU DO will be monitored. There are 300 million people in America and a reported 300 million people will need to be hired to track the every movement of every American. These are scary times and I am so glad to be a liberal journalist who doesn't interject her personal feelings into stories. The blogosphere is the only thing that can save us from this tyranny.
zh: 好了，终于结束了。国王赢了，罗马正在燃烧。保守派成功了，宪法成了一团糟。在沙文主义法案更新后，「你所做的一切」都将受到监控。美国有3亿人，据报道需要雇佣3亿人来监视所有美国人的一举一动。坏时代要来了，幸好我是自由派记者，不必将自己的私情融入报导。博客圈是唯一能从这种暴政中拯救我们的东西。

english: With the murder of heroic attorney, Tom Goldberg, a blow has been struck to the heart of the first amendment and freedom fighters everywhere. A moment of silence was called in the blogosphere as Mr. Goldberg stood for the freedom of speech and the rights of the little man to slander people anonymously online with no repercussions. He was in favor of immigration and proposed much tighter gun control. No wonder so few conservatives are mourning. He stood up to corporate America and the links between big business and government.
zh: 在英勇的律师汤姆･戈德堡被谋杀后，《第一修正案》和各地自由斗士的内心都受到了沉重打击。博客圈响起一阵默哀，戈德堡先生支持言论自由，为普通人在网上匿名诽谤他人而没有后果站台。他支持移民，并提议加强枪支管制。难怪如此少的保守派人士在哀悼。他坚决反对美国公司和政商勾结。

english: After a Freedom of Information Act request to the FIB, I found out that they had done surveillance on me and found out that I liked to visit trannies under the Broker Bridge. It is inexcusable that the government is reading my blog TranEELuvr. It is this kind of surveillance state that will bring this country down.
zh: 在向FIB提请《信息自由法案》后，我发现他们对我进行了监视，发现我喜欢在布洛克桥下见变性人。政府阅读我的博客TranEELuvr是不可原谅的。正是这种监视状态将让国家衰落。

english: The National Library Center is shutting down - as are all libraries nationwide - in a conspiracy by big chain computer stores and Bean Machine to make all information electronic so that the government can more easily read everything you do or say. With GPS devices in all mobile phones, the government can pinpoint your exact location at any time.
zh: 国家图书馆中心正在关闭，全国图书馆都是如此。这是大型连锁电脑店和冰的咖啡的阴谋，目的是将所有的信息电子化，这样政府就可以更容易地监视你的一言一行。通过所有手机都内置的GPS装置，政府可以随时获得你的准确位置。

english: Additionally, they have increased unconstitutional car inspections on the Broker Bridge. I was stopped on my way back to South Slopes after a trip to Vespucci University to pick up a pound of marijuana. Tempted to keep going, I eventually decided to stop for these fascists. What right does this fascist cop have to pull me over and inspect my trunk? Screw you, pig!
zh: 此外，他们还加强了违宪的布洛克大桥汽车检查。我去韦斯普奇大学取了一磅大麻，在回南坡的路上就给拦了下来。为了能继续前进，我还是决定为这些法西斯分子停车。这个法西斯警察有什么权利拦停我检查我的后备箱？去你妈的，猪头！

english: The increase of the terror threat level is another example of the National Office of Security Enforcement's sensationalism and willingness to limit our civil liberties. The money they have invested in putting a PR spin on public fears could have been invested in recycling and urban community composting schemes.
zh: 提升恐怖威胁等级是国安办制造恐慌和限制公民自由的又一案例。他们大可将用于制造恐慌的资金投资给垃圾回收和城市社区堆肥计划。

english: Every revolution needs a name, and this one is 2.0. Web 2.0 is so amazing that what most people don't realize is that there never was a dotcom bubble. Web 2.0 is the second generation. You are probably still living in your Web 1.0 land - never even aware that everything has evolved, passed you by and left you for dead. You are old. You are becoming irrelevant. Kids look at you with disgust. You are living in an information silo while the rest of us are 26-7 Internet 2.0. When I shit, it is automatically recorded on my blog, an RSS feed is sent out, my www.grype.org buddies are notified, and it goes out to the www.myroomonline.net community. It's a revolution. I have thousands of friends I've never met. I am so alone. The darkness is closing in.
zh: 革命都得有个名号，而这次的革命就叫2.0。Web 2.0如此神奇，导致绝大多数人都没有意识到从未有什么互联网泡沫。Web 2.0已是第二世代了，你却可能还活在Web 1.0的土地上——浑然不知一切都进化了，一切都抛下了你，离你而去。你已经老了，和社会脱节了。孩子们会用厌恶的眼光看你。你活在信息孤岛上，而我们其他人都26x7地活在互联网2.0中。我一拉屎，就会自动记录在博客上，然后推送一条RSS，我在 Grype上的好友就会收到提醒，之后再流传到MyRoom网。这是一场革命。我拥有成百上千个素未谋面的朋友。我如此寂寞。黑暗已然来临。

english: We are all doomed, living in a low-lying coastal city, but while the government willfully refuses to consider outlawing cars or energy, we might as well drown ourselves. Future generations will hate us even more than we hate ourselves, and the fact is they will be right.

english: The bridge and tunnel crossings between Algonquin and Alderney were finally reopened yesterday as the terror threat caused by the mismanagement of the war on terror was deemed to have sufficiently reduced enough to allow us to carry on destroying the planet by the burning of fossil fuels. It's global warming stupid. It's a win - win for big business as usual. As income from the war goes down, oil revenues go up as people start increasing their carbon footprint again.

english: A blast from the past today as former talk show host Lazlow is trying to get back on the airwaves. Lazlow used to host a popular show on a station called Chatterbox at the turn of the millennium, then things turned bad for him and he disappeared from our airwaves after a string of personal humiliations and bad choices, including several payola scandals, and a series of sexual shenanigans led to major credibility issues. But it appears he is back. Or trying to get back. He's been trying to raise financing for a new radio station to be launched in Liberty City in which the listener is put right into the action.

english: Announcing his plans at a poorly-attended press conference yesterday, he said, "This is radio 2.0, this is Lazlow 2.0, I'm back." When asked to explain what on earth this could mean, the popular shock jock said, "I don't really know - it's up to you, the listeners, to decide.' We will stay on this story in the hope this guy makes something of himself.
zh: 昨天，他在门庭冷清的记者招待会上公布了他的计划，他说：「这就是电台 2.0，这就是拉兹洛 2.0，我回来了。」当被问及所谓2.0究竟有何区别时，这名人气DJ回答道：「我也不清楚。主要还是看你们——听众们——的意见。」我们会持续跟进此事，希望他能有所成就。

english: The Deputy Police Commissioner for Liberty City, Francis McReary, was gunned down in Algonquin earlier. Some were shocked that a member of the LCPD would be the victim of a gangland execution, but not those that knew what he was really like. McReary's own brother, a known associate of the Alderney mob, was recently arrested on racketeering charges. This news organization was approached by two independent sources wishing to expose photographic evidence of Francis McReary's taking bribes. Soon after they made contact, however, both men were mysteriously murdered. One of these men was lawyer Tom Goldberg.
zh: LCPD副局长，弗朗西斯･麦克雷里，早前在阿尔冈琴遭遇枪击身亡。有人对LCPD的一员竟会死于黑社会私刑感到惊诧，但知其本性的人对此并不意外。麦克雷里的哥哥是奥尔德尼一个黑帮的同伙，于近日受涉黑指控被捕。曾有两个独立情报人士愿意向本站提供弗朗西斯･麦克雷里收受贿赂的照片证据，然而在联络后不久，这两人都离奇死亡。其中一人正是律师汤姆･戈德堡。

english: Sources within the LCPD have alleged that McReary was willing to take justice into his own hands in order to get his department's case clearance level up. In the weeks leading up to his death, this website had been attempting to get a comment from McReary on all of these accusations. He did not respond to our requests. Now, it seems, he will take the secrets of his corrupt reign of terror to his grave.
zh: LCPD内部人士声称麦克雷里本想采取一切手段提高其部门的结案率。在其死前几周，本站一直尝试从麦克雷里口中取得其对这些指控的看法，但其没有对此做出回应。看来现在，他就要将自己恐怖腐败统治的种种秘密带入坟墓了。

Some were shocked that a brother of a senior member of the LCPD would be the victim of a gangland execution, but not those that knew what the McReary family is really like. Derrick McReary, 52, had recently returned to the US from Ireland and was himself caught up in organized crime. Some believe he may have been trying to blackmail the Deputy Commissioner who himself saw his brother as a liability. Another brother, Gerald McReary, a known associate of the Alderney mob, was recently arrested on racketeering charges.
zh: 早些时候，自由城警察局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里于他的兄弟德里克在阿尔冈琴被枪杀时袖手旁观。有些人对一名LCPD高级警员的兄弟，会成为黑社会私刑的受害者感到震惊。但那些了解麦克雷里家族真实情况的人不这么认为。52岁的德里克･麦克雷里最近刚从爱尔兰回到美国，他本人也卷入了有组织犯罪。有人认为，他可能一直在试图敲诈副局长，而副局长本人也将他的兄弟视作累赘。他的另一个兄弟，格里･麦克雷里，是奥尔德尼黑帮的知名同伙，近因涉黑指控被捕。

english: This news organization was approached by two independent sources wishing to expose photographic evidence of Francis McReary's taking bribes. Soon after they made contact, however, both men were mysteriously murdered. One of these men was lawyer Tom Goldberg. Sources within the LCPD have alleged that McReary was willing to take justice into his own hands in order to get his department's case clearance level up. In the weeks leading up to his brother's death, this website had been attempting to get a comment from McReary on all of these accusations. He has so far not responded to our requests.

english: A spokesperson for activist group Citizens Understand Medieval Games Undermine Loving Parents argued that video games are to blame for this crime because fantasy has melded into reality in the minds of these sickos just like in too many of the games they play. The spokesperson added that she is available for all media appearances and TV shows on the subject and is writing a book about how children should be raised.

Obviously, video games also cause global warming and a lot of antisocial behavior, including farting, but now it turns out they also cause impotence in 90% of men, according to reports published yesterday. It makes a lot of sense - for years people put the falling birth rate down to the hopelessness of contemporary society and the terror of living in a godless world, but thankfully we have a new enemy.

"These savages love to copulate," Craig Wolternson said of the study, "They get riled up watching men pin each other down on TV, then in a drunken rage they toss and pile-drive the nearest woman for an hour - often resulting in pregnancy. It's an epidemic. These idiots breed like rabbits."

I work tirelessly with civic groups and politicians to ban video games, indecent words in movies, tobacco billboards, skateboarding, teen sex and eating meat that isn't free range. So when I want to take my kid to a baseball game and he sees these overpaid losers down there full of chemicals, what am I supposed to tell him? That mommy is on Ampheterate since starting therapy years ago? That daddy has to take a Mollis in order to bypass his biological response to throw up on my saggy tits? That we sneak gin martinis at lunch? What? These players deserve to be fired.

You should be able to marry your clone. It will be like a gum commercial. It's time to get hate out of the political process and let love rule. Love yourself.

The tragic bias against Dr. Yahann Klietzel is nothing more than hate politics. A man who has sex with another man is fine - even if it is his underage clone.

We asked Mr. Goldberg what he thought was the next step for him after the city government has taken notice of his complaints, "Well, it's a big job I've got at hand. The LCPD has been corrupt for years and there are a lot of people in it who need to pay for their actions.

english: But, when they have, I'm thinking green lawsuits are the next big thing. If you can sue a tobacco company for giving you lung cancer, why can't you sue an oil company for putting a hole in the ozone layer and giving you skin cancer? Or a car company for polluting the environment and screwing up your lungs. A professional skier would have good cause to sue someone for causing global warming and stopping it snowing. These cases are the future." The potential for a class action suit involving loss of income and medical complaints due to global warming could be huge.
zh: 不过在此之后，我觉得该侧重于环保方面的诉讼了。既然可以起诉烟草公司害你得肺癌，为什么不能起诉石油公司让臭氧层漏了，害你得皮肤癌呢？还可以起诉汽车公司破坏环境，害你生了肺病。职业滑雪运动员完全可以控告某人造成全球变暖，使得降雪减少。以后主要是这方面。因全球变暖导致的收入损失或健康损害类案件还有很多可以深挖。

english: Corrupt CEOs, politicians and police officers don't like the name Tom Goldberg. "If you are doing difficult and important work, then you can't expect everyone to like you. Kids hate going to the dentist but, you know, where would they be without him? Their teeth would be rotten. I'm like that with the city. I try to get rid of the decay." Mr. Goldberg made his name by launching class action suits against Betta Pharmaceuticals and other companies floated on the BAWSAQ 100.
zh: 腐败的CEO、政客和警察都不喜欢汤姆･戈德堡这个名字。「如果你的工作困难而重要，就不能指望每个人都喜欢你。孩子们不喜欢去看牙医，但是，没了他们真不行啊，牙齿会烂掉的。我之于本市就是这样。我在尝试除掉腐败。」对贝塔制药等上市公司发起的团体诉讼让戈德堡先生一炮成名。

english: As the debate in Congress rages on over illegal immigration, many activists are saying that America should continue an open door policy. "People have been coming here for hundreds of years," said Immigration Reform Center President Percy Simonson, "Who are we to close the door suddenly? Everyone in the world is an American. Come join us. Come live here. Do like we do and don't pay tax! We have no traffic or congestion problems. There is room for all." Liberals held a The Laws Don't Matter Day on Capitol Hill and protested lawmakers' attempts to enforce existing laws.
zh: 随着国会就非法移民问题展开激烈辩论，许多活动家表示，美国应该继续实行开放政策。「几百年了，人们都在往这儿来，」移民改革中心主任珀西･西蒙森说「我们有突然紧闭大门的权力吗？世界上所有人都是美国公民。来加入我们，来住在这儿。像我们一样生活，还不交税！我们没有交通拥堵的问题。所有人都能有一席之地。」自由主义者在国会山举行「法律无关紧要」的集会，抗议立法者试图执行现有法律。

english: The racists and snobs who run Liberty City once sacked Martin Hawes because he was clinically insane and wore a bra to work. Now, they are discussing an idea he came up with from his lunatic asylum bed. Why? Because, if the idea helps them make more money, they don't care where it comes from. And his idea? Re-close the bridges and tunnels. The reason? To ease traffic and keep the poor out. Only those who could afford speedboats would be able to function normally in the city. It is the proposal of a lunatic. It would keep the rich in, and the poor out. No wonder it is an idea people are actually discussing.
zh: 管理自由城的种族主义者和势利眼们曾因马丁･霍斯在临床角度上被诊断为精神失常和穿胸罩上班解雇了他。现在他们正在讨论一个他在疯人院病床上提出的想法。为什么？因为，只要这个想法能赚钱，他们就不在乎它是哪儿来的。至于是什么想法？再次关闭大桥和隧道。至于理由？减轻交通压力，与穷人进行隔离。只有那些买得起快艇的人才能在城里正常生活。这就是精神病人出的主意。它会在贫富之间划清界限。也难怪人们都会讨论这个想法。

english: For too long, Pete Vasshole has been lining his pockets with the blood of desperate people in desolate places. Typical man. Vassal's latest PR stunt is nothing more than a slap in the face to oppressed, abused, persecuted and underprivileged people everywhere. We need make a stand against the Evil Eris Empire and all the gun-touting redneck xenophobes who follow it. As we lace up our shiny new pair of sneakers, it is all too easy to forget that a child on the other side of the globe is getting whipped in an underground dungeon. Be the bigger person. Boycott Eris.
zh: 长久以来，皮特･瓦萨尔这个混蛋一直在荒凉之地压榨绝望的人们，用他们的血填满了自己的口袋。恶人啊。瓦萨尔最近的公关伎俩不过是对被压迫、被虐待、被迫害的弱势群体的一记耳光。我们要起来反抗邪恶的Eris帝国，反抗追随邪恶帝国的持枪红脖子排外者。在我们给光鲜亮丽的新球鞋系上鞋带时，不要忘记地球另一端还有被关在地牢中鞭笞的孩子。对世界负责。抵制Eris公司。

english: In yet another attempt to deflect attention from their shocking labor practices in Africa and South-East Asia, Eris has released a pathetic message on its website from fat-cat founder Pete Vassal that discusses how products are sold "at a 10,000% markup" and how "children require less sleep and women are better at multi-tasking." No doubt all the right-wing, white-trash hillbillies who read Weazel News will lap up this capitalist propaganda. Eris is the embodiment of everything that is wrong with American greed and the relentless march towards globalization. You have all seen the photos of the children with their body parts glued together. Eris forces local communities into slave labor and then kills all the babies and women of child-bearing age when they become too expensive or organized.
zh: 为了将舆论的关注点从他们非洲和东南亚工厂的不道德劳动条款上移开，Eris公司在其网站上发布了一则该公司富得流油的创始人皮特･瓦萨尔的可悲言论，其中提到如何将产品卖出「百倍利润」和「童工需要的睡眠时间更短，女性更擅长一心多用。」难怪那些看Weazel新闻的底层右翼乡巴佬白人会欣然接受这种资本家的宣传。Eris公司就是美式贪婪与大步流星的全球化的化身。你们也都见过用胶水粘上四肢的孩子的照片了。Eris公司奴役当地居民，一旦当地婴儿和育龄妇女的雇佣成本过高或成立了工会，他们就会被Eris公司屠杀殆尽。

english: Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins has been rumbled - he's been keeping someone in a city financed apartment. This arch conservative and holier-than-thou hypocrite is now hiding in rehab after his crimes were revealed. The man, Bernie Crane, also had questionable visa status and questionable choice in hot pants, when he was photographed yesterday.
zh: 副市长布莱斯･道金斯暴露了——他在城市财政补贴的公寓中上演了一出金屋藏娇。在他的罪行暴露后，这位保守而自命清高的伪君子躲进了康复中心。他所藏的伯尼･克兰的签证情况有问题，昨天拍照时他的热裤选择也很有问题。

english: Mr. Dawkins, who has long attacked the gay community was himself revealed to be a practicing homosexual. That's his business. What is our business is the money he has stolen from the city. Rather than rehab he should be working on a chain gang. Mr. Dawkins is a typical conservative - hypocritical, repressed and corrupt. We just wish he would hurry up and resign.
zh: 常年抨击同性恋社群的道金斯先生被发现是同性恋。不过那是他的事，我们更关心他从本市偷走的钱。比起康复中心，他更应该去接受劳改。道金斯先生是典型的保守派——虚伪，压抑而腐败。我们只希望他能尽快辞职。

This arch conservative and holier-than-thou hypocrite is now hiding in rehab after his crimes were revealed. The man, Bernie Crane, also had questionable visa status and questionable choice in hot pants, when he was photographed yesterday.

Rather than rehab he should be working on a chain gang. Mr. Dawkins is a typical conservative - hypocritical, repressed and corrupt. We just wish he would hurry up and resign.

english: Or maybe we are being too harsh? After all, we all fell for the greatest pyramid scheme of all time: Social Security. Now that our pensions have been blown on conservative war-games, it is easy to see how even the most ludicrous online scam could start to look appealing. President Lawton and his band of thieves have turned the US economy into a ticking time bomb. Move to India - you will be better off in the long run.
zh: 还是说我们太严格了？毕竟我们都身陷史上最大的金字塔骗局：社会保障。我们的养老金已经在保守派的战争游戏中灰飞烟灭了，由此不难发现就连最假的网络诈骗都会如此诱人。劳顿总统和他手下的贼已经让美国经济变成了一颗定时炸弹。移民到印度去吧——长远来看那边会让你过得更好。

english: It was confirmed today that the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the FRS, Darius Wolfe, frittered away taxpayers' money on a pyramid scheme. The scheme, entitled the 'Roman Empire Wealth System', promised returns of millions on an initial investment of $20,000. It comes as no shock that Wolfe would jump at the chance to become Julius Caesar: the two of them are vying for the top spot in the competition for the biggest egomaniac in history. Wolfe is now under investigation following reports that he publicly endorsed the scheme in a desperate attempt to speed up online subscriptions. It is a terrifying state of affairs that this man's manipulative words have the power to move global markets. You are better off taking financial advice from a compulsive gambler in Las Venturas.
zh: 本日，美联储理事会主席达里厄斯･沃尔夫被确认将纳税人的钱浪费在了一个金字塔骗局上。这一名为「罗马帝国财富系统」的骗局承诺，投资20,000美元即可获得数百万的收益。沃尔夫会立即抓住这一使其成为尤利乌斯·凯撒的机会并不令人意外，他俩正在争夺「史上最大利己主义者」的称号。报告指出其公开为这一骗局站台，意图在网上加速下线发展，沃尔夫现在正因此接受调查。鉴于此人的煽动言论足以撼动全球市场，事态已经极度糟糕。听取拉斯文加斯的赌鬼的理财建议会是更好的选择。

english: A young woman in Alderney City, who installed the Eunux open-source operating system on her home computer, has become the victim of an evil hate campaign. The Eunux community has taken the girl's attempts to infiltrate their little white boys' club as a personal attack on their inadequate masculinity and has thrown all their joint efforts into publicly bashing her on blogs and newsgroups. What gives a bunch of losers who spend their Saturday nights recompiling a kernel, fantasizing about sleeping with their mother and shuddering if a female brushes past them on the subway the right to take out their fear of women and lack of social skills on a 13-year-old girl? Are they afraid that she will disturb their circle jerk session? Since when was a penis a prerequisite for computer programming?
zh: 一位奥尔德尼市的年轻女性，因为在自己的电脑上安装了开源操作系统Eunux，就成了恶毒的反对运动的受害人。Eunux社区将她试图融入白人年轻男性社群的行为认定为对他们缺乏阳刚之气的人身攻击，并且不遗余力地在博客和新闻讨论组上抹黑她。是谁给了他们权利，让这些周六晚上写内核、每天意淫睡他妈、地铁上被女的碰到都发抖的失败者，可以将他们对女性的恐惧和匮乏的社交能力发泄在一个13岁的小女孩身上？他们是怕她搞乱他们的弱鸡循环会话控制吗？从什么时候开始写代码还一定要有屌了？

english: The worst part is that these young misogynists will soon be running the high-tech companies that continue to pay women 95% less than their male counterparts. The disgusting treatment of this poor girl at the hands of a group of pimple-faced teenagers who will never get laid is a microcosm of the phallocentric society in which American women are condemned to live. It is high time that Eunux woke up to the fact that a woman's interest in technology runs further than finding a cell phone that matches her shoes. You go girl. Fuck the patriarchy.
zh: 最糟的是，这些年轻的仇女癌迟早会管理起高科技公司，接着给女性雇员开比同岗位的男性雇员低95%的工资。这群注定打一辈子光棍的满脸粉刺的年轻人对这个可怜女孩的恶俗对待，正是美国妇女们被迫接受的父权社会的一个缩影。Eunux也该醒醒了，正视女性对科技的兴趣远不止找一款搭鞋子的手机的事实。前进吧，女孩们。去你大爷的父权社会。

english: Activists are outraged at what the blogosphere has dubbed the "Broker Bridge Massacre." Members of the media and activist groups charged into police headquarters to hear talking head Police Commissioner for Public Affairs, Tom Pireni, attempt to deflect complaints of brutality. In a slick propaganda slideshow and musical performance targeted to sooth activists, the show did nothing but enrage them. We should be able to do anything and go anywhere we want. What do we need police for?
zh: 社会活动家对博客圈称为「布洛克桥大屠杀」的事件感到愤怒。媒体人员和社会活动团体冲入警局总部质问警局公共事务处处长，汤姆･皮雷尼。他本想转移对暴力执法的控诉，但这场用于安抚社会活动家的空话宣传讲座和音乐表演反而激怒了他们。我们应该能做任何事情，去任何想去的地方。我们要警察干嘛？

english: Police brutality must stop. Searches and seizures must stop, especially among epileptics. And those announcements in the subway are creepy. What year are we in? 1984? Bloggers unite. Only by complaining to each other in the cold, hollow halls of cyberspace can we stop this police brutality.
zh: 暴力执法必须停止。搜查和罚没必须停止，尤其是不合理的搜查罚没。而且地铁站里的那些布告十分骇人。我们现在是哪一年？1984年？博主们联合起来。只有在寒冷、空洞的网络世界中相互控诉，我们才能阻止警察的暴力执法。

english: Responding to bloggers who have demanded a timeline for withdrawal for the police occupation of our city bridges, Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins told PLO, "These terrorists want to take away our freedoms. And I do too. But look, we've done it first. We win. You lose. Eat my shit terrorists. Yeah, you like that? Do you? Daddy is in charge. That's the way a family works - a man and a woman and not two men," said Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins. Recycling has ceased in the city, causing angst and worry among many of the city's socially-conscious members, who know deep down in their righteous hearts that this is the apocalypse, the neocons have won, and we are fucked. Many officials are seriously worried that the stock market is set to crash.
zh: 作为对博主们要求的警方解除大桥管制日程的回应，副市长布莱斯･道金斯向本报表示「这些恐怖分子想要夺走我们的自由。我也夺走了。但是，我们先做到了。我们赢了，你输了。吔屎啦，恐怖分子。呵，你喜欢吗？中意吗？你爸爸我做主。家庭就是这样运作的：一个男人和一个女人，而不是两个男人。」城市里的垃圾回收已经停止，许多有社会意识的市民对此感到焦虑与担忧，内心正直的他们深知这是灾难。新保守主义者赢了，民意被强奸了。许多官员担心股市即将崩盘。

english: Great weed. Lumberjacks. A shitty military. Canada is beginning to look better every day for those of us who want to live a peaceful life composting our own shit, drinking fair trade coffee and preaching to everyone about the evils of plastic. With the passing of the US Jingoism Act, it is clear that many Americans are not welcome anymore. The founders of our country were noble men who, upon losing their teeth, did like George Washington and had new ones extracted from their slaves and implanted into their own. It's that kind of freedom that this country was founded on - freedom for some, tough luck for the rest. We're liberal, and it's our time to be on top next.
zh: 优质大麻、伐木工人、垃圾军队。对于我们中想要平静生活的人来说，加拿大的魅力与日俱增，你可以将自己的粪便用于施肥，喝公平贸易咖啡，向别人宣扬塑料的罪恶。在美国沙文主义法案通过后，显然会有许多人被「开除美籍」。我们国家的创立者都是贵族，在失去牙齿后，他们像乔治华盛顿一样从奴隶身上拔出新的牙齿，植入自己的口中。这就是作为本国根基的自由：少数人的自由，其他人的不幸。我们是自由主义者，该轮到我们做主了。

english: Racial profiling. Shootouts at southern border checkpoints. Skyrocketing tequila prices. The bloody side effects of the recent legislation pushed through by Border Agents Love Land Security are very clear. A group of wealthy civil liberties donors gathered recently in downtown Liberty City to discuss the problem. "People from other countries are simple, and as rich white liberals we must coddle them, treat them like babies, nurture them, patronize them. Not everyone is as sophisticated and well-educated as us, which really is a pity," said web 2.0 entrepreneur Clive Lettington.
zh: 看肤色断案、南部边检站发生的枪战、龙舌兰酒价格飞涨。近日由边境爱国警备队(BALLS)推动通过的法案带来的副作用已十分明显。一群富有的人权活动家最近在自由城的市中心对此问题进行了讨论。「来自其它国家的人很单纯。作为富裕的白人自由主义者，我们必须照顾他们，把他们当婴儿对待，扶持他们，资助他们。因为并不是每个人都像我们这样见多识广、受过良好教育。这真的很遗憾。」Web 2.0企业家克莱夫･莱廷顿说。

english: We appear to have elected a fascist into City Hall. Worse, we have elected an idiot. Even worse, they are the same man. Deputy Mayor, Bryce Dawkins, made comments that would make your average village idiot blush when he attempted to link gay rights to global terrorism, economic collapse and America's supposed imminent downfall. His subsequent attempts to deflect the criticism show what an awful and pathetic little toad he really is. So the question is; how did this man get into a position of power? And the answer, of course, is big business.
zh: 我们似乎把一个法西斯分子选进了市政厅。更糟的是，我们选出了一个白痴。还要糟的是，他们是同一个人。副市长布莱斯･道金斯试图将同性恋权利与全球恐怖主义、经济崩溃和可预期的美国衰落联系起来。乡下人听了他的话都会发笑。后来他试图转移批判的方向，可见他是一只多么糟糕可悲的小癞蛤蟆。那么问题来了：这个人是如何登上权力宝座的？至于答案，显而易见：钱权交易。

english: Dawkins used connections in the market to leverage his way onto Ochoa's ticket by providing financing through contacts in the hedge fund world. Contacts who now ensure the city is run to support the rich and keep money out of schools and into government-funded spying programs through a complicated conspiracy I don't quite have the space to explain here. As usual, it's just another example of the big attacking the small and the rich using power systems to destroy the aspirations of the poor.
zh: 道金斯利用市场上的人脉关系进行融资，借由他在对冲基金界的熟人为政府提供资金，从而进入奥乔亚市长的阵营。这些熟人确保本市为富人服务，他们缩减教育支出转而投入政府资助的监视项目。其过程之复杂，这里地方太小解释不清。一如既往，这只是大鱼吃小鱼与富人利用权力系统摧毁穷人理想的又一案例。

english: If a group of four blocks of the same color are arranged to form a square they will become a larger block of that color.
zh: 当一组同色方块形成正方形时，它们会变成一个同色的大方块。

english: Once removed from the grid any blocks above those removed will fall down to fill the empty spaces.
zh: 方块消除后，原先在其上方的方块就会下落填补空位。

english: Once the power bar has been filled once you can use a power up by pressing either ~PAD_X~, ~PAD_Y~, ~PAD_A~ or ~PAD_B~.
zh: 能量槽填满后，你可以按~PAD_X~~PAD_Y~~PAD_A~~PAD_B~中的一个发动能量特技。

english: A maximum of three power up uses can be stored for future use by repeatedly filling up the power bar.
zh: 能量槽可反复填充，但最多只能储存三个能量特技。

english: Once the power bar has been filled once you can use a power up by pressing either ~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_1~, ~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_2~, ~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_3~ or ~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_4~.
zh: 能量槽填满后，你可以按~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_1~~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_2~~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_3~~INPUT_FRONTEND_MINIGAME_4~中的一个发动能量特技。

english: ~z~Yeah big deal. Damn right! Until I discover, that same motherfucker?
zh: ~z~是没什么，太他妈对了！直到我发现，全是这狗逼在说？

english: ~z~... and that's why the Penetrators ain't doin' nothing this season. They got no one who can work the lanes, man.
zh: ~z~...所以透人队这赛季成不了事，他们队就没人能串联中场好吧。

english: ~z~Well, son ain't too diesel or nothing, he a regular lookin' dude, nahmean?
zh: ~z~是个没什么特点的小子，长得比较普通，明白吗？

english: ~z~For real... listen, G. Dwayne ain't the only thing I got on my mind...
zh: ~z~真的...听着，哥们，我烦的人不止德维恩一个...

english: ~z~My mind ain't trapped. I just like hearing cats spit rhymes and I know you like pushing rocks on the corner.
zh: ~z~我的思想可没有僵化。我就喜欢听人口吐芬芳，我也知道你喜欢在角落推石头。

english: ~z~I didn't even tell you what Marlon looked like. Get it together and come see me.
zh: ~z~我都没跟你说过马龙的长相。全部做掉再来见我。

english: ~z~but you can see it in his eye, that he a hustler.
zh: ~z~不过从他的眼睛里还是能看出来，他是个欺诈师。

english: ~z~Yeah. He hangs out with his team near the courts on Exeter between X and W.
zh: ~z~对。平常他都是和几个小弟一起，在埃克塞特大道X路和W路那边的篮球场转悠。

english: ~z~You the man, son. You money. You my ice-cold Slavic killer! See you soon.
zh: ~z~够本事，小子，好家伙。不愧是我的冷酷斯拉夫杀手！回头见。

english: ~z~Marlon's the one dressed like a damn canary. Wearing that yellow jacket and shit. Get rid of him.
zh: ~z~马龙就是那个穿的跟金丝雀似的那个。穿着件屎色黄夹克。除掉他。

english: ~z~Yeah, Dwayne's been getting on my nerves... pushing me, man.
zh: ~z~对，德维恩最近搞得我很烦...一直逼我，伙计。

english: ~z~Shit, Lieutenant, that's something I was forced into from the necessity of my financial situation.
zh: ~z~我靠，大哥，我也是迫于自己的经济状况才做这种事的。

english: ~z~I thought you was my boy, Niko? I thought you knew how to chase down them dollar bills?
zh: ~z~我还以为你是我的人，尼克？我还以为你知道怎么追人？

english: ~z~If I get rid of the guys on the site, then won't there be more?
zh: ~z~要是我除掉了工地上的人，不是会有更多人来吗？

english: ~z~There's also a radio headset in there, so me and you can keep in communication.
zh: ~z~里面还有套头戴式对讲机，这样我们就能保持联络了。

english: ~z~I think you might want to look at a map, Playboy. Dubai isn't in Africa.
zh: ~z~我觉得你该去看下地图，花花公子。迪拜不在非洲。

english: ~z~Shit, you a cold motherfucker. Next guy is south of your position, up a few stories in the next building.
zh: ~z~操，你这冷酷的混蛋。下一个人在你的南边，隔壁那栋楼再上去几层。

english: ~z~But in my work... people change. Money changes people.
zh: ~z~不过替我干活的...都变了个人。金钱会改变人。

english: ~z~See you soon, Playboy. I'll try to save a grenade so you can have fun with one, too.
zh: ~z~回头见，花花公子。我会尽量留一颗手雷给你玩玩的。

english: ~z~They all up in the place, strapped to their fronts with hardhats on and shit. Won't let nobody get near it.
zh: ~z~他们占领了工地，戴着安全帽拿武器守在那边。谁都不让靠近。

english: ~z~Later on. If you can't see anything else from up here, you'll see these grenades going off.
zh: ~z~等着吧，就算上面视野不好，手榴弹爆炸你总看得见。

english: ~z~This guy's a big developer? Are you and him having meetings about how to run the city?
zh: ~z~这人是个大开发商？你是不是要和他去开会讨论怎么管理城市？

english: ~z~That's if you're hoping to talk a bunch of Mafia owned union officials off of a building site they've shut down.
zh: ~z~不然你咋跟那个黑手党手下的工会谈判，让他们离开被迫停工的工地呢。

english: ~z~As you can see, this place is going to need a cleanup before any workers come in.
zh: ~z~如你所见，在有工人进来前，最好先把这地方清扫一下。

english: ~z~Yo, there's three lookout cats making sure no one makes move on the site.
zh: ~z~看，那边有三个放哨的伙计，负责保证没人靠近工地。

english: ~z~Alright, you heard a Yusuf Amir? Big real estate developer.
zh: ~z~好吧，你听说过尤瑟夫･阿米尔吗？房产大开发商。

english: ~z~I'm givin' you them dollar bills, and when Playboy pays, he pays big!
zh: ~z~我会给你一堆钞票，一旦花花公子付钱，那就是一大笔钱！

english: ~z~Make the Mafia cats go away so the workers can come in and everything will be cool.
zh: ~z~赶跑那群黑手党，工人就能进来了，然后什么都好说。

english: ~z~But when they hear about this shit they gonna start listening to Playboy.
zh: ~z~不过只要听说了这回事，他们就会听我花花公子说话了。

english: ~z~I don't know. I've heard a lot of names since I got here.
zh: ~z~没听说过，我到这儿以后已经听说了一大堆名字了。

english: ~z~The last guy is to your east. Shit, money. You best watch yourself. There be more of these Mafia cats turning up.
zh: ~z~最后一个在你的东边。操，老弟。自己当心点。那边的黑手党伙计更多。

english: ~z~This shit is Mafia run and they all over his construction site with guns and shit.
zh: ~z~说白了是黑手党干的，他们全副武装地守着工地。

english: ~z~You ain't bringing in no immigrant scabs. We're gonna fight to keep this place closed.
zh: ~z~别想让移民进来工作，我们要靠斗争让这里长期停工。

english: ~z~We going to Castle Gardens. There's an alley we want to hit up just off the South Parkway.
zh: ~z~我们去城堡花园。South Parkway那边有条小巷，我们就去那。

english: ~z~Amongst other things. I don't know how good your plan is though, Playboy.
zh: ~z~算最需要的吧。不过我不确定你这计划能否实现，花花公子。

english: ~z~I'll tell you where the cats are at and who you need to look out for. I'm your eyes in the sky, money.
zh: ~z~我会告诉你人都在哪儿，要找的是谁。我就是你的天眼，老弟。

english: ~z~These cats is looking to squeeze our boy Amir for dollars just because he ain't from here.
zh: ~z~这些伙计因为我们的阿米尔兄弟不是本地人就想敲诈他一笔。

english: ~z~I'll give you what you after. Cold hard cash. That what you chasing, right?
zh: ~z~你要什么我给什么。真金白银，这就是你要的吧？

english: ~z~When we fuck their people up they'll realize that he ain't a cat to be messed with and they'll back off.
zh: ~z~等我们把他们的手下干烂，他们就会知道阿米尔不是他们能惹的人，然后收手。

english: ~z~This is my ticket to the big time, baby. I'm about to make it, for real.
zh: ~z~这是我成为大人物的敲门砖。我就要成功了，真的。

english: ~z~I left some heat for you in that car, money. You going to be strapped - sniper rifles, grenades, all that shit.
zh: ~z~我在那辆车里给你准备了些家伙，老弟。会给你武装上的——狙击枪，手榴弹，各种各样。

english: ~z~Alright, you in, money? The first guy is on the scaffolding in the building to the east of the yard.
zh: ~z~好了，你进去了没，老弟？第一个人在工地东面的脚手架上。

english: ~z~You might be better seeing the lookouts from up here too, money.
zh: ~z~你最好也上来，上面可以看见那些放哨的，老弟。

english: ~z~It don't matter, we're brothers, spiritually I mean, and that's the important bit.
zh: ~z~无所谓，反正我们是兄弟，精神上的兄弟，这才是关键。

english: ~z~Looks like that's the last of them. Now you just need to get the hell out of there, money.
zh: ~z~看来那些就是最后一波了。现在你只要逃出来就行了，老弟。

english: ~z~I left some heat for you in that car, money. Pop the trunk and take what you need.
zh: ~z~我在那辆车里给你准备了些家伙，老弟。自己上车拿吧。

english: ~z~Don't worry, money. When I'm big time, I won't forget about cats like you.
zh: ~z~别担心，老弟。等我成了大人物，也不会忘记你这个小弟的。

english: ~z~When I get the money, man... I will build parks, I will sponsor kids, I will save lives...
zh: ~z~等我有钱了，兄弟...我就造公园，我就资助孩子，我就挽救生命...

english: ~z~You can't be fucking with Playboy X. This is my town, my town, motherfucker. Remember that?
zh: ~z~你丫惹不起花花公子X。这是我的城市，我的城市，狗逼玩意。记住了？

english: ~z~Dwayne, I dealt with Playboy. You should know that he asked me to end you first.
zh: ~z~德维恩，我干掉花花公子了。有件事得告诉你，是他先叫我杀你的。

english: ~z~You gone crazy just like Dwayne, son. You gotta be wrong in the head if you think you can step to this shit.
zh: ~z~你和德维恩一样，都疯了，小子。要是觉得这事你能办妥，一开始你就错了。

english: ~z~Nah, fuck that shit. I ain't ready to go out yet. I need you to get him for me.
zh: ~z~算了，门都没有。我还不打算死。我需要你帮我解决他。

english: ~z~Fuck you, man. We was tight. You fake like the rest of them.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，我们明明那么铁。你和他们一样虚伪。

english: ~z~I thought you was my homeboy. That you was gonna put Playboy down for me. What you doing here?
zh: ~z~我还以为你是我的同伴，会帮我解决花花公子。你来这干嘛？

english: ~z~You did what you had to do, Niko. You got yourself that money. Good for you.
zh: ~z~你做了你该做的事，尼克。那笔钱是你的了。真有你的。

english: ~z~Always hungry though, always wanted more. Maybe I shoulda seen it then. Kept a closer eye on him.
zh: ~z~一直很饥渴，永远不满足。早该想到的，当时就要盯紧他。

english: ~z~You took down Dwayne, Niko. I see your face, I see the cat that killed my mentor.
zh: ~z~你杀了德维恩，尼克。我看清你的嘴脸了，我知道你老弟杀了我的导师了。

english: ~z~I tried everything a man could reasonably try and still call his self a man.
zh: ~z~正常人会商量的我都跟他商量了，很给他面子了。

english: ~z~All this? It means nothing if you ain't got the heart, Niko
zh: ~z~还是这些？要是没这个良心，这些都是空的，尼克。

english: ~z~and I changed stuff, and you know me, I do this stuff so I got a chance to do some good in this town.
zh: ~z~于是我转行了，你也懂我，做这行还能给这个城市做点好事。

english: ~z~Well neither do I, man. But if he goes insane, we all dead anyway.
zh: ~z~我也不想啊，兄弟。但是一旦他疯起来，我们都得完蛋。

english: ~z~I know what loyalty means, unlike some people. You and me is tight now.
zh: ~z~我知道忠诚的意义，不像某些人。咱俩现在是铁哥们了。

english: ~z~Dwayne was like a father to me. I can't be round you no more. It's over between us.
zh: ~z~德维恩就像是我的父亲。我不会再找你了，我们结束了。

english: ~z~Now, I got into this dope game because it was the only thing that was open to me, man.
zh: ~z~我之所以做毒品生意，是因为它是我唯一的出路，兄弟。

english: ~z~Fuck you, man. We was tight. You fake like the rest of them.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，我们明明那么铁。你和他们一样虚伪。

english: ~z~Dwayne, I killed Playboy. You should know that he asked me to end you first.
zh: ~z~德维恩，花花公子我已经杀了。有件事得告诉你，是他先叫我杀你来的。

english: ~z~They made sense inside. Three meals a day, time in the yard, lockdown at eight.
zh: ~z~在里头的时候对头。一日三餐，院子放风，八点回房。

english: ~z~Nah, fuck that shit. I ain't ready to go out yet. I need you to get him for me.
zh: ~z~算了，门都没有。我还不打算死。我需要你帮我解决他。

english: ~z~Dwayne, it's Niko. You been trying to call me. Say what you gotta say.
zh: ~z~德维恩，我是尼克。你打了这么多个电话，有话直说吧。

english: ~z~Hey man, I seen where you're living, you should take it.
zh: ~z~嘿，老哥，我见识过你住的地方，房子你留着吧。

english: ~z~Man, you ain't cool. You try to find something to live for, man. Peace.
zh: ~z~兄弟你不行。你得想想自己为什么而活，兄弟。别了。

english: ~z~Always hungry though, always wanted more. Maybe I shoulda seen it then. Kept a closer eye on him.
zh: ~z~一直很饥渴，永远不满足。我早该发现的，盯得他紧一点。

english: ~z~I took shit to the next level, cats like you just can't accept that.
zh: ~z~我已经升到了新的境界，你这样的小鬼还无法接受而已。

english: ~z~Shit - you nothing but a cold hearted killer, man.
zh: ~z~操－你除了是个冷血杀手就什么都不是了，兄弟。

english: ~z~You right. I can't give you no money for helping me, dog. But I'll stick by your ass.
zh: ~z~确实，你帮我我也给不了你几个子儿，小子。不过我会始终站在你这边。

english: ~z~Playboy was your best friend, and he's always been straight with me, more or less.
zh: ~z~花花公子曾是你最好的朋友，基本上他对我也是坦诚相待。

english: ~z~He killed people. He killed that John the Baptist cat. He did what he had to.
zh: ~z~他也杀过人。他杀了那个施洗约翰。他只是做了该做的事。

english: ~z~Now I paid my dues. Now I learned in a hard school, man...
zh: ~z~现在我得到回报了。现在我在社会上学到了，兄弟...

english: ~z~Because see me, now I ain't scared of no one, but a motherfuckers says he's gonna kill me?
zh: ~z~因为你看我，我谁都不怕，结果有个狗逼说要杀我？

english: ~z~Playboy was your best friend, and he's always been straight with me, more or less.
zh: ~z~花花公子曾是你最好的朋友，基本上他对我也是坦诚相待。

english: ~z~But I got the deed to Playboy's fancy silk sheet loft. You can have it.
zh: ~z~不过花花公子锦衣玉食的顶楼公寓的房产证还在我手里，房子就归你了。

english: ~z~I thought you was my homeboy. That you was gonna put Playboy down for me. What you doing here?
zh: ~z~我还以为你是我的同伴，会帮我解决花花公子。你来这干嘛？

english: ~z~he's gone crazy. I mean he's gone. Prison does that.
zh: ~z~他已经疯了。我是说他回不来了。监狱让他成了这样。

english: ~z~You cold, man, you cold. Taking a cat down in his prime. I was an innovator.
zh: ~z~冷酷的男人，冷酷。正当年的时候把人给杀了。我是革新者。

english: ~z~Now Dwayne after both our asses now, for sure. Come back to the penthouse.
zh: ~z~现在我俩都得被德维恩追杀了，真的。回我公寓来。

english: ~z~Argh. I was someone, you know. I made it. I changed the game.
zh: ~z~啊，怎么说我也是个人物。我做到了，我改变了游戏。

english: ~z~No, I tried talking. I... I... I tried giving him half of the business.
zh: ~z~早沟通过了。我...我...我跟他说分一半产业给他。

english: ~z~Do you think that I do? But it's kill or be killed out there. And you got a lunatic after you?
zh: ~z~你当我喜欢？现在不是干他就是被干。还是说你想被个疯子追杀？

english: ~z~I don't know that that is true, Playboy. This town don't belong to nobody.
zh: ~z~我还真不知道这是实话，花花公子。这座城市不属于任何人。

english: ~z~Man, Dwayne... it's like he thinks it's 1992 and the best you can hope for is a gold chain and a pager.
zh: ~z~兄弟，德维恩...他还活在1992年，最大的梦想就是根大金链子和BP机。

english: ~z~They made sense inside. Three meals a day, time in the yard, lockdown at eight.
zh: ~z~在里头的时候对头。一日三餐，院子放风，八点回房。

english: ~z~Do diamonds burn, cousin? How about gold, will that melt in a fire?
zh: ~z~钻石会烧着吗，堂弟？黄金呢，会不会在火里熔了？

english: ~z~I've got nothing left. Not my home, not my business, nothing.
zh: ~z~我什么都没剩下了。要家没家，要事业没事业，屁都不剩。

english: ~z~No, we are not. I was going to propose to her but it is no longer possible.
zh: ~z~不是，还没呢。我本来是要跟她求婚了，但现在不可能了。

english: ~z~Now, I have nothing to spend... nothing. Oh yeah, I have you. Great.
zh: ~z~现在我都没东西可以挥霍了...没了。噢，对，我还有你。真好。

english: ~z~I do not have a ring. It burnt in my apartment along with everything else.
zh: ~z~我没了戒指。在我的公寓里跟其他东西一起烧掉了。

english: ~z~I am sorry that your worldly possessions have been destroyed, but you were not that rich a man.
zh: ~z~很抱歉你那些世俗财产都被毁了，但是你又没那么富。

english: ~z~Listen, me and Niko are in a bit of trouble - need to get out of Broker a few days.
zh: ~z~听我说，我和尼克遇上了点小麻烦，要离开布洛克避几天风头。

english: ~z~We will, but I have left something important at the apartment. Something I must show you, cousin.
zh: ~z~肯定会，不过我在公寓里落了样重要的东西。你一定要看看那个，堂弟。

english: ~z~I've been beaten up, I was kidnapped and then shot in the stomach,
zh: ~z~自己给人打了，还给人绑走了，往肚子上来了一枪，

english: ~z~I'll call Mallorie, she might have somewhere we can hide out.
zh: ~z~我给玛洛丽打个电话，她可能有地方能让我们躲。

english: ~z~All I know is we have to get as far from Dimitri and Bulgarin as we can.
zh: ~z~我只知道，我们离迪米特里和布尔加林越远越好。

english: ~z~You remember that time we went to the bar back home and found it razed to the ground?
zh: ~z~你还记得当年我们去老家的酒吧，结果发现店被夷为平地吗？

english: ~z~Holy fuck, it's fucking burning. The whole place... I've got to go in, I've got to get something.
zh: ~z~操他妈的，他妈着火了。整栋楼...我要进去，我要进去拿东西。

english: ~z~Now, you know everything is shit and we are going to be killed, and you're all cheerful.
zh: ~z~现在你知道什么都完了，我们要死了，反而还很开心。

english: ~z~I'm glad you turned up and made some Russian killers burn down my home and business!
zh: ~z~你来了搞的一群俄国杀手烧了我的家和车行我可真高兴。

english: ~z~You have your life, Roman. You have a life which is worth a lot more than mine at the moment.
zh: ~z~你有你的生活，罗曼。现在你的生活比我的更有价值。

english: ~z~I was thinking about getting out of the cab business. Last night I had a dream...
zh: ~z~我刚好有想过不做的士生意。昨晚我做了个梦...

english: ~z~I always put a saddle on a horse before I ride her, Roman. I won't catch nothing.
zh: ~z~我上马之前总会先套个鞍的，罗曼。不会得脏病的。

english: ~z~You're an angel - beautiful and kind. I love you. We'll see you there.
zh: ~z~你真是天使，美丽而善良。我爱你。我们那边见。

english: ~z~I mean, I don't think we'll be impressing women with our wonderful hot tub, but, err, this looks okay...
zh: ~z~我是说，虽然我不觉得这个豪华开放浴缸会给女士们留下好印象，不过...看起来还挺好。

english: ~z~You are a sick fuck, cousin. No wonder half of Broker wants you dead.
zh: ~z~你这人哪，堂弟。难怪半个布洛克的人都想要你的命。

english: ~z~You know what? I think maybe they might get me when going after you.
zh: ~z~你知道吗？我觉得他们追杀你的时候可能会来抓我。

english: ~z~A classy place. None of this fast-food, diner bullshit. We own a real restaurant, a tavern.
zh: ~z~精致的地儿，不是什么垃圾快餐小饭店。我们开的是真正的餐厅，一家酒馆。

english: ~z~Must think about the future. A new apartment in South Bohan, another business,
zh: ~z~该好好想想未来了。在南波汉的新公寓，新的事业。

english: ~z~Pure like my Mallorie. In the dream Mallorie and me are married.
zh: ~z~和我的玛洛丽一样纯洁。在梦里我和玛洛丽结婚了。

english: ~z~Yes, you and I had a place of our own. A place where people come to eat and relax.
zh: ~z~对，你和我有了自己的一亩三分地。别人来这儿吃饭休闲。

english: ~z~I do not speak of diamonds, but of one diamond and a band of gold.
zh: ~z~我说的不是很多钻石，只有一颗钻石和一个金环。

english: ~z~We're here in America now and I should be thinking about my life here, my life which is ruined.
zh: ~z~我们现在在美国，我想的应该是这里的生活，已经被毁掉的生活。

english: ~z~Where should I start? Alright, I'll start with you - what's wrong with you?
zh: ~z~你让我从哪开始说？算了，从你说起吧。你有毛病吗？

english: ~z~I risk my bets to win more so I can spend on the hot
zh: ~z~压上我的筹码，赢走更多筹码，这样我就可以把钱花在

english: ~z~Fifteen minutes ago you were cowering in fear because you didn't know what was going to happen.
zh: ~z~一刻钟之前，你还因为不知道会发生什么吓得瑟瑟发抖。

english: ~z~America is about showing what you have, you express yourself with money you spend.
zh: ~z~在美国就是要展现财富，要靠挥霍金钱来表现自己。

english: ~z~Not now, but in the dream you've met the right woman. She is beautiful.
zh: ~z~现在是不能，但是在梦里你遇到了那个她。她很美。

english: ~z~You do not need a ring to propose. Mallorie loves you for who you are, not for some ring.
zh: ~z~求婚不需要戒指。玛洛丽爱的不是什么戒指，是你。

english: ~z~I got your message Dimitri, you piece of shit. You're a dead man. A dead man.
zh: ~z~短信我收到了，迪米特里，你这人渣。你死定了，死路一条。

english: ~z~You think we care about stupid gambling debt? We care about killing you.
zh: ~z~你以为我们要的是什么傻逼赌债吗？我们要的是你的命。

english: ~z~Niko, I think Roman has been kidnapped. I heard he owes some Russians money.
zh: ~z~尼克，罗曼可能被绑架了。我听说他欠几个俄国人钱。

english: ~z~I thought he would be wining and dining the woman he loves?
zh: ~z~我以为他是赢了钱，然后在和他的爱人吃饭来的。

english: ~z~You are Niko Bellic. Turn around and walk away or your cousin is dead.
zh: ~z~你就是尼克･贝利克吧。转身走人，不然我就杀了你堂兄。

english: ~z~Then I'm going to hang it on my wall to remind me what a lying, cheating, treacherous scumbag looks like.
zh: ~z~然后挂在我家墙上，警示我一个撒谎、欺骗、背叛的卑鄙小人是怎么样的。

english: ~z~Mallorie, they had Roman in the warehouse. I came too late.
zh: ~z~玛洛丽，罗曼确实被他们关在仓库里。我来晚了。

english: ~z~He never tells me anything. I heard they took him to a warehouse off Lompoc in Bohan Industrial.
zh: ~z~他都没跟我说过。听说他被带到波汉工业区的一个仓库去了，在隆波克大道上。

english: ~z~If he calls you, tell him the woman he loves wants to see his ass at home.
zh: ~z~要是他打给你，告诉他他的爱人想在家里看见这个混球。

english: ~z~He likes to party. He stays out late the whole time. You know what he's like.
zh: ~z~他就喜欢在外面浪，每次都很晚回来。他这德性你也知道。

english: ~z~You're right, at first it was just the debt then they found out my name.
zh: ~z~对的，一开始就是普通的欠债，后来他们知道了我的名字。

english: ~z~Mr. Rascalov will be so happy when he sees your dead body, Bellic.
zh: ~z~看见你的尸体拉斯卡洛夫先生会很高兴的，贝利克。

english: ~z~He wants you dead. Bohan is not safe. I'm going to get us a place in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~他想要你死。波汉也不安全了，我去阿尔冈琴找个地方。

english: ~z~We were hoping you would come, Bellic. This party is for you.
zh: ~z~我们就等着你来呢，贝利克。这是为你准备的派对。

english: ~z~Okay, I messed up... I know I did. I thought things would be different.
zh: ~z~行，是我的错...我知道怪我，我还以为这里会不一样。

english: ~z~He never tells me anything. I heard they took him to a warehouse off Lompoc in Bohan Industrial.
zh: ~z~他都没跟我说过。听说他被带到波汉工业区的一个仓库去了，在隆波克大道上。

english: ~z~That man knew Dimitri. He was trying to make me give you up to him. I would never...
zh: ~z~那人认识迪米特里。他想让我出卖你。我绝对不会...

english: ~z~Niko, I think Roman has been kidnapped. I heard he owes some Russians money.
zh: ~z~尼克，罗曼可能被绑架了。我听说他欠几个俄国人钱。

english: ~z~I'd go for anything as long as I could be guaranteed safety, that's all I want. Shit.
zh: ~z~只要能确保安全，选哪个我都无所谓。就这么个要求。操。

english: ~z~Dimitri Rascalov was on his way to that warehouse, they wanted me to give you up. I would never...
zh: ~z~迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫正在来仓库的路上，他们想让我出卖你。我绝对不会...

english: ~z~Dimitri was right. You come to collect your fat cousin right away.
zh: ~z~迪米特里说的没错，你果然马上就来找你的胖子堂兄了。

english: ~z~I get to sit in front of a computer and play Mr. Rich Man and get into debt with crooks.
zh: ~z~我可以坐在电脑前面，装作阔佬先生，还欠着一屁股债。

english: ~z~A friend of mine, Dimitri Rascalov, he would pay a lot of money for your cousin.
zh: ~z~我的一个朋友，迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫，肯出高价买你堂弟的人头。

english: ~z~I don't fucking know! I'm scared you cold bastard. What are we going to do?
zh: ~z~我他妈不知道！我很害怕，你个冷酷混蛋。我们该咋办？

english: ~z~If he calls you, tell him the woman he loves wants to see his ass at home.
zh: ~z~要是他打给你，告诉他他的爱人想在家里看见这个混球。

english: ~z~We have to get out of Bohan, maybe it is time to go to Algonquin. We can disappear in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~我们得离开波汉了，大概也是时候去阿尔冈琴了。我们可以在阿尔冈琴玩消失。

english: ~z~I know you wouldn't, Roman. I thought we were done with Dimitri when we got out of Hove Beach.
zh: ~z~我知道你不会，罗曼。我以为离开霍夫海滩就能和迪米特里了结了。

english: ~z~I thought he would be wining and dining the woman he loves?
zh: ~z~我以为他是赢了钱，然后在和他的爱人吃饭来的。

english: ~z~Okay, okay. But I want Florian and Darko. I need to know what happened. Give me that.
zh: ~z~行，行。但我要的还是弗洛里安和达尔科。我要知道是怎么回事。得让我找着。

english: ~z~If you want to walk out of here, Slav, you are going to have to think about how you will pay your debt.
zh: ~z~你要是想离开这里，斯拉夫人，就该考虑下该怎么还债了。

english: ~z~Only for so long. We will be found eventually no matter where we go.
zh: ~z~也只是暂时的。不管走到哪，被找到都是迟早的事。

english: ~z~Hey, I hear you know Florian Cravic. Where is he?
zh: ~z~喂，听说你认识弗洛里安･克拉维克。他在哪儿？

english: ~z~It's Bernie now. After I came here, I wanted a complete change. So I became Bernie Crane.
zh: ~z~现在是伯尼了。来这儿以后咱就想告别过去，所以咱成了伯尼･克兰。

english: ~z~Last thing I heard, you was itching to whack this guy? Must be some heavy shit.
zh: ~z~之前你不是还说很想干死这个人吗？那估计是个大岔子了。

english: ~z~Ummm. I really don't recognize this. I can't help you from here I'm afraid.
zh: ~z~呃，这里我真不认识。在这儿我恐怕帮不了你了。

english: ~z~Anything for you, cousin. Just name it. You want some women? I met this...
zh: ~z~赴汤蹈火在所不辞，堂弟。开口吧。你想找女人吗？我这儿有个...

english: ~z~Well, I'm a lifestyle coach, and I teach an aerobics class...
zh: ~z~咱现在是个养生教练，上课教有氧运动的内容...

english: ~z~Florian has moved on from what happened to you, you should move on too.
zh: ~z~弗洛里安已经从你的遭遇里走出来了，你也该走出来。

english: ~z~Cousin, Talbot is dead. We needed him to take us to Florian.
zh: ~z~老兄，塔尔博特死了。我们还得靠他带路找弗洛里安呢。

english: ~z~Oh, I started working out... you know, toned up the, er...
zh: ~z~噢，咱开始健身了...你也知道，壮实了一下，呃...

english: ~z~I will find out where he is, and I will make him answer for his actions.
zh: ~z~我会查到他在哪儿，我会让他为自己的所作所为付出代价。

english: ~z~I... I... I heard he was still in Europe, or Switzerland, or somewhere...
zh: ~z~咱...咱...咱听说他还在欧洲，瑞士，或者哪里...

english: ~z~We know now that it was him. I need to be alone now, Roman.
zh: ~z~现在我们知道是他干的了。我要一个人静静，罗曼。

english: ~z~I worry for you, NB. Sometimes you just got to let the hate go.
zh: ~z~我很替你担心，NB。有时候还是得放下往日仇恨。

english: ~z~Oh yeah, I should probably say, you ain't gonna get those ten Gs from Talbot.
zh: ~z~哦对了，有件事我得说，那一万你没法从塔尔博特手里拿回来了。

english: ~z~Talbot, I know him. I came up against him in a few tournaments. Small world.
zh: ~z~塔尔博特，我认识。打牌的时候对上过几次。世界真小。

english: ~z~Niko, that was unfortunate. There will be some other way to find Florian.
zh: ~z~尼克，太不幸了。总会有其它能找弗洛里安的法子的。

english: ~z~This is too bad, cousin. Maybe we find Florian another day.
zh: ~z~这太糟了，堂弟。也许我们还是改天再找弗洛里安吧。

english: ~z~So, it was Darko Brevic who betrayed you. Now you know. You should relax.
zh: ~z~这么说，背叛你的是达尔科･布雷维奇。现在你知道了。你该放下了。

english: ~z~Alright already. There's a guy I know, likes to be called Florian Cravic at... um... certain moments.
zh: ~z~够了够了。我是认识个人，好像是叫弗洛里安･克拉维克...呃...偶尔会这么叫他。

english: ~z~We're looking for a guy named Talbot Daniels. Hangs out in the Triangle.
zh: ~z~我们要找的是一个叫塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯的人。经常在三角区出没。

english: ~z~Ummm, I might be lost but keep going and I'll see if I can get there.
zh: ~z~呃，我可能迷路了，但你继续开，我看看还能不能认出来。

english: ~z~but then I heard that you had joined the circus so information can be unreliable.
zh: ~z~不过咱也听说过你加入了马戏团，所以消息不一定靠谱。

english: ~z~Stay right there, Talbot. Don't think you can push me around.
zh: ~z~乖乖站好，塔尔博特。别想着你能从我这儿逃了。

english: ~z~He's into me for about ten Gs, he says he might know something about Florian Cravic.
zh: ~z~他找到我开口就要了一万，他说他可能知道弗洛里安･克拉维克的下落。

english: ~z~You kill the wrong guy and his friends will fuck with me to get to you.
zh: ~z~你一杀错人，他的朋友就会来找我麻烦，好找到你。

english: ~z~Don't think you're going anywhere, Talbot. I'm going to go easy on you for now. But if you push me, you're in big trouble.
zh: ~z~你哪儿都别想去，塔尔博特。我现在先对你客气点，不过你要是逼我，那你麻烦就大了。

english: ~z~Ray Boccino, the cockroach mobster, he knows a man who might know Florian Cravic.
zh: ~z~雷･博奇诺，那个狡诈的黑社会，他知道一个可能认识弗洛里安･克拉维克的人。

english: ~z~He's moved on from what happened to you, you should've moved on too. What are you going to do?
zh: ~z~他已经走出那件事了，你也该往前走。现在你什么打算？

english: ~z~Your days of searching are over, my friend. This guy should point you in the right direction.
zh: ~z~你找人的日子结束了，我的朋友。这个人应该能给你带路。

english: ~z~Of course they would have. Look at your gambling career. What was I thinking?
zh: ~z~当然是早晚会了。看看你的赌博事业吧，我在想什么呢？

english: ~z~Come on, NB. You think I keep this figure by walking? Go get us a car.
zh: ~z~拜托，NB。我要是肯走路还会是这副样子吗？去弄辆车来。

english: ~z~Come on, NB. We won't ever find Florian unless you follow these directions.
zh: ~z~来吧，NB。你不按这些提示走，我们永远找不着弗洛里安。

english: ~z~There he is. Let's go talk to him. He's always at the games being held around Algonquin.
zh: ~z~那个就是。我们去跟他谈谈。他经常来阿尔冈琴的赌局。

english: ~z~I think he's a bit freaked out. I guess he thought seeing you would answer some questions.
zh: ~z~我觉得他有点过于激动了，可能本来他觉得能从你这里问出更多的。

english: ~z~I'd be rich even if you weren't here. I'm an entrepreneur. Things would have taken off for me.
zh: ~z~就算你不来我也会很富。我是个企业家，早晚都会腾飞的。

english: ~z~Hey Nicky. You've been a decent earner for me and I appreciate that. I'm throwing you a bone.
zh: ~z~喂尼克。之前的活你都做得很棒，我很感谢。赏你一根骨头。

english: ~z~I will find out where Darko Brevic is, and I will make him answer for his actions.
zh: ~z~我会找出达尔科･布雷维奇的所在，让他为自己的行为付出代价。

english: ~z~Who set us up. It was you or Darko. I thought it must be him.
zh: ~z~背叛我们的人，不是你就是达尔科了。我想一定是他。

english: ~z~There is no starting again. Darko Brevic may not be here in Liberty City, but he's still out there.
zh: ~z~没有重新开始这回事。达尔科･布雷维奇也许不在自由城，但他还在外面活着。

english: ~z~Slowly, slowly, catchy monkey, NB. We won't find him if you are racing.
zh: ~z~心急吃不了热豆腐，NB。你开这么快咱们找不着他。

english: ~z~So I see... well it's great to see you guys... we must do brunch.
zh: ~z~咱懂了...见到你们还是很高兴的...有空吃顿饭。

english: ~z~There's some fanook called Talbot, Talbot Daniels, over in the Triangle.
zh: ~z~有一个叫塔尔博特的基佬，塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯，人在三角区。

english: ~z~Cousin, I know you want to find him soon, but you must go slowly to do it.
zh: ~z~老兄，我知道你想快点找到他，但那样就必须慢慢开。

english: ~z~Shit NB, are you cranked on speed? We have to go slow to find the address.
zh: ~z~妈的 NB，你嗑了安非他明吗？得慢慢开才找得到地址。

english: ~z~I been head to head with this guy a few times, NB. I know his tells. He's lying.
zh: ~z~我和这人交手过几次，NB。我知道他的心思。他在说谎。

english: ~z~I have found Florian Cravic. There's a man called Talbot Daniels who will lead us to him.
zh: ~z~我找到弗洛里安･克拉维克了。有个叫塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯的人会带我们去找他。

english: ~z~You think it was me... that's why you're here. You've come to kill me!
zh: ~z~你以为是咱...所以你才会来这儿。你是来杀咱的！

english: ~z~All that has changed is that I am hunting one man instead of two...
zh: ~z~唯一的区别是，我要追的人从两个变成了一个...

english: ~z~I couldn't find Florian. Your man, Talbot, he was annoying the shit out of me.
zh: ~z~我找不到弗洛里安。你的人塔尔博特他搞得我暴跳如雷。

english: ~z~This is it. This is Bernie's place. Are you going to kill him?
zh: ~z~就是这里。这就是伯尼的住处。你是要去杀他吗？

english: ~z~That is the most your friend can look forward to. Get out of here now. You've done your job.
zh: ~z~这是你朋友最好的下场。你快滚吧，你的任务完成了。

english: ~z~~c~We were friends. We were all friends. We all grew up together...~s~
zh: ~z~~c~我们是朋友啊，我们都是朋友。我们都是一起长大的...~s~

english: ~z~I'm not saying that Darko should be forgiven - it is not our place to do that.
zh: ~z~我不是说要原谅达尔科，那不是在我们的立场上该做的。

english: ~z~But the Darko you are going to meet might be very different from the one who led our friends to their death.
zh: ~z~但是待会儿你见到的达尔科，可能和将你的朋友带向死亡的达尔科大不一样。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. It's over. It's all over now. Leave him there. We should go before anyone turns up.
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。结束了，现在都结束了。把他扔这儿吧，我们得在有人发现前离开。

english: ~z~Darko Brevic, here in Liberty City. You have worked hard to make this happen.
zh: ~z~达尔科･布雷维奇，来到了自由城。为了实现这个你真是费了很多工夫。

english: ~z~You piece of shit. That was for everyone. That was for me.
zh: ~z~你这个人渣。刚才是替所有人打的，是替我打的。

english: ~z~This is the moment you've been waiting for for so long, Niko. What do you mean you don't know how you feel?
zh: ~z~这一刻你等了那么久，尼克。「不知道」是什么意思？

english: ~z~~c~Dmitar, Dragan, Goran, Mijo... should I go on and name them all?~s~
zh: ~z~~c~德米塔尔，德拉甘，戈兰，米约...要不要我把名字都报一遍？~s~

english: ~z~It is not often that a man can be sure of that but you definitely did the right thing. Be proud of yourself.
zh: ~z~虽然别的事不能断言，但这次你绝对是做对了。为你自己骄傲吧。

english: ~z~Maybe now that you know that revenge is not what you are after you can look for
zh: ~z~现在你可能就知道了，需要的不是复仇，你可以用别的方式

english: ~z~This is all that is left of me. What am I good at, Roman? What is my trade?
zh: ~z~这就是那次遭遇后的我。我有什么长处，罗曼？我的职业是什么？
