english: ~z~It was weeks after the massacre that I realized that we must have been given up by someone in our group...
zh: ~z~在那场屠杀的几周后，我意识到我们一定是被小队里的某个人出卖了...

english: ~z~They are bringing him to the cargo bay at Francis International. I do not want to be late after I have waited so long.
zh: ~z~他会被送到弗朗西斯国际机场的货运区。等了那么多年了，我可不想迟到。

english: ~z~Niko, you can't do this alone. I'm coming with you. Come collect me from Firefly Island.
zh: ~z~尼克，这你不能一个人去，我和你一起。到萤火虫岛来接我。

english: ~z~I'm turning this shit off, I can't take listening to those annoying ads and DJs right now.
zh: ~z~垃圾广播我关了，现在没心情听这些烦人的广告和DJ。

english: ~z~This killing must stop sometime, Niko. Once this is done, then you must begin to forgive.
zh: ~z~这种杀戮之后必须要停下来了，尼克。这次解决以后，你一定要学会宽恕。

english: ~z~So, you keep living and you try to have a happy life. You try to move on.
zh: ~z~所以，你会继续活着，尽力过上幸福生活，尽力向前进。

english: ~z~And when I knew, everything I've done has been to find that person.
zh: ~z~当我知道后，我所做的一切都是为了找到那个人。

english: ~z~I will tell you what you are good at, Niko. You are a good cousin and a good friend. You still have integrity.
zh: ~z~我会告诉你你的长处的，尼克。你是个好堂弟，也是个好朋友。你仍然是个正直者。

english: ~z~I have not been the same man since the day that Darko betrayed us.
zh: ~z~从达尔科背叛我们的那天起，我就不再是那个我了。

english: ~z~I let a diseased, traitorous junkie live after hunting him for over a decade.
zh: ~z~我放过了一个有病的、背叛了的人渣，在寻找了他十多年以后。

english: ~z~You still have the power to be good. It's important that you believe that.
zh: ~z~你还是有能力做好人的。最重要的是对自己的信心。

english: ~z~but then, when I looked at him, I realized that nothing would change if I killed him,
zh: ~z~可是然后，当我看着他的时候，我意识到就算杀了他也无济于事，

english: ~z~I thought that revenge, that killing Darko, might fill me up a bit.
zh: ~z~我本以为复仇、杀了达尔科，可能能让我充实一点。

english: ~z~Well, this is the big moment - what you have been waiting for for so long. I hope you will not be disappointed.
zh: ~z~终于来临了，你苦等多年的一刻。希望你不会失望。

english: ~z~Roman, they've brought Darko Brevic into the country for me.
zh: ~z~罗曼，他们已经帮我把达尔科･布雷维奇送到美国了。

english: ~z~Ah ignore him. Come on we got to get this thing ready before we dock. Let's go.
zh: ~z~别管他了。赶紧的，我们得在靠岸前把东西准备好。走了。

english: ~z~We are passing the cab office, Niko. This is the business that will take us to the top of the pile.
zh: ~z~我们刚开过出租车行，尼克。这就是能让我们跻身上流的事业。

english: ~z~I always wanted to make it big... own a nice place, get a dog, a house...
zh: ~z~我一直想有所成就...有个好去处，养条狗，买栋房...

english: ~z~War is where the young and stupid are tricked by the old and bitter into killing each other.
zh: ~z~战争就是年轻无知者被一群老狐狸骗到一起自相残杀。

english: ~z~all I hear about is Mr. Big, Mr. Roman, living the American dream.
zh: ~z~我读到的都是大腕先生，罗曼先生，活在美国梦里。

english: ~z~The city is like a big Uder Milken Ice Cream shop: thirty-six flavors of titty.
zh: ~z~这座城市就像一家大Uder Milken冰淇淋店：36种奶昔俱全。

english: ~z~Niko. Give me a hug. Good to have you here cousin... I've got something for you.
zh: ~z~尼克，抱一个。堂弟你来了真好...我给你准备了点东西。

english: ~z~Maybe a little. I've been here 10 years! You can speak English.
zh: ~z~是有点忘了。我都来这十年了！你倒会讲英语啊。

english: ~z~Terrorists. There's been a big scare and you can't go across the bridges so good.
zh: ~z~恐怖分子。他们引起了很大的恐慌，搞得现在不能过桥。

english: ~z~Got him! Little bastard. If he paid some rent I wouldn't care...
zh: ~z~踩着了！小混蛋。他要是付了房租我也不会去管...

english: ~z~Yes, Vlad, sorry, forgive me, okay, no... no.
zh: ~z~好的，弗拉德，抱歉，对不起，好的，不...别。

english: ~z~Drive us to our place on Mohawk, it's just up the road. I'll let you know when we're there.
zh: ~z~去我在莫霍克的住处，顺着路开就是。到了我会跟你说的。

english: ~z~The city is like a big Uder Milken Ice Cream shop: thirty-six flavors of titty.
zh: ~z~这座城市就像一家大Uder Milken冰淇淋店：36种奶昔俱全。

english: ~z~Where's Barbara with big titties and Stephanie who sucks like a vacuum?
zh: ~z~奶子巨大的芭芭拉和口力十足的斯蒂芬妮哪去了？

english: ~z~people leave home to hang around the people they ran away from,~c~ very odd.
zh: ~z~人们背井离乡，和他们先前逃避的人处在一块，~c~很奇怪。

english: ~z~Here we have white, black, the Puerto Ricans and the Asians, Europeans on vacation...
zh: ~z~我们这有白的，黑的，波多黎各的，亚洲的，从欧洲来度假的...

english: ~z~No, everyone seems happy where they are. It reminds them of the Black Sea or something -
zh: ~z~不，所有人都对自己的境地心满意足。让他们想起了黑海之类的——

english: ~z~Terrorists. There's been a big scare and you can't go across the bridges so good.
zh: ~z~恐怖分子。他们引起了很大的恐慌，搞得现在不能过桥。

english: ~z~Scared Canadians, bored housewives from the Midwest - every possible choice!
zh: ~z~吓坏了的加拿大的，中西部来的寂寞人妻——应有尽有！

english: ~z~Oh, you're back. Can we go home now? ~c~ Please, important sir.
zh: ~z~噢，你回来了。现在我们能回家了吧？~c~求你了，大人物。

english: ~z~people leave home to hang around the people they ran away from,~c~ very odd.
zh: ~z~人们背井离乡，和他们先前逃避的人处在一块，~c~很奇怪。

english: ~z~That's right. I got the best cockroaches, I got the best dirt!
zh: ~z~这话没错。我这有最大的蟑螂，我这有最多的尘土！

english: ~z~Good to see you, man - what, you forget our language?
zh: ~z~很高兴见到你，老哥。咋了，你忘记我们的家乡话了？

english: ~z~Remember, we learned off the English girls with the big...
zh: ~z~记得不，我们还是跟那讲英语的妹子学的，她那大...

english: ~z~Okay, I'm an idiot, but you must admit I have the best line in bullshit you ever heard.
zh: ~z~行，我是蠢货。但你也得承认，我编的那些胡话是你听过的里面最好的。

english: ~z~I'm drunk and tired Niko, please drive me home, ~c~ be a good guy.
zh: ~z~我醉了也累了，尼克。把我送回去吧，~c~行行好吧。

english: ~z~How you going to find your way round the city without me? Come back Niko.~c~ Don't be a child.
zh: ~z~没我你不得马上在城里迷路？快回来，尼克。~c~别孩子气了。

english: ~z~You, without a visa. I would stay in Broker. Fuck it, stay in Hove Beach. Everyone like us does.
zh: ~z~你没有签证。换我就呆在布洛克。操，呆在霍夫海滩。屁民都这样。

english: ~z~I can't say that I have. ~c~ But I know what it's like to hang out with a tit.
zh: ~z~我不能说我有。~c~但是我知道和巨乳一起溜达是什么感觉。

english: ~z~a model on each arm - me and my cousin Niko, rulers of the world!
zh: ~z~美女左拥右抱——我和我的尼克堂弟，世界的统治者！

english: ~z~That is my cab depot, cousin. It is where I make all the money.
zh: ~z~那边的就是我的出租车行，堂弟。我的钱都是在那挣的。

english: ~z~he writes me in these wild emails, and after I got into trouble, I thought maybe uh...
zh: ~z~他给我发的那些疯狂的邮件里是这样的。在我陷入困难后，我想也许呃...

english: ~z~-It's easy. Out the door, turn left, then the first left at the diner,~n~-What are you talking about? I don't...
zh: ~z~－很好找。出了门，左拐，看见餐馆后的下个路口左拐，~n~－你在说些什么？我不太...

english: ~z~and then I got this gig, and I spend the next seven months with you fine people and I forget...
zh: ~z~然后我就有了这份工作，和你们这些好人一起过了七个月，我都快忘了...

english: ~z~It's really flash. We got lots of titties and some incredible motors...
zh: ~z~真的很炫。我们那儿有很多巨乳，还有一些豪车...

english: ~z~That is why the ladies love me. Fuck those shylocks, they'll get their money.
zh: ~z~所以女人们才爱我。操他妈的讨债鬼，他们会拿到钱的。

english: ~z~Lose these cops, Niko. I don't want to lead them right to an illegal game.
zh: ~z~把条子甩了，尼克。我可不想把他们引进非法赌局。

english: ~z~You spoke then you say your phone out of batteries. You treat me like a bitch.
zh: ~z~你一开口就是你手机没电了。你这是把我当婊子哪。

english: ~z~Maybe one day you get a premium quality one, like mine. Then you will have really made it.
zh: ~z~说不定哪天你也能用上高端手机，跟我这个一样。到时候你就是成功人士了。

english: ~z~Never! I'd treat you like an idiot, not a bitch, eh?
zh: ~z~没这回事！我把你当傻子，没把你当婊子，啊哈？

english: ~z~Niko, you have to lose these cops, we cannot lead them to my place of business.
zh: ~z~尼克，你得把条子甩了，别把他们引到我的车行去。

english: ~z~~c~The Janitor. Sure.~s~ I seriously hope your cards are better than your nicknames.
zh: ~z~~c~清洁工。确实。~s~希望你的牌能比你的外号要好点。

english: ~z~Jesus, Roman, you fuckin' idiota. How can I take you seriously?
zh: ~z~天哪，罗曼，你丫是白痴吧。这我怎么可能认真对你？

english: ~z~Do not hurt them, I know what you're like Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~别伤着他们，我知道你是个什么人，尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~Call me if some people show up in some shitty beige Willard. Those are the guys I owe money to.
zh: ~z~要是有几个人开着辆灰不拉几的威拉德来了就打电话给我。我欠的就是他们的钱。

english: ~z~What have you done, cousin? This is not good. Others will come and take more money from us.
zh: ~z~你都做了什么啊，堂弟？这可不好。会有别人找我们收更多钱的。

english: ~z~Only problem is I'm playing with some money I'm meant to give to these Albanian scumbags.
zh: ~z~只不过我准备拿应该还那些阿尔巴尼亚混账的钱下注。

english: ~z~No, the business shut down a long time ago. We go there because some guys are playing cards.
zh: ~z~没有，五金店早就倒闭了。我们去是因为有人在那里打牌。

english: ~z~Shit, I almost forgot. I'm giving you my old phone, my new number's in there.
zh: ~z~操，差点忘了。我的旧手机给你，我的新号已经存里面了。

english: ~z~You should lose few pounds - otherwise this beautiful lady is going to leave you.
zh: ~z~你也该减减肥了，不然这位美丽的女士可就要离你而去了。

english: ~z~Baby... when I look into your eyes, it means something.
zh: ~z~宝贝...当我望向你的眼中时，是有一些含义的。

english: ~z~I am the best. I kick all the asses that play me. They call me the Janitor.
zh: ~z~我最强。跟我赌的那群混账都没有好下场。他们管我叫清洁工。

english: ~z~Please don't hurt the men after us, cousin. They hate me enough as it is.
zh: ~z~拜托别伤着追我们的人，堂弟。他们已经够恨我了。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko, it's them, they must have been told I was here.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克，就是他们，肯定是有人告诉他们我在这了。

english: ~z~Do not hurt them, I know what you're like, Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~别伤着他们，我知道你是个什么人，尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~You're taking me to a backroom game where I'll win all the dollars we need to really see this town.
zh: ~z~你开车送我去地下赌场，我在那就能把需要的钱都赢来，带你在城里好好见识见识。

english: ~z~I think that Bellic is in this store. We will get our money.
zh: ~z~我想那个贝利克就在这家店里。我们会收到账的。

english: ~z~Call me if some Albanians show up in some shitty beige Willard. Those are the guys I owe money to.
zh: ~z~要是有几个阿尔巴尼亚人开着灰不拉几的威拉德来了就打电话给我。我欠的就是他们的钱。

english: ~z~No, funny guy - we going to get money. In America you need money to do anything.
zh: ~z~不，真会说笑...我们去挣钱。在美国，做什么事都要钱。

english: ~z~They're gone, perfect. That is the last we have seen of those loan sharks... I hope.
zh: ~z~他们走了，很好。希望这是我们最后一次遇上那些讨债的...

english: ~z~Doing some home improvements, Roman? You going to build this mansion you tell me about?
zh: ~z~要搞住房改造吗，罗曼？你是想自己造一个跟我说过的豪宅？

english: ~z~Don't worry I'm getting so many bullets it's like I'm an AK. ~c~We're cool.
zh: ~z~别担心，我手头弹药充足，感觉自己像把AK。~c~没问题的。

english: ~z~Everything that I read in the books. I do what Car Jabowitz tell me in 'May Contain Nuts.'
zh: ~z~明明照着书里写的打了。我照着卡尔･亚博维茨写的《可能有弹》来的。

english: ~z~It's all quiet out here Roman, you winning? ~c~Please say yes.
zh: ~z~外面很平静，罗曼，手气好吗？~c~希望你手气不错。

english: ~z~Hey, they have stopped following us. Clearly they are too scared of what I could do to them.
zh: ~z~喂，他们没再追过来了。肯定是怕我对他们做些什么。

english: ~z~Cousin - two guys are going in the store. I think they are the loan sharks you speak of.
zh: ~z~堂兄，两个人要进店了。他们应该就是你说的讨债的。

english: ~z~I lost it this time, but when I go back the last thing they will expect is for me to take everything.
zh: ~z~这次我是输光了，但下次再来的时候，他们一定想不到我会赢走一切。

english: ~z~It is the Russian mobsters, Vlad's bosses, that run everything. Be careful of them.
zh: ~z~俄罗斯黑帮，弗拉德的上级才是掌控全局的人。不要招惹他们。

english: ~z~Darling... I'll see you later. I've got to take my cousin around some more, get him settled...
zh: ~z~亲爱的...我们待会儿见。我还得带我堂弟出去多转两圈，帮他适应适应...

english: ~z~Come on, big guy - either do some work or get out of here. We don't need jokers.
zh: ~z~拜托，大哥，要么干活，要么滚蛋。我们不养闲人。

english: ~z~Of course they saw you. I mean... you're a distinctive man Roman.
zh: ~z~肯定看见你了。我是说...你这人很显眼，罗曼。

english: ~z~You tell me to behave, Mr. Janitor? If you understand it all, where is the money?
zh: ~z~你还能教我规矩，清洁工先生？你要是啥都明白，那钱到哪儿去了？

english: ~z~We're at the bottom of the ladder man. These thugs push us around. But they are not to be feared.
zh: ~z~我们在底层，老弟。这些恶棍肆意压迫我们，但他们不算什么。

english: ~z~Shit, cousin. We can't lead these cops right to this backroom game. Lose them.
zh: ~z~操，堂弟。我们不能把这群条子引到地下赌局去。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~Shit, I almost forgot. I'm giving you my old phone, my new number's in there.
zh: ~z~操，差点忘了。我的旧手机给你，我的新号已经存里面了。

english: ~z~If they had not taken it, other players would have. It's all the same, Roman.
zh: ~z~就算他们没拿，也会被别人赢走的。都一样的，罗曼。

english: ~z~Look, say what you like,but at least that guy knows how to speak to a lady.
zh: ~z~听着，随你怎么说吧，但至少人家知道怎么跟女士说话。

english: ~z~You're settling in pretty good, aren't you, Niko? You're staying with Roman, he got you a good job
zh: ~z~你这不是很适应美国了吗，尼克？你和罗曼在一块，他已经给你找了份好工作。

english: ~z~Mallorie! So, Niko, you haven't seen any crime since you've been here, have you?
zh: ~z~玛洛丽！就是说，尼克，你到这儿以后还没见过犯罪行为是吧？

english: ~z~and all he needs to do now is find you a woman... what you think of Michelle here?
zh: ~z~现在只需要再给你找个女人了...你觉得米歇尔如何？

english: ~z~I don't know, I think he looks... interesting... foreign.
zh: ~z~我不知道，我觉得他看上去...挺有趣的...有点异国情调。

english: ~z~Niko, you know what? You need someone to show you a good time. Michelle, how about you?
zh: ~z~尼克，我觉得吧，得找人陪你度个春宵。米歇尔，要么就你吧？

english: ~z~The friend gave me her number, but I don't think Mallorie likes my clothes so much.
zh: ~z~那个闺蜜给我留了电话，不过玛洛丽好像对我的衣服有意见。

english: ~z~Come on you guys. You're both single, you're adults. Take her number, Niko.
zh: ~z~好啦，二位。你俩都单身，大家也都是成年人。这是她的电话，尼克。

english: ~z~I know you don't. He just loves you is all. And I think Michelle might too.
zh: ~z~我知道。他只是太爱你了。我想米歇尔也是这样。

english: ~z~Hey, I'd like to see you again, Niko. You look like that kind of guy I want to get to know.
zh: ~z~嘿，我们是可以再聚一聚，尼克。你看上去像是我想认识的类型。

english: ~z~How you going to impress a classy girl like Michelle?
zh: ~z~就这你还想给米歇尔这样的时髦女郎留个好印象？

english: ~z~I'm trying to get you two together so Niko will stop taking up all of Roman's time.
zh: ~z~我是想把你们俩撮成一对，这样尼克就能把罗曼的时间让出来了。

english: ~z~or people being extremely rich? There's so much more to life here than that.
zh: ~z~或者是那些钱多的没地儿花的？生命里比这重要的东西要多得多。

english: ~z~I know a good place for you on Mohawk in Hove Beach. Get something a bit more American.
zh: ~z~我知道一家适合你的好店，就在霍夫海滩的莫霍克。去那买点更美式的吧。

english: ~z~Niko, what am I to do? I need to trust you with some things.
zh: ~z~尼克，你让我怎么办？这让我怎么把要事托付给你。

english: ~z~Hey, I'd like it if you called me. You must get bored hanging out with your cousin and that asshole boss of his.
zh: ~z~嘿，有空给我打电话吧。整天和你那堂兄还有他那混蛋老板一起也快无聊死了吧？

english: ~z~Show Niko what Liberty City is all about then. Not so much the violence but maybe a bit of the...
zh: ~z~那就让尼克见识下自由城到底是个什么地方。也许没那么多暴力，但或许有点...

english: ~z~Come on, Mallorie. This is embarrassing. Are you trying to set us up?
zh: ~z~拜托，玛洛丽。这样很羞耻的。你是要撮合我俩吗？

english: ~z~Anyway, you have Michelle. A classy girl for your arm. You should definitely keep dating her.
zh: ~z~总之呢，现在你有米歇尔了。唾手可得的美女。你一定要多约她出来。

english: ~z~Cousin, Mallorie's friend, Michelle... had an accident.
zh: ~z~堂兄，玛洛丽的朋友，米歇尔...出了点小意外。

english: ~z~I hope it wasn't too serious. I thought you two would get on. I will call Mallorie.
zh: ~z~希望她伤得不重。我还以为你俩能好上呢。我会给玛洛丽打电话的。

english: ~z~We must take what we get. When the big money rolls in, then we will look real classy.
zh: ~z~价钱摆在那里。等我们挣到大钱，就有机会穿上档次的了。

english: ~z~How come all the TV shows about Liberty City are either about rampant sex or mindless violence
zh: ~z~怎么关于自由城的电视节目不是讲色情成灾就是说滥用暴力呢。

english: ~z~Alright, but you like him, right? You both like each other so why don't you just go on a date?
zh: ~z~行啦，不过你确实喜欢他吧？既然你俩互有好感，直接去约个会不就好了？

english: ~z~Niko, what am I to do? I need to trust you with some things.
zh: ~z~尼克，你让我怎么办？这让我怎么把要事托付给你。

english: ~z~This is a good first step. The next step is to get some clothes that will impress.
zh: ~z~这是个好的开端。下一步就该去买点抢眼的衣服了。

english: ~z~Get yourself some nice clothes. You gotta look good if you're going to date a girl like Michelle.
zh: ~z~给自己买点新衣服吧。想和米歇尔这样的女孩约会就得注意外表。

english: ~z~You want to know why I'm not living in a nice condo, banging four women?
zh: ~z~想知道我为啥没住在精装公寓里，同时日四个女人吗？

english: ~z~Nice one, cousin. Drive back to the depot, these bruises are starting to really hurt.
zh: ~z~干得好，堂弟。送我回车行吧，这些淤青已经开始疼了。

english: ~z~These men, these shylocks like Dardan, they always try to squeeze you for everything.
zh: ~z~这些像达尔丹一样的高利贷，总是想榨干你的一切。

english: ~z~Nice one, cousin. Drive back to the depot, these bruises are starting to pain.
zh: ~z~干得好，堂弟。开车回车行吧，这些淤青已经开始疼了。

english: ~z~If I wasn't a pacifist I'd stick it to you too.
zh: ~z~要不是因为我是和平主义者，我早就把你暴打一顿了。

english: ~z~A man in Europe, another Russian... Bulgarin. He live on the Adriatic.
zh: ~z~一个欧洲人，也是俄罗斯的...布尔加林。他住在亚得里亚海那边。

english: ~z~Don't let him get away, Niko, they are like locusts. A plague of them will come back.
zh: ~z~别让他跑了，尼克，他们就像蝗虫一样。还会卷土重来的。

english: ~z~What about Mallorie, Roman? You shouldn't stay with her if you want to have these threesomes.
zh: ~z~那玛洛丽怎么办，罗曼？你还想乱搞的话可不能和她一起。

english: ~z~He'll come back and trash our place if he gets away, get him, cousin.
zh: ~z~他要是跑了还不得把我们的店给砸了，追上去，堂弟。

english: ~z~Over on the courts under the El Train on Firefly. Bledar, buddy, you proved your point the first time...
zh: ~z~我在萤火虫的轻轨下面的球场。布莱达尔，哥们，第一次的时候你已经证明你的态度了...

english: ~z~I saw bad things happen there. You do not know what it is that...
zh: ~z~我在故国目睹了坏事发生。你不知道那件事的...

english: ~z~I think he broke my rib. Man that hurts. Shit. I need a massage.
zh: ~z~他好像打断了我的肋骨。可真痛啊。操。我要去做个按摩。

english: ~z~Urghgh... I think it must be two ribs. Those fucking punks. What were you saying?
zh: ~z~呃啊...大概断了两根肋骨，这群狗娘养的。你刚才说啥？

english: ~z~Go after him, finish him off. I would do it but I'm hurt, you know? Urgh.
zh: ~z~追上去，做掉他。要不是我受伤了我就自己上了。呃啊。

english: ~z~Fucking Dardan smashing my fucking stuff. Who does he think he is?
zh: ~z~傻逼达尔丹他妈乱搞老子东西。他当自己是老几啊？

english: ~z~We got some of them, cousin. But not all. This is not a good thing.
zh: ~z~我们解决了一小部分人，但还不是全部。这可不是好事。

english: ~z~Just some fucking petty Albanian hood. If I wanted to buy a stolen TV I'd go to Dardan.
zh: ~z~不就是个阿尔巴尼亚土鳖么。想买偷来的电视，找达尔丹就对了。

english: ~z~Vlad, Dardan, Bledar, even Mallorie push me around.
zh: ~z~弗拉德、达尔丹、布莱达尔，就连玛洛丽都使唤我。

english: ~z~Who does he think he's fucking with? Bellic Enterprises, that's who.
zh: ~z~也不想想自己他妈在招惹谁？惹上贝利克集团了。

english: ~z~Ever since I get to Hove Beach, Niko, ever since I arrive here I have been pushed around.
zh: ~z~自打我到了霍夫海滩，尼克，自打我到这儿，我都是任人摆布。

english: ~z~They think they can fuck me around and beat me up because there are more of them. Not any longer.
zh: ~z~他们以为仗着人多就能打我、欺负我。这样的日子过去了。

english: ~z~Screw money I owe the Albanians, paying for the cab will be a lot harder.
zh: ~z~算上欠阿尔巴尼亚人的那些钱，我连新车都买不起了。

english: ~z~He had too many connections for that. I had to leave. He is one of the reasons I came here.
zh: ~z~他的人脉太广了，我只能离开。也是我来这儿的原因之一。

english: ~z~Hey, Roman ain't much better when he's behind the wheel. Sorry about that screw up.
zh: ~z~嘿，罗曼开车的时候也没好到哪去。抱歉搞砸了。

english: ~z~I ain't got no problem with that. Just don't tell me if you stole this shit from a hospital or a school for sick kids.
zh: ~z~只要东西不是从医院或者福利学校偷来的，我就没有问题。

english: ~z~Hey, yokel. Your dumb cousin isn't here. Go get me a coffee.
zh: ~z~喂，乡巴佬，你的蠢堂兄不在。去给我泡杯咖啡。

english: ~z~Where's Roman? Are you a cop? You've got to tell me if you're a cop. That's the law.
zh: ~z~罗曼人呢？你是条子吗？要是你是条子你就得告诉我。这是规矩。

english: ~z~Roman, I guess, and some other things. I'm looking for something.
zh: ~z~大概是罗曼吧，也有别的理由。我在寻找某样东西。

english: ~z~I got rid of one group of loan sharks but this asshole, Vlad, he has his hooks into him as well.
zh: ~z~我解决了一批高利贷，但他还是被弗拉德那混蛋吃得死死的。

english: ~z~That's just some bullshit that cops circulate to trick people into doing deals with them.
zh: ~z~条子会四处晃悠骗别人和他们做交易纯粹是在胡扯。

english: ~z~You shouldn't have said that, Jermaine. I've grounds to arrest you now.
zh: ~z~你不该说这句话的，杰梅因。我现在有充足的理由逮捕你了。

english: ~z~Cool, I think we managed to shake them. We just need to lay low for another minute.
zh: ~z~漂亮，我们好像甩掉他们了。现在只要再低调一会儿就行了。

english: ~z~Ok, ok. I've got to pick up some hot parts from my lockup, you down?
zh: ~z~行，行。我要去我的车库拿点烫手的零部件，你干吗？

english: ~z~Niko, sorry to ask, cousin... can you go pick up Jermaine, one of my regulars?
zh: ~z~尼克，很不好意思，堂弟...你能帮我去接我的一个熟客，杰梅因吗？

english: ~z~Alright, I don't think they know where we are. Don't attract any unnecessary attention.
zh: ~z~好了，这下他们就找不到我们了。别引起不必要的注意。

english: ~z~Shit. I thought Roman was gonna pick me up. I need someone I can trust for this run.
zh: ~z~靠，我还以为罗曼会来接我。这一趟我得找个信得过的人。

english: ~z~Shit, you just shoulda told me that. Jesus. You nearly gave me a heart attack.
zh: ~z~靠，不早说。天哪。我差点连心脏病都吓出来了。

english: ~z~I don't think they see us. Now, if we can stay outta their sights for a little longer we be all good.
zh: ~z~他们应该没看见我们。现在再在他们的视野外躲一会儿就行了。

english: ~z~Niko, how come you trash my cab but you never trash those tanks you drive back home?
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么只会弄坏我的车？你开回家的那些坦克怎么就没见你弄坏过？

english: ~z~No, I didn't. Just like every other chump who gets off a boat here, I thought things might be more exciting.
zh: ~z~不是的。和别的在这儿下船的傻瓜一样，我以为这里的生活会更刺激。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. He was one of my only regulars. This ain't good at all, man. Later on.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。他是我为数不多的常客。这可太糟糕了，老弟。回见。

english: ~z~This is just the beginning. It seems I need to sort out my cousin's life before I can work on my own.
zh: ~z~现在只是前奏。我要先解决我堂兄的生活问题，然后才能开始为自己的生活奋斗。

english: ~z~I'm Roman's cousin. If you can trust him, you can trust me.
zh: ~z~我是罗曼的堂弟。要是你信得过他，就可以信得过我。

english: ~z~Niko came in looking for you and Vlad told him to get him a fucking coffee and Niko didn't want to.
zh: ~z~尼克过来找你，然后弗拉德让他去泡杯咖啡，尼克不去。

english: ~z~I wouldn't want no cop driving me to pick up a load of hot parts.
zh: ~z~我可不想让条子开车带我去拿一堆烫手的零部件。

english: ~z~The hotshot lady's man, cruising around the Mediterranean, breaking hearts and making millions?
zh: ~z~就是征服了抢手辣妹，在地中海上巡游，伤尽无数人的心，分分钟百万上下的那个？

english: ~z~That's exactly the kind of bullshit I can imagine Roman making up. You've got to give him credit for his imagination.
zh: ~z~完全就是我想象中罗曼会说的胡话。他的想象力真的是一流水准。

english: ~z~Yeah, you gotta. I had a feeling you sounded too good to be true.
zh: ~z~确实，是这样的。我本来觉得你这人成功得有点假。

english: ~z~Good Niko, thanks, thanks... can't talk, see you soon.
zh: ~z~很好，尼克，谢了，谢了...说不来话，回头见。

english: ~z~My hands haven't been clean for a long time. Being here in Liberty City is just making them dirtier.
zh: ~z~我的手已经脏了很久了。在自由城也只会把手弄得更脏。

english: ~z~Hey? Yeah... okay... no, I can't do it; my cousin will do it.
zh: ~z~喂？对...好的...不行，我来不了，得让我堂弟来。

english: ~z~Roman, man, I got some bad news. Your client, Jermaine, he got hurt.
zh: ~z~罗曼，老哥，我有个坏消息。你的客户，杰梅因他受伤了。

english: ~z~But he's a serf, and you're a countess. Talking about serfs...
zh: ~z~但他只是个农奴，而你却是个女伯爵。说农奴农奴到...

english: ~z~Anyway, Niko dealt with them... broke Dardan's arm, then beat up a couple more.
zh: ~z~总之呢，尼克解决了他们...打断了达尔丹的胳膊，又打倒了几个人。

english: ~z~then those Albanians you said you would deal with came and smashed my computer.
zh: ~z~然后你说你会解决的那群阿尔巴尼亚人就冲进来砸了我的电脑。

english: ~z~You really got to get some practice driving on the right side of the road. Roman shouldn't have let you out of his cab.
zh: ~z~你真的该回去好好学学怎么开车了。罗曼不该让你把他的车开出来的。

english: ~z~Realness brother, you are me man Roman's cousin. Thanks, respect.
zh: ~z~真够兄弟，你是我哥们罗曼的堂弟。谢了，敬你。

english: ~z~Car seven, head to South Slopes. Come on, where are you, Mohammed?
zh: ~z~七号车，去南坡。得了吧，你到哪了，穆罕默德？

english: ~z~Can you take dis piece? Ya hear any ting bad going down, you come and help, sight?
zh: ~z~你能拿上这个家伙吗？只要听见下面情况不对，你就出来帮我，行吧？

english: ~z~Okay. Yes... go pick up my friend, Little Jacob... he's a good man.
zh: ~z~好吧。有...去接下我的朋友，小雅各布...他是个好人。

english: ~z~Oh! Miss Weinstock, no no, not you... what can I do for you today?
zh: ~z~噢！温斯托克小姐，不是不是，没说你...今天有什么我能帮上的吗？

english: ~z~Thanks for everything, ya can keep the piece. I tink ya know fe use it better than I an' I do.
zh: ~z~真是谢谢你了，家伙你留着吧。我觉得你比我更懂怎么用它。

english: ~z~Fuck, now I have to call his friend Real Badman. This ain't going to go well cousin.
zh: ~z~操，现在我得打电话给他的朋友真巴德曼了。情况不会太好的，堂弟。

english: ~z~Niko, man, we should talk some time - I'm a good listener.
zh: ~z~尼克，老弟，我们该抽时间聊聊了，我是个好听众。

english: ~z~Jacob, Jacob, Jacob... we have te teach Badman his lesson and ting.
zh: ~z~雅各布，雅各布，雅各布...我们要给巴德曼一个教训。

english: ~z~You see, Real Badman, me boss man, he get in a fight with these boys and I gots to go down te make peace.
zh: ~z~你看，真巴德曼，我的老大，兄弟，他和这群杂鱼打架，我下来替他讲和。

english: ~z~I want to make peace, but Jah know what type of shit they might pull off.
zh: ~z~我是想和平解决的，不过天知道他们会整出什么幺蛾子。

english: ~z~No. Maybe not. When you going to tell me properly about what happened?
zh: ~z~不，或许是的。你要什么时候才能告诉我到底发生了什么？

english: ~z~No. Mr. Bellic has stepped away from his office, can I take a message?
zh: ~z~不行，贝利克先生不在办公室，有什么需要我替您转达吗？

english: ~z~That is fe me breda. Seen, Niko, seen. Can ya do me a favor?
zh: ~z~这才像我兄弟嘛。懂了吧，尼克，懂了吧。你能帮我个忙吗？

english: ~z~Respect. Alright, alright. We going to this spot where I need ya to wait for I, seen?
zh: ~z~敬你。行了，行了。到了以后你得等着我，好吧？

english: ~z~Sorry for maga dog, maga dog turn round bite you.
zh: ~z~遇上狗杂种我很抱歉，狗杂种就是会反咬你一口。

english: ~z~Jacob is a good man, watching glue dry with Jacob would not be boring.
zh: ~z~雅各布可是个有趣的人，和雅各布一起看着胶水干掉都不会无聊。

english: ~z~Head into town. I don't give a fuck if the bridge is busy, you're a cab driver! Hey.
zh: ~z~给我进城。我他妈才不管桥上堵不堵，你丫可是个的士司机！嘿。

english: ~z~Alright, alright. Ya me man Roman's cousin, ain't ya?
zh: ~z~好了，好了。你就是我哥们罗曼的堂弟，对不对？

english: ~z~It seems that Roman has enough problem running his own life, let alone the whole city.
zh: ~z~罗曼似乎都管不好自己的生活，更别说掌管整个城市了。

english: ~z~Alright. There be a spot up there. Watch out for any badness.
zh: ~z~好了。上面有个高点。留意那些不怀好意的家伙。

english: ~z~Fuck you, I wish I could be there to watch Mikhail cut your peasant balls off.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，真希望能亲眼看见米哈伊尔把你这乡下人给阉了。

english: ~z~You knew my woman was banging this warthog and you didn't do anything?
zh: ~z~你知道我的女人跟这头野猪上了床居然还无动于衷？

english: ~z~You might let some Russian asswipe bang your woman, but I won't.
zh: ~z~你可能乐意让一个俄国傻逼上你的女人，我不乐意。

english: ~z~You're going for a little drive... you're going to leave Vlad alone, right?
zh: ~z~你只是要去兜两圈...你不会去找弗拉德的，对吧？

english: ~z~After what I did for you, you dick! You fucking dick!
zh: ~z~亏我还替你做了这么多，你这屌人！去你妈的屌人！

english: ~z~He'll come back. The only thing that will hold him down is six feet of dirt.
zh: ~z~他会回来的。唯一能阻止他的就是钉死的棺材板。

english: ~z~Cousin, this is crazy. We got each other. We don't need women in our lives.
zh: ~z~堂弟，这太疯狂了。我们互有彼此，不需要女人插足生活。

english: ~z~Look, Vlad has crashed his car and gone. Surely that is enough...
zh: ~z~你看，弗拉德已经出车祸走了。这样肯定是够了...

english: ~z~You're throwing you and your fatty cousin's lives away for that bit of Puerto Rican chocha.
zh: ~z~就为了那个波多黎各娘们儿，你连自己和你那胖子堂哥的命都不要了吗？

english: ~z~Great, we go now. Vlad and Mallorie can have happy life together.
zh: ~z~很好，我们走吧。弗拉德和Mallories从此可以过上幸福的生活了。

english: ~z~Aha ha! Screw you. Listen, man... you should try going online.
zh: ~z~啊哈哈！去你的吧。听我说，老弟...你也该试试上网。

english: ~z~Listen, I promised Brucie I'd go out with him - can you go out and get it sorted?
zh: ~z~听好，我跟布鲁斯约好一起出去了。你能自己去一趟搞定吗？

english: ~z~Yesterday I was online and I discovered a blog about women who don't like to shave.
zh: ~z~昨天我在网上看了个博客，讲的是不刮体毛的女人。

english: ~z~I have set up the email account. I am now online in Liberty City, Roman.
zh: ~z~我已经注册好邮箱了。我现在连上自由城的网了，罗曼。

english: ~z~Nice one, cousin. Did you meet the girl who works there? Nice pair of titties on her, no? Later on.
zh: ~z~很好，堂弟。见到在那上班的妹子了吗？她那对奶子很赞吧？回见。

english: ~z~In a dark corner, doing dark deeds, we're both players, my friend.
zh: ~z~在漆黑的角落，做暗黑的行径，我俩都是玩家，朋友。

english: ~z~I know how to go on the line. I just haven't done it here.
zh: ~z~我当然知道怎么上那个网，只是来这以后还没上过。

english: ~z~Hey there... my name's Niko. My cousin, he told me to come here.
zh: ~z~嘿，你好...我叫尼克。是我堂兄让我来这儿的。

english: ~z~also sexy... that's how I like my women. I work at it, so they should too, right?
zh: ~z~很性感...我就喜欢这种女人。我在这么做，她们应该也是这么做，对吧？

english: ~z~Roman? He call me about you. He so funny. I set you up on that computer already.
zh: ~z~罗曼？他在电话里跟我说过你了。他很风趣。账号我已经帮你注册了。

english: ~s~Teddy's goons are everywhere, use cover and move through the building with caution.
zh: ~s~公寓中到处都是泰迪的小弟，善用掩体，谨慎行动。

english: ~s~You did it Niko, you got rid of the mouchers, just me and you now, I have the ice on me, 50 / 50.
zh: ~s~牛逼啊尼克，你把那些多余的家伙全干掉了，现在就剩你和我了，钻石在我这，我们五五分吧。

english: ~z~only the friend ain't my friend no more, because he ain't getting me the vig he owes.
zh: ~z~不过他现在不再是我的朋友了，因为他不肯付欠我的利息。

english: ~z~Why go through all this? Why stick your neck out? Why do all this work?
zh: ~z~为什么走这条路？为什么要冒风险？为什么做这些活？

english: ~z~What are you talking about? Ted, who's he? I'm sorry to hear about your loss. I'll be in touch, Nicky.
zh: ~z~你在说什么呢？泰德，他哪位？我对你身边的噩耗感到遗憾。保持联络，尼克。

english: ~z~Ray, I've made some noise in these projects. I don't think I'm going to be able to find your boy, Teddy.
zh: ~z~雷，我在公屋社区闹了点动静，估计是找不到你要的泰迪了。

english: ~z~Oh, Ray? Why didn't you say so? Ray's a beautiful man, you know what I mean?
zh: ~z~雷啊？你怎么不早说？雷是个很好的人，懂我意思吗？

english: ~z~Maybe them micks was wrong about you, Nicky. I hope for your sake they wasn't.
zh: ~z~也许爱尔兰佬看错你了，尼克。我还是希望他们没有看错。

english: ~z~Yo, T Dog, someone's coming up. Don't know how, but he knows where your apartment is.
zh: ~z~呦，T Dog，有人上来了。不知道他怎么知道你的公寓在哪的。

english: ~z~Maybe them micks was wrong about you, Nicky. I hope for your sake they wasn't.
zh: ~z~也许爱尔兰佬看错你了，尼克。我还是希望他们没有看错。

english: ~z~I sure hope we ain't lost any on the route. Things got shaken up pretty good back there.
zh: ~z~希望我们没在路上掉过钻石，刚才震得可厉害了。

english: ~z~Ah hell, Nicky. They was good earners. You gotta control yourself, you're a fucking maniac.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克。他俩很能干的。学会控制自己，你这个疯子。

english: ~z~You think that's funny? Shit. You're an imbecile. We gotta talk about this.
zh: ~z~这很有趣吗？操，你这个白痴。我们得好好谈谈了。

english: ~z~Fuck, I thought this was going to be easy. Why does everything have to get complicated?
zh: ~z~操，我还以为会很容易。怎么做什么最后都一团糟？

english: ~z~I ain't gonna get caught by the cops with this stolen ice. Lose 'em before we pick it up.
zh: ~z~我可不想带着赃物钻石被警察抓到。在我们收回钻石前甩了他们。

english: ~z~Nah, me and Tuna will look after them. Sort them out from the trash.
zh: ~z~不了，我和图纳会处理的。把钻石从垃圾里分出来。

english: ~z~We was saying that there's a lot of opportunities for this to go wrong. The bag could split.
zh: ~z~我们在说这个计划很容易出问题。垃圾袋会破掉。

english: ~z~Go over to F between Columbus and Denver, there'll be a truck waiting there.
zh: ~z~去哥伦布大道和丹佛大道之间的F路，那里有辆垃圾车等着。

english: ~z~I dunno. These diamonds is serious. Anyone who heard of 'em would want them.
zh: ~z~我也不知道，这些钻石很值钱。谁听说了都想来截胡。

english: ~z~That's why we're going to be extra careful, right? We wouldn't want that to happen, would we?
zh: ~z~所以才要格外小心，对吧？我们也不想出什么岔子，对吧？

english: ~z~Yeah... you wanted a career in waste disposal, now you got one.
zh: ~z~对...你不是想要垃圾场的工作吗，现在你有了。

english: ~z~You could say that. Ray got that tweaker chick of his, the biker broad, you met her?
zh: ~z~可以这么说吧。雷的那个吸毒女友，飞车党的，你见过吗？

english: ~z~Ray, man. That Johnny kid got put out with the trash. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~雷，伙计。强尼已经死在垃圾堆里了，我很抱歉。

english: ~z~How'd they find us? I thought that we went to all this trouble so no one would know?
zh: ~z~怎么被发现了？我们特意绕这么大个圈子还被发觉了？

english: ~z~Fuck me, Nicky. I had some hopes for that cugine. Come see me.
zh: ~z~我操，尼克。我还有点期待那个老兄的。过来见我。

english: ~z~That a fact? Being a space monkey would probably pay better than this work.
zh: ~z~真这么想？当太空猴的工资可能是比这个工作高。

english: ~z~Ray came up with this plan to keep a bit of distance between us and the robbery.
zh: ~z~雷的这个计划就是为了避免我们和抢钻石间产生直接联系。

english: ~z~I can't see that we got much opportunity here. Either we lose these shitheads or we're screwed.
zh: ~z~我是看不出现在有什么机遇。甩不掉这些猪头就完了。

english: ~z~Every immigrant's dream ain't it? Being a wiseguy I mean, not trash collecting.
zh: ~z~移民都这么幻想，不是吗？要做聪明人，不去收垃圾。

english: ~z~I look after my friends... I got a lot of friends. Important friends.
zh: ~z~我很关照我的朋友...我有很多朋友。很重要的朋友。

english: ~z~Ray got her to get her friends to steal the ice off of some club owner guy.
zh: ~z~雷让她和她的朋友从一个夜店老板地方偷走了那些钻石。

english: ~z~Well, don't try your luck at the door any time soon and if you do, don't tip the bouncer with a diamond.
zh: ~z~以后别去那边乱转。就算真去了，别把钻石当给守门人的小费。

english: ~z~This ain't the easiest way to pick this shit up, even if we don't want to attract any attention.
zh: ~z~就算不想引起别人注意，也有更简单的方法能拿回钻石吧。

english: ~z~So, Luca, you are a professional trash collector when you ain't working for Ray?
zh: ~z~那个，卢卡，你不替雷干活的时候就是专业收垃圾的吗？

english: ~z~The manager of one of his waste depots was holding out on profits a couple a years back.
zh: ~z~几年前他的一个垃圾站的经理偷偷拿了一点回扣，

english: ~z~I dunno what this crew's gonna do without Luca. I looked to him, you know. For, like, leadership and shit.
zh: ~z~我不知道没了卢卡这个小队还怎么行动。我听他的，你知道吗。因为，他，有领导力这样的东西。

english: ~z~When I arrived in Liberty City, I didn't imagine that I'd become a trash collector.
zh: ~z~来到自由城的时候，我没想到自己会成为收垃圾的。

english: ~z~Yeah, they got it. They... they left it where you said.
zh: ~z~好，已经弄到了。他们把钻石放到你要求的地方了。

english: ~z~Course not. You know how pissed Ray would get if he found out some diamonds were missin'.
zh: ~z~当然不想。你也知道要是漏了钻石，雷会有多生气。

english: ~z~This guy who owns some big clubs in the city. You heard of a place called Maisonette 9?
zh: ~z~在城里开了好几家大型夜店的家伙。听说过9号豪宅吗？

english: ~z~I think I worked with a member of that gang up on Bohan. He was called Johnny or eh, something.
zh: ~z~我记得我和那个帮会的人在波汉合作过。他好像叫强尼来着。

english: ~z~That mook ain't gonna be following us no more. Let's get the ice back. You've done good, Nicky.
zh: ~z~这些呆子没法再跟着我们了。把钻石带回去吧。你做得很好，尼克。

english: ~z~I think you should worry about Ray and those diamonds before anything else. I'll see you around, Tuna.
zh: ~z~我觉得你还是先担心雷和那些钻石比较好。我们回头见，图纳。

english: ~z~Alright, Tuna, John Boy, you got the threads. Get on the back and get the trash.
zh: ~z~好了，图纳，小强，工作服你们都有了。到后面去负责收垃圾。

english: ~z~Luca and his crew have got the stuff, Ray. It's all in the back of the truck.
zh: ~z~卢卡和他的人拿到货了，雷。都在垃圾车后面装着。

english: ~z~They ain't on us no more. Good driving. Now all's you got to do is bring the ice home safe.
zh: ~z~甩掉他们了，好车技。现在只要把钻石安全带回家就行。

english: ~z~Fuck me, Nicky. I had some hopes for that cugine. Come see me.
zh: ~z~我操，尼克。我还有点期待那个老兄的。过来见我。

english: ~z~They'd rather have plastic surgery and a life sentence in suburban hell than take their punishment like real men.
zh: ~z~他们宁愿做整容手术，到鸟不拉屎的乡下度过余生，也不愿意像男子汉一样接受刑罚。

english: ~z~Yeah, but you got to admit the money we're getting ain't shit. We bust our balls and for what?
zh: ~z~确实，但我们的报酬真的太少了。费这么大劲都是为了什么啊？

english: ~z~Hey, Ray. I'm sorry but I had to put Luca and Tuna down. I didn't trust them.
zh: ~z~嘿，雷。很抱歉，我把卢卡和图纳干掉了。我不信他们。

english: ~z~This is Tunafish and Johnny Spaz. Tuna, Johnny, Niko.
zh: ~z~这个是Tunafish，他是强尼 斯帕兹。图纳，强尼，尼克。

english: ~z~Ray, I hate to tell you this but your friend Tuna is sleeping with the fishes.
zh: ~z~雷，很遗憾地告诉你，你的朋友图纳现在要到河底喂鱼去了。

english: ~z~Ray, the job did not go to plan. We lost Luca and Tuna. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~雷，事情没能按计划进行。我们失去了卢卡和图纳。我很抱歉。

english: ~z~Nice driving, Nicky. Looks like you lost 'em. Let's bring this ice home.
zh: ~z~车技不错，尼克。看来你甩掉他们了，把钻石送回家吧。

english: ~z~Money ain't the only thing I'm looking for in Liberty City, Luca. I'll take what Ray gives me.
zh: ~z~钱不是我在自由城的唯一目标，卢卡。雷给我多少钱都行。

english: ~z~is in the waste management business but it ain't usually this hands on, you know?
zh: ~z~都有参与垃圾处理事业，但也不是靠这个吃饭的，懂吗？

english: ~z~I don't think we going to complete our round, Ray. The truck's trashed.
zh: ~z~我觉得我们没法完成任务了，雷。垃圾车成垃圾了。

english: ~z~It sure fucking did. I got a feeling that Ray'll care more about not getting the diamonds though.
zh: ~z~当然搞砸了。不过我觉得雷会更在意我们没弄到钻石就是了。

english: ~z~Did these bikers get so fucked on meth that they threw the ice away?
zh: ~z~这些飞车党是吸冰毒吸坏脑子才把这些钻石给扔了？

english: ~z~There was this point where the sounds of his screams stopped and all you could hear was his bones crushin',
zh: ~z~一段时间后他的尖叫停了，传来的只剩下骨头粉碎的声音，

english: ~z~Nah. It seems the club owner's got more connections than a subway line.
zh: ~z~不是，那个夜店老板的人际关系似乎比铁路还复杂。

english: ~z~Yeah, you still get your hands dirty though. Who'd these diamonds belong to before us?
zh: ~z~懂了，但你手上还是不太干净。这些钻石原来的主人是谁？

english: ~z~You should start looking for a new crew, Ray. The old one's in a better place.
zh: ~z~你需要找新的手下了， 雷。老的几个上天堂了。

english: ~z~Fuck me, Nicky. I had some hopes for that cugine. Come see me.
zh: ~z~干，尼克。我从表兄那听到一些消息。过来见我。

english: ~z~He's in with the Ancelottis, the Dominicans up in Northwood, everybody.
zh: ~z~他和安切洛蒂家族有关，和北伍德的多米尼加人有关，谁都跟他有关。

english: ~z~Get rid of the cops, Nicky. We don't want the feds seeing us collect this ice.
zh: ~z~甩掉条子，尼克。我们不希望被警察发现我们带着钻石。

english: ~z~Crap, someone's got wise to us. Let's get the hell outta here. Drive to Fishmarket South.
zh: ~z~靠，有人发现我们了。快他妈离开这儿，去鱼市南。

english: ~z~I was planning for an easy life. It don't matter too much, bring me the score at Drusilla's.
zh: ~z~我计划退隐了。这没事，把德鲁西拉的分数带来。

english: ~z~Hey, hey! I left them with the stuff to bring to you, as instructed.
zh: ~z~嘿，嘿！我把你要的钻石交给他们了，照指示办的。

english: ~z~Fuck you, you cabbage-eating prick. Who says it weren't you that made off with 'em?
zh: ~z~操你妈，你个吃卷心菜的屌人。我看是你私吞了钻石吧？

english: ~z~I dunno what you talkin' bout, Nicky. I gave every one of those diamonds to Ray.
zh: ~z~我不知道你在说什么，尼克。钻石我一颗不少全给雷了。

english: ~z~Shit. I'm starting to think you guys are in bed together. You better prove me wrong.
zh: ~z~我靠，我要怀疑你们这群人是一伙的了。你最好能证明我错了。

english: ~z~Maybe I am, but if you thought that, I wouldn't be standing here right now.
zh: ~z~或许吧，但我要真参与了，现在也不会来找你了。

english: ~z~Go see him, go get my stuff back so everyone can get paid. Now.
zh: ~z~过去找他，拿回我的钻石，大家都有钱分。去吧。

english: ~z~Shit. I'm starting to think you guys are in bed together. You better prove me wrong.
zh: ~z~我靠，我要怀疑你们这群人是一伙的了。你最好能证明我错了。

english: ~z~Shit. I'm starting to think you guys are in bed together. You better prove me wrong.
zh: ~z~我靠，我要怀疑你们这群人是一伙的了。你最好能证明我错了。

english: ~z~Yeah, baby, I'll be there in a little bit. Alright listen, why don't you wear that pink thing, huh?
zh: ~z~好，宝贝，我马上过来。听着，要么你还是穿粉色那件吧，哈？

english: ~z~Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Since we're having a little show and tell, let's see some money.
zh: ~z~喔，喔，喔，喔。要我们给你验货可以，先把钱拿出来。

english: ~z~It'll be good... keep things on a level. People always behave better with company.
zh: ~z~这样更好...至少能安心点。人多办事效率高嘛。

english: ~z~Yeah, I know how it is sitting around with two million dollars worth of stolen ice, waiting to get jumped.
zh: ~z~我是知道身怀200万刀的钻石傻坐等着被抢是啥感觉。

english: ~z~Gentlemen, gentlemen, pardon the precautions. You know how things are.
zh: ~z~先生们，先生们，恕我带了保镖。这年头不安全啊。

english: ~z~So either you give me your word or go fuck yourself, I'm sick of this shit!
zh: ~z~你丫要么给个准数，要么玩蛋去吧，老子受不了了！

english: ~z~Yeah, yeah, the pink thing with the little feathers on the... yeah.
zh: ~z~对，对，粉色那件，有层毛绒的 *口哨* ...对。

english: ~z~Don't bust my balls. What's the point of talking about things unless they become real?
zh: ~z~别跟我扯淡了。讲这种未必发生的事有什么意思？

english: ~z~Listen we got a lot of missing money, and we got a problem with these fucking bikers...
zh: ~z~听着，我们丢了一大笔钱，还跟那群飞车党有点矛盾...

english: ~z~Ha ha... no. I've heard good things. Some aren't friends... but y'know... what are you gonna do?
zh: ~z~不。久仰久仰。听坏家伙提起过你...你打算怎么办？

english: ~z~This thing of ours is only surviving because we send a message when we get fucked with.
zh: ~z~我们能够活到现在，是因为谁敢搞我们，我们就给他警告。

english: ~z~Hey, why don't we see if he can keep up with some real American bikers?
zh: ~z~嘿，一起试试他能不能跟上真正的美国飞车党吧？

english: ~z~I feel like all I been doing is shutting people up ever since this diamond thing started.
zh: ~z~我觉得自从钻石事件发生后我一直在做的就是杀人。

english: ~z~I'm going out for a smoke. If the penthouse calls down again, tell them I'm on a break.
zh: ~z~我要出去抽支烟。如果他再打来，告诉他们我在休息。

english: ~z~You, listen to me Isaac - listen, dick. It is not my fault you got robbed. Not my fault!
zh: ~z~你听我说，艾萨克。听着，屌人。你被抢了不能怪我。不能怪我！

english: ~z~Screw you, Ray. I ain't your clean up guy no more. You get that?
zh: ~z~去你妈的，雷。我不再是你的打工仔了。懂了吗？

english: ~z~This city can get real scary if you don't got friends. You remember that.
zh: ~z~要是没有朋友，这座城市真的会很可怕。你要记住。

english: ~z~Show mercy. Is that not what your life has taught you? Let me leave here alive.
zh: ~z~善良点吧。这不是你的人生经验吗？放我一条生路吧。

english: ~z~I feel like all I been doing is shutting people up ever since this diamond thing started.
zh: ~z~自从跟钻石扯上关系后，我好像一直在给人封口。

english: ~z~Isaac's life is enough. Take that and the debt should be paid. You don't need me too.
zh: ~z~死一个艾萨克就够了。拿上那些应该就够还债了，没必要杀我。

english: ~z~I've done this work for you, you said you'd find someone for me.
zh: ~z~我已经帮你做事了，你说过会帮我找到那个人的。

english: ~z~I have seen your face. I know what it is to look evil in the eye. Let me live!
zh: ~z~我见过你的脸。我知道看过恶魔的脸会怎样。放我一马吧！

english: ~z~I told Isaac not to trouble you crazy scumbags. He wouldn't listen. Always the same.
zh: ~z~我跟lsaac说了别找你们这些疯子。他偏不听。永远是这样。

english: ~z~No, no, you know what? I ain't even started yet, you thieving fuck!
zh: ~z~不，不，你知道吗？我都没开始呢，你个混蛋毛贼！

english: ~s~While in a vehicle the colored line on the radar shows the shortest legal route to your objective - this is not always the fastest way.
zh: ~s~驾车时小地图上的彩色线条表示前往目的地的最短合法路线，但合法路线未必是最快的。

english: ~s~You can add your own icon via the pause menu map screen and a route will be added on the radar.
zh: ~s~你可以通过暂停菜单的地图界面添加自己的标记，随后小地图上就会出现一条路线。

english: ~r~Talbot is dead, you are no closer to finding Florian Cravic.~s~
zh: ~r~塔尔博特死了，你离找到弗洛里安･克拉维克又远了一步。~s~

english: ~s~To exit manual dial highlight the red phone icon and press ~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~.
zh: ~s~将光标移至红色电话图标后，按~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~可退出拨号键盘。

english: ~s~The icon above the radar tells you when a contact has been added to your phone.
zh: ~s~小地图上的这个图标会在有新联系人添加到你的通讯录时出现。

english: ~s~The color of the segments represent the type of character you are locked onto. Red indicates an enemy.
zh: ~s~短弧的颜色代表被锁定人物的类型。红色表示敌人。

english: ~s~If an enemy is above or below you an arrow will be displayed on their radar blip.
zh: ~s~如果敌人处在你的上方或下方，他在小地图上的图标中将显示一个箭头。

english: ~s~While locked onto an enemy, the target reticule's eight central segments represent their health.
zh: ~s~锁定敌人时，准星中的八个短弧表示他们的血量。

english: The area the cops search in is represented by the flashing zone on the Radar. Cops in this zone are marked by flashing red and blue icons.
zh: 小地图上闪烁的区域表示警方的搜捕范围。范围内的警察会用红蓝交替闪烁的圆点标识。

english: You have evaded the cops. Stay out of trouble to completely lose your wanted level.
zh: 你已经避开了警察。避免惹事生非，彻底摆脱通缉。

english: If you are seen leaving the zone by the cops then they will refocus their search and a new zone will be created.
zh: 若你在离开搜捕范围时被警察目击，警方就会重新划定搜捕范围。

english: ~S~You can use the Pay 'n' Spray to clear your wanted level as long as the cops don't see you entering.
zh: ~S~只要警察没有目击你进入，你就可以通过喷漆店清空你的通缉度。

english: Anyone seen performing a crime will gain a wanted level and the cops will attempt to hunt them down.
zh: 任何人被目击实施犯罪行为都会获得通缉度，警方会全力追捕他们。

english: ~S~It will repair and re-spray your vehicle and three hours will pass.
zh: ~S~你的车辆将得到修理并重新喷漆，时间会前进3个小时。

english: Your wanted level is represented by the number of stars on screen. The more stars the harder cops will try to catch you.
zh: 画面上的星星数量表示你的通缉度。星星越多，警方的追捕力度越强。

english: The target icon will indicate the height of your ~y~destination~s~ in relation to you with an up or down arrow.
zh: 目标图标会通过上下箭头表示~y~目的地~s~相对于你的位置。

english: Crouch to stay out of sight. Use ~INPUT_DUCK~ to crouch, this will make your aim more accurate.
zh: 蹲下以不被发现。按~INPUT_DUCK~蹲下，蹲下时瞄准精度更高。

english: The target icon will indicate the height of the ~r~enemy~s~ in relation to you with an up or down arrow.
zh: 目标图标会通过上下箭头表示~r~敌人~s~相对于你的位置。

english: ~s~To perform an execution on Vlad, lock on to him and fire. When locked on, the reticule will flash if an execution can be performed.
zh: ~s~锁定弗拉德后开火可对弗拉德实施处决。若能实施处决，准星在锁定时将会闪烁。

english: ~s~To perform an execution on Vlad, aim at him and fire. When locked on, the reticule will flash if an execution can be performed.
zh: ~s~瞄准弗拉德后开火可对弗拉德实施处决。若能实施处决，准星在锁定时将会闪烁。

english: ~s~To logout of the computer press ~INPUT_PICKUP~, ~CANCEL~, or click the "LOGOUT" icon on the desktop.
zh: ~s~按下~INPUT_PICKUP~或~CANCEL~，或是点击桌面右下角的「LOGOUT」 图标以从本机注销。

english: ~s~This is your Email Inbox. Your Inbox lists all the emails you have received.
zh: ~s~这是你的收件箱，收件箱中会显示你收到的所有邮件。

english: ~s~Move the Pointer to the "WEB" icon, it will change to a Hand when over the icon.
zh: ~s~请将指针移动到「WEB」图标上，此时指针会变成手形。

english: ~s~Click the "CHECK MAIL" link to view your mailbox or the envelope icon on the browser bar.
zh: ~s~点击「查看邮箱」字样或导航栏的信封图标打开你的邮箱。

english: ~s~This is your Email Inbox. Your Inbox lists all the emails you have received.
zh: ~s~这是你的收件箱。你的收件箱中会显示你收到的所有邮件。

english: ~s~To logout of the computer press ~INPUT_PICKUP~, ~CANCEL~, or click the "LOGOUT" icon on the desktop.
zh: ~s~按下~INPUT_PICKUP~或~CANCEL~，或是点击桌面右下角的「LOGOUT」 图标以从本机注销。

english: ~s~From here you can access your email, view news, weather, dating websites, etc....
zh: ~s~你可以从这里访问邮箱，查看新闻、天气、交友网站...

english: ~s~From here you can access your email, view news, weather, dating websites, etc....
zh: ~s~你可以从这里访问邮箱，查看新闻、天气、交友网站...

english: ~s~Click the "CHECK MAIL" link to view your mailbox or the envelope icon on the browser bar.
zh: ~s~点击「查看邮箱」字样或导航栏的信封图标打开你的邮箱。

english: ~s~To logout of the computer press ~INPUT_PICKUP~, ~INPUT_FRONTEND_PAUSE~, or click the "LOGOUT" icon on the desktop.
zh: ~s~按下~INPUT_PICKUP~或~INPUT_FRONTEND_PAUSE~，或是点击桌面右下角的「LOGOUT」图标以从本机注销。

english: Sleeping on the bed will save the game and advance time by six hours.
zh: 上床睡觉会保存游戏进度，并将时间推进6个小时。

english: The flashing ~BLIP_29~ on the radar shows the entrance to this apartment. You can save the game here.
zh: 小地图上闪烁的~BLIP_29~表示这间公寓的入口。你可以在这里保存游戏进度。

english: ~z~The Patriot got liberated from its temporary owners. It's in the lockup now, man.
zh: ~z~那辆爱国者从他的原主人地方解脱了。现在在车库里，兄弟。

english: ~z~Alright man, wanted to let you know that I'm not going to be able to get the bike.
zh: ~z~好吧兄弟，我打过来就是知会你一声，车送不到了。

english: ~z~Thanks, Brucie. Let me know if there's something else you need.
zh: ~z~谢了，布鲁斯。要是还有什么想要的，就知会我一声。

english: ~z~This lady had a hard night. Go looking somewhere else for what you need.
zh: ~z~这妞今晚已经够累了，去别处找你想要的东西吧。

english: ~z~Okay, I'm going to tell Brucie. I think we were going to go out hunting for titties later anyway.
zh: ~z~好吧，我去跟布鲁斯讲。反正我们本来也打算晚点去泡妞的。

english: ~z~No, he can take care of that all by himself. Brucie is a major motor head.
zh: ~z~不是，那点事他自己就能办好。布鲁斯是个汽车贩子。

english: ~z~He going to pay me to pump him full of steroids and tell him how great his abs are?
zh: ~z~他是要付我钱让我给他打类固醇，再跟他吹他的腹肌有多猛吗？

english: ~z~Alright then, man. Tell me if there's something else you want.
zh: ~z~那就这样吧，兄弟。还有什么想要的就跟我说一声。

english: ~z~Hell - yeah NB! Take that shit, just like we take the bitches we want in the clubs!
zh: ~z~太他妈棒了，NB！拿去吧，就像我们在夜总会选婊子一样！

english: ~z~Brucie will pay good for this, Niko. He loves spending money. I'll tell him the news.
zh: ~z~布鲁斯会开个好价钱的，尼克。他就喜欢花钱。这好消息我会告诉他的。

english: ~z~You're a fuckin alpha male man, you take what you need, and I love it!
zh: ~z~你老哥可真他妈猛啊，你要的你拿走，我爱死它了！

english: ~z~Good, Niko. I bet you receive a big man hug when Brucie next sees you. You're a lucky guy.
zh: ~z~很好，尼克。我猜下次布鲁斯见着你准会给你一个大男人的拥抱。你可真走运。

english: ~z~Okay Brucie, I get the point. Tell me if you need something else.
zh: ~z~好了，布鲁斯，到地方了。你要是需要别的什么就跟我说。

english: ~z~That's one way of putting it, Brucie. Tell me if you want something else.
zh: ~z~这么说也行吧，布鲁斯。你要是还想要别的就跟我讲。

english: ~z~I'm going to let Brucie know. Here's hoping he's not too juiced on testosterone from bull sharks.
zh: ~z~我会跟布鲁斯讲的。只能希望他牛鲨睾酮嗑得不是太多了吧。

english: ~z~He going to pay me to pump him full of steroids and tell him how great his abs are?
zh: ~z~他是要付我钱让我给他打类固醇，再跟他吹他的腹肌有多猛吗？

english: ~z~You make that shit look easy baby, you're a fuckin' animal!
zh: ~z~你好像很轻松就搞到手了啊，宝贝，你丫他妈就是头猛兽！

english: ~z~Man, this is bullshit. The bike is ruined. I'm not going to be able to get it to the lockup.
zh: ~z~哥们，太糟了。摩托毁了，没法送到你车库里了。

english: ~z~Chill the hell out, Brucie. It isn't a big deal. Let me know if you want something else.
zh: ~z~你丫冷静点，布鲁斯。没什么大不了的。你要想要别的就跟我说。

english: ~z~Ummm, sure Brucie... sure. Just let me know if you want another thing.
zh: ~z~呃，行吧，布鲁斯...行吧。你要是还想要别的就跟我说一声。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. Brucie might start to like you more than he likes himself, and that's saying something.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。布鲁斯说不定爱你都要爱过他自己了，这什么意思就不用我说了吧。

english: ~z~Brucie will not be happy, but what the fuck. He'll just look in the mirror and forget about everything else in the world.
zh: ~z~布鲁斯不会高兴的，不过去他的吧。他只要看看镜子就会把剩下的事情都给忘了的。

english: ~z~All good, Niko. Not everyone can be as perfect as Brucie's abs. Can you believe he actually said that to me the other day?
zh: ~z~挺好的，尼克。不是所有人都能像布鲁斯的腹肌一样完美的。你敢信之前他跟我说过这种话吗？

english: ~z~I ain't in the mood for no more nothing tonight. No matter how much you planning on paying me.
zh: ~z~今晚我没心情做别的了。你再付我多少钱都不干。

english: ~z~I think that you and me are going to be Brucie's two favorite immigrants in this city. Good, cousin.
zh: ~z~我觉得咱俩都快成布鲁斯在这里最喜欢的移民了。很好，堂弟。

english: ~z~No, he can take care of that all by himself. Brucie is a major motor head.
zh: ~z~不是，那点事他自己就能办好。布鲁斯是个汽车贩子。

english: ~z~Look at you, Niko. I'm proud that you're doing so good for Brucie.
zh: ~z~瞧瞧你，尼克。你替布鲁斯干得这么好，我很骄傲。

english: ~z~He's going to send you emails about all the cars he wants and you're going to get them for him.
zh: ~z~他会发邮件告知你他想要的车，然后你就去帮他弄来。

english: ~z~Be cool, Brucie. It's not a big deal. Let me know if you need anything else.
zh: ~z~冷静点，布鲁斯。没什么大不了的。你要是还想要别的就跟我说。

english: ~z~Brucie's going to be real happy. Thanks, Niko. I'll tell him.
zh: ~z~布鲁斯会很高兴的。谢了，尼克。我会告诉他的。

english: ~z~If you keep doing this good then Brucie might start asking you to lift weights with him. Watch out.
zh: ~z~你要是能一直干得这么好，说不定布鲁斯还会叫你跟他一起举重。自己小心。

english: ~z~I'd like to see you try an take one of my cars NB, not a fuckin chance baby!
zh: ~z~我倒是想见识下你偷一辆我的车，NB。不过这连门都没有宝贝！

english: ~z~Brucie. Are your balls okay? You're sounding really angry. Tell me if there's another thing you need.
zh: ~z~布鲁斯，你的蛋还好吗？你听上去好像很生气。要是你还要别的就告诉我。

english: ~z~He's going to send you emails about all the cars he wants and you're going to get them for him.
zh: ~z~他会发邮件告知你他想要的车，然后你就去帮他弄来。

english: ~z~The Sanchez is now in the lockup, man. It's a fun little bike.
zh: ~z~那辆桑切斯已经在车库里了，兄弟。这小车挺有趣的。

english: ~z~Shit Niko, your car skills, and my body, people are gonna be petrified of us!
zh: ~z~操，尼克，你这车技，我这形体，别人都得被我们吓尿了！

english: ~z~Alright man, thought I should let you know that I couldn't get the car. It's not going in the lockup.
zh: ~z~好吧兄弟，我是该让你知道这车我弄不到。不会送到你车库里了。

english: ~z~Yeah, Brucie, whatever. Tell me if there's another thing you need.
zh: ~z~行了，布鲁斯，随便吧。你要是想要别的就直说。

english: ~z~Sure Brucie, I'm going to assume that's the steroids talking. If you want something else, let me know.
zh: ~z~行，布鲁斯，我就当这是你药嗑多了说出来的话。你要是想要别的，告诉我就成。

english: ~z~Hey, Brucie. You've got that 'roid rage pretty bad. Let me know if you want anything else.
zh: ~z~嘿，布鲁斯。你嗑药后的暴怒有点厉害了。要是还想要别的就跟我说一声。

english: ~z~Hey, I'm sorry but I couldn't get the car, it's not going in the lockup.
zh: ~z~喂，我很抱歉，不过这车我弄不到，不会送到你车库里了。

english: ~z~Great, Brucie. If you need another thing, tell me.
zh: ~z~好的，布鲁斯。你要是还想要别的，跟我说一声。

english: ~z~Cool, Niko. Thanks for telling me. I'm sure Brucie will be cool.
zh: ~z~酷哦，尼克。多谢你告诉我。我想布鲁斯会很冷静的。

english: ~z~Maybe you've had too much juice Brucie. Tell me if you want something else.
zh: ~z~你药可能嗑得有点多了，布鲁斯。要是想要别的就跟我说一声。

english: ~z~Brucie's going to be upset. He's a bit of a child like that. I'll let him know.
zh: ~z~布鲁斯会很伤心的，他就是那么个孩子。我会告诉他的。

english: ~z~Alright man, hate to say this but the car is real messed up. It ain't gonna be delivered.
zh: ~z~好吧兄弟，我也不想这样的，不过这车现在是真废了。不会送来了。

english: ~z~Don't you pay attention to who has your cars? I've already got one. I'll go right there.
zh: ~z~你都不知道自己的车在谁手里么？车我开着呢，这就上路。

english: ~z~I really appreciate this, cousin. If you want any more work you've got my number.
zh: ~z~我很感激，堂弟。你要是还想接单，直接打给我。

english: ~z~Shit Roman, don't mean to let you down but I can't handle that fare for you. Hope that's cool?
zh: ~z~我操，罗曼，我也不想让你失望，不过这单我去不成了。希望不会有事吧？

english: ~z~Great, Niko. Thanks. If you want more fares just call.
zh: ~z~很好，尼克。谢了。要是你还想接单，打电话找我。

english: ~z~This is tough luck, NB. No one is calling for cabs. I don't know what's wrong.
zh: ~z~时运不齐啊，NB。现在没人叫车。我也不知道怎么回事。

english: ~z~I guess this could not be helped. Call me if you want another fare.
zh: ~z~我是在想这次你可能帮不上忙。想再接单就打给我。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. That's too bad. Call me soon if you want another try.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。关系不是很大。你要是想再试试的话就打给我。

english: ~z~Hey cousin, have you got any fares that need picking up?
zh: ~z~喂，堂兄啊，你那儿有没有什么客人需要我去接的？

english: ~z~Niko, you are doing Bellic Enterprises proud. Come get a cab from the depot.
zh: ~z~尼克，你要给贝利克集团长脸啊。来车行拿辆车。

english: ~z~Sure, I've got a fare for you, but you need to get this one where they're going.
zh: ~z~当然了，是有单子给你，不过这回你可得把人送到喽。

english: ~z~Just call me whenever you want to take a fare. You can do as many as you like, Niko.
zh: ~z~等你想接单了就打给我。你想接几单接几单，尼克。

english: ~z~I would only love you more if you had titties, Niko! Come get a cab from the depot.
zh: ~z~要是你有胸我就更爱你了，尼克！来车行拿辆车。

english: ~z~You can collect a cab from the depot, but Niko, you should know that you messing these fares up is really bad for business.
zh: ~z~你可以去车行拿车，不过尼克，你要知道你的恶劣行为会影响公司名誉。

english: ~z~I couldn't get them there, Roman. I hope this fuck up doesn't affect your business.
zh: ~z~人我没能送到，罗曼。希望我这次搞砸不会影响你的生意。

english: ~z~I've let Bellic Enterprises down, I couldn't complete the fare. Sorry.
zh: ~z~我让贝利克集团失望了，我没能完成任务。抱歉。

english: ~z~You are truly a Bellic, thank you cousin. Speak soon.
zh: ~z~真不愧是贝利克家的人，谢谢你，堂弟。有空再联系。

english: ~z~Sure, you can come get a cab from the depot - if you promise to do this right?
zh: ~z~当然，你可以来车行拿车，只要你确保这次不乱搞就成。

english: ~z~Cousin, I just sent out my last cab, I'm sorry. Maybe if you try later.
zh: ~z~堂弟，我刚把最后一辆车派出去，不好意思。要么你待会儿再问吧。

english: ~z~Roman, I'm doing my bit for Bellic Enterprises. Does anyone need to be picked up?
zh: ~z~罗曼，我想给贝利克集团尽一份力。有没有需要我去接的人？

english: ~z~This is not so good for Bellic Enterprises. Call again if you want to help the family company.
zh: ~z~这对贝利克集团可不太好。你要是想帮家里开的公司就再打给我。

english: ~z~Sorry Roman, but something went wrong with the fare. I couldn't get them there.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼，不过这单出了点岔子。我没能把他们送到地方。

english: ~z~Niko, you make my life so much easier. Thank you. Call me if you want more work.
zh: ~z~尼克，有你在我日子轻松多了。谢谢你。还想接单就打过来。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. No one is looking for cabs at the moment. Call later.
zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克。现在还没人叫车。待会儿再打过来吧。

english: ~z~Roman, come on, I have a car already. I will go straight to get them.
zh: ~z~罗曼，别这样，车我已经有了。我可以直接去接人。

english: ~z~You are truly a Bellic, thank you cousin. Speak soon.
zh: ~z~真不愧是贝利克家的人，谢谢你，堂弟。有空再联系。

english: ~z~Just call me whenever you want to take a fare. You can do as many as you like, Niko.
zh: ~z~等你想接单了就打给我。你想接几单接几单，尼克。

english: ~z~~x~Arise! Arise! Yes, there! There! Higher! Higher! Lower! Higher! Lower!
zh: ~z~~x~上升！上升！就是这样，对！对！高点！高点！低点！高点！低点！

english: ~z~~x~and you realize that day your dad disappeared he didn't leave your mom for the fat bitch at the gas station.
zh: ~z~~x~你才意识到那天你爸失踪不是抛下你妈跟加油站的胖娘们跑了。

english: ~z~~x~Yeah, play it, Al. Play it. Al's the fine piano player.
zh: ~z~~x~对，接着弹，阿尔。接着弹。阿尔就是这位优秀的钢琴师。

english: ~z~~x~Pre-recorded because his union got a little mouthy and greedy so we sing to his CD now.
zh: ~z~~x~因为他的工会和我们起了点矛盾，所以现在我们只能播预先录制的CD了。

english: ~z~~x~He was abducted. And your captors put you down in a farm field late at night somewhere in Iowa.
zh: ~z~~x~他被拐走了。拐走你们的人又把你们放了，放在了深夜爱荷华的一片田间。

english: ~z~~x~And then you grab a bottle of gin down from the dusty cupboard where you put it
zh: ~z~~x~然后你就从满是灰尘的橱柜里拿了一瓶之前放进的酒。

english: ~z~~x~One man even asked me, "Can you make my masculinity disappear?"
zh: ~z~~x~甚至还有男人问我：「你能不能让我的阳刚之气消失？」

english: ~z~~x~Ah yes, I can make this filthy woman fall under my dominion. Oh, arise! Yes!
zh: ~z~~x~啊，没错，我可以让这个贱女人在我的支配下堕落。噢，上升！对！

english: ~z~~x~ I am constantly asked, "Kleinman, when did you discover you were magic?
zh: ~z~~x~我经常被人这么问：「克莱因曼，你是什么时候发现你会魔法的？」

english: ~z~~x~I have a little song I want to share with you. It's about something that's happened to us all.
zh: ~z~~x~我有一支小曲想分享给你们。是关于一些大家都经历过的事的。

english: ~z~~x~Now let's hear it for Ms Bluesy St. John!
zh: ~z~~x~接下来让我们倾听Bluesy St. John小姐的演唱吧！

english: ~z~~x~No, no, I'm not talking about getting sandwiched by two Lebanese train porters in the caboose.
zh: ~z~~x~不，不，我要说的不是在职工车厢被两个黎巴嫩搬运工做成夹心饼干的事。

english: ~z~~x~Oh, Laurel, you're... oh, you're a quadraplegic!
zh: ~z~~x~噢，劳雷尔，你是要...噢，你是要四肢瘫痪了啊！

english: ~z~~x~Or makes you a little girl, even when you're a little boy.
zh: ~z~~x~或者让你成了个小女孩，就算你是小男孩也不例外。

english: ~z~~x~which leaves you time for more important things like watching sports and playing video games. Right, Laurel?
zh: ~z~~x~也就节约了你们宝贵的时间，可以做些更要紧的事，比如看球赛和打电玩。对吧，劳雷尔？

english: ~z~~x~Ooh, I'm feeling pretty hot tonight. Yeah, you're looking good out there.
zh: ~z~~x~呼，今晚我感觉浑身燥热。耶，你们看着都挺好。

english: ~z~~x~Like someone's been putting cigarettes out on your back and slapping you across the face as the sun sets.
zh: ~z~~x~像是有人用烟头烫你的背，随着落日照着你脸呼巴掌。

english: ~z~~x~And now, our next act is a Perestroika favorite, the Incredible Kleinman!
zh: ~z~~x~那么，接下来的一个节目是Perestroika各位的最爱，不可思议的——克莱因曼！

english: ~z~~x~I'm talking about you try sleeping with your husband's brother but it don't help.
zh: ~z~~x~我要说的是你试着睡了你老公的兄弟，结果俩人没差。

english: ~z~~x~Hello! Hello! There have been many great magicians throughout time.
zh: ~z~~x~你们好！你们好！在时间长河中有许多伟大的魔术师。

english: ~z~~x~So, you decide it's time to make a change. And it goes a little something like this.
zh: ~z~~x~于是你觉得是时候改变了。接着就发生了些这样的事。

english: ~z~~x~You envy the man that can make his woman levitate, as it's fantastic in the bedroom,
zh: ~z~~x~你们眼红那个人能让他的女人漂浮悬空，因为这样在卧室里爽得不行。

english: ~z~~x~Laurel, oh! Stop acting. Stop pretending. Oh, yes, yes. Oh, does it hurt?
zh: ~z~~x~劳雷尔，噢！别演了，别装了。噢，好，好。噢，痛不痛？

english: ~z~~x~Maybe it's that disgusting stagehand you've been trolloping about with...
zh: ~z~~x~可能是那个你们一直在婊的那个垃圾道具师的锅...

english: ~z~~x~Okay, we keep on theme of throwing knives with... the Incredible Kleinman!
zh: ~z~~x~好了，接下来是同一主题的投飞刀，有请...不可思议的克莱因曼！

english: ~z~~x~Please don't try this at home. It's Catch! He juggles barbeque tools!
zh: ~z~~x~请不要在家里模仿。接下来是凯奇！这次他要抛的是烧烤工具！

english: ~z~~x~We were very close once, Laurel and I, until she became an anorexic,
zh: ~z~~x~我们有一次很险，劳雷尔和我，搞得她得了厌食。

english: ~z~~x~My filthy assistant is strapped to this wall and I will take her to within a razor's edge of her life.
zh: ~z~~x~我的贱人助手已经绑在了板上，而我将要带她去鬼门关走一圈。

english: ~z~~x~Oooh Laurel, don't be afraid. You have nothing to fear. You're in the hands of the gods!
zh: ~z~~x~喔哦劳雷尔，别害怕。没什么好怕的。你可是天选之人啊！

english: ~z~~x~I have trained with black ops delta forces and throw knives with phenomenal skill.
zh: ~z~~x~我已经接受了黑色行动三角洲部队的训练，掌握了神乎其技的飞刀技术。

english: ~z~~x~the will to suspend belief and hypnotize is not just the work of bitches and politicians.
zh: ~z~~x~让人抛开信仰、迷失自我可不是婊子和政客的专利。

english: ~z~~x~Some people say I'm demonic or have supernatural powers or that I urinate fire -
zh: ~z~~x~有的人说我是魔鬼，有的人说是有超能力，还有人说我拉尿鸡巴冒火。

english: ~z~~x~And a year goes by and you're spending Thursday nights at a religious séance chanting Kifflom
zh: ~z~~x~一年以后，每个周四晚上你都在宗教降灵会上歌颂Kifflom。

english: ~z~~x~You meet a gal named Maggie who fancies herself a fingersmith of all trades.
zh: ~z~~x~你碰上了一个妹子叫玛吉，她自称是手上的活儿都很好。

english: ~z~~x~at your hospital bed and you're disgusted - you're a dog without a phone.
zh: ~z~~x~自己在病床上，你突然就厌恶了。没了手机你就是条狗。

english: ~z~~x~and in purdah and all you can think about is that cheerleader in high school,
zh: ~z~~x~还被雪藏深闺，你想着的一直都还是高中时参加的啦啦队。

english: ~z~~x~I'm gonna throw out a whole bunch of trite blues expressions right now for y'all. You ready?
zh: ~z~~x~马上就要给你们甩出一堆忧郁情绪了。准备好了吗？

english: ~z~~x~You know, I'm so sorry, everybody. I don't know what the hell I'm singing about.
zh: ~z~~x~我也很抱歉，各位。不知道自己唱了些什么玩意。

english: ~z~~x~and your car skidded off the road, and you was up the creek,
zh: ~z~~x~然后你的车打滑滑下了路，爬起来发现自己在沟里，

english: ~z~~x~Time for depressing song with Ms. Bluesy St. John.
zh: ~z~~x~接下来该是Bluesy St. John小姐的忧郁歌声时间了。

english: ~z~~x~We're gonna take it down right now, talk about something that's happened to us all.
zh: ~z~~x~现在就要稍微压抑一点了，讲点大家都经历过的事。

english: ~z~~x~This is a story about my best friend. we met in a truckstop... bathroom.
zh: ~z~~x~这个故事是讲我的挚友的。我们遇见彼此，是在一个服务区...的浴室。

english: ~z~~x~Perestroika! Put lips together for Incredible Kleinman!
zh: ~z~~x~Perestroika！各位可别惊掉了下巴，接下来是不可思议的克莱因曼！

english: ~z~~x~And speaking of which, please welcome...my lovely assistant, the lovely Laurel.
zh: ~z~~x~那么接下来就有请...我美丽的助手，美丽的劳雷尔。

english: ~z~~x~like a woman with an eeee-ahhh and a zing-zing, if you know what I mean.
zh: ~z~~x~就像一个长着咿－啊和金金的女人，懂我意思吧。

english: ~z~~x~She's sexiest junky in Hove Beach. Ms Bluesy St. John!
zh: ~z~~x~她就是霍夫海滩最性感的废人。Bluesy St. John小姐！

english: ~z~~x~Taking apart your washing machine or your TV or picking the carpet for a little piece.
zh: ~z~~x~拆了你的洗碗机或者电视机，地毯的话就撕成小碎块。

english: ~z~~x~Yes, that's happened to me before. You see, I have cheated death my whole life!
zh: ~z~~x~是的，之前我就遇到过这种事。你看，我这辈子都在欺骗死神！

english: ~z~~x~or if they do they find that being treated like a toilet is not as fun as it sounds.
zh: ~z~~x~就算努力，也只会发现被当便器也没听着那么有趣。

english: ~z~~x~Laurel, lock me in and do your worst! I am not afraid! Kids, do not try this at home.
zh: ~z~~x~劳雷尔，把我锁进去，下手狠点！我可不怕！孩子们，别在家里模仿！

english: ~z~~x~I can make love like a unicorn or fly on a carpet like an ape.
zh: ~z~~x~我可以像独角兽一样做爱，也能像猴子一样骑上飞毯。

english: ~z~~x~Everybody, please calm down! Don't leave! Wow, is terrible smell of burning person.
zh: ~z~~x~各位，请冷静！别走！哇哦，烧人的味道真糟糕。

english: ~z~~x~If you don't try, you can't fail. So, tonight I will crawl into this box and cheat death!
zh: ~z~~x~要是你没试过，也就不会失败。所以今晚我将进入这个箱子，欺骗死神！

english: ~z~~x~Welcome best magician in Hove Beach, Incredible Kleinman!
zh: ~z~~x~欢迎霍夫海滩最厉害的魔术师，不可思议的克莱因曼！

english: ~z~~x~Well, I went down to Mississippi. Yeah. Mississippi... you been there?
zh: ~z~~x~接着我去了密西西比。耶，密西西比...你们去过吗？

english: ~z~~x~Impossible? Yes - but it can be done. Laurel, ready the pistol.
zh: ~z~~x~不可能吗？是的，但可以做到。劳雷尔，准备好手枪。

english: ~z~~x~Ms Bluesy St. John! No touching self in the audience, please.
zh: ~z~~x~Bluesy St. John小姐！请不要在观众席自摸，谢谢。

english: ~z~~x~She will take this pistol and fire it at me and I will catch the bullet with my teeth!
zh: ~z~~x~她将用这把手枪对我开火，而我将会用牙齿接住子弹！

english: ~z~~x~Now, welcome to Perestroika stage, Incredible Kleinman!
zh: ~z~~x~现在，欢迎来到Perestroika的舞台，不可思议的克莱因曼！

english: ~z~~x~I medicate. I medicate. Thank you, you all. You all have been great.
zh: ~z~~x~我嗑药，我嗑药。谢谢你们，在座各位。你们都很棒。

english: ~z~~x~It's like four guys all playing a different song and you're right in the middle feeling slightly confused,
zh: ~z~~x~就像四个人演奏不同的歌曲，你在正中间有点懵逼，

english: ~z~~x~But my pill is orange, and the pharmacy ran out, and my anxiety came back.
zh: ~z~~x~但我的药是橙色的，药箱里也没了，我又开始焦虑了。

english: ~z~~x~How you all doing tonight? Yeah, yeah. Me, I'm doing great. Just great.
zh: ~z~~x~今晚你们都如何？耶，耶。我，我挺好的。挺好。

english: ~z~~x~Well, I'm a soccer mom with bad nerves, and my kid is going to fail, and my garden ain't pretty enough,
zh: ~z~~x~好吧，我是个坏脾气的足球妈妈，我的孩子注定失败，我的花园也不够漂亮。

english: ~z~~x~so I went to the shop and got me a gun and shot this other soccer mom in the head for laughing at my SUV,
zh: ~z~~x~于是我就去商店买了把枪，对着另一个足球妈妈的头就来了一发，谁让她嘲笑我的SUV，

english: ~z~~x~That's because, like most Americans, ladies and gentlemen, I medicate.
zh: ~z~~x~因为和大多数美国人一样，女士先生们，我也嗑药。

english: ~z~~x~Because I don't feel no pain, thanks to my pills. I feel fine, fine, fine.
zh: ~z~~x~因为我感觉不到痛，全靠我的药片。我感觉很好，很好，很好。

english: ~z~~x~~c~Are you ready for this?~s~ Here comes Ms Bluesy St. John!
zh: ~z~~x~~c~你们准备好了吗？~s~接下来是Bluesy St. John小姐！

english: ~z~~x~They are what make us American. They are our best friends and our worst enemies... shit!
zh: ~z~~x~有了它我们才是美国人。它是我们最好的朋友，也是我们最糟的敌人...操！

english: ~z~~x~You ready for some modern blues? How about a little jazz? I love jazz.
zh: ~z~~x~准备好来点现代蓝调了吗？要不要来点爵士？我爱爵士。

english: ~z~~x~You know when your heart gets turned inside out and you feel like you're going to die?
zh: ~z~~x~你们知道心脏里面给人翻出来感觉就像是要死了吗？

english: ~z~~x~Well, I used to do the hard shit, but now it's a prescription, baby. A prescription.
zh: ~z~~x~好吧，以前我也弄不着，但现在我有处方，宝贝。处方药。

english: ~z~~x~Well, that's the blues. That's the blues, yeah. Suburban homicide. You feeling me, ladies and gentlemen?
zh: ~z~~x~好吧，这就是蓝调。这就是蓝调，耶。郊区凶杀案。感受到了吗，女士们先生们？

english: ~s~You left ~b~Packie,~s~ ~b~Michael,~s~ and ~b~Gordon~s~ behind, go back and get them.
zh: ~s~你把~b~派奇~s~、~b~迈克尔~s~和~b~戈登~s~落下了，回去带上他们。

english: You can use the police computer to search the police database or view any active reported crimes in the area.
zh: 你可以使用警用电脑搜索警方数据库，或查看本区内任何已报告的且正在活动的犯罪。

english: Enter search name using the on-screen keyboard, or any attached keyboard device.
zh: 使用屏幕上的键盘或任何已连接的键盘设备来输入要搜索的姓名。

english: ~z~It's great to see you Alejandra, but I have things to do online.
zh: ~z~很高兴见到你，亚历杭德拉。但我上网有事要做。

english: ~z~No, Alejandra, it wouldn't be the same without you working here.
zh: ~z~不，亚历杭德拉，要是你不在这儿工作，这里就不一样了。

english: ~z~Niko, I hope you've come back because of me, not just these stupid computers.
zh: ~z~尼克，我希望你是为我才回来的，而不是为那些白痴电脑。

english: ~z~Niko, you're back. I was thinking, you do not even know my name. I am Alejandra.
zh: ~z~尼克，你回来了。我之前在想，你连我叫什么都不知道。我是亚历杭德拉。

english: The N.O.O.S.E. team have the bottom of the apartment covered, you'll need to escape via the ~y~roof.
zh: N.O.O.S.E. 小组已经包围了公寓的底楼，你需要从~y~屋顶逃走。

english: ~z~Big Vlad and his protection money, I so scared. What I need protection from?
zh: ~z~弗拉德大佬和他的保护费，好怕怕哦。我这儿要什么保护？

english: ~z~You think this door is going to save your shop? There's shit I can break out here.
zh: ~z~你以为靠这扇门就能保住你的店了？我在外面也能砸了你的店。

english: ~z~Hey yokel, you manage to do the job? Get Vlad his money?
zh: ~z~嘿，乡巴佬，事办成了没？弗拉德的钱收来了没？

english: ~z~If you give a shit about your fatty cousin's debt then I've got some more work for you.
zh: ~z~你要是还替你胖子堂兄欠的账着想，我这还有活给你。

english: ~z~Big Vlad and his protection money, I so scared. What I need protection from?
zh: ~z~弗拉德大佬和他的保护费，好怕怕哦。我这儿要什么保护？

english: ~z~You're deaf as well as stupid. That's good to know, yokel. I said scare him, don't hurt him.
zh: ~z~你这人真是又聋又蠢。很高兴知道这个，乡巴佬。我说了是吓吓他，不是打伤他。

english: ~z~Hey, don't hurt me. Vlad say you too stupid to understand his orders.
zh: ~z~喂，别伤着我。弗拉德都说你蠢到听不懂他的命令。

english: ~z~Take this bottle of Cherenkov. Say you're sorry and you won't do it again.
zh: ~z~拿上这瓶契连科夫，告诉他你很抱歉，下次不会了。

english: ~z~For the record, I don't take orders from Vlad. I'm just doing a favor for my cousin.
zh: ~z~事先声明，我不听弗拉德指挥。我只是帮我堂兄个忙。

english: ~z~You know what, Vlad. I wanted that vodka all to myself, so I got rid of the shop owner.
zh: ~z~想不到吧，弗拉德。我想独占那瓶伏特加，就把那个店老板做掉了。

english: ~z~Stupid jerk made a mistake of telling me how much he gets that shit for back east.
zh: ~z~那个傻逼错在告诉我那些玩意在东方才值多少钱。

english: ~z~Cousin... Niko... that's it, Niko... not big mouth prick. You funny guy.
zh: ~z~堂弟...尼克...对了，尼克...不是大嘴屌人。真会开玩笑。

english: ~z~He's the biggest crook in the neighborhood. Lucky I don't tell his customers what they're paying for.
zh: ~z~他是这一带最大的骗子。我没告诉别人他卖的都是什么已经算他走运了。

english: ~z~Shit. Here. I thought Vlad and I had understanding?
zh: ~z~靠，拿去。我还以为弗拉德和我已经相互理解了。

english: ~z~You pathetic halfwit, what if I decide to get rid of your cousin when I next pay him a visit. Shit.
zh: ~z~你个可悲的笨蛋，那要是我下次去拜访你堂兄的时候把他做掉怎么样。操。

english: ~z~Vlad should pay me to tell punks like you to go away. He get no money.
zh: ~z~弗拉德该付我钱好赶走你这样的小混混。他一分钱都别想拿。

english: ~z~I spoke to the Laundromat owner. He gets the message. He will pay you now.
zh: ~z~我跟洗衣店老板说了。他已经知道了，会给你交钱的。

english: ~z~Go on. Do what you gotta do. But remember, you see a cop... you don't know me.
zh: ~z~去吧，做你该做的事。不过记住，要是见着警察了...你不认识我。

english: ~z~You will be getting the money to him soon, or your wife shall be using your washing machines to get blood out of your clothes.
zh: ~z~赶紧把钱交上，不然你老婆就得拿店里的洗衣机洗你衣服上的血了。

english: ~z~I hope you didn't kill him, I hope he choked on some detergent or something?
zh: ~z~希望你没杀了他，他是不是给什么洗涤剂呛着了？

english: ~z~I hope you didn't kill him, I hope he choked on some detergent or something?
zh: ~z~希望你没杀了他，他是不是给什么洗涤剂呛着了？

english: ~z~Fuck it. This is a lesson to every other fuck head who thinks he is too clever to pay me.
zh: ~z~去他妈的。这是给那些自作聪明不付我钱的猪头的教训。

english: ~z~He's going to be the problem buzzing in my ears now. Dipshit!
zh: ~z~现在他这问题要一直在我耳边嗡嗡响 了。傻逼！

english: ~z~Muscovski jerk who owns a laundry on Masterson Street.
zh: ~z~混蛋穆斯科夫斯基，他在马斯特森街开了家洗衣店。

english: ~z~Okay, you want me to ram you? I'll ram you off the road.
zh: ~z~行，那你是想让我撞你喽？我会把你撞下马路的。

english: ~z~Hey, Mallorie. Tell fatty his cousin is okay... he just walked in.
zh: ~z~嘿，玛洛丽。告诉胖子他堂弟没事...他刚走进来。

english: ~z~Hey, Vlad. The car you wanted, it's... how you say? Fucked.
zh: ~z~喂，弗拉德。你要的车它...用你的话咋说来着？被搞烂了。

english: ~z~I know your cousins like them dirty. Maybe your whole yokel family drive around in their dirty cars but it's not the way over here.
zh: ~z~我知道你们两兄弟喜欢车子脏点。可能你们乡巴佬家族也都喜欢脏点的车，在这里可没这回事。

english: ~z~No... I had a late night last night. Spent it with Mikhail.
zh: ~z~不是...昨晚我睡得有点晚，和米哈伊尔一起过的。

english: ~z~Mikhail's the man... shit my nose is bleeding. Is my nose bleeding?
zh: ~z~米哈伊尔就是那个...干，流鼻血了。我是不是流鼻血了？

english: ~z~It's a silver Blista, and it's parked in the projects by E.I.C. subway station, okay?
zh: ~z~是辆银色的Blista，停在东岛城地铁站旁边的公屋社区，懂了？

english: ~z~Asshole owes Mikhail some money. Take his car instead, eh?
zh: ~z~那混蛋还欠米哈伊尔钱，先拿他的车顶着，懂了？

english: ~z~Man, where do these people get off? Like I'm gonna pay for their drug habits?
zh: ~z~天，这些人都是哪来的？搞得跟我会每天请他们吸毒一样？

english: ~z~You not as stupid as you look, yokel. Come back to see me at the bar soon.
zh: ~z~你也没看起来那么蠢，乡巴佬。之后再来酒吧找我。

english: ~z~Because of your cousin owing me a lot of money and until he pays me, your fresh off the boat yokel ass is mine.
zh: ~z~因为你堂兄还欠着我一屁股债。他不还清，你这刚下船的小逼乡巴佬就是我的人。

english: ~z~No, you're gonna take the train, buddy. You think I wanna be in a car with a peasant?
zh: ~z~不是，你自己乘地铁去，伙计。你觉得我乐意和土包子坐一辆车吗？

english: ~z~There's a carwash over on Saratoga Avenue. Just take it over there and then to my lockup just off Mohawk.
zh: ~z~萨拉托加大道上有家洗车店，先去那边洗个车再开回我在莫霍克的车库。

english: ~z~I have your new car, Vlad. It's not pretty though, real dirty.
zh: ~z~你的新车我开来了，弗拉德。就是不够漂亮，脏得很。

english: ~z~I hope you going to buy me dinner first, Vlad. I'm not that easy.
zh: ~z~那你先帮我把晚饭买了，弗拉德。我可没那么好打发。

english: ~z~Man, Mikhail gets the good stuff... it's got some laxative in it, though... gives you stomach problems.
zh: ~z~小子，米哈伊尔的货挺好...就是里面掺了点泻药...容易犯胃病。

english: ~z~Very funny... what would you say if I told you he was going to rob your cousin?
zh: ~z~真好笑...那要是我告诉你他要抢劫你的堂兄呢？

english: ~z~I'll stay out of Hove Beach. I'll be a ghost. I promise. Please!
zh: ~z~我会远离霍夫海滩，做一个幽灵。我保证。求你了。

english: ~z~If Vlad wants you dead, you can't be all bad. Stay out of Hove Beach.
zh: ~z~要是弗拉德想要你死，那你应该也不会太坏。以后离霍夫海滩远点。

english: ~z~I should have known you would screw this up. You are born loser, just like your cousin. Come see me sometime.
zh: ~z~我就知道你会搞砸的。你天生就是个失败者，和你堂兄一样。有空再来找我。

english: ~z~Vlad told me to go there. Let me go and I'll lay low.
zh: ~z~是弗拉德让我去那里的。放我走，我会低调做人的。

english: ~z~Hey, Vlad. I lost your boyfriend. He got away from me.
zh: ~z~嘿，弗拉德。你男朋友我跟丢了。他从我这逃了。

english: ~z~Fuck you. Say this to my face and I will break you.
zh: ~z~操你妈，你要是敢当我面说一次，我打爆你的狗头。

english: ~z~Because you don't have to deal with all their shit all day. Take Mallorie, for example...
zh: ~z~因为这样你就不用整天操心她们的破事了。就拿玛洛丽举个例子...

english: ~z~I wasn't sure about killing you when Vlad asked. Now I'm coming around to the idea.
zh: ~z~弗拉德让我杀你的时候我还不一定能下手，现在我改主意了。

english: ~z~Hey, you and your cousin's girlfriend should get together. She likes sticky finishes as well.
zh: ~z~嘿，那你真该和你堂兄的女友聚聚，她也喜欢黏稠的。

english: ~z~Fuck you. Say that to my face and I will break you.
zh: ~z~操你妈，你要是敢当我面说一次，我打爆你的狗头。

english: ~z~Ooh, that's funny. You know, for a dumb yokel, you're a very funny guy.
zh: ~z~喔，真好笑。作为一个蠢蛋乡巴佬，你还挺有趣的。

english: ~z~I knew we would understand each other, once I put it in this simple way.
zh: ~z~我就知道，只要把话说明白了，我们就能相互理解。

english: ~z~Get into the real America. You never gonna see me around here again.
zh: ~z~见识下真正的美国。你再也不会在这儿见到我了。

english: ~z~No, I mean underneath it... great... listen, I'll call you back, eh? Sorry.
zh: ~z~不是，再里面点...很好...听着，我之后再打过来，啊？不好意思。

english: ~z~Yes, and for an annoying dick, you're really an annoying dick.
zh: ~z~对，作为一个烦人的屌人，你还真是个烦人的屌人。

english: ~z~I owe you my life, man. You're a good man, you're a good man, thank you.
zh: ~z~我欠你一命，兄弟。你是个好人，真的是好人，谢谢你。

english: ~z~Well, it's a real shame, then, that I'm the guy with the powerful friends, and you're the little punk
zh: ~z~那还真是有够可惜，我是有人撑腰的腕儿，你就是个

english: ~z~Hey gorgeous, yeah where were we? Okay now listen, let's talk about tonight...
zh: ~z~嘿，小美人，我们讲到哪儿来着？好，听我说，我们先安排下今晚...

english: It's the TV show that has replicated into 18 identical TV shows set in different cities with the same plotlines and stunningly horrendous dialog. Punctuate your best Shory impression by taking your sunglasses on and off and spouting one liners like "Speed kills, and so do guns" or "Worlds collide because crime doesn't pay."
zh: 该节目被翻拍成了18个一模一样的节目，剧情没有变化，台词还是那么恶俗，只有背景城市不同。反复给你带上摘下墨镜，叨叨什么「速度能杀人，枪也能杀人」「犯罪零成本，世界会崩溃」，不断破坏你的观影体验。

english: The sound of million dollar bills being counted. People will think those are YOUR million dollar bills and then wonder why you're riding the bus like a loser.
zh: 百万美元大钞点钞时的音效。别人会认为这是你的百万钞票，然后想不明白你为什么会像个屌丝一样挤公交。

english: Nothing tells the people around you that you're a player like a high priced ringtone. You're about to find out what it's like to be a celebrity. Rich people know - your ringtone defines who you are and how much money you have so take bling to the next level with audio bling. Show the world how dope you are by blaring something unique.
zh: 除了高价铃声，还有什么能向身边的人突显你的地位？马上你就会知道什么才叫名流。富人有个共识－手机铃声会体现你的身份和财力，使得铃声也进入了饰品行列。响起独特的铃声，向世人展示你的不同。

english: Nothing says luxury like lesbians - women who are so taken by your manliness they can't help but make out. That's power. That's what being a VIP is all about.
zh: 没什么比女同更能代表奢华的了－女人们都为你的男子气概臣服，止不住地互搞。这就是力量。作为VIP的生活就是这样。

english: Only fools travel in first class. Show the world you're a man who loves to spend $60,000 on a $500 plane flight. Dope.
zh: 白痴才乘头等舱。告诉世人你是个乐意为$500一张票的航班花$60,000包机的人。大气。

english: The show that spawned a catchphrase "Bitch let's go!" is the #1 ringtone in the country. Show the world you are an individual by sporting the theme of the show where we get to judge women again.
zh: 全国最火铃声就是出自诞生流行语「贱人我们走！」的选秀节目的铃声。用重新审视女人的节目的主题曲，告诉人们你的与众不同。

english: Every time you get a call it will be like you are right in the movie! Imagine deleted scenes you wanted to see of elves fornicating with trolls, orcs ovulating, and dragons flying upside down. The Dragonbrain ringtone celebrates the movie that took America on a 4 hour journey to a land before time or sundials or basic critical faculties.
zh: 每一次响铃都是身临其境的体验！想象一下你想看的删节片段吧，精灵与侏儒通奸、兽人坐地排卵，还有倒着飞的巨龙。龙之脑铃声是对影片的赞颂，影片带美国进入了四小时的旅途，来到了没有圣光和是非观的史前大陆。

english: VIP Luxury Ringtones spent months at nursing homes trying to get just the right sound. This one is a favorite. Every time you get a call people will ask, "did you hear that? It's like an old woman just broke her hip." It's comedy that never gets old.
zh: VIP奢华铃声站花费数月时间，在疗养院精挑细选得到的音效。这款音效备受青睐。每当你接到电话的时候，别人就会问「听见了吗？好像有个老太婆屁股裂了。」这个笑话永远不会过时。

english: Get medieval every time your phone rings and celebrate the War on Terror the American way.
zh: 手机一响就能回到中世纪，用美国方式庆祝反恐战争。

english: The sparkle of diamonds is unmistakable - the sound is truly unbelievable. Show the world you're a real player with the tones of 5 karat rocks banging around.
zh: 钻石的闪光绝不会被听错－真的是令人难以置信的声音。用5克拉的钻石落地的声音告诉世界你的真实地位。

english: The sound that set the hip hop community on edge - recorded at the bedside of Trey Diggity as he died from a nasty Brazilian STD - this flatline has been sampled in over 125 top rated rap albums, which all sound the same these days anyway.
zh: 把嘻哈社群送上风口浪尖的音效－在特雷･迪吉蒂的病床边录制的，他死于某种巴西性病－该音效已经在至少125张高分Rap专辑中得到使用，搞得最近的专辑听起来都没啥区别。

english: What is it about the sound of champagne that says class? Not just an overpriced wine-seltzer that gives you a raging hangover, champagne can celebrate every phone call - even ones where you find out your house burnt down.
zh: 开香槟的音效是如何体现地位的？它不是只会给你留下剧烈宿醉的昂贵起泡酒，香槟能够庆祝每一次来电－通知你你家烧了的也是。

english: ~s~Hold ~INPUT_AIM~ to auto aim. Half hold ~INPUT_AIM~ to free aim. Use ~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~ to aim.
zh: ~s~按住~INPUT_AIM~可以自动瞄准，半按~INPUT_AIM~可以自由瞄准。使用~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~瞄准。

english: ~s~Press and release ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to throw. The longer you hold ~INPUT_ATTACK~ the further you will throw.
zh: ~s~按下~INPUT_ATTACK~后松开可以进行投掷。~INPUT_ATTACK~按得越久，扔得越远。

english: The envelope icon above the radar is displayed when you have a new text message. This will fade slightly when it is read.
zh: 小地图上方的信封图标表示你收到了短信，阅读后就会消失。

english: Trains can be used to travel large distances in a short time around the city.
zh: 各种列车可以让你在短时间内在城中进行远距离穿梭。

english: An icon with an upward pointing arrow indicates that the objective is above your current position, and an icon with a downward pointing arrow indicates that an objective is below you.
zh: 小地图中，带有向上箭头的圆点表示目标所处位置高于你，带有向下箭头的圆点表示目标所处位置低于你。

english: To perform a stun punch lock onto an enemy and approach them unarmed. When close enough the target reticule will change then press ~INPUT_MELEE_ATTACK1~ to perform the move.
zh: 要使用击晕，赤手锁定敌人并靠近。靠近敌人后按~INPUT_MELEE_ATTACK1~使出击晕。

english: You can surprise some enemies with a ~h~stun punch. ~s~This will knock them to the floor instantly. Stun punches can not be performed while in combat.
zh: 你可以使用~h~击晕~s~给敌人来一个突然袭击。~s~你的敌人会直接倒地。击晕无法在战斗中使用。

english: ~s~When an enemy's icon flashes between blue and red you have the choice between killing them and letting them live. Your decision could have repercussions.
zh: ~s~当敌人的标志出现红蓝闪烁时，你可以选择杀死或放过对方，你的决定可能会对后续情节造成影响。

english: Anti-terrorism police battled angry residents and public opinion as they shut bridges and tunnels in an effort to protect freedom and democracy after an Internet rumor blog warned of an impending dirty bomb attack in Liberty City. Civil liberties groups, upset since the recent repeal of the Fourth Amendment was deemed necessary to save the country, decried the closures as an overreaction.
zh: 网传自由城将受脏弹袭击，反恐警察即以保护民主自由为由封锁了大桥和隧道，引起了公民的愤怒与民意的反弹。先前「为了保护国家，有必要废除第四修正案*」的提出已让民权组织十分沮丧，此次他们发表谴责，称封锁行为反应过激。(第四修正案：保护公民的人身、住宅、文件和财产不受无理搜查和扣押，有合理根据方可取得搜查和扣押令。)

english: But who will be laughing when a cheap nuke goes off and residents are radioactive for 10,000 years? This is not a joke or a tofu love-in. This is a war. It is a war we can win if we take precautions, overreact, bomb innocents overseas and protect the homeland. That's what America is about and, if you don't like it, leave. Please. No, just go. Out.
