zh: 这是一个没人想过的禁忌话题：消防队有基佬。大多数人不会考虑这一问题，但据道金斯先生所说，多数消防站采用的开放式公共浴室会让男人感到尴尬。他爱国地说：「如果要改造浴室，让使用者不能大大方方地眼馋别人的生殖器的话，改造所需的开销会很大，而我更愿意将这笔钱用于保护我们城市不受恐怖袭击。」我们深表同感。谢谢你，道金斯先生，谢谢你能保持真诚。

english: Illegal counterfeit medication is making its way onto US soil through the under-protected ports and harbor system. This is a disgrace. Containers that originated at a false address in the Guangdong Province of China were intercepted by N.O.O.S.E operatives in charge of customs and border security. If it wasn't for these patriots, our economy would be even more undermined and unable to finance the battle against terror.
zh: 非法假药正通过防护薄弱的港口系统向美国伸出魔爪。太丢人了。负责通关与边境安全的N.O.O.S.E截获了一批集装箱，其发货地址是一个中国广东的虚假地址。要不是还有这些爱国者在，我们的经济会更加虚弱，甚至无力继续支持反恐战争。

english: Not only could these pills be dangerous to those poor souls unable to get REAL erections, but the money from the sale of these pills is probably going to fund bombs. The Surgeon General should make Mollis available over the counter before this becomes a more dangerous situation.
zh: 这些药片不但会毒害无法「真正勃起」的可怜人，而且花在这种药上的每一分钱都可能变成恐怖分子的炸弹。卫生部长应增加药店中Mollis的备货，以免陷入更大的危险。

english: Silencing sissy liberals, a new taskforce is being considered to fight the scourge of dirty unwashed eastern Europeans attempting to muscle in on our last great industry - organized crime.
zh: 软弱的自由派看了沉默，政府考虑建立一支特遣部队以对抗肮脏下贱的东欧人，试图阻止他们染指我市最后的大型产业——有组织犯罪。

english: This will make more people patriots, will make us safe, and will scare our enemies, who will stop at nothing to hurt us for no reason and don't worry about foreign policy or understanding other religions. Let's get to wiretapping and detaining indefinitely, the Mayor said.
zh: 「这会促使更多的人爱国，可以保护我们的安全，让我们的敌人，那些无缘无故不择手段伤害我们、毫不考虑外交关系也不理解其他其他宗教的人，得到震慑。让我们接纳监听与无限期刑事拘留吧。」市长说。

english: The Mayor and members of City Council are planning a parade to celebrate the next chapter in American freedom: the renewal and expansion of the Jingoism Act.
zh: 市长与其他市议会议员正计划筹办一场花车游行来庆祝美国自由的新篇章：沙文主义法案的修订与扩展。

english: Worrying trends on the markets as the BAWSAQ refused to allow a discernible pattern to emerge. It went up and it went down and then it went nowhere. And we are not sure what to make of it; in a world in which no news is definitely bad news, especially for our ability to make money off this website. The fact is we'd like a pattern, as that would give us a story and currently we've got neither. It's a mess, and that makes it harder for people to say anything intelligent. Like when you vomit. It's not a bull, it's not a bear. It's a puddle of bile.
zh: 市场行情令人担忧，BAWSAQ大盘仍未给出明确走势。先是上涨，又是下跌，然后上下乱窜。我们不知道该怎么办，毕竟这个世界没有绝对的坏消息，而我们经营网站的目的也是为了营利。实际上我们都希望走势明确，因为这样我们还有故事能讲，但现在我们既看不清走势，又讲不出故事。实在是混乱，混乱到任何人都难以说出明智的话，就像你呕吐的时候。这不是牛市，也不是熊市，这就是一摊胆汁。

english: In a world in which clever rich people can make money if the market goes down or up, the one thing we are told to write that we hate is the market doing nothing consistently. So come on Feds, loosen up regulations, stop trying to tell us what to do and allow unbridled capitalism to let the power brokers gain greater control for all our good.
zh: 身在这个聪明的富人无论行情好坏都能赚钱的世界中，我们很讨厌写上面布置的这种稿子：市场依然无所作为。快点啊，联邦政府，放松管制，别再教我们做事了，快让资本主义脱缰，让有权有势的人拥有更大的权力，这样对大家都好。

english: So-called civil rights activist, Tom Goldberg, was the victim of a gruesome murder facilitated by laws he pushed for as a partner in the law firm Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster. The firm is famous for trying to stand up for so-called civil rights, weak on terror, wooly on immigration and far too Draconian on gun control. Mayor Julio Ochoa's liberal agenda is not giving Liberty City the protection it needs in this climate of anarchy.
zh: 所谓的民权活动家汤姆 戈德堡惨遭杀害，其与他人共同经营戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行，这一惨案便是该律师行推动立法的恶果。该律师行的知名主张有所谓的维护民权、温和反恐、宽松移民，且在控枪政策上过于严苛。在这一多事之秋，胡里奥･奥乔亚市长的自由派主张绝对无法保护自由城。

english: The great country that is the United States of America was founded on family doctrines and teachings. If these are not presented alongside the so-called scientific arguments at the Libertonian Museum after it is reopened, then I'll be home schooling my children another year.
zh: 美利坚合众国是一个伟大的国家，其根基就是家传教义和教育。在自由城博物馆重新开馆后，如果这些没被他们与所谓的科学论据一起展出，我会让我的孩子继续在家学习一年。

english: The Libertonian Museum has been closed for renovation for several months now, not that anyone would notice. This columnist, for one, wants it to stay that way. It is a liberal establishment aiming to infect anyone who visits it with godlessness. Anyone who sees the fossil exhibit will understand this - it completely fails to present the real side of the so-called dinosaur debate. At no point do they alert visitors to the possibility that these beasts were put there to test our faith.
zh: 自由城博物馆已经闭馆翻修数月，尽管很多人都没有发现。但本文作者希望它能一直闭馆。自由城博物馆是一个自由派设施，用于向所有参观者灌输无神论思想。任何一个见过化石展的人都知道，这些化石展完全没能展现所谓恐龙争论*的真相(即神创论和进化论之争)。他们完全忽视了一种可能：这些怪物是上帝创造出来考验我们信仰的。他们没有告诉参观者这种可能的存在。

english: The city is in the throes of chaos as the National Office of Security Enforcement increased the terror threat level in Liberty City to a new height. N.O.O.S.E has created the Charcoal 8 Level in order to bridge the gap between the Red High 7 risk level and Black Severe 9. At Charcoal 8, citizens should be wary of the new forms of attack becoming open to the twenty-first-century terrorist in addition to all of the other means in his arsenal.
zh: 国安办将自由城的恐怖威胁等级提升至新高度，宣告自由城正处于混乱的阵痛当中。国安办在恐怖威胁等级中增加了炭灰色级(8级)，用于填补深红色级(7级)和极黑色级(9级)间的空缺。在炭灰色级(8级)下，市民不仅需要警惕通常的恐怖袭击，更要防范21世纪恐怖分子的新型恐怖袭击。

english: In particular, N.O.O.S.E warns us to be aware of a terrorist-led assault upon American morale and patriotism including possible media-terrorism and cyber-terrorism. America decides what's right and wrong. Articulating anti-American thoughts is a form of terrorism and should be treated as such.
zh: 国安办还特别叮嘱，警惕一切由恐怖分子主导的针对美国民族信心和爱国主义的攻击，例如可能出现的传媒恐怖主义和网络恐怖主义。是非对错由美国决定。表达反美思想就是一种恐怖主义，也应这般处理。

english: How can we expect to compete in the global marketplace if our unions are run by thugs brandishing weapons and making unreasonable demands for minimum wage and health care? The only way to be sure that business is conducted fairly in this city is for the unions to be dissolved and the labor market totally deregulated.
zh: 如果工会的组织者都是「舞刀弄枪」的残暴歹徒，一边还要求不可理喻的最低工资和医疗保险，我们怎么可能在全球市场中赢得竞争呢？要想让本市的工商活动公平进行，唯一的解决方法就是解散工会，并彻底解除对劳动力市场的管制。

english: Not content with killing off the entrepreneurial spirit, some unions have taken to violence. The recent bloodbath on Yusuf Amir's construction site in Castle Gardens can only be attributed to one thing - the endemic corruption in construction unions in the Liberty City area. The so-called victims of this massacre were carrying semi-automatic weapons! This writer doesn't want to disrespect the dead, but I suspect the only time that these mob associates handled concrete was when they coated a victim's feet in it and dropped him into the Humboldt River. These mobsters were attempting to defraud a foreign business man and they were a disgrace to this great country.
zh: 光是扼杀企业家精神还不够，一些工会竟然采取暴力手段。日前，城堡花园区尤瑟夫･阿米尔名下的建筑工地发生了一起惨案，其原因只有一个——自由城建筑工会中普遍存在的腐败。这起惨案中的所谓受害者都持有半自动武器！笔者并无冒犯死者之意，但我怀疑这帮黑社会只有在把人沉尸洪堡河时才会接触水泥。这帮黑社会想要敲诈外国商人，他们是我们伟大国家的奇耻大辱。

english: National Office of Security Enforcement agents have intercepted some high quality counterfeit 100-dollar bills abroad. The government is calling these bills 'supernotes' because of the quality of ink and paper being used in their production. While they have only so far been found in Amsterdam and Belfast, authorities believe that the notes are being manufactured with the backing of a national government. Speculation is rampant that this is the work of a terrorist state or a communist power. To this reporter, however, a campaign this cowardly and vindictive points to only one possible perpetrator - France.
zh: 国家安全办公室的探员查获了一批假钞，这种假钞质量极高，系从海外流入本国。因其印刷所采用的油墨和纸张质量较好，政府将这种假钞称为「超级钞」。尽管目前我们只在阿姆斯特丹和贝尔法斯特发现了这种假钞，但有关部门认为这些假钞系由具有国家政府背景的组织制造。有猜测称这是恐怖主义国家或共产主义政权所为。然而在笔者眼中，这种软弱的报复性行为只可能出自一个国家——法国。

english: As he pushes forward his legislation to ban same sex marriage, Senator Travis Evans was singled out on Capitol Hill today by activist groups who have video footage of the Senator while on vacation in Florida soliciting sex in a men's bathroom in a park. "These degenerates and morally moribund losers have nothing on me," Senator Evans stormed on Weazel News earlier today, "I am for family values. I just have a wide stance. My wife and I are very happy." Over 20 men have stepped forward claiming to have engaged in sexual encounters with Evans, and indicated that he totally gives bad head.
zh: 今日，参议员特拉维斯･埃文斯于国会山被社会活动组织包围，这名议员曾提出禁止同性婚姻的立法，而最近却有他在佛罗里达公园的男厕所进行同性援交的录像被爆出。「这些品行不端道德败坏的失败者根本没有我的把柄，」埃文斯议员早前在Weazel新闻中大发雷霆，「我支持家庭观念，不过我拥有广泛立场。我和我妻子的生活十分幸福。」目前已经有超过20名男性称自己与埃文斯发生过性行为，并表示他的技术很差。

english: Officials in Liberty City announced yesterday that the river crossings between Algonquin and Alderney may reopen shortly. The Hickey Bridge and Booth Tunnel have been closed recently due to the terror alert the city has been living under intermittently the last few years. Is it me or is this just another example of the liberal pinkos who run that awful city bending over and letting terrorists give them one where the sun don't shine? Nothing gives our enemies strength like realizing that we are not on a 24-hour full-time alert and lockdown. If we don't cavity search every man, woman and child in that town right now, they deserve to die.
zh: 自由城官方于昨日发出通告，宣布连接阿尔冈琴和奥尔德尼的通道即将重新开放。由于常年间歇出现的恐怖袭击警告，希基大桥和布斯隧道早先已被封锁。只有我这么想吗？我觉得这只是掌管城市的自由派左倾分子向恐怖分子低头寻求和解的又一案例。无法做到24小时的警戒和全面管制只会助长我们敌人的气焰。如果不能立刻对城里的男女老少进行全面彻底的搜身，那只能说他们活该去死。

english: Hell, I'm happy to help. I'll do some searches myself. To prove what a patriot I am, I let a stranger cavity search me every day. I'm not carrying any explosives or anthrax up my orifice and I'll prove it to you. How about you, Mayor Ochoa? It's high time you proved to all of us that you're not in league with our enemies and smuggling disaster up your ass.
zh: 天，我很乐意提供协助。我自己也可以帮忙搜查。为了证明我忠诚的爱国之心，我每天都让陌生人对我搜身。我的身上没有携带炸药和致命病菌，不信的话可以证明给你看。那你呢，奥乔亚市长？现在轮到你向我们证明你没有同我们的敌人狼狈为奸谋划袭击了。

english: The bridges being shut is exactly the kind of thing that showed the terrorists that their tactics were not working, because we could shut bridges and keep them out and then go and blow up their countries. Now where are we? In another fine liberal mess.
zh: 封锁大桥可以明确告诉恐怖分子，他们的阴谋无法实施。因为封锁大桥后我们就能拒敌千里之外，反手轰炸他们的国家。但现在呢？我们陷入了自由主义的泥潭。

english: So, they've opened the bridge and tunnel into Algonquin from Alderney? What a pathetic liberal copout! Allow people their freedom? We'll be free when we are all dead at this rate. The fact is terrorists use bridges to cross rivers and to kill innocent lives. Families will die because of this - we are at war, and when you're at war, you should suffer.
zh: 他们居然开放了连接阿尔冈琴与奥尔德尼的大桥和隧道？自由派的退缩真是可悲！竟然给予民众自由？照这样下去我们都会自由的，死得自由。事实是恐怖分子会用大桥过河残杀无辜，家庭也会因此遭到破坏。我们陷入了战争，而一旦陷入战争，民众就会受难。

english: Despite our repeated warnings, terrorists have attacked Liberty City again. This time the target was a fueling depot in Northwood. Some liberal news outlets are trying to spin this into a story about the Mafia. They're saying that the explosion was related to organized crime rather than terror. These leftist loons are crazy. They'll say and do anything before they admit that terrorism is the number one problem facing the nation and much more important than any of their pet projects, the environment, health care and ludicrous foreign welfare projects.
zh: 尽管警报不断播报，恐怖分子还是袭击了自由城。这次的袭击目标是位于北伍德的一个燃料仓库。某些自由派新闻媒体妄图把本次事件编造成黑手党所为。他们称本次爆炸事件应归类到有组织犯罪案件，而非恐怖袭击。这些左派野蛮人简直就是疯子。他们无论如何都不会承认，解决恐怖主义问题才是我国的燃眉之急，他们只会关注动保、环保、医保和滑稽的外国福利保障。

english: Proof that the government is doing all that it can to protect home owners and families came through from Liberty City with the news that, in a city in which not much goes right, the cost of living remains reassuringly high. Although the city is plagued by social problems, and has a massive shortfall of strip malls and obesity compared with rest of this great nation, at least they are keeping the economy strong.
zh: 在自由城这个诸事不顺的城市中，生活成本仍然高得令人安心，证明政府正在尽全力保护房主和家庭的利益。尽管这里社会问题繁多，小商场的缺口巨大，肥胖问题对比全国格外突出，但政府仍然保持着强大的经济实力。

english: Even more alarming, the LCPD forensic team has found a triggering device at the scene which may have been activated by a cell phone. It is more than likely that this was just the first of many planned bombings. If you see a foreigner using a cell phone, he is probably a terrorist. Act first, ask questions later. You have the safety of your fellow Americans to consider as well as your own.
zh: 更可怕的是，LCPD鉴证科还在现场发现了一个起爆器，可能是通过手机进行操作。这多半会是连环爆炸袭击的开端。要是你瞧见一个外国人在用手机，他很可能是恐怖分子。记住，先行动，后提问。你要考虑的不只是自己的安全，还有美国同胞的安全。

english: Witnesses saw a "foreign looking man" walking away from the warehouse. What more evidence does the President need before the borders are shut to America-hating immigrants?
zh: 有数位目击者称看见一名「外国样貌」的男子离开仓库。那么，在对仇美移民封锁边境前，我们的总统还需要什么证据吗？

english: While this is bad news for some, it's good news for us as we are big supporters of those who help themselves. Especially when those who help themselves are the already wealthy figuring out a way to stay rich. Above all, good house prices are good for us as we have literally nothing else to talk about over dinner. We grew up in the 1980s after all, so missed out on hippies and swinging and ideas.
zh: 对我们这些坚定的自食其力派来说，这的确是一个好消息，但对某些人来说则不然。自食其力者富起来后想要保持富裕，这种情况就会凸显。最重要的是，房价高对我们都有好处，不然我们在饭桌上就真的没啥可聊了。毕竟我们都在80年代长大成人，所以也就错过了嬉皮士，错过了性开放，也错过了那些奇思妙想。

english: Fans of the movie Dragonbrain just might have a pox upon thee as theater owners are concerned at outbreaks of violence during the epic four-hour movie. Billed as the largest CG cinema expense in Vinewood history, the movie features knights, dragons, ladies in waiting, vague Shakespearian sexual puns nobody gets, armies of trolls, orcs, elves and a talking sidekick with multiple personalities.
zh: 电影《龙之脑》的粉丝随时都可能咒汝去死，影院老板也开始担心这部长达四小时的史诗级电影中的暴力场景造成的影响了。该电影号称好麦坞史上成本最高的CG电影，其中有骑士、巨龙、侍女、晦涩难懂的莎士比亚式性暗示双关、巨魔大军、兽人、精灵，还有一个喋喋不休的多重人格的助手。

english: But this period drama was too real for one Alderney resident who lost his head after an altercation with another moviegoer. Some witnesses say he had it coming to him. More on this story as it develops as police are still questioning fans as to why anyone would sit for 4 hours of special effects without any discernable story.
zh: 然而对某个奥尔德尼居民来说，这部时代剧实在过于真实，以至于他在与另一名电影观众发生争执时「失去了头脑」。有部分目击者称是他活该。关于这一案件，警方仍在询问粉丝为什么会有人坐在那儿看4个小时剧情空洞的特效。

english: Another death related to fantasy violence rather than real, American violence.
zh: 又一例与幻想暴力相关的死亡事件，非现实的美国式暴力。

english: Liberty City's Deputy Police Commissioner, Francis McReary, was ruthlessly gunned down earlier. To most of us he is a hero, a man dedicated to serving the city who was taken before his time. Liberal "Blame America First" news outlets have been sullying the man's reputation. Rather than celebrate this patriot's great career, they dig up some unsubstantiated accusations of corruption. Francis McReary valiantly served Liberty City until he was murdered. We should remember him as an American Hero.
zh: 自由城的警局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里于早些时候惨遭枪杀。对于我们大多数人来说，他是英雄，是一个为自由城勤恳奉献的人，但他却英年早逝。那些「凡事都怪美国」的自由派媒体一直在抹黑他，他们不去称赞这位爱国英雄的丰功伟绩，却在宣传无凭无据的贪污指控。弗朗西斯･麦克雷里为自由城鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已，我们应当把他当作美国英雄纪念。

english: Although Mr. McReary has never tried to hide his tough Dukes upbringing, nor a family background with links to organized crime, he himself has always stood tall as a community leader and we mourn with him in this time of sorrow.
zh: 虽然麦克雷里先生从未掩盖过他在公爵区的艰苦成长环境，也没有掩盖他那与黑社会有关联的家庭背景，但他一直是社区的榜样与领袖。此时此刻，让我们与他一起默哀。

english: Deputy Police Commissioner, Francis McReary, witnessed the murder of his elder brother in Algonquin. His brother Derrick was assassinated by a sniper while the two men enjoyed a catch up in a city park. Francis McReary has risen through the ranks of the police force and been a vocal proponent of law and order throughout difficult times for the city. He has strongly denied spurious allegations made against him.
zh: 警局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里目击了他哥哥在阿尔冈琴遇害的过程。当时他们兄弟二人在公园里感人重逢，随后他的哥哥德里克被一名狙击手暗杀。弗朗西斯･麦克雷里在警局内平步青云，在本市的困难时期仍坚持拥护法律与秩序。他坚决否认那些对他发起的虚假指控。

english: Suspicion is good enough evidence for us to send a terrorist to an internment camp, so why shouldn't that be enough in a drug case? Dropping an ounce of crack cocaine on an elementary school is just as bad as dropping a bomb on the subway. Let's make this Dimitri Rascalov character pay in the same way.
zh: 既然光靠怀疑就足以将恐怖分子关进拘留营，为什么对毒贩就不能这样呢？在小学门口扔一盎司霹雳可卡因跟在地铁上安炸弹一样恶劣。我们得让迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫以同样的方式付出代价。

english: The Russian Mafiya appear to have their hands around the throats of your children. Russian mobsters have become major drug importers into the city. A boatload of cocaine was intercepted at the mouth of the Humboldt River. The boat driver, Russian Andriy Maximov, is thought to have brought the drugs up from Vice City.
zh: 俄国黑帮正在用魔爪扼住你孩子的咽喉。如今流入自由城的毒品中，很大一部分是由俄国黑帮走私入境的。日前，一艘满载可卡因的货轮在洪堡河入海口被拦截。这些毒品被怀疑是由货轮驾驶员俄国人安德烈･马克西莫夫从罪城运来的。

english: This is a conspiracy between foreigners inside and outside of this country aimed at crippling our children with addiction. We believe, however, that Mr. Maximov is just the fall guy. His boss, Dimitri Rascalov, who lives in Hove Beach, has been released without charges being filed after the District Attorney determined there was not enough evidence. This man isn't from here, why should we need evidence?
zh: 这是外国人里应外合的阴谋，他们想要利用毒瘾毁掉我们的孩子。然而，我们相信马克西莫夫先生只是一只替罪羔羊。他的幕后老板是居住于霍夫海滩的迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫，由于地方检察官判断起诉证据不足，他已被无罪释放。但这家伙又不是美国人，抓他还需要证据吗？

english: It is an act of war. When our government systematically devalues our currency 40% we accept it's for the common good. When a foreign country plays with our economy, it's war.
zh: 这明显是一种战争行为。我国政府有计划地让货币贬值40%是出于国民利益的考量。而别国玩弄我们的经济，那就是战争了。

english: It's feels like the 80's all over again, but instead of communists besting our sports heroes and boycotting our Olympics, now they've invaded your wallet. The American dollar is being systematically devalued by counterfeit $100 bills thought to have originated in communist countries. Previously, US authorities had only found these bills in Europe and Asia. Suddenly, they are appearing in huge quantities on home soil. These counterfeits are too sophisticated to be manufactured on a homemade press in this country.
zh: 感觉我们好像回到了80年代的冷战时代，但不同的是，以前共产主义者大败我们的体育英雄、抵制我们主办的奥运会，现在他们入侵了我们的钱包。美元受百元假钞影响持续贬值，而这些假钞被怀疑是由共产主义国家制造。此前，美国当局只在欧洲和亚洲发现过这种假钞。现在这种假钞在美国本土大量出现。这种假钞的制作工艺过于复杂，不是美国产印刷机所能生产的。

english: The ink and paper used in their production is the same as that used in genuine currency. This is a sophisticated operation that is clearly being masterminded by a foreign power.
zh: 制造这种假币所使用的纸张和油墨与印刷真钞所用的材料完全一致。如此细致的犯罪行为必定是境外势力的手笔。

english: In a predictably freakish development, Dr has sex with clones.
zh: 意料之中的变态展开，博士与克隆人发生性关系。

english: In another example of the sick and disgusting, self-important, misleading nature of scientists in this country who meddle with stem cells and lie about warming - Dr. Yahann Klietzel has been arrested for cloning himself and having sex with the clones.
zh: 证明我国瞎搞干细胞、谎称气候变暖的科学家都是恶心自大满口胡言的变态的新证据——亚汉･克利策尔博士因克隆自己并与克隆体发生性关系而被捕。

english: The nation was shocked and outraged that any doctor would do such a sick and disgusting thing rather than working to clone a hot celebrity like Cloe Parker so that men could buy a clone of her and enjoy a fantastic life fucking a super celeb instead of a fat piece of shit they picked up from the airport bar.
zh: 他的行为引起举国震惊，民众对科学家作出这种恶心的变态行为感到愤怒，也为科学家没有克隆克洛伊･帕克这样的名人愤怒。否则他们就可以买个克隆体回家和名人享受性福生活了，而现在他们只能面对在机场酒吧捡回来的肥猪八婆。

english: The Liberty City metropolitan area continues to be the main target for pathetic terrorists in their war on freedom. They struck the American-owned AutoEroticar Showroom in West Alderney City, massacring everyone in sight. This comes soon after the recent slaughter of US citizens in the Acter Industrial Park by terrorists. Some reporters have decided to dig into the past of the victims of these massacres to suggest that they were somehow related to organized crime.
zh: 在那些可悲的恐怖分子们的「自由之战」中，自由城大都会地区仍是他们的主要袭击目标。这次他们又袭击了一家美国企业——位于西奥尔德尼市的AutoEroticar展厅，将所见之人全数杀害。继最近在阿克特工业园的美国公民屠杀后，恐怖惨剧再度上演。然而某些记者却还在挖掘受害者们的过去，试图证实这些惨案与有组织犯罪有关。

english: It's disgusting. These people are American heroes. They have involuntarily given their lives for all of our freedom; what right do we have to dig into their past and make accusations and muddy the reputations of the dead? If N.O.O.S.E tells us these were acts of terrorism, then that's what they were. It's un-American of us to question that. N.O.O.S.E has said that a number of suspects have been extracted to offshore questioning centers. All I can say is thank god for that constitutional loophole.
zh: 实在太恶心了。这些人可都是美国的英雄。他们都在无意中将生命献给了我们的自由事业，我们又有何权利去乱挖他们的过去、妄图控告他们，甚至去玷污遇难者的英名呢？如果国安办说这些屠杀都是恐怖袭击，那它就是恐怖袭击。谁敢质疑，谁就是反美国。国安办说嫌疑人已被运送到海外的讯问中心，我只能说得亏宪法存在这些漏洞。

english: Why do attempts to bring this kind of class and distinction to American soil always grind to a halt? Who are these local groups insistent upon whingeing about big business and necessary developments? Is this a secular progressive conspiracy to stop bringing money into Liberty City from overseas? Would these leftist loons rather the deservedly wealthy residents of Liberty City gave their money to war-dodging Frenchmen in Paris than Yusuf Amir here in Liberty City?
zh: 为什么这种将阶级隔离带入美国土地的尝试总会慢慢消沉？这些整天抱怨大型私企跟必要建设的本地组织到底是什么来头？这是不是世俗改革派(对自由派的蔑称)妄图阻止海外资金流入自由城的阴谋？这些左派蠢人是不是宁可把富有的自由城居民的钱交给高举双手的法国人，也不愿意交给自由城本地的尤瑟夫･阿米尔？

english: Yusuf Amir, the renowned property developer, has run into issues when attempting to build a luxury condo tower in Liberty City. Aside from teething problems with union representatives, local groups are complaining that this development will ruin the skyline in Castle Gardens. Yusuf is a personal friend of this reporter and his name is synonymous with opulence and luxury throughout the world. His most notable achievement was the construction of the Hanging Gardens of Amir - an apartment complex suspended from balloons over the Persian Gulf.
zh: 知名地产商尤瑟夫･阿米尔在自由城建造豪华住宅楼的计划受阻。除了先前与工会代表之间的矛盾，本地组织也投诉称建造高楼会破坏城堡花园区的天际线。尤瑟夫的名字响彻世界，可以跟荣华富贵画上等号，本文记者也与他是私交。他最出名的成就是建成了「阿米尔的空中花园」——依靠气球吊在波斯湾上空的公寓楼。

english: There is a market for luxury living. People work hard on the stock market in the Exchange in order to come home and hear the sound of flowing champagne in a golden fountain on their living room floor. They want to be waited on by Yusuf Amir's team of chefs, butlers, Reiki practitioners, friends for hire and plastic surgeons because their busy schedules do not allow them to go out and find these services for themselves. Amir's development represents everything that the successful entrepreneur deserves after a hard day at the office. Investing in this property is an investment in the American economy. Leftist loons are trying to shut it down and, you know what? This reporter thinks that that is wholly un-American.
zh: 高端住宅市场广阔。人们在位于证券交易所的股票市场努力工作，为的就是回家后能听见客厅黄金喷泉里的香槟流动声。他们过于忙碌，无暇出门自己寻找生活服务，所以会需要尤瑟夫･阿米尔准备的厨师团队、管家、气功大师、雇佣朋友和整容医师。阿米尔的项目代表了成功企业家忙碌一天后应得的一切。投资这一项目就是投资美国经济。左派的蠢蛋居然还试图进行阻止，这么说吧，本文记者认为他们不算是美国人。

english: A-mir $5 Million for a Penthouse View of Hell
zh: 只要500万，就能向阿米尔买到俯瞰众生的顶楼公寓

english: The Kerry McIntosh self-destruction rollercoaster, that has increased circulation and replaced real news for weeks now, spiraled out of control yet again last night when the supermodel checked herself out of a luxury rehab spa in Los Santos only three days into her four-day program. Less than an hour after telling paparazzi that she had been "humbled by the recovery experience," McIntosh was jacked up on a cocktail of booze, pills and coke and crashed her car into the side of a Wigwam Burger restaurant.
zh: 数周以来，有关凯里･麦金托什自我毁灭欲望的各种新闻提高了报纸的发行量，顶替了真正的新闻。昨晚，这名超模又一次创下了记录。当时她在洛圣都一家内有温泉的豪华戒毒所接受四天的戒毒计划，仅仅经过三天，她就结帐离开了。离开后她告诉狗仔队这家戒毒所的待遇是在侮辱她，不到一小时后，她就因喝下混有酒精、药片和可卡因的鸡尾酒，驾车撞上了Wigwam汉堡店的外墙。

english: An eyewitness joked with reporters that, "it must be the closest she'd come to food in years." Ever since photos emerged of a male stripper blowing cocaine up her ass at a Lovefist reunion after-party last year, the McIntosh Meltdown has been a permanent fixture in the tabloids, propelling her career into the stratosphere with new contracts at Max Renda, Le Chien and Veneer. Max Renda's VP of Marketing explained that, "Girls these days want multi-dimensional role models.
zh: 一名目击者在受访时向记者开了个玩笑：「这肯定是几年来她离食物最近的一次。」去年流出的一组照片(脱衣舞男在麦金托什的屁股上吸食可卡因 拍摄于去年的爱之拳重聚余兴派对)让她走红，成为八卦新闻的常客，同时也推动了她的发展，让她与Max Renda、Le Chien和Veneer签下合同。Max Renda的市场部副总裁解释道：「当代女孩想要形象立体的模特。」

english: A pretty face and an eating disorder just isn't enough any more. A celebrity face-down in a pile of champagne vomit translates into more sales than a hundred displays of self-satisfied charity work." McIntosh believes that the rehab center is to blame for her relapse and is considering taking legal action. McIntosh said, "I tried to be a good person and completely failed. I'm still a selfish idiot, it's their fault not mine." We wish her well.
zh: 「光是有漂亮脸蛋和进食障碍已经不适合这个时代了。比起宣传名人上百次的自我满足的慈善活动，让名人在一堆香槟里醉得天昏地暗、吐到神志不清带来的销售量更多。」麦金托什坚称那家康复中心必须为她的复吸负全责，目前考虑采取法律手段。麦金托什说：「我曾想做一个好人，但彻底失败了。我还是那个自私的蠢蛋，这都怪他们，不怪我。」我们衷心祝愿她一切顺利。

english: They are everywhere you look - people who aren't white who want to do your job for half the pay, to sleep with your wife without complaining, to do the yard work instead of getting drunk and watching football. How do we throw out these people with a better work ethic, better music, and who haven't degenerated into violent psychopathic gun crazy lunatics?
zh: 所见之处，遍是其人——想拿半价薪水做你的工作的黄种人和印度人，想不必解释而跟你老婆上床的黑人和拉丁裔，想包揽你的庭院劳务而不是捡垃圾和看球赛的混血人。我们怎样才能把这些工作态度更好、音乐品味更优、没有堕落成反社会暴力精神病枪手的人赶出去？

english: There is only one way. They must learn our ways. Learn to hate everyone, even your next door neighbor. Stay inside, become lazy, don't read the paper or contact politicians. You can do it illegal immigrants - be like us. We need you on our side. Weazel News supports the Indoctrination Act currently before Congress that would round up all illegal immigrants and put them into reform camps where they will watch hours of television, eat Cluckin' Bell and Burger Shot and get lethargic. Cocoon conditioning works - and it will solve illegal immigration once and for all.
zh: 方法唯有一种。让他们入乡随俗。学会憎恶所有人，包括你的隔壁邻居。窝在家里，变得懒惰，从不看报，不接触政客。亲爱的非法移民们，你们可以做到的——变得跟我们一样。我们需要你成为同伴。Weazel新闻现在就对国会尚未通过的《教化法案》表示支持，该法案会集中所有非法移民，将他们送至改造营，让他们每天看电视，吃饭不是铛铛钟就是吃得饱汉堡，从而变得跟我们一样慵懒。封闭调教效果极佳，能够一劳永逸地解决非法移民的问题。

english: Since we were stupid enough to reopen the bridges around the metropolitan area, traffic has got much worse. At the same time, terrorists are now running wild about the city, in incredible numbers, we imagine. Next time you are on a bridge, look around you. Those other cars are full of terrorists, trying to blow up our freedom.
zh: 自从我们蠢到重新开放大都会周边的大桥后，交通状况就差了许多。与此同时，依我们看，数量极多的恐怖分子正在城市里肆意行动。下次你开车上桥的时候，看看你的周围，那些车里都是想要破坏我们自由的恐怖分子。

english: Well, beat them to it. Restrict your own freedom and help the environment, if you care about that sort of nonsense - support the proposals to shut the bridges permanently. These radical ideas were suggested by Martin Hawes, a man so freethinking the liberals locked him up. We say close the lunatic asylums. Turn them into detention centers for undesirables of a different sort, and close the bridges now.
zh: 那就抢占先机吧。限制你的自由然后保护环境吧，如果你真的在乎什么环境——拥护永久关闭大桥的议案吧。这些激进的想法是由马丁･霍斯提出的，他的思想太过自由，以至于自由派把他关了起来。我们提议关闭疯人院，改造成看守所关押各种不良分子，然后立刻封锁大桥。

english: Alright, so Bobby Jefferson went out of his way to praise some immigrants while he was damning others in his speech at the Civic Citadel. He argued that 99% of the people who come into this country are honest (I'd like to see the statistics to back that one up, by the way) and believe in the same things that patriotic American citizens do. He then went on to say that, besides terrorism, the biggest threat to American safety at the moment is these gangsters coming into Liberty City from Russia and Eastern Europe and setting up shop in immigrant communities like Hove Beach.
zh: 好吧，所以说博迪･杰斐逊在市政厅发表的演说可谓是煞费苦心地赞美移民，同时也毫不留情地咒骂其他人。他认为，这个国家99%的外来者都是诚实的(顺便一提，我倒想瞧瞧支持这一观点的数据)，且与我们美国的爱国者信仰相同。他还强调，除了恐怖主义，目前对美国国民安全的最大威胁，就是自由城中来自俄国和东欧的黑帮歹徒，他们还在霍夫海滩这样的移民社区里开张店铺。

english: Firstly, if people are going to come over to our country they should adopt to our customs of growing obese and loving bad sitcoms. Also, learn our language, even if we haven't quite properly mastered it yet. They shouldn't go somewhere like Hove Beach which is more Russian than some parts of Moscow. If these guys are such a threat, then why don't we just close the borders to everyone? I say close the borders to these bastards. Remember, 9 in 10 terrorists are foreign too.
zh: 首先，如果有人想移民我们国家，他们应该学会适应我们的肥佬习惯、爱上垃圾情景剧。同时，还要学习我们的语言，尽管我们自己也没有完全掌握。他们不该去类似于霍夫海滩这种俄国佬比莫斯科的某些地区都多的地方。要是这些家伙是一种威胁，那我们为什么不对所有人都封锁边境呢？我是说，对所有的那些混蛋封锁边境。时刻记住，10个恐怖分子里面，有9个是外国佬。

english: For years, sneaker manufacturer Eris has been made the villain by work-shy lefties for choosing to help third world countries. Historically, Eris's visionary founder, Pete Vassal, has kept quiet, refusing to descend to the level of veggie hypocrites who are more than happy to take a welfare check from the same government that they profess to despise. However, after years of silence, Vassal has now chosen to speak out against the rants of stoned human rights activists the world over.
zh: 多年来，运动鞋制造商Eris一直被好吃懒做的左派塑造成坏人，只因为Eris在帮助第三世界国家。此前，富有远见的Eris创始人皮特･瓦萨尔始终保持沉默，拒绝把自己降低到和那些素食伪君子同样的水平，后者一边反对政府，一边巴不得政府给他发福利支票。然而在经过数年的沉默后，瓦萨尔终于发声反对了那些吸毒的人权活动家。

english: In an online missive that delivers a powerful blow to the heart of the liberal manifesto, Vassal poses the hard-hitting questions that most in our politically-correct society no longer dare to ask, such as, "What would you rather do? Starve or earn 10 cents an hour?"
zh: 瓦萨尔用一篇长文对自由派的主张进行了有力反击，他提出了我国被政治正确束缚的人们不敢提出的问题，比如「如果让你选，你会选择饿死还是10美分的时薪？」

english: Thankfully, we are not complete losers. We've almost won one war - fun has almost been defeated. Nightclub-owning degenerate, Tony Prince, noted yesterday that Liberty City has been transformed into a strip mall. And not before time. The quicker we shut all of the night clubs there the better. Fun can be stopped, and we will prove it.
zh: 谢天谢地，我们还不是彻底的失败者。我们就快要打赢一场战争了——娱乐就要被击垮了。堕落的夜店老板，托尼･普林斯，于昨日表示，自由城已经变成小商场了。早该这样了。再不关掉那些夜店，我们哪有美好的未来。娱乐不是必需品，而我们会证明它。

english: The unfortunate truth is that tree-huggers would rather see third-world communities unemployed and homeless than working for a successful corporation. An Indonesian child is not going to thank a dreadlocked middle-class hippy for closing down her only source of income and sending her back to a life of crime, prostitution and cannibalism.
zh: 不幸的是，那些环境保护狂宁愿让第三世界的居民失业、流离失所，也不愿意让他们替一家成功企业工作。留着脏辫的中产嬉皮士断绝了一个印尼女孩唯一的收入来源，让她回到了满是犯罪、卖淫和吃人的生活，受害者可不会感谢他。

english: Some strategists are saying that, "We should focus on this war, so we don't make the same mistake as the Nazis and try to fight a war on two fronts. Let's defeat fun first then focus on everything else we hate, like Europe."
zh: 某些决策者称：「我们应该专注于这场战争，不能犯下与纳粹同样的错误两线作战。我们要先干掉娱乐，再集火我们所憎恨的别的东西，比如欧洲。」

english: Now, he's also come out as a homosexual, married with children. Well, it's scarcely surprising. He's a liberal. Wooly thinking is their watchword. Or watch words. This news organization can never be accused of wooly thinking (apart from our weird attitude to China, but let's ignore that), so we will continue to attack liberals like him, until we have driven them out of this country for good.
zh: 如今，他又作为一名同性恋出柜，而他已有妻儿。好吧，这一点都不意外。他是一个自由派。柔性思维是他们的口号。本报永远不会被说是柔性思维(我们对中国的古怪态度除外，但咱们先不管这个)，因此我们将继续攻击像他那样的自由派，直到把他们永远逐出国门。

english: Disgraced sinner, Bryce Dawkins, was hiding a terrible secret. He lived a double life. In public, he was a staunch hang 'em and flog 'em conservative, but in private, he was a filthy liberal. The fact is Mr. Dawkins was not as conservative as he made out. He even owned a passport. Most terrorists own passports, as do many drug dealers.
zh: 布莱斯･道金斯这个耻辱的罪人一直隐瞒着一个恐怖秘密。他过着双面的生活。在公众面前，他是坚定的保守派，整天叫嚷着「吊死他们，抽死他们」，但在私下，他完全是一个肮脏猥琐的自由派。事实上，道金斯先生并没有表面上那么保守。他甚至还有护照。而绝大多数恐怖分子都持有护照，许多毒贩也是如此。

english: Why do we think this? Mr. Dawkins admitted he took pity on Mr. Crane and gave him somewhere to stay. If this isn't an awful example of people expecting state handouts, I don't know what is. Quite frankly, I think we'd all prefer it if Mr. Crane was Mr. Dawkins' lover. It is an awful example to set. Pity is for the weak.
zh: 我们为什么会这样想？道金斯先生承认自己同情克兰先生，为其提供了住所。如果这都不算指望政府救济的人的实例，我都不知道怎么样才算了。不过老实说，如果克兰先生是道金斯先生的情人的话，那我们还是喜闻乐见的。这是个坏榜样，因为同情是给弱者的。

english: Now, he's also come out as a homosexual, married with children. Well, it's scarcely surprising. He's a liberal. Wooly thinking is their watchword. Or watch words. This news organization can never be accused of wooly thinking (apart from our weird attitude to China, but let's ignore that), so we will continue to attack liberals like him, until we have driven them out of this country for good.
zh: 如今，他又作为一名同性恋出柜，而他已有妻儿。好吧，这一点都不意外。他是一个自由派。柔性思维是他们的口号。本报永远不会被说是柔性思维(我们对中国的古怪态度除外，但咱们先不管这个)，因此我们将继续攻击像他那样的自由派，直到把他们永远逐出国门。

english: Why do we think this? Mr. Dawkins admitted he took pity on Mr. Crane and gave him somewhere to stay. If this isn't an awful example of people expecting state handouts, I don't know what is. Quite frankly, I think we'd all prefer it if Mr. Crane was Mr. Dawkins' lover. It is an awful example to set. Pity is for the weak.
zh: 我们为什么会这样想？道金斯先生承认自己同情克兰先生，为其提供了住所。如果这都不算指望政府救济的人的实例，我都不知道怎么样才算了。不过老实说，如果克兰先生是道金斯先生的情人的话，那我们还是喜闻乐见的。这是个坏榜样，因为同情是给弱者的。

english: Disgraced sinner, Bryce Dawkins, was hiding a terrible secret. He lived a double life. In public, he was a staunch hang 'em and flog 'em conservative, but in private, he was a filthy liberal. The fact is Mr. Dawkins was not as conservative as he made out. He even owned a passport. Most terrorists own passports, as do many drug dealers.
zh: 布莱斯･道金斯这个耻辱的罪人一直隐瞒着一个恐怖秘密。他过着双面的生活。在公众面前，他是坚定的保守派，整天叫嚷着「吊死他们，抽死他们」，但在私下，他完全是一个肮脏猥琐的自由派。事实上，道金斯先生并没有表面上那么保守。他甚至还有护照。而绝大多数恐怖分子都持有护照，许多毒贩也是如此。

english: Unfortunately, what should have been an afternoon of wholesome family entertainment, ended in scandal and therapy. Parents and organizers were horrified at what is being called the "C word event" after an angry student took out frustrations on the judges whom he also called pedophiles.
zh: 不幸的是，下午档播出的合家欢节目最终毁在了丑闻和混乱中。一名愤怒的学生向他口中的恋童癖裁判发泄不满后，这一「逼字事件」震惊了观赛的父母们和裁判。

english: Despite Wolfe's baseless allegations, the 'Roman Empire Wealth System' has been an upstanding sponsor of Weazel News and we cannot allow some cretin to sully its name. Life is full of risks and, as civilization goes down the toilet, it only means more ratings and sponsors for us.
zh: 尽管沃尔夫的指控毫无根据，「罗马帝国财富系统」一直是Weazel新闻的强力赞助商，而我们绝不容许某些白痴玷污它的清誉。生活充满风险，而且随着文明的衰落，我们的收视率只会更高，赞助商也会更多。

english: It seems that nobody is immune to the temptations of 'get rich quick' schemes on the Internet. Brilliant economist and Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Darius Wolfe, has revealed that he was persuaded into investing $20,000 into a online pyramid scheme. "As soon as I received the spam email titled 'Amazing Business Opportunity' that directed me to www.money2makemoney.com, I just had to know more," said Wolfe, "I've never been able to resist a risky investment."
zh: 似乎没人能抵抗互联网中「一夜暴富」骗局的诱惑。达里厄斯･沃尔夫，杰出经济学家兼美联储主席，于近期被曝给一个网络金字塔骗局投资$20,000。「我收到了一封题为『绝妙的赚钱良机』垃圾邮件，并将我导向 www.money2makemoney.com ，我只是觉得我得了解更多，」沃尔夫说道，「我从来都抗拒不了风险投资。」

english: We at Weazel News say fair enough. In England they call each other the C word all the time. Here it is somehow held in high esteem as the argument ender - the word that is at the point of no return and makes her leave you for good. No word on if the Lip Reading Bee will continue.
zh: 我们Weazel新闻已经很客观了。在英格兰，他们一直都互称对方为「〇逼」。在美国则被视作争论的终结者——此言一出，即无回旋余地，她就会离你而去。读唇大赛是否会继续举办目前尚无定数。

english: We've all covertly mouthed something to someone, such as "Let's get out of here," or "I'm going to kill you," or "Hurry, before my husband gets back." But lip reading isn't just important for communicating quests for infidelity. It is a fundamental part of the academic process, and this year it was being celebrated at the inaugural Lip Reading Bee.
zh: 我们都悄悄地用口型跟别人说过话，比如「我们赶紧跑吧」「我要杀了你」或者「快点，我老公要回来了」。但是读唇不仅对偷情时的交流重要，在学术研究中也十分重要，今年的读唇大赛也备受人们关注。

english: Experts are theorizing that the video footage showing several women and children being thrown off the bridge by police is probably fake or touched up by a liberal activist.
zh: 专家试图证明所谓「妇女儿童被警方扔下大桥」的视频系自由派人士伪造，抑或被其动过手脚。

english:
Liberty City's Police Commissioner for Public Affairs, Tom Pireni, presented a "Wing It" slideshow presentation to the media today, clearly spelling out in simple bulletpoints how the actions of the heroes in the LCPD in, what some are calling the "Broker Bridge Incident", are not considered to be police brutality. Pireni spent 20 minutes on the first slide, using a laser pointer to underline bulletpoints that said:
* Protect
* Serve
* Freedom
He then played the Star-Spangled Banner on an acoustic guitar and ended with a chorus of reporters singing "What does freedom mean to me?" that drew tears from the audience.
zh:
今日，LCPD公共事务处处长汤姆･皮雷尼利用「Wing It」软件向媒体做了一份幻灯片报告，要点明确地表达了LCPD的英雄们在所谓「布洛克桥事件」中的行为并非暴力执法。皮雷尼把第一页讲了20分钟，用激光笔圈了半天要点：
* 保护
* 服务
* 自由
然后他用民谣吉他演奏了《星条旗之歌》(美国国歌)，最终以记者合唱「于我何为自由？」作结，观众泪如雨下。

english: She called police in a state of rage as she hasn't been able to climax in weeks and is so ugly that none of her fellow junkies would have sex with her, despite meth's effect of intense sexual arousal." Officials indicated that meth is an epidemic and that police need raises and high-tech equipment, new cars and more vacations in order to make Liberty City safe. We say; what price is freedom?
zh: 尽管冰毒有强烈的性唤起作用，她仍然愤怒地报了警，因为她几周都无法高潮且变得丑陋不堪，导致同伴都不愿意同她发生关系。警方指出冰毒会广泛传播，故警方需要加薪、高科技装备、增配新车以及更多的假期来保护自由城的安全。令人不禁发问：自由的代价是什么？

english: Her teeth gray from years of meth abuse, Steinway resident Stephanie Peerson called police to rat out her fellow junkies. A mobile meth lab set up in a box truck was found and suspects taken into custody. "Meth has destroyed the lives and businesses of cocaine dealers in Vice City, and we see the same happening here," said agent Albert Thomas, "And this woman who is 22 years old looks like she's 62 because of the ravages of meth.
zh: 斯坦威居民斯蒂芬妮･皮尔森报警揭发了她的同伙，她的牙齿已因常年滥用冰毒而变灰。一个设立在厢式货车内的移动制毒设施被查封，嫌犯皆已送押。「冰毒毁掉了罪城可卡因商人的生计，而同样的事也发生在这里。」探员阿尔伯特･托马斯说，「这个看上去有62岁的女人其实才22岁，只因为她滥用冰毒。」

english: Proving that hype overpowers sensibility, local residents have been flocking to hybrids such as the Karin Dilettante. Climate change is natural and has been happening since the Earth was created 6,500 years ago, say leading petroleum scientists. Volcanoes and animal flatulence create much more warming than the 3.5 billion cars burning oil each day.
zh: 本地居民纷纷购买包括Karin 半吊子在内的混动车，证明了过度炒作带来的冲动。「气候变化是自然现象，自从6500年前地球诞生就开始了」，几位顶尖石油科学家说。火山和动物放屁每天会产生比35亿辆车要多得多的热量。

english: In related news, solar power has been studied in a new report which found it is too expensive and actually takes energy to make the panels. The President and Congress are working on a bill to protect industries like gas, coal and electric in the face of the solar threat.
zh: 相关新闻称，一份新的研究报告指出建造太阳能面板过于昂贵，制造时也会消耗能源。总统与国会正致力于通过法案，以保护油气、煤炭和电力等产业不受太阳能威胁。

english: Most criminals are foreigners and vice versa. And the sooner we all acknowledge this, the sooner we can be safe in our city, and focus on what matters, like telling foreigners how to run their countries and fighting abstract concepts.
zh: 大多数罪犯是外国人，大多数外国人是罪犯。我们越早认清这点，就能越早使城市安全，然后抓住真正的重点，例如告诉外国人如何治理自己的国家、打击某些抽象概念。

english: Only the terminally unobservant have failed to notice the remarkable rise in violent crime in Liberty City over the past few weeks and months. And only weak-minded liberals are afraid to discuss the causes of this crime wave - immigration. As usual, the liberal elite are banging on about the causes of crime - our right to bear arms, not immigration. Anyone with half a brain knows gun control should be relaxed in this city immediately so people can defend themselves from the border jumpers.
zh: 只有底层的违规者才不会注意到，在最近的数周数月中，自由城的暴力犯罪显著增加。也只有玻璃心的自由派才会惧怕提及这一犯罪浪潮背后的原因——移民。一如既往，自由主义精英抨击的犯罪原因还是持有枪支，而非移民。只要有点脑子，就能知道本市的枪支管控应当放松，这样人们才能从非法移民的手中保护自己。

english: In a bold and courageous move by city and federal officials, bridges and tunnels will be closed indefinitely while officials root out what is rumored to be a terror cell in Liberty City. While activists and other un-Americans have questioned the war on terror, to those who have died at the hands of police during protests, it is quite clear. "These terrorists want to take away our freedoms. But look, we've done it for them. Ha. We win. You lose. Eat my shit terrorists. Yeah, you like that? Do you? Daddy is in charge," said Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins. Income from tolls has dropped to zero, and officials say that bankruptcy is a small price to pay for safety. The stock market won't crash.
zh: 市政府和联邦官员通过大胆而有魄力的措施，无限期封闭了各个大桥和隧道，直到根除所谓的自由城中的恐怖分子才会解除。尽管社会活动家与其他非美国人已对反恐战争发起质疑，但对那些在抗议时死于警察手中的人来说，答案十分明确。「这些恐怖分子想要夺走我们的自由。但是，我们先做到了。哈，我们赢了，你输了。吔屎啦，恐怖分子。呵，你喜欢吗？中意吗？你爸爸我做主。」副市长布莱斯･道金斯说。来自收费站的收入已经降到了零，而政府官员则称「为了安全，破产不值一提。」证券市场不会崩盘。

english: It's the news our enemies love - the terrible price of freedom - the catastrophe of the falling stock market. The BAWSAQ has been in freefall the last few days, and it's the kind of news that makes terrorists rejoice and liberals wonder how they can interfere to bring prices down further. It's a natural consequence of years of over-regulation, big government and the killing of the entrepreneurial spirit that made this country the envy of foreigners everywhere. The country will enter a serious recession and be governed by a combination of Islamic terrorists, homosexuals and communists unless action is taken immediately - the government must cut the highest rate of income tax for the rich, abolish capital gains tax and liberate the rich to make investments wherever they see fit.
zh: 又是我们敌人喜欢的新闻：自由的可怖代价——股市跳水。BAWSAQ股指近日几乎是自由落体，这种新闻能让恐怖分子狂喜，还会让自由派思考如何继续拉低股价。这是多年过度管制、政府干涉和企业家精神消散带来的必然后果，我国让外国人羡慕的正是企业家精神。如不立刻采取行动，我国将会陷入大萧条，还会被一群伊斯兰恐怖分子、同性恋和共产主义者统治。现在政府必须降低富人的个人所得税，废除资本利得税，并且允许富人进行任何可以获利的投资行为。

english: As terrorists try to blow up our way of life and our Rusty Brown's stores, Congress took the courageous move today and passed the Jingoism Act, bringing back some much needed sanity into a country that has lost its way. Family values will be mandatory under the new law, and sodomy has been outlawed completely except in rare cases. Citizens are required to submit their email passwords to their local police to assist in tracking down those who would do harm to our country. Since the liberals desperately want the terrorists to win, this is a goose step in the right direction.
zh: 鉴于恐怖分子想要破坏我们的生活和Rusty Brown甜品店，国会今天迈出了极具魄力的一步——通过沙文主义法案，这将给我们迷途的国家带回些许亟需的理智。新法施行后，构建家庭观念将成法定义务，肛交成为违法行为(特殊情况除外)。公民需要将自己的邮箱密码交给当地警方，以协助追查可能危害国家安全的人。既然自由派这么希望恐怖分子获胜，本法案必定是向正确方向迈出的一大步。

english: Otherwise, an important part of our population is going to suffer unfairly - the wealthy will be punished again as they have to pick up the tab for the government's mismanagement of the economy and the war on terror. We have said it before on Weazel: we are a nuclear power; we should blitz the economy and our enemies.
zh: 如不行动，我国人口中的重要组成部分就会受到不公平对待：富人们不仅要为政府在经济方面的失策和反恐战争买单，还要再被割一刀。之前我们在Weazel电台说过：我们是核国家，我们应当闪击经济和敌人。

english: At least someone amongst the bunch of liberals, degenerates and immigrant lovers in Liberty City's governing team understands the problems our society faces. Deputy Mayor Dawkins made an intelligent and impassioned speech yesterday in which he stood up for family values and against the liberal monopoly on ideas. His ideas were simple - so simple a five year old could understand them - and that's the kind of idea that made this country great and that our enemies hate.
zh: 自由城政府的那些自由派、废人、移民爱好者中，总算有个明白人发现了我们社会面临的真正问题。道金斯副市长昨天发表了一篇雄才远略慷慨激昂的演讲，他在演讲中为捍卫家庭观念发声，极力反对自由派的一言堂。他的观点十分简单，简单到五岁小孩都能理解，正是这种想法造就了我国的伟大，我们的敌人憎恨的也正是这种想法。

english: He said what we all think and are afraid to admit - gay people cause terrorism. Not directly, of course, but by giving our enemies reason to hate us. Our enemies don't hate us because we bomb them or protect vicious absolute monarchies in oil rich states - that's left wing poppy cock. Our enemies hate us because we tolerate degenerates. The sooner we all accept this, the sooner we can begin to win the war on terror, which is also a war on our families. Thank you, Mr. Dawkins.
zh: 他说出了我们不敢承认的想法：同性恋导致恐怖主义。当然，并不是直接导致的，但同性恋给了敌人憎恨我们的理由。敌人憎恨我们，不是因为我们对他们开展轰炸，也不是因为我们维护石油大国的残暴君主专制，而是因为我们对退化废人的容忍。我们越早接受这一现实，就能越早打赢这场反恐战争，这场战争同时也是捍卫我们家庭的战争。谢谢你，道金斯先生。

english: Still underperforming globally, the markets have been volatile due to the underperforming economies of Europe. With everything twice as expensive due to the ridiculous price of gas, cigarettes and liquor, the underperforming continent is having a major effect on the rest of the world.
zh: 欧洲经济的下行给全球市场带来波动，全球经济仍不景气。油气、烟草、酒水的价格疯涨致使物价几乎翻了一番。经济下行的欧洲大陆正在给世界带来巨大影响。

english: In an attempt to discourage employees from taking three-hour lunch breaks, as is customary in Europe, some companies there have decided to start allowing drinking in the workplace, which is customary if not legal in the US. It is also believed that this will promote carpooling and make fellow employees more pleasing on the eye.
zh: 为了缩短欧洲惯例的三小时午餐休息，一些欧洲公司开始允许雇员在工位饮酒，不过这在美国已经是不成文的规矩了。这一措施还有望提高雇员的拼车意愿，让雇员们有更多的机会发现彼此身上的魅力。

english: Senator Charles Martin said, "We were in a never-ending loop with border security. You keep seeing the same faces again and again. However, we have broken that cycle. Giving greater authority to our brave men and women who are sitting in the hot desert for days straight to find a permanent solution to this problem is working. Granted, a few families driving back from a vacation in Mexico have been gunned down at border checkpoints, but security is our number one concern. There will always be some collateral damage."
zh: 参议员查尔斯･马丁说：「过去我们在边境问题上陷入了死循环，来来回回看见的永远是那几张脸，但现在这个循环被打破了。守在炙热沙漠中的勇敢男女一直在寻找一劳永逸的解决方案，而将更大的裁量权交给他们正是灵丹妙药。的确，有几户从墨西哥度完假回来的人家在边检站被枪杀，但安全才是最重要的。有一些副作用也是在所难免。」

english: Calling it repugnant but highly effective, even Bash America First liberals agree that the new border security bill is working. Many politicians supported the new law which was written by the group Border Agents Love Land Security, an organization composed of many brave soldiers recently dishonorably discharged from the military.
zh: 向来「先找美国原因」的自由派嘴上虽然厌恶新的边境安全法案，但也认可了新法案的效率之高。边境爱国警卫队(BALLS)拟订的这一新法得到了许多政治家的支持，该组织的主要成员为近日被开除军籍的英勇士兵。

english: The ~r~Russian gang members~s~ are in the alleyway just off Carrollton Street doing a deal. Take Badman to them.
zh: ~r~俄国黑帮~s~在卡罗尔顿街的小巷里交易。带巴德曼去那里。

english: You must keep Brian in sight. Get back in ~y~position.~s~
zh: 你必须让布莱恩保持在你的视野中，回到~y~位置上。~s~

english: She's slowing down. Get ready to park up. Keep her in sight but don't get too close.
zh: 她正在减速，准备停车。确保她在视野内，注意保持距离。

english: Use ~PAD_LSTICK_ALL~ to move the camera. Zoom in and out using ~PAD_RSTICK_UPDOWN~. Press ~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~ to capture an image. When taking a photo of a person make sure you get a clear shot of their face.
zh: 用~PAD_LSTICK_ALL~移动相机，用~PAD_RSTICK_UPDOWN~进行缩放。按~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~拍照。拍人时确保能拍到脸。

english: Use ~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~ to move the camera. Zoom in and out using ~PAD_LSTICK_UPDOWN~. Press ~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~ to capture an image. When taking a photo of a person make sure you get a clear shot of their face.
zh: 用~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~移动相机，用~PAD_LSTICK_UPDOWN~缩放。按~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~拍照。拍人物时确保能清楚拍到脸。

english: They are going inside the cafe, wait until they reach the bar and take a photo of the ~r~couple.~s~ Don't get too close.
zh: 他们要进入咖啡厅了，等他们到达吧台后并拍下那对~r~男女。~s~别靠太近。

english: Clay is on his way to deliver a bike to you. It is indicated by the ~BLIP_126~ on the radar.
zh: 科雷正在为你送车的途中，小地图上的~BLIP_126~表示他的位置。

english: Jim has left a 9mm Pistol with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的9mm手枪。

english: Jim has left a Micro SMG with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的微型冲锋枪。

english: Jim has left a SMG with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的冲锋枪。

english: Jim has left an Automatic 9mm with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的全自动9mm手枪。

english: Each time you successfully complete a job with Terry and Clay they will become more fight hardened.
zh: 与特里和科雷一起完成任务可以提升他们的战斗力。

english: As Terry and Clay get more fight hardened, their abilities and choices of weapons will improve.
zh: 随着战斗力的提升，特里和科雷的能力和武器也会得到强化。

english: Losing the cops with Terry and Clay will make them more fight hardened.
zh: 与特里和科雷一起摆脱通缉可以提升他们的战斗力。

english: Riding in formation with Terry and Clay will make them more fight hardened.
zh: 与特里和科雷一起车队骑行可以提升他们的战斗力。

english: Terry and Clay are on their way to join you. They are indicated by ~b~~BLIP_95~~s~ and ~b~~BLIP_96~~s~ on the radar.
zh: 特里和科雷在过来支援你的路上了。小地图上的~b~~BLIP_95~~s~和~b~~BLIP_96~~s~表示他们当前的位置。

english: Reinforce positive playtime, family values and gender roles with the Gender Role Doll.
zh: 寓教于乐，玩性别角色娃娃的同时，还能学习家庭观念和性别角色。

english: America's best-selling men's lifestyle magazine! It's the 21st century - worship yourself. Bandit!
zh: 畅销全美的男性生活杂志！现在是21世纪，崇拜自己吧。Bandit！

english: The Uptown Riders are a group of urban riding enthusiasts based out of Northwood in Liberty City.
zh: 「上城骑士」热爱在都市中骑行，以自由城的北伍德为活动范围。

english: Men wanted to treat women like objects, ride motorcycles, and say fuck off to anyone who looked different - they joined the AODMC
zh: 死亡天使收人标准：物化娘们，骑摩托车，党同伐异。

english: Go see Liz Torres. She might be able to unload some of that shit we found. If it's cool, you can collect from Brian off Inchon Ave.
zh: 去见莉兹·托雷斯。我们弄到的那批货，她也许能处理掉。要是没问题，就去仁川大道那边的布莱恩那儿取。

english: You ever need some firepower, let me know. I might just be able to drop off what you're looking for in the House.
zh: 需要火力了就跟我说一声。说不定我能帮你弄来，扔在会所的桌上。

english: Ha ha. Johnny, I've sent you a link to the Deadbeats' website. Check it out!
zh: 哈哈。强尼，我给你发了死妈天使网站的链接。去看看吧！

english: Johnny, I'm getting bored of this business shit. Let's have fun sometime.
zh: 强尼，天天干正事也太无聊了。有空一起出去玩吧。

english: All work and no play makes Johnny a dull boy. Let's hang.
zh: 只工作不放松，强尼马上变笨逼。有空一起出去吧。

english: Dude, you ever need some help, Terry and Clay can back you up. Just call one of em.
zh: 老兄，要是需要支援，特里和科雷都能帮你。需要支援就找他们。

english: Now that you're chapter leader you should take advantage. Get Terry and Clay up off their asses and make em help you.
zh: 现在你是分会会长了，多用点权力。叫特里和科雷过来帮你忙吧。

english: I feel like you're giving Terry and Clay an easy ride, dude. Give 'em a call and make 'em help you out.
zh: 感觉你让特里和科雷太轻松了，老兄。给他们打个电话，让他们来支援你吧。

english: These are fucked up times, dude. Remember to get T and C to help you if shit gets tough.
zh: 现在的日子不好过啊，老兄。出状况了记得叫T和C来支援你。

english: Shit, man. Jackie's gonna kill me when she sees these bruises. Nice racing.
zh: 妈的，兄弟。看见这些淤青，杰基会杀了我的。好车技。

english: I enjoyed the race, even if it nearly killed me. Call me soon, brother.
zh: 我很享受这场赛车，虽然我被揍了个半死。有空再联系，兄弟。

english: Shit, hitting you with that bat was the best part of the race for me. How about you?
zh: 妈的，拿棍子揍你真的是比赛中最棒的部分。你觉得呢？

english: I should play for the Swingers after that bat work. Nice race, dude.
zh: 这么会耍棍子，我应该考虑下加入浪人队了。好车技，老兄。

english: You ain't gonna win those raaces if you're all pacifist with it. Later on, brother.
zh: 赛车还当和平主义者，那你就别想赢了。回见，兄弟。

english: Johnny man. You're the friendliest biker I know. Get aggressive in the next race.
zh: 强尼老兄，你是我见过的最友好的飞车党。下场比赛凶一点吧。

english: We should hang out at the clubhouse sometime, do arm wrestling, play pool, or play cards. Or we could play air hockey, play darts, or play pool - shit, there's all kinds of stuff we can do. Call me.
zh: 改天我们一起去会所玩会儿吧。扳扳手腕，打打台球，打打牌。也可以玩桌上冰球、飞镖或者台球，妈的，能做的多了去了。有空联系。

english: You should sleep in Brian's old apartment - he won't be turning up there again. Sure beats that old bed at the clubhouse.
zh: 你去布莱恩的那间公寓睡觉吧，反正他不会再出现了。总比会所的破床好。

english: Me and the boys have fixed up Brian's apartment after the fire. You should sleep there. It's still a shithole, but might be better than that old bed at the clubhouse.
zh: 我和弟兄们已经把上次烧掉的布莱恩的公寓修好了。你应该去那里睡觉。虽然也没好到哪去，但是总比会所的破床要好。

english: Hey man, don't tell Jackie that I stayed in the club. Thanks, dude.
zh: 嘿，兄弟，别告诉杰基我在会所过夜。谢了，老兄。

english: Sorry, man. I wasn't gonna leave that club. You'll know what I'm talking about when you get married. Later.
zh: 抱歉，兄弟。我今天就待在会所了。等你结婚就知道我这话的意思了。回见。

english: Something about faked terrorist acts gets me all excited, Klebitz. You can either take out the chopper as it lands or deal with the convoy as it makes its way out of the airport. By the way, I've got a man at the Southwest gate who can help you if you're locked into the runway area. - TS III
zh: 伪造恐怖袭击让我很兴奋，克雷比兹。你可以轰烂正在降落的直升机，也可以袭击离开机场的车队。对了，万一你被困在机场里面，西南门有我的人可以帮你出去。 - TS III

english: Excellent work. Call 123-555-0160 if you want to tune into that listening device of yours. - TS III
zh: 干得漂亮。如果你想听那个窃听器，拨打 123-555-0160 - TS III

english: I still got work for you to do. Give me a call if you need a job. - TS III
zh: 我还有活给你干。需要活儿就给我打电话。——TS 三世

english: My sources tell me you've been locked inside the airport. There's a man on the Southwest gate who can unlock it for you. - TS III
zh: 消息说，你被锁在机场里面了。西南门上有个人能帮你开。

english: A friend of mine asked me to pass on the number of her boyfriend's cab business. It's called Bellic Enterprises and it's 555-2222. - Liz
zh: 朋友让我帮忙宣传她男友的叫车服务。贝利克集团，号码 555-2222。 - 莉兹

english: Johnny! I spoke to your friend Jim and he's says you need work. He's sending a friend of his called Malc as well. Meet me at my apartment. - Liz
zh: 强尼！我跟你的朋友吉姆聊过了，他说你在找活干。他还带了个叫马尔科姆的朋友过来。来我的公寓找我。 - 莉兹

english: You're like my fucking ex wife, always standing me up. Screw you, man.
zh: 你他妈怎么跟我前妻一个德性，老是放我鸽子。去你妈的，哥们。

english: I don't mean to sound like a bitch, but come on dude. Where were you?
zh: 我也不想说这种婊子会说的话。不过拜托，老兄，你人呢？

english: Hey man. You need help, call me or Clay.
zh: 嘿，兄弟。需要支援了，就给我或者科雷打个电话。

english: Hey, Prez. Call me or Clay if you need some backup.
zh: 嘿，头儿。需要支援了就给我或者科雷打个电话。

english: Me and Clay are here to help out on Club business, Prez. Just call one of us.
zh: 我和科雷加入失落帮就是为了给帮会做事的，头儿。有事打个电话。

english: Johnny, man. You ever need to replenish your weapons supply, call me and I'll bring round the War Wagon.
zh: 强尼，兄弟。需要补充武器了就给我打个电话，我会开战车过来的。

english: Man, why ain't you calling? I can take my bitch of an ex walking out, but not my brothers.
zh: 兄弟，怎么没见你找我们啊？我可以把娘们扔在一旁，但不会抛弃兄弟。

english: Fuck, man. You smacked me good. Serves me right for racing with an asshole like you. Ha ha ha.
zh: 操了，兄弟。你打我打得好狠。不过跟你这种混蛋一起赛车，我活该被打。哈哈哈。

english: Shit. Was that you that smacked me? Pleasure racing with you.
zh: 妈的，敲我的人是不是你？和你一起飙车很高兴。

english: Johnny K, smacks his own brother in the face to try and beat him in a race. Let's hang out soon.
zh: 强尼 K，给兄弟脸上一棍，还想往冠军席混。以后一起出去吧。

english: Nothing like having a bike between your legs and a bat in your hand. Sorry if I hit you too hard, John.
zh: 胯下一台车，手上一根棍，真是太爽了。没给你放水不好意思啊，约翰。

english: Let's do that again, Johnny. I could get used to hitting you in the face with a bat. Ha ha ha.
zh: 以后再来赛车啊，强尼。我可以习惯棍子甩你脸上的手感的。哈哈哈。

english: Too bad, Johnny. You might do better if you actually made contact with that bat of yours.
zh: 真可惜，强尼。要是你和铁棍多沟通，说不定能做得更好。

english: You're a pleasure to race with, Johnny. Mainly coz you don't know how to use your bat. Ha ha.
zh: 和你赛车很愉快，强尼。主要是因为你不会耍铁棍。哈哈。

english: You may not have won the race, but you upset anyone with your bat. Good for you, man. Call me soon.
zh: 也许你是没赢得比赛，但你的棍术实在是菜。努努力，兄弟。有空联系。

english: Thanks for leaving me at the club, dude. Nothing cooler than a divorced man lone wolfing it amongst the strippers. See you soon.
zh: 谢谢你把我扔在脱衣舞俱乐部，老兄。离婚大叔单挑一众脱衣舞女真是太酷了。再见了。

english: Hey dude, I oughta left with you. Just left that place with a bunch of debt and a sore cock. Later.
zh: 喂，老兄，我就该跟你一起走的。刚从那里出来，赊了点账，叫了只鸡。回见。

english: I hope you're having fun, man. Because you missed out.
zh: 希望你玩得高兴，兄弟。不来找我们总有更好的去处吧。

english: I'm itching to see some action, man. Let me know if you need Terry and me behind you.
zh: 我现在很想战一战，兄弟。需要特里和我来支援你就说一声。

english: Me and T are itching for some action. Unleash us, man. Come on.
zh: 我和T都想动动筋骨。满足我们吧，兄弟。来吧。

english: You ever need a bike delivered, just call the Road Captain. Yours truly.
zh: 哪天需要送辆摩托过来，就给本行车长打个电话。此致。

english: You call that a hit, man? My little sister can hit harder than that. Let's race again soon.
zh: 你管这叫比赛，老兄？我妹妹水平都比你高了。改天再比一次吧。

english: We need a rematch. I wanna see if you're just as cold next time we race.
zh: 还是得重赛一场。我倒要看看下次比赛你是不是还是这么冷酷。

english: You hit your own brother? I'm shocked, Johnny. Let's have a rematch soon.
zh: 自家兄弟都打？太让我震惊了，强尼。改天重赛吧。

english: Oh, Johnny. You're an easy target. If you ain't scared, let's race again soon.
zh: 哦，强尼。你太好对付了。没吓出阴影的话，就择日再赛一场吧。

english: Shit. Was that you I hit? I hope so. Call me soon, man.
zh: 妈的，被我打到的是你吗？希望是你。再联系啊，兄弟。

english: Johnny, man. Racing's a sport for aggressive men. You should stick to darts.
zh: 强尼，兄弟。赛车的时候要硬气点。你还是回去投飞镖吧。

english: Johnny, man. Maybe we should play air hockey next time. You ain't even man enough to swing a bat.
zh: 强尼兄弟，下次我们还是打桌上冰球吧。你居然连挥棒的勇气都没有。

english: The give you the bat so you hit people, Johnny. Next time why don't you use it?
zh: 给你棍子是用来敲人的，强尼。下次能用一用吗？

english: You ain't on the track to make friends. If you need to hit someone in the face to win, fucking do it. See you soon, man.
zh: 赛车不是用来交朋友的。想赢必须给别人一闷棍，别手软。再见了，兄弟。

english: Johnny I heard your Hexer got messed up, call me and ill get it fixed up and will bring it to you.
zh: 强尼，听说你的迷魅光轮出事了，给我打个电话，我就能帮你修好送过来。

english: Brother, why'd you leave the stripclub? You get jealous of my gifts with the finer sex? Maybe you coulda learned something.
zh: 兄弟，你怎么直接走了？是嫉妒我天资超凡的性功能吗？下次看着点学着点。

english: Thanks for giving me some space with the ladies at the club. You were seriously killing my vibe, dude. We'll hang soon, yeah?
zh: 谢谢你在脱衣舞俱乐部给我和妹妹留下私人空间啊。这样真的太扫兴了，老兄。有空再出去，好吗？

english: I've got some more bikes that need getting. We got to keep making money, man. Call me.
zh: 我需要的摩托还有很多。钱还是要继续赚的，兄弟。有空联系。

english: ~s~The special icon above the radar is a mission replay text message. Press ~INPUT_PHONE_TAKE_OUT~ to read this message and select the ~h~replay~s~ option to replay the last mission you failed.
zh: ~s~小地图上方的特殊图标是重玩任务的短信。按~INPUT_PHONE_TAKE_OUT~阅读短信后选择~h~重玩~s~可以重新开始刚才失败的任务。

english: ~s~You can play online with your friends via the multiplayer option on the phone. This allows you to play with other Social Club users.
zh: ~s~通过手机中的多人游戏选项，你可以与你的朋友在线联机，也可以与其他Social Club用户共同游戏。

english: ~s~For a quick online game select the Instant Play option in the phone menu.
zh: ~s~若想快速加入一局多人游戏，请选择手机菜单中的即刻加入。

english: The ~BLIP_114~ icon represents the meeting point for a gang war. Go to that location to meet with other Lost members. In gang wars you will battle with other gangs. There will be various gang wars around the city.
zh: ~BLIP_114~图标表示帮派战争的集合地点。前往图标所示地点与其他失落帮成员会合，然后与其他帮派进行战斗。城市各处有许多帮派战争。

english: There will always be various gang wars around the city. These will be represented by the ~BLIP_114~ icon. Gang wars are a good way to increase how battle hardened Lost gang members become.
zh: 城市各处有许多帮派战争，在地图上以~BLIP_114~图标表示。帮派战争可以提高失落帮成员的战斗力。

english: 10 Gang Wars completed: Sawn-off shotgun delivered to safehouse.
zh: 已完成10场帮派战争：短管霰弹枪已送至安全屋。

english: 20 Gang Wars completed: Semi-automatic pistol delivered to safehouse.
zh: 已完成20场帮派战争：半自动手枪已送至安全屋。

english: 40 Gang Wars completed: Assault shotgun delivered to safehouse.
zh: 已完成40场帮派战争：突击霰弹枪已送至安全屋。

english: 50 Gang Wars completed: Grenade launcher delivered to safehouse.
zh: 已完成50场帮派战争：榴弹发射器已送至安全屋。

english: You can cancel an activity after it has been arranged. Use the option on the phone under Jim's name. He will prefer to be warned than stood up.
zh: 在安排活动后你仍然可以取消它。使用手机中吉姆下的选项取消。比起被放鸽子，他更乐意事先得到通知。

english: You can take Jim to any location marked on the radar, or to the location of other activities.
zh: 你可以带吉姆去小地图上标记的任何地点，亦可进行未标注的其他活动。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Jim. Take him home or go on another activity if you have found one. You can go on up to 3 additional activities.
zh: 你已完成了与吉姆的预定安排。送他回家或再进行一项其他活动。你最多可以追加三项活动。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Jim. You have already taken him on 3 additional activities. Take him home.
zh: 你已完成了与吉姆的预定安排。你已追加了三项活动。送他回家。

english: You are drunk. Your vision is blurred and you will find it difficult to walk and drive. Try to keep your balance and take Jim home. You'll sober up soon.
zh: 你喝醉了。视线一片模糊，行走和驾驶也变得十分困难。尽量保持平衡，送吉姆回家。很快就会恢复正常的。

english: Compete with Jim at Arm Wrestling ~BLIP_110~ or Cards ~BLIP_112~ one floor up. Leave the Clubhouse to quit hanging out with Jim.
zh: 上楼向吉姆挑战掰手腕~BLIP_110~或纸牌~BLIP_112~。离开会所可以结束与吉姆的约会。

english: You can cancel an activity after it has been arranged. Use the option on the phone under Terry's name. He will prefer to be warned than stood up.
zh: 在安排活动后你仍然可以取消它。使用手机中特里下的选项取消。比起被放鸽子，他更乐意事先得到通知。

english: You can take Terry to any location marked on the radar, or to the location of other activities.
zh: 你可以带特里去小地图上标记的任何地点，亦可进行未标注的其他活动。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Terry. Take him home or go on another activity if you have found one. You can go on up to 3 additional activities.
zh: 你已完成了与特里的预定安排。送他回家或再进行一项其他活动。你最多可以追加三项活动。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Terry. You have already taken him on 3 additional activities. Take him home.
zh: 你已完成了与特里的预定安排。你已追加了三项活动。送他回家。

english: You are drunk. Your vision is blurred and you will find it difficult to walk and drive. Try to keep your balance and take Terry home. You'll sober up soon.
zh: 你喝醉了。视线一片模糊，行走和驾驶也变得十分困难。尽量保持平衡，送特里回家。很快就会恢复正常的。

english: Compete with Terry at Arm Wrestling ~BLIP_110~ or Cards ~BLIP_112~ one floor up. Leave the Clubhouse to quit hanging out with Terry.
zh: 上楼向特里挑战掰手腕~BLIP_110~或纸牌~BLIP_112~。离开会所可以结束与特里的约会。

english: You can cancel an activity after it has been arranged. Use the option on the phone under Clay's name. He will prefer to be warned than stood up.
zh: 在安排活动后你仍然可以取消它。使用手机中科雷下的选项取消。比起被放鸽子，他更乐意事先得到通知。

english: You can take Clay to any location marked on the radar, or to the location of other activities.
zh: 你可以带科雷去小地图上标记的任何地点，亦可进行未标注的其他活动。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Clay. Take him home or go on another activity if you have found one. You can go on up to 3 additional activities.
zh: 你已完成了与科雷的预定安排。送他回家或再进行一项其他活动。你最多可以追加三项活动。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Clay. You have already taken him on 3 additional activities. Take him home.
zh: 你已完成了与科雷的预定安排。你已追加了三项活动。送他回家。

english: You are drunk. Your vision is blurred and you will find it difficult to walk and drive. Try to keep your balance and take Clay home. You'll sober up soon.
zh: 你喝醉了。视线一片模糊，行走和驾驶也变得十分困难。尽量保持平衡，送科雷回家。很快就会恢复正常的。

english: Compete with Clay at Arm Wrestling ~BLIP_110~ or Cards ~BLIP_112~ one floor up. Leave the Clubhouse to quit hanging out with Clay.
zh: 上楼向科雷挑战掰手腕~BLIP_110~或纸牌~BLIP_112~。离开会所可以结束与科雷的约会。

english: Terry and Clay's stats are displayed just above the radar. For these characters you can see more info on the stats by pressing ~INPUT_PHONE_PUT_AWAY~.
zh: 特里和科雷的状态会在小地图上方显示。按下~INPUT_PHONE_PUT_AWAY~可以查看他们的更多信息。

english: Terry and Clay's stats are displayed just above the radar. For these characters you can see more info on the stats by pressing ~INPUT_FRONTEND_SHOWSCORE~.
zh: 特里和科雷的状态会在小地图上方显示。按下~INPUT_FRONTEND_SHOWSCORE~可以查看他们的更多信息。

english: The details displayed above the radar show how fight hardened your Lost gang members are. This is represented by the colored bar next to their names.
zh: 小地图上方的图表表示此次作战对你战友的强化程度，具体程度以名字右侧的色块表示。

english: Gang members get harder each time they complete a job with you. They will become more effective in gun battles.
zh: 每当你的战友与你共同完成一项差事后，他们的战斗力就会得到提升。

english: If they die on a job they will be replaced by a new Lost gang member.
zh: 若有人在某次差事中战死，就会由一名新的失落帮成员顶替。

english: You can now use Jim's special ability. You can call up Jim and select "Weapons" and he will stash your fully loaded weapon in the Lost Clubhouse.
zh: 你现在可以使用吉姆的特殊能力了。呼叫吉姆时选择「武器」，他就会为你在失落帮会所准备满载弹药的武器。

english: You can now use Terry's special ability. You can call up Terry and select "Gun Van" he will arrive at a location near you and sell you guns and equipment at discounted prices.
zh: 你现在可以使用特里的特殊能力了。呼叫特里时选择「军火车」，他就会到你附近的某地向你以低价出售武器装备。

english: You can now use Clay's special ability. You can call up Clay and select "Bikes" he will drop off the bike of your choice near your location.
zh: 你现在可以使用科雷的特殊能力了。呼叫科雷时选择「摩托」，他就会将你选择的摩托送来给你。

english: You can now phone Jim to get a fully loaded weapon left in the Clubhouse arm wrestling room, Clay to bring you a bike, or Terry for cheap weapons and ammo.
zh: 现在你可以呼叫吉姆，让他在会所的掰手腕室准备一把满载弹药的武器，也可以联系科雷送来一辆新车，亦可向特里低价购买武器以及弹药。

english: The autosave pause menu option is used by The Lost and Damned. It is currently switched off. Switch it on again to re-enable autosaving for The Lost and Damned.
zh: 暂停菜单中的自动存档选项由失落与诅咒使用。目前已被关闭。开启后可以启用失落与诅咒的自动存档功能。

english: ~z~~x~Dude. I didn't think I'd get given the third degree. I'll call you back with a locate.
zh: ~z~~x~老兄，我好像连三等学位都没拿到。知道地名了我再打给你。

english: ~z~~x~I dunno. Ain't it enough that I'm calling for help? Fucking bureaucrats.
zh: ~z~~x~不知道。光打过来求救还不管用吗？傻逼官僚主义。

english: ~z~~x~Hello, this is the LCPD, where would you like us to send an officer?
zh: ~z~~x~您好，这里是LCPD，请问您想让我们向哪里出警？

english: ~z~~x~Hello, you're through to the MS Paramedics. In which area is your medical emergency?
zh: ~z~~x~您好，您呼叫的是医疗服务中心，您需要在哪里的医疗应急？

english: ~z~~x~We'll send a basically trained paramedic as soon as we can, sir.
zh: ~z~~x~我们会尽快派出一支训练有素的医疗小组，先生。

english: ~z~~x~Hold tight and please be advised that the FDLC takes no responsibility for damage to property.
zh: ~z~~x~请坚持住。注意，FDLC不对过程中造成的财产损失负任何责任。

english: ~z~~x~I'm sorry, but all our peacekeepers are currently busy filling quotas and dealing with paper work.
zh: ~z~~x~很抱歉，但目前我们的干员都忙于完成指标以及书面工作。

english: ~z~~x~All our lines are busy at the moment, please call again later. Your emergency is important to us.
zh: ~z~~x~目前我们的电话全部占线，请稍后再拨。您的紧急状况对我们十分重要。

english: ~z~It don't matter what the world thinks of America, at least we can still buy guns here.
zh: ~z~世界上其他人怎么评价美国不重要，至少我们还能买到枪。

english: ~z~Don't worry, pal. The recession ain't gonna affect the illegal arms trade.
zh: ~z~别担心，哥们。经济再萧条也影响不到黑市军火。

english: ~z~Thanks man. The next guy I shoot, I'm going to tell him where I shop.
zh: ~z~谢了，兄弟。下次开枪前，我会告诉目标你的店的。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. I had to cut down spending on firearms. This fucking economic downturn...
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟。武器这块只能消费降级了。都他妈怪经济衰退...

english: ~z~You know what, I thought I was gonna go out and kill somebody then I decided not to.
zh: ~z~知道吗，本来我想出门杀几个人，想想还是算了。

english: A biker's running through checkpoints with a gunship at his back. How long will he last?
zh: 一名车手在武装直升机追杀下冲过检查点。他能撑多久？

english: ~m~The ~COL_NET_1~N.O.O.S.E.~m~ must protect the state witnesses while ~COL_NET_2~The ~COL_NET_2~Lost~m~ must take them out.
zh: ~m~~COL_NET_1~N.O.O.S.E. ~m~必须保护州证人，而~COL_NET_2~失落摩托帮~COL_NET_2~~m~必须干掉他们。

english: Get respect within the club. Angus will let you know of any club business.
zh: 在俱乐部里赢得尊重。有任何帮务，安格斯会通知你。

english: ~m~The ~COL_NET_1~biker~m~ tries to get to a checkpoint - the pursuer pilots an attack helicopter hunting them down. When the biker dies, the roles are reversed. Hold ~INPUT_VEH_EXIT~ to respawn your vehicle.
zh: ~m~~COL_NET_1~车手~m~要去冲过一个检查点，追捕者驾驶武装直升机全力追杀。车手一旦死亡，双方角色互换。按住~INPUT_VEH_EXIT~重生载具。

english: ~m~The ~COL_NET_1~N.O.O.S.E.~m~ have to escort witnesses to police stations around the city, while ~COL_NET_2~The Lost~m~ try to destroy the transport bus and take out the snitches before they talk.
zh: ~m~~COL_NET_1~N.O.O.S.E. ~m~必须把证人押送到城中各警察局，而~COL_NET_2~失落摩托帮~m~要摧毁押运巴士，在告密者开口前干掉他们。

english: ~m~Angus will keep you informed as to what's on the agenda for The Lost MC. Complete tasks to gain standing within the Club.
zh: ~m~失落摩托车俱乐部的日程安排，安格斯会随时告知你。完成任务可在俱乐部中提升地位。

english: ~m~Race to the finish, passing through each checkpoint in order. Hold ~INPUT_VEH_EXIT~ to respawn your vehicle on the last checkpoint passed. Bikers don't play fair so you've been given a bat to wield. Crack the heads of any racers who come close enough.
zh: ~m~冲向终点，按顺序通过每个检查点。按住~INPUT_VEH_EXIT~可在最后通过的检查点重生载具。车手们从不守规矩，所以给了你一根球棒。谁敢靠近，就敲碎谁的脑袋。

english: ~m~Starting on foot, get from the starting position to the finish line by any means necessary. First one there wins.
zh: ~m~从起点出发，用你能想到的任何办法赶往终点。最先到达者获胜。

english: ~m~Starting on foot, get to the next point on the map however you can. Proceed through the points in order. First one to finish wins.
zh: ~m~从起点出发，用你能想到的任何办法赶到地图上的下一个点。按顺序通过各点。最先完成者获胜。

english: ~m~Take the other faction out. The faction with the most cash at the end wins. Remember to loot the cash dropped by deceased players. That's how to gain dominance.
zh: ~m~干掉另一阵营。结束时现金最多的阵营获胜。记得捡走阵亡玩家掉落的现金，这才是夺得上风的方法。

english: ~m~Take as much territory as you can. A territory becomes yours when all its defenders are dead. While you own a territory, members of your club will appear to defend it. Your club's Gun Van is marked with a square blip on your radar. Drive it near your defenders to equip them with better weaponry.
zh: ~m~尽可能多地夺取地盘。守方全部阵亡后，该地盘即归你所有。你占据地盘期间，帮会成员会出现协防。帮会的军火车在小地图上以方形标记显示。把车开到防守者附近，可为他们配备更好的武器。

english: ~m~One player is the ~COL_NET_1~Lone Wolf Biker~m~, racing to checkpoints while evading the ~COL_NET_2~pursuers~m~. Kill the Lone Wolf Biker and it'll be you getting hunted - and you'll become invincible for ten seconds. Pursuers can hold ~INPUT_VEH_EXIT~ to respawn their vehicles.
zh: ~m~一名玩家扮演~COL_NET_1~独狼车手~m~，在逃避~COL_NET_2~追捕者~m~的同时冲向检查点。杀死独狼车手，被追杀的就换成你——而且你会获得十秒无敌。追捕者可按住~INPUT_VEH_EXIT~重生载具。

english: ~m~Kill the other bikers as many times as you can. The biker with the most cash when the game ends wins. Remember to loot the cash dropped by your dead adversaries.
zh: ~m~尽可能多地击杀其他车手。游戏结束时现金最多的车手获胜。记得捡走阵亡对手掉落的现金。

english: ~m~Kill the other bikers as many times as you can. The biker with the most cash when the game ends wins. Remember to loot the cash dropped by your dead adversaries.
zh: ~m~尽可能多地击杀其他车手。游戏结束时现金最多的车手获胜。记得捡走阵亡对手掉落的现金。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Witness Protection.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 证人保护对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Club Business.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 帮务对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Race.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 竞速对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Team Deathmatch.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 团队死斗对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Own the City.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 争夺城市对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Lone Wolf Biker.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 独狼车手对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Deathmatch.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 死斗对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Instant Play.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 快速开局对局。

english: You have been invited to play GTAIV:The Lost and Damned - Freemode.
zh: 你被邀请参加 GTA IV：失落与诅咒 - 自由模式对局。

english: Team Game. The N.O.O.S.E. must protect the state witnesses while The Lost must take them out.
zh: 团队游戏。N.O.O.S.E. 必须保护州证人，而失落摩托帮必须干掉他们。

english: Select this option to jump straight into a player match free-for-all game, bypassing the lobby screen.
zh: 选择此项可直接进入玩家对战的混战模式，跳过大厅界面。

english: Coop Game. Get respect within the club. Angus will let you know of any club business.
zh: 合作游戏。在俱乐部里赢得尊重。有任何帮务，安格斯会通知你。

english: One biker on the run. How long could you last with everyone else chasing you?
zh: 一名车手被全程追杀。被所有人追着跑，你能撑多久？

english: A biker's running through checkpoints with a gunship at his back. How long will he last?
zh: 一名车手在武装直升机的追杀下冲过检查点。他能撑多久？

english: Johnny will need the bike to ride in convoy with the other Lost bikers.
zh: 只有骑在摩托上，强尼才能在失落帮车队中骑行。

english: This is Johnny's Hexer. It's the only one of its kind in Liberty City.~n~A modern classic chopper with a 2032cc twin cam engine and 6 speed transmission with a final chain drive.
zh: 这是强尼的 Hexer，在自由城独一无二。~n~它是一台现代复古摩托，搭载 2032cc 双凸轮发动机、六速变速箱和链条传动。

english: Enter and stay on the badge to hold the gang formation. This will increase your health and repair your bike.
zh: 在会徽内骑行以保持队形，这将增加你的生命值和护甲，修复你的摩托。

english: If you lose your ride, a phone call to Clay will get you an alternative bike.
zh: 若你失去了你的座驾，给科雷打个电话就能得到备用摩托。

english: A Lost Motorcycle Club badge will appear behind Billy when cruising in a gang.
zh: 车队行进时，比利车后会出现失落摩托帮的会徽。

english: Sleeping on the bed will save the game and advance time by six hours.
zh: 上床睡觉会保存游戏进度，并将时间推进6个小时。

english: You can hang out and take part in activities with fellow members of The Lost.
zh: 你可以与失落帮的其他成员一起出行，进行各种活动。

english: When using the grenade launcher, aim slightly above your target to compensate for gravity.
zh: 使用榴弹发射器时，榴弹会受重力影响下落，应瞄准略高于目标的位置。

english: One of your crew has stolen the armored vehicle. Make your way to the ~Y~rendezvous point.~S~
zh: 你的一个队员已经偷走了装甲车。前往 ~Y~会合点~S~。

english: You each have some explosives. Head out to the ~Y~docks~S~ in Broker.
zh: 你们每个人都有一些炸药。前往布洛克区的 ~Y~码头~S~ 。

english: The bombs have been placed. Everyone needs to disembark to trigger the explosion.
zh: 炸弹已经被安置。所有人都需要下船来引爆炸药。

english: One bomb is in place. Get the other to the second weak spot.
zh: 一个炸弹已经就位。 把另一个炸弹安放在第二个点。

english: There are enemy snipers somewhere on the boat, someone should take up a sniping position and keep watch.
zh: 敌人的狙击手正在船上某处，你们中的一个人要去占领狙击点并且持续监视

english: To reach one of the bomb sites you will need to access the cargo hold from the ship's galley.
zh: 你需要从船上的陈列室进入货仓来到达一个炸弹安放点。

english: If you damage the ~B~armored vehicle~S~ enough it will stop and you can steal it.
zh: 如果你把 ~B~装甲车~S~ 破坏到一定程度它就会停下，你可以趁机偷走它。

english: You are the suspect. Stay alive until you are no longer wanted by the cops.
zh: 你是嫌疑人。保持生存直到你不被警察通缉为止。

english: You are the Ride Captain. Stay alive until all the ~r~Angels of Death~s~ are dead.
zh: 你是骑行队长。 保持生存直到 ~r~死亡天使~s~ 的全部成员死亡。

english: Driving in convoy with the Ride Captain will give you health and money. The Captain will get health and money if everyone is in convoy with him.
zh: 和骑行队长一起开运输者会提高你的生命值和金钱。如果所有人都和骑行队长待在运输者里，骑行队长会得到生命值和金钱

english: This task will involve some members leaving their bikes for other transport - share rides on your way to the objective.
zh: 这个任务中的一些成员会放弃自己的摩托车，转乘其他载具 - 你也可以和其他成员共乘一辆车。

english: You will attract attention in the prison transport bus. Try to avoid the cops on your way to the drop off point.
zh: 驾驶囚车会引起警察怀疑。到达碰头地点前尽量避开警察。
