english: ~z~Put the brakes on your case against Dave Grossman or you'll be one good fucking lawyer, dude.
zh: ~z~停止你对戴夫･格罗斯曼的诉讼，否则我把你变成好律师，伙计。

english: ~z~Davey boy. I got good news, and I got bad news. The good news is the lawyer ain't gonna cause you anymore trouble.
zh: ~z~戴维仔。我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。好消息是那个律师不会给你添麻烦了。

english: ~z~Officer, can you keep this man the hell away from me? And get his details while you're at it. I'll need them in court.
zh: ~z~警官，你能让他离我远点吗？趁你还在赶紧查清他的情况。到时候法庭见。

english: ~z~Give up your flirtations with the outlaw life. You don't know anything about what we do.
zh: ~z~别再装作法外狂徒过家家了。你根本就不了解我们。

english: ~z~There's more to being one of us than writing checks and polishing chrome. Adios.
zh: ~z~失落帮成员的生活不止是开支票和擦摩托。再见。

english: ~z~Hey, hey, cop. Can you take this man into custody? He's caused me physical and emotional harm.
zh: ~z~喂，喂，警察。你能把他抓起来吗？他对我的精神和肉体都造成了损伤。

english: ~z~David, you don't have a legal problem any more, but can you do me a favor?
zh: ~z~戴维，你的法律问题解决了，但你能帮我个忙吗？

english: ~z~She's saying that I looked at her tits, and because I did that, I suppressed her.
zh: ~z~秘书说，我盯着她的奶子看，这种行为是对她的压迫。

english: ~z~You know what they say about guys who spend time in South East Asia, man.
zh: ~z~你也知道别人怎么评价去过东南亚的人吧，老兄。

english: ~z~Get out there, man. There's hardbellies all over this city looking for a man with your gifts.
zh: ~z~放宽心，兄弟。自由城能被你迷倒的小妞有的是。

english: ~z~The craziness, man. You're getting old. You can get out of this shit.
zh: ~z~这种疯狂，兄弟。你年纪大了，可以远离这种生活了。

english: ~z~They can take everything, but you're still a fucking man, Terry. You got that.
zh: ~z~他们能夺走一切，但你还是个男子汉，特里。懂了吗。

english: ~z~Herpes ain't a gift, man. It's a disease. You should keep that shit to yourself.
zh: ~z~疱疹不是礼物，老兄。那是病毒。你还是自己独享吧。

english: ~z~Shit, can we reach out to women as well? Don't think I could do without pussy for fifteen to twenty.
zh: ~z~妈的，能不能再招点娘们？十几二十年不碰女人我可受不了。

english: ~z~Like the country isn't run by five guys behind the scenes.
zh: ~z~搞得跟这个国家不是幕后的五个人做的决策一样。

english: ~z~Alright, man. Then I will rephrase it. The fucking pricks running this country, man.
zh: ~z~好吧，兄弟。那我换一个说法。管理国家的都是傻逼，兄弟。

english: ~z~Fuck, man. I thought the outlaw life would save me from that shit.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟。我还以为法外狂徒就不会有这种闹心事了。

english: ~z~Very funny... sometimes, I find myself thinking what the fuck happened to my country?
zh: ~z~好好笑哦...有时候我在想，我的祖国怎么成了这个样子？

english: ~z~You retiring me? Gonna take me 'round the back and shoot me like a lame horse?
zh: ~z~你叫我退休？绕到我身后，像对待瘸腿马一样给我一枪？

english: ~z~That's life in twenty first century America, my brother. We woke up in a nightmare.
zh: ~z~这就是二十一世纪美国的生活，好兄弟。醒来仍是噩梦。

english: ~z~I'd like to see 'em try and repossess my balls, man. That'll be the day.
zh: ~z~我倒想看看他们能不能收回我的蛋，兄弟。差不多得了。

english: ~z~Dude, you're in The Lost. You're just looking out for your brothers.
zh: ~z~老兄，你是失落帮的一员。你只是在照应兄弟罢了。

english: ~z~Yes, Jesus. Batshit fucking crazy he is, whole family has gone into hiding.
zh: ~z~是啊，上帝啊。他是彻头彻尾地疯了，我全家都躲起来了。

english: ~z~Might do her some good getting shit from her parents after all the crap she gave you.
zh: ~z~给你找了那么多麻烦，也该轮到她的父母给她找点麻烦了。

english: ~z~I don't need your pity man. And she ain't worth your pity, not no more.
zh: ~z~我不需要你同情，兄弟。她也不配被同情，现在的她不配。

english: ~z~I'm on a fucking treadmill, man. Feel I'm running and if I stop everything goes to shit.
zh: ~z~我就像是在跑步机上，兄弟。不能停下来，否则一切就都完了

english: ~z~Clay, man, you get the respect. Got to admire a man who served his country and saw some action overseas.
zh: ~z~科雷，老兄，注意着点。必须对为国效力征战海外的战士心怀敬意。

english: ~z~Know what the American dream is? The house, the car, the family - that bullshit.
zh: ~z~知道美国梦是啥吗？大房子，小轿车，一家人。纯放屁。

english: ~z~I know, brother. But life is hard, man. Take happiness where you can find it.
zh: ~z~我懂的，兄弟。但是人生苦短，老兄。还是要及时行乐啊。

english: ~z~I love you brothers. The heartache... the pain, man. It's good to have you boys. You're constant.
zh: ~z~我爱你们，兄弟们。爱到心痛...爱到痛苦，兄弟。有你们在真好，一直都在。

english: ~z~I don't fucking know... seriously fucking weird coffee by the look of things.
zh: ~z~我他妈也不知道...看样子应该是什么狗屎咖啡吧。

english: ~z~Don't say nothing about this country, Terry. I fought for this country. My friends died for this country.
zh: ~z~别对这个国家逼逼赖赖，特里。我为这个国家而战，我的朋友为了这个国家牺牲。

english: ~z~We can start an all inclusive prison gang. Crossing lines. Reachin' out to every creed and color?
zh: ~z~可以在牢里建一个包容的帮派。打破隔阂，对所有肤色和信仰开放。

english: ~z~Man, I knew God moved in mysterious ways, but that is fucking perverse.
zh: ~z~天，我知道主的意图难以捉摸，但这也太扯了吧。

english: ~z~Johnny Klebitz! Leading the way. You're a real figure of authority, man.
zh: ~z~强尼･克雷比兹！带头冲锋。你的官帽可真高啊，老兄。

english: ~z~Same old shit. Dodging bullets when I'm out and whatever Jackie can throw at me when I'm home. You?
zh: ~z~老样子。出门在外躲子弹，回家躲老婆的暴风雨。你呢？

english: ~z~I'm responsible for my brothers too, Johnny. You included. This shit don't end good.
zh: ~z~我还要对兄弟负责，强尼。对你也是。不会轻易结束的。

english: ~z~It's control man. They make you want that shit so they can trap you.
zh: ~z~都是为了控制你。给你画一个饼，你就掉进陷阱了。

english: ~z~I know, man, I know. You ain't turning snitch on us are you?
zh: ~z~我知道，兄弟，我知道。你该不会出卖我们了吧？

english: ~z~I dunno how you do it, Jim. One woman and she drives you fucking crazy?
zh: ~z~我有点想不明白，吉姆。光一个女人就能把你逼疯吗？

english: ~z~Oh, I'm good. Real good. Found me somethin' fresh. Nice little mattress thrasher.
zh: ~z~噢，我很好。非常好。刚找了个新玩具。超级棒的小骚逼。

english: ~z~Yeah, it's a handicapping system. They put the strongest of us with the weakest. Evens us out.
zh: ~z~这就是差点系统。把最强跟最弱分到一组，拉成平均。

english: ~z~The shit that happened to the kids in my class... I swore to my momma I'd never touch that stuff.
zh: ~z~我同班同学的那些遭遇...我对我妈发过誓，绝不会碰这一行。

english: ~z~Pretty shit, man. Only way they could get worse is if you or Clay turned snitch.
zh: ~z~糟透了，伙计。想要更糟的话就只有你或科雷叛变告发了。

english: ~z~Feds don't need snitches, man. They can pluck conversations outta thin air.
zh: ~z~政府不需要有人告发。现在这样说话他们也能听到。

english: ~z~Then you're working like a dog - breaking your back - and soon there's nothing left.
zh: ~z~让你像条狗一样卖力，榨干你的精力，然后变成一具空壳。

english: ~z~Just keep 'em away from my fucking menorah, man. That's all I ask.
zh: ~z~你别往我的大烛台边上放就行，兄弟。就这点要求。

english: ~z~Place was always a dump brother, difference now is the people ain't buying the bullshit no more.
zh: ~z~这里一直都是粪坑，兄弟。只不过现代人对那些屁话不买账了而已。

english: ~z~How come I'm always stuck with you? Seems like wherever I go, you're right there next to me.
zh: ~z~我怎么一直跟你在一块儿？好像无论去哪儿，你都在我旁边。

english: ~z~For real, man. Fool found God inside and now he's trying to convert anyone in a ten mile radius.
zh: ~z~真的，老兄。那傻逼心里有上帝了，见着个人就跟他传教。

english: ~z~Dude, being in the army, I don't get how you could stay away from America that long.
zh: ~z~老兄，一直在外服役，我都不知道你怎么能在海外待这么久。

english: ~z~Don't put that round, man. I'm clean. I wrap my presents before I put 'em under the tree.
zh: ~z~别提这茬，兄弟。我很干净。我会套上套子再把礼物放到圣诞树下的。

english: ~z~I mean, the boys in there wouldn't take too kindly to my associations with men of your pale pigmentation.
zh: ~z~主要是里面的人未必见得我跟你这种白皮交朋友。

english: ~z~Let's enjoy this, boys - freedom. We ain't dead and we ain't in jail. How long can it last?
zh: ~z~尽情享受吧，各位——享受自由。我们一没有死，二没坐牢。这日子能持续多久？

english: ~z~They can tap any phone they wanna. Shit, federal witnesses became obsolete at the turn of the century.
zh: ~z~所有人的手机都被监听了。妈的，证人保护计划在世纪之交的时候过时了。

english: ~z~That's funny, cause the army still got a bee in their bonnet about homosexuality.
zh: ~z~有意思了，因为军队对同性恋的态度还是那么纠结。

english: ~z~Much as I like that show, I was talking about politicians not hookers.
zh: ~z~虽然我也喜欢，但我问的是政治投票，不是选秀。

english: ~z~Shit, maybe three years. Ever since I was reborn into civilian life.
zh: ~z~妈的，差不多有三年吧。一退伍我就想去旅行了。

english: ~z~I guess I'm just a generous person. I wanna give the gift of brotherhood to the whole US.
zh: ~z~可能是因为我乐善好施吧。我想把这种天赐的兄弟情谊分享到全美。

english: ~z~You boys ever thought about taking this club national? Like the AOD.
zh: ~z~你们有想过在全国发展失落帮吗？就像死亡天使那样。

english: ~z~I mean, what're we gonna do when Johnny gets himself arrested or killed?
zh: ~z~就是说，万一强尼出事死了或者进了局子，我们该怎么办？

english: ~z~This is stupid. Nothin's gonna happen to Johnny. He's charmed.
zh: ~z~说什么傻话。强尼不可能出事的，他是天选之人。

english: ~z~That's pretty funny. I love it when a couple complete each other's thoughts. Real sweet
zh: ~z~真有意思。就喜欢你们这种心有灵犀的情侣。超棒的。

english: ~z~Fuck. I hope there is an afterlife so I can look down upon you fellas.
zh: ~z~操。希望我死了以后还能有机会从阴间看着你们。

english: ~z~No, keep the jokes coming man. It's like being in an '80s sit-com hanging out with you.
zh: ~z~不，接着开玩笑吧，哥们。跟你们出来就像在看80年代的情景喜剧。

english: ~z~You can't blame her. I'd worry if my husband was hanging out with a chump like Johnny.
zh: ~z~这不怪她。我丈夫和强尼这种蠢驴在一起我也急。

english: ~z~I don't know. That guy off the TV, Jeremy St. Somethin'? You've always had a crush on him.
zh: ~z~我不知道。电视上那个Jeremy St。什么的？你一直喜欢他。

english: ~z~Just look for the strung-out tweekers. Please. Come on, baby.
zh: ~z~哪儿有瘾君子就往哪儿走。拜托了，快点，宝贝。

english: ~z~Shit, Johnny. I don't know. It had a red door. Hurry up, I'm crashing hard.
zh: ~z~妈的，强尼，我不知道。红门的公寓。快点，我受不了了。

english: ~z~You're funny, Johnny. You care about everyone else when they're fine. And you end up tying yourself in a knot.
zh: ~z~你真好笑，强尼。别人没事你还一直关心他们，结果搞得自己一团乱麻。

english: ~z~Can't you hear us? These freaks are partying real hard, man. Please.
zh: ~z~你听不见吗？这些疯子闹得动静很大，老兄。拜托了。

english: ~z~Sure, sure. Do you expect me to stay clean when you're not there to look after me?
zh: ~z~确实，确实。没你照顾我，你还指望我洁身自好吗？

english: ~z~Fuck you, Ashley. I ain't changed. I stuck to the code I set myself.
zh: ~z~操你妈，阿什莉。我没变。我坚守自己定下的原则。

english: ~z~I can't talk about this now. Lecture me all you like later on, but right now, I need help. Please, sugar.
zh: ~z~没空聊这些了。之后你爱怎么问怎么问，但现在快来救我。拜托了，甜心。

english: ~z~You try and live by what makes sense, take your own path and it burns you out.
zh: ~z~尽力遵循常理生活，走自己的路，直到燃尽自己。

english: ~z~Oh, baby. You don't mean that, do you? You're all I've got.
zh: ~z~噢，宝贝。你开玩笑的，对吧？你是我的全部了。

english: ~z~I told you. I'm not friends with Tina no more. I ain't gonna lose me to meth..
zh: ~z~我都说了，我现在没跟蒂娜来往了。不会迷失在冰毒里了...

english: ~z~Okay, I'm bad, baby. I'm bad. I know it. You should teach me a lesson.
zh: ~z~好啦，我不好，宝贝。我不好，我知道了。教训我一顿吧。

english: ~z~If I close my eyes they can't see me, if I close my eyes they can't see me.
zh: ~z~闭上眼睛他们就看不见我，闭上眼睛他们就看不见我。

english: ~z~I know I am, Johnny. And you know what's the best thing about me? You. Call me, okay?
zh: ~z~我也知道，强尼。你知道我最大的幸运是什么吗？是你。多联系，好吗？

english: ~z~I think I'm having a heart attack. I feel numb. Oh God, oh God.
zh: ~z~好像要犯心脏病了，我有点麻了。噢天哪，噢天哪。

english: ~z~Damn, Johnny. I thought you cared about me. You can't leave me like this. Johnny...
zh: ~z~妈的，强尼。我还以为你在乎我。你怎么能这样对我，强尼...

english: ~z~Sure, sure she ain't. Thats why you running all over town trying to snatch a fool up, huh? Please.
zh: ~z~对，当然不是。所以才要大老远地去绑架一个傻逼？别吧。

english: ~z~Ahhhh. Help me. Someone. I'm too young to die. Please.
zh: ~z~啊啊啊，救命啊！来人啊！我还不想死啊！拜托！

english: ~z~I knew you were a fucking racist. I fucking knew it. Stop the car.
zh: ~z~就知道你是个种族主义者，我就知道。给我停车。

english: ~z~You should apologize for that smell. You shat yourself or something?
zh: ~z~你还是先为自己的臭味道歉吧。你是拉裤子了吗？

english: ~z~Did you mean to insult us, Mr. Roman Bellic? I sure hope not.
zh: ~z~你是存心侮辱我们吗，罗曼･贝利克？希望不是。

english: ~z~Hey there, babe. Something went wrong. This job isn't happening. Stay safe.
zh: ~z~你好啊，宝贝。出了点岔子。绑架失败了。注意安全。

english: ~z~I'll take you through the bright lights of Star Junction, past the glamorous shops of Middle Park West,
zh: ~z~我会带你们穿越星汇广场的灯火辉煌，看遍中央公园西的繁荣市场。

english: ~z~I'm hoping he ain't too good at poker. Hell, if we're here because of his debts, he can't exactly be the Buffet Car.
zh: ~z~希望他牌技没那么好。妈的，他都欠债到要被人绑架了，总不能是赌神吧。

english: ~z~If he only knew how close he came though. Thanks, Malc.
zh: ~z~可惜他不知道自己离危险有多近。谢了，马尔科姆。

english: ~z~Oh shit, Johnny. Shit. What happened? I thought you were looking out for me.
zh: ~z~噢，天哪，强尼。妈的，什么情况？你不是会帮我的吗？

english: ~z~Hell no, I don't wanna get my hands all dirty and shit. Get gravy all on my new manicured fingers.
zh: ~z~不干，我才不想脏了自己的手。刚修过指甲不想沾油。

english: ~z~Hello, this is Bellic and Bellic Enterprises. What can I assist you with?
zh: ~z~您好，这里是 贝利克&贝利克 集团。有什么我能帮您的吗？

english: ~z~We let him go and he'll come back with a bag full of unmarked twenties, right?
zh: ~z~我们把他放走，以后他就会给我们一麻袋没被标记的20块，对吧？

english: ~z~It's easy. You grab him and deliver him to warehouse, off Lompoc in Bohan Industrial.
zh: ~z~很简单。绑架他，然后送到波汉工业区隆波克大道那里的仓库。

english: ~z~So, yeah this guy we're snatching isn't the only European-type dude I've come across recently.
zh: ~z~其实，在这次绑架之前我已经遇到过一个欧洲人了。

english: ~z~You know, Malc, I think you've got unresolved women issues.
zh: ~z~知道吗，马尔科姆，我觉得你有没解决的女性情结。

english: ~z~I don't know. Both maybe. Fuck it. Shut up for a second.
zh: ~z~我不知道，都有可能吧。无所谓了。闭上你的嘴吧。

english: ~z~If it was a box of donuts you'd get your fat ass in there.
zh: ~z~要是有一盒甜甜圈，你肯定会自己进来。快点，胖子。

english: ~z~We snatch this guy, deliver him to some other guys, then we pat ourselves on the back for doing a great job.
zh: ~z~先抓住他，再把他送过去，然后互相拍拍后背大功告成。

english: ~z~I told you, I like this gun. I ain't getting no bodies on it. Not today.
zh: ~z~哟，我说了，我喜欢这枪。暂时不想沾上血，现在不行。

english: ~z~Dude, you busy? I got something and I don't need it getting round the clubhouse. I'll owe you, brother.
zh: ~z~老兄，有空吗？我有点事，不能让帮里的兄弟知道。算我欠你的，兄弟。

english: ~z~-Your woman here owes Dimitri Rascalov a lot of money.~n~-Okay.
zh: ~z~－你的女人欠了迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫一笔巨款。~n~－好。

english: ~z~Where you off to, Johnny boy? We kind of in the middle of something right here, man.
zh: ~z~你要去哪儿，强尼仔？我们还有事要办呢，哥们。

english: ~z~If you want Wingit Presentation before every job you do, you're running with the wrong crowd.
zh: ~z~做什么事之前都要长篇大论，我又不是那种领导。

english: ~z~And this here job - smells like a bitch to me. It got bitch-stink all over it, son.
zh: ~z~这次的活儿，闻着就像是臭娘们。一股子骚味儿，小子。

english: ~z~Just pop the fucker. And you can get the bullets outta him afterwards and no one's gonna trace that shit back to you.
zh: ~z~赶紧崩了他。待会儿把子弹掏出来就行了，条子查不到你身上的。

english: ~z~Yeah we just stole this guy, too. But I guess we gotta let him go. I'll be seeing the both of you.
zh: ~z~这哥们也是刚绑来的。不过只能放过他了。两位以后再见。

english: ~z~Why are all you bikers racist, just like the Angels of Death?
zh: ~z~就说死亡天使吧，你们飞车党怎么都搞种族歧视？

english: ~z~Ashley, you need to tell your Russian loan shark that the guy they're after is dead.
zh: ~z~阿什莉，麻烦你转告你的俄国债主，他们要的人死了。

english: ~z~Those Russians have got their guy. You got lucky, but you got to control yourself, Ashley.
zh: ~z~人质交给俄国人了。算你走运，麻烦你管住自己，阿什莉。

english: ~z~Ummm, Johnny, my dude, we're going to do this or what? What the fuck is wrong with you?
zh: ~z~呃...强尼，好兄弟，我们还办不办事了？你他妈犯病了是吧？

english: ~z~who preferred rusty oil dripping junk to hi-tech precision machinery.
zh: ~z~比起高科技精密机械，他更喜欢生锈漏油的破铜烂铁。

english: ~z~I need to snatch some guy name of uhh, Roman Bellic. Runs a cab firm,
zh: ~z~我要绑架一个叫罗曼･贝利克的人。开出租车行的，

english: ~z~Oh, it's like that, is it, now? She like your girlfriend or something? Nah, nah, that's cool. I'm feeling that.
zh: ~z~噢，我差不多能猜到了。就是你的女友之类的吧？这又没关系的。可以理解。

english: ~z~Bellic, I wanted to kidnap you, now I might kill ya.
zh: ~z~贝利克，本来我只是绑架你，现在我都想杀你了。

english: ~z~You and your boys might ride, but you don't know nothing about brotherhood.
zh: ~z~你们帮的人确实在骑车，但根本就不了解什么是兄弟情谊。

english: ~z~Oh, wait. You hate me because where I'm from? Man, that's cold.
zh: ~z~啥玩意？你居然因为我的出身鄙视我？天，真恶心。

english: ~z~For future reference, Malc, it might be worth locking your hostages into a car.
zh: ~z~留供日后参考，马尔科姆，绑架别人的时候最好锁住车门。

english: ~z~Malc, tell this gentlemen what my kind of people do to guys who try to buy their way out.
zh: ~z~马尔科姆，告诉这位先生，我会怎么对待想花钱走后门的人。

english: ~z~They flip her, a lot of brothers go down for a long time. You break her out and take her to the safehouse.
zh: ~z~她要是反水，很多兄弟得蹲上大牢。你把她劫出来，送到安全屋。

english: ~z~Now the vans full of guns are big red FIB targets.
zh: ~z~现在那些装满枪的货车成了 FIB 眼里的特大目标。

english: ~z~Show that west coast prick the Liberty City bottom rocker belongs to The Lost.
zh: ~z~让那个西海岸的蠢货瞧瞧，自由城的底章归失落帮。

english: ~z~Keep the heat off whoever N.O.O.S.E have got a hard-on for until I can call in a favor.
zh: ~z~N.O.O.S.E. 正死咬着某个人，你先帮我顶着风头，直到我能动用关系。

english: ~z~The new Nightblades are getting delivered to shops today. And us being such good customers, we deserve a free sample.
zh: ~z~新款夜刃今天就要送到车行了。咱们是这么好的客户，理应拿个免费试用。

english: ~z~I just got the heads up our stash is gonna be raided. Sometimes a corrupt police department can work in our favor.
zh: ~z~我刚得到风声，咱们的货要被突查了。有时候腐败的警察局也能为咱们所用。

english: ~z~We were supposed to sell an arms shipment to the Salvadorans, but the deal fell through.
zh: ~z~我们本要把一批军火卖给萨尔瓦多人，结果交易黄了。

english: ~z~We got a club mandate to do what we can for the struggling American Auto Industry.
zh: ~z~会里有令，要为举步维艰的美国汽车工业出一份力。

english: ~z~I just heard that the Deadbeats' San Fierro Road Captain is in town to meet with Joe Jon.
zh: ~z~我刚听说废物帮的圣菲耶罗车队队长进城来见乔･乔恩了。

english: ~z~He ain't worthy to wear his Lost MC patch no more. Get his colors and bring 'em back here now.
zh: ~z~他不配再戴失落帮的会徽了。收了他的行头，马上带回来。

english: ~z~I say you trash all the Uptown Riders' Jap Scrap and Pasta Rockets.
zh: ~z~我说你们把上城骑士那些日本破烂和意裔火箭全砸了。

english: ~z~The fuck you idiots do? Every cop in Liberty's out there looking for you.
zh: ~z~你们这帮蠢货干了什么？自由城所有警察都在外面找你们。

english: ~z~It's your last chance to pay him back for all the brothers he jammed up before he disappears into WITSEC.
zh: ~z~这是你最后一次收拾他的机会，他为害的兄弟那么多，之后他就要进证人保护计划消失了。

english: ~z~Someone take Arnie Lester's bike and bring it back here. See how the Deadbeats like that.
zh: ~z~谁去把阿尼･莱斯特的车弄回来。看看废物帮受不受得了。

english: ~z~Some brothers just got jumped by the A.O.D. You got a fight on you, boys!
zh: ~z~几个兄弟刚被死亡天使偷袭了。有架要打了，小子们！

english: ~z~Earl gets out of the pen today. We got all the drugs, booze and hole he can handle,
zh: ~z~厄尔今天出狱。毒品、酒和女人，他要多少咱们有多少，

english: ~z~They could get taught a little geography lesson before they leave, don't you think?
zh: ~z~他们走之前，可以给他们上一堂地理课，你说呢？

english: ~z~We gotta raise bail for Otis and fuck me if we're putting our hands in our own pockets.
zh: ~z~我们得给奥蒂斯筹保释金，要咱们自己掏钱那就见鬼了。

english: ~z~What about your brothers, man? Ain't you in it for The Lost?
zh: ~z~那你把兄弟们放哪儿，老兄？你把失落帮放在哪里？

english: ~z~I know, man. I'm loyal, but I ain't a drone, man. We should be able to talk about shit.
zh: ~z~我知道，老兄。我很忠诚，但我不是奴隶啊，老兄。我们有畅所欲言的权利。

english: ~z~Shit, Johnny. You should have a drink. Your nerves must be shot.
zh: ~z~妈的，强尼。你还是去喝几杯吧，肯定是哪根神经断了。

english: ~z~Yeah, good for you Johnny. If you had so much fun why don't you go start your own chapter?
zh: ~z~哦，那好啊，强尼。你这么喜欢以前，滚出去自立门户吧？

english: ~z~Only Billy Grey would get taken down on a distribution beef and end up in a country club.
zh: ~z~也就比利･格雷会因为贩毒被抓，然后关进乡下戒毒所吧。

english: ~z~You've had your turn at the head of this pack, but I'm here now. So you better do what I say, Johnny.
zh: ~z~之前你确实是车队领队，但现在我回来了，你最好听我命令，强尼。

english: ~z~Johnny the Jew. Klebitz the Heeb. Good to be here, man. Good to fucking be here. What's your problem?
zh: ~z~犹太佬强尼，希伯来的克雷比兹。来这儿真好啊，兄弟，真他妈的好。你怎么回事？

english: ~z~Wouldn't be a man if I didn't need that now, would I? How's Ashley, by the way? She single?
zh: ~z~不需要女人的话我就算不上男人了吧？对了，阿什莉现在如何？还单着吗？

english: ~z~You're gonna be up all night fucking and getting high. The bike'll wait til morning.
zh: ~z~我看你只会翻云覆雨彻夜狂欢，天亮了才想起车子的事。

english: ~z~You boys'll be too drunk to catch VD, let alone two hundred and thirty pounds of rapidly approaching middle age.
zh: ~z~你们这些醉到鸡巴发软的家伙，肯定扶不住我这个两百多斤的大叔。

english: ~z~You really gone soft, haven't you Johnny? You know, you could do with a stretch in the joint, might harden you up.
zh: ~z~怎么这么软弱了，强尼？知道吗，你可以去蹲个号子，说不定能更强硬些。

english: ~z~Okay, Johnny boy. I hope you had fun playing leader, but the big man is back. Stay behind me.
zh: ~z~好了，强尼仔。当领队的感觉是不是很爽，但现在大哥我回来了。不要超过我。

english: ~z~Brothers aren't meant to be this close, Johnny. But we're gonna have to be until I get my bike back.
zh: ~z~是兄弟也不带贴这么紧的，强尼。但拿回车子前只能这样凑合了。

english: ~z~Yeah? Well, I signed up to be a brother for life, you ungrateful fuck.
zh: ~z~就这？我加入这里是来做生死兄弟的，忘恩负义的废物。

english: ~z~Maybe. Let's just say I'm not gonna share today's events with Jackie and the kid.
zh: ~z~也许吧。反正今天的事我是不打算告诉杰基和孩子了。

english: ~z~That's a President's job, ain't it, Clay? Same with a motorcycle club or a whole country.
zh: ~z~这就是首领的工作啊，科雷，摩托帮会长和美国总统都一样。

english: ~z~Yeah, sure. I got a lot on my plate. I only just got out and look at the state of shit around here.
zh: ~z~好，知道了。我手头事很多。我才刚出狱，结果帮会就成了这鬼样。

english: ~z~I know what he can't do, Billy. He does too. Just go and fucking see him, alright?
zh: ~z~我知道他做不了什么，比利。他自己也知道。你他妈有空去看他一趟，好吗？

english: ~z~The business that we are all in, while you're out pretending to be saved.
zh: ~z~这生意我们齐心协力，只有你置身事外假意戒毒。

english: ~z~Technically, you're two hundred and thirty pounds of Jewish biker, John boy.
zh: ~z~准确来说，你是个两百多斤的犹太飞车党，阿强。

english: ~z~I'm happy about it alright, John boy. Fuck, after that therapy shit, a drink and the road is all I need.
zh: ~z~我还是很高兴的，阿强。去过傻逼戒毒所以后，我最需要的就是喝酒跟上路。

english: ~z~Well yours is plenty big, my compassionate friend. You should donate some. To the cause.
zh: ~z~你鼻子不挺大吗，这位热心车友。捐点给他吧，当作补偿。

english: ~z~Yeah, Bill? At least I twisted the wick when I had the brothers behind me, old man.
zh: ~z~是吗，比利？至少弟兄们跟着我的时候能拧成一股，大哥。

english: ~z~paid your rent, paid everything, shit, we set stuff up for you.
zh: ~z~租房子的钱，都替你付了，妈的，我们全安排好了。

english: ~z~Ride with the brothers, man. Did you get too good for them while I was away?
zh: ~z~别抛弃弟兄，老兄。我不在的时候你就看不上他们了吗？

english: ~z~and maybe if we stopped doing it for a minute, we'd look around and realize that the fun ended a long time ago.
zh: ~z~可能停止争吵一会儿，我们就会发现那种快乐很早之前就结束了。

english: ~z~Enough with that shit. We got more things to worry about than respect and stupid kids' stuff.
zh: ~z~别扯这没用的了。比起这些小孩子过家家一样的尊重，还有更重要的事要担心。

english: ~z~I ain't interested in their faces. You're the one who gets emotionally attached, J, not me.
zh: ~z~我对他们的脸没兴趣。只有你才会对他们有感情，J，我没有。

english: ~z~Whether it's train gangs in the showers or grown men crying and hugging in rehab,
zh: ~z~一边是囚犯拴着链子洗澡，一边是大老爷们在戒毒所泣不成声。

english: ~z~Give me a stiff drink, some hard drugs, the road and my chopper. That's all I need. Maybe an occasional bit of the hole.
zh: ~z~给我一些烈酒，一些毒品，让我骑着机车上路。我只需要这些。偶尔再来点艳遇。

english: ~z~Why don't you ride with the brothers, Johnny? Being acting President must have changed you.
zh: ~z~你怎么脱离弟兄们的队伍了，强尼？当过代理会长后你变了。

english: ~z~everybody gets to do business and make money without looking over their shoulders too much.
zh: ~z~大家井水不犯河水，赚钱的时候也不会有性命之忧。

english: ~z~I'll run it the way it needs to be run. Same as the three guys before me did.
zh: ~z~该怎么管理我就怎么管理。之前的三任会长是这么做的，

english: ~z~I ain't attached to no drugs, man. They're attached to me, clingy bastards.
zh: ~z~不是我离不开毒品，是毒品不放过我，这黏人鬼。

english: ~z~You like being back in line? Wouldn't want you getting too used to thinking for yourself.
zh: ~z~你能接受回到队中吗？我不想让你变得自我中心。

english: ~z~I'm going to blindfold you when we get back. All you gotta do is fall over and trust that your brothers
zh: ~z~回去以后我把你眼睛蒙住，然后你就往后倒，相信有兄弟

english: ~z~That guy with the bone yard might know where the bike is. He's over on Guantanamo.
zh: ~z~废车场那人可能知道车的下落。他在关塔那摩大道。

english: ~z~We're in it to stick it to all those yuppies and hippies and mother fucking Deadbeats.
zh: ~z~我们入会就是为了反抗那些雅皮士、嬉皮士，还有狗逼死妈天使。

english: ~z~Yeah, I been fucking this Russian broad in Broker. Gets her psycho daddy real mad.
zh: ~z~嗯，我在布洛克搞一个俄国婆娘，她的疯子老爹都气炸了。

english: ~z~If you don't get that, then you don't get nothing, John boy. Sad state of affairs.
zh: ~z~这都不明白的话，你就什么都不会懂了，阿强。真是悲剧。

english: ~z~Shit, I guess we gotta make a call on Pretty Boy. He's over in Bohan on Guantanamo.
zh: ~z~妈的，看来我们得去拜访下靓仔了。他在波汉的关塔那摩大道。

english: ~z~The Lost MC rides together, Johnny. That change while I was in there?
zh: ~z~失落帮要共同进退，强尼。我一不在就没这规矩了？

english: ~z~You just don't get it, do you? This is what it's about. This. Not that money shit.
zh: ~z~你就是不明白是吧？尊重才是最重要的。尊重，与钱无关。

english: ~z~Are any of the brothers giving you shit? I'll have a talk to them, don't worry.
zh: ~z~有弟兄不听你话吗？我会找他们谈谈的，别担心。

english: ~z~Let's hope Pretty Boy still knows where this thing is. Guantanamo Avenue, boys.
zh: ~z~希望靓仔还知道车的下落。关塔那摩大道，各位。

english: ~z~There's a truce, Billy. You know that. A truce means no hassle,
zh: ~z~我们休战了，比利。你知道的。休战就是不找麻烦，

english: ~z~I don't know what I'd rather go back to, stints in the hole or group share cluster fucks in that place.
zh: ~z~我都不知道哪种更好，坐大牢还是在那破地方组团悔过。

english: ~z~Okay. I'll save my questions until I see the chapter. And you better have looked after my baby.
zh: ~z~好。见到帮会之后我再决定怪不怪你。我的宝贝最好是没出差错。

english: ~z~Had any contact with my dear old friends, the Angels of Death?
zh: ~z~最近有跟我们亲爱的老朋友死亡天使打过交道吗？

english: ~z~I've been putting up with rehab skanks getting sex therapy for the last few months. I need something real.
zh: ~z~这几个月都只能找戒毒所的公交车做性治疗。我需要实战。

english: ~z~Chill out, man. I just hope when we decide to take a break, to slow down, that it's still an option on the table.
zh: ~z~冷静，兄弟。我只是希望哪天我们决定休息一下，想要放慢脚步了，还能选择以前的心态。

english: ~z~You're tense, Johnny. Must have been stressful heading up the chapter while I was away.
zh: ~z~你太紧张了，强尼。肯定是替我管理分会的时候压力太大了吧。

english: ~z~With a nose the size of yours there wouldn't be much blow left for the other brothers anyway, John boy.
zh: ~z~不过有这么个大鼻子在，你吸一口弟兄们就没得吸了，阿强。

english: ~z~Everything I do is about The Lost. I don't exist without my brothers - without you.
zh: ~z~我所做的一切都是为了失落帮。没有兄弟，没有你，就不会有我。

english: ~z~It's hard to be proud when you don't have a roof over your head. I can show you the books.
zh: ~z~家徒四壁的时候，想站你都站不住。书里就这么写的。

english: ~z~You haven't always got the information, brother. So shut up and behave.
zh: ~z~你也不是每次都清楚状况，兄弟。老实点闭嘴吧。

english: ~z~I've seen men die for their brothers and men rat their brothers out. And I know that this gang don't mean shit
zh: ~z~我见过有人为兄弟牺牲，也见过有人出卖兄弟。如果手下不服从他们的老大，

english: ~z~I'll just taxi you around on your little welcome back tour.
zh: ~z~都是你的决定。我只是在你的回归欢迎会上当个车夫。

english: ~z~If you're in The Lost for the good times only, fair weather weekends in the Carraways, then you ain't in The Lost.
zh: ~z~如果你加入失落帮只是为了同甘，不能接受共苦，那就不算失落帮的兄弟。

english: ~z~Good thing I'm not fragile, Johnny. Otherwise I'd break when you treat me like this.
zh: ~z~幸好我不是易碎品，强尼。否则你这样我早碎了。

english: ~z~Yeah, Jim? Something tells me fucking up Pretty Boy and killing them Deadbeats ain't enough for him.
zh: ~z~是吗，吉姆？我倒觉得光是收拾靓仔一顿和宰掉几个死妈天使对他来说还不够。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, I ain't too happy about it neither man - you wanna turn around and go back to the clubhouse?
zh: ~z~的确，这样我也不高兴，兄弟。你想现在调头回会所吗？

english: ~z~Now, let's be clear, I keep getting caught because assholes like you
zh: ~z~我就直说了，我这么容易进去都是因为你这样的混蛋

english: ~z~I don't know where you've been living, pal. Us brothers are the only free people I see.
zh: ~z~我们真的生活在同一个国家吗？这里好像只有我们几个兄弟是自由的。

english: ~z~You ain't gonna keep those good looks if you keep falling off your bike, John.
zh: ~z~老从车上摔下来的话，你的小白脸可就不保了，约翰。

english: ~z~I'm the leader of the chapter again, Johnny. And you're just another brother. Can you handle it?
zh: ~z~现在我回来当分会老大了，强尼。你又回归普通弟兄了。你能接受吗？

english: ~z~Because this one, my chapter, isn't big enough to have two people pulling it in different directions.
zh: ~z~因为这里，我的分会，容不下两个方向不同的领队。

english: ~z~Shit, John. You should have a drink. Your nerves must be shot.
zh: ~z~妈的，约翰。你还是去喝几杯吧，你的哪根神经肯定断了。

english: ~z~We took a break from saying "fuck you" to everything and we made some deals that worked out.
zh: ~z~当时我们不再动不动就「操你妈」，成功做起了生意。

english: ~z~Like when your wife is screwing the neighbor. I'm gonna be up all night tuning her back to normal.
zh: ~z~感觉就像你老婆跟隔壁老王偷情，我得花一晚上才能把她调教好。

english: ~z~You ain't gonna keep those good looks if you keep falling off your bike, John.
zh: ~z~老从车上摔下来的话，你的小白脸可就不保了，约翰。

english: ~z~Look at me, manage to avoid prison and I'm still ass to cock with a dude.
zh: ~z~看看我，就算免了牢狱之灾，还是得顶着爷们的菊花。

english: ~z~you would just taken mine and left me on the road. Later, bro.
zh: ~z~你会骑走我的车子，把我晾在路上。回见，老兄。

english: ~z~Billy, man. Shit! The Lost ain't much without the chapter President. What're we gonna do?
zh: ~z~比利，天哪。妈的！分会会长挂了，失落帮要完了。我们该怎么办？

english: ~z~I'm out of rehab three minutes, and they think they can crash my party?
zh: ~z~我才从所里出来几分钟，他们就敢来砸老子场子了？

english: ~z~Sad to see the kid go like that. But he had the mark, didn't he?
zh: ~z~可惜那小子就这样走了。但是他也辉煌过，不是吗？

english: ~z~I know, man, I know. It's just this Billy shit that's getting to me.
zh: ~z~我知道，兄弟，我知道。主要是比利的事太让人心烦了。

english: ~z~you think it's okay to gatecrash my party, Deadbeat motherfucker.
zh: ~z~休得你们敢来砸老子场子了，崽种－死妈－天使。

english: ~z~Ah, well at least we tried. Now Billy's brought every Deadbeat in the country down on us.
zh: ~z~啊，至少我们尽力了。现在比利让我们与所有死妈天使为敌了。

english: ~z~What the fuck was that? Some kind of fucking coup? Billy was chapter President, man.
zh: ~z~这他妈怎么回事？谋权篡位吗？比利是分会会长啊，伙计。

zh: ~z~嘿，强尼，这话轮不到我说，但你应该管好你的车，兄弟。

zh: ~z~我也不知道自己脑子里在想什么。我去想一想。回头见，杰森。

zh: ~z~他是这个分会的老大，兄弟。如果比利想开战，所有弟兄都要准备好开战。

zh: ~z~我们还活着只是撞了大运，比利，你也清楚。再见。

zh: ~z~准备干了他爹的巨贵伏特加，再到码头下面干她。

zh: ~z~谢了，兄弟。让我想起了你还在见习期的时候，替兄弟们满城奔走。

english: ~z~Johnny, man, you let those Deadbeats tell their buddies a war's on?
zh: ~z~强尼，伙计，死妈天使告诉他们的同伴要开战了吗？

zh: ~z~谢谢你为了一个小小的引擎故障把整件事都搞砸了，布莱恩。

zh: ~z~哦老兄，汤姆･斯塔布斯会乐意认识认识你们的。

english: ~z~Look dude, you and me, shit seems kind of tense lately, doesn't it?
zh: ~z~看，伙计，你我之间，最近似乎有点紧张，不是吗？

zh: ~z~是啊，起码不会明着来。我看你肯定会背地里捅刀子。

zh: ~z~啥？我还以为责任在你，你是老大，什么都是你的。以后再说吧，伙计。

zh: ~z~妈的，我听不见，大哥。风太大。下次喊大声点。

zh: ~z~走吧，兄弟们，上车了。死妈天使已经学到了什么是尊重。

zh: ~z~我很想揍你一顿，布莱恩。但我永远都不能和兄弟作对。

zh: ~z~绝逼是纯种美国人啊，伙计，你太了解什么叫作虚伪了。

english: ~z~Time was we'd kick ass with baseball bats, not SMGs. Now that was fun.
zh: ~z~以前的快乐源泉是棒球棍，不是冲锋枪。还是以前好啊。

english: ~z~Sure, that makes a whole lotta sense. Thanks for the ride, Bill.
zh: ~z~确实，这话说得很有道理。谢谢你送我一程，比利。

english: ~z~You ready to break some more heads? I heard some bitches are getting smart.
zh: ~z~准备好再大杀特杀一次了吗？听说又有贱人自以为是了。

english: ~z~Tell me, brother. How am I supposed to lead this motley crew of bikers, without a bike?
zh: ~z~告诉我，兄弟。没有车子，老子带领个屁飞车党？

english: ~z~The days when we had all the pigs this side of the West River coming down on us? Those happy days?
zh: ~z~西河这边的条子都冲我们来的日子？那段快乐时光？

english: ~z~You talk and talk about sticking it to the man and then you hang out with a lawyer?
zh: ~z~你口口声声喊着反抗权威，结果和律师混在一起？

zh: ~z~和比利在一起他们就惹不起了。哈哈。没人敢招惹比利。

english: ~z~He's got some business contacts that'll appeal to your newly minted business mind.
zh: ~z~他有政商界的人脉，能跟你萌生的商业头脑产生共鸣。

english: ~z~Pre-emptive strike, my brother. And fuck me if it wasn't the right move.
zh: ~z~先发制人啊，好兄弟。要是我做错了，我就去死，好不好？

english: ~z~Yeah, I need to do some learning. Mind if I practice on you, Brian?
zh: ~z~是啊，我是得多学着点。介意我拿你练习吗，布莱恩？

english: ~z~Tell you what, send me a fucking link to that Ashley video. What do I care what she's up to? We're through.
zh: ~z~这样吧，你把阿什莉那部片的链接发我。我管她那么多干嘛？我们结束了。

english: ~z~Oh, shit, you sonofabitch. I was hoping you'd go OTB or somethin'. Good driving.
zh: ~z~噢操，妈了个逼的。我还以为你会放水的。好车技。

english: ~z~You gonna take out that Deadbeat on the stairs or do I gotta do everything?
zh: ~z~赶紧把楼梯上的死妈天使干掉，别让我包办好吧。

english: ~z~Billy, man. Just for once I'd like to know what the fuck we're doing before we do it.
zh: ~z~比利，兄弟。我想先知道这次到底要干什么，就这一次。

english: ~z~Yeah, I sure am, Bill. Thanks for pointin' out the glaringly obvious one more time. Later, man.
zh: ~z~对，我傻逼，比利。谢谢你把显而易见的东西又指出了一次。回见，伙计。

zh: ~z~比赢了不是不尊重你，比利。我还是你卑微的仆人。

zh: ~z~不是很懂你，但我要吞云吐雾找女人去了。好好放松一下。

english: ~z~Think nothing of it, brother. We have all got to pull together in this climate of war and uncertainty.
zh: ~z~没关系，兄弟。在不稳定的战争环境下，我们必须要团结一心。

english: ~z~It's not luck, Brian. The man wants you he's gonna come find you no matter how smart you think you are.
zh: ~z~跟运气无关，布莱恩。存心抓你的话再聪明也没用。

english: ~z~The brothers are doing what you tell 'em to. Maybe that's the problem, Bill. Adios.
zh: ~z~弟兄们都是听你命令行事的。可能这就是问题吧，比利。再见。

english: ~z~I don't need to now that I'm carrying your heavy ass around with me, Johnny.
zh: ~z~没那个必要，带着你这头肥猪跑就够累了，强尼。

english: ~z~Yeah I can, Johnny. I can. So fuck you, man. Yeah, fuck you!
zh: ~z~当然值得，强尼。值得的。去你妈的，伙计。对，去你妈的！

zh: ~z~我在网上看到了阿什莉上镜的黄片。你就一傻逼，强尼。

english: ~z~That's what you do with a leader, dumbass. Are you sad no one's following you, Johnny?
zh: ~z~跟在大哥后头就是这样，白痴。没人跟着你你难受吗，强尼？

english: ~z~I thought you only watched gay porn on the internet, Brian. You're into cock, right?
zh: ~z~你不是只看基片的吗，布莱恩。你就喜欢鸡巴，对吧？

english: ~z~Everything is fucking up around me, man. My bike... my brothers too.
zh: ~z~我身边的一切都被毁了。我的车...还有我的弟兄。

english: ~z~Billy's bought it, oh shit. Oh shit. What're we going to do! We're fucked!
zh: ~z~比利死了，我操。噢，妈的。这我们怎么办！我们完了！

english: ~z~Sure, yeah. I'm sorry for not having enough explosives to fuel your war efforts, Billy. See you.
zh: ~z~是这样没错。对不起，这些榴弹不足以帮你赢得战争，比利。再见。

english: ~z~How about we inject some speed into proceedings, Mr. President. See if you still got it?
zh: ~z~要么我们全速前进吧，会长大人。看看你还行不行？

english: ~z~Calm down, Brian. The brothers can pull through this. Now get the fuck out of my face.
zh: ~z~冷静，布莱恩。弟兄们能够度过难关的。别在我面前碍事了。

zh: ~z~你想让我明天交一份一千字的兄弟情作文吗，混蛋？

zh: ~z~蹲号子的都是蠢到被抓的白痴。除了比利，他是运气差。

english: ~z~I'm thinking you ride a cage next run. Cos it don't look like you can be trusted to ride a bike.
zh: ~z~下次只能把你关笼子里了。因为不值得把机车托付给你。

zh: ~z~布莱恩，伙计。最近你在干嘛，肯定是在舔比利的屌吧。

english: ~z~So long, brothers. Wash the taste of gun powder out your mouths with a cold American beer.
zh: ~z~再见，弟兄们。用冰冷的美国啤酒漱掉嘴里的火药吧。

english: ~z~There's a Congressman, needs your help, Tom Stubbs III.
zh: ~z~有一个众议员需要你的帮助，汤姆･斯塔布斯三世。

zh: ~z~我看还是多去扫荡几次吧，因为我才是老大。过来找我。

zh: ~z~赶紧他妈跑路。我走下面，你们走上面。祝大家好运。

zh: ~z~操，强尼，这不犹太啊。找到新下家我再联系你。

english: ~z~It's just opposite the Libertonian. Go pay him a visit, if you're still thinking about your brothers and not just your own ego, that is.
zh: ~z~那家店在自由城博物馆对面。如果你还把弟兄们放在心里，就给我过去找他。

english: ~z~I got good news and I got bad news. The bad news is we've lost a brother. The good news is it's Brian.
zh: ~z~我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。坏消息是我们死了一个弟兄，好消息是死的是布莱恩。

english: ~z~This guy's at one of them dumb ass gentlemen's clubs in Algonquin - the kind without tits - The Jousters.
zh: ~z~这位议员现在在阿尔冈琴的一家绅士俱乐部——不露奶的那种——枪斗士。

english: ~z~We're nervous. Will you oversee the deal and check everything is cool?
zh: ~z~我们很担心。你能帮忙盯下这次交易，确保一切顺利吗？

english: ~z~I don't go near the stuff... professionally... but I found him a buyer.
zh: ~z~我不卖那玩意...说真的...但我帮他找了个买家。

english: ~z~Jim, I love you man, but since you've hit middle age, you've really lost something...
zh: ~z~吉姆，我爱你，兄弟。但自从进入中年，你就少了点东西...

english: ~z~Another deal fucked up in Liberty City. Don't look so surprised, man. Adios.
zh: ~z~自由城又出了一桩砸了的买卖。不用惊讶，兄弟。再见。

zh: ~z~我们要挺过去。生死兄弟情，哥们。失落帮万岁。以后见。

zh: ~z~听见了吗，布莱恩？看来肯让你口的人就只有比利。

zh: ~z~你什么意思？强尼和我被袭击了。你怎么没保护好比利？

zh: ~z~你们做了什么是你们的事，老兄。你们都是成年人了。好吧，一定程度上是。

english: ~z~After that shit Billy was saying, you think we'll still have a chapter?
zh: ~z~比利能说出那种话，你觉得我们的分部还能维系吗？

english: ~z~Johnny, you're wasting away, man. I think it's all the worrying you do. Why don't you hit the weights later?
zh: ~z~强尼，最近瘦了啊，兄弟。我看你就是每天想得太多了。待会儿你去举个铁吧？

zh: ~z~我得先保护好自己，兄弟。我是说，总不能指望我...

english: ~z~Look, man. Look, look, look. I been up for three days, man.
zh: ~z~听着，老兄。听着，听着，听着。我来这儿三天了，老兄。

english: ~z~That's bullshit. If you were looking out for us, where were you when me and Johhny had to fight our way outta there?
zh: ~z~放屁吧你。要是真在暗地保护，我和强尼杀出重围的时候你在哪里？

english: ~z~Bill, yeah, he's fucked now. Thanks to you. I'm around the corner.
zh: ~z~比利，对，他现在完了，多亏了你啊。我就在路口那儿。

english: ~z~I think you knew more about the brown when we found it at the Deabeats pad and I think you know more now.
zh: ~z~在死妈天使的会所找到货的时候我就觉得你知道的很多，现在更是如此。

english: ~z~Shit, Billy. You're the fucking man. How bout you beat us brothers in a race just to prove it.
zh: ~z~妈的，比利。现在你最牛逼，要么跟哥几个飙车证明一下吧？

english: ~z~We were watching your back, man. Looking out for you brothers. Doing more than you did for Billy.
zh: ~z~我们在保护你的后背，兄弟。暗地保护你们。做的可比你替比利做的多多了。

english: ~z~You must have fucked shit up, Johnny. Billy never wanted to make nice in the first place.
zh: ~z~都是你的错，强尼。比利一开始就没考虑过谈判。

english: ~z~Fuck, man. Billy's gonna go away for good with those priors of his.
zh: ~z~操了，兄弟。有之前的案底在，比利这次是回不来了。

english: ~z~Life wouldn't be worth living if we didn't to fight to survive. Ain't that right Jim?
zh: ~z~如果生存不需要战斗，生命就毫无价值。不是吗，吉姆？

english: ~z~Shit, Bill. I don't know where my head is right now. I been feeling weird.
zh: ~z~妈的，比利。我现在都摸不着头脑。实在是太怪了。

english: ~z~Too right, man. Guy like you shouldn't waste his time with all that shit.
zh: ~z~太对了，兄弟。你这种人就不该在娘们身上浪费时间。

english: ~z~Okay, Bill, you think you're so tough. How about we light a fucking fire. Come on!
zh: ~z~好了，比利，你觉得你那么牛逼，要么我们来比一比？走起！

english: ~z~Not gonna waste my time with that crap. I got the brothers. All the hole I need at the house, man. Yeah!
zh: ~z~跟女人浪费什么时间啊。老子有弟兄在，会所又有公交车。耶！

english: ~z~Brian, man, what the fuck were you and Billy doing while those Triads jumped on me and Jim?
zh: ~z~布莱恩，兄弟，我跟吉姆被三合会袭击的时候你跟比利在干嘛？

english: ~z~You just love sniffing out an argument, Billy boy. Enjoy the ride for a minute. Mellow out.
zh: ~z~你就喜欢没事找事，比利仔。先享受骑行吧，放松一下。

english: ~z~Important question, Brian. What happened there? Billy said these Triads were ready to deal.
zh: ~z~很重要的问题，布莱恩。当时怎么了？比利不是说三合会准备好交易了吗。

english: ~z~Well, Bill. I may have beat you, but you're still the fucking man in my book.
zh: ~z~好吧，比利。也许我是赢了，但你还是我眼中最牛逼的人。

english: ~z~When people hear about Billy going down, there's gonna be more pressure on us than ever.
zh: ~z~等别人知道比利进去了，我们面对的压力还会更大。

english: ~z~Sure she did. Probably ran good before you touched her. Get out my face, Brian.
zh: ~z~当然了，你碰之前估计是好好的。滚蛋吧，布莱恩。

english: ~z~Johnny, man. We got to have a meet for all the brothers when we get back. Tell 'em what happened.
zh: ~z~强尼，老兄。回去后我们要召集所有弟兄开个会。告诉他们情况。

english: ~z~Brian, man. Shit's fucked. Billy's been taken down. Where are you?
zh: ~z~布莱恩，兄弟，全都完了。比利被抓走了。你在哪儿？

english: ~z~Tell me if I'm wrong, but you know more about this deal than you're letting on?
zh: ~z~我错了你直说，但关于这次交易你是不是留了一手？

english: ~z~Did you get jealous and wish that Billy was fucking you instead? You'd like that wouldn't you, you fat little bitch?
zh: ~z~你是不是吃醋了，希望被比利操的人是你？这样你就高兴了是吧，死胖子？

english: ~z~It's like being made Captain of a sinkin' ship. What am I gonna do?
zh: ~z~感觉就像是撞上冰山后被任命成船长了。我要做什么？

english: ~z~Billy's inside and Jim's gone for good. You're a real lucky charm, buddy.
zh: ~z~比利进去了，吉姆人没了。你的运气真好，伙计。

english: ~z~You haven't been talking have you? Don't go forgetting what happened when Horse sang his little ditty.
zh: ~z~该不会是你在告密吧？别忘了Horse想要告密的时候发生了什么。

english: ~z~I'm surprised Billy agreed to this. It's the first smart move he's made since gettin' out of rehab.
zh: ~z~没想到比利居然同意了。这是他从戒毒所出来后的第一个明智之举。

english: ~z~You're gonna stick by your brothers. We got to pull together now.
zh: ~z~你要和弟兄们站在一起。现在我们必须上下一心。

english: ~z~Fuck 'em, man. The two of us are chapter enough and Terry 'n' Clay will back you up when you need it.
zh: ~z~去他妈的，兄弟。光靠我们两个人都是分部了，而且特里和科雷也会在需要的时候支援你。

english: ~z~Shit, man. There must be some weird gremlins fucking with my machine. She ran smooth earlier.
zh: ~z~妈的，兄弟，肯定是有小妖怪搞了我的摩托，之前还好好的。

english: ~z~The Deadbeats told them we got it and they want it back.
zh: ~z~死妈天使说货在我们手里，中国人现在想要回去。

english: ~z~Not if I got anything to say on it. Not if Billy hears about this.
zh: ~z~我反对的话就不可能。比利知道了的话就不可能。

english: ~z~but there's other parts that are a lot bigger now I'm off the drugs. Just ask Ashley.
zh: ~z~但我停药以后也有变得巨大的地方，你去问阿什莉吧。

english: ~z~We got more important things to think about. Without Billy we got no leader.
zh: ~z~还有更重要的事情要考虑。比利不在我们就群龙无首了。

english: ~z~And you're in charge of the asylum. Ha, ha, ha. No wonder I have trouble sleeping at night.
zh: ~z~那你就是疯人院院长了。哈哈哈，难怪我晚上睡不着。

english: ~z~They think we're bitches? Fuck them. They are going to pay.
zh: ~z~他们当咱是臭娘们？操他妈的，让他们付出代价。

english: ~z~I couldn't give up my bike, man. The outlaw lifestyle. This shit.
zh: ~z~我不可能放弃摩托，伙计，放弃这种亡命徒的生活，放弃种种。

zh: ~z~桌上冰球？！我得说下，跟我想的不太一样，兄弟。但来都来了...

zh: ~z~你看到我最后那发绝杀了吗？那可是教科书级别的。

zh: ~z~嘿，强尼，我是特里。听着兄弟，我手头有些枪，又好又便宜。

zh: ~z~嘿，我是特里。医生叫我出院了。你能来接我吗？

zh: ~z~你太懂我了，强尼。可以的话你几小时内过来吧。

zh: ~z~我们安全了，强尼。死亡天使不会贸然踏入失落帮的地盘的。

zh: ~z~先说好，你也知道只有比利这样的分会会长才能呼叫武力支援。别告诉他我们来帮你了。

zh: ~z~打电话叫些弟兄来，强尼。这次想活着回去必须叫点支援。

zh: ~z~做这种事的感觉真好。比起因为比利一时兴起就打得头破血流好多了。

zh: ~z~卡车是没你的摩托快，但就是这次的坐骑，强尼仔。

zh: ~z~科雷，老兄，我和吉姆需要对付死亡天使的帮手。

zh: ~z~太糟了，好兄弟。我本来想干这群死妈天使一炮的。

zh: ~z~你可以从暴怒的死妈天使手里保护我和吉姆。我们需要你的帮助。

zh: ~z~兄弟，原则上只有会长才能叫我们支援，不过去他妈的。我们马上就到。

zh: ~z~多联系他们吧，兄弟。他俩还是你哥们儿，估计想法也跟你差不多。

zh: ~z~确实，强尼，我懂你意思。这种情况我就需要深思熟虑了，好吧？

zh: ~z~是吗？我都不知道哪个更好，是去蹲号子，还是跟混球律师厮混。

english: ~z~You know what, I can't wait to get them down the precinct so we can really stomp on those fuckers.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，我等不及想把他们抓进局子，好爆踹他们一顿。

english: ~z~so I said, "But racial profiling works, motherfucker. Now give up the product."
zh: ~z~于是我说：「依肤色断案就是管用，傻逼玩意。把货交出来。」

english: ~z~Yeah, they spend the kickbacks on getting high and getting hole - just like the rest of us.
zh: ~z~是啊，他们把回扣花在吸毒和嫖娼上，就像我们帮的那些人。

english: ~z~We run this city, mopes. We are your Gods and we will crush you.
zh: ~z~我们管理这座城市，二逼。我们是你们的神，我们会毁灭你们。

english: ~z~Man that shit was heavy. I feel bad for them bastards. Once upon a time, they must have wanted to do good.
zh: ~z~天哪，真是难受。我替这些混蛋感到难过。从前，他们一定也想做个好人。

english: ~z~Send in the wrecking crew, Sarge. We got a couple of bikers need to be taught a fucking lesson.
zh: ~z~请求紧急支援，警长。我们要好好教训下这帮飞车党。

english: ~z~Fuck me man, the whole LCPD are gonna be after us now. You can't just do that to a cop.
zh: ~z~他奶奶的，现在整个LCPD都要盯上我们了。条子不是随便就能杀的。

english: ~z~The second they shook us down for money, man, they came down to our level.
zh: ~z~在他们向我们索取贿赂的那一刻，他们就和我们没有差别了。

english: ~z~Hey Sarge, me and Matthews need a hand. Send out some boys who ain't afraid to break some fucking heads.
zh: ~z~喂，警长，我和马修斯需要支援。派一些不怕死的弟兄们过来。

english: ~z~Make tracks to Trinity Road, John. Come on. I got some brothers coming to meet us.
zh: ~z~赶紧去特里尼蒂路，约翰。快点。我在那里安排了弟兄。

english: ~z~You know, there's some people on the LCPD who'd thank us for what we're about to do.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，LCPD里会有人感谢我们接下来要做的事的。

english: ~z~We got lucky there, Johnny boy. I thought we'd be shovelling shit for those dudes 'til God knows when.
zh: ~z~我们很走运，强尼仔。我还以为要给他们当一辈子孙子。

english: ~z~You fucking mopes. McCornish was the best bad cop I knew.
zh: ~z~你们这群混蛋。麦科尼什是我认识的最牛逼的坏警察。

english: ~z~We gotta finish this bullshit off, get us to Trinity in Acter Industrial.
zh: ~z~我们要一劳永逸，去阿克特工业园的特里尼蒂路。

english: ~z~Back up! Back up! Some perps have just got a hard on for killing cops. We got a man down!
zh: ~z~呼叫支援！呼叫支援！有罪犯在屠杀警察。我们有人倒下了！

english: ~z~Round up the boys. We got a cop killer on our hands! Man down!
zh: ~z~集合人员。杀害警员的凶手就在眼前！友军伤亡！

english: ~z~Head to Trinity in Acter Industrial, alright? The boys are gonna meet us there.
zh: ~z~去阿克特工业园的特里尼蒂路，好吧？弟兄们埋伏在那里。

english: ~z~I don't like people having a hold on me like this. People ask me why I dislike cops...
zh: ~z~我不喜欢被别人这样束缚。有人问我为什么讨厌警察...

english: ~z~They should get treated like the rest of us as well. Law of the streets.
zh: ~z~他们也该像我们帮的其他人一样，用街头的规矩对待。

english: ~z~A dirty cop's just like a Deadbeat or a Triad or any other crook in this town.
zh: ~z~腐败警察跟死妈天使、三合会这样的坏人之流没有区别。

english: ~z~Come on. I give up, alright, I give up. Come on, tell me.
zh: ~z~好啦。我投降，好吧，我投降。好了，告诉我吧。

english: ~z~How bout we race over to those fucking dirty cops, old man? Think you can handle it?
zh: ~z~我们比比谁先骑到臭条子那里吧，老家伙？你有信心赢吗？

english: ~z~Let's see if you still got it, old man. Let's drop the fuckin' hammer on this run to those assholes.
zh: ~z~看看你的车技有没有退步吧，老家伙。比比谁先开到那俩混蛋那儿。

english: ~z~Mommy. He's crying like a little fucking bitch. Matthews you kill me you prick.
zh: ~z~妈咪。他像婆娘一样哭个不停。马修斯，我快笑死了。

english: ~z~Yeah, paying taxes and declaring incomes. And all the while taking the kickbacks.
zh: ~z~是啊，老老实实纳税、申报收入。然后私下拿着回扣。

english: ~z~A hooker being picked up by the chief on a Saturday night and let off with a special caution.
zh: ~z~周六晚上，局长带走了一个妓女，口头警告一下就放人了。

english: ~z~You stole his donut and spilled his coffee. Real mature, man.
zh: ~z~你抢了他的甜甜圈，泼了他的咖啡。够爷们儿，兄弟。

english: ~z~Officer down. Officer down. We need fucking back up ten minutes ago!
zh: ~z~有警察倒下了。有警察倒下了。早十分钟就该派支援了！

english: ~z~Hey, Billy's Billy. They had him cooped up in that place for a while. He's just blowin' off some steam.
zh: ~z~嘿，比利就是比利。他被关了一段时间，现在只是要发泄一下。

english: ~z~Tell some of the boys to get their nightsticks out, Sarge. We got a couple of bikers need to be broken.
zh: ~z~长官，告诉兄弟们拿好装备。我们得对付一帮飞车党。

english: ~z~Oh yeah. You messed with a dirty cop's donut. You're one badass biker.
zh: ~z~哦，没错。你抢了臭条子的甜甜圈，真是一个大坏蛋。

english: ~z~We just couldn't take 'em out in the open like that. They're still cops. See you soon, man.
zh: ~z~我们不能大摇大摆地干掉他们。他们可是警察。之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~... I.A.D. and the Sarge taking turns to screw me like it's my fucking quinceañera.
zh: ~z~...内务部和警长轮番折磨我，搞得跟给我办成人礼一样。

english: ~z~Johnny man, we can't have the cops catching us now. Lose this heat.
zh: ~z~强尼兄弟，现在还不能让条子抓到我们。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~I know, I know, it's just there's only so many you can carry. Who'd think there'd be five of them.
zh: ~z~我懂，我懂。可是我没这么多枪啊，谁知道他们有五个人。

english: ~z~How you feeling, Jim? Billy, man. I hope he handles his shit.
zh: ~z~感觉如何，吉姆？比利，天，我希望他能处理好他的事。

english: ~z~No, no, no. It was the Humboldt. They found those left feet in the West River.
zh: ~z~不不不，你那是洪堡河。在西河发现的是几只左脚。

english: ~z~Man, I want the old Billy back, the one before the heroin.
zh: ~z~老兄，我更想要以前的比利，没沾上海洛因的比利。

english: ~z~Something tells me they weren't the only ones in the LCPD, Johnny. Back to the house, my man.
zh: ~z~我觉得LCPD里不会只有他们两个坏警察，强尼。回会所吧，好兄弟。

english: ~z~Assholes don't know how much it's worth. They're screwing it up on the beach at Firefly.
zh: ~z~有一群不识货的臭傻逼，在萤火虫的海滩上瞎搞。

english: ~z~If I could use my legs, I'd jump for joy Johnny boy. Later on, Brother.
zh: ~z~要不是腿瘸了，我就高兴得跳起来了，强尼。之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Your man's gonna get some bad news, Angus. Tell him for me, will you?
zh: ~z~有一个坏消息要跟你老板说，安格斯。替我转告他好吗？

english: ~z~Fuck if I can pronounce it, but a Ha-ha-coochie-koo is now in your possession, Angus.
zh: ~z~这名儿真念不来，那辆哈哈库奇库现在是你的了，安格斯。

english: ~z~Shit man, you could have told me I'd be driving a dirt bike. Anyways, I got that Sanchez for you.
zh: ~z~妈的，你早点说这次是山地车啊。总之，我拿到桑切斯了。

english: ~z~Angus, man, I'm sorry but shit got fucked up and I couldn't get that bike.
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟，很抱歉事情搞砸了，我没弄到车。

english: ~z~Brother, Man, something's come up. I can't get the bike for you. Another time.
zh: ~z~兄弟，出了点意外。我没法替你弄车了。下次再说吧。

english: ~z~There's too many assholes in this city on bikes, my man. Which one can I deprive of his ride?
zh: ~z~城里骑摩托车的傻逼太多了，老兄。我该抢哪个人的车？

english: ~z~Hey, your contact better still want that bike 'cause I got it for him.
zh: ~z~嘿，你的上家最好不要跑单，因为我已经得手了。

english: ~z~Brother man, tell me where I can find a bike and I'll bring it right to you.
zh: ~z~好兄弟，告诉我哪里能找到摩托，我给你搞过来。

english: ~z~How 'bout that, man? I happened to come across a Nightblade right where you said.
zh: ~z~怎么样，兄弟？我碰巧在你说的地方看到一辆夜刃。

english: ~z~Bike's outside of the clubhouse, now all you need to do is get it out the country, Angus.
zh: ~z~车已经在会所外面了，接下来只需要出口国外了，安格斯。

english: ~z~Shit, Angus, I'm in the bike stealing mood. Where am I gonna be able to find one?
zh: ~z~妈的，安格斯，我想偷摩托车了。你说去哪儿偷一辆好？

english: ~z~We've got one for you, old friend. Just try to save me the hassle and deliver it this time.
zh: ~z~之前也找过你了，老朋友。这次就让我省点心，把车弄到手吧。

english: ~z~Hey Angus, hate to do this to a brother, but I can't go get you that bike. Sorry.
zh: ~z~嘿，安格斯，虽然不想这样，但我不能你搞到那辆摩托了。抱歉。

english: ~z~I hate to split up a pair of lovebirds, but there's a couple taking it for a spin round Middle Park.
zh: ~z~我讨厌棒打鸳鸯，但是有对情侣正骑着它在中央公园兜风。

english: ~z~I've got something, Johnny. Please, for me, can you make sure it gets here?
zh: ~z~是有目标，强尼。给兄弟个面子，这次能保证弄到手吗？

english: ~z~There's an Angel motorcycle ready for export, man. That was my end of the deal.
zh: ~z~这辆天使摩托已经准备好出口了。我这边完成了。

english: ~z~Big group of Deadbeats are taking it for a run down the old Alderney freeway.
zh: ~z~一大群死妈天使正骑着车在奥尔德尼的高速上兜风。

english: ~z~You got your Daemon, man. Put a stamp on it and ship that mother.
zh: ~z~恶魔到手了，兄弟。贴好邮票以后就装箱发货吧。

english: ~z~There's a guy detailing it like he knows it's for sale or something. Outside the tattoo guy in Alderney City.
zh: ~z~车主正在洗车，这不正好要帮他卖车吗。车在奥尔德尼市的纹身店外面。

english: ~z~Looks like I'll be able to afford that hardware I was after. You did good, my brother.
zh: ~z~这下有钱买一直想要的大件了。干得漂亮，好兄弟。

english: ~z~We got one, man. This guy gets mad when they're not delivered, but fuck him, man, you're my brother.
zh: ~z~上次就找过你，兄弟。老板没拿到车气得暴跳如雷。但是去他妈的，你才是我兄弟。

english: ~z~Johnny, man. We haven't been able to source any. It's only a matter of time though so call back.
zh: ~z~强尼兄弟，暂时没有看中的车。但早晚会找到目标的，有空再聊。

english: ~z~Well, you didn't get the last one, but who cares, right? There's another one lined up for you.
zh: ~z~上次你就失手了，但也没关系。新的目标已经给你安排好了。

english: ~z~There's nothing available right now, Johnny. Call back soon and we'll see if we can find one.
zh: ~z~现在什么活都没有，强尼。过会儿再来问问有没有目标吧。

english: ~z~The guy's happy with the last one and he's hungry for another, man.
zh: ~z~老板对上次的车很满意，急着要下一辆呢，兄弟。

english: ~z~It's outside the Triangle Club in Bohan. Just bring it back to the House, OK?
zh: ~z~车在波汉的三角俱乐部外面。到手了就送回会所，懂了吗？

english: ~z~After delivering like you did before, this dude is happy to be in business with us, man.
zh: ~z~上次你完美交差，现在老板很乐意跟我们合作，兄弟。

english: ~z~How about that? You just keep knocking 'em out. And you know what? We got another bike lined up.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，你继续保持就行了。知道吗？又有新订单了。

english: ~z~How about that, man. We haven't been able to find what we need. Call again soon and they'll be one.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，兄弟。我们还没找到目标。过段时间应该就有了。

english: ~z~Angus, brother. If you were going to export a bike to Japan, where might I be able to find it?
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟。假如你要向日本出口摩托，我得去哪儿找车？

english: ~z~Hey dude, your man isn't going to get his ride. Let him down easy.
zh: ~z~嘿，哥们。你老板拿不到摩托车了。让他放宽心吧。

english: ~z~Angus, man, you and your contact are now the proud owners of a second hand bike.
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟，你和你的上家现在是二手车的荣誉车主了。

english: ~z~Good to know, man. I hope you had some fun scaring 'em off, at least. See you round.
zh: ~z~知道了，兄弟。希望你至少从吓唬他们中得到了乐趣。再见。

english: ~z~Give Terry or Clay a call if you ever need some help on club business.
zh: ~z~帮会的事哪里需要帮助，就给特里或科雷打个电话。

english: ~z~We're at war again, boys. That means we get to kill this Lost motherfucker.
zh: ~z~现在又开战了，兄弟们。不要放过失落帮的傻逼玩意。

english: ~z~Seriously, man. You should start using the brothers more now that you're in charge.
zh: ~z~说真的，老兄。现在你是老大，就该多使唤使唤弟兄们。

english: ~z~Deadbeats we're after are in vans, boys. Come on!
zh: ~z~我们要找的死妈天使在面包车上，兄弟们。上吧！

english: ~z~Job done, my man. Those Deadbeats ain't a problem and you introduced me to your new friends.
zh: ~z~搞定了，兄弟。死妈天使不成问题了，你还把我介绍给了你的新朋友。

english: ~z~Terrence, man. You wanna watch me shove some stick of dynamite up a Deadbeats ass?
zh: ~z~特伦斯，老兄。想看我把炸药塞到死妈天使的屁眼里吗？

english: ~z~Whoo wee! Me and Clay'll put on our raincoats. Don't have all the fun without us.
zh: ~z~喔喂！我和科雷做好安全措施就来。别一个人吃独食。

english: ~z~Yeah, Malc and DeSean are good guys. No bullshit. Apart from the hairdryers they ride.
zh: ~z~嗯，马尔科姆和德肖恩都是好人。不骗你。坏就坏在都爱骑「吹风机」。

english: ~z~Dude, I got me some new toys that go boom. Put in your ear plugs and come join me.
zh: ~z~老兄，我搞到些会爆炸的新玩具。戴上你的耳塞跟我来。

english: ~z~I told them to go fuck themselves. I may be an asshole but I won't talk about my brothers.
zh: ~z~我叫他们滚蛋。我也许不是好人，但绝不会出卖兄弟。

english: ~z~Maybe you should do the talking, man. I don't know if I can trust myself.
zh: ~z~还是你去跟他交涉吧，兄弟。我有点信不过自己。

english: ~z~And that's what we got left. You, me, Angus, Terry, Clay - brothers.
zh: ~z~也正是我们现在拥有的。你，我，安格斯，特里，科雷——都是兄弟。

english: ~z~Man, I had no idea Brian was this popular. Who the fuck are these punks?
zh: ~z~天哪，我都不知道布莱恩这么受欢迎。哪来这么多傻逼？

english: ~z~Hey man, last thing I want is to talk to that snivelling little shit bag.
zh: ~z~喂，兄弟，我才不想和那个爱哭鼻子的小混蛋说话。

english: ~z~Interesting because I thought he was actually an ass kissing double crossing little shit.
zh: ~z~有意思，因为我觉得他是个两面三刀的舔狗叛徒。

english: ~z~Don't apologize, Johnny. Brian's the one with something to be sorry for. Another time.
zh: ~z~别道歉，强尼。布莱恩才是需要道歉的人。下次再说吧。

english: ~z~Don't I know it, man. But what choice do we got? It's them or us!
zh: ~z~我也恶心啊，兄弟。但也没得选了，水火不容啊！

english: ~z~You think Billy'd stick his neck out for you? You're dumber than I thought.
zh: ~z~你以为比利会为你两肋插刀？你比我想的还要蠢。

english: ~z~We spoke to that fat fuck Brian. He wants to sit down, call a truce.
zh: ~z~我们和那个死胖子布莱恩谈过了。他想要坐下来，和谈。

english: ~z~I couldn't do it to a brother, even him. He's dead inside anyway.
zh: ~z~我无法对兄弟下手，即使是他。反正他已经是具行尸走肉了。

english: ~z~No one likes to take down a brother, Terry, but this has to be done.
zh: ~z~没人乐意杀自己的兄弟，特里，但这次必须下手。

english: ~z~I was just thinking how selfish it was of me to deal with Brian all by myself.
zh: ~z~我在想我一个人去找布莱恩算账会不会有点自私。

english: ~z~I mean I wouldn't want to be in prison or anything, but I, you know, I'd take it.
zh: ~z~我也不想去蹲监狱受苦啥的，但是，那个吧，我接受了。

english: ~z~Oh, okay, man. Cool. We'll fix her up. It's not the end of the world.
zh: ~z~噢，没事，兄弟。我们会修好的。事情还没那么糟。

english: ~z~I'd pay a dollar to see Brian's face if you shot a grenade through that window, man.
zh: ~z~你往那扇窗户来颗榴弹，我就出一块钱看布莱恩的烂脸，老兄。

english: ~z~Please, Johnny, please. I'll be good. I'll leave and never come back.
zh: ~z~求你了，强尼，求你了。我会学乖的。我会离开这里，永不回来的。

english: ~z~Clay, I'm at Brian's place. You guys want to come here and help me with him?
zh: ~z~科雷，我在布莱恩的藏身处了。你们想过来帮我收拾他吗？

english: ~z~James, I couldn't do it, man. He getting out of town.
zh: ~z~杰姆斯，我下不了手，兄弟。他滚出这座城市了。

english: ~z~You swore an oath, Johnny. Don't do this to your brother, man. I'll get out of town.
zh: ~z~你发过誓的，强尼。别这么对你的兄弟。我会消失的。

english: ~z~You wouldn't kill a brother, you wouldn't. I'll be a ghost man, gone!
zh: ~z~你不会杀兄弟的，不会的。我会从你们眼前消失的，消失！

english: ~z~I'm gonna wait for our brother round back with Clay. Send him out to us, will you?
zh: ~z~我和科雷去后面等我们的好兄弟。把他熏出来，行不？

english: ~z~I know what you mean. Let's just hope he's not planning anything else. Later on, man.
zh: ~z~我懂你的意思。希望他不要打其他小算盘。下次见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Lost MC forever, my brother. Don't do it. I'll leave the city, I promise you man.
zh: ~z~失落帮万岁，好兄弟。别这么做。我会离开这座城市的，说话算话。

english: ~z~Right on, Brother. Me and Terry can go 'round the back and wait for him.
zh: ~z~马上就来，兄弟。我和特里可以绕到后门去等他。

english: ~z~but now that you mention it so does Brian, and right now he's our problem.
zh: ~z~不过转念一想，布莱恩也一样。现在他还是我们的麻烦。

english: ~z~That the same Ash you ain't seeing no more? The Ashley Butler who's too tweaked to know what's good for her?
zh: ~z~又是那个再也不见的阿什莉？犯毒瘾犯到失去判断力的阿什莉･巴特勒？

english: ~z~More shit storm than steam room, Congressman. We weren't all born into money.
zh: ~z~烂得没空去蒸汽浴室，议员。不是所有人都生来富贵的。

english: ~z~Jonathan. That export guy we got, he don't have no more bike orders at the moment.
zh: ~z~乔纳森。问我们收车的人，他暂时不需要摩托了。

english: ~z~That Ashley, sure. I just want her to be okay so I ain't leaving her to die, you know.
zh: ~z~是那个阿什莉，没错。我只是不想见死不救，让她能保住小命而已。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, I'd prefer to stand up for something then to chop and change and stab a friend in the back to get ahead.

zh: ~z~如果你喜欢钞票、毒品和混蛋，那确实。但我喜欢老派的抢劫。

zh: ~z~克雷比兹，听着，有事跟你说一声，顺便感谢下你先前的协助。

zh: ~z~阿什莉？她毒瘾太重了，我终于能放下她了，伙计。

zh: ~z~我这会长据点被烧、兄弟尽失。已经完了，伙计。都结束了。

zh: ~z~你是个好人，强尼。你的人生不该是现在这样的。

zh: ~z~也是那些不会背刺我的弟兄。你去探望比利吗？他说了那种话，我可能去不了了。

zh: ~z~不知道。可能会每月给吉姆的老婆孩子生活费吧，我欠他的。

english: ~z~Well, dude, what do you think? Is he on top of his shit or is he gonna run this club into a hole?
zh: ~z~那老兄，我问问你，你觉得他会振兴帮派还是带来麻烦？

zh: ~z~他也不会希望我去的。再见了，阿强。分会会长。

zh: ~z~反正他肯定会自讨苦吃。妈的，比利真没怎么跟我聊过。

zh: ~z~(唱歌) 度过我黄金般的人生... 度过我黄金般的人生。

zh: ~z~是啊，只不过你那买家朋友是个卧底。差点没把我阴死。

zh: ~z~挺好，挺好。他可能是城里唯一一个不替政府干活的人了。

zh: ~z~要是他来我们队效力，我希望我是捕手，宝贝。真的。

zh: ~z~乔纳森，兄弟，我在想要不要一起去赛车。你说呢？

zh: ~z~那是曾经的我。我现在清白了。已经把冰毒之类的都戒了。

zh: ~z~我们啥都没干，强尼。没做越界的事。只是我需要你来找他。

zh: ~z~肯去拜托狱警的话，你俩说不定还能来次夫妻探视。

zh: ~z~还是老样子，强尼。你能来阿克特区的阿斯普丁路找我吗？

zh: ~z~汤姆･斯塔布斯是一个自豪的爱国者，对上帝心存敬畏。他反对自由堕胎，支持自由。

zh: ~z~说不来话，麻烦你过来找我，好吗？快点，宝贝。

zh: ~z~这位议员现在在阿尔冈琴的一家绅士俱乐部——不露奶的那种——枪斗士。

zh: ~z~如果有兴趣帮我的忙，你就联系我，我会告诉你要求。

zh: ~z~得了吧，阿什莉，别扯了。你溜了三天冰，哪有工夫做梦啊。

zh: ~z~以前比利当分会老大的时候，布莱恩又给他洗衣服又给他点烟。

zh: ~z~我天天跟你这种恶棍在一块，老娘们比起我更喜欢吸毒。

zh: ~z~你应该看下世人对失落帮的想法，兄弟。有混蛋给我们建了网站，链接我发你了。

zh: ~z~我需要你这种能人帮的忙已经多了两倍了，这还是保守估计。

zh: ~z~好的，兄弟。我会找他们的。下次一定叫上。谢了，吉姆。

zh: ~z~有一个众议员需要你的帮助，汤姆･斯塔布斯三世。

zh: ~z~我也让马尔科姆和德肖恩过去了，去她在南波汉的住处。

zh: ~z~需要一个披坚执锐的骑士救我出去。他们要杀我...甚至更糟。

english: ~z~Oh, I think so. Don't really know where the other brothers stand, so it's them or no one.
zh: ~z~呃，不至于。主要还是帮里弟兄各怀鬼胎，只能找他们了。

english: ~z~Now listen, Klebitz. The tax payer is picking up the bill for this call so I'm going to make it brief.
zh: ~z~你听好，克雷比兹。打这通电话用的是纳税人的钱，我就长话短说了。

zh: ~z~哪天想帮你维系锦衣玉食的生活方式了，我再联系你。

english: ~z~If you ever feel like this war we're in ain't worth it, that'll persuade you it is.
zh: ~z~要是你觉得开战不值得，看完网站就不会这么想了。

zh: ~z~嗯，听说了。听着，强尼。那个，你身上有钱吗？

zh: ~z~我上次见到你的时候可不是这样。你没事就好。再见，阿什莉。

zh: ~z~操你妈的，强尼。说这种话干嘛？我只是喜欢比利，仅此而已。

zh: ~z~那些条子早就不在了。准备好了就给安格斯打个电话。

zh: ~z~听着，之前让我们偷死亡天使摩托的那个人，他想要的摩托还有很多。

english: ~z~We're over at Drusilla's in Little Italy. Can't wait to see you, baby.
zh: ~z~我们在小意大利的德鲁西拉's。期待你的到来，宝贝。

english: ~z~Hey, Johnny boy. It's nothing. I mean it's something, but, but, it ain't like you think.
zh: ~z~嘿，强尼仔。没怎么，不是，确实有点事，但不是你想的那样。

zh: ~z~他可是有脾气的，强尼。妈的。你他妈怎么能这么对我？我谢谢你啊。

zh: ~z~没有，甜心。都没摸到过。把这坏消息告诉雷吧。

english: ~z~Mr. Tony, I have what I tell you, perfect clarity, beautiful clarity,
zh: ~z~托尼先生，我之前可没骗你，净度完美，成色美丽，

zh: ~z~好的，哥们。我会跟那边的分会说一声你要来的。

zh: ~z~雷最好祈祷下垃圾车不会马上来。他给我钱了没？

zh: ~z~特里，科雷，咱们去追钻石。其他人去追那两个人。

zh: ~z~我只知道，这些钻石在一个叫托尼･普林斯的交际花手里，

zh: ~z~哦，别理他，可能是跟哪个蠢妞玩了一宿犯傻了。

zh: ~z~兄弟们，去追那两个人。特里！科雷！咱们去追钻石。

zh: ~z~杰姆斯兄弟。有条大鱼在布洛克，需要人手支援。

zh: ~z~我很抱歉，甜心。太可惜了。我觉得雷不会给你钱了，抱歉。

zh: ~z~我需要你把钻石分开。一半放到赤铁矿街的垃圾堆，另一半放到翡翠街的垃圾堆。

zh: ~z~为了帮派在所不辞，好兄弟，连披萨都得吃。咱们晚点见。
