zh: ~z~是吗，关我屁事。老子钱呢？你别挂我电话，你别挂我电话啊...

english: ~z~You better not be pulling nothing, Johnny. Or I'll start pulling your fucking teeth. You hear me?
zh: ~z~你最好别耍花招，强尼。不然我让你脑袋开花，听到没？

english: ~z~Uhh, yeah, this is Ray Boccino. Shut your mouth and don't say nothing incriminating on this uhh, voicemail.
zh: ~z~呃，对，我是雷･博奇诺。管住嘴巴，别在电话留言里说什么违法的事。

english: ~z~Mind waiting here while I get the cash. All these tattoos might scare em.
zh: ~z~你们别动，我去拿钱。一群纹身男会吓死他们的。

english: ~z~That don't sound too salubrious, Jonathan. Ah fuck sign us up, brother.
zh: ~z~听上去就对身体不好，乔纳森。啊，算了，带上我们吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~Uhh, brother man. I need some help. Shit's kicked off at the Libertonian.
zh: ~z~呃，兄弟，我需要帮忙。自由城博物馆闹翻天了。

english: ~z~Terry, man, I could sure do with some help. Stuff went bad at the Libertonian.
zh: ~z~特里哥们，我很需要有人帮忙。自由城博物馆出了状况。

english: ~z~We worked hard for this cash, slick. It's Lost MC property.
zh: ~z~为了这钱我们累死累活，滑头。这是失落帮的财产。

english: ~z~Awww, man. You mean I got to sit here with Terry. Shit.
zh: ~z~啊，哥们。那我只能和特里坐着发呆。妈的。真无聊。

english: ~z~Whoa. Surpirse. You are a fuckin' ape. Who woulda guessed it.
zh: ~z~哇哦，太惊喜了。你没进化全是吧？真没想到啊。

english: ~z~Haven't been in here since I was a kid. Shit don't change, do it?
zh: ~z~小时候来过一次就再没来过了。这里还是没有变化啊。

english: ~z~Got kind of distracted in the Libertonian and, umm, I think the deal's off.
zh: ~z~在博物馆里的时候有点走神了，呃，交易应该是吹了。

english: ~z~Okay Johnny. Nicky tells me you got away with the money. Bring it to me.
zh: ~z~好了强尼，尼克跟我说钱都在你手里。快拿过来。

english: ~z~Then you should cheer up, Raymundo. It didn't feel right. Later.
zh: ~z~那你还是高兴点吧，雷蒙多。我觉得有问题。回见。

english: ~z~Niko said that? Dude, that's weird. Shit was kicking off.
zh: ~z~尼克这么说的？老兄，太奇怪了。当时一片混乱。

english: ~z~Thanks for the advice, Ray. I was thinking the same thing about you and a coffin. You got that diamond money?
zh: ~z~谢谢你的建议，雷。我觉得你和棺材也挺配的。钻石变现了没？

english: ~z~You know I never thought I'd say this, I hope your phone is tapped you fucking imbicile. So long.
zh: ~z~没想到我都能说出这种话，真希望你电话被政府窃听了，你他妈个傻逼。再见。

english: ~z~Terry, man. I need you guys to get down to the Libertonian ASAP. Meet me at the North entrance.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，你们赶紧来自由城博物馆。来北门找我。

english: ~z~Ha ha. Yeah, sure. I need some help with an exchange, Terrence.
zh: ~z~哈哈，是这么回事。有笔交易需要你来帮我，特伦斯。

english: ~z~You've got to give that girl another chance, you know. You kids are perfect for each other.
zh: ~z~你能不能再给她一次机会啊？其实你俩挺般配的。

english: ~z~Gentlemen, gentlemen, pardon the precautions. You know how things are.
zh: ~z~先生们，先生们，恕我带了保镖。这年头不安全啊。

english: ~z~Clay, dude, can you and Terry get your asses to the Libertonian? I need some help. I'll see you at the North door, man.
zh: ~z~科雷，老兄，你和特里赶紧来自由城博物馆。我需要支援。我们北门见，哥们。

english: ~z~Isaac and Mori ain't happy Johnny. I am telling you these are serious people.
zh: ~z~艾萨克和莫里很不高兴，强尼。这些人都不是好惹的。

english: ~z~Yeah? That's real cute. Taking people out is some kind of joke to you?
zh: ~z~是吗？你真可爱。杀人对你来说就像是玩笑一样吗？

english: ~z~We had a problem, Raymond. I didn't like the look of some of the muscle at the Libertonian.
zh: ~z~我们有麻烦了，雷蒙德。博物馆里有些打手的臭脸让我很不爽。

english: ~z~Shit, I'd call me. Then I'd lead those suckers over to, uhh, Keneckie Avenue maybe.
zh: ~z~妈的，我会找我支援。再把这些混蛋引到...基内基大道吧。

english: ~z~Are you telling me that a backstabbing mob guy who wants to kill me ain't the problem?
zh: ~z~你想跟我说，这个背刺我的黑手党不是问题所在？

english: ~z~Cause he's the boss, Terry. And 'cause no one else in the gang is dumb enough to get in the trouble he does.
zh: ~z~因为他是大哥，特里。帮里也不会有谁傻得像他一样天天摊上事。

english: ~z~Billy would be getting himself a drink, and trying to screw my woman. Not fighting alongside me.
zh: ~z~比利会给自己满上一杯，然后来抢我的女人，不会跟我并肩作战的。

english: ~z~Clay, man. What would you do if you had an unknown number of mobster hitmen on your tail?
zh: ~z~科雷，哥们。要是被数量不明的黑帮杀手追杀，你会咋办？

english: ~z~Come over to Keneckie Ave. and we'll see if those greaseballs can handle The Lost MC.
zh: ~z~你来基内基大道吧，看看这帮意大利佬打不打得过失落帮。

english: ~z~Johnny K you're alright. I'm sorry, sweets. I think Ray sent some guys after you.
zh: ~z~强尼 K，你还好吗？对不起，甜心。我想雷已经派人追杀你了。

english: Terry and Clay have set up an ambush. If you can get to them, they can help you.
zh: 特里和科雷已经设下埋伏。只要找到他们，就能得到支援。

english: ~z~He's coming into Francis International from his estate in South Carraway in the family helicopter.
zh: ~z~他从South 卡拉韦的家里开着他家的直升机来到弗朗西斯国际机场了。

english: ~z~We're looking after a VIP and he doesn't wanna see your ugly face. So long.
zh: ~z~咱们在找一位VIP，但他不想看你那丑逼脸。再见。

english: ~z~Let me tell you something... you've got a job wiping rich pricks' asses,
zh: ~z~我跟你说句实话...你干的是给阔佬擦屁股的活计，

english: ~z~Oh, don't get sentimental, Klebitz. It's unappealing. I am a WASP, after all.
zh: ~z~哦，别煽情了，克雷比兹。这很不爽。毕竟我是个大佬。

english: ~z~a typical Stubbs you might say. Sleep easy and drop into the club sometime soon.
zh: ~z~可谓是斯塔布斯家的典型。好好睡一觉，有空再来俱乐部一趟。

english: ~z~It'll have a baggage handler uniform in it that should get you access to the runways. Enjoy yourself.
zh: ~z~里面会有件行李搬运工的制服，这应该能帮你进到跑道里去。嗨起来吧。

english: ~z~"I think you should leave sir, before I...", dude, it is the twenty-first century.
zh: ~z~「请您自己出去，不然...」老哥，这都二十一世纪了。

english: ~z~You don't racially profile like a terrorist, but I'm about to start treating you like one.
zh: ~z~虽然你长得不像恐怖分子，但我还是得把你当作恐怖分子招待了。

english: ~z~And thank you, best massage I ever had that didn't involve a happy ending
zh: ~z~谢谢了，这是我做过最好的按摩，既没有性服务，

english: ~z~Oh, Mr. Stubbs, sir. Okay, you only had to say so, sir.
zh: ~z~噢，您找斯塔布斯先生啊。好的，下次您早点说，先生。

english: ~z~Unfortunately, an awful man has insured that my chance of being re-elected is pretty much zero.
zh: ~z~很不幸，有个坏家伙让我再次当选的几率趋近于零。

english: ~z~Nice tattoos, no wonder you can only get a job like this. Move it, asshole.
zh: ~z~纹身不错，怪不得你只能找到这样的工作。去吧，混蛋。

english: ~z~but I'm supposed to see Tom Stubbs and well... he said to meet him here.
zh: ~z~但我是来这儿找汤姆･斯塔布斯的...他说来这里找他。

english: ~z~Personally, I'd prefer a benign dictatorship without the pretence of choice,
zh: ~z~对我来说，我更中意开明独裁，没有「你有选择」的假象。

english: ~z~I've just sent my black suit to the dry cleaners. You better have the news I'm looking for.
zh: ~z~我刚刚把我的黑色西装送去干洗了。你最好告诉我想听到的消息。

english: ~z~Follow me, will you. Mr. Stubbs is in the day spa, receiving some back work.
zh: ~z~我来为您带路。斯塔布斯先生在做SPA，按摩背部呢。

english: ~z~Ah, he was a man of the people, a philanthropist, a pompous windbag and an occasional catamite,
zh: ~z~啊，他是人民公仆，是个大善人，是个牛皮大王，有时也是个小受。

english: ~z~Sadly, Stubbs, I'm not going to be able to disappoint you. Your uncle is no longer with us.
zh: ~z~很遗憾，斯塔布斯，没能让你失望。你叔叔与世长辞了。

english: ~z~Life insurance too, for that matter. Oh no, you take out my dearest kin any way you can.
zh: ~z~也买了人寿保险。哦不，你千方百计要干掉我最爱的家人。

english: ~z~Yeah, under this ravaged, drug-addled exterior lies the heart of a reactionary prick,
zh: ~z~对，在这副瘾君子的皮囊下，藏着一颗叛逆浪子的心，

english: ~z~I'm familiar with mechanics. I believe it's man's duty to take things apart and see how they work.
zh: ~z~我对机械很熟悉。我相信男人的使命就是把东西拆开，弄清楚原理。

english: ~z~My former friends are on their own now. I'll see you, Klebitz.
zh: ~z~我以前的这些朋友该自力更生了。再见，克雷比兹。

english: ~z~Long way from the Exchange now, aren't you, you yuppie pricks? Still think you're better than guys like me, huh?
zh: ~z~这里可不是你们的证券交易所，雅皮士屌毛。还觉得自己比我们优越吗？

english: ~z~There's a boat waiting behind the Globe Oil plant in Acter Industrial.
zh: ~z~有条船在阿克特工业园的Globe炼油厂后面等我们。

english: ~z~I need some help, brother. The cherry tops have got me closed in. I need some friends to take some of the heat for me.
zh: ~z~我需要帮助，兄弟。条子把我关起来了。我需要来几个兄弟帮我弄走这玩意。

english: ~z~while my whole life falls to shit all around me. But fuck it. I'm alright.
zh: ~z~同时我的整个人生都变得一团糟。不过没事，爷很好。

english: ~z~Your friends are out to sea, Mr. Stubbs. Good luck to them. I think they'll need it.
zh: ~z~你的朋友都出海了，斯塔布斯先生。祝他们好运吧，他们会需要的。

english: ~z~Believe me, a short recession and a trip to Panama isn't going to finish those boys off.
zh: ~z~相信我吧，短暂的经济衰退和巴拿马之行弄不垮他们的。

english: ~z~Oh don't you worry, those boys don't need luck. You shoulda seen them in '73.
zh: ~z~哦，别担心，那帮人不需要运气。你该看看他们73年的表现。

english: ~z~Anything for a brother in need. I'll tell them to listen out for the sirens. Good luck with it.
zh: ~z~兄弟有难，八方支援。我会告诉他们注意听警笛声的。祝好运吧。

english: ~z~Well, Mr. Stubbs. The good news is the cops aren't going to get there hands on those voters.
zh: ~z~呃，斯塔布斯先生，有个好消息，那些选民不会被警察抓回去了。

english: ~z~I was thinking their problem might lie with one of the other passengers on their little cruise. Later on, Mr. Congressman.
zh: ~z~主要是船上还有个不妙的家伙。回见，议员先生。

english: ~z~Unless you yuppies want me to throw you to the pigs, shut the hell up.
zh: ~z~你们这帮雅皮士，不想被我送给傻逼条子就他妈闭嘴。

english: ~z~Dead men don't talk, Klebitz. This, I can work with. I'll talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~死人不会说话，克雷比兹。这样，我来处理吧。晚点找你。

english: ~z~Acter Industrial is where they're meant to meet us. By the Globe Oil plant.
zh: ~z~他们计划的会合点在阿克特工业园的Globe炼油厂。

english: ~z~Yes, sir. Something like that. And tell me sir, are you happy?
zh: ~z~是的，先生。差不多是这样。告诉我，先生，您快乐吗？

english: ~z~I'm afraid I can't get your yuppie friends out of the city, Mr. Stubbs.
zh: ~z~恐怕我不能带你的雅皮士朋友逃出生天了，斯塔布斯先生。

english: ~z~Those coveralls chafing you? Well you must be used to wearing Perseus suits and shit.
zh: ~z~这身囚服是不是硌得难受？你们肯定只穿得惯神之子的垃圾西装。

english: ~z~Bad news, Mr. Congressman. Something more important than your career has come up and I can't help you.
zh: ~z~坏消息，议员先生。我突然有些比你的政治生涯更要紧的事，帮不了你了。

english: ~z~Oh, appreciate the heads up and the friendly patter. Another time, Johnny.
zh: ~z~哦，感谢你毫无意义的友情提示。那就下次吧，强尼。

english: ~z~Find some other putz to clean up your shit, Mr. Stubbs. I've decided I'm busy.
zh: ~z~擦屁股这事您还是另请高明吧，斯塔布斯先生。我说过我很忙了。

english: ~z~While your work ethic needs much improvement, Klebitz, you can always be relied upon for your charm.
zh: ~z~虽然你的职业素养有待提高，克雷比兹，但能力确实值得信赖。

english: ~z~Hey, Stubbs, did you really want that thing done? Too bad, 'cause something else came up.
zh: ~z~嘿，斯塔布斯，你真的想那么做吗？很遗憾，我突然有点急事。

english: ~z~Hey, Mr. Stubbs, working for you makes me feel like a piece of shit. I can't do that thing for you. Sorry.
zh: ~z~嘿，斯塔布斯先生，替你做事让我感觉很糟。我不能为你做那件事。抱歉。

english: ~z~I guess the old horn dog couldn't get it up. When I last saw him in the changing room he looked virile enough.
zh: ~z~我猜这只老色鬼硬不起来了。我上次在更衣室见他还挺有男子气概的。

english: ~z~I'm here. Problem is I can't tell your colleague from all the other bottom feeders hanging round.
zh: ~z~我到了。问题是怎么从附近这么多小人物里找出你的同事。

english: ~z~The guy had a semi after squash. Oh well. Must have been on Mollis. Call me, Klebitz.
zh: ~z~那家伙打完壁球后喝了半杯。噢好吧。一定是靠Mollis硬的。有空打给我，克雷比兹。

english: ~z~What I'm after is someone to snap a shot of a fellow Congressman picking up a lady of the night.
zh: ~z~这次的需求是找人帮我拍一个议员同事找小姐的照片。

english: ~z~That's too bad for him and us, Klebitz. Give me a call later on.
zh: ~z~那对他和我们来说太糟了，克雷比兹。过会儿再给我打个电话。

english: ~z~Unless you're after some necrophilic porn, Congressman, I'm not going to be able to help you out this time.
zh: ~z~除非你想看恋尸癖的黄片，议员先生，我这次帮不了你了。

english: ~z~Now make sure the photograph's tabloid material, will you, sport? Ah, there's a champ!
zh: ~z~务必确保照片会成为小报的素材，好吗，哥们？啊，知道你靠谱！

english: ~z~The cops have scared off all the women, Mr. Stubbs. Your guy ain't gonna get his dose of VD.
zh: ~z~条子吓跑了那些妓女，斯塔布斯先生。你那同事肯定得不了性病了。

english: ~z~It's sensational. I might employ you to come around and photograph my family Christmas card as well.
zh: ~z~这太妙了。我可能还会找你来我家帮忙拍圣诞贺卡上的照片。

english: ~z~a little hypocrisy is hardly a sin. He's over on Traeger St in Port Tudor. Get a good one.
zh: ~z~有点虚伪算不上罪过。他就在都铎港的特雷格街。拍张好点的。

english: ~z~If it means bringing down scumbags like you, Stubbsie boy, I'm in.
zh: ~z~如果能让你同类的小人下台，Stubbsie仔，我干。

english: ~z~Is that what you're after? Run out of tennis partners when you killed off your uncle?
zh: ~z~是说你的需求吗？杀了你叔叔后就没人当你的网球搭档了？

english: ~z~Exactly! That's part of my new campaign strategy. Giving people no choice.
zh: ~z~正是如此！我的新竞选策略就有这条。不给选民选择。

english: ~z~Wouldn't be in this situation if it wasn't for positive discrimination, dammit.
zh: ~z~要不是为了少数族裔的特别优待就没这回事了，妈的。

english: ~z~Oh, you've got a mind for damage control, Johnny. If this rebel thing doesn't work out,
zh: ~z~噢，你还真有损害管制的头脑，强尼。哪天叛逆不下去了，

english: ~z~Fair enough. I can't claim to like it, but I also can't claim to have a choice.
zh: ~z~也行。我谈不上喜欢这个主意，但我的确也没得选。

english: ~z~In all seriousness though, some jumped up little twerp is about to go to the press with sensitive information.
zh: ~z~回归正题，有个无耻混蛋要把一个敏感信息透露给媒体。

english: ~z~Ah, if it isn't the road warrior, himself. Still sticking it to the man, man?
zh: ~z~啊，这不是公路战士吗。还是原来那样叛逆吗，兄弟？

english: ~z~Making threats like that can get you some serious jail time, sir. That was a big error.
zh: ~z~这样威胁我可是能让你坐牢的，先生。你犯了个大错。

english: ~z~You're the guy who just realized what a big fucking mistake it'd be to talk to some mud slingin' hack about Tom Stubbs.
zh: ~z~你就要意识到自己差点犯下多大的错误了，居然想找三流记者写汤姆･斯塔布斯的黑料。

english: ~z~I knew you were stuck in the '70s, but that's ridiculous.
zh: ~z~我知道你的思想还停留在70年代，但也太荒唐了。

english: ~z~Mr. Stubbs. Your friend got away from me. Looks like you're gonna have your fifteen minutes.
zh: ~z~斯塔布斯先生，你的朋友从我这里跑了。看来你的光荣时刻就快要结束了。

english: ~z~Too bad for him and us, Klebitz. Give me a call later on.
zh: ~z~于他于我们都很遗憾，克雷比兹。有空再打给我吧。

english: ~z~Stubbsy, I didn't get the chance to talk to that friend of yours. He was too busy getting killed.
zh: ~z~斯塔布西，我没能跟你的朋友说上话。当时他忙着去死。

english: ~z~Oh, can you give him a big fuck off from me when you got him?
zh: ~z~噢，见着他的时候能替我问候句「去你妈的」吗？

english: ~z~I'm doing okay. You are down one good friend to the horrors of gangland violence.
zh: ~z~我很好。但你的一位好友因恐怖的黑社会暴力遇害了。

english: ~z~Appreciate the tip, but I think I'll stick to terrorism, the economy and the environment.
zh: ~z~不错的主意，但我还是会坚持恐怖主义、经济和环境的议题。

english: ~z~But, I've been working twelve hour days on a six month unpaid internship...
zh: ~z~但是，我每天工作12小时的无薪实习已经持续半年了...

english: ~z~... that's the problem with your generation. You expect everything to come to you at once.
zh: ~z~...这就是你们这代人的问题。你们总是希望立刻得到回报。

english: ~z~First it's family, now it's friends. You're not a good guy to get close to, Stubbs.
zh: ~z~之前是亲人，现在又是朋友。你不是什么值得交往的好人，斯塔布斯。

english: ~z~Leave it in the moth balls, Congressman. Your old friend's funeral may not be for some time.
zh: ~z~还是挂在衣柜里吧，议员先生。你老朋友的葬礼可能还得过段时间。

english: ~z~Book us a room at the Majestic. I'll show you what hard work really is.
zh: ~z~给我们在Majestic酒店开个房。我会告诉你什么是真正的努力工作。

english: ~z~There you are, Johnny. Should I break out the lucky black suit?
zh: ~z~好了，强尼。我需要拿出那套黑色的幸运西装吗？

english: ~z~Ha ha. I sure will, sport. Old bastard's just got to shut up for a second first.
zh: ~z~哈哈。我保证会的，哥们。老混蛋得先闭一会嘴了。

english: ~z~Yes Mr. Mayor, huge proponent of change. Always have been!
zh: ~z~是的，市长先生，变革的坚定支持者。向来如此！

english: ~z~Listen, I need you to deal with an old friend of mine. He's meeting an intern at the Superstar Café in Lancaster.
zh: ~z~听着，我需要你去解决我的一个老朋友。他正在兰开斯特的Superstar Café见一个实习生。

english: ~z~Make sure you don't scratch this on the way back, okay. Otherwise, he'll be wise to you, man.
zh: ~z~回去的路上别把车刮花了，好吗？不然的话，他会看出来的，老兄。

english: ~z~Charming, Klebitz. I'm thinking this means I won't be able to tune into radio Dawkins tonight?
zh: ~z~太好了吧，克雷比兹，意思是我今晚没法收听道金斯电台了。

english: ~z~Now, calm down, work out the tension, get a massage, beat off, kill someone, I don't care.
zh: ~z~现在，你冷静点，不要紧张，做个按摩，撸一管，杀个人，我不在乎。

english: ~z~That's too bad, pal. Here's hoping Dawkins puts it down to the city's high crime rate.
zh: ~z~真倒霉，朋友。希望道金斯会把这怪罪到本市的高犯罪率上吧。

english: ~z~Charming, Klebitz. I'm thinking this means I won't be able to tune into radio Dawkins tonight.
zh: ~z~太好了吧，克雷比兹，意思是我今晚没法收听道金斯电台了。

english: ~z~Oh Johnny, I wouldn't want to hog all the fun for myself, I'll text you the number so you can have a listen, too.
zh: ~z~哦，强尼，我可不想独享这份快乐。之后我把号码发给你，这样你也能一起偷听了。

english: ~z~Klebitz, Klebitz, you caught me in a fine mood. Just heard some good news about a bill I've been championing.
zh: ~z~克雷比兹，克雷比兹，我刚好心情不错。刚收到了个关于我支持的法案的好消息。

english: ~z~Okay, man. We got you fitted out. You going to know everything that happens in this car.
zh: ~z~好了，老兄。东西都装上了。车上发生什么你都能知道。

english: ~z~In the mean time, I'd like you to help me get some info on the Deputy Mayor. His car's over in Westdyke.
zh: ~z~同时，我想让你帮我搜集点副市长的情报。他的车停在韦斯代克。

english: ~z~Yeah, sure, look, I think your guy's gonna noticed that his car's been cosmetically damaged to shit.
zh: ~z~对，是的，听着，我想那家伙会发现车子成了大花脸的。

english: ~z~Maybe stick them on the web as well once I've got what I need, capiche? Ciao, buddy.
zh: ~z~拿到需要的消息，我就该考虑发到网上了，懂了吗？再见了，伙计。

english: ~z~It's like talking to a vampire whose just spotted a virgin. Sucking more money outta hard American workers, I bet.
zh: ~z~这话说的跟刚发现处女的吸血鬼似的。我看你又从辛苦劳动的美国工人身上吸了不少血吧。

english: ~z~You need to take it over to a garage on Muskteer to be fitted with surveillance equipment.
zh: ~z~你要把车开到火枪手街的一个车库去安装监听设备。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. You probably got enough listening to boy's jerk off at your fancy prep school. I shoulda known.
zh: ~z~抱歉，老兄。是我没考虑到你上高级预科学校的时候就听过太多男孩子撸管了。

english: ~z~Drop the formalities, Klebitz. Dawkins has reported the car stolen.
zh: ~z~别客套了，克雷比兹。道金斯报警说他的车被偷了。

english: ~z~Alright, but just in case I'll instruct my mechanic to knock out any dings you might make along the way.
zh: ~z~好吧，但是以防万一，我会叫我的机修工把你在路上刮花的地方修好的。

english: ~z~Now mind you, you might have to go off radar and take some shortcuts. Call me when it's done.
zh: ~z~提醒你一句，你要走小路，躲开监控。完事了给我打电话。

english: ~z~When the patron saint of killing cops and smoking meth tells you to atone, you know you've been a bad girl.
zh: ~z~当杀警察和吸冰毒的守护神告诉你你该赎罪时，你就明白自己是个坏女孩了。

english: ~z~Well, who says campaign donations don't buy you anything? I'm on it, Stubbs.
zh: ~z~好吧，谁说竞选捐款没法带来收益的？我来干，斯塔布斯。

english: ~z~Thanks for the info. And I thought guys like me were the scourge of society.
zh: ~z~谢谢你的情报。我还以为我这样的人才算社会毒瘤。

english: ~z~I don't even wanna guess what that means, but I'm thinking Juan ain't one of the schmucks who invested in your company.
zh: ~z~我都不想猜这句话的意思，但我觉得胡安不是唯一一个给你公司投资的傻逼。

english: ~z~Apart from watching a woman sail into the sunset with millions of dollars that belong to mom and pop investors,
zh: ~z~我刚看着一个女人卷走投资者的数百万血汗钱消失在晚霞里，

english: ~z~Mr. Congressman. I'm afraid your CEO friend is gonna have to stay and face the music.
zh: ~z~议员先生，恐怕你的CEO朋友要留下来接受制裁了。

english: ~z~I've got ten hours before Juan Pedro is crushing limes for my mojito on his rippled abs.
zh: ~z~在胡安･佩德罗用波涛汹涌的腹肌给我的莫吉托榨柠檬汁前，我还有十个小时的时间。

english: ~z~I can't say I've enjoyed your listening to your socialist hypocritical nonsense, but thanks for the ride.
zh: ~z~我也谈不上是欣赏你那番社会主义者的伪善废话，但还是要谢谢你救我出来。

english: ~z~cuddling junior analysts who think they can fuck their way to a partnership. You?
zh: ~z~跟那些以为上床就能谈成生意的初级分析师搂搂抱抱。你呢？

english: ~z~I've not felt like this since junior high school. Anyway,
zh: ~z~自从我初中毕业之后就没体验过这感觉了。总之，

english: ~z~Took her last bonus. Her shares have hit the bottom. You dig?
zh: ~z~带上了她最后的分红。她的股票已经触底了。懂吗？

english: ~z~Juan! Juan! Up anchor, my boy. We're heading South. Vamos!
zh: ~z~胡安！胡安！起飞吧，伙计。咱们往南飞，走吧！

english: ~z~Ha. I haven't had an annual salary since I punched out licence plates for a year in the joint.
zh: ~z~哈，自从我进局子造车牌劳改一年后，我就没领过年薪了。

english: ~z~For me, okay. For your friend, not so well. She bought the big one.
zh: ~z~我的话，还好。你的朋友就不太好了。她已经去世了。

english: ~z~I, ummm, dig, Johnny. Good to see you can't be rattled by something like this. Call me, okay?
zh: ~z~我，嗯，懂了，强尼。很高兴看见你没被像这种差事吓到。再电话联系吧，好吗？

english: ~z~Take me over to the helipad in Alderney City. My man's waiting there with a chopper.
zh: ~z~带我去奥尔德尼市的停机坪。我的人在直升机上等我。

english: ~z~Get me a vodka tonic and some sedatives, okay. This hasn't been easy.
zh: ~z~给我来杯伏特加汤力，再来点镇静剂，好吗。今天太不容易了。

english: ~z~Buckle up, lady. Looks like you're real popular with this city's regulating forces.
zh: ~z~系好安全带，小姐，看来你很受这个城市监管部门的欢迎啊。

english: ~z~Johnny, sorry, thought you were my broker mate. These markets, oh boy, I'm getting raped.
zh: ~z~强尼，不好意思，我把你当成股票经纪人了。那股市，哦伙计，我要亏大发了。

english: ~z~I need you to liberate her from an alleyway off Vitullo in Berchem.
zh: ~z~我要你去伯尔赫姆的维图洛路上的一个小巷里把她救出来。

english: ~z~Firstly, no one calls me lady without having at least one zero docked from their annual salary.
zh: ~z~首先，不把自己的年薪扣掉至少一个零，谁都不许叫我小姐。

english: ~z~Too much information, sister. Mine was a moral question, not a practical one.
zh: ~z~信息量很大啊，姐姐。我问的是你的良心，不是怎么入睡。

english: ~z~Oh, well done, well done. Conscience aside, I'll send her your best on my next holiday to the Caribbean. Thanks.
zh: ~z~哦，干得好啊，干得好啊。抛开良心不谈，下次去加勒比海度假的时候我会替你问候她的。谢了。

english: ~z~all Juan's assets are God given. And they're worth a lot more than those stocks right now.
zh: ~z~胡安所有的财富都是上帝赐予的，眼下这些财富可比那些股票值钱得多。

english: ~z~a friend of mine who may well have contributed to the recent BAWSAQ meltdowns has been arrested by an FIB task force.
zh: ~z~我有个朋友可能和最近BAWSAQ的熔断有关，她被FIB的专案组抓起来了。

english: ~z~A ton a year buys significant traction with certain more sophisticated dictatorships I'll have you know.
zh: ~z~一年一吨的收入，对某些更为复杂的独裁政权来说，会有很大的吸引力。我会让你知道的。

english: ~z~I didn't move funds into an offshore account so I could downgrade my lifestyle.
zh: ~z~我没把钱转到海外账户上，所以我可以降低点生活标准。

english: ~z~Jesus, come on. This is meant to be your field of expertise. Best of luck, sport.
zh: ~z~天哪，来吧。这是你大显身手的地方。祝你好运，老哥。

english: ~z~Angus, Billy's gone, man. Our chapter's dead. We got to give it a funeral.
zh: ~z~安格斯，比利死了，哥们。咱们帮也完了。我们办场葬礼吧。

english: ~z~There's no sanctuary here William. The rules don't apply to your kind.
zh: ~z~这里可不是庇护所，威廉。那些规则在你身上并不适用。

english: ~z~Stay away from the gate, brothers. I'm about to blow it open with a grenade launcher.
zh: ~z~离门远点，兄弟们。我准备用榴弹发射器把门轰开。

english: ~z~Well, we lost Terry. Another fucking casualty to Billy Grey's junkie ego bullshit.
zh: ~z~好吧，咱失去了特里。又他妈是个被比利･格雷的那狗屁毒瘾害死的人。

english: ~z~Bring Clay, bring all the fucking firepower you got, and meet me at the Alderney State Correctional.
zh: ~z~叫上科雷，手头的家伙全他妈带上。立刻来奥尔德尼州立监狱找我。

english: ~z~Billy may have helped to build our club, but he sure as shit ripped it apart.
zh: ~z~比利对帮派建设有所贡献，但毁也是毁在他手里。

english: ~z~You know, I would have thought your problem would be getting out, not getting into Alderney State.
zh: ~z~你懂的，我寻思让你伤脑筋的那个人要出来了，不在奥尔德尼州监狱待着了。

english: ~z~Step away from the gates.You're not on the visitor's list, you're not coming in.
zh: ~z~离大门远点。来访名单上没见着你，你不能进来。

english: ~z~I'm amazed there are still sickos loose in this town when I look at all these freaks.
zh: ~z~当我看到这些奇葩的时候，我很惊讶这城里居然还有这么些怪胎。

english: ~z~Brothers, don't let anyone in or out. Terry, Clay, we're going in.
zh: ~z~兄弟们，别让任何人进出大门。特里，科雷，咱们进去。

english: ~z~Terry, man, we got to pay our friend Billy a visit. He's been talking.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，得去拜访下咱们的朋友比利了。他在告发。

english: ~z~Clay, dude, we got some hard work to do. We got to pay Billy a visit in the pen.
zh: ~z~科雷，老哥，我们要干些重活了。咱去监狱拜访下比利吧。

english: ~z~You got a ticket to the freak show, freshman. Freakiest freaks on earth in this pit. Good luck to you.
zh: ~z~新人们，你们领到的是奇葩秀的门票。地球上最奇葩的奇葩都在这深渊里了。祝你们好运。

english: ~z~Let's get outta here, boys. Billy stopped talking bullshit for good.
zh: ~z~咱们走吧，伙计们。比利再也不会为了得到好处开口扯淡了。

english: ~z~This gang is fucked all to hell right now, but I'll love you brothers until I die.
zh: ~z~虽然现在帮派彻底完了，但我会爱你们几个兄弟一辈子的。

english: ~z~Killing everyone around me isn't an option, Mr. Congressman. Goodbye and thank you.
zh: ~z~杀死我身边的人这事不是我能选的，议员先生。再见，谢谢你。

english: ~z~This is a zoo, newbie. Don't feed the animals, don't rattle the cage. You should be fine.
zh: ~z~这是个动物园，新来的。不要投喂动物，不要触碰笼子，否则罚款。

english: ~z~hell, maybe you can jump the wall on that bike of yours. Good luck, sport.
zh: ~z~见鬼了，也许你可以骑你的摩托车跳墙出去。祝你好运，老兄。

english: ~z~Maybe there's a disguise somewhere, or maybe you can get him from your side of the fence,
zh: ~z~也许你可以在某处躲起来，或者也可以从你这边过去拿下他，

english: ~z~You brothers hold this position. Me, Terry, and Clay are gonna go get this asshole.
zh: ~z~你们几个守住这里。我、特里和科雷进去找那个混蛋。

english: ~z~Clay wouldn't be dead if Billy had just taken his time like a man.
zh: ~z~要是比利该爷们的时候不娘们，科雷就不会死了。

english: ~z~Welcome to Hell, rookie. Keep your back to the wall and your finger on the trigger.
zh: ~z~欢迎来到地狱，菜鸡们。背部保持靠墙，手指搭在扳机上。

english: ~z~He's dead, brothers. Now all we need to worry about is getting out of here alive.
zh: ~z~他死了，兄弟们。现在我们该操心的是怎样活着离开这。

english: ~z~Shit, I can't get another ticket, dude. Can I, like, suck you off or something? Come on.
zh: ~z~妈的，我搞不到另外的门票了，老哥。我，能不能，抱你大腿啥的？好不好嘛。

english: ~z~I ain't been smugglin' nothin' into Alderney State, officer. It's all for personal consumption, man.
zh: ~z~警官，我可没走私东西进奥尔德尼州，这些都是我自用的，哥们。

english: ~z~Oh, man. I'm thinking you're thinking we don't have a choice. We'll come meet you.
zh: ~z~哦哥们，我就知道你觉得咱们没得选。咱们见个面吧。

english: ~z~Man, I miss Jim. He was one princely son of a bitch. The best thing this gang ever had.
zh: ~z~天，我想吉姆了。帮里就属他最高洁，他是失落帮的宝物。

english: ~z~I'll forgive him the insults and injuries, but I can't forgive him that.
zh: ~z~我可以原谅他的冒犯中伤，但破坏帮派无法原谅。

english: ~z~Well, Billy isn't going to be talking to anyone about us. We can clear on outta here.
zh: ~z~好了，比利再也不会开口提到我们任何人了。咱们收拾收拾走吧。

english: ~z~If you've learned anything at all from me, I hope it's how to cope with a crisis.
zh: ~z~要是你从我身上学到了啥的话，我希望是如何应对一场危机。

english: ~z~Fuck, but that van was bound to be volatile, wasn't it? Later, man.
zh: ~z~操，但那货车早晚会出问题，不是吗？再见吧，哥们。

english: ~z~You know, I'm really lost as to what that's got to do with me, sport. I did all I could for you.
zh: ~z~你懂的，我真不懂这和我有啥关系，老兄。我尽力了。

english: ~z~So, ummm, Stubbs. Billy's in a maximum security institution, how am I meant to do this?
zh: ~z~那，呃，斯塔布斯。比利可是在守卫森严的监狱啊，我该咋办？

english: ~z~Yo, officer, we're on the same team. I can, like, beat you off or something, but no tickets, man.
zh: ~z~哟，警官，咱一队的。我，能不能，把你打趴下啥的，不用门票也能进去，哥们？

english: ~z~Funny thing is, five years ago he woulda lead the charge into Alderney State himself.
zh: ~z~可笑的是，放五年前他还会亲自带队杀进监狱灭口叛徒。

english: ~z~Terry, man, I've had some bad news. Billy's been singing from his cellblock.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，有个坏消息。比利还在牢房里活蹦乱跳的。

english: ~z~Let's meet Angus at the house, guys. This thing is nearly finished.
zh: ~z~咱们去帮会所找安格斯吧，伙计们。这事快结束了。

english: ~z~Terry, man, I'm sorry. Things got too much for me in there - I fuckin' bailed.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，我很抱歉。说来话长，我他妈开溜了。

english: Another State's witness has made it safely to the police station, there is 1 left.
zh: 又一名州方证人已安全抵达警察局，还剩 1 名。

english: Another State's witness has made it safely to the police station, there is 1 left.
zh: 又一名州方证人已安全抵达警察局，还剩 1 名。

english: ~COL_NET_2~The Lost~s~ have hi-jacked the ~b~prison bus~s~, get it back before they kill the State's witnesses.
zh: ~COL_NET_2~失落帮~s~劫走了~b~囚车~s~，赶在他们杀掉州方证人之前抢回来。

english: ~COL_NET_2~The Lost~s~ have hi-jacked the ~b~prison bus~s~, get it back before they kill the State's witness.
zh: ~COL_NET_2~失落帮~s~劫走了~b~囚车~s~，赶在他们杀掉州方证人之前抢回来。

english: You can stop the van by hijacking the tollbooth or chase it down.
zh: 你可以通过劫持收费站或进行追击战来截停货车。

english: During this police chase, when you are in any vehicle hold ~INPUT_VEH_CIN_CAM~ to change the camera to show the helicopter view.
zh: 此次警察追捕中，你可以在载具内按住~INPUT_VEH_CIN_CAM~切换至为直升机的视角。

english: Professor Flavio Covarrubias B.A, B.Ec, B.S., MFA, MBA, LL.M, Msc, Ph.D, MD (Harford University)
zh: 弗拉维奥･科瓦鲁维亚斯教授 B.A, B.Ec, B.S., MFA, MBA, LL.M, Msc, Ph.D, MD (哈佛大学)

english: Man, i fucked things up. I know I did. But you weren't a saint. You weren't. You're who you are, and you do bad shit. and hanging out with you made me do bad shit, even though it ain't your fault. but i did bad shit to you, because you were my world. i thought you would kill me and you didn't. so that makes you a better person than some. i'm so glad we are friends now.
zh: 老兄，我是个烂人，这我知道。但你也不是什么圣贤，绝对不是。你就是你，你也会做坏事。跟你混在一起害得我也跟着做坏事，尽管这不是你的错。但我做了蠢事拖你下水，因为你就是我的全部。我以为你会杀了我，但你没有，说明你比某些人强多了。很高兴我们现在还是朋友。

english: I ain't in the mood for internet chit chat, Ash. Have a nice life. Johnny.
zh: 我现在没心情在网上闲聊，小艾。祝你幸福。 强尼

english: Ash, Ain't much point going over shit again. Whole world we live in is fucked up and we belong in that world. Things weren't meant to be, and I don't seem to be the family man type. I'm your friend, nothing more. Not ever. I can't watch you do any more drugs. Good luck staying clean this time. Johnny.
zh: 小艾，没必要再翻那些旧账了。我们所在的这个世界就是狗屁，但我们还就属于它。事情不应该这样的，而我也不是什么居家好男人。我们是朋友，仅此而已。一直如此。我不能眼睁睁看着你吸更多毒品了。祝你这次能多洁身自好一会儿。 强尼

english: i fucked up. it weren't my fault. i got thrown out of the facility. it weren't my coke. I love you, Johnny. i love you. drugs ain't shit. you're my drug. Listen, Johnny, can i borrow some money, for a few days? I miss you. i miss you so much.
zh: 我搞砸了，明明不是我的错。我被从设施里赶了出来。那不是我的可卡因。我爱你，强尼。我爱你。毒品算什么，你才是我的毒品。呃，强尼，你能借我点钱吗，就几天？我真的很想你。

english: it makes me happy to know you're on my side and even though we ain't together and we both fucked this thing up, we are at least friends. i'm off the drugs, Johnny boy. i'm off them. i don't want to get high no more. Not ever. i'm sorting myself out. i'm even exercising. i went running yesterday. i was nearly a model, one time.
zh: 尽管我们分手了，尽管我们都成了烂摊子，但你能站在我这边还是让我很高兴，至少我们还是朋友。我戒毒了，强尼仔。我戒掉了。我再也不想吸嗨了，一点都不想。我要重回正轨了。我甚至都开始运动了。我昨天去跑步了。我就像个模范人物，有生以来的头一次。

english: I checked into rehab again last week. i feel rough, but this time it's going to stick, i know it.

english: ~z~Hey, Johnny, time to teach them motherfuckers who runs this town.
zh: ~z~嘿，强尼，该告诉那帮狗逼玩意谁才是真正的老大了。

english: ~z~Okay, brother. Let's you and me sniff out these ganja smoking dopes.
zh: ~z~好了，兄弟。我们一起去收拾那些抽大麻的毒贩吧。

english: ~z~You ready, Johnny? Let's send the AOD a message they ain't never gonna forget.
zh: ~z~准备好了吗，强尼？给死亡天使传达无法磨灭的消息吧。

english: ~z~We got some tracksuit-wearing motherfuckers to beat on, man. Let's go.
zh: ~z~这次的目标是一帮穿运动服的混蛋，兄弟。走吧。

english: ~z~You speak Russian? Me neither, Johnny. Let's hope these hoods understand an ass beating.
zh: ~z~会讲俄语吗？我不会，强尼。只能用拳头跟他们说话了。

english: ~z~Let's do this, Johnny. Those Deadbeats ain't gonna know what hit 'em.
zh: ~z~动手吧，强尼。死妈天使不会知道自己是怎么死的。

english: ~z~The Angels of Death won't know what hit 'em, men. Let's do this!
zh: ~z~死亡天使不会知道自己是怎么死的，兄弟们。开干吧！

english: Predict if the value of the next card is higher or lower (Aces are low). Last person remaining wins.~n~Press ~INPUT_FRONTEND_ACCEPT~ to continue.~n~Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to leave the game.
zh: 猜下张牌更大还是更小(A最小)。猜错淘汰，活到最后的人获胜。~n~按~INPUT_FRONTEND_ACCEPT~继续。~n~按~INPUT_PICKUP~离开游戏。

english: ~z~If I had it my way, we wouldn't waste our time - you'd be inside already.
zh: ~z~要是我说了算，你早就进去了，省得浪费大家时间。

english: ~z~you'll be locked up and calling some cellmate Daddy within a month.
zh: ~z~不出一个月，你就会被抓回去管狱友叫「爸爸」。

english: You can phone Terry or Clay for help at any time during a job.
zh: 差事期间，你随时可以打电话给特里或科雷寻求帮助。

english: ~r~The cops are unable to follow you. You couldn't take them out in the open.
zh: ~r~条子无法跟着你。你不能在光天化日之下干掉他们。

english: Johnny has to go with Jim to lure some undercover cops who have been hassling ~n~the Lost clubhouse into an area where they can take them out.
zh: 强尼得和吉姆一起将骚扰~n~Lost会所的便衣警察引诱到一个可以干掉他们的地方。

english: ~s~If you launch a grenade through a window into the house, the occupants will flee.
zh: ~s~如果你通过窗口向房子里发射榴弹，房子里的人就会逃走。

english: ~s~PHONECALL~n~~n~Jim tells you where to meet him and the others if you want to join them in an attack on a rival gang.
zh: ~s~PHONECALL~n~~n~如果你想和他们一起攻击敌对帮派的话，吉姆会告诉你去哪与他和其他人见面。

english: After the recent murderous incident at Alderney State Correctional Facility, a security review is being called for. Sally Butters of Moms for a Police State says she's "sick and tired of criminals stealing from us. We want to put them to work in order to make the US economy the powerhouse it once was. The private medical sector has worked so well for this country, why can't we privatize everything?"
zh: 发生杀人案件以后，奥尔德尼州立监狱遭到安全检查。「警察国家之母」的成员萨莉･巴特斯表示：「犯罪者一直在窃取我们的劳动果实，我已经受够了。我们想让他们参与劳动，好让美国的经济再次强大。私营医疗机构在国内很成功，我们直接把一切都私有化不就好了？」

english: Ever since the flamboyant interior designer, Dalton Randolph, hit the public eye as star of the home makeover show Posh Touch For Poor Schmucks, online message boards have buzzed with claims that he is as gay as a picnic basket and his marriage is a sham. Now, finally, Dalton and his wife Betania have decided to speak out against the constant barrage of accusations. In an exclusive interview, Betania told the Liberty Tree, "He hasn't decorated my interior since the wedding night, I'll admit, but I know what my husband is and isn't. I'd never dream of going shopping for clothes without him. Nobody understands layering like Dalton. Can't a man wear fuchsia and depilate these days without being called gay?" Randolph, who says that he is waging a one-man war against terracotta, is best-known for jumping up and down and clapping while squealing, "What is this hot mess?" when he walks into somebody's house for the first time. The jury might still be out on this one.
zh: 自从表现抢眼的室内设计师道尔顿･伦道夫在家装节目《雅气拂白丁》中走红后，网络社区中到处是他是个骗婚基佬的传言。现在，道尔顿和他的妻子贝塔尼娅终于对这些传言进行了公开反驳。在专访中，贝塔尼娅告诉Liberty Tree：「我承认，在新婚当夜以后他就没替我装修过了，但我知道我的丈夫是什么人。我都不敢想没有他陪我，我还怎么逛街买衣服。没有人比道尔顿更懂层次感。紫红色的衣服和脱毛就非得跟基佬扯上关系吗？」这位设计师正在单枪匹马对抗土红色，他最有名的一点就是在初次进入某人的家时手舞足蹈上蹿下跳，大声尖叫「这是什么玩意？」目前我们暂时无法确定他是否是一名同性恋。

english: Certain liberal groups have blamed the incident on strict prison rules. They call for regular meditation sessions and Reiki training for all guards. Earth-Song Bowden, a campaigner for prisoner rights, says "most violent tendencies can be traced to a misalignment of Chakras. We need to treat the cause of the problem. Not the symptom." Whatever the reason for what happened, something has to change at Alderney State. Parents have enough to worry about with terrorists on the loose and our economy failing, our prisons must remain secure.
zh: 某些自由主义团体将这一案件的发生归咎于严格的狱规，他们呼吁所有狱警定期进行冥想和灵气训练。 狱囚人权活动家厄斯桑･鲍登说：「大多数人的暴力倾向是脉轮失调导致的。我们要对症下药，不能治标不治本。」无论导致这一案件的原因如何，奥尔德尼州立监狱必须作出改变。光是逍遥法外的恐怖分子和我国乏力的经济已经够让父母们操心了，我们的监狱必须严抓安全，别给他们再添烦恼。

english: After several incidents of wrongful shooting by the Liberty City Police Departments this year, it seems that the shoe is finally on the other foot. The bodies of several police offices were found in Acter Industrial Park earlier. Amongst them, Detectives Jimmy Matthews and Ed McCornish.
zh: 在今年的多起LCPD警员不正当开枪事件后，情况发生了反转。这一次，警员成为了受害者，他们的尸体在阿克特工业园被发现。警探吉米 马修斯和埃德･麦科尼什也在受害者之列。

english: Every human needs water to survive and must expel that water - both of which have airline execs seeing green. The announcement that beleaguered airline, Air Sol, has started charging passengers to use the restrooms on all domestic and international flights could have passengers hiding their daily dump in the front seat pocket.
zh: 人类生存离不开水，也离不开排水，而这两者都被航司高管视为商机。饱受批评的Air Sol航空公司发布公告，宣布将在该公司的所有国际国内航班中推行收费厕所，这一举措或将导致某些乘客在前排座椅背后的口袋中解决三急。

english: Sources within the District Attorney's Office have revealed that there were multiple Internal Affairs investigations against these officers who were suspected of involvement in several corruption scandals. At the time of their death, the two were thought to be investigating the Angels of Death Motorcycle Club. An AODMC spokesman denied any club involvement in illegal activities. "This is typical of the LCPD, a bent cop gets what's coming to him and they blame it on decent hardworking American bikers."
zh: 据地检署内部人士透露，此前这两名警察因涉嫌腐败遭到内务部调查。遇害时他们似乎正在调查死亡天使机车俱乐部。死亡天使的发言人否认了指控，拒绝认同俱乐部涉嫌非法行为：「这就是LCPD的典型做派，明明是罪有应得的腐败警察，到头来却怪罪到正派勤劳的美国骑手身上。」

english: It's time to wake up and smell the lukewarm, germ-infested airplane coffee. This recession is barely out of the starting block. Buy gold, stay at home and pray that your pension and healthcare policy are worth more than the paper they're written on by the time you reach retirement. The time to panic has arrived.
zh: 是时候清醒过来了，闻闻这杯温热的、充满细菌的机上咖啡吧。经济萧条尚处于相当早期的阶段。购买黄金，待在家里，祈祷退休时你的养老金和医保没有贬值到不如打印纸值钱。现在该开始恐慌了。

english: Security officials were unavailable for comment, but did ask for more funding, especially desiring a better gym, and more breaks, blaming work stress on the recent problems at the Airport. One airport security guard told us "It is tiring annoying people all day long, and sometimes we have to work for an hour straight. No wonder all these drugs get through and people keep getting shot."
zh: 安保部门对此事不予置评，但他们要求获得更多资金、拥有更好的健身房和更多假期，并将机场近期出现的事件归咎于工作压力。一名机场安保人员告诉本报：「整天找别人麻烦真的很累人，有时我们甚至要连续工作一个小时。也难怪毒品走私频频得手，枪击惨案多次发生了。」

english: While thousands of security guards were busy giving cavity searches to old ladies they did not like the look of, carnage erupted in immigration, and for once it was not because a Mexican was trying to sneak in.
zh: 成千上万的安保人员正忙于为相貌讨厌的老太太做毒品检查，此时却有一场屠杀在移民中爆发，而这场屠杀并不是墨西哥人想要偷渡入境所致。

english: It appears that it takes more than a boatload of booze and a smorgasbord of tiny reproductive organs to have a hit series these days. It was billed as: 'One island full of genetic disasters' but CNT's primetime show, Hermaphrodite Island, has been cancelled after just one season following disastrous viewing figures. The producers tried everything from Bikini Tuesdays to Absinthe Thursdays to Jockstrap Fridays but, apart from a confusing fumble between Dave and Ken in the mud pit, passion failed to ignite between the contestants and angry reality TV fans began switching off in their droves. Phoebe, the star of the show, says her calendar will be out in time for Christmas and will excite both men and women.
zh: 现在看来，爆款节目需要的不仅是一船酒水和一大票生殖器。以「充斥着灾难般基因的岛屿」为宣传标语的CNT电视台的黄金时段节目《双性岛》仅仅拍摄了一季，就因惨不忍睹的收视率被迫腰斩。制片人拿出了百般花样：比基尼周二，苦艾酒周四，三角裤周五。但除了戴夫和肯在泥坑中的混乱争球之外，参赛者之间没能擦出任何激情火花，愤怒的真人秀粉丝也纷纷换台。该节目的红人菲比表示，她的写真日历会在圣诞节推出，男人和女人都能从中找到亮点。

english: A routine arrest for drugs trafficking on the flight into Francis International from Bogota ended in chaos and carnage. A suspected drug smuggler was freed by an accomplice amid a hail of bullets in scenes not seen at the airport since the last major security breach. The smuggler was freed and rescued by an accomplice as a bloody fire storm ensued, and security and innocent by standers were killed. The suspect is described as being "probably foreign" with "a foreign, creepy vibe, like a rapist." Or "one of those white guys who becomes a terrorist."
zh: 一班飞机由波哥大入境弗朗西斯国际机场，对它进行的例行缉毒最终在混乱的屠杀中结束。一名疑似毒品走私者在枪林弹雨中被同伙救走，这是机场自上次重大安全漏洞以来首次出现的场景。走私者逃出生天，枪林弹雨后只剩下无辜民众和安保人员的尸体。对嫌疑人的描述有「凶神恶煞的外国人，像是强奸犯」和「白人恐怖分子」两种。

english: Now they're charging for everything. Tiny, germ-infested pillow? $10. Glass of warm water? $5. In-flight magazine full of old toenails and dried vomit? $4. Stale bag of party mix? $6. The final insult is the $3 to take a dump in a restroom the size of a coffin Air Sol began charging. A new range of adult protective underwear called Flypers has been selling out in airports across the country. We used to have the most envied airline industry in the world. Now we sit in our filth for five hours. Like foreigners.
zh: 现在航班上的一切都要收费。细菌遍布的枕头？十块。一杯热水？五块。满是脚趾甲和干呕吐物的舱内杂志？四块。快过期的小零食？六块。最令人气愤的是，得花三块才能到棺材大小的卫生间里上一次厕所。一种名为「飞人」的成人纸尿裤正在全国各大机场热销。我们曾经有过世界上最成功的航空业。现在却只能在脏兮兮的机舱里熬过5小时，就像外国人一样。

english: Remember the good old days of air travel? Getting served endless miniature bottles of cheap vodka by statuesque blondes in low-cut tops and short skirts? Flying used to be considered the height of luxury. Now you have to print off your own ticket, check in your own bags and submit yourself to humiliating security checks before being herded like cattle onto a filthy plane to sit for 2 hours on the runway because an undertrained stoner in air traffic control hit ESC by mistake.
zh: 还记得航空旅行的辉煌曾经吗？低胸短裙的金发美女不断为你续上廉价伏特加？坐飞机曾被认为是一种奢侈的体验。现在你得自己打印机票，自己托运行李，还被迫接受耻辱的安检，然后才能像牲口一样被赶上肮脏的飞机，再在机舱里坐上两个小时等待起飞，仅仅因为一个训练不足的瘾君子在空管室手滑按下了ESC键。

english: Brokerage firms were rocked yesterday by the news that some of the people who work there are not corrupt, greedy rule breakers. After a wide spread investigation into insider trading and corporate greed, the FIB only arrested 20 brokers at three brokerage firms in northern Alderney yesterday, which represented only 35 per cent of the work force. Human resource professionals at all the firms were humiliated to discover they had employed as up to 65 per cent of their work force people who are not morally destitute and greedy as can be. One CEO commented to us "How are we supposed to make our growth targets and raise our share price if we are not taking undue risks with other people's money, driven on by the desperate greed of our brokers? I'm appalled at what is happening in this town." Federal investigators promised to search out more corruption on the exchange and make sure those found guilty are properly punished with book deals and talk show appearances.
zh: 各大证券公司被昨天的一则消息震惊，因为公司内竟然有不腐败、不贪婪、遵守规矩的经理人。在一场针对内幕交易和企业贪婪的大规模调查后，FIB仅逮捕了3家北奥尔德尼券商的20名经理人，只占该行业从业者的35%。各大券商的人力资源部门纷纷以此为耻，因为他们雇佣的人中竟有65%的人拥有道德，不够贪婪。一名CEO告诉本报：「如果不拿别人的钱冒险，不雇贪婪至极的经理人，我们怎么实现营业额增长目标，怎么抬高公司股价？这里发生的事情令我震惊。」联邦探员保证会在证券交易所中查出更多腐败，并会让违法者得到应有的惩罚，让他们出书或是亮相脱口秀。

english: In an ironic twist of fate, this patriot's children were also killed by rogue acts of terrorism. The family is now headed by Congressman Thomas Stubbs, Arthur Stubb's nephew. Mr Stubbs told reporters at a conference he hastily convened "This is a tragedy. My family has given so much to this country and to freedom. Arthur Stubbs was a great. Great man. I will carry on his work fighting justice and honor wherever I find it. His death had made me a very rich man and I will use that money for good, and for insuring my re-election."
zh: 或许这是命运开的一个玩笑，这名爱国者的子女先前同样是因恐怖主义暴行遇害。现在率领家族的重任降临到了阿瑟･斯塔布斯的侄子，众议院议员托马斯 斯塔布斯身上。他在一场匆匆召开的发布会上告诉记者：「这是一场悲剧。我的家族为自由和这个国家贡献了太多。阿瑟･斯塔布斯是一位伟人，十分伟大的伟人。我会继承他的遗志，为正义和荣耀而战。他的死使我现在非常富有，我会将这笔钱用于正途，还会用于资助我的连任竞选。」

english: Michael Graves's campaign is fighting allegations that his campaign manager bore him a love child after discussions over strategy became a little too intimate. Three years ago, Mona Arthurs, 40, gave birth to a child she claimed was fathered by her openly gay husband, Jay. However, as baby Mike grew and developed, observant friends noticed a problem - Jay Arthurs is black. Baby Mikey is apparently, not. Ms. Arthurs and Mikey, who live in Los Santos, have gone into hiding while politicans try to score points off each other over the story. Mr. Graves released the following statement "I did not sleep with Ms Arthurs, nor with any woman, at any time, under any circumstances. My political opponents are ruining this poor woman's reputation, which is odd, given that the wives are notorious sluts."
zh: 迈克尔 格雷夫斯被控在讨论完竞选策略后与其竞选经理过度亲密，致其竞选经理怀孕生子。三年前，40岁的莫娜･阿瑟斯产下一子，她称这个孩子是她已公开出柜的男同丈夫杰的。但是，随着小迈克逐渐长大，细心的朋友就发现了问题：杰 阿瑟斯是黑人，而小迈基显然不是。住在洛圣都的阿瑟斯太太和迈基躲了起来，而政客们正在借助这一故事互相博取民众好感。格雷夫斯先生发表了声明：「我没有睡过阿瑟斯太太，也没用睡过任何女人，任何时候、任何情况下都没有。我的政敌正在摧毁这位可怜女士的名誉，这很奇怪，要知道所有的妇人都是臭名昭著的荡妇。」

english: Arthur Stubbs, elder statesman of the legendary Stubbs political clan was gunned down by terrorists yesterday shortly after arriving at Francis International Airport. Mr. Stubbs, 83, was arriving in the city for a family meeting and to help to discuss bailing out a lot of rich people upset by the recent problems on the exchange. A passionate democrat when it suited him and also an elitist who hated poor people, Mr. Stubbs embodied an America that has mercifully disappeared. He was brutally killed standing up for freedom by a splinter cell now on the loose in Liberty City. Police are searching for the terror cell and advise people to be very afraid and report any activity by brown people.
zh: 阿瑟･斯塔布斯是传奇的斯塔布斯政治家族中的老政治家，他于昨天到达弗朗西斯国际机场的不久后惨遭恐怖分子杀害。83岁的斯塔布斯先生本要到自由城参加家族会议，并会协助商讨如何帮助近期因证券交易所爆出内幕交易而大失所望的富人。他是一个热诚的民主党人(当民主党符合他的需求时)，也是一个讨厌贫民的精英主义者，斯塔布斯先生身上颇有美国曾经的糟粕之风。他因弘扬自由被一名「独狼特工」残忍杀害，目前凶手仍然在逃。警方正在搜寻恐怖分子的窝点，并建议民众保持恐惧，及时汇报棕种人的一切活动。

english: It's part of every adult magazine: a several page spread with two nasty hot twins going at it with a guy who we'll call The Luckiest Man in the World. But is he really so lucky? Why is sex with twins ok, but inter-family sex considered foul and taboo? Reports are now coming in that sex with twins isn't all that great. One area man who declined to be named said, "It was a dream, right up until the point where two family members started 69ing. I'm sorry, I'm as red blooded as any man but that's difficult to deal with. I mean, why do you even need me? Why not call your dad over and bang him?" The twins' father refused to comment, only stating that they have a very close family.
zh: 这是每个成人杂志的一部分：几页纸上印着一对身材火辣的双胞胎，在「世上最幸运的男人」身上进进出出。但他真的这么幸运吗？为什么和双胞胎发生性关系没有问题，而家族内的性关系却是恶劣的禁忌？现在有消息称双胞胎之间发生关系并没有那么好。一位不愿意透露姓名的当地男士称：「确实一度如梦似幻，但当两名家庭成员开始做69式时就梦想破碎了。抱歉，我确实是一个血气方刚的男人，但这样真的很难处理。我是说，这还需要我干什么？直接叫你爸过来上他不就好了？」这对双胞胎的父亲拒绝评论，只是说他们的家庭关系非常紧密。

english: Despite allegations of involvement in drug dealing, the cagey Uptown Riders motorcycle gang is launching a clothing line. Known for their turbo-tuned sports bikes, blaring rap music, and reckless stunt riding; the group hopes their street wear will be a hit with suburban white kids looking to impress their friends. "We going for the urban scene, but most the shit that gets bought in North Holland and Bohan ain't exactly street legal. We looking to sell to the white boys whose mommas are gonna pay for the genuine article." When not beating up anyone who thinks they look 'kind of gay' and blowing their own faces off with over cooked batches of meth, the Angels of Death Motorcycle Club spend their time monopolizing the biker merchandise market. Their website sells everything from branded meth pipes to baby diapers. We'll see if the Uptown Riders can carve out a niche of their own.
zh: 尽管被控涉嫌贩毒，但神秘的「上城骑士」飞车党推出了品牌服装。他们以自改涡轮的运动摩托、喧闹的说唱音乐和鲁莽的摩托特技闻名。这一组织希望他们的街头服饰能够在郊区的白人孩子中掀起潮流，让飞车党制服成为给朋友留下印象的不二之选。「我们想表现城市风格，但在北荷兰和波汉流通的大多数商品都是违法的。我们的目标人群是家长愿意为正品买单的白人男孩。」在殴打把他们当基佬的人、用烧焦的冰毒炸烂自己的脸的闲暇之余，死亡天使机车俱乐部付出时间垄断了骑手周边的市场。从品牌冰毒吸管到婴儿尿布，他们的官网什么都卖。上城骑士能否开辟出属于自己的市场，让我们拭目以待。

english: The transport bus was taking him to Alderney State Correctional Facility along with several men recently convicted of insider trading. The police advise you to look after your families and share portfolios until they are able to track down this bus full of miscreants.
zh: 囚车本应将他与数名近期因内幕交易定罪的犯人一起移送奥尔德尼州立监狱。在这帮恶棍的行踪明确之前，警方建议民众看好自己的家人和股票投资。

english: The Dine and Dash killer, Curtis Stocker, could be back to his old cannibalistic tricks after his prison bus was hijacked from Leftwood Police Station. If you're not interested in having your internal organs feasted upon, we recommend you stay at home this evening. That said, Double D has a history of breaking into people's houses, so you may not be safe there either.
zh: 一辆囚车在左伍德警察局遭到劫持，食人杀手柯蒂斯･斯托克可能重拾他的食人大餐。如果你不希望自己的器官成为他的美食，我们建议你今晚不要出门。不过，也有记录表明这位食人魔曾经破门而入，所以待在家里也未必安全。

english: Evan Moss, 24, was found murdered in Broker. When, at the age of sixteen, he won the Teen Iron Weightlifting Competition in Arizona, no one could have predicted this violent end. Tragically, his life took a turn for the worse. After positive drug tests, the loss of his weight supplement sponsorship deal, and alleged involvement in a male escort business he hit rock bottom.
zh: 24岁的埃文･莫斯死于一场在布洛克发生的谋杀。他曾在16岁时赢得了亚利桑那州青少年举重比赛的冠军，在那个时候，没有人能预料到他会有这样的结局。可悲的是，他的生活每况愈下。药检阳性、增重药不再找他代言、被怀疑涉嫌男妓生意，最终他陷入了人生低谷。

english: A Los Santos man, who was prescribed medical marijuana for his glaucoma, has filed a lawsuit against his doctor and Cluckin Bell after ballooning from 180 to 350 pounds in less than six months. Phil Rosenburg, who can now back-roll a perfect blunt with just one hand, claims that he was not adequately informed of the side effects of his new medication. Rosenburg's attorney told Weazel News that his client now regularly devours a stuffed Pollo Toto Frito, a jar of mayonnaise, three pizzas and a plate of chocolate brownies covered in ranch sauce. He's lost his wallet seventeen times in the last month, developed an obsession with iconic bands of the 1970s and has started expressing increasingly left-wing political views. This is a landmark case and, if Rosenburg is awarded damages, predatory law firms are gearing up to get a class action suit against God, who created weed in the first place.
zh: 洛圣都一男子在服用了医生为治疗他的青光眼所开的医用大麻后，在不到六个月时间内体重从160斤激增到了320斤。在经历了这一切后，他对他的医生和铛铛钟正式提起诉讼。这位名叫菲尔･罗森堡的男子现在只用一只手就可以轻松地卷好完美的大麻烟。他声称医生在开药时并未向其阐明新药方的副作用。罗森堡的律师跟Weazel新闻透露说，他的这位患者现在经常狼吞虎咽地吃掉填酱的意式烤面包卷、一整罐蛋黄酱、三个披萨还有一碟子淋满了田园沙拉酱的巧克力布朗尼。仅仅是在过去的1个月里，这位患者就丢了17次钱包，在迷上了上世纪70年代的偶像乐队的同时，他的政治立场也越发左倾。这一诉讼在法律史上具有里程碑的意义。若是罗森堡起诉成功得到损失费，虎视眈眈的众多律师事务所会向上帝提起集体诉讼，因为大麻是由上帝创造出来的。

english: These are just some of the words that our editors thought would lead you into reading this story. But they are also words that could be used to describe how local recently graduated workers feel about Liberty City companies who are taking advantage of them. Sandra McColland has filed a lawsuit that sets a new standard for workers. After collapsing on the job in what she describes as a work/life balance, McColland is fighting for all Liberty City businesses to allow 2 months paid vacation a year, flexible hours, yoga a flotation/isolation chamber spa on site. Local businesses complain about a generation that wasn't required to work in high school, received an allowance, had college and a condo paid for, and then expect the same from the workforce.
zh: 小编承认自己标题党了，但这也确实是应届求职者对利用他们的自由城企业的感受。桑德拉･麦科兰就势提起诉讼，试图为工人争取更人性化的行业新规。此前她在工作时昏倒，因为那份工作让她无法平衡工作时间和私人时间。在此之后，她便一直致力于为自由城所有企业的员工争取每年2个月的带薪休假、弹性的工作时间、瑜伽活动室、SPA中心等福利。而当地企业则抱怨这一代人高中不需要勤工俭学，拿着助学津贴，大学学费和公寓租金都有补贴，就业后居然还想要这样的待遇。

english: Moss had recently gained public attention as a star of the Liberty City nightclub scene. He was often sited with minor celebrities too drunk to know better at Algonquin hotspot Masionette 9. It was even rumored that Moss had hooked the biggest whale in the Liberty City Scene - nightclub baron Tony Prince. Mr. Prince would not comment on his friend's untimely death. The LCPD are looking for a group of men wearing tight black leather in connection to the slaying.
zh: 作为自由城的夜店明星，莫斯最近备受关注。据说他经常在阿尔冈琴最著名的9号豪宅中与一群烂醉如泥的十八线明星谈人生聊理想。甚至有传言声称莫斯钓到了自由城最大的鱼——夜店大亨托尼･普林斯。普林斯先生对他朋友的早逝不予置评。LCPD正在寻找一群穿紧身皮衣的人，他们与这起谋杀有密切关系。

english: Do you want to lead the convoy? Press 1 for Yes or 2 to set a biker as leader.
zh: 你想领导车队吗？按1确定或按2来设置一个车队领导者。

english: ~z~Yo, what? Them rat bastards shot you? Shit yo, don't worry. Me and Johnny's on the way.
zh: ~z~哟，啥？那些混账开枪打你？妈逼的，别慌。我和强尼过来了。

english: ~z~No. No, I guess you don't. Nice image, by the way. You just put me off corn dogs for life.
zh: ~z~确实，应该用不着。你的比喻真不错，让我不想吃玉米热狗了。

english: ~z~I sure hope D's learnt how to hold his tongue. Last time he got hit, he couldn't shut the fuck up.
zh: ~z~真希望D能管住自己的嘴。上次挨枪就是因为他管不住嘴。

english: ~z~We were meant to be hitting back for DeSean. Not getting him killed, man.
zh: ~z~我们是去替德肖恩讨回公道的，不是去让他送命的。

english: ~z~I know, man. I know. At least he went down with his head held high. See you round.
zh: ~z~我知道，兄弟。我知道。至少他是昂首挺胸地倒下的。回头见。

english: ~z~I look like a need help? You don't need to shoot a guy who got a bat two feet up his ass.
zh: ~z~我像是要黑枪的人吗？屁股中间夹球棍的人根本不用鸟他。

english: ~z~Yo, B. You didn't have to get yourself shot, now? Shit, we coming. We coming.
zh: ~z~哟，兄，也没必要硬吃枪子儿吧？妈的，来了来了。

english: ~z~DeSean? Shit man, I thought you was with Big D. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah we on our way.
zh: ~z~德肖恩？妈的，兄弟，你没和大D在一起吗？哦，好好，我们过来了。

english: ~z~DeSean's aight, probably only got hit with a nine. The fool's on the phone, right?
zh: ~z~不会有事的，顶多就是颗九毫米吧。这不还能打电话吗？

english: ~z~They only meant to be using baseball bats in the race. I wasn't expecting no lead slinging.
zh: ~z~那场赛车最多也只能用上棒球棍，但他们居然打黑枪。

english: ~z~Malc, Malc. You think Johnny's trying to become a Uptown Riders prospect or something?
zh: ~z~马尔科姆，马尔科姆。你说强尼是不是想来我们上城骑士实习啊？

english: ~z~Pretend like you're in the Liberty City Swingers, man. Knock 'em the fuck out.
zh: ~z~想象自己是自由城浪人队的一员，兄弟。用力打飞他们。

english: ~z~Yo, you just keep yours in your pants as well. I know how itchy that finger gets.
zh: ~z~哟，你还是把枪藏裤兜里吧。我知道你管不住手。

english: ~z~Hey yo, Johnny, remember, don't shoot anyone till the race is over, aight?
zh: ~z~嘿，强尼。记住，比赛结束前别对任何人开枪，好吗？

english: ~z~Well, well, well, if my little baby here didn't burn your antiquated ass Johnny boy.
zh: ~z~好好好，都怪我的小宝贝，烫着了你的古董屁股，强尼仔。

english: ~z~Haven't liked bats since I got kicked outta little league. Later on.
zh: ~z~被少棒联盟除籍以后，我就不想碰球棒了。回见。

english: The greed and corruption of war-mongering politicians has left our economy in tatters. Air Sol squandered half a billion dollars last year on executive bonuses. People that run companies shouldn't get rich. We at PLO are all in favor of raising taxes. But when Big Business thinks it can start taxing our bodily functions, it's time to make a stand. Boycott the airlines. Take the bus. March on the White House. Wear sloganned t-shirts. Eat more sprouts. Your consumer choices CAN make a difference. The people still have the power. Honestly.
zh: 好战政客们的贪婪和腐败已让我们的经济千疮百孔。Air Sol公司去年在高管奖金上浪费了五亿美元，经营企业的人就不该这么有钱，本报职员都赞成加税。但当大企业连我们的身体机能都不肯放过时，我们就该表明立场了。联合抵制航空公司，改坐公共汽车，白宫门口游行，衣服印上口号，多吃豆芽菜。你的消费选择至关重要。权力依然在人民手中，真的。

english: Just as workers were getting their work-life balance back, corporations are crushing resistance, forcing employees to stay at their constraining cubicles, not surf the internet for seventy five percent of the day, and show up on time. Another casualty this week as Sandra McColland collapsed while at work. Many therapists and holistic specialists believe an open attendance policy, lack of management hierarchy, and daily breaks to catch up on literature about celebrities creates a happy and fruitful workplace.
zh: 一如工人们想夺回他们工作与生活的平衡，企业也在进行反抗。他们逼迫职工呆在工位上，让他们一天有75%的时间不能网上冲浪，还要求他们每天准时出勤。本周还有一个噩耗，桑德拉･麦科兰在工作时昏倒。许多治疗师和调养专家认为，快乐而又高效的工作环境需要满足以下条件：包容的出勤考核，缺失的管理体系，用于阅读名人八卦的每日休息时间。

english: Are you incontinent, diabetic or menstruating? Make sure you arrive at the airport with a big bag of quarters for your next flight (although be aware that you'll probably exceed your weight allowance). In a last-ditch attempt to sustain their record levels of profit, Air Sol has announced that pay toilets have been installed on all its aircraft. Passengers will now be charged $2 for a number one and $3 for a number two. Where will this lunacy end? $20 for a life jacket? And, yes, before all the CEOs start whining from the top of their ivory towers, we know what's at the root of all this nickel-and-diming: Oil.
zh: 您是否大小便失禁或患有糖尿病？抑或是正好来了月经？下次乘飞机的时候记得多带点两毛五的硬币(不过有可能超过行李限额)。为了将公司利润率维持在历史高点，Air Sol公司做出最后一搏，宣布其已在公司名下的所有飞机上安装收费厕所。小号两元，大号三元。这种全国一人给我一块钱的疯狂何时是个头？20元一件救生衣？在这些活在象牙塔塔顶的CEO开始哭惨之前，我们就已看透了这种疯狂的根源所在：石油。

english: Sweatshops. That's what the ragged, broken American college student finds when they hit the workforce. Fresh out of college, a place of learning, they want time to balance life by taking long hikes, getting colon cleansing, writing in a journal! How do we expect people to be part of a democracy when they are bogged down by oppressive work 8-9 hours a day? We feel sad for Sandra McColland, she's standing up for herself and fighting corporate America. Good for you. You go girl. These conservatives will take every ounce of your being. Sue them till they get a clue that work is about more than working.
zh: 广大落魄的美国大学生加入劳动大军时所遇到的是血汗工厂。刚从大学这片知识天地毕业的他们，需要时间远足、洗肠、写日记，借此平来衡生活！如果人们被每天八九个小时的强制劳动绑架，他们还怎么参与到民主社会当中？桑德拉･麦科兰为自己发声，并与美国企业界进行抗争，我们为她的遭遇感到难过。你真行，加油姑娘。这些保守派会榨干你的每分每毫。起诉他们，让他们认清劳动不仅仅是干活。

english: ~z~I'd almost given up on you, man. Come on, we've got some racing to do.
zh: ~z~我都没指望你来了，哥们。快点，还有比赛要比。

english: ~z~Slow to the start of this race, you'll be slow to the finish too. Let's go.
zh: ~z~来比赛磨磨蹭蹭，你一会儿也是吊车尾。开始吧。

english: ~z~Nice bat, man. I'll try not to smack you in the face with it. Ha ha.
zh: ~z~棍子不错兄弟，一会儿我尽量不朝你脸上打。哈哈。

english: ~z~Did you park it on the way over here to save energy for the race Johnny? Let's do it, man.
zh: ~z~你是半路休息在为比赛养精蓄锐么？开始吧，哥们。

english: ~z~Did you forget how to use that throttle, man? Well you better start learning. Let's get this race started.
zh: ~z~你是不会拧油门了吗，哥们？那还是赶紧学吧。比赛就要开始了。

english: ~z~Shit man. I thought you was never gonna get here. OK, let's do some racing.
zh: ~z~妈的，兄弟。我还以为你不打算来了。好了，准备比赛吧。

english: You have a bat which can be used to attack other competitors. Press ~INPUT_VEH_HEADLIGHT~ for a left attack, or press ~INPUT_FRONTEND_RT~ for a right attack.
zh: 你手上有一根球棒，可以用它攻击对手。按~INPUT_VEH_HEADLIGHT~左击，按~INPUT_FRONTEND_RT~右击。

english: You have a bat which can be used to attack other competitors. Press ~INPUT_MOUSE_LMB~ for a left attack, or press ~INPUT_MOUSE_RMB~ for a right attack.

english: Al Di Napoli - star of stage, screen, and drugs interventions around the country - has raised fresh doubts about his ability to perform on the Boulevard stage every night. We're not talking about the garbled lines or the stink of booze that goes all the way back to row F at the AmDram Theatre. No, police are wanting to question him after a Celebinator-reading cop recognised him as one of the suspects in a drugs bust. Big Al claims that he was in his hotel room all night and has several hookers to back up this story, but is still considered a suspect. Whoever's insuring Al's production of Legless better watch out. It's only a matter of time...
zh: 阿尔･迪纳波利——全国舞台、银幕和戒毒记录上的大明星——最近有人对他如何做到每晚都在林荫大道舞台上表演起了怀疑。我们不是在说他在阿姆德拉姆剧院演出时混乱的台词和一直飘到F排的酒臭味。不，而是警队中有一名「名人终结者」的读者认出了他，怀疑他涉嫌参与一起毒品交易想要对其进行问询。阿尔哥则称他整晚都在酒店房间，并且有几名妓女作证，但他仍被认为是嫌疑人。阿尔的作品《寸步难行》的保险公司可要悠着点了，出事只是时间问题...

english: FYI - I'm not writing this as the Celebinator, but a mere human being. Ive got all this power and it should be wielded with responsibility. With that in mind, Gay Tony Prince is the first / only guy we're apologizing to. We got to know him and his charming partner, Luis Lopez, when we shared a bottle of vintage Bleutr'd on a helicopter tour of the city. We talked about summer parties in the Carraways and winters in Vice - we clicked. That stuff we said before was stupid. Maisonette and Hercules are still the two hottest clubs in the town, and the guys who run it are awesome!
zh: 前言：本文是以一名普通人的角度所写，并非是作为「名人终结者」。我有这么大的影响力，理应为自己的言行负责。考虑到这一点，基佬托尼･普林斯是第一位，也是唯一一位我们要对其道歉的人。搭乘直升机游览城市时，我们认识了他和他迷人的伙伴路易斯･洛佩兹，并且有幸与他们共饮了一瓶Bleutr'd陈年香槟。我们谈到了在卡拉韦斯的夏日派对和在罪城的冬日派对——我们很合得来。之前我们在博客里说的话很蠢。9号豪宅和大力神仍然是城里最火的两家夜店，两家店的经营者都很棒！

english: Whoop! Whoop! After a brief closure by the city on health and safety grounds - boring people - Tony Queen's two nightclubs have reopened. Yay! EVERYONE is going to be at the opening gala including moi! It's going to be proper fabulous! I'd write about it for you, but I'll probably be too gone on Bleutr'd too type, and too surrounded by fabulous people to be able to single one out. Jealous much??? Welcome back, Tony. Kiss kiss. I love you!
zh: 喔！喔！出于健康和安全考虑，托尼 Queen的两家夜店曾被无趣的当局短暂关闭，现在两家店都重新开张了。耶！所有人都会去开业庆典，包括我！一定会非常棒的！我很想为你们记录一篇博客，但我可能会被香槟灌到神志不清，被很赞的人们团团包围，难以抉择与谁作伴。羡不羡慕？？？欢迎回来，托尼。亲亲。我爱你！

english: In other Maisonette 9 news, Poppy Mitchell was thought to be engaged in group sex in the VIP room! Poppy Mitchell! And we thought she was a nice girl? We wish we'd been there to see it / film it / join in / all of the above. Sadly we weren't and the paps were too soggy to get some good photo journalism for us. :( Anyway, we love your newest RomCom Poppy, we don't care if you're a cum guzzling slut queen.) xxx
zh: 还有一则来自9号豪宅的新闻。波比･米切尔似乎参与了VIP包厢里的群交！波比･米切尔！我们之前还认为她是个好姑娘？我们真希望能够亲身 观看/拍摄/加入/以上全部 这场淫趴。可惜的是我们不能，而狗仔队当时都湿透了，没法拍到好的新闻照片。:( 不管怎样，我们喜欢你新拍的浪漫喜剧，波比，即便你是吞精的荡妇我们也不在乎。么么哒

english: Some paparazzi got a nasty surprise outside Maisonette 9 the other night as a rogue fire truck accidentally sprayed them with their hose. I know some people who'd kill to have a fireman turn his hose on them, but these paps aren't so happy. Several of them are getting together to launch a class action suit against the LCFD. Keeping the paps' cameras working is a hell of a lot more important that the firemen's pension plans so I say go for it. Who ever saw an old fireman anyway?
zh: 一天晚上，一些狗仔队在9号豪宅外得到了一份惊喜，他们被失控的消防车意外地喷了一身水。我知道有人很愿意被消防员的水枪射到浑身湿透，但这些狗仔队可没那么乐意。他们中的一些人计划对自由城消防局提起集体诉讼。让狗仔队的摄像机正常工作可比消防员的养老金重要多了，所以我是支持诉讼的。话又说回来了，谁又见到过上年纪的消防员呢？

english: Tiny tweeny pop sensations the the Brothers Blue set mouths wagging after a fan accused them of date rape. No one has been able to get the truth since their meany publicist told them to keep schtum. Well, one of our spies managed to corner Bill and Bobby at a party and we've got the low down! You heard it here first, the kind souls only gave her a sedative to calm her down. "She was freaking out having a panic attack so we slipped her one to chill her out. We thought she might die." Good thing you had those roofies on you boys, you can sedate us whenever you like!
zh: 一位粉丝指控Blue兄弟约会强奸，令这一年轻的流行组合立刻成为了八卦中心。在他们刻薄的公关人员要求他们保持沉默后，没有人能够知道真相。但我们的一位线人在派对上堵到了比利和博比，让我们掌握了内幕消息！全网首发，善良的他们只是给了她镇定剂让她平静下来。「她吓坏了，一下子惊恐发作，所以我们给了她一支镇定剂让她放松下来。我们觉得当时要出人命了。」还好你们身上带了迷奸药，想蒙倒我们了就拿出来用吧！

english: Tony Queen and his rent boy princess, Luis Lopez, are at it again. Apart from being the least convincing non-couple since two men spit-roasted an albino cheetah in Las Venturas, Queeny and Queenier insist on telling half the few desperate shlobs who bother to try to go to the now irrelevant Maisonette to take a hike. Get over yourselves! Hello sweeties, no one is interested in coming in there to watch you lap dance each other anyway.
zh: 托尼 Queen和他的男妓路易斯･洛佩兹再次登场。尽管他俩在拉斯文加斯共烤一只白化的猎豹的事实已经有力地证明了他们之间的暧昧关系，但他们仍坚持将少数要死要活的蠢货拒之门外，无意让他们进入现已无关紧要的9号豪宅。差不多得了！亲爱的，真没人想进去看你们两个跳脱衣舞的。

english: Clay 'The Pain Giver' Jackson was spotted out with a mystery blond last night. No, not Poppy Mitchell or Cloe Parker. Contrary to what Mr. Jackson would have us believe in his raps, this date was less ho and more homo. His new album of ballads LOVE ISN'T A CRIME comes out soon. Being gay isn't a crime either, Clay, so get on out of that closet, amigo! And stop going to Hercules! Closet case or not, that place SUCK, SUCK, SUCKS!
zh: 「痛苦给予者」科雷 杰克逊昨晚被拍到和一个神秘的金发人物约会。不，不是波比･米切尔，也不是克洛伊･帕克。与杰克逊先生在说唱中给我们留下的印象截然相反，这次约会更像是同性恋而不是异性恋。他的新专辑《爱不是罪》即将发行。同性恋也不是罪，科雷，所以别遮遮掩掩了，老兄！也别去大力神了！不管你有没有出柜，那个地方都烂透了！烂烂烂烂烂！

english: Tourists in Star Junction got a surprise earlier when they looked up to see aging action star Chris Hunt's flaccid member flashing across the Weazel News Mega-Screen. Our sources hear that an explicit video featuring him and British debutante Daisy Cash-Cooze was broadcast to passers-by before being leaked on the internet. It was like briefly time travelling back to the nineties when people actually went to see Chris Hunt movies. They're about as old as the dinosaurs, people. That oh so familiar sense of disappointment came back too, when we realised that the only thing you get to see is a hand job! Boo! I watch hand shandies every morning in my shower! Come on Chris, you're going to have to do better than that if you expect any of us to believe that you stand to attention for anyone other than your little Filipino house boy! P-lease!
zh: 早些时候，路过星汇广场的游客一抬头就会大吃一惊，年迈的动作明星克里斯･亨特那疲软的老二正在Weazel新闻的大屏幕上播放。据我们的线人所言，当时播放的是他和英国富家女黛西 卡什-库兹的露骨视频，而这则视频甚至还没有在网络上流出。这就像短暂地回到了90年代，那时人们还会去看克里斯･亨特的电影。那些人现在已经像恐龙一样古老了。当我们发现银幕上唯一的内容是撸管时，那种熟悉的失望感也回来了！切！我每天早上洗澡的时候就能看手冲啊！别这样嘛，克里斯。如果你想让我们相信，能让你保持「坚挺」的不止是你的菲律宾男佣，那就拿点更劲爆的东西出来嘛！求求你了！

english: Want to know the real reason Vinewood leading man Bruce Spade fired his agent? He couldn't book him a gig at the Civilisation Committee. A source close to El Spado says "Bruce has been reading a lot of pamphlets on international relations recently. He's got some really interesting theories he wants to share with luminaries from around the world and thought addressing the Citadel was the perfect way to do it." When his agent couldn't secure the appointment (normally reserved for world leaders) he threw a hissy fit and tore up their contract. Hopefully his next agent will be able to help him get that Peace Prize he's been eying for the awards cabinet.
zh: 想知道好麦坞男一号布鲁斯･斯佩德解雇经纪人的真正原因吗？那位经纪人没能给他在全球文明委员会预约一场演讲。一名与这位斯佩德佬关系密切的消息人士说：「布鲁斯最近读了很多关于国际关系的刊物。从中他得出了一些非常有趣的理论，想与世界各地的杰出人士分享。而他认为在自由城的市政厅演讲就很合适。」但他的经纪人无法保证能够预约这场演讲(通常是留给世界领导人的)时，这令他大发雷霆，直接撕毁了与经纪人的合同。希望他的下一任经纪人能够帮助他获得他期待已久的诺贝尔和平奖，好摆在奖牌陈列柜里。

english: Rumor has it a member of the British Royal family has been taking time out from spending taxpayer money in the UK to come spend their money over here. After a few too many at a Middle Park East drinks party he over-shared with one of our secret informants - "I've had all the 18 to 25 year olds in London so I'm going to come over here until a new crop matures. Being next in line to the throne might allow you to quash tabloid kiss and tell stories, but not so much with the statutory rape allegations." Awww. It's a hard life, isn't it, petal?
zh: 有传言称，一名英国皇室成员百忙之中来到了自由城，换了个地方浪费纳税人的钱。他在中央公园东的一场酒会上喝大了，给我们的秘密线人爆了个猛料：「伦敦18岁到25岁的我都搞过了，所以我要到这里来，直到新的『幼苗』长成。作为王位继承人，你或许可以平息小报上的各种绯闻，但对法律上的强奸指控就没那么好办了。」噢。生活很艰难，不是吗，亲爱的？

english: Hey Mr. Celebinator, we're big fans of your site at the club, so it's kind of confusing when we read this spiteful shit. I'm sure you don't wanna offend us, so give us a call and we'll try to work it out.
zh: 嘿，名人终结者先生，我们来自您博客中提到的夜店，同时也是您网站的忠实粉丝。您博客上这些充斥着恶意中伤的文字实在是让我们有点困惑。您肯定也不想冒犯我们，给我们打个电话，我们一起想办法解决吧。

english: Once legendary night club Mr. Big, Gay Tony is losing his touch. Rumors persist he's too wrapped up in his rent boy, Luis Lopez, to worry about running a decent club any more. Tony, who was a big star before the internet but has seen his popularity begin to wane, really should try relaxing his notoriously strict door policy and letting people in. Now it seems Tony and Luis are too busy staring into each other's eyes to worry about the fact their drinks are overpriced, their music is lame and even worse, the cool people simply don't go to their shitty clubs anymore. Bye bye!
zh: 曾经的传奇夜店大亨，基佬托尼，正在淡出人们的视野。有传言称他把精力都放在他的男妓路易斯･洛佩兹上，已经无暇经营一家像样的夜店了。托尼是互联网时代之前的大明星，但他的知名度正在逐渐下滑。早该放宽他那出了名严格的准入政策了，多放点人进去吧。估计现在托尼正忙着和路易斯深情对视，根本没空关心店里饮料价格虚高、音乐太差劲之类的问题。更糟糕的是，潮人根本就不去他们的垃圾夜店了。拜拜！

english: Yummy but ohh so skinny Brit, Charlotte Crown is fighting back against people who say she is anorexic. We saw her out last night and she said "I just love food. I am obsessed by food. Seriously. When I get older and have kids, I'm definitely going to write a cook book. All my favorite recipes. I love eating. I ate 3 shepherd's pies today and lots of crisps and fish and chips and all these scrummy English things, because I'm really proud of being English, even though I have to live in Los Santos now. I'm definitely not anorexic. It's ridiculous. I'm just really lucky." You go girl! And don't forget to start shaving soon. Ciao!
zh: 夏洛特･克朗，一位令人垂涎欲滴却又骨瘦如柴的英国人，正在对那些说她患有厌食症的人进行反击。昨晚我们在路上与她偶遇，她说：「我热爱美食，钟情于美食。真的。等我过几年有了孩子，我一定会写一本烹饪书，记录我最爱的那些食谱。我爱吃。我今天吃了3个牧羊人派，还吃了很多薯片和炸鱼薯条，以及各种美味的英国食物。尽管我现在不得不住在洛圣都，但我依然为自己是一名英国人而骄傲。我绝对没有厌食症。绝无可能。可能是天生体质比较好吧。」继续编吧姑娘！别把脱毛减重这条给忘了。拜拜！

english: (note: I would never compromise this blog's credibility by accepting bribes. Tony, Luis and me really did vibe, and the clubs are f-ing fabulous. You'd be a doofus to think otherwise! Would people please stop bitching about my Silver Schafter as well! All kinds of public figures get free shit!
zh: (注：我绝不会干接受贿赂这种败坏博客信誉的事。托尼、路易斯和我真的关系很好，他们的夜店太TM棒了。你要是不这么想就太蠢了！大家能不能别再挖苦我的那辆银色莎夫特了！公众人物免费拿点东西很正常的！

english: The other day I had the unfortunate experience of getting up-close and personal with the statue of Happiness. It's horrible! I could swear that disgusting strained smile on her face reminds me of someone, too. That's the face of a woman who needs some work done, or some action, or both! I mean, she is seriously living a lie, that one, and for what? She just stands there and does nothing! Reminds me of my mother. If I was married to that cold slab of stone I'd be off with any fat bird who'd take me. It's amazing that angry black heart of hers still beats in her chest.
zh: 前几天，我很倒霉地与幸福女神像来了次亲密接触。太可怕了！我敢发誓，她脸上紧绷着的恶心笑容让我想起了某人。这张脸的主人不是欠收拾就是欠操，也可能既欠收拾又欠操！我是说，她活得很虚伪，有必要吗？她只是站在那里，什么都不做！这让我想起了我的母亲。如果我娶了那种冰冷的石头，我会和任何愿意嫁给我的胖女人一起离开。她那颗愤怒的黑心还在胸中跳动，真是令人惊奇。
