english: A rival gang is transporting some drugs. Intercept the convoy and steal the drugs vehicle.
zh: 敌对帮派正在运输毒品。抢走运毒载具，截下货物。

english: A rival gang has stashed a drugs vehicle. Steal this vehicle before they get a chance to move it.
zh: 敌对帮派装好了一辆运毒载具。在他们转移货物之前将其偷走。

english: A drug deal is going down. One member of the rival gang will have the stash. Take them out and take the stuff.
zh: 一桩毒品交易正在进行。敌对帮派的成员之一持有毒品。干掉他们，拿走毒品。

english: ~z~It's just not working out sugar. We're from different worlds. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~这样不会有结果的，甜心。我们来自不同的世界。我很抱歉。

english: ~z~Hey Luis, it's me? We met at the club. You wanna hang out?
zh: ~z~嘿，路易斯，是我。我们在夜店见过。你想约一下吗？

english: ~z~Oi, Luis. I don't think I wanna see you no more. Just got a bit bored you know.
zh: ~z~喂，路易斯。我不想再见到你了。就是有点厌烦了。

english: ~z~Hey, gorgeous, you're gonna have to fogive me, but I ain't the relationship type.
zh: ~z~喂，美人，希望你能原谅我，但我不适合长久的恋爱。

english: ~z~Hey sorry, chula, but I've too much going on for a relationship right now.
zh: ~z~喂，对不起，美女，但我现在没空维持这段感情了。

english: ~z~I can't believe I got dumped by a bouncer. I really do need some major lipo.
zh: ~z~我居然被一个门卫甩了。看来真得去做个抽脂了。

english: ~z~Hey Luis, you get my text? You up for a little something?
zh: ~z~嘿，路易斯，收到我短信了吗？你准备找点乐子吗？

english: ~z~Hey, this is me, I'm lost somewhere in the big city. Leave me a message and I'll call ya!
zh: ~z~嘿，是我，我在这个大城市迷路了。给我留个言，我会联系你的！

english: ~z~I figured. Everyone I've met here has been a condescending asshole so why d'you be any different?
zh: ~z~我懂了。我在这儿认识的都是自以为是的混蛋，你怎么可能不一样呢？

english: ~z~Hey, hey! I must be at a model shoot or something, so leave me a message!
zh: ~z~嘿，嘿！我一定是在忙模特拍摄之类的，给我留言吧！

english: ~z~Hey sugar, I'm sitting in my room feeling all lonely. Wanna fill that void?
zh: ~z~嘿，甜心，我在房间里好寂寞啊。想来填补空虚吗？

english: ~z~And I was just about to call you and tell you I loved you. You broke my poor heart.
zh: ~z~我刚想打电话告诉你我爱你。你伤害了我脆弱的心。

english: ~z~Yo, it's Luis, I was thinking about you. And maybe we could hook up again.
zh: ~z~哟，我是路易斯，正在想你呢。要么我们再约一次吧？

english: ~z~My boyfriend told me to stop fucking the help, so I have to cut you off. Sorry!
zh: ~z~我男友让我别打慈善炮了，所以不能再联系你了。对不起！

english: ~z~Yo, it's Luis, I was thinking about you. And maybe we could hook up again.
zh: ~z~哟，我是路易斯，正在想你呢。要么我们再约一次吧？

english: ~z~I think you're just using me baby. I don't like that. Don't call me again.
zh: ~z~你好像只是在利用我，宝贝。我不喜欢那样。别再打给我了。

english: ~z~Hey, either I don't like you or I'm busy. Try me again later to find out.
zh: ~z~嘿，可能是我不喜欢你，也可能是我很忙。待会儿再打过来看看吧。

english: ~z~Ok, we're both adults. Do you. Whatever.
zh: ~z~好吧，大家都是成年人。做你喜欢的吧。无所谓的。

english: ~z~And I was just about to call you and tell you I loved you. You broke my poor heart.
zh: ~z~我刚想打电话告诉你我爱你。你伤害了我脆弱的心。

english: ~z~Darling, it was fun but I'm done slumming it. Don't call me again.
zh: ~z~宝贝，虽然很快乐，但我受够了平民生活了。别联系我了。

english: ~z~Hey, gorgeous, you're gonna have to fogive me, but I ain't the relationship type.
zh: ~z~喂，美人，希望你能原谅我，但我不适合长久的恋爱。

english: ~z~Hey sorry, chula, but I've too much going on for a relationship right now.
zh: ~z~喂，对不起，美女，但我现在没空维持这段感情了。

english: ~z~Oye mami, just wanted to give you the heads up that I got a lot going on. And I ain't gonna be able to give you the attention you need.
zh: ~z~喂，妹子。跟你提醒一下，我有很多事要做，可能给不了你你想要的关心。

english: ~z~And I was just about to call you and tell you I loved you. You broke my poor heart.
zh: ~z~我刚想打电话告诉你我爱你。你伤害了我脆弱的心。

english: ~z~Hey sorry, chula, but I've too much going on for a relationship right now.
zh: ~z~喂，对不起，美女，但我现在没空维持这段感情了。

english: ~z~Hey, gorgeous, you're gonna have to fogive me, but I ain't the relationship type.
zh: ~z~喂，美人，希望你能原谅我，但我不适合长久的恋爱。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna be able to hang out with you for a while, sorry! I'm gonna be...out of town.
zh: ~z~我要有段时间不能和你约会了，抱歉！我要...离开这里了。

english: ~z~Yo, it's Luis, I was thinking about you. And maybe we could hook up again.
zh: ~z~哟，我是路易斯，正在想你呢。要么我们再约一次吧？

english: ~z~Hey mami, I'm sorry but things aren't working out. I'm deleting your number.
zh: ~z~喂，妹子，对不起，但我们不会有结果的。我会删掉你的号码。

english: ~z~Aye mami, I think we both know this ain't going nowhere. I gotta end it.
zh: ~z~喂，姑娘。我们都知道这样不会有结果。我们结束吧。

english: ~z~Hey baby, it's been fun, but I'm gonna have to cut things off. Sorry!
zh: ~z~喂，宝贝。我们玩得很高兴。但我打算结束这段感情了。抱歉！

english: ~z~Timur? He is replaceable, but his death is part of the large failure.
zh: ~z~蒂穆尔？他是可以替换的，但他的死是这次巨大失败的一部分。

english: ~z~I'd prefer we weren't taking on the National Office of Security Enforcement, but that's a different matter.
zh: ~z~我可不想和国家安全办公室干上，不过那是另一回事了。

english: ~z~Take these sticky bombs, Luis. We will need them for our NOOSE friends.
zh: ~z~拿着这些黏弹，路易斯。要用它来招待NOOSE的朋友们。

english: ~z~Well placed. The bomb should prove quite a surprise for our friends.
zh: ~z~安装的位置不错。炸弹会给我们的朋友一个大惊喜。

english: ~z~Get rid of these cops, Luis. We do not need extra eyes on us.
zh: ~z~甩掉这些条子，路易斯。不能多一双眼睛盯我们。

english: ~z~Get out of here, civilian. We don't want to start reading you the Jingoism Act.
zh: ~z~快点滚出去，平民。我不想给你念沙文主义法案。

english: ~z~There is no plan B, you simpleton. Ray Bulgarin should not need to provide for failure.
zh: ~z~哪来的B计划，你这傻逼。雷･布尔加林不需要失败时的预案。

english: ~z~Sir. You are going to have to leave the premises. We are on official N. O. O. S. E. business.
zh: ~z~先生，请你离开这座停车场。我们是国安办官方人员。

english: ~z~Hey, civilian, you don't want to be around here. Move on out before we redact your ass.
zh: ~z~喂，平民，别在这里待着。不出去就让你人间蒸发。

english: ~z~Perhaps. For now... perhaps. But do you think you are achieving everything you could?
zh: ~z~也许吧。也许现在是这样。难道这就是你力所能及的一切吗？

english: ~z~Luis, you could be much more than that. Unless you enjoy working for such a man? 'Partner', or whatever you call it.
zh: ~z~路易斯，我看你大有可为。除非你只想给这种人打工，这位「合伙人」什么的。

english: ~z~Of course. But what is he? He is a drug addict, a madman.
zh: ~z~当然。可他是什么人？是一个瘾君子，是个疯子。

english: ~z~I don't know what you're implying, bro. Tony and me are partners. I got a stake in the enterprise.
zh: ~z~我不太懂你意思，兄弟。我和托尼是合伙人。我可是有股份的。

english: ~z~I can handle myself. But you can only fight for so long until you run into the wrong guy, and then it ain't pretty.
zh: ~z~我是有两下子。但遇上硬茬后，你的格斗生涯就结束了。下场可不好看。

english: ~z~I tell you where it's got me, it's got me off the street. Before I met Tony, I was a no hoper.
zh: ~z~告诉你我的收获吧，我不用再流落街头。遇见托尼之前，我苟且偷生。

english: ~z~I know people and people know me. I can get things done in this town.
zh: ~z~我认识别人，别人也认识我。可以在城里解决问题。

english: ~z~Yes. It must be nice for you to get out from the under big Tony.
zh: ~z~是啊。能从托尼大哥的手底下解脱也是你的幸事吧。

english: ~z~The money I have can open those legs more readily than your bottle service can.
zh: ~z~想让她们张开双腿，用我手上的钱可比你在那端茶倒水容易多了。

english: ~z~I'm cracking up here, Luis. Hurry the fuck up. How long are you going to be?
zh: ~z~我要忙裂开了，路易斯。你他妈快点。多久才能到？

english: ~z~I don't wanna be no rock star like you guys seem to. That what you asking?
zh: ~z~反正我对你俩的摇滚明星梦不感兴趣。这样可以吗？

english: ~z~Tony's my business partner, bro. I ain't just leaving when a better offer comes along.
zh: ~z~托尼是我的合伙人，兄弟。我不会因为一点利益就抛弃他。

english: ~z~Shit, bro, just 'cause I got a gay boss, don't mean I'm gonna get intimate with you.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟。我有个基佬老板，不代表会跟你亲密接触啊。

english: ~z~You diss my boss for being gay and yours went to wrestling school? Gimme a break, man.
zh: ~z~你看不起我的基佬老板，结果自家老板去过摔跤学校？放过我吧，哥们。

english: ~z~There is a point where you will not be able to gain anything from him, understand?
zh: ~z~总有一天，你将无法从他身上得到任何东西，懂吗？

english: ~z~That's a bit of a problem, bro. I ain't fresh off the boat, this is my town. I don't come alone.
zh: ~z~这就是问题了。我可不是刚偷渡下船，这是我老家。我不单干的。

english: ~z~Alright. Rewind a second. What you mean, "employ"? I'm already in business with Tony.
zh: ~z~好吧。话说回来，「雇佣」是啥意思？我已经和托尼搭伙了。

english: ~z~Nothing can be achieved here in Liberty City with Ashvilli's pigs rooting through my affairs.
zh: ~z~只要阿什维利的走狗还在妨碍我，我在自由城就什么都做不成。

english: ~z~I don't think so, bro. Not yet. Tony and I are partners. I'm gonna bring him with me wherever I go.
zh: ~z~我不同意，兄弟。还早呢。托尼和我是合伙人。走到哪里我都会带着他。

english: ~z~I don't think you realize the magnitude of your insults, so I will let them slide.
zh: ~z~你好像没意识到拿我开涮的严重性，所以这次放你一马。

english: ~z~That's real flattering, Mr. Bulgarin, but whatever it is you're offering, I'm gonna have to decline.
zh: ~z~您过誉了，布尔加林先生。但无论条件如何，我都会拒绝的。

english: ~z~Pro fighting's a joke, bro. May as well be a wrestler if you want to join the circus.
zh: ~z~职业格斗就是个笑话，兄弟。还不如进马戏团当摔跤手。

english: ~z~He gets his kicks elsewhere, but he's been a good boss to me, and a good guide. Helped me out.
zh: ~z~虽然他天天出去鬼混，但他是我的好老板、好大哥。他救了我。

english: ~z~Really, bro? I don't know. When I was left to my own devices, I got locked up.
zh: ~z~是吗，兄弟？我不清楚。我之前单干结果进了局子。

english: ~z~A stake. Sure. You still take orders from him, don't you? You clean up his shit?
zh: ~z~哼哼，股份。是，可你不照样被他差遣使唤？帮他擦屁股？

english: ~z~Shit, look man. I don't wanna be no wrestler. This hospitality shit, this is my thing now.
zh: ~z~妈的，听我说哥们。我不想当什么摔跤手。我现在想做的，就是夜店经理。

english: ~z~Maybe I'll make you man with one leg, but I make you rich man with one leg.
zh: ~z~哪怕成了只剩一条腿的瘸子，那也是有头有脸的富瘸子。

english: ~z~Them clubs is leveraged to the max already, man. I don't know if there's anything left to sell.
zh: ~z~夜店已经债台高筑了，哥们。都不知道还有没有能卖的。

english: ~z~Yeah, great. Thanks. But if you need more cops taken out, crooked or otherwise, you ain't choosing me.
zh: ~z~真好，谢谢您嘞。要是你要干掉更多条子，不管他坏不坏，别选我了。

english: ~z~There is a particular unit that has a "hard-on" for me. And why? Because Marki Ashvilli won't sell me The Rampage.
zh: ~z~有那么一个小队，跟我杠上了。至于原因？因为马尔基･阿什维利不肯把暴怒队卖给我。

english: ~z~Yo, Ray. Shit man, something else came up. I hope you could take care of that thing without me.
zh: ~z~哟，雷。妈的，哥们，我突然有急事。希望没有我你们也能搞定。

english: ~z~Ha! You don't have any friends. You don't even have a business here. You are nothing in this country. - My sister,
zh: ~z~－哈！你哪来的朋友。你在这儿都没有事业。在美国你屁都不是。 －我姐姐。

english: ~z~I'm cracking up here, Luis. Hurry the fuck up. How long are you going to be?
zh: ~z~我要忙裂开了，路易斯。你他妈快点。多久才能到？

english: ~z~Some of these investors aren't the type to go away. They aren't the type to pay off either.
zh: ~z~有几个投资人可是钉子户，不是把钱还清就能打发走的。

english: ~z~Of course. Tony pulls the string and the little puppet man dance for him.
zh: ~z~哈哈，当然了。托尼一拉绳子，小木偶就手舞足蹈了。

english: ~z~Okay, man. Good for you. You got a nice place here, Mr. B.
zh: ~z~好吧，哥们。你喜欢就好。这地方不错啊，B先生。

english: ~z~I don't care about other investors. They will forget about debts if I am involved.
zh: ~z~我不在乎其他投资人。只要我一出手，债务就烟消云散了。

english: ~z~This is what the world sees. This is what they think of when they see you.
zh: ~z~这就是别人对他的印象。这就是别人看见你之后的想法。

english: ~z~Anyway, it's not my place to sell them. I have a stake, but Tony's got the controlling share.
zh: ~z~再说了，卖不卖我说了不算。我是有股份，但决定权还是托尼的。

english: ~z~What the fuck is this? I don't like killing government agents so I ain't got no balls? Gimme a break.
zh: ~z~你他妈说啥呢？不想杀政府的人，所以我没种？饶了我吧。

english: ~z~Hey, don't say that about Tony, man. I can't have you talking shit about him.
zh: ~z~喂，不许这么说托尼。哥们。我不允许你抹黑他。

english: ~z~You need to go home and exfoliate your balls? May as well cut them off.
zh: ~z~你要回家洗洗卵蛋上的死皮吗？要么直接切了吧。

english: ~z~Hey! You bring me to this fucking country and you keep me in an ugly cage. No one on TV lives in fucking Dukes.
zh: ~z~喂！你把我送到这个傻逼国家，关在这个破笼子里。电视上的大牌哪会住公爵区区啊？

english: ~z~Okay. Give them here. I'll need that Advanced MG too if I'm going to take on the NOOSE.
zh: ~z~好的。都拿来吧。既然要跟NOOSE打架，那把高级机枪我也要了。

english: ~z~Then you come and move all my stuff into hallway and fill place with fucking guitars.
zh: ~z~然后你来了，把我的东西全部搬到门厅，腾出位置堆这些破吉他。

english: ~z~Let me know when Tony next has hand up your ass and ventriloquist's dummy can talk.
zh: ~z~哪天托尼把手插你屁眼里，拿你表演腹语术了，记得通知我。

english: ~z~I'm gonna be honest, I kind of prefer a hot girl and a bottle of wine to a gun fight with the terror squad.
zh: ~z~我是认真的。比起陪恐怖分子枪战，我更喜欢喝酒和辣妹。

english: ~z~The NOOSE, bro? I'll need more than bombs. GImme that machine gun you got there and I might just be ready.
zh: ~z~国安办，兄弟？只有炸弹还不够。给我你那把机枪吧，这样稳一点。

english: ~z~Tony has some tough times, but he ain't no embarrassment. He used to be the coolest guy in this city.
zh: ~z~托尼是陷入了窘境，但绝对不会是笑话。他曾经是城里最酷的人，

english: ~z~Fuck that. I got explosives already. Hand over that MG of yours and I'm ready to go.
zh: ~z~算了吧。黏弹我早有了。那把机枪给我，我就准备好了。

english: ~z~I don't need no bombs, bro, but I will need one of them Mgs if I'm gonna take on the NOOSE.
zh: ~z~炸弹不需要，兄弟。但跟NOOSE干还是给我杆机枪吧。

english: ~z~ I would like you to think about what you can become without this weight around your neck.
zh: ~z~希望你好好思考思考，没有这个累赘，你能成就多少。

english: ~z~There is this team are tracing a car of mine. Take out the whole team. No exceptions.
zh: ~z~这支小队盯上了我的一辆车。干掉整支小队。斩草除根。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna take you up on the bomb offer 'cause I got my own, but I will take that Advanced MG you got there.
zh: ~z~不用你们的黏弹了，我自己有。但是这把高级机枪我要了。

english: ~z~Gimme that Advanced MG you got there as well. I ain't taking no chances with the NOOSE.
zh: ~z~你那挺高级机枪也给我吧。我可不想跟国安办赌运气。

english: ~z~That you did, Luis. A serviceable job. Most competent.
zh: ~z~就是你干的，路易斯。手到擒来的活，你最擅长了。

english: ~z~Chill, man. I'm just trying to converse with you. My job is hospitality and...
zh: ~z~冷静，哥们。我就是想跟你聊聊。我的工作是打理夜店和...

english: ~z~I would do but there is chance Ashvilli's people come for my family back in old place.
zh: ~z~我不上是因为阿什维利可能派人报复我老家的家人。

english: ~z~Only when I hurt people. When I kill them, no, but hurt them, yes, very tense.
zh: ~z~没打死人我就紧张。打死了没事，没打死就会很紧张。

english: ~z~Stay the fuck away from Tony, man. You touch him I'll fucking kill you.
zh: ~z~你他妈离托尼远点，哥们。敢动他，老子宰了你。

english: ~z~This is why you tell Mr. Ray you are not "contract killer"? You scared?
zh: ~z~所以你才跟雷先生说自己不是「契约杀手」？你怕了？

english: ~z~Fuck, bro, in the future, can we just listen to the radio on these trips.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟，以后咱出来，能不能听听收音机就得了。

english: ~z~You kill Ashvilli, send message and leave building. I pick you up on ground.
zh: ~z~你杀掉阿什维利，给我消息，然后离开大楼。我在地上接应你。

english: ~z~Maybe you right. In the moment you forget everything else, but then they turn into psychos.
zh: ~z~也许是吧。爽的时候是真的爽，之后就成疯婆娘了。

english: ~z~Can we just not talk? Is that a problem? Can you shut the fuck up?
zh: ~z~咱能不能不聊了？这样没问题吧？你他妈能不能闭嘴？

english: ~z~Go in, find Ashvilli, kill him. I wait outside with other headset.
zh: ~z~进去，找到阿什维利，杀了他。我戴着耳机在外面等你。

english: ~z~You with us now. I thought you done with him. You kill him and take over.
zh: ~z~你现在跟着我们，我还以为你已经和他决裂了。把他杀了，取而代之。

english: ~z~You think they would not notice chopper landing on building? You must go in silent.
zh: ~z~顶楼降落是怕他们没长眼睛吗？你必须潜入进去。

english: ~z~Hey, I know who I am. Sure, I do bad shit, but that ain't who I'm going to be forever.
zh: ~z~喂，我知道自己是什么人。我是干过坏事，但不可能永远干坏事。

english: ~z~You killer like me. That what Bulgarin want you to do, so that what you do.
zh: ~z~你和我一样是杀手。既然布尔加林让你这么做，那你必须这么做。

english: ~z~Ashvilli office is in MeTV Building. You no going to get in from ground so you come in from above.
zh: ~z~阿什维利的办公室在MeTV大楼里。地面上你是进不去的，只能从上面进去了。

english: ~z~It means I don't like doing anything that could easily kill me, but sometimes you got to.
zh: ~z~就是说容易出人命的事我都不喜欢，但有时候不得不干。

english: ~z~Sure, they open up when you shoot in their head. You put people in the ground, my friend.
zh: ~z~确实，一枪爆头就能让他们放开来了。你会把人放倒，我的朋友。

english: ~z~Timur, bro, I like to think I can talk to people. I try to put them at ease, make 'em open up.
zh: ~z~蒂穆尔，兄弟，我经常觉得自己很会聊天。让对方放松，放开来说话。

english: ~z~Hey I'm sorry to break up your party, man. You looked like you were having fun.
zh: ~z~喂，抱歉打扰你们狂欢了，哥们。你刚才好像挺开心的。

english: ~z~Your job is kill Marki Ashvilli for Ray Bulgarin.
zh: ~z~你的工作是帮雷･布尔加林杀了马尔基･阿什维利。

english: ~z~I'm gonna swing out over the Broker Bridge. We'll gain some height and come back over the city.
zh: ~z~我先从布洛克大桥上飞过去，拉点高度再回市区。

english: ~z~There will be a place for you in my new empire. Please, come to see me soon.
zh: ~z~我新建的帝国里会给你留一席之地的。拜托，再来找我吧。

english: ~z~We needed chopper. This will make Ray angry. I tell him you are to blame.
zh: ~z~我们需要直升机。雷要生气了。我会告诉他你全责的。

english: ~z~You'll have to find someone else, man. I mean, it's not my thing. I ain't qualified for that shit.
zh: ~z~你还是另请高明吧，伙计。总之我干不了，超出能力范围了。

english: ~z~Yeah, great. Tell him I'm not his fucking hitman, okay. That's not why I'm hanging with him.
zh: ~z~那就好。转告他我不是他的杀手，好吗？我跟他混不是为了当杀手。

english: ~z~Shit, bro, I must have forgotten. We'll get him another time.
zh: ~z~妈的，兄弟，我肯定是忘了。咱们改天再去杀他。

english: ~z~I wasn't discussing your career development. I was telling you what to do.
zh: ~z~我不是在讨论你的职业规划。我是在给你下命令。

english: ~z~I figured if you had him, you wouldn't need me to help on this thing. I left him to it.
zh: ~z~我发现有他在，你就不用我来帮忙了。我都交给他了。

english: ~z~Maybe. Mr. Ray does not normally allow people to disappoint him twice. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~也行吧。雷先生一般不允许有人让他失望两次。再见。

english: ~z~The owner still will not accept my offers. I have been more than reasonable.
zh: ~z~球队老板还是不肯接受我的开价。我已经很客气了。

english: ~z~I am sorry, Mr. Hospitality man. You do what Mr. Ray says, that's it.
zh: ~z~真不好意思，服务员先生。你按雷先生的命令做，就是这样。

english: ~z~You mean after you killed his special team of cops? That's weird... You want me to negotiate with him?
zh: ~z~你不是已经干掉他的特警队了吗？怪了...你要我跟他谈谈？

english: ~z~No, but I got some friends I could introduce you to if that's how you get your kicks.
zh: ~z~不，但是你想这样玩的话，我倒是可以给你介绍几个玩伴。

english: ~z~He's from the Kremlin. I knew they'd send someone.
zh: ~z~他是克里姆林宫派的吧。我就知道他们会派杀手。

english: ~z~I thought they would kill you. I am in truck outside. Jump out the window.
zh: ~z~他们会追杀你的。我在外面的卡车上，从窗口跳出来吧。

english: ~z~Okay. Now you got to go. I am outside in truck. Come out window.
zh: ~z~好的，现在你得撤了。我在外面的卡车上，从窗户出来吧。

english: ~z~Who'd you hear that from? Timur? That guy left me to get killed, bro. Some getaway driver.
zh: ~z~你听谁说的？蒂穆尔？那家伙都扔下我自生自灭了，兄弟。这车夫不行啊。

english: ~z~Oh shit. We getting our wires crossed, bro. I meant Timur's dead, man.
zh: ~z~噢，妈的，咱俩不在一个频道上。我是说蒂穆尔死了。

english: ~z~You Spanish have the rhythm. Give us fucking beat, man.
zh: ~z~你们西班牙人都有节奏感。快他妈敲两下吧，哥们。

english: ~z~It wasn't on purpose, man. I just missed it. I'll talk to you soon, okay.
zh: ~z~我不是故意的。飞过了而已。之后再联系，好吗。

english: ~z~Yeah, but I'm an asshole that don't have to hang out with you anymore. Tell your boss to shove his money up his ass.
zh: ~z~对，但我是个不用再跟着你们混的混蛋。告诉你老板拿钱吃屁去吧。

english: ~z~You don't drum, but you dance, don't you, Luis? You dance.
zh: ~z~不会打鼓的话，跳舞总会吧，路易斯？你跳舞吧。

english: ~z~Hey I ain't a hitman, bro. I mean, I'll fight anyone, do whatever, but I ain't a contract killer.
zh: ~z~喂，我不是杀手啊，兄弟。让我跟任何人打架、干任何事都行，但我不是契约杀手。

english: ~z~I want you to cover Timur's back. He's is going to talk to some people and I need you there.
zh: ~z~我要你去掩护蒂穆尔。他准备和某人谈谈，你过去帮忙。

english: ~z~Okay, man. I got it. But you should chill out, bro.
zh: ~z~好的，伙计。我明白了。但你最好冷静点，兄弟。

english: ~z~So, I heard from some people I know that maybe you have some diamonds for sale?
zh: ~z~那个，我的熟人告诉我，你好像有几颗钻石要卖？

english: ~z~He cut that cook's head off. Long story short he wants us dead.
zh: ~z~他还把那个厨子的头砍了。简而言之，他要我们死。

english: ~z~Hunting? Hunting humans, dog. I got top of the line sniper shit I can give you.
zh: ~z~猎枪？狩猎人类是吧。我有顶级的狙击枪可以给你。

english: ~z~You think you're a big man. Where's your house on Middle Park East? Where's your big sports team, huh?
zh: ~z~你以为你算老几。你在中央公园东的豪宅去哪了？你的大球队在哪呢，啊？

english: ~z~He's bad news. I hate to be the voice of reason here, but I don't think we need that kind of stress in our lives.
zh: ~z~他让我很不舒服。我不想当理中客，但我们不需要他那样的压力。

english: ~z~Yo you putting me in an awkward position, man. I can't tell you this thing's taken care of - 'cause it's not.
zh: ~z~我现在就很尴尬，伙计。我不能说事情已经处理好了，因为真没办好。

english: ~z~You got to talk to Daddy... I thought I was making you a real man. Not a rentboy.
zh: ~z~你咋不问问你爹...我还以为我让你成为了男子汉，而不是男妓。

english: ~z~Listen, Tony, I got something to talk to you about. You remember that Ray Bulgarin guy?
zh: ~z~听着，托尼，我有事要跟你说。还记得那个叫雷･布尔加林的家伙吗？

english: ~z~I can't sell what ain't mine, bro, and plus, with all the work I put in for you, I don't really feel like a man yet.
zh: ~z~不是我的东西我卖不了，兄弟。再说了，给你办了这么多事，我也没觉得自己成了男子汉。

english: ~z~Yo, man, we already got it. I, ummm, talked to him about some opportunities.
zh: ~z~喂，老兄，已经有压力了。我之前想找他碰碰运气。

english: ~z~I was in with some bad Russians, and they've sent this crack sniper team after us.
zh: ~z~我被几个毛子盯上了，他们派出了支狙击小队对付我们。

english: ~z~and I think I might need some long range type shit for it. You got a hunting rifle, something like that, for me?
zh: ~z~我觉得可能需要一把远程武器。你那里有猎枪之类的装备吗？

english: ~z~Your thingie was tiny even before the wrestling coach make you take steroids.
zh: ~z~摔跤教练让你用类固醇之前，你那玩意就小得可怜了。

english: ~z~I shoulda handled them myself, but I got scared and I ran. I'm sorry, bro. Look after yourself.
zh: ~z~我本该自己处理，但是我临阵脱逃了。我很抱歉，兄弟。照顾好你自己。

english: ~z~Hey man, quick favor to ask. I got to watch over this deal on Denver in Little Italy
zh: ~z~喂兄弟，帮我个小忙。我要去小意大利的丹佛大道盯一笔交易。

english: ~z~I'm sorry. I fucked up. Kind of refreshing for me to be the one getting us in shit for once, don't you think?
zh: ~z~很抱歉，我搞砸了。这次是我把你拖下水，对我来说还挺新鲜，不是吗？

english: ~z~Poor old chef. What were you doing talking to these guys without me, Lou?
zh: ~z~可怜的老厨子。你和这些人交涉怎么不带上我，卢？

english: ~z~You mean even more people want us dead? How am I not surprised? Fuck!
zh: ~z~就是说想要我们性命的人又多了？我好像不太意外啊？操！

english: ~z~Tony? Fuck! Look, bro. I'm sorry I can't explain all this, but you need to lay low a while.
zh: ~z~托尼？操！听着，老兄。很抱歉，我不能全部解释清楚。但你最近要保持低调。

english: ~z~Can't believe I'm saying this but, sure. It's a recession afterall.
zh: ~z~没想到我会说这么说，进来吧。毕竟经济衰退了。

english: ~z~Hey, it's the least I can do in these troubled times. Come on in.
zh: ~z~嘿，虽然是困难时期，至少我还能放你进去。进来吧。

english: ~z~Wow. This ain't some irish pub. Clean up a little, then come back to me.
zh: ~z~哇哦，这可不是爱尔兰酒吧。打扮得好看点再回来吧。

english: ~z~Sure, I guess in this economy we all got to lower our standards.
zh: ~z~行，看来以现在的经济状况，不得不降低标准了。

english: ~z~You know, Luis, I don't believe you. The only way I'll believe you're sorry is if I fucking tax you for it.
zh: ~z~知道吗，路易斯，我不信你了。能让我相信你是真心道歉的唯一方法是多收你点利息。

english: ~z~But I'm back now, Baby B. I'm b-b-b-back. And your life just got fun again.
zh: ~z~但我回来了，宝贝布鲁斯。我回回回回来了。你的日子又要丰富起来了。

english: ~z~That's bullshit, Lou! Fucking bullshit! The logistics were right there. My side of the operation was perfect.
zh: ~z~真是扯淡，卢！太他妈扯了！安排上毫无问题，我的执行也完美无缺。

english: ~z~You gonna show me that training of yours in action, Mori?
zh: ~z~今天这出你是想给我秀秀你的练家子是吗，莫里？

english: ~z~Funny for a guy with all those pecs, but you got the lats of a little girl. And man you need calf implants, look at you.
zh: ~z~说你逗是因为你胸肌大，背阔肌却像个小姑娘。小腿也去隆一下吧，你这人。

english: ~z~Mori don't worry about me, man. I'm fine. Okay? I'm going to be just fucking fine.
zh: ~z~用不着你担心我，哥们。我很好，好吗？我他妈一直都会好好的。

english: ~z~When I met you, I had a feeling you would drag me through some insane shit like this. You got that aura about you.
zh: ~z~当我一见到你的时候，我就觉得你会带我脱离像这样的苦海。你有这种特质。

english: ~z~No more cooperation, my friends. It's hostile takeover time, hand it over!
zh: ~z~我不是来合作的，我的朋友。今天强买强卖，交出来吧！

english: ~z~Look at you. You're lumpy. You're like - a- awful, like a big pale mess.
zh: ~z~看看你，一坨大块头。你这也太糟了，整个一废物。

english: ~z~"You're, you're"...Perfect? Yeah. Chiseled, tanned, handsome. I'm the dream ticket.

zh: ~z~我是知道，这就是问题所在。你什么时候回去念书？

zh: ~z~哦对，是不太坏，老兄。我们班多少人一辈子就在这儿了？

zh: ~z~哟，H，对不起，但计划还是赶不上变化。注意安全，好吗？

zh: ~z~好像是这样，兄弟。除了一个收了钱的护卫任务，我们暂时也没别的活了。

zh: ~z~行了兄弟。那会儿我还小，很傻逼。不过现在你们都有女人了吗？

english: ~z~I should never have invited you along, bro. You is too used to the good life to get shit done now days.
zh: ~z~我就不该叫你来的，兄弟。你现在小日子过习惯了，干不了粗活了。

english: ~z~L, man, here you go. Take that bitch down. You was always the best shot.
zh: ~z~L，兄弟，拿好了，把她打下来。你一直是神枪手。

english: ~z~Sure am. Nice little girl by the name of Carmen Ortiz, lives out in So Bo.
zh: ~z~当然有。一个叫卡门･奥尔蒂斯的小美女，住在南波汉。

english: ~z~You gonna listen to me or what? You never going to get anywhere if you guys are the ones selling on the corner.
zh: ~z~你到底听不听我讲话？在路边派货是出不了头的。

english: ~z~How the fuck we gonna get rid of this thing? Check the NOOSE van, L. They might be something in there.
zh: ~z~这他妈要怎么打？看看NOOSE的车，L。里面说不定有武器。

english: ~z~Oh shit! You did, didn't you? I wouldn't go making no piss jokes, A.
zh: ~z~哦操！真尿了啊？我就不开这种尿裤子的玩笑了，A。

english: ~z~What the fuck, man? We was always meant to protect that dumb bastard.
zh: ~z~这他妈咋了，哥们？保护这傻子明明是我们的职责。

english: ~z~Shit, bro. I got these guys to the left. Henrique, go left, motherfucker.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟。左边来人了。恩里克，快来左边，妈了个逼的。

english: ~z~Yo L, we holding these guys. Get behind the car and take out the NOOSE guys on the roof.
zh: ~z~哟，L，我们拖住他们。你躲到车后对付房顶上的NOOSE。

english: ~z~This thing is holding us down, bro. Check that motherfucking NOOSE van. See if they got something can help.
zh: ~z~直升机在跑不了，兄弟。看看傻逼NOOSE的卡车，说不定有能用上的家伙。

english: ~z~but me and Rique are gonna need to do some serious work if we gonna maintain shit on these streets.
zh: ~z~但我和恩里克还想接着在道上混的话就得干几票大的。

english: ~z~Putting him to work on a corner don't seem much like protecting him to me man. I'm out.
zh: ~z~我不觉得让他去路边贩毒是保护他，哥们。我走了。

english: ~z~That all well and good, bro. But selling ain't our issue. It's getting hold of product.
zh: ~z~确实很有道理，兄弟。但销售不成问题，重点是找到货源。

english: ~z~You got to get behind that car and deal with those NOOSE boys on the roof, L. Me and H is holding here.
zh: ~z~你躲到车后面对付房顶上的NOOSE，L。我和H在这里拖延。

english: ~z~I'll do that, bro. You better lay low. Cops might want to ask you questions when they identify him.
zh: ~z~我去吧，兄弟。你低调点。条子查到他的身份后多半会来找你。

english: ~z~Thanks, bro. Me and Rique mighta been fucked up if you weren't around for us.
zh: ~z~谢了兄弟。要不是有你在，我跟恩里克可能就被抓了。

english: ~z~We ain't moving with that thing there. See if there's something we can take it out with in that NOOSE van.
zh: ~z~直升机在我们跑不掉的。看看NOOSE的卡车里面有没有能用的装备。

english: ~z~Luis bro, you want us to come downtown to lecture you on interior decoration?
zh: ~z~路易斯，兄弟，你要咱们去城里教你室内装修吗？

english: ~z~Thanks for the lecture, professor. I didn't know a two year stretch qualified you to teach Street Life 101.
zh: ~z~说得太好了，教授。没想到你进号子蹲了两年，出来都能教我们黑社会入门了。

english: ~z~Them guys on the roof is yours, L. Get behind the car and handle them. Me and Rique will hold position.
zh: ~z~房顶上的家伙你负责，L。躲到车后干了他们。我和恩里克守这边。

english: ~z~At least I didn't abandon him for some rich downtown assholes. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~至少我没为了城里的哪个阔佬就抛弃他。你滚吧。

english: ~z~What are you talking about? There's product all over the city. Just take it off motherfuckers.
zh: ~z~你说什么呢？城里最多的不就是货？找个冤大头就是了。

english: ~z~Look. As you say, I ain't an expert in this shit, but I do run a business.
zh: ~z~听着。如你所说，我不是道上的专家，但我确实在做生意。

english: ~z~Shit. Yeah. Ummm... we had this thing about a year ago. She kinda nasty, bro.
zh: ~z~操。对，呃...我们一年前认识的。她有点放荡，兄弟。

english: ~z~The Jingoism Act, that shit means they can pretty much read your thoughts now and get away with it.
zh: ~z~沙文主义法案，就是说他们想查你的信息就查你的信息。

english: ~z~Fuck! Rique, bro, pop test. What you do when you got cops behind you and a dead end in front?
zh: ~z~操！恩里克，兄弟，我考考你。后有追兵前无出路该怎么办？

english: ~z~We ain't getting out of here with her pinning us down like this. Take this and get her out the sky, shooter.
zh: ~z~被她这样咬着咱是跑不掉的。拿这个把她从天上打下来，射手。

english: ~z~I don't see why you guys are giving me shit. You was the ones who asked me to come along on this thing.
zh: ~z~你们没事找我麻烦干嘛？这次就是你把我拖下水的。

english: ~z~This don't look good, L. Can you take this and try to sink the chopper. I don't trust my aim.
zh: ~z~情况不太妙啊，L。你能拿这个把直升机打下来吗？我准头不大好。

english: ~z~Oh yeah sabes que, Now that you mention it, I could do with some dick sucking lessons.
zh: ~z~哦，是吗，你这么一说，我觉得是得跟你学学怎么口人。

english: ~z~Oh yeah. I forgot about that. What can I say man, I was the star pupil.
zh: ~z~是吗。我都快忘了。我能怎么办呢，我可是尖子生。

english: ~z~Yo Armando, you got to be careful of them phones, man. People are onto that shit.
zh: ~z~喂，阿曼多，以后打电话多长点心眼，哥们。政府都盯着的。

english: ~z~Thanks, bro. You know I hate to ask this now you all Johnny lawful and shit,
zh: ~z~谢了兄弟。你现在是守法公民，我也不太想拉你下水。

english: ~z~That wasn't good, bro. I thought we was gonna be rich after today.
zh: ~z~这可不好啊，兄弟。我还以为过了今天我们就发财了。

english: ~z~Move that car, you idiot. I got plans for that wall.
zh: ~z~到那辆车去，你个傻逼。对于那堵墙我有办法了。

english: ~z~Yo, man. I don't know. I could do with the money but you boys is clowns.
zh: ~z~哟，兄弟。我不知道。给钱我就肯帮，但你俩有点菜。

english: ~z~I pissed myself, did I? You the one who couldn't hold it in in Mrs. Lebowitz's class?
zh: ~z~我是尿了，怎么？在莱博维茨老师的课上没憋住的是谁来着？

english: ~z~~c~ Oh, de verdad? ~s~You getting paid for real? My guess is you getting chump change for some dangerous work.
zh: ~z~~c~哦，真的吗？~s~真会给你钱吗？我看多半是给你两块钱让你送死去的。

english: ~z~Right, but you take the money, right? You take the fucking money every time.
zh: ~z~是啊，但钱你都拿了，对吧？你他妈哪次拒绝了？

english: ~z~I'm nervous after last time, Luis. Can you look about to see we got no imminent danger?
zh: ~z~上次之后我就很紧张，路易斯。你能去确认一下周边不会有异样吗？

english: ~z~He always was a college fool. Kid loved the Vespucci scene more than us, didn't he?
zh: ~z~他一直是个书呆子。这逼比咱还怀念韦斯普奇的满园春色呢，不是吗？

english: ~z~Take care? You take care, son. Dealing drugs, people getting killed, nightclubs. You take care.
zh: ~z~保重？你才该保重，儿子。倒腾毒品，到处杀人，开夜店。你自个保重。

english: ~z~Yo L, can you check out the boats for anything that seems funky?
zh: ~z~哟L，你去检查下船上有没有什么可疑物品好吗？

english: ~z~I got these cats. H, take Luis and watch the guys by the boat.
zh: ~z~我负责这些人。H，带上路易斯，盯着船旁边的人。

english: ~z~I believe it, bro. She was always a save the world, special needs helping type girl.
zh: ~z~我是信的，兄弟。她就是那种女菩萨，能普度众生的。

english: ~z~You're being paid a fraction of what the shit is worth, but you taking all the risk by escorting it across the city.
zh: ~z~货款只给你们一个零头，路上的风险全让你们担着。

english: ~z~I mean, I know I made mistakes, but things are better now. I mean, how many times we gotta go over this?
zh: ~z~以前我的确犯过错，但现在情况好多了。这件事你想让我说多少次？

english: ~z~That gonna be some unruly shit, bro. We need us another set of eyes.
zh: ~z~可能会出什么幺蛾子，兄弟。我们得多找点帮手。

english: ~z~Yeah, bro. Or a serious amount of heat if some stickup guys hear what's going down.
zh: ~z~是啊，兄弟。也可能被收到消息的强盗半路截胡。

english: ~z~Fool couldn't even spell SAT, let alone GED, I doubt he can even spell ABC.
zh: ~z~但这蠢逼一不识SAT，二不认GED，估计都不会写ABC。

english: ~z~I mean you a fuckin' Dominican. All Dominican mommas ride their hijos like that. You think me and Rique don't get shit too?
zh: ~z~你他妈是多米尼加人啊。多米尼加人的妈都爱数落自家孩子。我和恩里克又不是没被数落过。

english: ~z~Aye dio, mami, perro que to, you always taking care of the down and outs.
zh: ~z~天哪，老妈，你太善良了，一直都在照顾这些落魄的人。

english: ~z~It would be a serious bad idea to show the law this shipment. We better lose them before we head there.
zh: ~z~带着执法大队卸货可不是个好主意。到之前最好甩了他们。

english: ~z~I guess there's nothing you can do for now, if you're so interested in being a drug dealer. But you got to try to get out of this petty hand to mouth shit.
zh: ~z~要是你们一条路走到黑，那确实没什么办法。可你俩不能一辈子靠这个吃饭啊。

english: ~z~Yeah well, apparently your boys and your real son got some work to do, so ladies,we gotta roll.
zh: ~z~行吧。现在你的孩子和亲儿子有正事要做，所以二位，该出发了。

english: ~z~We being paid to oversee the movement of a shipment, bro. Just got to get it back to the Heights and we get paid.
zh: ~z~有人雇我们去监督卸货，兄弟。把货运回高地就有钱拿了。

english: ~z~Mami, but you got it all wrong. I mean, it's not like that anymore. You know,
zh: ~z~老妈，你又误会了。我早不是那样了。你知道的，

english: ~z~Professor Lopez from the University of Downtown. Department of "I'm a expert in fucking everything".
zh: ~z~来自都市大学「没有人比我更懂XX学院」的洛佩兹教授。

english: ~z~Yo, whatever, bro. You guys want to keep running bids for that shit money, go for it.
zh: ~z~哟，爱咋咋，兄弟。想要为了这点臭钱坐牢的话，那请便。

english: ~z~Hanging with them trust fund bitches must have given him the taste for cash.
zh: ~z~天天跟信托基金的大小姐在一起让他尝到甜头了。

english: ~z~We get it back home and we going to be paid. This a mad success for us.
zh: ~z~把货送到，就可以拿钱了。这是咱们的大胜利啊。

english: ~z~Luis, I love you, bro. But you part time. Life up here keeps going when you off with them rich people.
zh: ~z~路易斯，我爱你，兄弟。但你不常在啊。你跟阔佬打交道的时候我们就不过日子了吗。

english: ~z~Successful? Shit bro, I know you slow but you can't have failed to notice them hoods trying to rip us off back there.
zh: ~z~成功？操，兄弟，我知道你人木，但有人来抢劫你总该知道吧。

english: ~z~Yeah I guess my shooting was more important than my man management skills on this "business trip".
zh: ~z~今天出的这趟差，我的枪法比管人的经验还要重要。

english: ~z~You gonna have to start thinking for yourself, man. I'll call you soon.
zh: ~z~你得开始自己思考了，哥们。我晚点给你打电话。

english: ~z~You everyone's bitch! I'm sorry, Henrique, but you ain't got shit.
zh: ~z~谁都把你当狗使！我很抱歉，恩里克，但你真不是什么人物。

english: ~z~Luis, bro, what the fuck? They some important party downtown that you forgot about? You have to run off?
zh: ~z~路易斯，兄弟，搞什么鬼？赶着去城里的哪个大派对吗？非得现在跑去？

english: ~z~This ain't real money. Take how much you get paid for this and divide it by how many bodies you had to drop back there.
zh: ~z~这钱没有用。数数你到手多少钱，除上刚才杀掉的人数。

english: ~z~Nah, bro. You don't need to work this hard. It's just the only way you know about.
zh: ~z~不，兄弟。没必要这么拼。只是你们不知道能干别的而已。

english: ~z~This may be shit, but at least we work for ourselves. We ain't someone's bitch.
zh: ~z~可能是不太好，但至少我们是为自己工作，不是给谁当狗。

english: ~z~You get involved in making drug deals, bad luck ain't never far, bro. We all know that.
zh: ~z~只要跟贩毒沾上边，就别想不背了，兄弟。大家都懂的。

english: ~z~Mira, all I'm saying is you had to take down a lot of people to earn not very much money. Ain't a good business model, man.
zh: ~z~你看，我只是想说你被迫杀掉这么多人，才赚这么点钱。这买卖划不来，哥们。

english: ~z~We can't just leave Henrique behind. Dumb as he is, he's useful.
zh: ~z~咱不能把恩里克落下。虽然他傻，但他还是有用的。

english: ~z~Bet you don't get action like this with them downtown rich kids.
zh: ~z~估计跟城里的富家子弟处一起见不到这种场面吧。

english: ~z~We don't all got what you got, L. I ain't got your looks. I ain't got your brains.
zh: ~z~我们没有你的条件，L。我没你那么帅，没你那么聪明。

english: ~z~Something like that. Look, I'll call you soon, okay. Later on.
zh: ~z~差不多吧。听着，我晚点给你电话，好吗？再见了。

english: ~z~Fuck, bro. At least we ain't there when the police is showing up. That's the one consolation I can think of.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟。至少我们没被警察抓到现行，让我还算欣慰。

english: ~z~We need to get this stuff back to the Heights. We earned it, yo. Follow me in that car.
zh: ~z~咱得把货送回高地。赚到了，哟。开那辆车跟我走吧。

english: ~z~What am I gonna do, man? Armando was always the guy to tell me what to do.
zh: ~z~我该咋办，哥们？阿曼多一直都是教我该怎么做的人。

english: ~z~Fucked up? What you talking about, bro? That was some of the most successful shit I participated in.
zh: ~z~砸了？你说啥呢，兄弟？这是我干过最成功的事情之一。

english: ~z~L, Rique, go in that car. I'll take this one. We need to get this shit outta here.
zh: ~z~L，恩里克，上那辆车。我开这辆。咱们得把货带出去。

english: ~z~I wasn't meant to be doing anything. I was doing you a favor. See you soon, bro.
zh: ~z~本来我根本不用来这儿，我只是来帮你个忙。再见了，兄弟。

english: ~z~"A guy got to go"? Henrique was family, bro. I'll see you round.
zh: ~z~「人总有一死」？恩里克是我们的家人啊，兄弟。再见了。

english: ~z~It never gonna be as good as your mom's cooking, L. But let's go get something to eat.
zh: ~z~虽然比不上你妈做的饭菜，L，但咱们还是下个馆子吧。

english: ~z~There a Burger Shot near here, ain't there? Unless you too good for that shit now.
zh: ~z~附近是不是有家吃得饱汉堡来着？你不会已经高贵到不吃这些垃圾了吧。

english: ~z~You part time motherfucker. I can round up Rique for you. I think he probably forgot who you are though.
zh: ~z~这可是位稀客啊。我可以帮你叫上恩里克。不过他可能都不认识你了。

english: ~z~Me and H had a bet on whether you'd show. Thanks, L. You just made me some money.
zh: ~z~我和H赌了你到底会不会来。谢了L，你让我赢钱了。

english: ~z~Okay, bro. H certainly ain't busy and I could postpone some shit. Come pick us up.
zh: ~z~好的，兄弟。H肯定闲着，我也能排出时间。来接咱们吧。

english: ~z~Armando, what's up? You got some shit in that van of yours? I need to restock.
zh: ~z~阿曼多，你好吗？你车里有家伙吗？我要补点货。

english: ~z~Rique could do with some L time, bro. Let's take him out.
zh: ~z~恩里克想和L玩一会儿，兄弟。咱们带他出去吧。

english: ~z~I spent enough on gas. I ain't giving you shit as well. Sorry, bro.
zh: ~z~油钱已经是倒贴了，不可能连枪都白送。对不起，兄弟。

english: ~z~I should stop selling drugs, bro. Getting these guns is so much easier.
zh: ~z~我还贩什么毒啊，兄弟。倒卖军火不是比贩毒赚钱。

english: ~z~Oye, I'd love to hang with you and H, but the schedule don't permit.
zh: ~z~喂，我很想跟你和H一起出去，但实在排不出时间啊。

english: ~z~Mira bro. I need something that's gonna help me win a fight. Can you come by in your van?
zh: ~z~听着兄弟，我需要能让我打胜仗的东西。你能开那辆车过来吗？

english: ~z~We get the point. You a busy motherfucker, L. Can't even see out darts with your friends.
zh: ~z~我们懂了。你丫是个大忙人，L，陪朋友玩飞镖都要早退。

english: ~z~Show H some of that toto at Honkers. It been a time for his starved ass.
zh: ~z~带H看点Honkers俱乐部的逼吧。他有段时间没去过了。

english: ~z~Diablo, loco, you always call when I'm the busiest. Can we do this another time?
zh: ~z~你有病吧，我哪天没空你哪天约我。改天好不好？

english: ~z~This a blessing in disguise, L. Now I can put H back to work and make some paper out the dumb motherfucker.
zh: ~z~那我是因祸得福了，L。现在我可以叫H回去干活，接着压榨那个傻子的劳动力了。

english: ~z~L. We see your fucking mom more than we see you. Shit is fucked up. Can you get your head out the homo's ass to chill with us a minute?
zh: ~z~L，我们见到你妈的次数比见到你还多。能不能把你的头从基佬的屁眼里拿出来，陪我们出去逛逛？

english: ~z~Always were okay at bowling, L. Must be all them shit dates you go on.
zh: ~z~你还是这么强，L。一定是跟别人约会练出来的吧。

english: ~z~Much as I want to help a friend in need, they's more pressing things need my attention. Might be some room in the calendar later on if you still in need.
zh: ~z~我很想帮求助于我的朋友，但还有更重要的事需要我关注。过段时间我可能有空，到时候你再问我吧。

english: ~z~This ain't a good time for me, L. You got to get your weapons somewhere else. If you call me later shit might have changed though.
zh: ~z~我这时间不太行，L。你得去别的地方弄武器了。过会儿再问的话我可能会有空。

english: ~z~Downtown starting to lose its sparkle, eh? Alright, come pick up your old friends in the next two.
zh: ~z~城里人光芒不再了，嗯？好吧，两小时内来接你的老朋友吧。

english: ~z~If it ain't Northwood's prodigal son. Alright, we'll welcome you back into the fold. You better show in the next two hours though.
zh: ~z~这不是北伍德的回头浪子嘛。好了，欢迎你回归队伍。不过你最好两小时内到。

english: ~z~Bro, you can't be calling here at this hour. Conyo. Call me later.
zh: ~z~兄弟，你别挑这种时候打过来啊，妈的。晚点再打。

english: ~z~Funny you should call. There's a big hole in me and Rique's schedule. Come pick us up in the next two.
zh: ~z~真会挑时候。我和恩里克的日程刚好空着个大洞。两小时内来接我们吧。

english: ~z~Oh! Now he calls, does he? We can hang out with you, but only 'cause it's such a rare fuckin' treat. Scoop us in the next two.
zh: ~z~终于来电话了，好家伙。我们可以出来陪你，不过是因为你难得找我们出来。两小时内来接咱们吧。

english: ~z~Sorry, L. You might have to buy from the competition. I'm otherwise occupied. Maybe later though.
zh: ~z~对不起，L。你得去找我的竞争对手买了，我实在忙不过来。晚点再找我吧。

english: ~z~H was looking forward to this. It like you cancelling Christmas, motherfucker.
zh: ~z~H还等着来嗨呢。你这么搞就像把他杀了一样，你个狗逼。

english: ~z~There that pub with the dart board we could go to. Long as H don't take his eye out.
zh: ~z~有家酒吧里有飞镖靶子，可以去玩一下。不过得确保H不会扎到自己的眼睛。

english: ~z~I tell you it's a rush driving round with this shit. You just daring people to fuck with you.
zh: ~z~跟你讲，车里装着这些到处跑很危险的。时刻都得当心被盯上。

zh: ~z~等下，哥们，我们可是相当重要的人。放我们进去，兄弟！

english: ~z~The exchange is on Charge Island. They're coming by land, we're on the water.
zh: ~z~人质交易定在查奇岛进行。他们走陆路，我们走水路。

english: ~z~Mission aborted. You think they'll kill Gracie when we don't show?
zh: ~z~任务中止。要是我们没到场，他们会不会杀了格雷西？

english: ~z~and we wouldn't be doing this if old man Ancelotti hadn't "made me an offer I couldn't refuse".
zh: ~z~要不是安切洛蒂头子给了我一个「无法拒绝的提议」，我才不干。

english: ~z~Sponsor, bodyguard, business advisor, fucking guru. I'm here to keep you out of trouble, Tony. Just listen to me, yo.
zh: ~z~赞助商、保镖、商业顾问、指导。我需要帮你减少麻烦，托尼。听我的吧。

english: ~z~You got Gracie back safe and sound, Tone. I hope she was worth 2 mil'.
zh: ~z~你把格雷西完完整整地带回来了，托尼。希望她对得起两百万。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, those kidnapping bitches don't deserve peaceful. Fuck 'em, T.
zh: ~z~是吗，这些天杀的绑匪不配和平。操他妈的，T。

english: ~z~We need to get over to Charge Island, Luis. They're expecting us to dock there.
zh: ~z~我们要去查奇岛，路易斯。他们要求在那里交易。

english: ~z~I should have given her some pills. But, oops, Haha! I took 'em all.
zh: ~z~我应该给她嗑点药的。但是呢，哈哈！我全嗑完了。

english: ~z~You don't know half what we been through for you, bitch, so shut the fuck up.
zh: ~z~你压根就不知道我们为你付出了多少，贱逼。闭嘴吧你。

english: ~z~She had a boating accident. Make sure her old man understands that. I don't want to see her again.
zh: ~z~她在船上撞到了，你让他爹理解一下。我不想再看见她了。

english: ~z~but they'll be lucky if they can get a chance before I die of a heart attack.
zh: ~z~不过能在我犯心脏病断气之前杀了我就算他们走运。

english: ~z~I don't care what he has to say. We paid for it fair. His beef's with the chef.
zh: ~z~我才不管他的想法。我们付了钱的，算账找那厨子。

english: ~z~What the fuck have we got to do with Gracie? Shouldn't her old man be handling this?
zh: ~z~我们跟格雷西又有什么关系？这不是她老爹的事吗？

english: ~z~But I don't want you to get a big head. I don't want you to go change; become a mega star, go to Vinewood, write a blog.
zh: ~z~但我不希望你发飘，不想看到你变样：变成大明星，去好麦坞，写博客啥的。

english: ~z~The Heights is my home man. Always will be. Nothing's worth shit if I can't go back there.
zh: ~z~高地就是我家，永远的家。要是回不去，一切都没有意义。

english: ~z~Don't make me, man. You know you just gonna slow me down, bro, and kill us both. I want at least one of us to survive.
zh: ~z~别逼我，哥们。你也知道自己是拖油瓶，只会害死我们。我俩至少得活一个。

english: ~z~I nearly had him, T. I nearly had him. He's gone back to fucking Russia now!
zh: ~z~差点就成功了，T，就差那么一点。还是给他跑回俄罗斯了！

english: ~z~Maybe you turned your back on where you was from when you was a kid, but that ain't something I can really do.
zh: ~z~你是从小就抛下老家走进都市了，但这事我干不出来。

english: ~z~You think he will forget about you? You and all your friends are dead.
zh: ~z~你以为他会一走了之吗？你和你的朋友都死定了。

english: ~z~This is our last chance, ain't it, Lou? We've got to take down Bulgarin and all his people.
zh: ~z~这次是背水一战了，对吧，卢？必须要干掉布尔加林和他的手下。

english: ~z~Oh, yes, silly me. Silly fucking me...huh?
zh: ~z~哦，是，我不好，呵呵呵呵。全是我的错...哼？

english: ~z~We took on this town and we won. We took on this place and we gave it the fucking finger.
zh: ~z~我们拿下了自由城，我们赢了。拿下了这座城市，狠狠地鄙视了所有人。

english: ~z~Look, ok, I'm sorry I thought about killing you. I really am. But if you keep up with the bullshit, I might have to kill you for real.
zh: ~z~听我说，好吗，很抱歉我有想过杀了你，对不起。只是你再这样发疯，我很难不杀了你。

english: ~z~Tell people Timur and Mr. Ray have serious package now. We own H trade in Liberty.
zh: ~z~传出去，蒂穆尔和雷先生手头有大量货。自由城的海洛因归我们管了。

english: ~z~One of my less salubrious associates told me Bulgarin was in on this H deal at Fun Land on Firefly.
zh: ~z~狐朋狗友跟我说布尔加林在萤火虫的游乐园交易海洛因。

english: ~z~There ain't nothing you can do, Yusuf. If this crazy Russian fuck manages to leave the country, it's over for me and Tone.
zh: ~z~你帮不到我了，尤瑟夫。万一被那个疯毛子跑出美国，我和托尼就完蛋了。

english: ~z~Go somewhere no one's gonna find you. Maybe back to Dukes? Ain't nobody gonna look for you there.
zh: ~z~去别人找不到你的地方。公爵区怎么样？没人会去那儿找你。

english: ~z~But I didn't. And now it's you and me, against the world. Okay?
zh: ~z~但我还是没下手。现在，是你和我对抗全世界，好吧？

english: ~z~Word is they're taking on a big heroin shipment at Fun Land on Firefly Island.
zh: ~z~听说他们在萤火虫岛的游乐园接收了一大批海洛因。

english: ~z~Okay, cool. Hit up, like, err, that Monoglobe monument thing in Meadows Park. Hang out for a few hours.
zh: ~z~好，可以。你就去草地公园的巨型地球仪那里吧。在那儿等几个小时。

english: ~z~Stop whatever is going on back there. I'm trying to fly plane.
zh: ~z~别管是什么，赶紧把后面解决了，飞机要起飞了。

english: ~z~It's Bulgarin or us. Or you can shoot us both, and make his life easy for him.
zh: ~z~布尔加林死了，我们活。不然你现在开两枪，帮他省点事。

english: ~z~I heard you were here, man. Yusuf's here to save the day. Again!
zh: ~z~听说你在这儿，哥们。尤瑟夫「又」来拯救世界啦！

english: ~z~We'll leave town and start all over. New clubs, someplace else. If I can do it, you can too.
zh: ~z~离开自由城，重新开始。新的夜店，换个地方。我能做到，你也能。

english: ~z~Dukes? Alright, I'll wait for you in Middle Park by that silly Monoglobe. You are gonna make it, L. I know it.
zh: ~z~公爵区？好吧，我在草地公园的巨蠢地球仪那儿等你。~n~你能做到的，L。我知道的。

english: ~z~Luis, bro, do not fear, Yusuf's here. I found you, motherfucker.
zh: ~z~路易斯，哥们，别害怕，尤瑟夫来了。找到你了，妈个逼的。

english: ~z~And if your brains ain't working right, then I'll make the decision for us, okay?
zh: ~z~要是你脑子转不过来，那就由我来做决定，好吗？

english: ~z~Now we own junk trade in Liberty. Anyone need package, they must deal with us.
zh: ~z~城里的货全被我们拿下了。谁想要货，只能跟我们交易。

english: ~z~Yusuf's fucking here! A bad ass A-rab with a mechanical camel.
zh: ~z~尤瑟夫闪亮登场！阿拉伯恶霸骑着机械骆驼来啦！

english: ~z~I'm sorry, T. I couldn't take it. Bulgarin can keep his shipment. We're finished.
zh: ~z~抱歉了，T。我搞不定。布尔加林的货还在。我们完蛋了。

english: ~z~This is over. It's over. I just want to go some place far away from here and quietly wait to die.
zh: ~z~已经完了，全完了。我只想离自由城越远越好，找个地方等死。

english: ~z~He the last one. I'm giving up on it. I'm out. Sorry, T. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~他是最后一个。我不干了，我退出。抱歉，T，再见。

english: ~z~Yeah, I know. It's a real problem with me. You know? I wish I was more like you - subtle, shy, retiring.
zh: ~z~确实，我这人就这毛病，真的。我挺想像你这样的，内敛、含蓄、羞怯。

english: ~z~dreaming of the world. Wondering what it was like that at that place over there, or that little island over there.
zh: ~z~幻想着世界，想象着这个地方长啥样，那个岛长啥样。

english: ~z~So we're going into exile together. Okay Lou, here's to the open road.
zh: ~z~那我们亡命天涯吧。好了，卢，庆祝我们光明的未来吧。

english: ~z~I ran away from there when I was a kid and I swore blind I'd never go back, apart from to catch a plane.
zh: ~z~年轻的时候我就离开那儿了。不赶飞机绝对不会回到那里，我发过毒誓的。

english: ~z~We gonna take out their income stream and then we gonna take them out. End this bullshit.
zh: ~z~先断掉他的生财之道，然后再赶尽杀绝。做个了断。

english: ~z~The problem ain't gone away, Tony. He's gonna come right back at us. We're still fucked, bro. I'll talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~麻烦还没完，托尼。他会回来找我们的，情况还是那样，兄弟。晚点再聊。

english: ~z~You're a fucking joke, man. All the money in the world and you can't get shit done.
zh: ~z~你真他妈搞笑，哥们。给你全世界的钱都办不成事。

english: ~z~Fuck the people. Fuck them all! Whip out your dick and piss all over them.
zh: ~z~什么人不人的，都滚犊子！掏出你的大屌，滋他们一脸。

english: ~z~Fuck Ray Bulgarin, fuck the mob, fuck the loan sharks, fuck the angry triads, the moaning celebrities, fuck everybody, Lou.
zh: ~z~什么高利贷，什么三合会，什么名流，全都滚犊子，卢。

english: ~z~If I survive this shit, I'll find you. If I don't show, then I'm gone.
zh: ~z~万一活下来了，我来找你。没来的话，就是死了。

english: ~z~It's not like I haven't been in my share of fire fights, Lou. By now, I'm a seasoned veteran by anyone's fucking standards!
zh: ~z~我又不是没见过枪战，卢。现在，怎么说我也算是身经百战的老兵了！

english: ~z~Stay away, Yusuf. You don't need to get involved with this. I'll call you if I make it out.
zh: ~z~不用了，尤瑟夫。别掺和进来。完事了我打电话给你。

english: ~z~You! Over there! You fuck with Luis Lopez you get one angry fucking Arab on your ass!
zh: ~z~你！敢跟路易斯･洛佩兹对着干，就等着被阿拉伯暴脾气干烂吧！

english: ~z~No, you fuck off, Tony. I didn't kill you. I wanted to. Why? Because you've become a useless junkie fuck, that's why.
zh: ~z~你才该滚出去，托尼。我没下手，只是有想过。为什么？因为你现在就是个吸毒废物，死了算了。

english: ~z~Tony, bro, I love you, but I should handle this alone. I don't want you getting yourself killed.
zh: ~z~托尼，好兄弟，我爱你，但这事得我自己处理。我可不想害死你。

english: ~z~I know that, bro, but there's no point in you coming in there. You can go off and die alone on some beach somewhere.
zh: ~z~我知道，兄弟。但是你来没有意义啊。你走吧，找个海滩孤独终老吧。

english: ~z~You dumb bastard trying to screw with Luis Lopez! Bring it on, bitches!
zh: ~z~哪个傻逼还敢跟路易斯･洛佩兹对着干！放马过来吧，臭逼！

english: ~z~The Russian mob want me dead, my best friend just contemplated murdering me, the mob are on my case,
zh: ~z~老毛子要我命，最好的朋友拿枪指着我，黑帮找我的麻烦，

english: ~z~I got to get down the Dukes Expressway without any number of Russian assassins taking me down, or we're done.
zh: ~z~我得活着通过公爵区高速，不能被毛子杀手干掉，否则就完了。

english: ~z~You did it. You saved my life, you saved the business. You fucking did it.
zh: ~z~你做到了。救了我的命，挽救了生意。你他妈做到了。

english: ~z~One nightclub catering to the rich mindless crowd in a city where the rich mindless crowd are suddenly poor and mindless.
zh: ~z~一家店面向有钱无脑的庸人，而城里有钱无脑的庸人随时会没钱没脑。

english: ~z~That the queen's car? You ain't gonna be his favorite piece of ass, bro.
zh: ~z~这是夜店女王的车？你肯定不是他最好的那个基友，兄弟。

english: ~z~they wanna stay up all night talking bullshit to morons because they enjoy it"
zh: ~z~只要有白痴扎堆听他们吹逼到天亮，他们就高兴了。

english: ~z~Sometimes I wonder if you brought me on as a partner just to share the blame when the IRS comes knocking.
zh: ~z~有时候我都怀疑，你找我当合伙人是为了在国税局敲门的时候陪你背锅。

english: ~z~You see what I mean, L? They don't even have dishes at Burger Shot.
zh: ~z~这下懂我意思了没，L？吃得饱汉堡甚至连碗都没有。

english: ~z~we're not spics, or guidos, or fags - we're proud Americans!
zh: ~z~我们不是西班牙佬，不是意大利佬，也不是死基佬——我们是骄傲的美国人！

english: ~z~IQ don't mean nothing, man. You guys are better than this. I don't want any of us to go away again.
zh: ~z~智商不能代表什么，伙计。你们没必要自甘堕落。我不想我们中再有人坐牢了。

english: ~z~I knew that club of yours was bullshit. You gonna take us back to the Heights or what?
zh: ~z~我就知道你们的夜店是坨屎。你要送我们回高地那边吗？

english: ~z~Anyway, uh- listen, I'm coming over. Okay? So wake up. You hear me? Wake up.
zh: ~z~总之，呃，听着，我过来了，好吗？该醒了。听见了吗？醒醒。

english: ~z~That's what you say, T. Pero, I'm kind of suspicious. Maybe witnessing that robbery made me paranoid,
zh: ~z~这能是真心话，T？我现在有点多疑。目击抢劫或许让我有被害妄想了，

english: ~z~Hey, Tony it's me. Yeah, there was a problem at the bank. Place got robbed.
zh: ~z~嘿，托尼，是我。是，银行里出了点问题。那地方刚才被抢了。

english: ~z~they must really really want to substitute my inadequacies with their money because, after all,
zh: ~z~他们肯定非常非常地愿意，慷慨解囊来资助我，因为说到底，

english: ~z~I was investing in your industry and acumen. Don't look for anything sinister here.
zh: ~z~我只是看中了你的勤奋和敏锐，没别的不良动机。

english: ~z~I don't know anything about it, but take care of it, Luis. No nonsense.
zh: ~z~什么都不知道，但请好好处理，路易斯。别胡闹了。

english: ~z~and every half-wit, part time hood in the city thinking, "I know, let's put the squeeze on the club owners...
zh: ~z~那些智障、半吊子的混混都想着「有了，干脆压榨夜店老板吧...」

english: ~z~You sound like five-o. Shit. You think Henrique could get a job at Burger Shot?
zh: ~z~你丫是条子吗。妈的。你觉得恩里克会被吃得饱聘用吗？

english: ~z~when the gay and decadent crowd suddenly think decadence means buying outrageous new throw cushions
zh: ~z~而纸醉金迷的基佬突然觉得，纸醉金迷需要的是买新得要命的抱枕，

english: ~z~Ancelotti goons I borrowed money from way back...never mind.
zh: ~z~安切洛蒂的打手，我很久之前问他们借过钱...别管了。

english: ~z~He's paranoid no one will buy his next CD if they know he'd rather be singing cabaret than rapping.
zh: ~z~他就怕没人买他的新CD，不想被人知道他更愿意唱卡巴莱而不是搞说唱。

english: ~z~I'm one hundred percent legitimate, Luis. You know me. Total transparency.
zh: ~z~我可是实打实的守法公民，路易斯。你了解我的。一清二白。

english: ~z~You ain't no postman, Loco, you're a pusher. All those hours.
zh: ~z~你又不是邮差，疯子，你是个毒贩子。有这个时间，

english: ~z~I'm told that one of your "friends" is causing trouble out front. Can you go help Dessie?
zh: ~z~听说你的「朋友」在门口闹事。你能不能去帮帮德西？

english: ~z~Yeah, we have a no guido policy at the club; here I ain't so sure.
zh: ~z~对，夜店那边是意大利佬勿入，这边就不确定了。

english: ~z~I took a bid for you once, man. I ain't going back there. You think I put in all this work to go back inside?
zh: ~z~我替你们进去过一次了，伙计，才不要再回去。你以为我这么努力是为了回去坐牢？

english: ~z~Hello. Hey mami, como esta? Yeah, I'm sorry, yeah- no, I was working late at the club. Yeah.
zh: ~z~你好。嘿，老妈，近况如何？是，我很抱歉，对-不，我只是在夜店工作到很晚。是。

english: ~z~There ain't another job in the city for this dumb bastard to do; hourly wage considered, and all.
zh: ~z~城里再找不出这种白痴弱智能做的了，连时薪制的都没有。

english: ~z~Mami, don't be like that. Okay? I'll come home soon. Look, I got to go. Okay, bye.
zh: ~z~老妈，别这样。好吗？我最近会回趟家的。那个，我得挂了。好的，再见。

english: ~z~Your connections, man, we'll have the whole city on our gear.
zh: ~z~有你的人脉，兄弟，整座城市都是我们的囊中之物。

english: ~z~Jesus, Dessie. Who would have thought running the door here was such a dangerous gig.
zh: ~z~妈呀，德西。谁能想到在这看门是这么危险的活。

english: ~z~I don't know - I think the little people who live in his head, the ones stuck in 1955?
zh: ~z~不知道，可能是他脑子里住着的小人吧？现在还活在1955年。

english: ~z~Don't tell me that sugar daddy of yours woulda been interested in the scrawny fucker that went away?
zh: ~z~别跟我说你干爹会喜欢进去前那种皮包骨头的细竹竿？

english: ~z~I never thought about being grateful to you for signing me up to the "fight off hairy ass rapists day and night" exercise plan.
zh: ~z~我还真没为被你们送进「日夜打退多毛傻逼鸡奸犯」的健身课说过谢谢。

english: ~z~Forty-five years old and I get my kicks doing blow with seventeen year old kids whose only claim to fame
zh: ~z~都45岁了，还跟17岁的小孩口到爽翻天，然而他们的逼

english: ~z~Blah. Blah. Blah. Another time, Troy. We'll be at Maisonette.
zh: ~z~得了得了得了。下次再说，特洛伊。我们要去豪宅了。

english: ~z~Shit, L. You gave it to them! I knew this downtown bullshit would get to you.
zh: ~z~妈的，L。你屈服于他们了！我就知道市中心的狗屁会影响你。

english: ~z~All that money on helicopter lessons and you don't even know how to drive? Great.
zh: ~z~花了那么多钱学直升机，结果你连车都不会开？真好。

english: ~z~You know me, Tone. Don't ask, don't tell. Military grade.
zh: ~z~你了解我的，托尼。不会问，不用说。军规级的。

english: ~z~The nightclub business is going to shit. Forget the banks, we're the ones who needed a bailout.
zh: ~z~夜店生意一团糟。别救银行了，我们才需要政府拨款。

english: ~z~What's wrong with you, back on the roids? We got a business to run, you idiot Luis.
zh: ~z~你咋回事，又开始用类固醇了？我们有生意要做，白痴路易斯。

english: ~z~Yeah, he said he loves you, but he can't handle working the door of a gay club anymore. Says people are laughing at him.
zh: ~z~嗯，他说他爱你，但他不想给男同夜店看门了。说是有人笑话他。

english: ~z~Saw that bank robbery on the news. Could have been an opportunity for some positive PR.
zh: ~z~我在新闻上看到银行劫案了。本来你可以搞点正面公关的。

english: ~z~If them Ivy League motherfuckers can't find work, what you think Rique is meant to do?
zh: ~z~如果连名校毕业的傻逼玩意都找不到工作，你觉得恩里克能干什么？

english: ~z~Hey, we're in debt to the kid and his uncle and he's got the ear of one of the most powerful families in the city.
zh: ~z~喂，我们欠这个小鬼和他叔叔钱，而他在城里的五大家族之一里也说得上话。

english: ~z~Well we're not heading out for dim sum. Rocco's asked us to talk to someone.
zh: ~z~其实不是去吃点心的。罗科让我们去找某人谈谈。

english: ~z~Hey, something came up, T. That's it. I'll stop by soon, okay?
zh: ~z~嘿，突然有急事，T。就是这样。我很快会来一趟，好吗？

english: ~z~Ha! That's right, I forgot. You little yellow people are commies too, huh?
zh: ~z~哈！还有这茬，我都忘了。你们这帮小黄人还是共党，嗯？

zh: ~z~操你妈的，路易斯，真以为自己牛逼是吧，你他妈个基佬。

english: ~z~the last thing we need to be doing is further enhancing this egomaniac piece of shit's opinion of himself.
zh: ~z~最不需要做的就是让这个自大狂觉得自己是个人物。

english: ~z~T, chill out. It was an accident. We'll explain it and everything'll be cool. I'll call you soon.
zh: ~z~T，冷静点。是一场意外。我们跟他解释，不会有事的。晚点找你。

english: ~z~Sorry Gracie, you ain't my type, so can you let me be a "limpdick" in peace?
zh: ~z~抱歉，格雷西，你不是我的菜，所以能让我安安静静地当个萎男吗。

english: ~z~You think I like going to Alderney? Even us kids from Dukes look down on fucking Alderney.
zh: ~z~你以为我喜欢去奥尔德尼吗？就连公爵区出身的小鬼都他妈看不上那里。

english: ~z~Because I want to be married, man. You know? I want to have a nice life.
zh: ~z~我想结婚了，哥们。知道吗？我想过小日子去了。

english: ~z~This is something we don't need right now. Ughh, if no one comes to our summer party in the Carraways...
zh: ~z~但我们现在不能被黑屁。啊，要是没人参加我们在卡拉韦斯的夏日派对...

english: ~z~I could do with some comforting so gimme a call soon. Promise, okay.
zh: ~z~我需要有人安慰，晚点给我打电话吧。说到做到，好吗？

english: ~z~Hey Troy... Hey, how's business? Luis, come on, let's go.
zh: ~z~嘿，特洛伊...嘿，生意怎样？路易斯，快，咱们走。

english: ~z~Thanks, Luis. Call me when you've emailed that dreadful blogger.
zh: ~z~谢了，路易斯。给那死妈博主发完邮件就联系我。

english: ~z~He's got a hard-on for us and it ain't gonna go away. He'll bring heat and that'll mean license trouble.
zh: ~z~他跟我们杠上了，还赖着不走。事情一闹大，我们的经营执照就难保了。

english: ~z~There's a big Celebinator shaped mess somewhere, T. He ain't gonna be blogging no more.
zh: ~z~他应该在哪里摔成一摊了，T。肯定是发不了博客了。

english: ~z~The Derriere launch? Maisonette's fifth birthday? You left me off the list, it was a deliberate snub.
zh: ~z~记得Derriere的开业典礼吗？还有9号豪宅的五周年庆？你们没邀请我，存心冷落我是吧！

english: ~z~Where'd you go, L? I thought we were taking our friend on a guided tour of the city?
zh: ~z~你去哪儿了，L？不是说好要带朋友城市观光吗？

english: ~z~Get in, Lou. Don't worry, I didn't forget about the vertigo, I got you a chute.
zh: ~z~上来吧，卢。别担心，知道你恐高，给你拿了降落伞。

english: ~z~I never want to blog ever again. I fucking hate the internet!
zh: ~z~我这辈子都不写博客了。互联网你他妈毁了多少人！

english: ~z~You nearly missed the fun, L. Come on board, grab your chute. He's so fucking paranoid, this one.
zh: ~z~你差点就赶不上了，L。快上来，拿好降落伞。看这家伙，总是这么多疑。

english: ~z~Where the fucking bubbly then? You can't tell me I'm on a helicopter tour and there's no fucking champagne.
zh: ~z~酒他妈在哪呢？别告诉我空中旅行没有香槟助兴吧？

english: ~z~Yo. Do you got, like, a real name? Or do I got to call you the whatsit?
zh: ~z~哟。你能说一下本名吗？还是说叫那什么者比较好？

english: ~z~All aboard, Lou! Here's that chute you wanted, you really gotta get over that fear of flying.
zh: ~z~都到齐了，卢！拿好你的降落伞，你啥时候能不恐高啊。

english: ~z~Leaving me off them lists, it was a declaration of war. So I fucking brought it.
zh: ~z~你们不邀请我，就是在对我宣战。所以我应战了。

english: ~z~Oh, you remember alright. Last year's Maisonette Summer party?
zh: ~z~肯定有印象的。记得去年9号豪宅的夏日派对吗？

english: ~z~He's an annoying little fuck, but I think we saw eye to eye by the end of it. He ain't gonna be giving us no smack talk no more.
zh: ~z~这逼崽子确实讨厌，但我们还是达成共识了。他不会再抹黑我们了。

english: ~z~I don't know what the coroner's gonna think went on, but we better lay low. Let's talk soon.
zh: ~z~不知道验尸官会怎么想，咱们最好先低调点。之后再联系。

english: ~z~This is a very grown up gesture of yours. I thought it'd be just tit for tat from here on in.
zh: ~z~你的处事很成熟啊。我还以为接下来就要报复我了。

english: ~z~So, it's time you asked what it's going to take to get me off your backs.
zh: ~z~那...轮到你们提问了，怎么做我才会放过你们。

english: ~z~Fair point, man. I guess we got to get better at scaring cats, not dropping them. See ya.
zh: ~z~也是，哥们。还是得学学怎么唬人，不是杀人。再见。

english: ~z~I was on the scene, Luis. Fuck it. I am the scene. Me! Moi!
zh: ~z~我当时在现场，路易斯。操了。我就是主角！我！我啊！

english: ~z~I see a blog about this, I am going to fucking kill you, bro. Don't think for a moment that I ain't.
zh: ~z~你敢发这件事，我他妈就杀了你，老兄。别以为我不敢。

english: ~z~Luis, have you met our charming new friend, the Celebinator?
zh: ~z~路易斯，你见过咱们迷人的新朋友，名人终结者吗？

english: ~z~It kind of looks like you had a little accident. Someone might post a picture of that online.
zh: ~z~－看来你出了点小意外。当心被人拍下来发到网上。

english: ~z~Let's show our friend a view of the city. Take us up above Happiness Island.
zh: ~z~带咱们的朋友观赏一下城市风光。飞到幸福岛上空去。

english: ~z~You ain't dead, man. You getting a second chance at life. You a fucking miracle.
zh: ~z~你没死，哥们。你得到了重新做人的机会。这他妈是奇迹。

english: ~z~I'd love to say this was mine, but I'm just borrowing it off a rich friend of mine, Mr. Yusuf Amir.
zh: ~z~很想说这是我的飞机，但这是问我的阔佬朋友借的，尤瑟夫･阿米尔先生。

english: ~z~Of course you want to take some of what the Celebinator's got, and bottle it, and put it on the fuckin' shelves and sell it.
zh: ~z~你肯定想问名人终结者要点什么，装进罐子，然后放到货架上出售。

english: ~z~Well maybe if you'd stuck around, you would have had some fun. Come see me soon, okay.
zh: ~z~要是一起来的话，乐子少不了你的。晚点见好吗？

english: ~z~Boring! I knew you sad old washed up cunts had forgotten how to party.
zh: ~z~没意思！就知道这俩下坡路上的老臭逼已经不会开派对了。

english: ~z~What you mean "tit for tat"? You just started insulting us on your website. We ain't done shit to you.
zh: ~z~你说「报复」是几个意思？你莫名其妙就在网站上喷我们，我们又没怎么你。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, bro. I couldn't stand being around that guy.
zh: ~z~对不起，兄弟。但我是真的受不了跟这人坐一起。

english: ~z~You know what, I don't think you ever seen Liberty City like this.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，我看你肯定没以这个角度欣赏过自由城。

english: ~z~The head of the LTA is out at Francis International in his private jet.
zh: ~z~交管局局长在弗朗西斯国际机场，乘的是私人飞机。

english: ~z~Only when you want a plane to crash does it stay in the air. Figures. I'll tell him Lou... and thanks.
zh: ~z~想让飞机坠毁了，它倒平安无事。太对了。我会告诉他的，卢...多谢。

english: ~z~Rocco's gone nuts. He's gonna burn the clubs down for insurance. He's gonna fucking kill us.
zh: ~z~罗科气疯了。他打算把夜店烧了骗保。他会整死我们的。

english: ~z~Explosives? Explosives?! What's wrong with you, man? You run a nightclub, not a terror cell.
zh: ~z~炸弹？炸弹？！你疯了吧，老兄？你是开夜店的，不是恐怖分子。

english: ~z~The Transport Workers guy is driving an out of service subway train through North Holland.
zh: ~z~运输工会的人开着一辆未运营的地铁通过北荷兰。

english: ~z~Where's Tony? Where's Tony? What's wrong with, "Hi Evan, you're looking cut".
zh: ~z~托尼人呢？托尼人呢？你为什么不说「嗨埃文，你身材真棒」？

english: ~z~What do you care about the business? You got your fucking head in the clouds. Huh?
zh: ~z~现在倒关心起业务来了？你就是站着说话不腰疼。

english: ~z~And you'll probably blow yourself up as soon as you walk out the door. You ain't doing this.
zh: ~z~待会儿你一出门就把自己炸飞了。这事你做不了。

english: ~z~Okay. I know why you did that, so thank you. How'd it go?
zh: ~z~还好。我知道你为什么打我，谢谢你。还顺利吗？

english: ~z~Yeah I heard that before, T. If it's real this time, it's a good thing.
zh: ~z~之前也是这么说的，T。如果这次是认真的，那挺好。

english: ~z~Okay, I'm just going to admit that. Now would you shut the fuck up before I shut you up? Now where's Tony?
zh: ~z~这我不得不承认。你丫再不闭嘴，我帮你闭嘴。托尼在哪？

english: ~z~Thank you, partner. You should know that Evan's walked out on me. We're over.
zh: ~z~谢谢你，好兄弟。埃文已经和我分手了。我们结束了。

english: ~z~Ay Dios mio. Evan, look, I've always thought that, even for a coke pushing steroid junkie, you were a particular asshole,
zh: ~z~天哪。埃文，听着，我一直在想，放眼所有打类固醇的瘾君子，你也是最混蛋的那个。

english: ~z~Now fuck off, Evan. You gave him the pills. Be gone before I get back.
zh: ~z~快滚吧，埃文。你让他嗑上药的。在我回来之前消失。

english: ~z~You think you're a big shot. You're a nothing and soon you gonna be a dead nothing.
zh: ~z~真把自己当回事了。你是个鸡巴，过两天还会变成烂鸡巴。

english: ~z~Were you gonna let me take care of this explosive bullshit, or were you gonna insist on blowing yourself up?
zh: ~z~你是会让我出来安炸弹，还是会坚持把自己炸飞？

english: ~z~Who cares about fucking Tony? The man's a neurotic. He's back on drugs. He's looking old.
zh: ~z~谁他妈在乎托尼？那家伙是神经病。他天天嗑药，人老珠黄。

english: ~z~My business partner punched me out, my boyfriend left me, could this day get any worse?
zh: ~z~我的合伙人给了我一拳，我的男朋友离开了我，今天还能再糟一点吗？

english: ~z~Then break up with him for the last time and fuck off out of all of our lives. Please.
zh: ~z~那麻烦你赶紧和他分手，就此滚出我们的视线。求你了。

english: ~z~Don't underestimate it, Luis. The snatch has brought down empires bigger than our own.
zh: ~z~别低估女人，路易斯。娘们搞垮过比我们更大的帝国。

english: ~z~Oh, funny shit. One of the benefits of running a club is a thorough ID check on any potential interaction.
zh: ~z~哦，别开玩笑了。夜店经理的好处之一，就是对客人的身份知根知底。

english: ~z~Yeah you'll be holding back more than that, you fucking prick. Any debt Tony had died with him. Get the fuck out of here.
zh: ~z~是的，你要忍住的可多多了，他妈的混蛋。托尼欠的钱都一笔勾销了。赶紧消失吧。

english: ~z~Never trust a Mex to do a man's job. That's what my mamma taught me.
zh: ~z~永远不要把男人的工作交给老墨。这是妈妈教我的。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, if you weren't out chasing tail, and this was a two man operation like it should be,
zh: ~z~是啊，要不是你在外面瞎转悠，我们的合作经营肯定好好的。

english: ~z~Yeah, I can. I got better things to be doing than babysitting the snot nosed prick.
zh: ~z~能啊，怎么不能。比起照顾这个鼻涕虫，我还有更好的事情能做。

english: ~z~Shit, Tone. I wish you'd told me you got yourself in these kind of scrapes when you asked me to work for you.
zh: ~z~妈的，托尼。让我当你手下的时候你咋不说会遇到这种麻烦。

english: ~z~You hit him with some balls when I tell you to. You think you can that do for me, Louise?
zh: ~z~等我发话了，你就给他来几球。有没有信心，路易丝？

english: ~z~Listen, Lou, would you mind paying Mori a visit. He says he needs help with something.
zh: ~z~听着，卢，你能拜访下莫里吗？他说有事情需要帮忙。

english: ~z~I can't handle anything on my own. It's amazing I don't ask you to come take a piss for me.
zh: ~z~我一个人什么都不行。没让你帮我拉尿已经很不错了。

english: ~z~Running away from mobsters in a motherfucking golf cart? I think you got us here, T. Thanks for that.
zh: ~z~开着傻逼高尔夫球车摆脱黑帮？我看是你害的，T。谢谢你啊。

english: ~z~Pussy makes him do stranger things, but luckily I'm not susceptible to those perils like you are.
zh: ~z~娘们会让人失大智。好在我不会像你一样，遇到红颜祸水。

english: ~z~I need you to help me get some information out of this union prick who's decided to get an over inflated opinion of himself.
zh: ~z~我要你帮我从这个自以为是的工会傻逼嘴里问点话。

english: ~z~Oh really, Tone? When did you become the golf buggy specialist?
zh: ~z~真的假的，托尼？你什么时候成了高尔夫球车专家啊？

english: ~z~the wolves are baying for blood, and the guy who's meant to be my rock has become a bitter and cynical prick.
zh: ~z~嗜血的群狼环伺，该当我后盾的人却成了悲观刻薄的混蛋。

english: ~z~Okay, I'm helping with the shooting this time. You can't carry me through this like you did in Dim Sum Plaza.
zh: ~z~好了，这次我会帮着开枪的。你别想像上次在点心广场那样护着我了。

english: ~z~I know he's a bit of a schmuck, but we owe the man money and I don't want him anywhere near the clubs.
zh: ~z~我知道他有点混蛋，但我们欠着他钱，我不想让他靠近夜店。

english: ~z~Everything's gonna turn out just perfect, because Tony says so, and he never makes mistakes.
zh: ~z~结果一定很完美，因为托尼这么说了，而且他从不犯错。

english: ~z~Yo, T. I just love your new friends. Fucking fantastic guys.
zh: ~z~呦，T，我爱死你的新朋友了。都他妈是帮能人。

english: ~z~Alright, bro, cool. I mean shit, if you don't wanna save money. Car jacking makes economical sense, that's all. Later.
zh: ~z~好吧，兄弟，没事。他妈的，不想省钱就算了。抢车多经济实惠，就这。再见。

english: ~z~Oh, baa da boom. I'm sure I woulda found that funny if I spoke spic.
zh: ~z~噢，这人真是。我懂西语的话应该就能找到笑点了吧。

english: ~z~Push it, Lou. Come on. We're nowhere near top speed in this thing.
zh: ~z~油门踩到底，卢。快点。还没跑到这玩意的最高速度。

english: ~z~Don't worry, L. I ain't gonna chicken out on you like I did in Chinatown.
zh: ~z~别担心，L。这次我不会像上次在唐人街那样当缩头乌龟了。

english: ~z~If you think I signed up to be this boy scout mafioso's stooge with a big grin on my face...
zh: ~z~你以为我当这个黑手党小屁孩的狗腿子，是心甘情愿吗...

english: ~z~You think you're ready for that? You know who to grease when the licenses expire,
zh: ~z~你真觉得自己很能吗？营业执照过期了找谁打点？

english: ~z~Yo Rock, you've invested in the wrong clubs, man. Maybe Split Sides is more your vibe.
zh: ~z~哟，罗科，你这夜店买错了，哥们。喜剧俱乐部更适合你。

english: ~z~He doesn't! I don't think at least. Do you think he does? All that pent up suburban hard man angst.
zh: ~z~的确不是，至少我觉得不是。你觉得像吗？完全是乡下人装硬汉。

english: ~z~What happened to that Margot girl, anyway? She was nice. Or that English one, Rose, wasn't it?
zh: ~z~那个叫玛戈的姑娘怎么了？她挺不错的。还有那个英国人，罗斯是吧？

english: ~z~I don't actually. The kid might just want some company. Can you blame him?
zh: ~z~谁知道啊，说不定只是小屁孩想找人打球了。你能怪他吗？

english: ~z~Tony, shit, you got burrito breath. You ain't been eating Mexican again have you?
zh: ~z~托尼，你他妈一股卷饼味，是不是又吃墨西哥菜了？

english: ~z~You should get some T-shirts made, T. Get out of the nightclub business and concentrate on your philosophical sayings.
zh: ~z~你可以找人生产文化衫了，T。别搞夜店这行了，多写点至理名言吧。

english: ~z~Something's gonna have to go our way soon, Tone. I can feel it. See you soon, okay.
zh: ~z~总会有成功的机会的，托尼。我有预感。回见，好吗。

english: ~z~Sarcasm. Great. Just what I need right now. The world is crashing down around us,
zh: ~z~阴阳怪气，真棒。我现在可太需要了。天都快塌下来了，

english: ~z~Enjoy your youth, Luis. You don't appreciate it until it's over.
zh: ~z~珍惜青春年华，路易斯。只有失去了才会懂得珍惜。

english: ~z~Alright. Alright. Maybe I have taken you for granted. I'll change. I'll be better.
zh: ~z~好吧，好吧。是我想当然了。我会改的，我会变好的。

english: ~z~Yeah. Keep that smile on your face until after the whole Ancelotti family comes down on us.
zh: ~z~是啊。还搁那傻笑呢，我们马上就要被安切洛蒂家族追杀了。

english: ~z~Hey you know, I'm really warming to that guy. Like a bad case of crabs.
zh: ~z~我说，我可太喜欢他了，像喜欢死螃蟹一样喜欢。

english: ~z~Oh yeah, I'll look back on these years of getting shot at and helping you clean up puke as the best times of my life.
zh: ~z~是啊，我会怀念这段穿梭枪林弹雨、帮你清理呕吐物的美好时光的。

english: ~z~I know everything that happens in the clubs. I may be a washed up old has been, but I pay attention.
zh: ~z~店里就没有我不知道的事。我可能是有点过气了，但眼光还是有的。

english: ~z~You been reading my Lovemeet profile? "Lonely old has been seeks crazy coke head with bulging orange biceps."
zh: ~z~你看过我的觅爱网简介吗？「寂寞老男人，寻找拥有橙色饱满二头肌的可卡因疯子。」

english: ~z~This is a new Tony Prince you got here, L. Not that gunshy pussy you shleped through Chinatown.
zh: ~z~我现在是全新的托尼･普林斯，L。不是那个在唐人街被你护着的胆小鬼了。

english: ~z~Listen, Tone. Maybe you should take a holiday. Get down to Vice City. The Caribbean maybe.
zh: ~z~听着，托尼。你最好去度个假吧。去趟罪城，或者是加勒比。

english: ~z~Sorry, man, but I really got us in the shit here, Luis.
zh: ~z~对不起，伙计。碰上这种事都是我害的，路易斯。

english: ~z~Shit, I'm not nearly medicated enough to comtemplate what might happen next. See ya, Lou.
zh: ~z~妈的，嗑的药不够多，我都不敢想接下来会发生什么。再见，卢。

english: ~z~Because some of the girls I seen you with, I could swear their parents must have signed consent forms.
zh: ~z~跟你一块儿的姑娘里面，有几个好像都没到合法年龄吧？

english: ~z~Didn't it seem surprising that I wanted a violent criminal on board in the first place?
zh: ~z~谢谢你的阴阳怪气。光是会找残暴的罪犯搭伙就很奇怪了吧？

english: ~z~Yes. One of the joys of getting old is being ordered around by people below the age of consent in Utah.
zh: ~z~没错。中年人的一大乐趣就是被未成年小鬼使唤。

english: ~z~I guess I got to go car shopping, and before you suggest it, I'm not gonna let you "boost" one for me.
zh: ~z~只能去买新车了。我知道你想说啥，用不着你帮我去「搞」一辆车。

english: ~z~I left you to it, T. I thought you could handle this on your own. Sorry, bro.
zh: ~z~都交给你了，T。我还以为你一个人能行。抱歉，兄弟。

english: ~z~Toto don't get you killed nearly as much, if recent times is anything to go by.
zh: ~z~考虑到最近的遭遇，至少女人不会让你差点没命。

english: ~z~You don't ever let me into the serious shit. And you do deals without even telling me.
zh: ~z~管正经事没我的份。跟别人谈生意也不通知我一声。

english: ~z~Whenever I come to the clubs you ask me to run off on some stupid errand like a chump.
zh: ~z~我每次来夜店，都被你派出去干傻逼活，跟白痴一样。

zh: ~z~操，要是你和埃文算是模范夫妻，我还是敬而远之吧。

english: ~z~Fucking Rocco! After what happened in Chinatown, please tell me we gonna take a nine iron to his legs.
zh: ~z~傻逼罗科！在唐人街出了那种事，我们能不能往他腿上来一棍子？

english: ~z~Save the jokes until we're out of mobster shooting range. Can you do that for me? Yeesh.
zh: ~z~逃出这群黑帮的射程范围再讲笑话吧。替我着想一下吧，拜托了。

english: ~z~I feel you there, T. That guy is a social atom bomb. I'll go see him.
zh: ~z~我能理解，T。那家伙就是社交场所的泥石流。我会去找他的。

english: ~z~He's not going to be happy, either. I've got a feeling the prick's about to become even more insufferable.
zh: ~z~反正他绝对不会开心。我有种预感，这混蛋只会变本加厉。

english: ~z~I may have dumped us in the crap but sadly, for you and ME,
zh: ~z~我可能害得咱们掉进火坑。但很可悲，你我之中，

english: ~z~See it's me? Yes, you okay? So I am good? I'm good. Yes, okay.
zh: ~z~看，是我对吧？没问题吧？我能进了？我进去了？好，好嘞。

english: ~z~You should come back on a busier night then, normally it's wall to wall corpses by midnight.
zh: ~z~那你得见识下生意好的时候，没过零点就「尸体」遍地了。

zh: ~z~差点被人杀了当然火大，托尼。何况现在每天都在玩命。

zh: ~z~这女的对我没感觉，托尼。让罗科去找别的小白脸吧。

english: ~z~That's what I told 'em. Hey, I'm all good baby. How you doing, I.D?
zh: ~z~我就这么跟他们说的。嘿，我好得很，宝贝。你好啊，证件？

english: ~z~Don't we wish. No, sadly, he just wants you to talk to a lady in there.
zh: ~z~谁不想啊。可惜不是，他是要你去和店里的女士聊聊。

english: ~z~Yo, Mr. Lopez, if you ever got an opening at Maisonette, think of me.
zh: ~z~哟，洛佩兹先生，要是豪宅缺人手了，考虑一下我。

english: ~z~Gentlemen, my name's Tony Prince, I hope you're enjoying yourselves.
zh: ~z~先生们，我叫托尼･普林斯，希望二位玩得开心。

zh: ~z~勾引你的老熟人，在萨福克的Derrierre时装店工作的莫尼克。

english: ~z~Don't let anybody in, Maurice. And you better not say a fuckin' word to Vic.
zh: ~z~别让任何人进来，莫里斯。你最好一个字都别跟维克说。

english: ~z~What's gotten into you? Why you so moody, Luis? You should talk to someone.
zh: ~z~你怎么了？怎么这么火大，路易斯？找人疏导一下吧。

zh: ~z~叫我们去巴哈马干嘛？那种店不是罗科的最爱吗。

zh: ~z~总之，她男友惹恼了罗科，所以他要你去挖墙脚。

english: ~z~Oh Jesus, what did I do wrong? Take us to Bahama Mamas.
zh: ~z~噢天哪，怎么摊上了这种事？带我去巴哈马妈妈。

english: ~z~Okay, I see why you're upset. Get some rest and we'll talk soon.
zh: ~z~好啦，知道你为什么不高兴了。休息一下，回头再联系。

english: ~z~Monique? Shit, after that thing with her roommate, I don't think that's gonna fly.
zh: ~z~莫尼克？操，跟她室友那件事在先，我觉得不太可能。

english: ~z~Fuck! Monique's boyfriend wasn't in Venturas. The whole fucking club got shot to shit!
zh: ~z~操！莫尼克的男友不在文加斯。整家店都被打烂了！

english: ~z~You think having a past-it old queen on your arm is some kind of aphrodisiac? Just try and forget it's a job.
zh: ~z~和我这个过气基佬在一起能帮你壮阳吗？别把这次当成公事就行。

english: ~z~Sorry, T. I guess I was just excited about chillin' with all them Alderney girls. Another time, okay?
zh: ~z~对不起，T。可能是想到要约奥尔德尼的女人就兴奋过头了。下次再说吧，好吗？

english: ~z~Well, they're everywhere. That one over there is a TV starlet. That one there is a model.
zh: ~z~这个，到处都是啊。那边那位是电视新星。这位是个模特。

zh: ~z~都不知道他怎么会找上我们。总之，去那儿是因为他要你泡个妹子。

zh: ~z~这一天还是来了，T。你开始给我拉皮条了，我的自尊也丢完了。回见，兄弟。

zh: ~z~兄弟，放过我好吧？吃了药多米尼加打桩机就要暴走了。

zh: ~z~可不是！嗑着药和其他意大利佬炫耀肌肉确实是他的风格。

english: ~z~That one there I don't know, but I believe she just signed on with the Derriere campaign.
zh: ~z~那一位我不认识，但她刚刚签下Derriere的时装活动。
